title: Un pequeño gesto de Amor es un milagro cotidiano de Resistencia
body:
Publicado en Español, Inglés y Portugués.

---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWSPZiPbXc3FEBKPMVeqTsK5eNrTUpbs42xStYMq2CsmS/1779676632667.jpg) *Editado en PhotoCollage*
---


Buenas noches, deseo un sueño tranquilo después de un gesto de amor y humanidad.

Corren tiempos de caos que consumen nuestro planeta hermoso en un set de guerra y ambición. El odio de erige como bandera de muchos aún pidiendo muerte para sus hermanos de patria y sangre.

Necesitamos de amor y estaran en línea conmigo, cuando es necesario negarse a no creer que un mundo mejor es posible. Hagamos cada día algo que nos defina como humanos, como personas de bien. No es el cartel de falso samaritano, es intentar desde lo mas sensible compartir lo poco que tienes si asi le haces la vida mejor a alguien.

El hambre real y de amor desdibuja el mañana y convierte la piel de esta tierra en un mapa de ausencia. Y sin frenar su curso, la violencia se empodera porque alguien enseñó que el dolor era el único idioma posible. Y por otro lado sufren los niños cuando la tele exihibe juguetes que jamás tendrán, mientras aprende sin saberlo, que su lugar en el mundo era el de espectador.

El mundo se consume y nos vemos atados de pies y manos. Arde en titulares de violencia, cruje en vientres vacíos, se agrieta en fosas de desigualdad. Y ante eso, la lógica suele decir, un plato de comida no arregla el hambre estructural. Una palabra amable no desactiva una bomba. Un abrazo no redistribuye la riqueza.

Pero hay algo que esa lógica fría no entiende y que a los que nos queda algo de humanidad si entendemos. Estarán de acuerdo conmigo amigos.

Allá donde el hambre arraiga, lo que primero muere no es el cuerpo. Es la certeza de importar. Con la violencia pasa algo y es que no solo rompe huesos, rompe la fe en que el otro te vea como humano. Y bueno la desigualdad no hace menos, no solo quita recursos, arrebata la dignidad de sentirse parte de algo.

Y entonces, amigos, llega un gesto de amor.

No uno ruidoso y viral, no. Alguien que comparte su pan sin fotografías. Alguien que se sienta al lado del que llora y no dice \

. Alguien que protege a un niño del odio, aunque afuera el odio grite.

Ese gesto no derriba imperios. Pero hace algo más urgente y es  detener por un segundo la deshumanización. Le dice al corazón herido que todavía existe y aun pertenece a alguien y que todavía hay un lugar para el en esta tierra tan violenta.

Porque la violencia no vence solo con más fuerza. Vence cuando la gente se ve como enemigos o estadísticas. Y eso solo se recupera con actos diminutos, casi invisibles, que insisten en recordar lo obvio, el otro también es alguien e importa.

Quizá la humanidad no se salve con grandes planes. Quizá sobreviva porque, en medio del infierno, una mano tendida le recordó a otra que todavía no era tarde para ser tiernos.

Y eso, aunque los titulares lo ignoren, es la única revolución que vale la pena.

Porque un mundo que se consume puede ser apagado. Pero un alma que recibe un gesto de amor…
esa ya no se apaga más.

---
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)


---
---

# *ENGLISH*

---
---


Good evening. I wish for a peaceful sleep after a gesture of love and humanity.

These are chaotic times that consume our beautiful planet in a theater of war and ambition. Hatred rises as a flag for many, still demanding death for their brothers of homeland and blood.

We need love, and you will agree with me: we must refuse to stop believing that a better world is possible. Let us do something every day that defines us as human beings, as good people. Not as false Samaritans, but as those who try, from their most sensitive place, to share what little they have if it makes someone's life better.

Real hunger —and hunger for love— blurs tomorrow and turns the skin of this earth into a map of absence. And without stopping its course, violence becomes empowered because someone taught that pain was the only possible language. Meanwhile, children suffer when the TV shows toys they will never have, learning without knowing it that their place in the world is that of a spectator.

The world is consuming itself, and we find ourselves tied hand and foot. It burns in headlines of violence, creaks in empty bellies, cracks in pits of inequality. And faced with this, logic often says: a plate of food does not fix structural hunger. A kind word does not defuse a bomb. An embrace does not redistribute wealth.

But there is something that cold logic does not understand — something that those of us who still have some humanity left do understand. You will agree with me, friends.

Where hunger takes root, the first thing to die is not the body. It is the certainty of mattering. With violence, something similar happens: it not only breaks bones — it breaks the faith that others see you as human. And inequality does not just take resources; it snatches away the dignity of feeling like you belong to something.

And then, friends, a gesture of love arrives.

Not a loud or viral one, no. Someone shares their bread without photographs. Someone sits next to the one who cries and does not say \

Someone protects a child from hatred, even though outside, hatred screams.

That gesture does not bring down empires. But it does something more urgent: it stops dehumanization for a second. It tells the wounded heart that it still exists, that it still belongs to someone, that there is still a place for it in this violent species.

Because violence is not defeated by greater force alone. It is defeated when people stop seeing each other as enemies or statistics. And that can only be restored through tiny, almost invisible acts that insist on remembering the obvious: the other person is also someone, and they matter.

Perhaps humanity will not be saved by grand plans. Perhaps it will survive because, in the middle of hell, an outstretched hand reminded another that it was not yet too late to be tender.

And that —though the headlines ignore it— is the only revolution worth fighting for.

Because a world that is consumed can be extinguished. But a soul that receives a gesture of love…
That one will never be put out again.

---
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)


---
---

# *PORTUGUÉS*

---
---


Boa noite. Desejo um sono tranquilo depois de um gesto de amor e humanidade.

Correm tempos de caos que consomem o nosso belo planeta num cenário de guerra e ambição. O ódio ergue-se como bandeira para muitos, ainda pedindo morte para seus irmãos de pátria e sangue.

Precisamos de amor, e vocês concordarão comigo: é preciso recusar a ideia de que um mundo melhor não é possível. Façamos todos os dias algo que nos defina como humanos, como pessoas de bem. Não é o cartaz de falso samaritano, é tentar, a partir do que temos de mais sensível, partilhar o pouco que você tem, se isso fizer a vida de alguém melhor.

A fome real — e a fome de amor — desfaz o amanhã e transforma a pele desta terra num mapa de ausências. E sem frear o seu curso, a violência se fortalece porque alguém ensinou que a dor era a única língua possível. Enquanto isso, as crianças sofrem quando a TV exibe brinquedos que nunca terão, aprendendo sem saber que o seu lugar no mundo era o de espectador.

O mundo se consome e nos vemos de mãos e pés atados. Arde em manchetes de violência, range em ventres vazios, racha em fossos de desigualdade. E diante disso, a lógica costuma dizer: um prato de comida não resolve a fome estrutural. Uma palavra amável não desativa uma bomba. Um abraço não redistribui a riqueza.

Mas há algo que essa lógica fria não entende — e que aqueles de nós que ainda têm um pouco de humanidade entendem. Vocês vão concordar comigo, amigos.

Onde a fome se enraíza, o que primeiro morre não é o corpo. É a certeza de ser importante. Com a violência acontece algo parecido: ela não só quebra ossos, mas quebra a fé de que o outro te vê como humano. E a desigualdade não só tira recursos: ela arranca a dignidade de se sentir parte de algo.

E então, amigos, chega um gesto de amor.

Não um gesto barulhento ou viral, não. Alguém que partilha o seu pão sem fotografias. Alguém que se senta ao lado de quem chora e não diz \

. Alguém que protege uma criança do ódio, mesmo que lá fora o ódio grite.

Esse gesto não derruba impérios. Mas faz algo muito mais urgente: interrompe a desumanização por um segundo. Diz ao coração ferido que ele ainda existe, que ainda pertence a alguém, que ainda há um lugar para ele nesta espécie tão violenta.

Porque a violência não se vence só com mais força. Ela se vence quando as pessoas deixam de se ver como inimigas ou estatísticas. E isso só se recupera com atos minúsculos, quase invisíveis, que insistem em lembrar o óbvio: o outro também é alguém e também importa.

Talvez a humanidade não se salve com grandes planos. Talvez ela sobreviva porque, no meio do inferno, uma mão estendida lembrou outra de que ainda não era tarde para ser gentil.

E isso — embora os titulares ignorem — é a única revolução que vale a pena.

Porque um mundo que se consome pode ser apagado. Mas uma alma que recebe um gesto de amor…
Essa já não se apaga mais.

body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![pT4qmPGB8ovjjlxt_IMG_9605.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/pT4qmPGB8ovjjlxt_IMG_9605/pT4qmPGB8ovjjlxt_IMG_9605.webp)
![mk3Y5O0rtBx8vNBn_IMG_9606.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/mk3Y5O0rtBx8vNBn_IMG_9606/mk3Y5O0rtBx8vNBn_IMG_9606.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天第一次吃自己做的凉拌秋葵，没想到随手一做，味道着实惊艳。原本组里中午安排了聚餐，不过上午九点多我要去中医院做头皮微针理疗，想着做完治疗再专程骑车赶回南区那边吃饭，太过浪费时间，于是便跟组长说明情况缺席聚餐，能察觉到对方神色略有不悦。只是我实在懒得来回折腾，索性就安心在家吃饭了。

结束理疗回到家，我便着手准备午饭，第一次解锁凉拌秋葵，以往我从没采购过这种食材，早先就听同事赞过它的口感，前几天老公点外卖，不晓得店家怎多送出一袋秋葵，我就先将秋葵焯水断生，随后调配简易酱汁，蒜末搭配蒸鱼豉油和香醋，浇上热油激出香味，这么简单的调料真的巨鲜香，做这道菜也太简单了！

第二道菜用的是剩余的兔腿肉，直接放进空气炸锅，随意码料，用了烧烤粉、食用油和料酒调味，大概烤制二十多分钟便出锅，肉块粘连在一起，比起干煸味道稍逊一筹，但全程无油烟操作，也是方便。

最后还炖煮了一锅乱炖，食材都是从山姆选购而来，有机胡萝卜，嫩滑豆腐，搭配冷冻处理的花甲肉，还有菌菇与西兰花一同焖煮，非常清淡。

主食就吃全谷物粗粮饭，再加点黑莓和番茄，发给朋友看，她说我吃得太全面了，哈哈！

上次逛山姆，除了采购食材，尝试新菜品，还入手了一台爱丽思桌面循环小风扇，昨天心血来潮重新布置餐桌，挪走体积偏大的装饰花瓶后，桌面瞬间宽敞许多。如今桌上摆放上新入手的养生壶与小风扇，用餐空间豁然开朗。独自享用美味餐食，闲适惬意，满满都是独处的幸福感。

title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《女扮男装被千岁爷相中了要给我封妃》（刘润铭x王云云）
body:
![IMG_5208](https://s1.img-e.com/20260404/69d120a5afd63.jpeg)

看这部剧的时候我还闹了个大乌龙，这部剧名太长没显示完整导致我直接打开了第三季。我说咋男女主进度条拉那么快怎么开篇就是要休妻，仔细一看发现原来不是开头！

从剧情的角度来说，现代金牌杀手死于意外魂穿同名同姓的古代女子身上。女主父亲战死沙场她母亲将其当作男孩子养大，随着年岁渐长身份眼看着要隐瞒不住了。

她预备带着母亲跑路的档口，不知怎么就被权倾朝野的千岁爷看上并带回府内。男主的人设偏阴湿心狠手辣那挂的，在跟女扮男装的女主互动中几番怀疑自己的性向。

就光看第一季的内容的话，我觉得男主对女主与其说爱不如说是「对未知事物」的兴趣「对自己物品」的占有欲和控制欲，女主身上大大小小的上直接间接来自于他。

我看到评论区有姐妹说恨不得结局BE，而此刻的女主想必也是没爱上男主的。原本女主假死脱身眼看就成功了，但是不怕坏人恶毒就怕坏人有智商，男主一秒就看破时候。

从演员的角度来说，男女主绝对是颜值演技在线的。男主我印象不太深应该看过他的剧，女主王云云实在太熟悉啦。这部剧里她的妆容很淡依然很美，底子是真的好。

总的来说，剧本身的可看性很强，火速去看后续啦。


（本篇完）

title: Dutton Ranch:   It's an old formula, but one that still works
body:
I might be jumping the gun on this just a tad but it doesn't take long before Dutton Ranch starts to feel very familiar. So far, although the cast of characters are much smaller, it seems a great deal like Yellowstone but without as large a cast of characters and the big price tag of Kevin Costner. Will it be good? Well that's tough to say after one episode because although I do like the formula of the Duttons being ass-kickers that have their own unique way of dealing with bad people without using the law, it does feel like a candy bar that I really like repackaged with a different name on it. It kind of feels like cheating.
https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/ys-513-070924-sc24-25-26-em-00030-r2-1-6759b57db836c.jpg?crop=0.460xw:0.690xh;0.256xw,0.255xh&resize=1200:* [src](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/ys-513-070924-sc24-25-26-em-00030-r2-1-6759b57db836c.jpg?crop=0.460xw:0.690xh;0.256xw,0.255xh&resize=1200:*)
They seem to just be picking through the most popular characters from the Yellowstone series and running with all of them. I have enjoyed all of the prequels but I have to give the thumbs down to *Marshals* which I think simply isn't very good and that the main actor and his actor child are just awful. But at least in the case of *Dutton Ranch* basically everyone thought that Rip and Beth were excellent characters. The problem now is, how do we build a story around them? At the conclusion of *Yellowstone* everyone knows and respects them, and there really isn't much else for them to go with that since so much of the story revolved around Costner's character. I do like how they didn't really feel as though a long and drawn out explanation was necessary though and they just get right to it in the first 10 minutes when a fire starts and completely wipes out their ranch in Montana or wherever it was meant to take place and instead of rebuilding they just move to Texas.
https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/RP_108_EM_1202_00494_RT2.jpg?w=2000&h=1126&crop=1 [src](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/RP_108_EM_1202_00494_RT2.jpg?w=2000&h=1126&crop=1)
Through great wealth, or so it is presumed, they quickly establish a large ranch and it is immediately successful but that brings about the jealousy of a rival family that has been in that part of Texas for a very long time and wants to protect what they have by any means necessary. This seems awfully familiar, it's almost like *Yellowstone* but the shoe is on the other foot this time. The Dutton's as far as I have watched do not get rattled and are kind, fair, but also stern with everyone that they meet and they have a unique way of intimidating those that get in their way that is very familiar because it is exactly the sort of things we saw in the original series Whether or not a person can enjoy this I think depends a great deal on whether or not you are really tired of this entire process that was done so many times in *Yellowstone*. I don't really know exactly where the story is going but it does seem to directly mirror the original series and for the most part, I am ok with that. However, I can't treat this series as if it was a priority because even though it is a putting one of my favorite albums on repeat, it is still something I have seen before.
https://fwtx.com/downloads/54488/download/DuttonRanch.jpeg?cb=6314f823819c674d3954b0a1155d0fe8 [src](https://fwtx.com/downloads/54488/download/DuttonRanch.jpeg?cb=6314f823819c674d3954b0a1155d0fe8)
One thing that the showrunners have always done really well is to make the scenery the star of the show and they aren't as able to do this with Texas being the location because Texas is flat and simply isn't going to have the awe-inspiring shots that they were able to pull off in the far north of the USA. It's still lovely though. Instead of having the American Indians be the marginalized group that they are friends with they now have Mexican Americans and I can see that becoming more and more of a focus here as well. I don't really know what to expect but I can tell after a single episode that Paramount knows they have a good product here and just had to figure out a way to repackage it and get people to buy it again. I don't believe this one will go over as well as the previous show or the 2 prequels, but it is still better than most anything else that is on TV right now. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qCF7CY6LUo

Should I watch it

I think if you enjoyed the original you will like this too if you can push past the fact that there really isn't but so much rivalry that you can put into a ranch sort of situation and yes, the stuff from *Yellowstone* will be repeated. If you haven't seen *Yellowstone* this will appeal to you as well because it isn't necessary to know the backstory from that show (for the most part) in order to enjoy this. I probably wont watch it as adamantly as I did the original but it is still great story-telling, even if it is re-used.
![photodune-6774981-recommended-grunge-red-stamp-xs-643x272.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/netflixr/2424GudAc7bFr8LHXNQd8JLsDNgGoxs5MdjkNGMffLso1dZZdkwAvVmdd5ooMynWyTa3r.jpg) This is currently only legally streamable on Paramount+

>

Bueno realmente ahora terminé participando a última hora ya que no me venía canción a la mente, supongo que aún el no saber que pasará conmigo y el postgrado me tiene la cabeza super mal. Ahora que es casi dictado que reprobe y estoy fuera del postgrado, me dolió más de lo que esperaba, aún la coordinadora no nos llama o da el anuncia, toca esperar y ver. >Well I actually ended up joining at the last minute because I couldn't think of a song. I guess not knowing what's going to happen with me and the graduate program is really messing with my head. Now that it's almost a foregone conclusion that I'll fail and be out of the program, it hurts more than I expected. The coordinator still hasn't called us or made an announcement, so we'll just have to wait and see.
Hola gente linda de la comunidad de HIVE OPEN MIC por acá @eudarcabello y esta vez para participar en la semana 319 que se titula Forever and ever. No quise dejar este post para último momento, siempre haciendo el maximo esfuerzo para mantenerme posteando a tiempo en la semana, esta vez paso y no quise fallar, espero mantenerme puntual de ahora en más, de verdad. Las evaluaciones del postgrado estan con fuerza, esto me lleva loco de verdad, tambien con el trabajo de grado, sigo medio perezoso. Recordando que me dieron la oportunidad de continuar con este postgrado de Biología Marina, así que toca seguir dando más, despues de todo si quiero lograr este titulo de magister y capaz ahora si logre enamorarme del area Marina. La canción seleccionada creo que terminó siendo super romantica, la verdad nunca me dedique a aprendermela, pero es ahora cuando leí y acomode montón parte de la letra que tenía en mi cabeza, la canción es de las más bonitas de a cantante puertorriqueña Kany Garcia y titula \

. No quise seguir pensando a ver si se me ocurria otra canción, conforme de como resulto mi elección para esta semana, sin dudas necesitaba hacerla, capaz es dedicada a mi amor por la Biología en el pregrado que se enfocaba a las plantas terrestres, así que me pareció oportuno. >Hello, everyone in the HIVE OPEN MIC community! It’s @eudarcabello here, and this time I’m participating in Week 319, titled “Forever and Ever.” I didn’t want to leave this post until the last minute—I always try my hardest to post on time each week, but this time I slipped up and didn’t want to let you down. I hope to stay on schedule from now on, for real. Graduate school exams are in full swing—this is really driving me crazy—and I’m also working on my thesis, though I’m still a bit lazy. I’m reminded that I was given the opportunity to continue this graduate program in Marine Biology, so I need to keep pushing myself. After all, I want to earn this master’s degree, and maybe now I’ll finally fall in love with the marine field. I think the song I chose ended up being super romantic. To be honest, I never really bothered to learn it by heart, but it wasn’t until now that I read and pieced together a lot of the lyrics I had in my head. The song is one of the most beautiful by the Puerto Rican singer Kany Garcia, and it’s titled “Para siempre.” I didn’t want to keep thinking about whether another song might come to mind; I’m happy with how my choice turned out for this week. I definitely needed to do this—maybe it’s dedicated to my love for biology during my undergraduate studies, which focused on terrestrial plants, so it seemed fitting.

title: Isn't Rainy Season Yet / Monday / Olongapo City
body:
![IMG_20260525_103549.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNyg4jJkuBSDFB7zWdKexoeCdztziZ8NLP4YcmHd7n9bt/IMG_20260525_103549.jpg)

### Isn't Rainy Season Yet
It's still summer, but we can already sense the coming of the rainy season. We've been having some rain in our province over the past few days. In other places, especially in the city, flooding is being experienced. It has brought back the flood control issue, which became big news in our country because it became a source of corruption.
Meanwhile, I saw on the news that a huge rock fell from a mountain and struck a vehicle. Fortunately, the passengers and the driver are safe. The intense rain was believed to be the cause of the incident.
Well, it isn't the rainy season yet, but these incidents are happening already. Hopefully, the rainy season won't be bad. That's what we're hoping for because our country is prone to weather disasters.

### Monday
Last night has been a struggle sleeping because of the extremely hot weather. Besides, we had some coffee yesterday which affected our sleep last night. 

### Olongapo City 
We had this walk in Olongapo City. It was so hot that time. It reminded me of the first time when I have been here around 30 years ago, and it was also hot during that time.

title: An \
Sunday!
body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejBcVYp4SCrvtuX4HZiW8gWo1vAm6Lkd31gbPbrpiUma/1779676738429.jpg)

Hello friends!
Happy  #aliveandthriving Sunday evening to you, and thank you for your visit!
✨🙋🏻‍♀️✨ 

So friends, this evening I have just a few photos of my #aliveandthriving Sunday that I would like to share with you. 
So first the day started after taking care of the Kitties here and house chores with feeding Dozer. I had not seen him for a few days and thought they might have moved him, but no he was still there living under the floor of the old shad next door, and today he came out to see me!
Here I just tossed him a head of lettuce - he's eyeing it,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb2gL6ozSE43DNZti4Huq1z2shAp8FFujhPv9F5ongXEU/1779676764819.jpg)

And then he decided to stop wasting time and go for it,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcu39EGM8BuhUj9G4rPuTdc96ntZ5eYwe7M5REZp7bi4E/1779676776420.jpg)

And all done - already!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYTEP2KEhtnoYt8viYxLTMW8ZLK8B8BLasm6F2NwG8eJy/1779676788969.jpg)

I love this guy, and he has gotten to where he \

that is truly awesome!

A little later in the afternoon I went out again, and drove over to the Park instead of taking the bike. It gave me a little better opportunity to walk around.
So first the Fishing Pier had quite a few people,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaQwxMZE1RLGf8neopUp4LNxVsEwQeVaJm3xE2iNQ7kxF/1779676832697.jpg)

And these guys came in from fishing in the Channel,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmScDm8VN3YA2856P7tuqK3Kg3XUdcTpyobADF2hnrSkP8/1779676846484.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPyAT6YAg8fkNjyNeToLdp8p4WQ4kDH9FdpL77iUQs5Bs/1779676846620.jpg)

Then I caught something I had not seen before! Unfortunately the wingtip is out of the frame but...
I caught a Seagull carrying Seagrass in its beak! I am sure they must do this all the time - but I have never seen it before!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme54CYJX9a2BXZwmjVYe5LBPY2mZK7152vUYow8qkUFYg/1779676879190.jpg)

And something else I saw for the first time this year, a Grass skipper on a Sea Oxeye Daisy!
Here it's wings are closed,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWz4JzCGzJhwHrmRNhncj3udHDCMkEwr7EvNwCCyxtrSZ/1779676904167.jpg)

And here starting to open,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeEbSuwjdtHuqYr3zxFwV26N7t7aTJDwJbY4YAkXdN9zn/1779676913148.jpg)

Since it was not opening them further I walked over to the side and got this view,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWJymy9Vr7ZVS8TmgLdiKkJz9wBsnrgP2PxkBRkEz9JS2/1779676921270.jpg)

These Grass skippers are kind of rare by the water, they are mostly in lawns - but here is one!

And finally, a look at the Shade Structure today - somewhat \

,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUWMw8HPHZZrmyvnZMovT1pSyvC825PfGFs91fsCH2xKD/1779676932436.jpg)

And some other people heading back out,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdb15aotVJBpCVC5NGauoPdwPtkqA2f2TaxcZBfqgN4kn/1779676960333.jpg)

And that was my #aliveandthriving Sunday!
I want to thank you again for your visit and I am Wishing you a Very Blessed, Happy, and Safe New-Week!

title: [EN/PT] Gabi’s    Birthday
body: > # [EN] Today was my wife’s cousin Gabi’s birthday, and we were invited to have lunch at a seaside restaurant. The place is very pleasant, facing the meeting point between the sea and the tide, which makes the view even more beautiful. On top of that, the food is really good, with a homemade style that fits the atmosphere perfectly. We ordered a portion of garlic shrimp, fried fish, and fish steaks, all served with that delicious fish pirão. The celebration was very intimate, with only close family gathered to celebrate Gabi’s birthday. We ate a lot, talked a lot, and for a few hours we were able to forget a little about the problems of everyday life. It was a very enjoyable day. The only less enjoyable part was the financial side of it: transportation, food, and also the birthday gift. My wife picked out a very thoughtful gift, and it was up to me to figure out how to cover all those expenses. It’s funny how, just when we decide to save money and slow down a bit, occasions like this always seem to come up. At the end of the afternoon, Gabi’s husband invited us to sing happy birthday with a small cake and some savory snacks. It was a really nice moment, especially for the birthday girl. Some people truly enjoy celebrating dates like this, and it’s nice to see. I’m a bit more reserved and usually prefer not to celebrate these occasions as much, but I do enjoy being present for these family moments. In the end, it was a special day filled with good food, good conversations, and quality time with family. I hope you enjoyed this little story! ---- # [PT] Hoje foi aniversário da prima da minha esposa, a Gabi, e fomos convidados para almoçar em um restaurante à beira-mar. O ambiente é muito agradável, de frente para o encontro do mar com a maré, o que deixa tudo ainda mais bonito. Além disso, a comida é muito boa, com aquele estilo caseiro que combina perfeitamente com o lugar. Pedimos porção de camarão ao alho, peixe frito e peixe em posta, tudo acompanhado daquele delicioso pirão de peixe. A comemoração foi bem reservada, apenas com a família reunida para celebrar o aniversário da Gabi. Comemos bastante, conversamos bastante e, por algumas horas, conseguimos esquecer um pouco os problemas do dia a dia. Foi um dia muito agradável. A única parte menos divertida foi a financeira: transporte, alimentação e ainda o presente da aniversariante. Minha esposa escolheu um presente bem caprichado, e sobrou para mim me virar com todos esses gastos. É incrível como, justamente quando a gente decide economizar e pisar no freio, sempre aparece alguma ocasião assim. No fim da tarde, o marido da Gabi nos chamou para cantar os parabéns com um pequeno bolo e alguns salgados. Foi um momento bem legal, principalmente para a aniversariante. Tem gente que realmente gosta de celebrar essas datas, e isso é bonito de ver. Eu já sou mais reservado e prefiro não comemorar tanto, mas gosto de estar presente nesses momentos com a família. Enfim, foi um dia especial, com boa comida, boas conversas e tempo de qualidade em família. Espero que tenham gostado desse pequeno relato! --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@elderdark/en-pt-gabis-birthday)

title: La diversidad cultural cubana: el desafío de sostener la creación en medio de la crisis
body:
La diversidad cultural cubana: el desafío de sostener la creación en medio de la crisis

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaiHgaufQ2E5NK7k5avdyUWXxtaCw3SANC9o2ZpuBxb8k/1779676669371.png)

Cuba es un archipiélago donde la diversidad cultural no es un eslogan, sino un tejido vivo forjado por siglos de migraciones, mestizajes y resistencias. De la confluencia española, africana, china, caribeña y, más tarde, de influencias globales, nació una identidad que se expresa en la música, la danza, el teatro, las artes visuales, la literatura y el cine. Sin embargo, detrás de esa riqueza simbólica, reconocida internacionalmente, se esconde una paradoja dolorosa: el país enfrenta crecientes dificultades para garantizar que el público acceda a esa pluralidad de manifestaciones artísticas, y para que los creadores puedan producir sin que la precariedad se convierta en una forma de censura material.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWkHQwdiMt65AKBGVFyiNJn6DrmEJ8yeXqnPVJusvkiPj/1779676690533.jpg)


La crisis económica que atraviesa la isla, agravada en los últimos años por la pandemia, las sanciones internacionales y las ineficiencias estructurales, ha impactado de lleno en el ecosistema cultural. Los teatros reducen funciones por falta de climatización o reparaciones, las galerías luchan contra la escasez de materiales básicos, los festivales se encogen o desaparecen, y los rodajes cinematográficos dependen casi por completo de fondos externos. No se trata solo de una carencia de recursos: es una erosión progresiva de la infraestructura que sostiene la vida artística, que convierte cada estreno en un acto heroico.

A esta fragilidad material se suma la emigración masiva de artistas, un fenómeno que ha vaciado elencos, colectivos y escenas enteras. La salida del país no responde únicamente a la búsqueda de mejores condiciones económicas; es también la consecuencia de un contexto donde la innovación tropieza con trabas burocráticas, donde la gestión cultural oscila entre el control estatal y la falta de políticas efectivas de estímulo, y donde el creador independiente navega en una zona gris que lo deja sin amparo legal ni acceso a financiamiento. Así, la diversidad que sobrevive en la Isla tiende a concentrarse en los circuitos turísticos o en pequeñas burbujas comunitarias, mientras el gran público queda progresivamente desconectado de propuestas que no logran materializarse.

El acceso del ciudadano común a las manifestaciones artísticas se ha vuelto un reto mayúsculo. La red de instituciones culturales, antaño orgullo del proyecto revolucionario, sufre hoy un deterioro visible. Bibliotecas sin libros actualizados, cines que cierran o proyectan solo ocasionalmente, museos con salas clausuradas y una programación errática. A ello se suman los apagones, la falta de transporte y la desconexión digital, que limitan no solo la movilidad hacia los espacios culturales, sino también la difusión de las obras. En un país donde la electricidad falta durante horas, el arte digital, el cine y la música grabada ven cortado su principal canal de llegada a los hogares.

Paradójicamente, la creación no se detiene. Brota en talleres improvisados, en plataformas digitales precarias, en festivales que se resisten a morir. El problema es la desconexión entre esa efervescencia y la posibilidad de que el público la disfrute. La diversidad cultural cubana está viva, pero se encuentra cercada por una tormenta perfecta: escasez, diáspora, burocracia y un modelo de gestión que no termina de reconocer la legitimidad de los actores independientes. Proveer de arte a la sociedad en estas condiciones no es solo cuestión de voluntad, sino de construir un entorno donde la cultura deje de ser un sobreviviente para volver a ser un derecho pleno y cotidiano.


👇
Recuerda que estos contenidos no los voy a dejar mucho tiempo. Por favor lea e interiorice

title: Sunday Gym Vibes 💪✨ / Domingo en el Gym 💪✨
body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeNgzWwfZqGUeqDvudTY8kPeNxkNj6NPxWUJExewTpfdZ/IMG_8538.jpg 

Here I am at the gym on a Sunday. While many people are resting, I decided to keep going and stay consistent with my routine. There’s something special about training on a Sunday — it feels calmer, more peaceful, but still full of purpose. It’s like a quiet reminder that discipline doesn’t take days off.

Sometimes it’s not about going all out, but simply showing up and doing what you can. Being here today makes me feel proud, because I know I’m building habits that will last. Every workout, even on a Sunday, is a step forward.

I feel focused, grateful, and motivated to keep pushing. Because at the end of the day, this is not just about the gym… it’s about becoming stronger in every way. 💪✨

Aquí estoy en el gym en domingo. Mientras muchos descansan, yo decidí seguir y mantener mi constancia. Hay algo especial en entrenar en domingo — se siente más tranquilo, más en calma, pero igual con propósito. Es como un recordatorio silencioso de que la disciplina no descansa.

A veces no se trata de dar el máximo, sino de simplemente venir y hacer lo que se pueda. Estar aquí hoy me hace sentir orgullosa, porque sé que estoy construyendo hábitos que se van a quedar conmigo. Cada entrenamiento, incluso en domingo, es un paso más.

Me siento enfocada, agradecida y motivada para seguir. Porque al final, esto no es solo el gym… es crecer en todos los sentidos. 💪✨

title: Weekend & Yongi
body:
Hola Monday💚 And the new week arrived uneventfully. Well, except for my lil boy, who seems to be in a different mood, he keeps howling as he plays (outside). It's been a while since he went running, so it's understandable. Probably just ecstatic to be out in the open, lol! Anyhow, we drove to the Lil Kingdom (our old place) yesterday afternoon for an engagement. While we don't live there anymore, we are still part of the community, so keep the connection and participate in its activities. The visit turned out to be fruitful and engaging, so we stayed until early evening. We did have another purpose on the drive—to pick up the hollow blocks we ordered previously. We used the truck and detoured to the aggregates center before proceeding to our old place. Here, the LilGuy was waiting curiously and *joyfully* as they loaded the heavy stuff at the back.
||| |-|-| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23xebSLDYM81FB9FdDfvxWeYyxpyBxvkkqwBVkXvevzTPqH4TatzPaqLSmDgdQFztT5u2.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23wWyBwweesY8BZuzppUwjbKBFyTpL2JswGmDCv9cdsyRBSDcs7PKxwsh4HQHzKNGfUCR.jpg|
After a while, he sensed the presence of an aspin nearby and started growling at it nonstop, while blowing (stepping on) the horn. As I mentioned a couple of times before, he isn't very friendly to others and is easily aggravated by anything that moves, lol!
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23zRvaUhQLwZUCFbhVjVS1V2apJQRDuSn8L1ZXg2iHLWMWMv4DDThYNodGW8ZCPK2fJWn.gif
A couple of folks commented that we spoiled him too much, and they are probably right. It made me look back a few years, and like these days, we always bring him wherever we go, so he wasn't deprived of exposure to people. Some would even hold and touch him before, but for whatever reason, he changed and became rather antisocial as he grew up (he's turning 3 in August). Oh well, I digressed. That wasn't supposed to be the day's story, but it ended that way. It's okay, of course. That's how ramblings go, yeah😂 Anyway, the hubby went to the other town to meet the new boys. Hopefully, they will agree on things, so they can start working sooner, either here in DD or at the other farms, wherever they prefer. Meanwhile, Yongi and I will be having a more laid-back start to the week. Cheers to a fabulous one!🥂

title: My Actifit Report Card: May 25 2026
body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g84de5f0a578272c30c14577a6fe66d4a04500ba12c2613a43d27792036d91de70dd164e5861b9902fc600967c372fbf22c6a40cb490f282b88db42153f190d45_640.jpg)
Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente revitalizante. Empecé mi recorrido en el parque central, donde vi a un grupo de personas practicando yoga al aire libre. Me llamó la atención una mujer que parecía ser instructora; su energía era contagiosa y se notaba que disfrutaba compartir ese momento con los demás. Mientras continuaba mi camino, pasé por una pequeña cafetería y conocí a un artista callejero que estaba pintando un gran mural. Se llamaba Luis y me contó que había estado trabajando en este proyecto durante semanas. Su pasión por el arte era evidente y me mostró algunas de sus obras en una carpeta. También vi a un grupo de niños jugando en una plaza cercana, riendo y disfrutando del día soleado. Me hizo recordar la importancia de disfrutar los pequeños momentos y la alegría de estar al aire libre. A medida que avanzaba, cada esquina de la ciudad parecía contar una historia diferente, y eso siempre me motiva a seguir explorando y conociendo más sobre el lugar donde vivo. Sin duda, fue una caminata que llenó mi día de energía y buenas vibras. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title: Book Review: The Power of Now by Eckhart Tolle (A New Concept)
body:
![123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/EoGytUQRG764ahkrWpPs6K7aKE7Nnq6YiAL63oP4RQdsTnVP626iviFgpZDkv43dUvy.jpg)
Hello everyone, Welcome to a new concept from a book I reviewed in 2025. This time, I chose to share more light on my knowledge from the book. I have always believed that a book could teach you more than one thing or give you more than a single insight. So today's writing will be another lesson concept from the book The Power of Now by Eckhart Tolle, but my new concept will be # BE PRESENT Before I move on to share more light, here is a previous article I wrote last year about the book, if you would like to read it for more context. [Book Review: The Power of Now](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@samostically/book-review-the-power-of-now-4dw) The concept of being in the present brought me to this book review. I share in the statement from the author of the book, Eckhart Tolle, that *realize deeply that the present moment is all you ever have.* This makes you understand it is all about enjoying what you have now at the given time instead of focusing on what is not there. The author seeks to share that the human mind is usually somewhere else, dealing with something else. Be it mistakes, regrets, missed opportunities, or painful memories, or they decide to use my memo, that is, worry about the future, especially within the area of worries, goals, fears, and imagined outcomes. This clouds the mind with things that are not present or things that are gone. The author argues that the ability of the mind to ponder a lot of things causes distraction in our brains. When I look at it, there is some solid point here, especially when my mind runs wild. I have seen that the conception of my mind being noisy is because of how I have paid so much attention to a lot of things. I will think of this, and I am not yet done; I am already running on the next thought. This is interesting to me because I have a loop within a loop when it comes to my mind. This is what I mean, I could be thinking about an apple, and after spending a couple of minutes on the apple, I begin to ask myself questions like why was the apple created, how did it come to live and when did it come to life? This is what a loop within a loop looks like, and it is every easy to get roped in when you keep asking more and more questions. Although this can be a good means of learning something new because it is kind of the fuel for curiosity, at least in my opinion, it can create noise. Something like this is what it means for the mind to be noisy. Take it back to the book, and I am already seeing why the author claims that humans find it difficult to be in the present, and in our defence, it is not to be present in a given time like this. There is a lot competing for our attention in the world of today, and there is definitely a lot going on in the world. This alone is enough for our minds to get busy, making it hard to be present. The understanding of the past is gone, and the future is yet to happen, but the present is now, a strong tool to have and remind oneself about. We have to remember to appreciate the things around us, the people we see, what we are doing, and the fact that we are alive and breathing, as these are micro steps towards the direction of being present. Also, engage in the community around you and appreciate the little things, for nothing is guaranteed.
___ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)

I am @samostically, a chess player and writer. I love to share the experience I have gained from different battles over the 64 squares and the knowledgeable insights from books I have read. > Hola amigos espero que se encuentren bien, @lmac nos trae la ronda 251 del Concurso Hagamos un Collage, nos dejan esta imagen de @m1alsan, para que demos rienda suelta a nuestra imaginación... ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYwxCZNWfWjWeFyaXPd9sritJ3YW6Defx9bbFSxH4QEQ9/imagen.png)
Por un muelle de madera cruza ella, despacio desde la choza de paja, donde el ocaso pinta el sentimiento de un mundo que parece suspendido. Allí va Alicia en blanco y negro sosteniendo un corazón que quiere elevar, su corazón palpita, no encuentra sosiego, a sus lados ve delfines nadar. Su alma voladora no deja de soñar, los globos flotan libres, fingiendo volar, y la luna dorada es un pañuelo que alumbra este rincón tan bonito y puro. Es un viaje al espacio del deseo, donde la tierra se une con el mar, un tierno y surrealista titubeo de un alma que no deja de soñar.

English Version

We've reached week 189 of the Hive Music Festival, which speaks to almost four years of sustained work and effort from the @musiczone community to maintain this virtual space for sharing and growing, not only musically but also in other ways. This week, I'm sharing my version of a song popularized by the unforgettable Spanish vocalist Nino Bravo in 1970. It's the song \

(I love you, I love you).\n\nThe theme of this song is that of a lover who doesn't know how to explain why he loves. He can't explain it to the person he loves, nor even to himself, even though it's his \

He experiences an intense, desperate love; he loves with tenderness, fear, and madness. He promises eternal fidelity and asks from the depths of his soul... for a hug.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sayury/EoiWgSunpGfRbLY8aDZ31otK2nbJeg8StXa2uQVJZ46zDKUHXQAK74dy8oaXKd3hLvf.jpg

doesn't it? Anyone who has experienced it at some point in their life, or is experiencing it now, will identify with this song that bares the soul of the one who loves.\n\nNino Bravo recorded this song in 1970 for the album \

title: [ESP/ENG] Semana intensa: Emergencia familiar + emprendimiento + un animalito nuevo Intense week: Family emergency + new business venture + a new pet
body: > Hola amigos. Bienvenidos a mi blog, a mi espacio. Esta semana ha sido toda una montaña rusa, desde el 15 de mayo, por parte de mi novio, un familiar presentó una situación médica que tuvo que ser operada y conjunto a eso había estado teniendo picos de ansiedad, a lo mejor por la misma situación o un cúmulo de cosas. Total es que, de alguna forma, tenía tiempo que no drenaba eso en mi blog, y pensé en hacer una publicación de algo así como el review de mi semana. > Hello friends. Welcome to my blog, to my space. > This week has been a real rollercoaster. Since May 15th, a family member of my boyfriend had a medical issue that required surgery, and on top of that, I've been experiencing bouts of anxiety, perhaps due to the situation itself or a combination of things. Anyway, I hadn't really vented about it on my blog in a while, so I thought I'd write a post sort of like a review of my week. ![Screenshot_20260524_222324_com_android_chrome_ChromeTabbedActivity.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZbb9cDq4pP6auipLag1orekpUVHF8DEbNgiaWjdDN5KM/Screenshot_20260524_222324_com_android_chrome_ChromeTabbedActivity.jpg) La verdad es que, no todo fue malo, invertí en unos trajes de baños qué, llegaron a comienzo de semana, y que gracias al universo pude vender el 90% de ellos. Así mismo, me surgieron unos encargos de pulseras 7 nudos y hoy pude entregar una de ellas. Siempre agradezco tener un emprendimiento que, me da la oportunidad de seguir usando mi creatividad para crecer y generar ingresos para una meta que tengo entre ceja y ceja, y que seguro cuando logre, les diré. > The truth is, it wasn't all bad. I invested in some swimsuits that arrived at the beginning of the week, and thankfully, I was able to sell 90% of them. I also received some orders for 7-knot bracelets, and today I was able to deliver one. I'm always grateful to have a business that gives me the opportunity to continue using my creativity to grow and generate income toward a goal I have firmly in mind, and I'll definitely tell you about it when I achieve it. ![IMG_20260524_123209.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZv5CshAcg3ECwxxa5UKSxcyB2L5mNN428Jhvav5RCp1W/IMG_20260524_123209.jpg) ![IMG_20260524_114147.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWWgNsP3J3McQH2AVQPhJqGQm7MxkVVwBkxrkF6jjmMLD/IMG_20260524_114147.jpg) También quiero mencionarles que, en una de esas salidas, cuando fui a la basura a botar un papel, me he conseguido una tortuga viva, pregunté en el grupo de la urbanización si pertenecía a alguien y no apareció dueño. Así que, la tengo en mi casa, pero la verdad, quisiera que, ella pudiera tener un espacio un poco más grande con tierra para que crezca más cómodamente. > I also want to mention that on one of those outings, when I went to the trash to throw away some paper, I found a live turtle. Yes, I asked in the neighborhood group if it belonged to anyone, but no one came forward. So, I have it at my house, but honestly, I wish it could have a slightly larger space with soil so it could grow more comfortably. ![IMG_20260522_135521.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPj9zrqye6zPHxNJ2BXB8BB8nMDvTvxLkGMZmBJ6TLhv2/IMG_20260522_135521.jpg) ![IMG_20260521_123839.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRkfmourFAqk1LbLAFWmUuo38pFc4o98w692PzB3hGhXy/IMG_20260521_123839.jpg) ![IMG-20260520-WA0221.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQnJXq4tqqHoTbgUEKRG3B6EXRXBkhYcB8qYsWHfhF1o4/IMG-20260520-WA0221.jpg) Aunque los picos de ansiedad se han mantenido al margen, con ayuda de mis distractores, como la meditación, hacer actividades recreativas, como las pulseras, y bastante amor propio, quise hacer esta entrada para recordarme que el camino no es una línea recta y que es normal tener baches. Saludos y buenas noches para todos los que me leen. > Although anxiety spikes have been kept at bay, thanks to distractions like meditation, recreational activities (such as wearing bracelets), and plenty of self-love, I wanted to write this post to remind myself that life isn't a straight line and that bumps in the road are normal. Greetings and goodnight to everyone reading this. ![IMG_20260519_193531.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPF1QQor4UquxhVePVnEtgihUL4bC74K1jgysgXqeEaUQ/IMG_20260519_193531.jpg) ![IMG_20260520_185656.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaKxioN2ahGnYQ9AcPK6RDc6TCcFcFoFqZa798JzYipek/IMG_20260520_185656.jpg) ______ #familyandfriends Fotografía por | Photography by: @mairimmorales, HONOR MAGIC 7 LITE. title: Re: stayoutoftherz's post
body:
Agree with that.

Anyway, (in another parallel reflection) we are going up in temps and there is no realistic way to reverse what is happening in the next livable years in my view (unless by reducing world population drastically). We (assuming here) will be gone by then (in many decades from now) and some places on earth will not be recognizable or possible to inhabit without additional life-support infrastructure.

But lets even consider a modest timeframe, say 50 years (and maybe I will be here), and say this is 2 C increase (if not more)... many places around the world would stop having frozen lakes, Antartica will have less ice, polar bears might not be able to survive on the Artic because there is not enough ice for them to catch seals, and so on and on... it creates a snowball effect that is very very hard to reverse.

So, until then, we have time as a species to find how to live on other planets (and maybe) to get used to how can we maintain them best. We could be trying harder to no f our own planet with those same resources, but I don't think to be possible. Humans are humans... and they will be humans for a long time.

title: Why TON Meme Projects Need Hive — The Case for MemeHive, Decentralized Communities, and Digital Survival
body:
Video: https://youtu.be/OEeMFpGU5DM?si=lb3UchZ7zQcQu5YI

Introduction — The Problem Nobody Wants to Admit

Most meme projects today are building entire ecosystems on infrastructure they do not actually control.

That is the uncomfortable reality many communities still refuse to confront.

Projects spend months — sometimes years — creating:

audiences,

culture,

engagement,

memes,

lore,

videos,

discussions,

and online identity,


while depending almost entirely on centralized social media corporations whose priorities can change overnight.

X can throttle visibility.
TikTok can suppress discoverability.
YouTube can demonetize channels.
Facebook can reduce organic reach into near invisibility.

Entire communities can lose momentum because an algorithm changes internally without warning.

For meme communities, this creates a dangerous contradiction.

The very communities generating culture, engagement, and internet virality often own absolutely none of the infrastructure they depend on.

That is not a sustainable long-term model.

And this is precisely why projects like Baby Lady are beginning to look toward Hive and MemeHive as something far more important than “another social platform.”

Hive represents decentralized social media infrastructure.

And MemeHive represents one of the most important meme-focused ecosystems inside that infrastructure.

This is not merely a discussion about posting memes.

This is a discussion about:

ownership,

permanence,

censorship resistance,

decentralized communication,

creator monetization,

and the future survival of online communities.



---

The Centralized Platform Problem

Modern social media platforms operate on a model where:

users create value,

platforms own distribution,

algorithms control visibility,

and corporations maintain ultimate authority.


This creates a massive imbalance between creators and platforms.

Creators:

generate engagement,

create viral content,

build communities,

and sustain platform activity,


while platforms retain the power to:

suppress reach,

alter discoverability,

remove monetization,

suspend accounts,

or erase visibility entirely.


This has become increasingly noticeable across:

crypto communities,

meme projects,

political communities,

independent creators,

and alternative media ecosystems.


Many meme projects now experience:

throttled impressions,

shadow suppression,

inconsistent discoverability,

arbitrary moderation,

and declining organic reach.


Even successful creators are discovering that virality on centralized platforms often depends less on community support and more on opaque algorithmic behavior.

That creates instability.

And unstable communication infrastructure creates unstable communities.


---

Meme Culture Is Not “Just Entertainment”

One of the biggest mistakes outsiders make is assuming memes are trivial.

Memes are not merely jokes.

Memes are compressed cultural communication systems.

They:

spread narratives,

build identity,

unify communities,

create emotional bonding,

transmit ideology,

and generate collective participation.


Internet culture itself increasingly moves through memes faster than through traditional media formats.

In crypto specifically, memes are extraordinarily powerful.

Entire ecosystems have grown around:

mascots,

visual identity,

community humor,

symbolic narratives,

and viral participation.


Projects like:

Dogecoin,

Pepe,

Wojak ecosystems,

TON meme projects,

and countless others,


demonstrate that meme culture can drive enormous social coordination.

But if memes drive communities, then meme communities require infrastructure capable of surviving long term.

That is where Hive becomes important.


---

What Hive Actually Is

Many people incorrectly describe Hive as “a blogging platform.”

That dramatically understates what Hive actually represents.

Hive is:

a decentralized blockchain,

a social infrastructure layer,

a distributed publishing system,

and an ownership-based social ecosystem.


Unlike centralized platforms:

Hive accounts are controlled through cryptographic private keys,

not through corporate custody.


This changes the relationship between creators and platforms entirely.

On traditional platforms:

your account exists because the corporation permits it.


On Hive:

your account belongs directly to you.


That distinction becomes more important every year.


---

Ownership Changes Everything

Ownership is the core difference between Web2 social media and decentralized social infrastructure.

On centralized platforms:

creators rent visibility.


On Hive:

creators own participation.


This creates several major advantages:

1 Account Durability

Hive accounts cannot simply disappear because a centralized executive changes policy.

As long as the blockchain exists, the account exists.

2 Portable Identity

Your identity becomes blockchain-native rather than platform-dependent.

3 Community Persistence

Communities become harder to erase because the infrastructure itself is decentralized.

4 Creator Monetization

Hive allows creators to directly participate in reward systems built into the ecosystem itself.

These differences are not theoretical.

They fundamentally alter how online communities operate.


---

Why MemeHive Matters

Inside Hive exists MemeHive: a long-running meme-focused tribe and community ecosystem.

MemeHive allows creators to:

publish meme content,

participate in meme curation,

engage with meme communities,

and earn MEME tokens through decentralized participation.


This matters because meme creators historically receive very little ownership within the platforms they help build.

Centralized corporations profit enormously from meme engagement while creators themselves often receive:

minimal monetization,

little algorithmic stability,

and almost no infrastructure ownership.


MemeHive attempts to invert that relationship.

The ecosystem revolves around:

meme culture,

community engagement,

creator participation,

decentralized rewards,

and social curation.


Creators commonly publish using:

#meme

#memes

#memehive


allowing content to flow into the broader MemeHive ecosystem.


---

Curation Is One of Hive’s Most Important Features

One aspect outsiders often misunderstand is the importance of curation.

Hive is not purely creator-driven.

It is also curator-driven.

This distinction matters enormously.

On centralized platforms: algorithms determine visibility.

On Hive: communities themselves participate directly in content discovery and reward distribution.

That creates a fundamentally different ecosystem dynamic.

Curators help:

reward quality,

surface valuable content,

strengthen communities,

and support ecosystem growth.


Without curation:

decentralized social ecosystems stagnate.


MemeHive survives because communities continue participating actively in:

discovery,

engagement,

voting,

and support.


That community participation becomes part of the infrastructure itself.


---

Why TON Meme Projects Should Pay Attention

TON meme ecosystems are growing rapidly.

But they face the same vulnerabilities every crypto meme ecosystem faces:

centralized suppression,

discoverability instability,

dependence on corporate algorithms,

and communication fragility.


This creates a dangerous long-term situation.

Entire projects can become dependent on platforms that:

do not share their values,

do not prioritize their survival,

and can reduce their visibility without warning.


Hive offers something extremely important:

decentralized redundancy.


Not necessarily total migration overnight.

But a permanent secondary infrastructure layer.

That distinction matters.

Hive can function as:

a permanent archive,

a community home,

a communication backup layer,

a monetization layer,

and a censorship-resistant publishing environment.


This becomes increasingly valuable as centralized moderation intensifies.


---

Baby Lady and Long-Term Decentralized Presence

The Baby Lady project increasingly reflects this broader shift toward permanence and decentralized infrastructure.

Rather than existing solely on:

X,

TikTok,

YouTube,

or other centralized systems,


Baby Lady has begun establishing a long-term presence inside Hive and MemeHive.

That matters because:

decentralized identity becomes durable,

content becomes harder to erase,

and community participation becomes more resilient.


The goal is not simply visibility.

The goal is survival.

Projects that survive long term usually understand one critical reality:

Temporary hype is not infrastructure.

Communities require permanence.


---

The Psychological Problem of Centralized Dependence

One of the hidden dangers of centralized social media is psychological dependency.

Communities become conditioned to:

algorithm chasing,

engagement anxiety,

visibility volatility,

and platform uncertainty.


Creators constantly worry:

whether content will reach audiences,

whether monetization will disappear,

whether suppression is occurring,

or whether discoverability will collapse.


This creates unstable ecosystems emotionally as well as structurally.

Decentralized systems reduce some of that dependency because:

ownership becomes more direct,

participation becomes more transparent,

and infrastructure becomes community-based rather than purely corporate.


No system is perfect.

Hive is not perfect.

But decentralized ownership changes incentives dramatically.


---

Why Decentralization May Become Necessary

For years, decentralization was treated as optional experimentation.

Increasingly, it may become necessary infrastructure.

The internet is moving toward:

greater moderation,

stronger algorithmic filtering,

centralized discovery systems,

and increased platform control.


This affects:

meme creators,

crypto communities,

political communities,

independent artists,

and alternative ecosystems disproportionately.


Projects that fail to build decentralized backup infrastructure may eventually discover they have no real control over their own communication systems.

That is a dangerous position for any online movement.

Especially meme-driven ecosystems.


---

Meme Communities Need Permanent Homes

Memes move quickly.

But communities should not disappear quickly.

That is the central contradiction modern internet culture must solve.

Communities require:

continuity,

memory,

ownership,

archives,

and infrastructure durability.


Hive offers many of those things.

And MemeHive specifically provides a meme-centered environment where:

culture,

humor,

creativity,

and decentralized participation


can continue existing outside purely corporate systems.

That may become increasingly important over the next decade.


---

The Future May Belong to Communities That Own Themselves

The internet is changing.

The relationship between creators and platforms is changing.

And meme culture itself is evolving into one of the dominant forms of online communication.

Projects that survive long term will likely be projects that:

build durable communities,

establish decentralized infrastructure,

maintain cultural identity,

and reduce dependence on centralized control.


Hive represents one possible path toward that future.

Not because it is perfect.

But because ownership matters.

Permanence matters.

And communities deserve infrastructure that cannot be erased simply because an algorithm changes internally.

That is why MemeHive matters.

That is why Hive matters.

And that is why decentralized social infrastructure may eventually become essential for the long-term survival of meme culture itself.


---

title: Jacksmith: El herrero del reino [SPA/ENG]
body:
![ChatGPT Image 24 may 2026, 22_10_01.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcXWhoZKya3UX4LX4UTteKxadkz82o5jgK2Zxwf4RUL9M/ChatGPT%20Image%2024%20may%202026,%2022_10_01.png)

👾 Jacksmith: El herrero del reino 👾

---

> ###
Español
¡Hola, comunidad gamer de Hive! Jacksmith es un juego flash de estrategia y simulación en el que tomas el papel de un herrero, un burro llamado Jack, cuya tarea no es pelear directamente, sino fabricar las mejores armas posibles para que otros héroes enfrenten al enemigo. Su historia gira en torno a una misión bastante clara: la princesa Liliana ha sido capturada por el malvado mago Dudley, así que Jacksmith debe apoyar a los guerreros del reino con armas de calidad para ayudar en la rescate.

> ###
English
Hello, Hive gaming community! Jacksmith is a Flash strategy and simulation game where you play as a blacksmith, a donkey named Jack, whose task isn't to fight directly, but to forge the best possible weapons for other heroes to face the enemy. The story revolves around a fairly straightforward mission: Princess Liliana has been captured by the evil wizard Dudley, so Jacksmith must support the kingdom's warriors with quality weapons to aid in her rescue.
![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-44-27-813.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZyYDZhGSLXiX489V5GX7hXtiQywJz5Cwyg7GnUkT7Aaz/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-44-27-813.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-44-34-249.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfKa8zVecmtL97FQvS544C3LgcoSD6bRy6sVtR8PDPAwq/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-44-34-249.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-44-39-993.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPAW9R5Yw8m3XzCMRr4zKUH83BqC8AtxpTzgcg5R443Ja/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-44-39-993.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-44-47-320.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPDNJLmEiVGgF1MbXUzXSxeSKuYgjcuHamf6MrSygNAtr/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-44-47-320.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-44-52-452.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV7CniyFtbrDFBQK4jyZdCfbxgbghYk315zgjX4g9ziV1/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-44-52-452.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-44-59-117.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcfAVDWe61bmsXEj5isAyQ4E27GRWpFzoUgxLRsFLhh1H/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-44-59-117.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-45-07-347.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNzsE6tCN1TMrNbVbLsrfzzyMF3KJCzCpsvfyXWN3aXsv/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-45-07-347.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-45-15-972.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVdT9SWqp9AV3kuhqmHyDmRH8MNNJHGBjdwLXYJ5wbEx4/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-45-15-972.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-45-23-039.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRu6W8Pyw4WhZcH49An1U2MoEA32ctPv5o8RGh3sQDTEB/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-45-23-039.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-45-31-349.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQJYLSDHNDDNBTM4sdqtYSRr1Y5CdrybWq6EffyEAjsVu/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-45-31-349.jpg)

> El encanto del juego está en que mezcla fantasía clásica con un tono ligero y muy original. En vez de controlar al típico héroe armado, el jugador maneja a un herrero que vive dentro de un mundo lleno de monstruos, soldados y regiones por conquistar. Esa idea le da personalidad al lore, porque convierte la forja en una parte central de la aventura: no se trata solo de producir objetos, sino de ser la base del ejército y el responsable indirecto del avance del reino. Además, el enemigo final, Dudley, funciona como una meta narrativa simple pero efectiva. La progresión del juego está ligada a esa misión de salvar a la princesa y avanzar por distintas batallas, lo que hace que la historia sirva como impulso para seguir mejorando armas y enfrentando enemigos más difíciles.

> The game's charm lies in its blend of classic fantasy with a light and highly original tone. Instead of controlling the typical armed hero, the player controls a blacksmith living in a world full of monsters, soldiers, and regions to conquer. This concept gives the lore personality, making the forge a central part of the adventure: it's not just about producing objects, but about being the foundation of the army and indirectly responsible for the kingdom's progress. Furthermore, the final boss, Dudley, serves as a simple yet effective narrative meta. The game's progression is tied to the mission of rescuing the princess and advancing through various battles, making the story a driving force for improving weapons and facing increasingly difficult enemies.
![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-49-15-730.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPWWPPLTMMYQdxueu92F84h7a1hzXUU47VUbmoFBFTJMz/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-49-15-730.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-49-20-683.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbPRdTfUxrs7fTrDeszPy4AHKstGfBDJUv8pMZ2wAXxQy/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-49-20-683.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-49-31-202.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWgy2qbDShFck5fnHe3s8AWJLu2y6cRTxfeDfAs7X1JUk/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-49-31-202.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-49-50-937.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCPKetRhs4dDcRTK8kZa4D7fJkudoEPnTrNw2uJwRiaA/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-49-50-937.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 21-10-40-329.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmainHh7ate2BTdD2NX4dGH741RviYA8TmebjYurcmdB6U/bandicam%202026-05-24%2021-10-40-329.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 21-12-07-292.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbPtchVieFxt2FeofoLMFHhnbKHp9HcJyzVtShttxVXVb/bandicam%202026-05-24%2021-12-07-292.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 21-12-27-963.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaPCsHnabTcxmZVHpwEZcn8LeLtukjDJo954mfdhD936J/bandicam%202026-05-24%2021-12-27-963.jpg)

> La jugabilidad de Jacksmith se centra en dos fases principales: la forja y el combate. En la parte de forja, eliges minerales, moldes y materiales para construir armas como espadas, arcos, hachas y flechas, cuidando que cada paso se haga bien para obtener mejores resultados. Esto le da un componente de gestión del tiempo y precisión, porque el rendimiento en la batalla depende de la calidad del arma que fabriques. Después, los guerreros usan esas armas en combate contra monstruos, y tú observas cómo rinden en el campo de batalla. Durante las peleas también puedes obtener botines, como gemas y metales, que sirven para comprar objetos o seguir creando mejores equipos. Esa combinación entre trabajo artesanal y recompensa estratégica es lo que hace que el juego sea tan adictivo.

> Jacksmith's gameplay focuses on two main phases: forging and combat. In the forging phase, you choose minerals, molds, and materials to craft weapons such as swords, bows, axes, and arrows, ensuring each step is done correctly for better results. This adds a time management and precision element, as your performance in battle depends on the quality of the weapon you create. Afterward, warriors use these weapons in combat against monsters, and you observe how they perform on the battlefield. During fights, you can also obtain loot, such as gems and metals, which can be used to purchase items or continue crafting better equipment. This combination of craftsmanship and strategic reward is what makes the game so addictive.
![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-51-29-174.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc3acurXx18s3DReFQqpw1SEz6DTaCp3UyUQc77wu5CbV/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-51-29-174.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-51-30-217.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfX8g35ZmZUNQmnNQB8JFzoRG2fQKx5Z5AVGpdbFDhtm3/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-51-30-217.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-51-31-509.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdiuzddYYKeTFoZSDwZ4suVAoSqS5PKsshR1ue6v3dnnJ/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-51-31-509.jpg) ![bandicam 2026-05-24 19-51-43-136.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcUVypjaFk8ojKVk1b9vT2RaJ26vUp1HSo8BEekAW6iiJ/bandicam%202026-05-24%2019-51-43-136.jpg)

> Jacksmith sobresale porque toma una idea simple y la convierte en un ciclo muy entretenido: fabricar, probar, mejorar y volver a fabricar. No es un juego de acción directa tradicional, sino una experiencia donde la planificación importa tanto como la batalla. Por eso muchos lo recuerdan con cariño: tiene un estilo visual llamativo, una premisa distinta y una progresión que hace sentir que cada arma realmente cuenta. En resumen, Jacksmith no solo es un clásico del flash, sino también un ejemplo muy bueno de cómo una idea original puede transformar algo tan cotidiano como la herrería en una aventura completa.

> Jacksmith stands out because it takes a simple idea and turns it into a highly engaging cycle: craft, test, improve, and craft again. It's not a traditional action game, but rather an experience where planning matters as much as the battle itself. That's why many remember it fondly: it has a striking visual style, a unique premise, and a progression system that makes every weapon feel truly important. In short, Jacksmith is not only a Flash classic, but also a prime example of how an original idea can transform something as mundane as blacksmithing into a complete adventure. ---

title: DESDE LA MAREA NEGRA CUBA AFLORA | FROM THE BLACK TIDE CUBA EMERGES (es | en)
body:
/>

Hola Hivers, hoy regreso nuevamente por la **Comunidad Literatos (@**hive-179291) , un sitio con gente buena y afable que siempre me ha recibido. Hoy quiero presentar este texto, un poco abrupto quizás, áspero, dedicado a mi patria que hoy sufre mucho y por razones del espacio, no quiero comentar. Espero no sea un tema indeseado.  
Agradezco su lectura,

Un abrazo fraterno,

hasta más ver.

<h4 style=\

>DESDE LA MAREA NEGRA CUBA AFLORA Esperpento, que la ruina sea tu destino. Bloqueo: te maldigo. Que la boca de tus padres vomite la hostia negra hasta el abismo de los siglos. La derramada en el mar que golpea en mi costilla de arrecife y que mira el horizonte donde la ingesta tendrá fin. Quiero saborear tu olor a infierno y sacudirme la punzada blanda del pan ganado. Yo en tu anatema me humillo, soy un paria aferrado a la garganta de los míos. Me duele la sangre, del ronco latir en tu marea. Desangrarme es inmolarme infinitesimalmente, también por los otros: quienes no calzan sino su propio zapato de sureño. Nosotros, la arboladura y la raíz de toda la masa, hemos sido golpeados en el hígado donde la multitud se contiene. A ti también escupo el rostro, de retama cuajada en las varices de mi ser, combatido, espantado de que no duelan los adioses, y los barcos no regresen nuestros muertos. Resignarse es ponerse la bandolera de los tigres que se comen uno a uno a los hermanos, que por pacto de sangre me traen en fuga y con el dolor como un astro quemante en la maraña de los días. Aún vuelan mariposas amarillas, las verdades, cuales astros, hacen alba: ¡Oigan estrellados, si alcanzan! La negritud es la mancilla de mis ojos lanzados al asfalto. **Que tengan un lindo día! Gracias por tu visita. 😍☀️**

></center>

Hello Hivers,

Today I return once again to the Literatos Community, a place filled with kind and warm-hearted people who have always welcomed me. Today I would like to share this text — perhaps somewhat abrupt, perhaps rough — dedicated to my homeland, which is suffering greatly today and, for reasons of space, I would rather not elaborate on.

I hope it is not an unwelcome subject.

Thank you for reading,

A fraternal embrace,

until we meet again.

<h4 style=\

>FROM THE BLACK TIDE CUBA EMERGES Grotesque thing, may ruin be your destiny. Blockade: I curse you. May the mouths of your fathers vomit the black host into the abyss of centuries. The one spilled into the sea, that strikes against my reef-rib and stares toward the horizon where the ingestion will end. I want to savor your smell of hell and shake off the dull sting of earned bread. I, within your anathema, bow myself, I am a pariah clinging to the throats of my own. My blood aches from the hoarse beating in your tide. To bleed out is to immolate myself infinitesimally, also for the others: those who wear nothing but their own southern shoe. We, the rigging and the root of all the masses, have been struck in the liver, where the multitude restrains itself. At you I also spit in the face, of broom blossom hardened within the varicose veins of my being, embattled, terrified that farewells no longer hurt and that ships no longer return our dead. To resign oneself is to strap on the bandolier of tigers that devour brothers one by one, who, by blood pact, drive me into flight and with pain like a burning star through the tangle of days. Yellow butterflies still fly, truths, like stars, become dawn: Hear me, star-struck ones, if you can! Blackness is the stain upon my eyes cast onto the asphalt. **Have a beautiful day! Thank you. 😍☀️**

Yesterday afternoon, when the light sunlight was shining in nature, I saw this small Leptapoderus insect on a green leaf in a calm environment, which I am now sharing with everyone. At first glance, its long face, small curved trunk and brown-golden body created a very different feeling and it looked amazing. It is worth seeing extraordinary moments and beauty in the midst of green nature.

Leptapoderus is a type of weevil or trunked beetle, the shape and structure of their body gives them a different kind of beauty. Especially their long face and fine antennae are very easy to see. In nature, they are usually seen around trees.

While taking the picture, I noticed that this small creature was moving very carefully along the edge of the leaf. Such an extraordinary structure and beauty among the small creatures of nature is really worth enjoying. When you look closely, you can understand how perfectly nature creates this small insect.

Now I am sharing some pictures of this insect below, I hope everyone will like it and enjoy it.

es locura incipiente

antes de tiempo

si en verdad conoces el tiempo.

no importa para seguir

se encarga el instinto

title: A Sunday at the Abbey in Black and White
body: >These pictures are my entry for the #monomad contest by @brumest and @monochromes.
>Hello Hivers and everyone dropping by!\n

>Last Sunday we headed out to the Abbey of the Transfiguration in Bukidnon for a family day. I had my mobile phone with me and shot everything in color like I normally do but when I got home and started going through the photos in Adobe Lightroom, I decided to convert them all to black and white just to see how they would look. Glad I did. The place just feels different without color. Quieter somehow,The editing was nothing complicated. I pulled the color out, tweaked the contrast and shadows a little, and let whatever light was already in the shot do the work. That's pretty much it.
![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23x159q2q6bTEJKzRLrkoR6gpvNx8pYZWW5pFoQFH6xBW9xeoV6iek4Xc2Y7xjRLnmCwD.jpg)

>I took shots at home first. We have this big old tree in the yard that I keep coming back to the trunk splits in a way that always catches the light differently. The potted plants along the wall have been slowly taking over. My wife's collection keeps growing.
![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23tbsLrFMjAuTnv5dqM5eGgddtVMPQaLthdZWLsr2K9tBMgTyqoCQTtuHLA325XMf7FTw.png)

>We passed this parking area with two huge bonsai trees in concrete trays sitting right next to the vehicles. I had to stop. They looked like they had been there forever trunks all twisted, not bothered at all by the pickup trucks beside them. The black and white conversion made the bark texture really come out. Shot them from both sides.
![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23wMWbB55vR9Hi2VwfhAtvWkwvV6HSyjB2cw8arT5qamNdyob6dnDButNjXav2sMR5JUK.jpg) ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23uQp4ugjVXexKPfYK3gtHV2MnxapZxtqXGQ9ESWf7JfadFAypdb59CcGebkVrDrC7Kzq.jpg)

>The chapel is hard to get tired of photographing. That pyramid shape looks different depending on where you stand and what the sky is doing. That afternoon the clouds were heavy and dark on one side and bright on the other which is exactly what you want when you're planning to convert to black and white. The tones just fall into place. I walked around the parking lot, crossed the field, crouched near the base probably took more frames than I needed. In Lightroom I brought up the highlights on the roof and pushed the shadows down on the cloud edges. Simple adjustments.
![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23wC1a1GpGsArrHxQdF6ShPsxQUdFmDZqimLyDrNQE8ar1AvTTDxYXTdqGTDWSzJRe7Mq.png) ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23uQpMjbRQi4rtysEJH5P1D8QU4KDLXKKG63K5hbmMzyF5sD8ZaTiwxCPsrznFtx53Y6t.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23wCA6d2S11KdVVwedyKskdAdqYB3yXi8gkgidPihZVXeaiTxGpuDLfe9a27KC6HAJW6u.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23uQp4ugjQJpfziQEqHDiDWoQcy7oXw7hLMVrQ95xoxV7iUi5cxmyZLYsAJN2kkRgwGE8.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23w2ijy84Ff41p8RdXxyp2wnVhVeswCJ3rJmZnVC7dXK8h7e2Zn3JiEZqmTB21sLEFCnL.jpg)

>The kids had zero interest in the architecture. They found a rope somewhere and spent most of the afternoon playing tug-of-war and chasing each other across the grass. I just followed them around with the camera. Shooting in color first actually helped here, I could expose for their skin tones and then control how light or dark they came out in the conversion. Some of my favorite shots from the day are just them doing their thing in front of the chapel without knowing I was shooting.
![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23xVGnoZj3p6SXY9ouJUnqrZg1ZvToGLWio66m19iHpZrpTkeqkCfcWaABtfFD3LNeqrK.jpg) ![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23tH1iRqc3vyvUar5TLM6EQkv9MSD76f3Qfb3uAUdwk6rwe7dF5YyDMsmgSFi2Hax4rda.jpg) ![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23wqg3q1dV5zAEZXqsEEqWqe2ZxhLWqnaGGzfzat8NArpoKRo8JresFToW7kg8g7375W7.jpg) ![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23xyR3i8PsP2uopnVDSCfaHHidxwbmn6mKa3TLReKkSwjvSsTw9x3QPJMLmMwTkhsDMDV.jpg) ![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23wMUSLTH12aJBwQx5VDg4PQ6GD4uw29cWeoc67eyYExQ8tpWZT17JgQitEK3yEStnevM.jpg) ![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23x16f5AaVKqfUa8nU7aZzjrHdzvALgG3Cp3E4gK1mQMk1GPuLG3TowMgNVkhSyuEULa3.jpg) ![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23z7BQXLrLC2ppYQCU4KZzZrfaJdbic7uAWBbc4mp7sFKj2iV9GKD5eBGCDa8XZdSCRv8.jpg) ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23tmDhCTz33zfuqzFJ3P2tRSYCTBMaiHGYJFnHaKqmx6tnkbWTbytU8azPJyjdWmQrXcu.jpg) ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23tbiSeWDBH2RznSSKd55VEfbx1SKWRfvQnFGS3fYyfC2EyXSaDszbpUsKri4jXYUkCt2.jpg)

>We stayed longer than we planned. That happens every time at the abbey. Nobody really wants to be the one to say let's go. All photos shot in color on a smartphone and converted to black and white in Adobe Lightroom. No presets — everything adjusted manually per photo. If you're in Bukidnon and haven't been to the abbey, just go. Bring the kids. Let them run. Take too many photos. Thanks for reading. ![divider_BW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23wN2F4zwFweXPnq94PScnpgvNoi4P5jkxa9HZerApLMUb3QdJTtHcJcPtZEif5so47SU.png)
