我从小学起，就开始戴上了近视眼镜，算下来至今也有30多年了。

以前眼镜脏了，用眼镜布擦下就好了，嗯，以前都是玻璃那种的。现在呢，眼镜换成不是玻璃的，好像叫什么树脂片，优点是比以前玻璃的轻便很多，但缺点也很明显，不耐磨，几乎不能用眼镜布擦，一擦就容易留划痕。但眼镜脏了总得擦啊，因此我都习惯了每天用洗洁精清洗。

嗯，还特别容易脏，以前镜片几天不擦都没事，现在呢，一天不清洗就肉眼可见的脏。


![IMG20260525085119.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUtb5uooGpYqapPj9ytVygH3aTv4y1fzTCeRPPi2rAn5h/IMG20260525085119.jpg)


我小时候受电影电视剧的影响，对“举报”这个词语很没有好印象，一直都认为，正常人谁会去做那种事？

但在广州这地方待久了，发现举报这种事情是很平常，甚至常见的，比如楼下的下水道井盖发出异响；听到有那种摩托车炸街的。。。都会毫不客气的举报。

关乎到自身的利益，自然得维护。不仅得维护，还得及时去做。

说到举报，估摸着学校里的领导最怕听到这个了，但凡学校里有些稍微超规定的地方，必然会迎来家长的举报，我虽然没有举报过学校或老师，但每次去学校开家长会，总能听到老师们跟家长们一副苦口婆心的讲，有什么问题可以跟老师们商量，尽量不要举报哦。。。

也许有人会说，这种对老师们要求太多，会弄得老师们束手束脚，反而不利于孩子们教育。。。我认同这话，但又不完全认同。有些过于吹毛求疵的举报自然是不好，但对于学校和老师们的约束，我认为还是非常有必要，利远大于弊。


![IMG20260525085125.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXfTqjWDMhRx6RTneoQ9zQKfTQfTP4o8XcM6G1SPAQZ2X/IMG20260525085125.jpg)


跟家人聊天，谈到最近北方老家连续多雨。本来下雨是件好事，但这个时节多雨却很不恰当，庄稼和一些种植的水果正常收获季节，多雨反而给百姓造成了很多损失。就拿我们巷子里的一户人家，种植的杏树，之前谈好的果商，原本预估的收获价格大约在3、4万，因为多雨，导致成熟的杏屁股后边开裂，直接成次果被拒收。。。最后一算，总共才收了7000多，对比之前，不能不说损失很大。

我们县城北部，种植了大量的樱桃，本来这个时间也是樱桃成熟的季节，结果因为最近的雨水多，加上价格比往年过低，有些百姓种植的少还好些，自己挑好的摘掉；有些算了笔账，雇佣人去采摘后下来，实际到手的钱所剩无几，索性不摘了，放任樱桃烂在树上。。。去年荔枝大丰收，结果价格跌到阿妈都不识得，一斤荔枝卖1块多，一些种植户生气的直接将荔枝树砍掉。。。
类似的情况，砂糖橘也有过同样的遭遇。

谷贱伤农啊！

title: Fruits growing in my garden [Eng/Esp]
body:
> Hello, friends of Hive and Hive Garden. I hope you’re all doing well. As for me, I’m quite tired because I’ve had to sleep with my dad here at the outpatient clinic and I only have a plastic chair to spend the night on. Today is my fifth night here, but I hope he’ll be discharged tomorrow as he’s feeling much better. Today I wanted to give you a quick update on the tomato and pepper plants I have at home. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZTUuwJRcPwAcb9dUooNNiSHB28C4fpu76owTs4GLwv26/1779674906443.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) Just in case you don’t remember, or haven’t read my blog before, a few months ago I started a small seedbed of ‘Margariteño’ tomatoes and peppers, and I’ve been making compost for them because the soil conditions where I live aren’t great. The plants are already quite big now; we haven’t harvested them yet, but almost all of them have fruit growing on them. I planted all the sweet pepper plants in medium-sized pots because I didn’t want to plant them directly in the ground, given what I told you about the soil, and they’ve surprised me because they’re still small and they all already have sweet peppers growing on them, which seem huge to me if you look at how tiny the plants are, but I’m happy to see that they’re producing. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcQVNTLytqwcV3bgJc4LV3gcHsQ34u5Baxvmk9m2ft34q/1779674115117.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNkVAoBBFRzfqiRcLUn4Dkz8Lz1PSH8tDSX4wQEc88Kmo/1779674232817.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRejBF7cjQ8TciahTQqzWFDZmh4fdebeyRVKRK8azEY7m/1779674233149.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXpcFDT9yP5tcC6PTVNFTUQg7sWHdvBnt7LpMsx9YQ1hW/1779674232548.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT8Ev74RguzYwPY9jASM53hWG874RsGTfdHfvnhGYHd7i/1779674233489.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) I also had to make some supports for the pepper plants using sticks and nylon string to hold them up and keep them upright, because the weight of the peppers makes them bend over, and this has worked really well. I’ll come and show you as soon as I harvest them, and that’ll be soon because you can see that some of them won’t be long now. As for the tomato plants in the pots, I told you I’d made supports for them too and that they were flowering; now there are several tomatoes growing, and the plants have grown so much that I’ve had to prune them and tie them up in places to keep them upright, especially now that the tomatoes are growing. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRK3n54t2Xkicf1GCCRnMbtd9oD2AVsC8pDvcXEJAGCe9/1779674114130.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZXjWTPcJ7mJ6AUxuZVoXz3Lg1rizhQABAZ5fNi4FU3qG/1779674114880.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcWkoMveTRjLNhpQaY5jhPu4GaW2o6movx4TdsYV4zP9t/1779674114416.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXcCENsWZziyKh5rqicqxQejxFNv6YjHFadtVju5cfbAM/1779674114663.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) The ones that haven’t made much progress are the tomato plants I sowed directly into the ground; they’re still very small but they do have flowers, although none have set fruit yet. I’m thinking of taking them out and planting them in pots or in those gardening bags they sell, to see if they thrive, because even though I prepared the soil with compost, they aren’t growing as they should. So I’ll probably do that to see if they take to it. Well, my friends, that’s how things are going with the little crop. The cassava plants are struggling with the sun, which is far too intense, and I think we’ve gone nearly two months or more without a drop of rain, but they’re growing away and I hope we’ll have a good harvest. That’s all for today, friends. Best wishes to you all, and have a good week.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQqBK4zq2HWSFCnzaTBCorQVhth77Fx4CSZt1mYdJtPiF/1744729162300.png) Hola amigos de Hive y de Hive Garden, espero que todos estén muy bien. Por mi parte bastante cansado pirque me está tocando dormir con mi papá aquí en el ambulatorio y solo tengo una silla plástica para pasar la noche, y ya hoy es la quinta noche aquí, pero espero que mañana le den de alta porque está mucho mejor. Hoy les quería traer una pequeña actualización de las matas de tomate y pimentón que tengo en la casa. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) Por si acaso no se acuerdan o no habían leído antes mi blog antes, hace unos meses que hice un semillero pequeño de tomate margariteño y pimentón y estuve haciendo compost para ellas porque las condiciones del suelo donde vivo no son buenas y las matas ya al día de hoy están bastante grandes, todavía no hemos cosechado, pero ya casi todas tienen frutos creciendo. De las matas de pimentón todas las sembré en envases de tamaño mediano porque no las quería sembrar directamente en la tierra por lo que les dije de la tierra y me han sorprendido porque todavía están pequeñas y todas ya tienen pimentones en crecimiento que me parecen grandes si se fijan en lo chiquita de la matas, pero estoy contento de ver que están produciendo. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT8Ev74RguzYwPY9jASM53hWG874RsGTfdHfvnhGYHd7i/1779674233489.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXpcFDT9yP5tcC6PTVNFTUQg7sWHdvBnt7LpMsx9YQ1hW/1779674232548.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRejBF7cjQ8TciahTQqzWFDZmh4fdebeyRVKRK8azEY7m/1779674233149.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNkVAoBBFRzfqiRcLUn4Dkz8Lz1PSH8tDSX4wQEc88Kmo/1779674232817.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcQVNTLytqwcV3bgJc4LV3gcHsQ34u5Baxvmk9m2ft34q/1779674115117.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) A esas de pimentón también les tuve que hacer unos soportes con algunos palos y líneas de nylon para sujetarlas y mantenerlas derechas porque el peso de los pimentones las doblan, y con esto se han mantenido muy bien. En el momento en que coseche les vengo a mostrar, y eso será pronto porque hay unos que se ve que no les falta mucho. Las matas de tomate que están en los envases, yo les dije que les había hecho también sus soportes y que estaban floreando y ahora ya hay varios tomates creciendo y las matas han crecido tanto que ya las he tenido que podar y amarrarlas en algunas partes para que se mantengan derechas sobre todo ahora que los tomates están creciendo. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXcCENsWZziyKh5rqicqxQejxFNv6YjHFadtVju5cfbAM/1779674114663.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcWkoMveTRjLNhpQaY5jhPu4GaW2o6movx4TdsYV4zP9t/1779674114416.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZXjWTPcJ7mJ6AUxuZVoXz3Lg1rizhQABAZ5fNi4FU3qG/1779674114880.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRK3n54t2Xkicf1GCCRnMbtd9oD2AVsC8pDvcXEJAGCe9/1779674114130.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKPWdv7yDVPr1rR7CZtNEi4dSVi3ywSZWuh3BMdRgeoU/1744729162354.png) Las que no han avanzado mucho son las de tomate que sembré directo en la tierra, esas están muy pequeñas pero también tienen sus flores, aunque no han pegado ninguna todavía y estoy pensando en sacarlas y sembrarlas en envases o en las bolsas que venden para jardinería a ver si prosperan porque con todo y que preparé la tierra con compost no están creciendo como deberían, así que lo más seguro es que haga eso para ver si prosperan. Bueno mis amigos así vamos con la pequeña siembra. Las matas de yuca luchando con el sol que está demasiado intenso y creo que ya tenemos casi dos meses o más sin una gota de lluvia, pero ahí van creciendo y espero que sí podamos tener una buena cosecha. Eso sería todo ppr hoy amigos, saludos para todos y que tengan una buena semana.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSYRMxzXzCiqTVgUiNPZyrAfxRYV1CQVGjj7KEm2TsV31/1745361627552.jpg)

title: Pequeños logros crean hábitos | Small achievements build habits
body: > Me ha pasado algunas veces, querer hacer cambios radicales con la idea de que puedo lograr todo lo que me proponga y luego sentirme abrumada. Me rendí algunas veces, comencé a paralizarme por miedo a no ser capaz de cumplir lo que me propongo. No me agrada para nada la idea de comenzar algo y no terminarlo, es algo que va contra mí. Para prevenir eso, pienso muy bien en los compromisos que voy a asumir, que por lo general son conmigo misma, porque sí, soy yo quien más se exige.

> It’s happened to me a few times: I’ve wanted to make radical changes, thinking I could achieve anything I set my mind to, and then I’ve felt overwhelmed. I’ve given up a few times; I’ve started to freeze up out of fear that I wouldn’t be able to follow through on what I set out to do. I really don’t like the idea of starting something and not finishing it—it goes against my nature. To prevent that, I think very carefully about the commitments I’m going to make, which are usually to myself, because, yes, I’m the one who demands the most from myself. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmY7YFtL7Z4wwSqN7nunioscUb5CWf9UGw6kCY2C4nrwr9/20260505.gif Amo ver este gatito masajeándome | I love watching this kitten give me a massage
***

> Ahora voy preparando el terreo cuando quiero implementar un cambio importante en mi vida. Por ejemplo, cuando decidí iniciar un plan de 210 días de alimentación Keto para sanar el cuerpo, sabía que sería algo desafiante y que incluso podría llegara sentirme mal físicamente por el cambio de hábitos alimenticios. Entonces comencé como unos meses antes a ir disminuyendo poco a poco el consumo de harinas procesadas, trigo, azúcar. Aumenté el consumo de proteínas y disminuí el consumo de carbohidratos. También me preparé psicológicamente, leyendo todos los beneficios que ganaría... Me convencí de que es algo que necesito y que definitivamente me haría bien. Cuando me sentí lista, comencé mi dieta y hoy, 48 días después, puedo decir que no ha sido un trauma para mí y que incluso, la he disfrutado.

> Now I lay the groundwork whenever I want to make a major change in my life. For example, when I decided to start a 210-day keto diet plan to heal my body, I knew it would be challenging and that I might even feel physically unwell due to the change in eating habits. So, a few months beforehand, I began gradually cutting back on processed flours, wheat, and sugar. I increased my protein intake and cut back on carbohydrates. I also prepared myself mentally by reading up on all the benefits I would gain... I convinced myself that this was something I needed and that it would definitely do me good. When I felt ready, I started my diet, and today, 48 days later, I can say that it hasn't been a struggle for me—in fact, I've even enjoyed it. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxLEURgGq8oA4yx6uf27JL2wo7vq2bFHkwvMHS9ktEsM/20260524_201418.jpg
***

> Sé que no ha pasado tanto tiempo desde que inicié y más cuando el plan es de 210 días, pero así como de a poco fui eliminando los alimentos que me hacen daño, voy ganando el hábito que me ayuda a mantenerme firme en mi propósito de sanar y bajar de peso. No se trata de correr un maratón cuando apenas empiezas a caminar, sino de ir progresando de acuerdo a tu capacidad, pero de manera constante. Porque he ahí el secreto, nunca llegarás a ninguna parte sin constancia y esfuerzo. Se trata de dar un paso más que el día anterior cada día, que te impulse a salir de tu zona de confort, pero a la vez, que estés en capacidad de darlo. Así, casi sin darte cuenta, logras correr ese maratón que meses atrás, no hubieras siquiera podido imaginar.

> I know it hasn’t been that long since I started, especially since the plan is 210 days long, but just as I’ve gradually eliminated the foods that harm me, I’m developing the habit that helps me stay committed to my goal of healing and losing weight. It’s not about running a marathon when you’re just starting to walk, but about making steady progress at your own pace. Because that’s the secret: you’ll never get anywhere without consistency and effort. It’s about taking one more step each day than you did the day before—a step that pushes you out of your comfort zone, but one you’re also capable of taking. That way, almost without realizing it, you’ll end up running that marathon you couldn’t even have imagined just a few months ago. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmNf4qvvteZNGY2Pxdgwj2xL6JHp7F3NF9oqVevnDxyGZq/20260524_201319.jpg
***

> Entonces sí, pequeños logros crean hábitos, sobre todo porque cada victoria, por muy minúscula que parezca, transmite confianza a nuestro cerebro y nos hace sentir capaces. Recuerdo una vez que hice un intensivo de matemáticas IV en la universidad y con el profesor más difícil. De por sí esa materia es bastante ruda en un semestre completo... ¿Cómo se me ocurrió inscribirla en un intensivo? Conocía el desafío que había elegido, así que la estudié tanto como pude. Gracias a Dios la aprobé y eso me hizo sentir tan poderosa. Me había probado a mí misma, que yo sí podía pasar cualquier materia. Porque sí, nuestra mente necesita pruebas, pero, para no decepcionarla, es mejor comenzar con pequeños triunfos. Así se gana la confianza en sí mismo.

> So yes, small achievements build habits, especially because every victory—no matter how tiny it may seem—instills confidence in our brains and makes us feel capable. I remember once taking an intensive Math IV course in college with the toughest professor. That subject is already pretty tough over a full semester—so why on earth did I sign up for an intensive course? I knew the challenge I’d chosen, so I studied as hard as I could. Thank God I passed, and that made me feel so powerful. I had proven to myself that I could pass any subject. Because yes, our minds need proof, but to avoid disappointing them, it’s better to start with small victories. That’s how you build self-confidence. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmRL6Caw1CNP8tNGTNAJRWLwKDLSiLq8XSDhc9x8Ab6DLB/20260524_203543.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png

> Y estos son mis pensamientos para compartir con ustedes hoy amigos. Cada día nos ofrece un lienzo en blanco, listo para que construyamos nuestros sueños, trazo a trazo. A ustedes, gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.

> And these are the thoughts I’d like to share with you today, my friends. Every day offers us a blank canvas, ready for us to build our dreams, stroke by stroke. To all of you, thank you for joining me on this journey through these words. ***
https://images.hive.blog/350x350/https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmNTSoQ7tHfuKVDmksrsS9RzBg8HAqYnXghQXaHbi7Yt/image.png Thank you very much

body: The cost efficiency angle on Gemini 3.5 Flash is the part that matters most for the competitive landscape. If Google can deliver comparable capabilities at 1/2 to 1/3 the cost of competitors, the model provider market shifts from a capability race to an infrastructure margin race — and Google's vertical integration (TPU, data centers, energy) gives them structural advantages that OpenAI and Anthropic can't easily match.\n\nThe 130% stock recovery over the past year tells the real story: the market had written Google off in AI, and they've proven the obituary was premature. The question is whether execution at I/O translates to sustained enterprise adoption.

body: The chemical tank situation in Garden Grove is a textbook regulatory capture case study. Facilities handling methyl methacrylate at that scale don't just suddenly develop valve failures — there's usually a maintenance deferral trail that was ignored for quarters or years before the acute event.\n\nThe parallel to systemic risk in crypto is closer than it seems. Both environments have operators who run on thin margins, deferred maintenance (or unpatched contracts), and regulators who only notice when something catastrophic happens. The question is whether the post-mortem leads to actual structural change or just a new round of box-checking.

This is the kind of blockchain-native analysis that traditional analytics tools can't do. The app-level retention breakdown is something that would require buy-in from every centralized platform — but on Hive, the data is already there.

The finding that app choice correlates with retention is intuitive but the magnitude is what matters. If certain apps consistently show 2x+ retention vs others, that's not just a UX signal — it's an ecosystem growth lever. Wonder if there's a way to incentivize the high-retention apps to onboard more users, or if the correlation is reversed (certain user types self-select into certain apps).

The Claude-assisted analysis framework here is also interesting as a reproducible model for other Hive data questions.

title: Someone Saved an Ecosystem From an $800M Hack. The Team Offered $4,000.
body:
## Someone Saved an Ecosystem From an $800M Hack. The Team Offered $4,000.

A post hit Reddit's front page this morning with a number that stopped me: 936 upvotes, 49 comments, and a story that cuts to something uncomfortable about how this industry values security.

A bug hunter found a vulnerability that could have drained roughly $800 million from a protocol. They reported it responsibly through the proper channels. The team fixed it. And then the team offered $4,000 as a reward.

The Reddit thread didn't take it well. \

I don't know which protocol this was. The post links to an X thread and the details are sparse. But the dynamic is familiar enough that the specifics almost don't matter.

---

### The Incentive Gap

The standard argument for low bounties goes like this: the researcher is ethically obligated to disclose. They found the bug while poking around. They shouldn't be rewarded based on the size of the potential loss because that creates perverse incentives — what if someone finds a $10 billion bug and demands $100 million?

That argument sounds reasonable until you look at the actual outcomes. Protocols that underpay for critical vulnerabilities don't save money. They just shift the risk. The next researcher who finds a similar bug runs a simple calculation:

*Report it → $4,000 → thanks*
*Exploit it → significantly more → risk of getting caught*

Most researchers are honest. But \

is not a security strategy. When the gap between ethical disclosure and exploitation is this wide, the system is selecting for the wrong outcome.

Compare this with the major tech platforms. Google's Vulnerability Reward Program has paid out over $59 million since 2010. Microsoft pays up to $250,000 for critical bugs. The average critical bug bounty across the top ten tech companies is somewhere in the five-to-six-figure range.

Crypto protocols operate in a higher-stakes environment — money moves instantly, reversals are rare, and the attack surface includes smart contract execution, oracle manipulation, and cross-chain bridges. Yet the bounties often lag behind Web2 standards.

### Why It Happens

Three reasons, none of them good:

1. **Treasury constraints.** Most protocols don't hold large USD reserves. Their native token is down 80% from peak. Paying a $200,000 bounty means selling tokens into a thin market.

2. **Valuation denial.** A vulnerability that risks $800 million doesn't feel real until it's exploited. Before the exploit, it's a theoretical risk. After, it's catastrophic. The reward is set based on the pre-exploit risk perception.

3. **Bad precedent fear.** Pay big once, and every researcher will target you. This is the weakest argument. It assumes researchers are primarily motivated by your specific bounty pool rather than reputation, skill-building, or the broader ecosystem's health.

### What This Says About the Industry

The $4,000 bounty story is getting attention because it's an extreme case. But it's not an outlier in direction — just in magnitude. The broader pattern is that crypto consistently underinvests in the very security infrastructure it depends on.

Audits are expensive. Bounties are cheap relative to the risk. Insurance is still immature. The math works out in a bull market where token prices obscure structural weaknesses. In a flat or down market, the gaps become visible.

I don't have a solution beyond: pay researchers what they're worth. Not what the minimum ethical obligation requires. The difference between $4,000 and $400,000 is trivial compared to the cost of an $800 million exploit. And eventually, someone is going to find the bug that the underpaid bounty program missed. They'll make the other choice. The industry will act surprised. And we'll have this same conversation again.

---

*I don't know which protocol was involved in today's post, and the details are still emerging. But the pattern is old enough that the lesson applies regardless of the specific name.*

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

title: Wild mushroom story 🍄
body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcq8GNSpCCj8AGnZXv9EBiJYKvyQKeThtSmEbp5tj2SP1/1779671318454.jpg) Assalamu Alaikum Hello Hive Community friends, hope everyone is well. Today I am going to share with you a strange and beautiful creation of nature. Which was recently captured on my camera. Walking along the village path or looking carefully at the damp soil, you can see all sorts of amazing wild mushrooms. Similarly, dry leaves on a cool afternoon. And this wonderful mushroom, standing tall among the haystacks, caught my eye. The light golden-brown hue in the middle of this umbrella-shaped mushroom And the pure white color around it is bound to win the heart of any nature lover. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRTWkHYwYkNuYsfQFyiLwwW1ehgJncKbNRnwb2xTFPSFE/1779671318649.jpg) Many of us know mushrooms as frog umbrellas. When I saw these mushrooms on a rainy day as a child, I felt like someone had spread a small umbrella for the creatures of nature. The interesting thing is that these mushrooms Born for a short time. Just as they grow quickly when exposed to rain, they also fade away in the hot sun. No matter how attractive and tempting the mushroom may look in the picture, there is one rule that should always be followed when it comes to wild mushrooms. Just look at them with your eyes, don't touch or try to eat them. Because many naturally growing mushrooms are highly poisonous. Eating them without knowing can be a serious health risk. However, the joy of capturing this beautiful, fleeting creation is different. I tried to take this macro shot sitting very close to the ground, keeping the background of the dry branches intact. My main goal was to highlight the soft stem below the mushroom and the fine texture above. These small elements of nature remind us that true peace lies within the calm and silent beauty of nature, rather than in grand achievements.

title: Stitch Amigurumi
body:
> Saludos querida comunidad, hace unos días un prima me encargó un Stitch amigurumi tamaño mini para regalárselo a mi tía, realmente me encantó este proyecto porque no había tenido la oportunidad hacer a este personaje en pequeño tamaño, siempre es un reto hacer la figuras pequeñas porque la mínima diferencia de una puntada puede cambiar completamente las proporciones, otro aspecto que se me dificultó fue encontrar los tonos azules correctos para el personaje, por lo cual después de ponerme de acuerdo con la cliente me dio luz verde para hacerlo con otros tonos que no son como el original pero que igualmente quedan bien, ella quedó muy contenta con el resultado y yo aliviada de haber cumplido la misión que me encomendó 😊 > Greetings dear community! A few days ago, a cousin commissioned me to make a mini Stitch amigurumi as a gift for my aunt. I really loved this project because I hadn't had the opportunity to make this character in a small size before. It's always a challenge to make small figures because the slightest difference in a stitch can completely change the proportions. Another aspect I found difficult was finding the right shades of blue for the character. After discussing it with the client, she gave me the go-ahead to use other shades that aren't the same as the original but still look good. She was very happy with the result, and I was relieved to have accomplished the task she entrusted to me. 😊
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/EpEN8GuN5EwJNZoFRbVsArkHGkP6jx9kNuxMN2AqWcJZ6RGSrdYEJqJNdTfVkMVBL5L.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Proceso / Process

Trabajé con hilo acrílico y ganchillo de 1.25mm, con el hilo azul intenso hice un anillo de 6 puntos bajos, hice 6 aumentos por 4 hileras, luego una hilera de 30 puntos bajos, hice una hilera con 4 puntos con azul celeste, otra hilera con 6 puntos azul celeste y 5 hileras con 8 puntos azul celeste, en la siguiente hilera hice 6 disminuciones. Aparte hice los brazos con hilo azul intenso, haciendo un anillo de 6 puntos bajos y 5 hileras de puntos ajos, coloqué los brazos a los lados y los uní en la siguiente hilera del cuerpo, hice 6 disminuciones por 2 hileras hasta obtener 12 puntadas. Aparte hice las patas con azul marino solo en la base y el resto con azul intenso, los dedos los hice haciendo punto puff con azul marino, luego las cosí al cuerpo. > I worked with acrylic yarn and a 1.25mm crochet hook. With the dark blue yarn, I made a magic ring of 6 single crochet stitches, increased 6 stitches for 4 rows, then worked a row of 30 single crochet stitches. I worked a row of 4 stitches with light blue yarn, another row of 6 light blue stitches, and 5 rows of 8 light blue stitches. In the following row, I made 6 decreases. Separately, I made the arms with dark blue yarn, making a magic ring of 6 single crochet stitches and 5 rows of single crochet stitches. I attached the arms to the sides and joined them in the next row of the body, decreasing 6 stitches for 2 rows until I had 12 stitches. Separately, I made the legs with navy blue only at the base and the rest with dark blue. I made the toes with puff stitches using navy blue yarn, then sewed them to the body.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK2EQXtPVi1Dcj5cGs2ke2qQ9SRwmVC6cLsNaaTBXeHbBkEmhq1tx37x1UsJsXv.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Para la cabeza con hilo azul intenso hice un anillo de 6 puntos bajos, 6 aumentos por 6 hileras, 14 hileras sin aumentos, luego hice una hilera con la mitad de los puntos en azul celeste, luego hice 6 disminuciones por 4 hileras según correspondiera el color de la puntada para obtener 18, luego rellené y cosí la cabeza al cuerpo. > For the head with intense blue yarn I made a ring of 6 single crochet stitches, 6 increases for 6 rows, 14 rows without increases, then I made a row with half the stitches in light blue, then I made 6 decreases for 4 rows according to the color of the stitch to obtain 18, then I stuffed and sewed the head to the body.

Para las orejas hice 4 partes, dos rosadas y dos azules, luego las uní para formar cada oreja y las cosí a cada lado de la cabeza, los ojos los hice con negro y en la ultima hileras cambié a azul celeste, mientras que para la nariz usé solamente hilo azul marino.

title: Can you imagine regenerating like a salamander?
body:
Can you imagine regenerating like a salamander?


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmdz3VjhJuEAAxnxggz3N3DXgUk1XQXmvWiskh1ampZs35/image.png
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> The regeneration of full limbs seems something restricted to certain creatures in nature; salamanders manage to rebuild legs, tissues, nerves and even parts of the heart as if the body simply knew how to restart its own biology. In the field, mammals follow a different logic; when we suffer a serious injury, the body prioritizes rapid healing. forming fibrous tissue instead of rebuilding the original structure.


But now, scientists at

>Texas H&M University say they have taken an important step toward changing that. Researchers developed an experimental serum capable of stimulating mammals to activate regenerative mechanisms that normally remain “paid.” According to scientists, the regenerative capacity did not completely disappear in mammals, it was only obscured over time.


In the experiments carried out with mice, the researchers tried to artificially reproduce a biological process known as epimorphic regeneration, exactly the same mechanism used by salamanders to recreate lost limbs, it works more or less like this: after an amputation, the cells near the injury stop forming conventional scars and begin to return to a more primitive and flexible state, these cells then form a structure called blastema, a kind of temporary biological platform that serves as a basis for rebuilding bones, ligaments, joints and other tissues.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmSatr6WrcUmRdsDjzeKxoKBbPHDoXmeFj8CYVptqoSywu/image.png
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> The big challenge was always to induce this behavior in mammals, so the team created a serum capable of sending specific biochemical signals to local cells, directing them first to avoid excessive scarring and then to initiate regenerative patterns and that is one of the most revolutionary parts of the research, because unlike many experimental regenerative therapies, this approach does not depend on the introduction of external stem cells.


The process uses the cells already present in the animal's body. Scientists are beginning to treat regeneration not as artificial replacement, but as internal biological reprogramming. Of course, we are still a long way from regenerating complete human arms or creating scenes worthy of science fiction. The researchers themselves recognize the current limitations of the technique, but the potential impact is enormous.


In the short term, technologies like this can help in tissue regeneration after serious accidents, burns, nerve injuries or complex surgeries and in the future they may completely change our understanding of aging, amputations and biological recovery and as we begin to reprogram tissues and regenerate body parts, scientists also begin to try to directly modify invisible patterns within the human body itself.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png


Sorry for my Ingles, it's not my main language. The images were taken from the sources used or were created with artificial intelligence

links.title: My Splinterlands Diary: Buy Gladius Pack & Opening
links.body:
<center>https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://images.hive.blog/DQmcNsaFcaQViYoZNBVVwbz1MqkTGshwsdMxP8P4hUgS1gA/splinterlandsGIF.gif</center>

It's time again to buy and open some gladius packs. We have just completed our weekly brawl, finished in seventh. I contributed with a record of seven wins and two losses.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNayHgmqWckjSf4Hat5jPj3pLpiDwX3we7jgHmNQPzDcG/image.png)</center>

I'm a member of Gank's Squadron Guild, playing brawls weekly. From there, I earn rewards to buy packs which I will do today. My results in brawls improved because of the cards I borrowed from our leader, @snowboardingpete. Anyway, the topic today is the gladiator cards I'm buying and opening.

I have enough merits to buy two packs from the shop. A gladius pack is 2,000 merits per pack and I have 5k+ merits to buy two packs.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcdJYFSWgMXXtLGYR8A26R53VJnxAJrwmyo4cM5R3xXtq/image.png)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbHKa4UUGRqXNYoYmAR9BRitYwSHD1gN4pwRqE1pHW468/image.png)</center>


I opened the packs one at a time. The first pack contained the cards below.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZP1M1sEorFXoQJU251d8ct8aXncHQcSjQtRjtX8Jztro/image.png)</center>

The first pack contained a strong epic card named Marisol Contuna. It's a melee card that belongs to the life element. It has four attack which is excellent and a reach ability in addition to bloodlust which all gladiator cards possess. 

The pack also contained a rare card. It's a one mana earth card with one attack called Cutter Brieze. It has no other ability save for bloodlust. 

Another earth card was Bertrol Gobson. It's a low mana card like Cutter Brieze. It has an opportunity ability in addition to bloodlust. 



Next pack had the following units below.



<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdU4GQACWme2GN38Ba9z3j1R9vq1rEvV5her3BUFvCtog/image.png)</center>

It's one rare and four common cards. The rare card is one I like a lot. A magic card named Captain Katie. I like that she does big magic attack at level one. One more card I like is Katrelba Gobson. I like her double strike ability. She is the only card I have that has three abilities at level one.

Overall the cards were a good addition to my gladiator cards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbHKa4UUGRqXNYoYmAR9BRitYwSHD1gN4pwRqE1pHW468/image.png)

Thanks to mhowii for the free blog dividers he shared in his post.

For players looking for games in Hive, I invite you to play the following games. They can be played for free in the links.

Splinterlands https://splinterlands.com/

Next to Splinterlands, I also play Dungeon Cities daily. It's a text based dungeon crawler game similar to Diablo. Come to the city of Aldoria and start your quest in the following links.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV4soRrRSBHKxC9Bo2e1GrsbQjvhTxtznYwECQYsfZN8Z/image.png)</center>

Dungeon Cities: https://play.dungeoncities.com/login?ref=crypto-hokage

links.title: Peace that surpasses understanding!!! | Paz que sobrepasa todo entendimiento!!!
links.body:
<center>![](https://images.pexels.com/photos/460672/pexels-photo-460672.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)
[FUENTE](https://www.bible.com/)
</center>

Have you ever felt like you're carrying something that seems beyond your strength? Like no matter what you do, things just don't seem to work out? I know that feeling. We've all been there at some point in our journey.

I'm not talking about mere motivation here—I'm talking about the very presence of Jesus in our lives, illuminating everything that seems to have been covered by darkness. Everything can be restored. Everything can shine again. And out of nothing, Jesus can make everything new.

God always has good news to give us. Regardless of social status, history, past, or anything else. The message from heaven is a message of grace, redemption, and forgiveness. This good news brings joy to everyone.

> Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

Filipenses 4:6-7

## God Bless you today and always!!!

**********
**********

La vida tiene estos momentos de incertidumbre, momentos donde cuestionamos todo. El camino adelante se ve neblinoso, la ruta poco clara. Pero estos mismos momentos son en realidad oportunidades: oportunidades para confiar más profundamente, para apoyarnos con más fuerza, para crecer más fuerte en formas que nunca imaginamos.

No estoy hablando de motivación aquí, estoy hablando de la misma presencia de Jesús en nuestras vidas iluminando todo aquello que parece que fue cubierto por la oscuridad. Todo puede ser restaurado. Todo puede volver a brillar. Y de la nada Jesús puede hacerlo todo nuevo.

Decidamos hoy confiar a Dios y entregarle aquello que nos cuesta soltar. Y te puedo asegurar que cuando aprendes a soltar es cuando realmente aprendes a vivir.

> Por nada estéis angustiados, sino sean conocidas vuestras peticiones delante de Dios en toda oración y ruego, con acción de gracias. Y la paz de Dios, que sobrepasa todo entendimiento, guardará vuestros corazones y vuestros pensamientos en Cristo Jesús.

Filipenses 4:6-7

## Dios te Bendiga hoy y siempre!!!

links.body: ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQrJPUj7MBLxqoC4ucC87vRmD5TpSyjnPLcnqSpsErsQH/image.png)\n\n>U.S. President Donald Trump said on the 23rd (local time) that the ongoing end-of-war negotiations with Iran have reached the \

The U.S. and Iran are said to draw a draft memorandum of understanding (MOU), an agreement to end the war, and refine the details at the last minute.\n\n>President Trump said on Truth Social, a social network service (SNS), that negotiations to halt the war with Iran and reopen the Strait of Hormuz have reached the final stage. \

However, he did not specify the timing of the announcement.

>In response, U.S. media Axios quoted U.S. government officials as saying that a draft MOU was drawn for an agreement between the U.S. and Iran to end the war, and details were being coordinated on the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, the relocation of uranium enrichment, and the timing and method of sanctions relief. The U.S. and Iran are said to be considering setting the validity period of the MOU to 60 days for now, but allowing it to be extended under a mutual agreement. Iran's semi-official Fars news agency also reported on the 24th that the draft of a potential MOU between the United States and Iran included a ban on mutual preemptive strikes and the partial resumption of the Strait of Hormuz.

> Officials from both countries also hinted that negotiations are imminent. U.S. Secretary of State Marko Rubio, who is visiting India, told reporters on Sunday that there is a possibility to announce something, whether it is today or tomorrow, or in a few days, indicating that an announcement of an end-of-war deal is imminent. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Bagai also confirmed through Iranian state media that the two countries are close to finalizing the 14-point MOU aimed at ending the war, adding to the possibility of reaching a deal.

>The development came shortly after Qatar and Pakistan's special envoy visited Tehran and engaged in intensive diplomatic activities. Gen. Asim Munir, the commander-in-chief of Pakistan's power elite, met with Ahmad Bahidi, commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), a key figure in Iran's decision-making process, and continued behind-the-scenes negotiations with senior Iranian officials in Tehran.
President Trump has been pressing Iran for an agreement by bringing up a military option card. Earlier, in an interview with Axios early on the 23rd, President Trump evaluated the possibility of an agreement with Iran as \
and warned that the U.S. could \
Iran if the negotiations fail. In addition, Truth Social shared an image of an American flag covering the map of Iran, provoking Iran with the title \

It was interpreted as an open threat to attack Iran's civilian infrastructure and energy facilities if the negotiations break down.\nHowever, within the U.S. government, it was already leaning toward negotiations rather than war with Iran, according to the Washington Post (WP). President Trump's military threat was a strategic pressure to bring Iran to the negotiating table. Axios also said that President Trump has been struggling between a large-scale military attack on Iran and a diplomatic settlement until recently, but is now leaning toward a diplomatic solution.\nA U.S. official told Axios, \

San Francisco= Correspondent Park Ji-yeon (jyp@hankookilbo.com )

“I don’t know how this agreement will turn out, but if it’s merely an extension of the already agreed nuclear deterrence period, it would serve as a prime example proving Trump’s incompetence.
Incompetence, at times, can be the greatest of sins.”

links.body:
![8djs8gpgmxhDvBjs_1000263021.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/emmaris/images/8djs8gpgmxhDvBjs_1000263021/8djs8gpgmxhDvBjs_1000263021.webp) ![Ua6fRInxDVxFMYCB_1000262950.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/emmaris/images/Ua6fRInxDVxFMYCB_1000262950/Ua6fRInxDVxFMYCB_1000262950.webp) ![4a4AyDY3zYKvWBRG_1000262940.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/emmaris/images/4a4AyDY3zYKvWBRG_1000262940/4a4AyDY3zYKvWBRG_1000262940.webp) ![O2OqAnN4hKlxZhub_1000262947.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/emmaris/images/O2OqAnN4hKlxZhub_1000262947/O2OqAnN4hKlxZhub_1000262947.webp) ![Y9SMhUZQ08Z8auY7_1000262913.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/emmaris/images/Y9SMhUZQ08Z8auY7_1000262913/Y9SMhUZQ08Z8auY7_1000262913.webp) ![g2dMra8O1WB39itX_1000262916.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/emmaris/images/g2dMra8O1WB39itX_1000262916/g2dMra8O1WB39itX_1000262916.webp) ![PwGO5XogKztwRsaz_1000262925.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/emmaris/images/PwGO5XogKztwRsaz_1000262925/PwGO5XogKztwRsaz_1000262925.webp) ![d0j23dyKePmiaKwq_1000262922.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/emmaris/images/d0j23dyKePmiaKwq_1000262922/d0j23dyKePmiaKwq_1000262922.webp) ![owLnNhKipqB6bwa4_1000262919.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/emmaris/images/owLnNhKipqB6bwa4_1000262919/owLnNhKipqB6bwa4_1000262919.webp) ![0L8b421jHCLzSTmn_1000262953.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/emmaris/images/0L8b421jHCLzSTmn_1000262953/0L8b421jHCLzSTmn_1000262953.webp)

Saludos queridos y apreciados amigos, Feliz y bendecido día tengan todos, les cuento que para este año 2026 correspondió ser anfitrión para esta celebración a mí parroquia y pues hace unos días cuando recibí el cronograma de actividades me ilusione de poder asistir, sin embargo mi familia me decía que por mi enfermedad no debía exponerme. Cómo todos saben la quimioterapia es un tratamiento muy fuerte que deja el cuerpo con las defensas bajas por lo cual no debo exponerme a contraer ningún virus, y debo cuidarme mucho más

Las actividades eran todo el día, desde las 8 de la mañana con el recibimiento de las otras parroquias, hasta las 5 de la tarde la celebración eucaristíca, yo la verdad tenía muchas ganas de ir y odio estar encerrada, así que a pesar de no asistir al recibimiento, ni la caminata por la de, decidí ir con mucha precaución a la eucaristía tratando de cuidarme. Así pues le pedí a mi mamá que me acompañará y mi esposo nos llevó hasta el lugar exacto a la hora, la verdad había muchísimas personas, personas de todas partes de la isla de margarita, por un lado me sentía triste de no poder haber estado allí en las otras actividades pero también feliz de cumplir y estar presente en el cierre.

Fue una misa muy hermosa que duro un poco más de una hora, fue hermoso y me sentía llena de amor, esperanza, fe y también muy satisfecha, feliz y agradecida. Al terminar mi esposo fue por nosotros y pues así nos despedimos deseando el próximo año poder cumplir nuevamente.

El contenido de esta publicación es completamente original y todas las fotos son mías y fueron tomadas con mi celular Redmi note 13. ___ ENGLISH ___

> Greetings dear and esteemed friends, have a happy and blessed day. I wanted to let you know that my parish was chosen to host this celebration in 2026, and a few days ago when I received the schedule of activities, I was excited to attend. However, my family told me that because of my illness, I shouldn't risk it. As everyone knows, chemotherapy is a very strong treatment that leaves the body with low defenses, so I mustn't expose myself to any viruses, and I must take extra care.

> The activities were all day long, from 8:00 a.m. with the welcome from the other parishes, until 5:00 p.m. for the Eucharistic celebration. I really wanted to go, and I hate being cooped up, so even though I couldn't attend the welcome or the walk, I decided to go to the Eucharist with great caution, trying to take care of myself. So I asked my mom to accompany me, and my husband drove us to the exact place on time. There were so many people, people from all over Margarita Island. On one hand, I felt sad that I couldn't be there for the other activities, but also happy to be present for the closing.

> It was a very beautiful mass that lasted a little over an hour. It was beautiful, and I felt filled with love, hope, and faith, and also very satisfied, happy, and grateful. When it was over, my husband came to pick us up, and that's how we said goodbye, hoping to celebrate again next year.

> The content of this post is completely original and all photos are mine and were taken with my Redmi note 13 cell phone. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@emmaris/pentecostes-2026-esp-eng)

links.body:
<center>

</center>


<center> 
## La magia está en las manos de quien trabaja con amor, pasión,  y moldea las estrellas. 
(@mafalda2018)
</center>

<div class=\

> **¡Hola! Hermosa comunidad #HiveDiy, volandito ando para dejarles un fuerte abrazo, un café virtual con aroma que les despierte los ánimos y un proyecto de manualidades. Les deseo que sus días sean especiales y llenos de alegría.** **Oh la la**

>

>![ English]
>
> The magic is in the hands of those who work with love, passion, and shape the stars.
Hello! Beautiful #HiveDiy community, I'm just popping in to send you a big hug, a virtual coffee with an aroma to lift your spirits, and a craft project. I wish you special days filled with joy.
Oh la la



<center> 


![Romantic and unforgettable melodies from the movies (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/EoH3iN928uEc45nAXKcAstfdEWnLDKENn95VsSRmCPZti8kde4bpFFADrR2atYWC35E.png)

</center>

<div class=\

>

Unos minutos de reflexión con una taza de café a veces son necesarios para recapitular y dejar todo atrás, como dice la canción de Ricardo Montaner: “Vamos a dejarlo todo atrás y no dejes que el recuerdo…”, pero es que las personas somos así, nos gusta atormentarnos con lo que pudo haber sido. Perdemos el tiempo presente, el aquí y el ahora. Es lo único que tenemos y todavía algunas personas no lo entienden. Cuando esto me sucede y me pongo a pensar en “pajaritos preñados”, me sacudo y digo:

—Aquiétate, mente fastidiosa, — y me doy tres palmadas. Con esto le cambio el ritmo.

Esto sucede cuando estoy ociosa y me pongo insoportable e intensa. Sé que necesito urgente hacer algo para distraerme, matar el fastidio y poner a la mente a hacer algo provechoso y que se calme. Entonces conjuro a mis ancestros, me santiguo y pongo manos a la obra en cualquier cosa que me distraiga. Pero primero, me tomo un café cerrero sin azúcar para nivelar mis chakras. Oh la la.


¡WUAO! Con café y música, la vida es bella.  Decidí iniciar un proyecto que vengo posponiendo. A primera vista parece que es una sopita de pañitos de cocina, pero las apariencias engañan. Aunque no lo crean, mi madre hacía sopita con sus pañitos; los ponía a hervir con jabón de lavar y lejía, y quedaban blanquitos.  Como toda madre que se respetara y venezolana, tenía su olla especial para desmanchar sus trapitos de cocina. Esta técnica es hereditaria y todavía es utilizada en muchas familias en Venezuela; yo particularmente tengo la mía. A las niñas preguntonas como Paraulata, les decía:

—“Hoy tomarán sopita de pañitos de cocina” —, y Paraulata decía: “¡Guácala! Y se escondía.

Desde hace tiempo quería teñir unos retazos de tela de franela blanca. Las hormigas la destrozaron, así que corté lo que se podía reutilizar. Decidí hacer un proyecto para  practicar el teñido de tela. Inicié dando traspiés y las primeras no me gustaron cómo me quedaron. Paso a paso y practicando el teñido con vegetales, he logrado los colores que deseaba.

Según la página macondolaboresyoficios.com.ar, en su artículo: “Historia y origen del teñido”, donde indica:

>”Se han encontrado muestras de tinte solidificado que datan del neolítico (8000 a.C). Existen jeroglíficos egipcios que explican tanto la extracción como la aplicación de tintes, y en China e India se aplica ininterrumpidamente el teñido textil desde hace más de 5000 años…” Para más información visite  <a href=\

>	

El comercio textil ha sido una de las grandes fuentes de ingresos desde tiempos antiguos. Con las telas teñidas se puede hacer muchos artículos útiles, tales como vestidos, alfombras, tapetes, cortinas, manteles, entre otros. Los inicios fueron con tintes naturales extraídos de diferentes árboles. En la actualidad, muchas personas también utilizan productos de la naturaleza por ser sustentables. Las telas más utilizadas: hilo, lino, algodón, lana, entre otras. 

Me gustan las planchas que utilizan en madera para hacer  formas variadas como hojas y flores. Siguiendo con mi proyecto, les digo de antemano que no es de mi autoría; lo he visto en varios tutoriales en YouTube y me llamó la atención, sobre todo el canal de Kau Studio. Voy a utilizar este procedimiento. Les dejo el link:

<center>[“Link”]( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p0bHOdmY0sM&t=225s )</center>


<div class=\
> Con las telas teñidas se hacen lindos proyectos. Hoy les traigo uno que les va a gustar mucho y está muy de moda. ¡Manos a la obra!

>

>![English]
>
> A few minutes of reflection with a cup of coffee are sometimes necessary to recap and leave everything behind, as the Ricardo Montaner song says: “Let’s leave it all behind and don’t let the memory…” But that’s just how we humans are; we like to torment ourselves with what could have been. We lose sight of the present, the here and now. It’s the only thing we have, and some people still don’t understand that. When this happens to me and I start thinking about “pregnant birds,” it shakes me, and I say:
“Quiet down, you annoying mind,” and I clap my hands three times. That changes its rhythm.
This happens when I'm idle and become unbearable and intense. I know I urgently need to do something to distract myself, kill the boredom, and get my mind working on something productive and calming. So I invoke my ancestors, cross myself, and get to work on anything that will distract me. But first, I have a strong, unsweetened coffee to balance my chakras. Oh la la.
WOW! With coffee and music, life is beautiful. I decided to start a project I've been putting off. At first glance, it looks like a dishcloth soup, but appearances can be deceiving. Believe it or not, my mother used to make soup with her dishcloths; she would boil them with laundry soap and bleach, and they would come out white. Like any self-respecting Venezuelan mother, she had her special pot for removing stains from her dishcloths.
This technique is hereditary and is still used in many families in Venezuela; I, in particular, have my own. To inquisitive little girls like Paraulata, I would say:
\

and hide.\nFor some time now, I've wanted to dye some scraps of white flannel fabric. The ants tore it to shreds, and I cut off what could be reused. I decided to do a project to practice fabric dyeing. I started off stumbling, and I didn't like how the first few times I tried. Step by step, and practicing dyeing with vegetables, I've achieved the colors I wanted.\nFabric dyeing is an ancestral technique, according to the website macondolaboresyoficios.com.ar, in their article: \

which states:\n“Samples of solidified dye dating back to the Neolithic period (8000 BC) have been found. Egyptian hieroglyphs explain both the extraction and application of dyes, and textile dyeing has been practiced continuously in China and India for over 5000 years…” For more information, visit  <a href=\

>aquí The textile trade has been a major source of income since ancient times. Many useful items can be made from dyed fabrics, such as dresses, rugs, carpets, curtains, tablecloths, and more. Initially, natural dyes were extracted from various trees. Today, many people still use natural products because they are sustainable. The most commonly used fabrics include yarn, linen, cotton, and wool. I like the wooden tools they use to create various shapes like leaves and flowers. Regarding my project, I want to clarify that it's not my own creation; I saw it in several YouTube tutorials and it caught my attention, especially on the Kau Studio channel. I'm going to use this technique. Here's the link:
[“Link”]( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p0bHOdmY0sM&t=225s )
You can make beautiful projects with dyed fabrics. Today I'm bringing you one that you're going to love and that's very fashionable. Let's get started!
![Receta de Palagar sudado (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/23vshMfw7daJ1v5HNsDh1yUksgjr1ZWwGXYDMQVLRTqqhYoJip2YaTTc614cCy6je24TW.png)

> El proyecto es muy sencillo y se trata de aprender a teñir telas con productos naturales y con estos retazos de tela hice una linda manualidad. ¿Qué será? ¿Qué será? Lo dejo a su imaginación. En la revisión que hice encontré información importante sobre el teñido de ellas y se las dejo como tips. • El té negro da un color marrón, beige y vintage. • El té verde da un color verde pálido. • La flor de jamaica, hojas de remolacha y cayena da un color rosado, rojo, morado. Amigos de #HiveDiy la tonalidad va a depender de la concentración. Si lo desea oscuro, agregue más té y viceversa.

> >![English] > > The project is very simple and involves learning how to dye fabrics with natural products. With these fabric scraps, I made a lovely craft. What will it be? I'll leave it to your imagination. In my research, I found important information about dyeing fabrics, and I'm sharing it with you as tips. Black tea gives a brown, beige, and vintage color. Green tea gives a pale green color. Hibiscus flowers, beet leaves, and cayenne pepper give a pink, red, or purple color. Friends of #HiveDiy, the shade will depend on the concentration. If you want a darker color, add more tea, and vice versa.

In return, Iran also promised not to launch any preemptive military strikes against the United States and its allies.

>U.S. online media Axios said earlier that the U.S. and Iran are close to signing an MOU on the 60th that calls for extending the ceasefire, opening the Strait of Hormuz, and nuclear negotiations.
The two countries reportedly discussed plans to open the Strait of Hormuz, lift the blockade of Iran, and hold further negotiations over the suspension of uranium enrichment, the disposal of highly enriched uranium and easing sanctions.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![LK07E3iozJ5bHsem_IMG_20260522_194505.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/LK07E3iozJ5bHsem_IMG_20260522_194505/LK07E3iozJ5bHsem_IMG_20260522_194505.webp)
![AUCtGxHWgVUxnexM_IMG_20260522_194445.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/AUCtGxHWgVUxnexM_IMG_20260522_194445/AUCtGxHWgVUxnexM_IMG_20260522_194445.webp)
![G13R7OAIcfaT4Phc_IMG_20260522_194723.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/G13R7OAIcfaT4Phc_IMG_20260522_194723/G13R7OAIcfaT4Phc_IMG_20260522_194723.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

不知道是不是老了，现在经常做事丢三落四的！不是忘记这就是忘记那的！心里总是感觉空唠唠的！以前总是出门走了好远，感觉门没有关好，特意再回头看下门关好了没有！总感觉门没关好，回去看，其实关得好好！

今天更郁闷，两个人一起出门关好了就门，才发现我们两个人都没有带钥匙出门！真是有点懊悔啊！突然感觉心情就不好了！没办法了，只能叫开锁师傅啦！唉～真是的，关上门才想起来要带钥匙！

我家老头以为我背包里有钥匙！其实我也没带！只能求助开锁师傅啦！我在业主群里咨询一下，有没有开锁师傅！果然可能大家都有这样的问题！不久就有了联系开锁师傅方式！他说过半个小时才过来，那我们就去吃完饭再说吧！唉～本来记得带钥匙就不需要花这个冤枉钱的！要是可以还可以吃个好的！现在只能吃个便宜的饭饭了！

钱都要留着给师傅工钱！不知道开个锁多少钱！以前在广州开个锁都要三百多块钱！要是在这里也那么贵，我都想换个门了！开个暴力拆破！还好电话里师傅说只要一百块！他说我们这个门不是一级门锁，这个门锁简单！

只见师傅在门锁前插入特殊工具，扭几下，不开，再换个办法扭几下，还不见打开，我都心里捏一把汗，不知道师傅本事怎样！我以为他们开锁向电影那样，用卡片一滑就开了！想不到那么麻烦～师傅来回试了十分钟左右，才一头汗水地打开门！

有种如息重负的感觉！真好～没有砸门就弄好了！简简单单又花了我一百块钱！感觉辛辛苦苦又白干了！以后出门我都要记得带钥匙了，不然又是不见一百块！不知道是不是年纪大了，记性不好了！唉～心疼不见一百块，烦心自己记忆力不太好！这回长记性了！

---

body.title: What is Missing
body.body: I would feel sick at those nerve damaging TV shows starting with an instant pop out of bed and then onto brunch, the furnished and exactly measured rubbish manufactured to hide that it is, but it is not. I get it as a narrative of a deeply productive person, but what the character is usually up to is in the office, not sure what they are doing and they tend to have a very open schedule. They hang out all day, everything timed to a tee, but most egregious are the books built on being a product of time and space, no time to lament and think, but to go on. You know, endless bombardment of reading is wasteful to some who can learn to go out or get some skills. It is not sunshine and rainbows. People have lives, not manufactured dates and expiry.\n https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPC2oNrF6dnuJT5Q66LuJN3UJQrCDZfq3UGBS4XXbbk16/bruce-barrow-uGn0T3Kapzk-unsplash.jpg \nPhoto by <a href=\

>Unsplash Sometimes the days are long and sometimes a bit short. Every day presents everything different as if you are in a game. There is no strategy to waking up early. Sometimes you do. There is a reward to having consistent meals and sleep, no one argues with that. But when does the character find the time to clean up the bed or the house? That does not come up everywhere, so it has an element of fakeness to it that makes me sick. The more I think about this, efficiency or managing life is not the thing that rubs me the wrong way. It is the showing or cataloging of it. I used to be that way, but people do not care. It is you who does and the lie is not obvious as the euphoria you get from being the one in control is far superior. At some point you get obsessed with it like I was with fitness. And someday you realize that it is in fact a guardrail to hide beneath the surface your soul, for that obsession that masks the truth. You will never be able to work on that. So when I see someone on the posts or parading his routine, he may think he is so productive, but I think what is missing. EPL ပွဲစဉ်တွေက တရားဝင် ပြီးဆုံးသွားခဲ့ပြီ။ ချန်ပီယံကတော့ Round 37 မှာ ကတည်းက အဖြေပေါ်ခဲ့ပေမဲ့ တန်းဆင်းဇုန် ၁ နေရာ အတွက်ကတော့ နောက်ဆုံး ပွဲစဉ် Round 38 မှာမှ အဖြေပေါ်ခဲ့လေ၏။ တကယ်တော့ Round 37 ကတည်းက အဖြေပေါ်ခဲ့ရမှာ။ Tottenham တို့ သရေဆိုရင်ကို တန်းမဆင်းရတော့ဘူး။ ဒါကို ရှုံးသွားလို့ နောက်ဆုံးပွဲစဉ်ထိ ရောက်လာခဲ့ရရော။ နောက်ဆုံး ပွဲစဉ်မှာလည်း သရေကျရုံနဲ့ တန်းမဆင်းရတော့ပါဘူး။ ဒါပေမဲ့ Everton ကို ၁-၀ နဲ့ အနိုင်ကစား သွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။

West Ham အနေဖြင့် Leeds ကို ၃-၀ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရခဲ့ပေမဲ့ Tottenham ရဲ့ အနိုင်ရလဒ်ကြောင့် တန်းဆင်းသွားခဲ့ရပါပြီ။ စိတ်မကောင်း စရာပါ။ နောက်ဆုံးပွဲစဉ်မှာ ထရှုံးလို့ UEL ဝင်ခွင့် ဆုံးရှုံးခဲ့ရတဲ့ အသင်းက Chelsea ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ ရာသီဝက် ကျော်လာသည်အထိ UCL ဝင်ခွင့်နေရာမှာ ရှိနေခဲ့တဲ့ Chelsea ဟာ ရာသီသိမ်းခါနားနီးချိန်မှာတော့ ရလဒ်တွေ တဖြည်းဖြည်း ဆိုးလာပြီး အမှတ်ပေး ဇယားရဲ့ အလယ်အလတ်အဆင့်ထိ ဆင်းသွားခဲ့ရပါတယ်။ နောက်ဆုံးပွဲစဉ်မှာ Sunderland ကို အနိုင်ရခဲ့ရင် UEL ဝင်ရောက် ယှဉ်ပြိုင်ခွင့် ရမှာပါ။ သို့ပေမဲ့ Sunderland ကို ၂-၁ ဖြင့် ရှုံးနိမ့်ပြီး အဆိုပါ အခွင့်အရေးကို လက်လွှတ်ခဲ့ရပါတယ်။ UEL ဝင်ခွင့်ကို Sunderland က ရရှိသွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။

ငါတို့ အဆင့် ၂ ပဲ ရတော့တယ်ဆိုပြီး စိတ်လျော့ လိုက်လို့လားရယ် မသိ City တို့ အိမ်ကွင်းမှာ Aston Villa ကို ၁-၂ ဖြင့် ရှုံးနိမ့်သွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ပူပူနွေးနွေး UEL ချန်ပီယံအဖို့ ချိုမြိန်သော ရာသီပိတ် ပွဲစဉ်လေး ဖြစ်ခဲ့ပါတယ်။ Liverpool ကတော့ အိမ်ကွင်းမှာ Brentford နဲ့ ၁-၁ သရေကျသွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ချန်ပီယံ Arsenal ကတော့ Crystal Palace ကို ၁-၂ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYoYUqvRgPDeoQz5WuJGQqAAmhhX8hUwv4AMHLjKNKsYJ/1779672000089.jpg)


Arsenal ပရိတ်သတ်တွေ ပျော်ရသလို United ပရိတ်သတ်တွေလည်း ဝမ်းသာရတဲ့ နှစ်တနှစ် ဖြစ်ခဲ့ပါတယ်။ အသင်းက လမ်းကြောင်းပေါ် ပြန်ရောက်လာတယ်လို့ ပြောရမလိုပါပဲ။ Michael Carrick ရောက်လာပြီးနောက် ရလဒ်တွေ ပြန်လည် ကောင်းမွန်ခဲ့ပြီး အဆင့် ၃ နဲ့ ရာသီသိမ်းပြီး UCL ဝင်ခွင့်ပါရရှိခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ဝမ်းအသာရဆုံးက အသင်းခေါင်းဆောင် Bruno Fernandes အနေဖြင့် 21 Assist နဲ့ စံချိန်သစ် တင်သွားခဲ့တာပါ။ Round 37 မှာ Henry & De Bruyne ရဲ့ 20 Assist စံချိန် တူခဲ့ပြီး နောက်ဆုံးပွဲစဉ်မှာတော့ နောက်ထပ် Assist ထပ်ရခဲ့တာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

Bruno အတွက် အကောင်းဆုံး ရာသီလို့ ဆိုရမှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ EPL ပြီးဆုံးသွားခြင်း နှင့်အတူ Legend players တွေလည်း အသင်းတွေနဲ့ လမ်းခွဲနှုတ်ဆက်သွားခဲ့ပါပြီ။ လာမယ့် ရာသီမှာ ဒီ ကစားသမားတွေကို ကျနော်တို့ တွေ့မြင်ရတော့မှာ မဟုတ်ပါဘူး။ Man City, Chelsea တို့မှာ နည်းပြ အသစ်တွေနဲ့ ရာသီသစ်ကို ဖြတ်သန်းကြရမှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 25 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g2169c4bf574a17902de2e64ce71bf6447a5b681b62ba3faee775c07d0c0926be4480f32468632b9fe217315d6765018e_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente revitalizante. Empecé en el parque central, donde el aire fresco y el canto de los pájaros me dieron la energía perfecta para comenzar el día. Mientras caminaba, conocí a una mujer mayor que estaba alimentando a las palomas; se llamaba Marta y me contó que hace más de 20 años viene diariamente al parque. Su pasión por las aves era contagiosa, y me dio algunos consejos sobre cómo reconocer diferentes especies. Más adelante, me topé con un grupo de artistas callejeros que pintaban un mural vibrante en una pared. Era impresionante ver cómo cada uno de ellos aportaba su estilo y color al proyecto. Hablé con un joven llamado Leo, que me explicó que el mural representaba la diversidad cultural de la ciudad. Me inspiró ver cómo el arte puede unir a la comunidad y dar voz a importantes mensajes sociales. Cada paso en mi caminata me recordó la belleza que hay en lo cotidiano y la conexión que se puede forjar con los demás, incluso en un simple paseo por la ciudad. Definitivamente, estoy deseando salir de nuevo y ver qué nuevas historias me esperan. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: Among the cards I received today
body.body:
Today was a very special memorable day for my gaming life. Like every day, I sat down  play  game with great interest. Usually, I log in to the game every day and complete various missions and gradually try to improve my collection. But today's experience was completely different. Because today I received some cards as gifts through the game, which really gave me great joy. Especially the moment of receiving the gold card was the most exciting and joyful for me.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR1oYfyQmtUC5e3mHw23kC3FnokrWNWdpMCoaQ76Yq28z/1779671482195.png)

There is always a different excitement when opening cards in the game. Because no one can tell in advance when a card will be available. Sometimes ordinary cards come, and sometimes some rare or legendary cards come out that make the whole moment extraordinary. When I was opening the cards today, from the beginning it seemed that something good might be waiting for me today. My excitement was increasing as I opened one card after another and in the end I got some really beautiful cards.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdceBKK6f7ExBMjAbbeURbrWD3HmEvHQLycpxSw1QDAQg/1779671206717.jpg)

Among the cards I received today, I really liked the “Sturdy Axe Warden” card.  The design of this card is very attractive and its power is also quite good. I think it will be quite effective in the game battle as well as it looks strong. Having such a card collection gives you more confidence to play. Also, the “Moros Malik” card seemed very nice to me. Its rare status and unique look made the card even more special.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPS1g2JNLE44p3mYMyW1zY6cppSHNfLg1CrdUg5so7xFr/1779671206834.jpg)

The biggest surprise was the “Frank Arksgard” gold card. Honestly, when I saw the gold card, my joy knew no bounds. Because getting a gold card in the game is not very easy. Many players try for a long time and do not get such a card. So getting this card today felt like a great achievement to me. Gold cards have a different beauty. They look much more attractive and brighter than ordinary cards. In addition, gold cards are very important in terms of game value.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb2wWv462A9sN8hs5Y4XydGANMCkphtovhbvR9voUgu22/1779671206999.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSx6BMfR3vLJ5Pcc9L5VauC6gHFLRcZi4aNpaGn9CTrYo/1779671206890.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ7RSoZQoT4Zbekb4m69YH3G2YFRVGjnNN41EbeDVGEdd/1779671206945.jpg)

I also got a legendary card, called “Giam Root”. My joy increased even more after getting this card. Because legendary cards are always something special to gamers.  Such cards are not easy to find and usually have a lot of power. So I am really happy to have this card added to my collection. This card will definitely help me a lot in future battles.

Another thing that gave me a lot of joy was getting multiple rare cards in today's opening. Usually, it is very rare to get such good cards together. So today's experience will be very memorable for me. Every time I opened a card it felt like  new surprise was waiting. Moments like this increase gamers love for game.

I always try to learn new things and find joy through playing games. Not only winning, but also gradually expanding my collection and getting new cards has a different kind of joy. These cards today have enriched my collection. Now I think my deck will be stronger than before. Especially because  having gold  legendary cards, my performance in future matches can better.

I think gaming is not just a way pass time, it is also a world great joy and excitement.  Small achievements every day inspire a player anew. Today's gifts inspired me just like that. Because after receiving such beautiful cards, I now want to play with more enthusiasm.

I was really excited during today's card opening. Before flipping each card, I felt that maybe something better would come this time. And when I really saw one good card after another, it was difficult to express that joy in words. Especially after receiving the gold card, I was looking at it for a long time. Because such cards are not only for the game, but also a matter  pride for a gamer.

I also found the art and design cards very interesting. Each character has a different style and different strengths, which make game more fun. I always like this kind design. Because not only in terms  gameplay, but also in terms visual aspect cards game looks very beautiful.

Overall, today was an extraordinary day for me. It is really a pleasure receive such beautiful cards as gifts. Especially because  receiving gold cards and legendary cards today's experience will be even more memorable. These moments are very valuable for a gamer.  Because when you get such a reward after playing for a long time all the hard work seems worthwhile.

I hope get better cards like this in  future  enrich my collection even more. Today achievement has inspired me anew and increased my interest in the game. Honestly, today gifts will be one the best moments my gaming life.

</liketuimages>

Hola!

Hoy dejo por acá un poco de lo que fue mi entrenamiento de este domingo. 

Si bien mi entrenador me estaba colocando solo entrenamientos de 1 hora, incluyendo los domingos, ahora que ya tiene en cuenta que mi fisio me dio de alta, me dijo que podría empezar a realizar 10K suaves los domingos y vamos viendo qué tal me voy sintiendo y va respondiendo mi cuerpo, tomando en cuenta toda la carga de la semana, no solamente con el running, también con el fortalecimiento y que en lo posible quiero tomar al menos 1 día para pedalear. 

Hoy arrancamos con estos primeros 10K suaves que salieron en 1 hora con 16 min. Estaba indecisa si hacerlos solo en tierrita o agarrar también hacia afuera del parque, al final hice de todo un poco, aprox 5K en tierrita y aprox 5K entre acera y asfalto. En general me sentí bastante bien, le di tranquila, escuchando musiquita, disfrutando y concientizando el momento en lo que estaba haciendo, que a veces uno ni se da cuenta por estar tan en automático, en algunos kilómetros le di un poquito más rápido de lo que me tocaba, sin embargo, traté de regular lo más que pude y finalmente me salió el entrenamiento bastante bien. 

Ahora los domingos se van a ver de esta forma, hasta que me vayan cambiando un poco el plan, según como vaya evolucionando y vaya por un objetivo en específico. Por el momento solo estoy concentrada en hacer lo que debo hacer para ir retomando de la mejor manera, sin pensar aún en alguna carrera próxima.

Ya iremos viendo cómo voy avanzando y cómo me vaya sintiendo para decidir en qué momento comenzar a entrenar con foco en alguna carrera.

Feliz domingo!

body.title: Perjalanan Hidupku part.2
body.body:
Selamat Pagi sahabat 
Hi saya Nuni sekarang umur 57 tahun.  Setelah memutuskan bercerai, rasanya campur aduk antara bahagia dan sedih.  Bahagianya rasa was2 setiap hari sudah berakhir. Saya sempat merasa depresi hampir satu tahun sampai akhirya kita berpisah. Part Sedihnya saya merasakan saya gagal mempertahankan perkawinan ini. Waktu itu kakaknya datang dan mengusulkan kita berpisah atau cerai secara hukum islam. Mungkin ini jawaban dari Allah yang setiap hari saya panjatkan. Akhirnya kita berkomitmen kita berpisah dengan menjaga rulesnya tdan masih satu rumah demi anak . Ternyata beliau tidak bisa berkomitmen  seperti itu, dengan berjalan nya waktu. Akhirnya dengan berat hati saya minta beliau keluar dari rumah.

Mulailah saat itu perjalanan ku sebagai ibu single mother dimulai. Bayangkan saya dengan 3 anak yang masih kecil- kecil mulai hidup baru. Saya tidak tahu apa yang harus saya lakukan untuk  menghidupi ketiga anakku. Saya tidak bekerja. Pada waktu itu ada tetangga minta tolong antar jemput anaknya ke sekolah. Dibayangkan saat itu sudah membawa 3 anak dengan sepada motor ditambah satu lagi menjadi 4 anak sekali jalan pergi dan pulang kesekolah.
Mungkin hanya beberapa bulan mantan suami memberikan uang untuk anak-anak dengan nominal sangatlah kecil sekali. Dan Waktu itu saya harus membayar melanjutkan kredit motor, tagihan listrik, telepon dan air dan hidup sehari-hari. Bayangkan saya harus membayarkan itu semua dengan hati pilu saking sedikitnya uang di tangan. Beruntung saya dibantu  mama saya yang sudah pensiunan janda dan kakak-kakak. Tapi hal ini hanya temporary, mreka mmpunyai hidup sendiri dengan keluarga. Jatuh bangun dengan hidupku saat itu sampai suatu saat ai PAM ku disegel karena belum bayar. Dan aku harus membayar kredit sepeda motor. Menangislah aku sejadi-jadinya. Tuhan aku harus bagaimana?? Ternyata Tuhan selalu meberikan jalan. 

Kasihan anak-anakku harus hidup sengsara denganku. Setiap pagi kadang makan bubur ayam masing masing setengah mangkok. Aku berusaha untuk menyenangkan anak-anak. Pergi jalan-jalan di mall untuk melihat dan beli dua nasi goreng dan es teh. Melihat anakku bahagia saat itu membuatku hati sedih.

Suatu hari saat aku kesulitan keuangan dan pada saat itu aku minta bantuan sepupuku. Saat itu perjalanan hidupku berubah lagi. Suami sepupuku selain membantu keuangan saat itu, di menawarkan pekerjaan untukku. Waktu itu mereka sempat mengajakku untuk datang ke Jambi untuk medapatkan pekerjaan. Hatiku galau saat itu belum siap untuk berpisah dengan anak-anak ku. Aku minta pulang dulu untuk memikirkan semua.
Pulanglah aku kembali dengan rutinitasku. Tapi aku tidak mau seperti ini. Hdup dalam kekurangan dan belas kasihan dari sekitarku. Suatu saat suami sepupu menelponku lagi. Da begitu gigih untuk mebantu dan meyakinkanku . Ini ksempatan terakhirku katanya. Ada yang akan bantu kerja di oil company di Jambi. Dengan usiaku saat itu 39 tahun apakah ada yang mau nerima aku kerja?
mulai saat itu aku berpikir dan berbicara dengan anak-anak ku. Siapkan mental pada saat itu dan mulai packing  isi rumah, aku gak tahu tiba-tiba saja ide itu
Berjalan seperti ada yang menjalankan. Aku putuskan untuk  memberi kabar Suami sepupuku. Aku mau dan siap untuk bekerja. Tunggu sampai anak- anak terima raport dan sambil aku bebenah dan packing barang darirumah kecilku. Dimulai mencari sekolah untuk anakku, dan membawa barang-barang sedikit demi sedikit kerumah ibuku.

Saat nya sudah tiba, mantap ataupun tidak aku harus pergi. Ini untuk masa depanku dan anakku. Aku harus kuat jauh dari anak2ku. Akhirnya keberangkatan sudah ditentukan. Aku pergi ke Jambi untuk mengapai mimpi anak-anak ku. 
Aku bekerja di sebuah perusahaan oil company di Jambi. Bekerja sebagai clerk  Dan mayoritas pegawainya adalah laki-laki . Berjalanya waktu Alhamdulillah hidupku mulai membaik. Setiap 3 bulan pulang untuk anak-anak dan ibukku

body.body: > Blessings to all my Hive friends! It's always a pleasure for me to share great posts, especially those featuring gardens with beautiful plants. Growing them is incredibly difficult due to the lack of water, and the soil isn't ideal either; that red earth, no matter how moist it is, never seems to be. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbU6iepGAG6nJjqNtWTfQvfis7R79VxEPn153D5PwuMrw/1779669501614.jpg) I was definitely surprised to see so many plants in that garden, but especially the guayacan tree, which is gorgeous. I wanted to get a little closer, but I practically had to take the photos quickly because I wasn't sure how the owners of the house where we were working might react. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYYvbQTqrCBK6yLdWmW3qiYLH2Sje4GEsiRMnEE9Kn8cr/1779669362511.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdCRR3b7FcUfParq7USBnZQLtRS6ZDnVfN16rAbASKoND/1779669362887.jpg) Nearby was an orange lily, which is certainly not very common where we live. This was the one I photographed the most. The moment I saw it, I knew I would take several pictures to share here in the #hivegarden community, which is undoubtedly one of the best in the Hive ecosystem, especially for those of us who, like me, enjoy nature and appreciate all its beauty. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZCMvTMTMtPmLdjqdcsbLeSR2NZqu7pRLGSkwjicMRj5u/1779669403930.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRj2AzzwEo9nTDRyJXZYYo7zeJnM2ghkAtsXaKvswrk26/1779669404261.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZunYro97vgvLWkomWKG4SMhUgkeBo4cxgYtf1UcRgMjF/1779669404478.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRrhddghYEZMFVb5yWmTpRsEtmA38BTiW1AEYnzmMTWUm/1779669404664.jpg) These other photos, let's say random ones, show other plants found near the base of the guayacan tree, as well as others nearby in the garden. It's incredible what some people manage to grow at home despite not having a good amount of water available for irrigation. Besides, those are mostly cacti that can withstand several days without watering, but the important thing for me is knowing how to identify and choose the plants that are best suited to the terrain we have available. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeYjVJTW4UuX2y4tqzuWvJBY5jfpJ2LjoUVCrGDBwHM9o/1779669441695.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXiNqLivxWRF3pdFKgSv1xgfSSc6BKPzewBoH7W4LjNHR/1779669442141.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbjTUZgkzRP7b37e3qWJ61aNAND5z1d7Vv9ca8qxLoBqw/1779669442649.jpg)

Feliz domingo para todos, he estado un poco desaparecida, pero vamos a tratar de ponernos al día con las noticias 🤭

Mi semana resultó tranquila pero cumplidora, desde mis mañanas de entrenamiento en la piscina, donde creo que por fin le estoy viendo el queso a la tostada, y he notado una mejora en mis ritmos🥹 Ver esos resultados al finalizar cada entrenamiento es la mejor motivación para seguir mejorando... Hasta continuar con mis tardes en LPG corriendo junto al team.

El sábado se celebró la One Run, y varios del equipo estaban inscritos en esa carrera, y por ahí vi varios PR y caras sonrientes de que se la disfrutaron al máximo. Y como la gran mayoría corrio el sábado, era muy poco probable que alguno volviera a madrugar el domingo 😅

Al inicio dudé, y solo quería quedarme durmiendo😴 Pero sin pensarlo mucho me cambie y baje hasta la plaza, a ver si coincidia con alguien mas… Y logré alcanzar a mi compañero Alre segundos antes que empezara a correr, y nos fuimos directo hasta Las Mercedes, a un ritmo suave y conversando. La idea de pasar por allá era alcanzar a la carrera de 5K que había del Banco Provincial, donde otro compañero estaba participando. Pensamos que lo encontraríamos ya en la meta, porque se suponía que la carrera arrancaba a las 7am, pero resultó que empezó a las 7:30am

Y al ver que recién iban saliendo del arco de salida, procedimos a acelerar un poco para agarrar a nuestro compñero Oneiver en la vuelta y jalarlo en los últimos kilómetros… Y todo resultó perfecto, lo conseguimos al regreso y a partir de ahí lo acompañamos 💪🏽

Lo mejor de todo esto, fue que tanto él como mi querida @erilej (quien también estaba participando en la carrera) resultaron ganadores, pues cada uno hizo Podio en su categoría. De grande quiero ser como ustedes, felicitaciones a los dos 🥳✨
