body.title: Cuando el mar nos llama
body.body: > # Mi querido Mar ¿Alguna vez han sentido una emoción y un recuerdo tan intensos que parecen estar siempre presentes, para decir que algo nos falta? Es así como me siento cuando recuerdo el mar; es uno de mis lugares favoritos. El mar para mí significa calma, amor, fortaleza y energía, de esa que restaura el alma. En mis recuerdos encuentro e imagino mis atardeceres en el mar y cada momento que he podido disfrutar; cada vez que entro en esos momentos de evocación, mi alma se alegra. Desde hace algún tiempo he venido investigando sobre los beneficios de vivir cerca del mar, poder respirar la brisa marina y de bañarse en sus aguas. El mar, además de ser hermoso e imponente, brinda beneficios grandiosos para el cuerpo humano, ya que, el agua de mar contiene una gran cantidad de vitaminas y minerales que son buenos para la salud; incluso el solo estar cerca del mar activa la hormona de la felicidad y permite minimizar el estrés. Gracias a los beneficios del mar, en conjunto con los rayos del sol, hacen un juego muy interesante de beneficios que ayudan a la vida y la longevidad. Desde que me encuentro en Argentina, he sentido cómo el mar me llama, porque lo extraño un montón; sin embargo, hay que avanzar y adaptarse a cada situación, por ello los recuerdos me ayudan a traer al presente recuerdos que me hacen feliz. Cultivo la alegría y la esperanza de regresar un día; ya no lo veo con preocupación, sino como una fortaleza y una realidad de que algún día volveré a disfrutar de mi querido mar. Siempre agradecida de cada paso que he dado y toda la experiencia que estoy acumulando hoy para la vida. Cuando el mar llama, es un regalo para traer al presente bendiciones y buena vibra. Los invito a compartir sus momentos en Liketu y sus @talentos. Con cariño Angelica7 **English version** # My Beloved Sea Have you ever felt an emotion and a memory so intense that they seem to be always present, reminding us that something is missing? That's how I feel when I think of the sea; it's one of my favorite places. For me, the sea means calm, love, strength, and energy—the kind that restores the soul. In my memories, I find and imagine my sunsets at sea and every moment I've been able to enjoy; every time I enter those moments of recollection, my soul rejoices. For some time now, I've been researching the benefits of living near the sea, breathing in the sea breeze, and swimming in its waters. The sea, besides being beautiful and awe-inspiring, offers tremendous benefits for the human body, since seawater contains a large number of vitamins and minerals that are good for our health; even just being near the sea activates the happiness hormone and helps minimize stress. Thanks to the benefits of the sea, combined with the sun's rays, there's a fascinating interplay of advantages that contribute to life and longevity. Since I've been in Argentina, I've felt the sea calling to me, because I miss it terribly; however, we must move forward and adapt to each situation. That's why these memories help me bring joy to the present. I cultivate the joy and hope of returning one day; I no longer see it with worry, but as a source of strength and the certainty that one day I will once again enjoy my beloved sea. I am always grateful for every step I've taken and all the experience I'm accumulating for life. When the sea calls, it's a gift that brings blessings and good vibes into the present. I invite you to reflect and share your moments with Liketu and your @talentos too. Fondly Angelica7

links.title: The beauty of the Moss Rose flower.
links.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQRvGiqXfvJVmEvgMbmME7QQPAdCmZoCTVPtM1pU6VSb6/1779670129610.jpg) There is a strange magic hidden in every creation of nature. We often go after huge and expensive things. But how extraordinary can be the small, ordinary flowers blooming before our eyes? You can understand it by looking at this picture. This morning while walking in the garden, my eyes suddenly caught sight of this sweet flower. This is our very familiar Moss Rose, many people also call it locally as Time Flower or Dasata Flower. Because it unfolds its petals exactly as the clock ticks. If you look at the picture, you can see how fresh and bright the magenta or dark pink color of the flower's petals is. Right in the middle is a bright yellow center like a piece of sunshine. From where the tiny stamens are peeking out. This combination of pink and yellow has given the flower an artificial beauty. Which is enough to make any depressed mind better in an instant. Along with this, the thick, lush green leaves below enhance the brightness of the flower even more. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWf9ofM7jvZpBTUbcBVMUK5wF2dtW1HPgMFzASdCQ558p/1779670129852.jpg) They do not require much care. They smile with joy when they get a little soil and a lot of sunlight. When many other plants wilt in the hot sun, this flower is just the opposite. The more sunlight it gets, the brighter it shines. This tiny flower teaches a great lesson about how to adapt even in the face of adversity. In our busy lives, we often forget to enjoy the small, beautiful moments around us. In a life confined to four concrete walls, a cluster of flowers blooming in a corner of the balcony or in a rooftop tub changes every morning. 📸 Photography| Details 📸 |-|-| |Camera used|Smartphone| |Model|Realme-C53| |Location| Bangladesh| |Photographer|@queen88|

>Hola saludos a todos,para hoy les vengo mostrar la calidad de dibujo en una marca de colores que compré,son unos colores que compré por primera vez, y lo que llamo mi atención fue que traen sacapunta, y me pareció bien porque no tenía sacapuntas y necesitaba comprar uno,otra cosa que me gustó fue el precio, porque últimamente me he dado cuenta que los colores equivalen entre los 2-5 $,y no es tanto el precio,es la calidad que tienen porque la mayoría de los colores son para uso escolar,y algunos no sirve para hacer buenos dibujos, entonces además ví que son color pastel,y me arriesgué en el intento,y ver si me servían,para el uso que les voy a dar. Y para ponerlos a prueba de lo buenos que son es haciendo un dibujo.* # > Hello everyone! Today I'm going to show you the drawing quality of a brand of colored pencils I bought. These are the first colored pencils I've ever bought, and what caught my attention was that they come with a sharpener. I thought that was great because I didn't have one and needed to buy one. Another thing I liked was the price, because lately I've noticed that colored pencils usually cost between $2 and $5. It's not so much the price, it's the quality. Most colored pencils are for school use, and some aren't suitable for good drawing. I also saw that they're pastel colors, so I decided to take a chance and see if they would work for my needs. To test their quality, I'll be doing a drawing. ---

Me costaron 1.170,40 bolívares,al principio si me pareció muy costoso,pero el uso será poco porque de ves en cuando hay alguien que quiere que le haga una lamina para una exposición,y a mi me gusta hacer buenos dibujos para que tenga buena presencia.* # > The brand of these colored pencils is Macarons. It comes in a set of 12 pastel shades, and the box itself is eye-catching because of its nice design. Something I noticed was the type of box, since the colored pencils came in a tray that separated each color. They cost me 1,170.40 bolivars. At first, I thought it was very expensive, but I won't use them much because every now and then someone wants me to make a poster for an exhibition, and I like to create good drawings so they look good. ---

# *

>Elegí dibujar a Tinkerbell,si no la conocen,ella es un hada artesana del mundo de nunca jamás,sale en la película de Peter pan,y de la misma película de su nombre, la elegí hacer por su tierna apariencia,así que los colores le vendrían bien,comencé pon hacer el dibujo,y luego ya comencé por agregar el color,en el vestido,le agregué el color turquesa y el verde manzana,ya con el primer toqué del color en la hoja pude sentir lo buenos que dibujan,y no marcan mucho la hoja, siendo así buenos colores para hacer degradados,si son colores muy fuertes y vivos,pero con solo no aplicar tanta fuerza ya dibuja mucho. Ahora que ya confirme lo buenos que son puedo volver a comprar otros sin ningún problema. Me sentí feliz por ya tenía tiempo que no compraba colores por ese detalle de que no sean tan buenos,pero así como se ven los colores por encima,así mismo son los colores en el dibujo.* # > I chose to draw Tinker Bell. If you don't know her, she's a tinker fairy from Neverland. She appears in the Peter Pan movie, and the film of the same name. I chose her because of her sweet appearance, so the colors seemed perfect. I started by sketching the drawing, and then I began adding color. On her dress, I added turquoise and apple green. Even with the first touch of color on the paper, you can feel how well they work, and they don't press too hard, making them good for creating gradients. They are very strong and vibrant colors, but just by not applying too much pressure, they still create a lot of color. Now that I've confirmed how good they are, I can buy more without any problem. I was happy because it had been a while since I'd bought colored pencils because I was worried they weren't very good, but the colors look exactly as they do in the drawing. --- # *

>Si desean comprar este tipo de colores para sus proyectos, créanme que son buenos, siempre hay colores mejores,pero estos son colores en buena opción, porque si tienen mucha calidad,tanto como los colores kores, solita y faber castel. Espero les haya servido mi post como inspiración para probar nuevos materiales y probar nuestra creatividad. Gracias a todos por visitarme hoy hasta pronto.* # > If you're looking to buy these colors for your projects, trust me, they're good. There are always better colors out there, but these are a great option because they're high quality, just like Kores, Solita, and Faber-Castell. I hope my post has inspired you to try new materials and unleash your creativity. Thanks for visiting today, and see you soon! --- # *

links.title: Spaceballs Is One Of Those Comedies That Fully Embraces Being Ridiculous, And That Is Exactly Why It Still Works. Even Though It Is Corny, Silly, And Completely Over The Top At Times, It Remains A Personal Classic To Me Because It Is Just Pure Fun.
links.body:
Released in 1987 and directed by Mel Brooks, Spaceballs is both a parody of Star Wars and a giant comedy celebration of science fiction in general. Brooks takes the biggest sci-fi tropes imaginable and turns them into nonstop absurdity, but the movie succeeds because it understands the material it is making fun of. Good parody usually comes from genuine affection, and you can feel that throughout the film.

![IMG_2001.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdVxTnghcFpuR33jRTUxiiNqZ2aufYBs7ZgwasAh1BG45/IMG_2001.webp)

Bill Pullman stars as Lone Starr, the Han Solo inspired space hero who gets dragged into a mission to rescue Princess Vespa and save the planet Druidia from the evil Spaceballs. Pullman plays the role straight enough that the ridiculous comedy happening around him becomes even funnier.

John Candy is excellent as Barf, the half man half dog sidekick. Candy brings warmth and charm to every scene he is in, and honestly a lot of the movie’s heart comes from him. Even when the jokes get completely ridiculous, Candy somehow keeps the character lovable.

Rick Moranis steals the movie as Dark Helmet, one of the funniest parody villains ever created. Instead of trying to make the character threatening, Moranis leans fully into insecurity and childish frustration. Every scene with him feels hilarious because he treats nonsense with total seriousness.

Mel Brooks himself plays both President Skroob and Yogurt, clearly parodying both political leadership and the wise mentor archetype from Star Wars. Brooks knows exactly how silly the movie is and never hesitates to push the joke further than most filmmakers would dare.

The plot itself is intentionally ridiculous. Planet Spaceball has literally run out of air, so Dark Helmet and President Skroob decide the solution is stealing the atmosphere from Druidia. That setup tells you immediately the movie is operating entirely on comedy logic rather than realism.

What makes Spaceballs work is the nonstop commitment to the joke. The movie constantly breaks the fourth wall, mocks merchandising, pokes fun at sequels, and even jokes about watching the movie while the movie itself is happening. That self awareness was ahead of its time in many ways.

![IMG_1998.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYT4mYDzQU61ufynoNEXZLYk2Ec4F7xtoQs73YFJBg5ck/IMG_1998.webp)

The famous “Spaceballs the Flamethrower” scene alone perfectly captures the movie’s humor. It is dumb in the best possible way because it commits fully to the absurdity without trying to be clever or subtle about it.

Visually, the movie also does a surprisingly good job recreating the look of big budget sci-fi despite being a comedy. The costumes, ships, and sets are intentionally goofy versions of iconic science fiction imagery, but they are still detailed enough to make the parody work.

Now yes, parts of the movie are definitely corny. Some jokes are pure slapstick, some puns are incredibly cheesy, and not every gag lands perfectly. But honestly, that corniness is part of the charm. Mel Brooks comedies were never about sophistication. They were about energy and fearless ridiculousness.

The cast chemistry is another reason the film still holds up. Everyone understands the tone completely. Nobody is trying to make the movie cooler or smarter than it is. They fully embrace the silliness, which makes the comedy feel genuine instead of forced.

The movie also works because it came out during a time when Star Wars had become such a massive cultural phenomenon that audiences instantly understood every joke. Even today, most of those references still land because the original source material remained so iconic.

Over time, Spaceballs became one of the most beloved cult comedies of the eighties because people realized it was endlessly rewatchable. You catch different jokes every time, especially all the background gags and quick throwaway lines.

In the end, Spaceballs remains a classic to me because it understands that comedy does not always need to be sophisticated to be effective. Sometimes being loud, goofy, and unapologetically stupid is enough.

![IMG_1999.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQn3TNigyjP86EWZetfHzGxN7CR4wp2dscNHBNWEdpZa8/IMG_1999.webp)

It may be a little corny around the edges, but the movie’s energy, cast, and pure commitment to absurd comedy are exactly why it still works decades later.

links.title: 9km pero terminé con un tobillo lesionado 🏃🏻 [ESP-ENG]
links.body: >Bienvenidos, amigos de Hiverun, es un gusto compartir con ustedes en el día de hoy. Bueno, una carrera solamente esta semana, pero no fue de las mejores y una experiencia que espero que no pasen por esto. Esta semana, el día miércoles, mi carrera principal era hacer 10 km; estaba tan tranquilo y con mucha energía durante la carrera. De hecho, tenía pensado subir el ritmo para lograr completar la vuelta en menos de una hora y de esta manera estaría superando mi récord.\n\n

>Welcome, friends of Hiverun, it’s a pleasure to be sharing this with you today. Well, just one run this week, but it wasn’t the best and it was an experience I hope you never have to go through. This week, on Wednesday, my main run was 10 km; I felt so calm and full of energy during the run. In fact, I’d planned to pick up the pace to finish the lap in under an hour, which would have beaten my personal best. ---
![1001037006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tGXT1Ro3xgaCGQcB7Zs473ky1ZnSDqXKnjzzjnYT4hiP2KjykEjTnotEFwfdT3FrvtT.jpg)
|
![1001037008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tkhh4qws6vsZTkJGVRQcUusy3Cai73RusMf4Vbq2GUGwaBGMXc5VtBNnvgGaf6nW9Hj.jpg)
| |-|-| ---
![1001028277.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23yTcbt3kCzT1W7JKbhRPjc82QPWhiCMLKGxXxknwhBfmeKFhVb9xZsG8nWCtyGGzjdvJ.jpg)
|
![1001028297.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23uQNhrD6sdNJ78QWVKjxQz6SPWYdiue1kDaT9Ys78xi7UjNRg2U4PDufRMdkBfUEha1a.jpg)
| |-|-| ---
![1001028309.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/Eo6BiKn7dC2pNBGKsErwvU2RLwNrCt5J2Nz5tThYF64yoyKMuY4bgGrKsiNQBQZoR27.jpg)
| |-| ---

>Los primeros tres kilómetros fueron lo más suave de toda la carrera; mis primeros kilómetros los hago lo más lento posible para tener energía a mitad de la carrera y agarrar ventaja, manteniendo por más tiempo el ritmo rápido sin sentir agotamiento rápido. Luego, al llegar al kilómetro número 6, me sentía muy bien y empecé a subir el ritmo; mi cuerpo ya estaba lo suficientemente caliente para correr a un ritmo de 5 minutos el kilómetro. Kilómetro 7 y 8 fueron lo máximo; me sentía muy cómodo, además de que faltaba poco para culminar.\n\n

>The first three kilometres were the easiest part of the whole race; I run the first few kilometres as slowly as possible so that I have energy left halfway through the race and can build a lead, maintaining a fast pace for longer without tiring too quickly. Then, when I reached kilometre 6, I felt great and started to pick up the pace; my body was already warm enough to run at a pace of 5 minutes per kilometre. Kilometres 7 and 8 were brilliant; I felt very comfortable, and there wasn’t long to go until the finish. ---
![1001028314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tGVun4v9ZHjR9zxLwt5DTkxiBde7Gq13wTchCqwShHEKu63NcjDB6CxSYcZPZkH5ySi.jpg)
|
![1001028316.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23uFH66BYqJ4fEpZ1wJvuxMHP6LPs2eDsuTFkZTzCnZoXQjYtqcwmy6NXsGHcRSYcNZtB.jpg)
| |-|-| ---
![1001028325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tv4f5wNLWCS9R22dvESfNdeBzYvZ5ibA9aJiRp5U4S4v57rs2XsCSHccvsBxpMXjXTQ.jpg)
|
![1001028326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tvAS999AqEBquKr1SfZ5ekcbcKe4iYkX1CX1mQpxQo8xytEjGNDMdYj2neMuoLRyFfq.jpg)
| |-|-| ---

>Lamentablemente, al llegar justo al kilómetro número 9, tan solo a 10 minutos de terminar todo, sufrí una caída debido a un hueco que no vi por falta de alumbrado público. Me confié de la linterna del celular, pensando que veía todo, pero no; al no ver, la caída fue directo a mi pie izquierdo, por lo tanto mi tobillo colapsó y el dolor fue insoportable. Automáticamente paré la carrera y decidí esperar a que se me pasara el dolor; una vez que se me pasó el dolor, aproveché que no sentía nada para irme a mi casa.\n\n

>Unfortunately, just as I reached the 9-kilometre mark, with only 10 minutes to go, I took a tumble because I didn’t see a pothole due to the lack of street lighting. I’d relied too heavily on my mobile phone’s torch, thinking I could see everything, but I couldn’t; as I couldn’t see properly, I landed straight on my left foot, causing my ankle to give way and the pain was unbearable. I stopped running immediately and decided to wait for the pain to subside; once the pain had gone, I took advantage of the fact that I couldn’t feel anything to head home. ---
![1001028367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tkmuvs6fnnsxed3nLt2mLAXME8Da9fTxAwok5JoXTEbde7qJcuTPCEy4hddwd5Y83t4.jpg)
| |-| ---

>Al llegar a casa, mi tobillo estaba superhinchado, lo cual a día de hoy ha mejorado mucho; fue una lesión de grado 1, agradezco a Dios que fue así. He estado en reposo y todo tiene pinta de que volveré pronto a correr. Estén muy pendientes de las calles, amigos, no se sabe si hay algún hueco que los pueda perjudicar, ¡cuídense!\n\n

>When I got home, my ankle was really swollen, but it’s improved a lot since then; it was a grade 1 sprain, and I’m so grateful it wasn’t worse. I’ve been resting, and it looks like I’ll be back to running soon. Keep a close eye on the roads, friends – you never know if there might be a pothole that could cause you harm. Take care! ---
>Sin más nada que acotar gente, muchas gracias por haberse tomado el tiempo de ver mi post y nos vemos en otra publicación soy @zgaetano.\n\n
> Without further ado people, thank you very much for taking the time to see my post and I'll see you in another post I'm @zgaetano. ---

links.title: ☺️Mis padres ☺️
links.body:
~~Hola a todos los que me leen en Holos&Lotus y en general en Hive , antes de empezar mi blog , como siempre agradezco a mis hijos @valderalazaro y @diazktty por darme la oportunidad de conocer este mundo , esta comunidad , y sobre todo escribir que me gusta tanto , es una forma de que me conozcan y yo conocerlos a ustedes , también agradecer a @cathyarrow y a su esposo @bradleyarrow por formar parte de mi familia 🥰🥰🥰🥰

~~Hoy quiero hablar de mis dos padres, dos personas humildes y trabajadoras que han marcado mi vida para siempre.

![IMG-20260503-WA0039.jpg](image-4-IMG-20260503-WA0039.jpg)Mi mamá, Esther María, es mi hermosa viejita de pelo canoso, siempre con una sonrisa en el rostro aunque la vida no haya sido fácil para ella. Fue inauguradora de ETECSA la empresa de redes móviles en Cuba y trabajó muchísimo durante toda su vida, pero hoy cobra una jubilación muy pequeña y vive con muchas necesidades. Aun así, nunca pierde su bondad. Mi mamá es de esas personas que aunque no tengan nada, siempre quieren darte algo. Cada vez que voy a verla me dice: “llévate un platanito”, “llévate un pedazo de calabaza”. Si no le da algo de comer a alguien, siente que no está tranquila. Tiene un corazón demasiado noble.
Por su trabajo viajaba mucho y no pudo ser una mamá presente todos los días, pero siempre fue muy amorosa cuando podía estar con nosotros. Todo lo hacía por darnos el pan de cada día. Hoy también es una excelente abuela y bisabuela, llena de amor y ternura para todos.

![IMG-20260502-WA0091.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagroscmiranda/EpT4cAPYsYaQ6wjHPYDLCja6vhzW5ywd18HpUUiYwGvCjtGisZAgBbJ8EukAAXM4XSQ.jpg)

También quiero hablar de mi papá, Elías Ramón, aunque todos lo conocen como Mongo. Fue un hombre muy trabajador, albañil de toda la vida. Construyó muchísimas casas, túneles y calles en mi pueblo. En cada barrio hay algo que recuerda el esfuerzo de sus manos. Mi papá siempre estuvo más presente en la casa porque trabajaba dentro del mismo pueblo y ayudaba mucho mientras mi mamá trabajaba lejos. Nos cuidaba, nos atendía y hacía todo lo posible por nosotros.
Hoy está más enfermo y aunque fue un hombre que tomó mucho durante su vida, nosotros lo cuidamos con amor y hacemos todo lo posible para que esté bien alimentado y tranquilo. Hay momentos difíciles en los que hasta me quedo sin comer para que él pueda hacerlo, porque así es el amor por los padres.
Mis dos viejos siguen vivos y doy gracias por eso. Tal vez nunca tuvieron riquezas ni una vida fácil, pero me enseñaron el valor del sacrificio, del trabajo y del amor verdadero. Y aunque la vida nos haya golpeado muchas veces, me siento orgullosa de ser hija de ellos.
Ellos hace muchos años ya no son un matrimonio pero se llevan bien , los amo tanto que me duele mucho saber que algún día no estarán junto a mi 
*Para concluir mi post de hoy ,los invito a seguir y a conocer la comunidad BBH para que sigan apoyando a tantas personas *

links.title: Jicarilla the Rime:Echo Queen of Unbreakable Sustain.
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTcCcb7EYem43RRe2xhJYMTFRiKKCXRBRVj3qspZnjAvU/1779636211295.jpg)

**Good morning, warriors**! 🤗 Welcome to a brand new week.

The grinding is getting fiercer, I must say. At higher levels, you need the best deck combination to be able to complete.In this post I would be talking about the healing and cleanse abilities for tank sustain in battles.

Without further ado, last season the only water healing and cleansing monster I had was Anasth Soothsayer. But I discovered a more formidable and stronger overall tank sustain monster than Anasth, which is **Jicarilla the Rime**

.**Splinterlands is no walk in the park, but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building.Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)

**FEATURED CARDS**:![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTUpStETcChrz52bfAwDN3d9Lt8jyALX5suw7VNMSD57E/1779646060191.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcbmMYdWx11xo4VWpSdgAAbs2YqAmHuDnZXoxypXMseLz/1779646114007.jpg)











**Anasth** is excellent with tools like Lookout (protects against positioning attacks) and Dispel (removes enemy buffs).But she lacks the multiplier that Echo provides.
**Jicarilla’s** kit is more specialized toward pure, overwhelming sustain.That **Tank Heal + Rearguard Cleanse + Echo** synergy turns her into a defensive anchor that can carry teams through tough, prolonged fights — which is why I chose her over **Anasth**.

**Jicarilla the Rime** is a Legendary Water unit from the Conclave Arcana edition of Splinterlands,She is widely regarded as one of the standout cards from that set, especially for defensive, sustain-heavy strategies. At max level as shown above She has a mana cost of 7, Magic attack 1, Armor 1, health 9(solid for a support),and Speed 1.
 
**Core abilities at max level**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRjCFCz8N6qm5F6DbzANZ18y9s6jiUg6KJfon9ikPLTEn/1779648708315.jpg)

At level 1, (Bronze),She has the **Cleanse rearguard** ability.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX4gCaCqD9cUisxftFVf5hMap9izyMD6i978JowJrjMQB/1779649013498.jpg)**Cleanse Rearguard** (new ability introduced in Conclave Arcana):This lets her remove debuffs (negative status effects) from the backline/rearguard units. Excellent for countering common debuff-heavy strategies.


At level 2, (Silver),She unlocks the Tank Heal![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVXPZiN2g2j4gbK9DAofX4kCbmbHa29qT1a4AbEQbZcBs/1779649195701.jpg)**Tank Heal**: She provides healing focused on the tank (frontline unit) each round,helping the team’s primary damage sponge survive longer.This is huge in prolonged fights.


At level 3(Gold),She unlocks yet again another ability called the **Phase Ward**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPYEX8t8Bc3Gjoy5NxvU8mUyvdCkQtZfprSaxHwy1eeGy/1779650303235.jpg)**Phase Ward — Provides protective effects (phasing/evasion-like utility for allies).


At max level(Diamond),She unlocks her final ability called the **Echo**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUrz2nNuKH3WwgbVrGf8Ks5QpQqFwPMb9ihxXSWqKHm8A/1779650774686.jpg)**Echo**— Her strongest trait: All active abilities (healing, cleansing, etc.) trigger twice per round. This makes her sustain output potentially double that of similar cards.

Before I proceed,let me the talk about how the Echo ability works in details.
**What Echo Does**! With Echo active:
Tank Heal fires twice per round and your frontline tank gets healed two times every round (each heal is usually 1/3 of max health, rounded down).

**Cleanse Rearguard** triggers twice per round and the backline unit gets debuffs removed twice, which is incredibly strong against Poison, Weaken, Stun, etc.

This effectively turns her into a sustain machine. In long battles (6+ rounds), the doubled healing and cleansing often make the difference between your team collapsing or outlasting the opponent.

Echo is a powerful passive ability that makes all of her active healing and cleansing abilities trigger twice per round.
This is what makes her so strong — it essentially doubles her sustain output.


**Market Value** at the moment this a max level goes for $47 and 147.50 DEC/PER day for rentage.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ47doC68CETQwtk6SE3N2yg4NwrL2gQ9jEMjXq18VcR5/1779655877299.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbXwJUU8ngc9oTTtJEHeKzv55QsHLP9fskTvJAX8AmSQN/1779655877346.jpg)







![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)










**Overall Playstyle**:She is a premier sustain and support monster.Not great at dealing damage herself,but she excels at keeping your team alive by cleansing debuffs, healing the tank repeatedly (thanks to Echo),and adding protective effects.This makes her meta-defining in certain formats, especially defensive or control-oriented lineups. Players often pair her with strong tanks and other supports for near-unbreakable teams.


Her **Echo** ability is game-changing ,it turns good sustain into great sustain.In formats where battles last several rounds (common in many rulesets), the double healing + double cleansing is incredibly hard to overcome.She is often praised as one of the strongest defensive and support cards from her set for a reason.


In my subsequent post, I will bring you replay of her prowess in battlefield.Thank you for reading my post,

@zusi78, signing off,see you in battlefield.

links.title: My Concept of Unity 🇬🇧////Mi concepto de unidad🇪🇸
links.body:
Eng 🇬🇧 

First of all, thanks to the HolosyLotus community.

Today I would like to recommend a young woman who is just starting in this Hive community, @andrealove, and also @milagroscmiranda. I kindly ask for your support so they can grow and move forward with the help of this amazing community.

![file_00000000e90c71f4b2dc7a248c28da9f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23wgHuSAKaMrZwk4Uz7XxGnvGAN55aZgz4cUAvUUvBrVDBv3vm6n4LNpvpJzQNDPLgCAP.png)

The unity of a society is not born from imposition or from eliminating differences, but from recognizing that those differences exist and can coexist within the same common framework. A people become stronger when their members, even while thinking differently, share the desire to build something greater than their individual interests.

In times of uncertainty, it is easy to fall into the temptation of searching for simple answers, believing that stability can only be achieved if everyone moves in the same direction without questioning anything. But history shows that societies prosper not by suppressing diversity, but by learning how to organize it. True strength does not come from uniformity, but from cooperation among free people.

Authentic unity does not require everyone to see the world in the same way, but rather that everyone accepts basic rules of coexistence. These rules allow disagreement to become dialogue instead of destruction. They allow political, cultural, and social differences to become sources of learning and growth rather than threats.

To build that unity, it is necessary to begin with respect. Respect does not mean agreement; it means recognizing the dignity of others even when they think differently. From there, dialogue becomes the main tool for resolving conflicts. Where there is dialogue, there is the possibility of understanding; where there is only imposition, there is only forced silence, and silence is never true peace.

A shared sense of belonging is also essential. A society remains united when its members feel they are part of something greater, not out of obligation, but out of conviction. That sense is built through education, civic participation, and the creation of opportunities that exclude no one. When people feel heard and valued, they are more likely to contribute to the collective well-being.

Unity does not mean eliminating tensions, but learning how to manage them constructively. Conflicts are inevitable, but they can become engines of change if approached responsibly. A mature society is not one without problems, but one that knows how to face them without destroying itself.

Ultimately, true unity is sustained by freedom. Only when people can express themselves, organize, and think without fear can a strong and lasting cohesion be built. Freedom does not divide; it allows unity to be genuine, because it is born not from fear, but from the conscious decision to live together.

Thus, a united community is not one where everyone is the same, but one where differences do not break the common bond. It is a society that understands that its greatest strength lies not in obedience, but in collaboration; not in silence, but in participation; not in imposition, but in the shared construction of a common future.

![IMG_20260509_184440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23sUc9x8A2Qqn6mgt7eGV3G9mCNEZQmApgHimF3SZJYMbKhVXTpmy8V5wTqQSYZ8ybTDg.jpg)

Thanks to my Hive community, to my BBH 💪💯 community, to my mom from Canada @cathyarrow and her husband @bradleyarrow, and above all to my wife @diazktty, and to the words she used in her blog “Loving in Difficult Times.” Thank you, my princess ❤️

God bless you all 🙏🙏


Esp 🇪🇸 
Gracias a la comunidad de HolosyLotus 
Quiero hoy recomendar a una muchacha que recién empieza en esta comunidad de hive @andrealove y a @milagroscmiranda para pedirles su apoyo que ella pueda despegar con su ayuda 
![file_00000000e90c71f4b2dc7a248c28da9f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23wgHuSAKaMrZwk4Uz7XxGnvGAN55aZgz4cUAvUUvBrVDBv3vm6n4LNpvpJzQNDPLgCAP.png)
La unidad de una sociedad no nace de la imposición ni de la eliminación de las diferencias, sino del reconocimiento de que esas diferencias existen y pueden convivir dentro de un mismo marco común. Un pueblo se fortalece cuando sus miembros, aun pensando distinto, comparten la voluntad de construir algo más grande que sus intereses individuales.
En tiempos de incertidumbre, es fácil caer en la tentación de buscar respuestas simples, de creer que la estabilidad solo puede lograrse si todos avanzan en una misma dirección sin cuestionamientos. Pero la historia demuestra que las sociedades que prosperan no son aquellas que suprimen la diversidad, sino las que aprenden a organizarla. La verdadera fuerza no proviene de la uniformidad, sino de la cooperación entre personas libres.
La unidad auténtica no exige que todos vean el mundo de la misma manera, sino que todos acepten unas reglas básicas de convivencia. Estas reglas permiten que el desacuerdo no se convierta en destrucción, sino en diálogo. Permiten que las diferencias políticas, culturales o sociales no sean una amenaza, sino una fuente de aprendizaje y evolución.
Para construir esa unidad, es necesario empezar por el respeto. Respetar no significa estar de acuerdo, sino reconocer la dignidad del otro incluso cuando piensa distinto. A partir de ahí, el diálogo se convierte en la herramienta principal para resolver conflictos. Donde hay diálogo, hay posibilidad de entendimiento; donde solo hay imposición, solo hay silencio forzado, y el silencio nunca es verdadera paz.
También es fundamental el sentido de pertenencia compartida. Una sociedad se mantiene unida cuando sus miembros sienten que forman parte de algo común, no por obligación, sino por convicción. Ese sentido se construye a través de la educación, la participación cívica y la creación de oportunidades que no excluyan a nadie. Cuando las personas sienten que son escuchadas y consideradas, es más probable que colaboren en el bienestar colectivo.
La unidad no significa eliminar las tensiones, sino aprender a gestionarlas de manera constructiva. Los conflictos son inevitables, pero pueden convertirse en motores de cambio si se abordan con responsabilidad. Una sociedad madura no es la que no tiene problemas, sino la que sabe enfrentarlos sin destruirse a sí misma.
En última instancia, la unidad verdadera se sostiene en la libertad. Solo cuando las personas pueden expresarse, organizarse y pensar sin miedo, se construye una cohesión sólida y duradera. La libertad no divide, sino que permite que la unidad sea genuina, porque no nace del miedo, sino de la decisión consciente de convivir.
Así, una comunidad unida no es aquella donde todos son iguales, sino aquella donde las diferencias no rompen el vínculo común. links.body: > To forge alliances, I consulted Randvi and selected a new territory from the map. After a rainy voyage on the longship, we reached Duroliponte. There, I synchronized a local viewpoint before meeting Magni, a leader of the Summer Army, who requested help finding their retreated leader, Soma, following a devastating loss. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSAdDX8kXC4Q5MnjSbmsqCvJVMoobKTgDcYCLT77PGL2p/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSNw5E6YajSbNed68REegJFvQ2hePpgktQUts61oSSHnf/screenshot_2_.png) We had to forge alliances to secure our future in England, and Randvi mentioned she could give me insight into each territory before I commit to a journey there. So I had to choose a territory from the alliance map spread across the central table. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTynpQsyGgVysAWfWkUDYaGrzJyDnRsYFuwYspUn4yQsF/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXGxGuyR1TA9uFmoTupYieJ6gLd944LjFePUEL97BuRPG/screenshot_4_.png) After choosing one to investigate, Randvi gave me detail about the alliance mentioning where I could find them and the political climate of the region I was about to enter. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdY8Nj5dzTHLEZbXzNRWbSp4DtFbmPKcZXaK2iK4iFj5K/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU2XPm5LCUQhWncG69buYMWbhQg7gmEwB3wYD2rbDmVV9/screenshot_6_.png) To reach this new territory and make friends, I left my new home and ran to my longship. It looked quite empty at the dock, but right after taking command, I found it was full of soldiers ready for war. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxFvWZYBXNx8XDAh2EsopqNRuz77cCZ2E4H4tCmXjtMN/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdqNTxefPLarkowNz6xAzkLZx5GCXceKmgp3rMJ5Jmauj/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVoxZx8oepjByBB5HQfbcKr53jJiifngD7hATB42T2pky/screenshot_9_.png) We started rowing the longship with full sail down the winding river network when it was heavily raining around us. I was trying the photo mode to capture some cool photos along the way. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSTfVGdvaWT91gM5yNspzpgTdbahD8BfYhPaQmy1EbPvB/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZNi7zfhucEt7SVyTtwHF8BUQaMhPmYNoimdDoaXizNRK/screenshot_11_.png) At last, we discovered this location named Duroliponte, where I had to find and speak to the Summer Army's leader who were camped somewhere around the crumbling stone walls. But I was more focused on the high viewpoint towering over the Roman ruins. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP9jWBq4hZiZYzx4wDFNkmhVgpe3uEEjb426gH84H6217/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWqNqR46Bhqeet9cSNcH4jAP4ENZHqGTKYMxQKU4gqgQ4/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb3YSnRpY2mATbbpxVyVwxJnAyVzHCMs1PLw2pzUmLMC5/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWmthrpkmWXVCULzh5CwhRyfyCmxj1q4Q2YfA1eujKeRZ/screenshot_15_.png) So I went for the viewpoint first and synchronized with it. I can use it to get around fast through the fast travel option later, revealing the surrounding fog of war on my map. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZU3jEH1PWn7Mvo46xKvp4QR9QcbE5XyPCbx8WdGcTdDu/screenshot_16_.png) Then I found the Summer Army's leader around the ruins after noticing there are injured soldiers all around. The air was thick with blood and iron as the survivors groaned in the mud, clutching their wounds from the recent battle. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYH28Bhv78Ss6u7sGeFJWYbs2nJs5h8qaXm36ucrJUuB3/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf6dTvYUqEwdbwzLoAFMyhwwGSSAXau9586orhGBa9U3n/screenshot_18_.png) The leader was called Magni, who told me how they failed their land and had to back up into these ancient structures. Magni gave us a name, Soma, who was their jarlskona and who bellowed a retreat, and a new trail began for me. That's all for now. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=coooldude/ac90d8d6)

## How It Works

- 10 lottery rounds at fixed times: 00:00, 02:24, 04:48, 07:12, 09:36, 12:00, 14:24, 16:48, 19:12, 21:36 UTC
- **Round 1 is this post.** Rounds 2–10 are posted as comments below.
- Each round selects 1 newbie as beneficiary alongside their onboarder(s)

- Randomness sourced from the Bitcoin block at each round's **scheduled** time (not posting time)
- This means the operator cannot influence outcomes by delaying a post

**Sponsor** — If a new user has no trusted onboarder at all but you believe they are a real person worth supporting, comment on their introduction post:

> `!sponsor`

This makes you responsible for that account. You receive the onboarder's share of the rewards. Sponsoring requires a higher trust score than vouching.

links.title: A Dawn in the Lap of Nature
links.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779669841761-fc2c49055f597ef4.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/9f7386ea)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/9f7386ea)


---

Friends I wish you all a good morning because I started this morning by talking to nature.It started as if today was the morning of nature.I woke up and saw a dawn in the lap of nature.Morning nature means a gentle and fresh life.Spending time in nature in the morning means having good health.Nature is the life of every creature so please protect nature.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRnw6EF9Fug74JDkFk1yvEbJV2iuA6wAGYqRzWrSzRWvL/img_20260525_wa0004.jpg)

If we talk about nature, the conversation will never end.All the philosophers and poets who have come to this world have sung the songs of nature.Let's analyze when nature is best for human health.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmewQb2A25ykFgEcdLAhwfWdCxR5XYHRfm4RDh8SGfZzwT/img_20260525_wa0005.jpg)

I have read our religious books and I have seen that staying up too late at night is not good.Also sleeping too much in the morning is not good.So you should fall asleep quickly at night and wake up early in the morning.There is a reason to wake up early in the morning and that is that the morning nature is gentle and fresh which is beneficial for the human body.Science also says that morning nature is the best.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcK6bZTyPFMiFLnXkUgNodt7ns5ea1KqwDXMUfksT3KHo/img_20260525_wa0006.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWdAuex4oMVhtPbgdmEbDDizNyDYMMvx1oX9C2diCXT29/img_20260525_wa0003.jpg)

In today's era of social media, we stay up all night addicted to social media which is very bad for our body and health.So to get rid of this addiction, we have to fall asleep quickly.We have to try to sleep quickly at night and wake up early in the morning.The most important thing to try to do is to get a little closer to nature near your home in the morning.Because it makes us beautiful.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmecTPHJc7kdWSsZujf4vAdgDbDqsje1dmJDCmaR9C1giw/img_20260525_wa0002.jpg)

If we can get close to nature a little after waking up in the morning, it is a very healthy medicine for our brain and human body.It is a natural medicine that will build our immunity to various diseases.It is very good for the health of our eyes.If we take a little walk in nature in the morning, it becomes physical exercise.But we have lost that morning only because of the internet or media.But we have to try to create a morning in the lap of nature.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUPQuhDCA3gx4YSVRcTgCV5omeeSQvGFMRK5g6W9eDKJo/img_20260525_wa0001.jpg)

We are just busy with the internet or Android phones or restaurants.We are busy with social media but we do not look at the wonderful creation of the Creator.Go out in the morning and see how beautiful the green nature and flowers the Creator has created without your knowledge.This morning I found myself in the middle of nature near my house.Ah, it's like a gentle morning in the lap of nature.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR9pNXJWL6HuM7sfyTD2Z85T2LJj1SjY81yWCpy7wyNFk/img_20260525_wa0000.jpg)

I tried to talk to nature today.I saw how beautiful God's creation is and how much the cool morning breeze comforts my body.I looked at the green leaves and flowers.I walked on the road surrounded by nature, there was no chaos.Hey here is peace and a fresh life.Here is the natural medicine that will make our human body strong.May everyone have a healthy life.

📷: Nature photos and videos 📷 taken by me.

Thank you.

@Angelmitu

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=angelmitu/9f7386ea)

links.title: Material update - the frequency cloth
links.body:
Last post, I had just received the cloth that can block WiFi, Bluetooth, etc. and it worked on my first test, as I had explained.   Right after that, I had decided to sew it into a cloth sheet.   I will now tell you about that and how the functionality dropped to nothing. 

The reason I encased the Faraday material into a cloth case is because even touching it can cause it to corrode and oxidize.   It is very thin and prone to unravelling. So, I protected it right up front. 

The first night that I reached or the protective blanket, I was having symptoms of electrical vibrations under the skin and I draped the blanket over me and it did nothing to quash the sensations.  I was left to the old tricks like sleeping pills to get to sleep or a glass of wine.   

Then I remembered my test and read up on the material.  Its shielding is based on the structure and the cloth sealing  ***and connecting*** (electrically) on all seams.  Cloth, like what I had sewn it into, is an insulator and would cancel the effectiveness of the frequence shielding.  The material may very well work, but would best be used inside a wall, connected electrically to another wall, and so on until all corners were connected and any doors sealing where they close.  Not to mention the floors being over lapped onto the walls as well.  

I am looking for relief from these symptoms that are causing me distress when I am almost asleep, thus startling me to an awakened state.  

**The solution?**
I can either buy more material and isolate an area with my bed inside where I drape and lap the same material on all walls, front, back, side to side, floor and ceiling with Faraday material.  (and hope it works)

Or I can attack the problem with Faraday bags which would isolate all phones and electronic devices in the house and then hope that there are not any in neighboring apartments that would frustrate my situation.  Half a dozen of those bags were ordered the same time was the cloth was.  They will be here this week. 

Ever since this started, I have been weeks if not months behind in keeping up with defending my biology as the tech or whatever it is develops and attacks what are supposed to be the most tranquil and calm moments of anyone's life, in this case, mine.

Night time is no longer a place of solace after a hard day of working.  It is the start of  a cat and mouse game of trying to get to sleep quick, before it starts up.  

---

 I will leave it there.  I know this is a small platform but I am hoping that someone who has the same kind of thing happening would empathize and maybe we can cooperate with what has or has not worked. 

<center>Everything I write is my own work unless otherwise noted and referenced</center>

links.title: The streets lights have been upgraded
links.body: Good Morning to all my wonderful friends here @asean.hive. How are you all doing? I have been working and exercising through the whole weekend. It's a Monday again and in two days time, it is my day off. I usually take the day off on Wednesdays. I found out that business is better during weekends. And going to do things like shopping during weekdays is quite beneficial in a way as there is less crowd. It is another Monday morning. Next week is going to be the Rice Harvest Festival here in Sarawak, and I will have a couple of days off. Great news for me. I guess the neighbourhood around my house has been upgraded in terms of lighting. It used to be dark at night with the dim orange light. It is currently lit with LED lights. Now, I even wash my car by parking outside. It feels a lot safer as well as driving out here is much brighter, especially at night.
/> I live somewhere near the city, and this is my neighbourhood.
/> Opposite in this picture is a bungalow, and that is the house of a plant lover. He has lots of plant at his house.
/> Being this bright at the moment brings one problem, and that is during the festive season when there are fireworks. The fireworks cannot be clearly seen, as there is no dark contrast.

/> The local city council has done a good job at upgrading the street lights around the city to make the city safer. There are not a lot of crime here in Miri. There are cameras around the ctiy monitoring parks and even the night lights that light up the highways.
/> My friend bought for me three packs of Pokemon cards while he was in Shanghai, China. This is my first pack of Pokemon. I've never collected Pokemon card before now. New hobby at the moment.
/> Got one Holo card. I have already bought a binder to keep all the Pokemon cards. Will be sharing that in future post.
/> These are printed in Japan for China. @luueetang YouTube: www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice

links.title: Visions of Everyday Life - DIGITAL ART I NFT ART * II ENG - PT_BR II
links.body:
![TEMPLATE ART ALIEN HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/48friu8WtfhMESvD4jEok87bfEaM5NrhMAfU5PJLsnPQEdW5Cnj9VDp2ocmVr5iEqz.jpg)













------------------------

















I haven't been around here for a while, haven't shared any new art, haven't shown a bit of what happens behind the scenes and the creative process. During this time I continued creating in silence, observing more, experiencing the streets more, and better understanding what I really wanted to convey through my art.






     
> Estou um tempo sem aparecer por aqui, sem trazer uma arte nova, sem mostrar um pouco do que acontece por trás da tela e do processo criativo. Nesse tempo eu continuei criando em silêncio, observando mais, vivendo mais a rua e entendendo melhor o que eu realmente queria transmitir através da minha arte.

------------------------




![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23tS2TAEiUoFC5QUuzEHE54GEybJvH4W9zzPfCMrxjeuhPjqMoCc3L8hPTsHkUC35Ttvz.png)













------------------------


And on this return, I wanted to bring something that has always been a part of me: scenes from the daily life of my country, Brazil. The hustle and bustle of the streets, the wires crisscrossing the sky, the marked walls, the neighborhood shops, the movement of people, the texture of the city, and all the identity that exists in urban landscapes. Things that many people pass by without noticing, but that carry history, truth, and feeling.






     
> E nessa volta, eu quis trazer algo que faz parte de mim desde sempre: as cenas do cotidiano do meu país, o Brasil. A correria das ruas, os fios cruzando o céu, os muros marcados, os comércios de bairro, o movimento das pessoas, a textura da cidade e toda a identidade que existe nos cenários urbanos. Coisas que muita gente passa sem perceber, mas que carregam história, verdade e sentimento.
------------------------







![brazocavila.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/Eo6HRxc7Fa3qR4jYrdKnWHDhwL379zQ2s3TzX6jkZGs1E4aTJ1ZkdtBC2Myx7SSCZzG.jpg)



------------------------
My work in design stems largely from this observation. Before any composition exists, there's a careful look at the street, at the city's natural aesthetics, and at everything it communicates without needing to say a word. Every detail becomes a reference. Every walk becomes inspiration. And this entire process ends up transforming into digital art.

     
> Meu trabalho no design vem muito dessa observação. Antes de qualquer composição existir, existe um olhar atento pra rua, pra estética natural da cidade e pra tudo que ela comunica sem precisar dizer uma palavra. Cada detalhe vira referência. Cada caminhada vira inspiração. E todo esse processo acaba se transformando em arte digital.
------------------------


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/EoATuje9ZWT9zTiW5Cq3pgXwNfa85fLdDSaUJgu247KYN9NXS5sbmxDmFMwkNnNzDRo.png)

More than creating something visually beautiful, I want to build images that have atmosphere, identity, and reality. Something that evokes the weight of Brazilian urban life, the energy of daily life, and the beauty that exists in the chaos of the streets.


     
> Mais do que criar algo visualmente bonito, eu quero construir imagens que tenham atmosfera, identidade e realidade. Algo que lembre o peso da vivência urbana brasileira, a energia do cotidiano e a beleza que existe no caos das ruas.

------------------------







![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/242Y1n4853pfUQ5XdGTHESfCTrVzFkKHexEoqiDGhcawcE5TPBbaotZZNfTYVJvNG3tue.png)








------------------------






![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23wzxssAPGpv475vA95VWX8RJqKXngZBKHSX4ZZGkNdDmP9jS5ggmGreDaqsLuJ6Mahpk.png)





------------------------

This return is also a way to show more of my creative process, the ideas that emerge along the way, and how I see design: as an extension of the street, the culture, and the experiences that the city offers every day.

     
> Essa volta também é uma forma de mostrar mais do meu processo criativo, das ideias que surgem no caminho e da forma que eu enxergo o design: como uma extensão da rua, da cultura e das experiências que a cidade entrega todos os dias.
------------------------




![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23tS2TAEiUoFC5QUuzEHE54GEybJvH4W9zzPfCMrxjeuhPjqMoCc3L8hPTsHkUC35Ttvz.png)

links.title: Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash Just Broke the AI Performance Curve — And Declared War on the 'Pro' Model
links.body: ![header](https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmZg5peSyXkj3h9GrwAubBAwJVQgUR93tcQFBAPDqj1XNv)\n\n**At Google I/O 2026, Sundar Pichai unveiled a \

model that outperforms the previous flagship across nearly every benchmark — while running four times faster and costing 40% less. The era of the Pro model may be over before it even began.**

---

On May 19th, standing on the Shoreline Amphitheatre stage in Mountain View, Google CEO Sundar Pichai delivered what may prove to be the most disruptive AI product announcement of 2026. Google had just released Gemini 3.5 Flash — a model positioned as the \

tier of its new family — and it doesn't just compete with Google's own Gemini 3.1 Pro flagship from three months ago. It beats it across almost every benchmark that matters today, at a fraction of the cost and with dramatically lower latency.

This is not an incremental improvement. This is a fundamental reshuffling of the AI model hierarchy that forces every company building on top of large language models to reconsider their architecture, their pricing, and their competitive strategy.

## The Numbers That Matter

Google published a comprehensive benchmark comparison that tells the story in detail:

**Coding and Software Engineering:** On Terminal-Bench 2.1 — which measures a model's ability to execute terminal commands and solve real engineering tasks — Gemini 3.5 Flash scored 76.2%, a full 5.9 points above Gemini 3.1 Pro's 70.3%. On SWE-Bench Pro, which tests real-world GitHub issue resolution, Flash achieved 55.1% versus the Pro's 54.2%.

**Agentic Capabilities — Where It Really Counts:** This is where the announcement gets genuinely exciting. On MCP Atlas (measuring how well models use the Model Context Protocol to orchestrate external tools), Flash scored 83.6% versus 78.2%. On the Finance Agent v2 benchmark, the gap widens dramatically to 57.9% versus 43.0%. On OSWorld-Verified (desktop UI control), Flash achieved 78.4% versus 76.2%.

**The Economic Impact:** Google's optimization slashed the cost per token by roughly 40% compared to 3.1 Pro — pricing at .50 per million input tokens and  per million output tokens. The model runs four times faster than comparable frontier models in terms of output tokens per second.

## The Agentic Era Is Here

But the benchmarks are only half the story. Pichai used the I/O keynote to declare that Google is now shifting its focus toward bringing autonomous AI agents directly to everyday consumers. \

The ecosystem supporting this shift is massive. Google announced Antigravity 2.0, a standalone desktop platform for managing cohorts of autonomous AI agents, alongside Gemini Spark — a personal AI agent that handles long-running background tasks across Chrome, email, and chat services. Google Flow, Daily Brief, Gemini-powered smart eyewear, and even Gemini for Science (an experimental architecture aimed at accelerating life sciences discoveries) were all unveiled.

The scale is staggering: Google now processes over 3.2 quadrillion tokens monthly — up from 9.7 trillion just two years ago. More than 8.5 million developers build with Google AI models every month, and the Gemini app has crossed 900 million monthly active users.

## The Delay That Made the Audience Groan

Not everything was smooth sailing. Gemini 3.5 Pro — the true flagship variant — was delayed until June, drawing audible groans from the live audience according to Business Insider. But that delay may ultimately be a strategic masterstroke. If Flash already outperforms the previous Pro across most practical workloads, then 3.5 Pro needs to be genuinely exceptional to justify the wait — and Google is clearly positioning it as the model for pure deep reasoning tasks where Flash still trails (Humanity's Last Exam and ARC-AGI-2).

## What This Means for the Future

The implications of Gemini 3.5 Flash extend far beyond Google's product roadmap. When a \

model surpasses the previous generation's flagship, it signals that the gap between tiers is collapsing. The traditional model hierarchy — where Pro models cost more and perform better, while Flash models are cheaper but weaker — is breaking down.

For developers and enterprises, the message is clear: if your workload prioritizes speed, cost-efficiency, and agentic capability over extreme single-turn reasoning, Gemini 3.5 Flash may be the smarter choice today — even before Pro arrives.

For the broader AI industry, this announcement raises an uncomfortable question for competitors: if Google can deliver flagship-level performance at Flash-tier pricing, what happens to the premium model market? The answer may determine which AI companies thrive in the agentic era and which get squeezed out by economics they didn't see coming.

The AI race just got a lot faster, a lot cheaper, and a lot more dangerous for incumbents who assumed their performance moat was wide enough to matter.

links.title: [ESP - ENG] ✨🛍️ A Birthday Party in true Disney style 🎂🎉
links.body: > ¡Hola hola Comunidad! ✨✨, el pasado fin de semana mi grupo de amigos y yo nos vestimos de personajes de Disney (o al menos lo intentamos), para celebrar el cumpleaños de una de del grupo, bueno de dos realmente pero la idea, la casa y la fiesta en sí misma, era de una sola 🤣. Yo intenté ser Sharpay Evans (la diva, diosa, mi modelo a seguir), pero también contamos con la presencia de Lilo, Mitchie Torres, la princesa Tiana y el príncipe Naveen, y más personajes, hasta Bolt estuvo presente 🤣.

> Lo que al inicio sería simplemente una pijamada temática donde pasaría mis toda la noche viendo pelis de Disney, con el pasar de los días se transformó en toda una fiesta. La cumpleañera y su familia organizaron la decoración, la comida, los juegos (mi parte favorita), premios estilo rifa, el karaoke y demás. Fue un fin de semana increíble, las risas obviamente no faltaron y el tiempo entre amigos fue lo máximo 💖.

> Mi parte favorita fueron los juegos, el primero lo hicimos estando sin luz (obviamente), y debo decir que justamente eso le dió mucha más diversión. Todos entramos en modo niños a nuestras maneras, y contra todo pronóstico mi pareja y yo ganamos ese primer juego 🤣. Aunque en el exámen sobre la cumpleañera no me fue mal, la verdad esperaba una mejor puntuación, pero es que ella misma no se conoce bien 🤣.

- - -

Hace ya una semana de ésta fiesta, y la verdad ya extraño pasar tiempo con mis amigos, la vida adulta definitivamente genera un poquito de distancia, es inevitable. Pero al menos tenemos éstos momentos de diversión para volver a conectarnos, y darnos cuenta que la amistad sigue siendo la misma 💖.

![separador nuevo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/EoibzJBuKooMnVdgJahuM46NCrLqCQuNqYyj1hFhu6eT7e3G3jft7A7Tu33wLKDwTCF.png)
Hello my beautiful people ✨💕!
- - -

> Hello hello Community! ✨✨, Last weekend, my group of friends and I dressed up as Disney characters (or at least we tried to) to celebrate the birthday of one of the group—well, two of them actually, but the idea, the venue and the party itself were all down to just one person 🤣. I tried to be Sharpay Evans (the diva, goddess, my role model), but we also had Lilo, Mitchie Torres, Princess Tiana and Prince Naveen, and more characters – even Bolt was there 🤣.

> What started out as just a themed pyjama party where I’d spend the whole night watching Disney films turned into a full-blown party as the days went by. The birthday girl and her family organised the decorations, the food, the games (my favourite part), raffle-style prizes, karaoke and everything else. It was an incredible weekend; there was obviously no shortage of laughter and spending time with friends was the best 💖.

> My favourite part was the games; we played the first one in the dark (obviously), and I have to say that’s exactly what made it so much more fun. We all reverted to being kids in our own ways, and against all odds, my partner and I won that first game 🤣. Although I didn’t do too badly in the quiz about the birthday girl, to be honest I was expecting a better score, but the truth is she doesn’t know herself very well 🤣.

- - -

It’s been a week since that party now, and to be honest, I already miss spending time with my friends; adult life definitely creates a bit of a distance between us – it’s inevitable. But at least we have these fun moments to reconnect and realise that our friendship is still just as strong 💖.

- - - ![Banner_20250718_175732_0001.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kiutvariedades/48Vjprgf7L64hn2E1pd3Px4kDfvdqTJTphafvcf7mh8hY4Dn4JZTf8nr8Y3UVKMnBV.gif)

我曾经一次又一次的在社区表达，我要用HIVE的积累，购买一个属于自己的汽车，哈弗大狗，前些日子，因为资金实在是太不够用了，这些微微的积累，也被我取了出来，变现，还账，导致我现在的账户里又是空了，目前币安账户里HIVE币还有320个，我今天给自己定制一个小目标，一点点的实现自己的理想。

短期之内希望自己能够存够3500个HIVE币，然后再下个阶段，存够7000个币，第三个阶段，存够10000个HIVE币。把长目标分解成几个阶段，再把阶段目标，分成小目标，就看起来比较容易实现一点点，所有的成功都是长期主义的怪物，所以坚持就显得非常重要。

把目标定好了，币价格的浮动在短期看来就显得不是那么的重要，只有拥有大量社区币的大佬级别，才更需要短暂的拉升和暴涨，对于只有300个币的我来说，积累才是第一位的，所以坚持输入，坚持记录，坚持表达，就会觉得格外的重要。

金钱的渴望，对欲望的妥协，都是持续坚持的理由，人活着，总要有点念叨，有点奔头，用大佬的话，就是马活驰骋，人活梦想，为理想而战，为哈佛大狗而战。希望自己早已点实现自己的小目标。

花开两朵，各表一枝，线上就HIVE一个点线了，线下就是实体服装店了，服装店的主要业绩就是化债，解决所有的负债，这是服装店目前的短期目标和规划，也越来越好，但是从前几到现在一直下大雨，严重影响了店铺的营业额，心情开始慢慢的浮躁，，稳住自己，稳住情绪，才能稳住业绩。

外面下着雨，我还在店里，，打开了电脑，记录自己的心情，积累HIVE，立下自己心里的小算盘，小计划，慢慢的实现它，惊艳自己，回报社会。

今天的灰鸽子比昨天更努力，加油。

links.title: Visitando una feria Ovina, Caprina y Bufalina en Venezuela  | Visiting a Sheep, Goat, and Buffalo Fair in Venezuela
links.body:
>

¡Feliz domingo amigos de @hivevenezuela ! Espero que hayan pasado un sabroso fin de semana. La semana pasada tuve la oportunidad de ir a la ExpoFeria Nacional 2026 (Bufalina, Caprina y Ovina) en la Carlota, Caracas, una feria dedicada a conocer todas las empresas venezolanas que hoy en día están trabajando alrededor del país haciendo productos provenientes principalmente de la leche de búfalos, cabras y ovejas, y obviamente en la cría de estos gentiles animales. >Happy Sunday, friends! I hope you had a delicious weekend. >Last week I had the opportunity to visit the 2026 National ExpoFeria (Buffalo, Goat, and Sheep) in La Carlota, Caracas—a fair dedicated to showcasing all the Venezuelan companies currently operating across the country, producing goods made primarily from buffalo, goat, and sheep milk, and, of course, raising these gentle animals.

![IMG_20260516_131734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/23sU8dvStGnRozTVBmGVDoJHWeRi2Ct1RqLKNaJBJZsaxSB8CCoUaMFkkHgNmmUdbigvZ.jpg) ![IMG_20260516_120859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/EpA279K7SyxJEsTXEg3365qosdV9bAfto12ktJp2sJhwTThCtCD1BD1xkHX7rsXhUkF.jpg)

>

Fue una feria gigante, al principio, habían dos grandes carpas interconectadas con stands de las diferentes marcas de productos venezolanos y al final había una especie de redoma cerrada donde hacían la presentación de los animales que concursaban para ser los campeones de la feria. >It was a huge fair. At the beginning, there were two large interconnected tents with booths featuring various Venezuelan brands, and at the end there was a sort of enclosed arena where the animals competing to be crowned fair champions were showcased.

![IMG_20260516_121443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/EogNKuTEGZw7r8EkRcD6A8XRLwSaqcMkdFujqP5S6eHb81VVTneASnXcE9D5sXAcbZL.jpg) ![IMG_20260516_130242.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/EokdaWDt9imS8BWR3c85gDBdz4ZDJgsgwd6bZowJ1nQZYYzx1FJnXLMLzyCZhQKixRW.jpg)

> Sin embargo, la parte más atractiva de la feria, era fuera de esas carpas, habían largas hileras de grandes todos blancos donde estaban los verdaderos protagonistas de la feria, ovejas, cabras, y búfalos por todos lados, si algo me impactó fue ver la dedicación y el nivel de cuidados que cada uno de los criaderos mostraba tener con sus animales, lo tranquilos y acostumbrados a las personas, gorditos, algunos comían, otros dormían o jugaban con sus criadores, y su pelaje, un pelaje limpio, suave y muy brillantes. Creo que es importante reconocer el esfuerzo que están haciendo esos criaderos y fincas para mantener sus animales en tan buen estado, la agricultura, la ganadería y todos los parecidos, no es un rubro fácil, y menos en Venezuela. En mi caso, es primera vez que veía tan de cerca en persona a un búfalo, que animales tan enormes y nobles, siempre me parece increíble que existan animales tan grandes solo comiendo pasto, las maravillas de la naturaleza. >However, the most appealing part of the fair was outside those tents, where there were long rows of large, all-white animals—the true stars of the show: sheep, goats, and buffalo everywhere. If anything struck me, it was seeing the dedication and level of care that each of the breeders showed toward their animals—how calm and accustomed to people they were, plump, some eating, others sleeping or playing with their breeders, and their coats, clean, soft, and very shiny. I think it’s important to recognize the effort these breeders and farms are making to keep their animals in such good condition. Agriculture, livestock farming, and all related fields are not an easy business—and even less so in Venezuela. >In my case, it was the first time I had seen a buffalo up close in person—such enormous and noble animals. It always seems incredible to me that animals this big can exist just by eating grass; the wonders of nature.
![IMG_20260516_135652.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/23xAZpckyoEieXnLqZC4VWsNTVpFVzYNNEvpoXZ7cJv5RR5RQQ4h3DsePYqaDHmg64cPh.jpg) ![IMG_20260516_132929.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/EpJY754Wg84wtwH3NCLMLUo46zTGm2dhxaDnVi5MqGCUAC8axjrKs14yFd2KMr45xEU.jpg) ![IMG_20260516_140755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/Eou7BVA7aoKKywBARCo8ZzqmHjV5JRVcEGNdkruKQFdMiSqg9FjUKD4PcPvq6rbq4FX.jpg)

> Por último, había el sueño de todo adulto chiquito, los tractores amarillos con el que todo niño juega de chiquito, pero tamaño real, bueno, no solo tractores, todo tipo de maquinaría agrícola, me pareció lindo que permitían a algunos niños montarse para que sus padres le tomaran una foto, hasta yo quise un máquina de esas y nisiquiera sé manejar. Sin duda fue una tarde diferente, llena de esa sensación de “Todavía hay personas que siguen apostando por este país.” >Finally, there was every little kid’s dream: the yellow tractors that every child plays with when they’re little, but life-size. Well, not just tractors—all kinds of farm machinery. I thought it was nice that they let some kids climb on so their parents could take a picture of them. Even I wanted one of those machines, and I don’t even know how to drive. >It was definitely a unique afternoon, filled with that feeling that “There are still people who believe in this country.”
![IMG_20260516_120611.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/EpQvqnvUTCJypbKeAsXc42MgVRm16sdGwjRhEbbVBRJZwP5REVBiLLMuMcwzAsTJmDv.jpg) ![IMG_20260516_120444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/EpvhTwR16QVLoNvad57W3fAnKwzDtqiuoqsAuNXA9vLZUYZRW4DT2Mdd6bALS1pvX9q.jpg) ![IMG_20260516_120709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/Eqb1dzkgrQ8MpAmTTeo7FPGejuANaAYHi8c8f9sAH7KE4mKgfSc2ivpi3HgSHw3ZscD.jpg)

> Esto es todo por hoy, si llegaste hasta aquí muchas gracias por leerme y apoyarme. ¡Nos leemos en una próxima publicación!💙 >That's all for today. If you've made it this far, thank you so much for reading and supporting me. See you in my next post.

links.title: 卖榴莲的老板跑路了……
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![EsX4sW97eRn5aLns_IMG_20260523_212339.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/EsX4sW97eRn5aLns_IMG_20260523_212339/EsX4sW97eRn5aLns_IMG_20260523_212339.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

帅哥周末过来了，我说找找那个老板看看，能不能退一下榴莲，然后我们就带着发苦的榴莲过去。结果在那里找到了他，但是又不太敢确认，然后我就拨通了那个收款方的电话，发现就是他兄弟接的。然后我们就去找了他。那个兄弟就跟那个老板说。

后面那个老板就给了一个小榴莲我们叫我们自己回家开。然后我感觉他态度很不好，而且货也不对版。我买的大榴莲，只给我们小的还让我们自己回家开。我就和他吵了起来。

后来就说要报警什么的，他就说他没收到钱，钱是转给了那个兄弟。他让我找那个兄弟。然后说不要影响他做生意。然后后面我不走，他就说他走，就骑车跑了，我叫老铁拍照，他也没拍到，感觉像个旁观者傻傻的看戏。🙃

后来我就想去找那个兄弟，叫他他不应，骑着三轮车也跑了。气得我就报警了。结果警察等了快一个小时到了之后给了我一张不在管辖范围的回执单，就说他们也管不了。叫我们找市场监督管理局。🙃

后面我问他，那如果人找到了，能打电话给你们吗？他就说可以。然后他们给我们回执也开车走了。。。。。。留下我们两个弱小无助又可怜。

后续就是我俩又找了一圈，那两个人跑了不见踪影。我俩又拎着放了几天的破榴莲回家了。🙃

links.title: 又做手工作业
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![10SdqUO1FRzwE4v6_bxw5.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/10SdqUO1FRzwE4v6_bxw5/10SdqUO1FRzwE4v6_bxw5.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

这个周末孩子妈带孩子去北京旅游，周天下午我寻思着把孩子书包收拾一下，顺便看看老师让周一带啥东西。这不看不要紧，一看出问题了。老师留了一个项目式作业，让做一个关于探秘自然奇观的项目式作业，要求图文并茂并且结合自然景物，说清楚特点或者蕴含的知识。老师给了几个参考样例，比如“早晨为什么有露水”，“海市蜃楼是什么”，”番茄“，”马铃薯“等等之类。这些例子有图有画，还有艺术字体，我哪能做出这么复杂的东西出来。

我直接把老师的要求发给豆包，让豆包帮我出主意，然后我从豆包给的建议里选择”彩虹“主题，就写”彩虹是怎么形成的“。我选了一个图画最少的模版，找了一个彩虹图片，还有彩虹形成的解释，整合到一张A4纸上打印出来。然后我又找来一张硬卡纸，把打印出来的材料用剪刀裁剪好，用双面胶贴到硬卡纸上，就这么完成了。虽说有些粗糙，但我的能力有限只能这样子了。

记得我上小学时候就有过这种项目式作业，当时我总是做的一塌糊涂，因为压根没有美术功底。然后我就对这种作业产生了心理阴影，好在小学上完后就再也没有这种作业了。现如今孩子上小学，又是类似的手工作业，而且每学期有好几次，暑假寒假也有，真是越怕什么越来什么，要了我的命啊。怎么没有家长为这个事投诉教育局呢，因为这明摆着是给家长留的作业。

---

@lizandra, esta es una situación preocupante, me imagino como te sientes. Aunque el caso de Dylan es autismo severo, me gustaría decirte lo que hice cuando mis hijos estaban por entrar en la preadolescencia. Yo decidí llevarlos a consultas de psicología para prever alteraciones en el comportamiento como consecuencia normal por los cambios hormonales. No es la misma situación, eso lo entiendo porque mis hijos tienen autismo leve, y el mayor muy, pero muy leve. Incluso me hablaron luego de autismo atípico en el caso de mi hijo mayor. 

Sin embargo, lo que quiero decirte es que es posible que a Dylan debas llevarlo a consulta con un especialista en autismo, ya sea psicólogo, aunque te recomiendo neurólogo porque es posible, que sea necesario medicarlo con algún estabilizante del humor sin necesidad de doparlo, no te preocupes porque hay medicinas muy suaves y en dosis muy mínimas porque son indicadas en autismo para estabilizar el humor, solo eso y funciona.  Pero, por supuesto, solo un médico debidamente capacitado es quien debe decir que hacer para ayudar a Dylan con el único fin de evitar que aumenten los arrebatos y por ende el riesgo de daños mayores. 

Solo es una sugerencia, en base a lo vivido con mis hijos pero no soy médico, solo soy una madre que te comprende, más de lo que puedas imaginar. Más de una vez me he sentido confundida e incomprendida, la verdad sola aún rodeada de mucha gente. 


Mi abrazo sincero para ti y para Dylan 🫂💙

links.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill | Review [ENG-ESP]
links.body:
![hhhh.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgJXigZFHaUCNNUem6P43s1SCM7QvyDEti33uLHWxBkB/hhhh.jpg) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=148866) Staying home and catching up on all those movies that are currently in theaters is a great plan, since many of these films are new releases while others continue a series—and in the end, they all serve as a way to stay in the loop. Plus, it’s a chance to see the work of new directors who are committed to keeping the genre alive. That’s why The Punisher: One Last Kill was recently released, and many were talking about this movie simply because it’s part of the Marvel franchise. Despite having a different style, it presents an interesting, challenging story with a touch of action, precisely because it’s about a man who is already completely broken. >Quedarse en casa y terminar de todas esas películas que están en estreno es un gran plan, ya que muchas de esas producciones son nuevas como otras para continuar una secuencia que a la final todas sirven para entrenar, además ver el trabajo de nuevos directores que están apostando en mantener ese género activo. Por eso hace poco se estrenó The Punisher: One Last Kill y muchos comentaban de esta película por el mismo hecho de ser de la franquicia de Marvel, a pesar de contar con un estilo diferente nos presenta una historia interesante, desafiante y a la vez con ese toque de acción, por el mismo hecho de ser un hombre que ya está completamente roto. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTqncfATRA3PwhuC5LeR7RmfyvswECPygQpaggwH8PqFP/image.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es-ES/title/tt36042156/mediaviewer/rm1788661250/) What’s great about this movie—and what sets it apart from the rest—is that it blends a crime thriller with a superhero story, and this is where the film really shines, as the tension, the tough decisions, and the silences give it that intriguing twist. Another standout aspect is the action sequences, which feel realistic and free of the exaggerations seen in recent Marvel films. Instead, everything fits together seamlessly, keeping us hooked, and this is where we find ourselves wondering: Can he erase the past? Will he live a peaceful life? The characters in this film aim to create something different and unique, and that’s where actor Jon Bernthal carries one of the biggest responsibilities of the entire installment—he doesn’t need to adopt other personas, since with a single word he conveys more than many Marvel protagonists do in entire films, which would make him perfect for other projects in the franchise. Furthermore, in this film, Frank isn’t just out to cause harm; he’s also portraying himself as a broken man who keeps fighting because he doesn’t know how to live any other way. >Lo bueno de esta película y la hace un poco diferente a las demás es que combina thriller criminal con superhéroes y es aquí donde la película se lleva su mayor punto fuerte, ya qué hay tensión, decisiones y silencios que le da ese giro interesante a la película. Otras de las cosas que se destaca es ese trabajo en la acción, ya que se siente real y nada de exageraciones como en las últimas películas de Marvel. Más bien todo encaja y nos lleva a seguir viendo y es aquí donde nos preguntamos ¿Podrá borrar el pasado? ¿Vivirá una vida tranquila? # >Los personajes esta película apuestan en crear algo distinto y ser único y es allí donde el actor Jon Bernthal cuenta con una de las responsabilidades más grande de toda esta entrega y no necesita tomar otras personalidades, ya que con una palabra transmite más que muchos protagonistas de Marvel en películas enteras, la cual sería perfecto verlos en otros proyectos de la franquicia. Además, en esta película Frank no solo busca causar daño, sino mostrarse como una persona destruida que sigue peleando porque no sabe vivir de otra manera. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmatd8xA6GYyAv197A2PbHdDzHNXpTn8hJy6sVQJ1iPuQN/image.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es-ES/title/tt36042156/mediaviewer/rm1771884034/) The film has a solid storyline without too much filler, but just as things start to come together, it falls back on the same old Marvel formula of milking the characters for all they’re worth. And while this new story has its jokes and action sequences, Frank Castle works best when he shows his human side—demonstrating that he wants to be special and that, despite all his flaws, he has so much more to give and offer in this cinematic universe. >La película cuenta con una buena secuencia, sin tanto relleno, pero cuando todo comienza a ir bien se repite la misma historia de Marvel usando los personajes hasta el límite y aunque esta nueva historia tiene sus chistes, sus combates Frank Castle funciona mejor cuando muestra su lado humano mostrando que quiere ser especial y con todos sus defectos tiene mucho más para dar y ofrecer en este mundo de películas.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb1YQAsu4GB81sVj4eS7YynfmSoXYhjpF5CvEkReLPj1r/image.png)

links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVz9o2afNdb2ZZmWpdCUayJTmgneBizusJLuVZea1FWUG/dfuns_2026_05_25_021132d07359a60b9b.jpg)


Dwie aktualne narracje dotyczące Królestwa Bez Kresu, czyli ta o \

doskonale się uzupełniają, ale niestety nie oddziałują wystarczająco na emocje (tak by ludzie gotowi byli regularnie wspierać KBK). Wspomniałem już o tym w [poprzednim wpisie](/@hallmann/roboty-jak-marasu). W opinii tej utwierdza mnie również przykład Wolnego Jazdowa, który mimo podobnego przekazu dość mozolnie [zbiera](https://zrzutka.pl/xjkmwa) na nowe czynsze. Emocje mogą być różne. Mam wrażenie, że dominują te negatywne: ludzie robią coś wbrew czemuś, bo coś innego ich wkurza. W taki sposób w Krakowie odwołano właśnie prezydenta. W tym samym czasie Łatwogang zebrał kolejne miliony na walkę z chorobą. No cóż, walka wywołuje emocje i niewątpliwie jest to temat, który można byłoby poddać głębokiej analizie. Dla KBK byłaby ona jednak bezużyteczna. No bo z czym my niby walczymy? Z inflacją? Z samotnością? Nikt tego nie potraktuje poważnie. No ale przecież emocje mogą być różne. Poszedłem ostatnio do Żabki odebrać paczki. Na półce zobaczyłem Cherry Coke w starej puszce. O takiej: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTtpsnJyYq5zFQQUSBwxoaAzuQNiyQWV9q8BFk9bG97on/image.png) Był wieczór, paczki były ciężkie, więc pomyślałem sobie: jutro wrócę i kupię kilka puszek. No i co? Następnego dnia nie było ani jednej. Wszystko wykupione. Dało mi to trochę do myślenia w kontekście KBK, bo już jakiś czas temu zauważyłem, że grupą, która najbardziej może doceniać istnienie takiego miejsca są osoby w wieku 30-40 lat, które pamiętają jeszcze analogowe czasy i ich vibe. Może więc brakującym elementem naszej narracji jest retro nostalgia i podkreślenie, że w KBK można odnaleźć ten utracony świat, w którym ludzie poznawali się i spędzali czas w realu. Oczywiście można to spotęgować poprzez odpowiednią formę. Magnetofon już kupiłem...
