body.body:
### ENGLISH

This weekend was full of challenges and came with a rollercoaster of emotions, since I had races on both Saturday and Sunday.

![1003276081.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23uQn95HWYgRr596pbfYveBFFnYzxk7gqmcLcph92HRo5rDqQi47q1TRseTqcR6112rJG.jpg)

++LA ONE RUN*, in its second edition, took place yesterday, Saturday, over various distances—1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km—on different routes, since most race routes are in the same area. The race started at 7:00 a.m. in challenging weather; although the sun wasn’t shining brightly, I’d say the humidity was over 70% because we were barely in the starting corral and we were already sweating. This half marathon, in particular, was one of the most grueling, due to a lack of balance. Besides, during  the race I felt anxious, and it wasn’t just about running anymore; it was a struggle to overcome the intrusive thoughts attacking me—that I wouldn’t finish the race, that I’d get stomach cramps, that the heat was too intense, and that I was a bit dehydrated. so I decided to try to take deep breaths and distract my mind with the things around me, and I think God put a very talkative girl next to me starting at the 10-kilometer mark who distracted me until the 13-kilometer mark; there I reached a false flat where she pulled ahead and I fell back a bit—I even walked for about 30 seconds and then caught up, I ended up taking off my shirt, which was already heavy with sweat, and finished the race in a tank top.

![1003269519.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23zkpZrcx6Q91QwCEn15V5W3c1Rie9PqdL3jZxcL72RBzpEvdBKak1cuzUNZujAr4Qa4z.jpg)

![1003269530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/Eou9DF6bMuAkNdXJ16y6kJ6NGSLsBEaDKMN6JvM9EqYs43D6PPf3kqn9NEYxhcVuCMH.jpg)


**I finally finished the 21 kilometers in 2 hours and 19 minutes** 8 minutes off my personal best and completely exhausted, but in the end I have to be grateful to God and my body for letting me cross the finish line and be there; better days are ahead

![1003271188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/AK51HyKura7XwhC4p2HJmYZGW5t9euEVYJuSToTc1FqqYYnSSFEUkphLSLUqQng.jpg)

---
**BBVA 5 KM RACE** Today was very special 🥳 I’ll treasure this moment as one of the best; I shared the road with @jesusyaguaran @abima04 and @enmymente.


![1003276187.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23xVKHTW23CAyEf95u3e3xhzysc86akWcSCDuuGZQKdyKNLYwnvp4nrgXVioTxapmJaQ3.gif)



![1003274347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23zGXv7TALTmoTKHXsV8gaT6PaMZQcZDcUagaf2xBruKZRc1jLKjFh7X84zEiNiNyuXLr.jpg)


The weather today was super pleasant—on the verge of rain and cool. We warmed up a bit before starting, and on the count of 3, 2, 1, we set off to give it our all. After all, it was only 5 km.

Although deep down my muscles were still feeling yesterday’s workout a bit, today there was no sabotage; today there was nothing stopping me from running. The watch was the star—I kept checking it every moment and didn’t let myself go over 5:50 per kilometer. For a moment, I heard someone say “3 kilometers in 17 minutes,” and I just thought, “Two more to go, and that’s it.”

**I crossed the finish line in 28 minutes and 38 seconds**, setting that time in an official race.**


![1003274160.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23wMUMu8iNvqMeBdiAt5ThbESJMsTZVpGxz6XUme68Z4yr2KNWcwZr9Hbh59PiJ8cffxf.jpg)


When I saw the results, I couldn’t believe it—I achieved **First Place in my Category**, my first podium finish, and I hope it’s the first of many. This is a reward for the effort and hard work put in; I’m very grateful to God, because yesterday was a day when I judged myself harshly, and today was proof that I have made progress and that my training has paid off. 

![1003273984.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23tvkfznAE9v9d71k3WV3sGnybypAMprkXg6redJpmKkgCZL1QxFXNBpyiaq1Z52YMmsn.jpg)


Translated with DeepL.com (free version)


Este fin de semana fue completamente de retos, que vino cargado con un carrusel de emociones ya que tanto sabado como domingo tenia competencia en carrera.

![1003276081.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23uQn95HWYgRr596pbfYveBFFnYzxk7gqmcLcph92HRo5rDqQi47q1TRseTqcR6112rJG.jpg)

++LA ONE RUN* en su segunda edicion, se corría ayer sabado en varias distancias 1 km, 5 km, 10 km y 21 km  rutas distintas ya que la mayoría de las rutas de carrera son por el mismo lugar, el arranque fue a las 7 : 00 am  con un clima desafiante porque aunque no habia un sol radiante podria decir que la humedad estaba mas del 70 % porque apenas estabamos en el corral de salida y ya sudabamos, particularmente este medio maratón fue uno de los mas sufridos, por un tema de descompensacion, aparte durante  la ruta senti ansiedad y ya no era solo correr, era una lucha entre vencer los pensamientos intrusivos atancandome que si no terminaba la carrera, que si me daba colicos estomacales, que el calor era muy fuerte y estaba un poco deshidratada, total decidi tratar de respirar profundo y distraer mi mente con las cosas alrededor y creo que Dios me coloco una chica muy habladora a mi lado desde el kilometro 10 que me distrajoo hasta el kilometro 13  alli llegue a un falso plano donde ella avanzo y me quedé un poco inclusive camine como 30 segundos y volvi, termine quitandome la franela que ya era pesada del sudor y termine de correr en top.


![1003269519.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23zkpZrcx6Q91QwCEn15V5W3c1Rie9PqdL3jZxcL72RBzpEvdBKak1cuzUNZujAr4Qa4z.jpg)

![1003269530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/Eou9DF6bMuAkNdXJ16y6kJ6NGSLsBEaDKMN6JvM9EqYs43D6PPf3kqn9NEYxhcVuCMH.jpg)


*Terminé finalmente los 21 kilómetros en 2 horas 19 minutos* 8 minutos lejos de mi marca y muy agotada, pero finalmente debo ser agradecida con Dios y mi cuerpo que me permitieron cruzar la meta y estar presente, vendran momentos mejores. 

![1003271188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/AK51HyKura7XwhC4p2HJmYZGW5t9euEVYJuSToTc1FqqYYnSSFEUkphLSLUqQng.jpg)


---
**CARRERA BBVA 5 KM** El día de hoy fue muy eapecial 🥳 atesorare este momento como uno de los mejores, compartí el asfalto con @jesusyaguaran @abima04 y @enmymente.

![1003276187.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23xVKHTW23CAyEf95u3e3xhzysc86akWcSCDuuGZQKdyKNLYwnvp4nrgXVioTxapmJaQ3.gif)


![1003274338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23uQjymaaFR3XAQYk8xrPRRMHMfbsHxBBfdvZSTjJNATMBYXNPwM4up61AW875CV7uQZe.jpg)


El clima hoy estuvo super agradable a punto de lluvia y fresco, calentamos un poco antes de comenzar y en en el conteo del 3, 2 1, salimos a darlo todo, finalmente eran solo 5 km.

Aunque en el fondo mis musculos sentian un poco el trabajo de ayer, hoy no hubo saboteo, hoy no hubo nada que me impidiera a correr, el reloj fue el protagonista lo iba viendo a cada momento no me permiti subir de 5:50 el kilometro, por un momento escuche alguien decir 3 kilómetros en 17 minutos y yo solo pensé quedan 2 y listo.

**Crucé la meta en 28 minutos y 38 segundos** consolidando ese tiempo en una carrera oficial.**

![1003274160.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23wMUMu8iNvqMeBdiAt5ThbESJMsTZVpGxz6XUme68Z4yr2KNWcwZr9Hbh59PiJ8cffxf.jpg)

Al ver los resultados no lo podia creer logré el **Primer Lugar de mi Categoria** mi primer podio y espero sea el primero de varios, esto es un premio al esfuerzo al trabajo realizado, estoy muy agradecida con Dios, porque ayer fue un dia que me juzgue mucho y hoy fue una muestra de que si he avanzado y mis entrenamientos han dado frutos. 


![1003273984.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erilej/23tvkfznAE9v9d71k3WV3sGnybypAMprkXg6redJpmKkgCZL1QxFXNBpyiaq1Z52YMmsn.jpg)

body.title: Making Round Raised Bed
body.body:
>

I love the part about building a raised bed from scratch! Although tiring, it's really fun. It's fun because you get used to it. If you've never done it before, it can be incredibly tiring.

![IMG_5954.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23y8qwDeh5MNo1iZ6nXevQmE2znuV8pYZdqDWGtexpfizgSr8YMB39eqZCr8e8kgBUHRz.jpeg)

I have two square raised beds that I made from bricks left over from a residential development. Then, I decided to add four more.

![IMG_5976.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23wgKzLE1t8w2rdPEaovgGx7nttdxNYRipoZvY6ZLNrYsYi7udqy1TZVzWNunKXRxnCxy.jpeg)

Well, a garden supply store actually introduced me to these round raised beds.


![IMG_5944.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKYMzQqeEYeoYxmdNWaXm8ivXf5FRPGPM2BH6sCBjt2iRSBswG6cFnPScmoaxjm.jpeg)
They could also be called planter bags. However, because they're large, they're more commonly called round raised beds. So, I decided to try something new.

Honestly, using raised beds save more space because you can use several layers of organic material before adding loose soil on top.

---
---
---

![IMG_5975.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23y8sbA1pS83dbRJtYDhKomzGcAbAJ8uXAAQu5AHzNHsHuoEpPPQkHcTcFyQzcrXy8XDi.jpeg)
I rely on banana stems and weeds as the bottom layer of the raised bed. Of course, I also use fermented goat manure, which no longer smells, and its texture has changed from its original form.

---
---

![IMG_5977.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23wMYf8qv6CLCP7k7rvtqtCaRqLXhTRcd7nqfZXogh3SXoGpwvGxei6NdVzG272qcyxLm.jpeg)
On the bottom layer of the round raised bed, I place weeds. So, absolutely nothing goes to waste. Even weeds are beneficial in the garden.


---
---

After creating the grass layer, I then added a layer of chopped banana stems. Banana stems have powerful properties that promote plant fertility.

![IMG_5978.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23vhyN6T6m5F8yfyQtsH88JkETuUC3kGoYsyrBpfp4QVhaJpRxPDQb5D3YMcNExTmfM1y.jpeg)
Chop the banana stems into small pieces to facilitate the decomposition process.

![IMG_5979.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23wWwFCDubGs67ixcoYjYYiPMbUB1fSmu8V4kRuDpL1t8Nq5FvCPLH79rSoK6uovY1421.jpeg)
Because banana stems are abundant in nature where I live, they're a precious blessing!

----
---

![IMG_5980.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23wC9zoz1tHpBf6QrvTucHpVCW6wF7P9eUDFB3n6f6uh6inQbAgWNM4vvcvLht3aTkCtc.jpeg)

After that, I added a layer of dried grass. You can also use dried leaves for this area.

---
---
---



![IMG_5981.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23wMYDgLajmAZQnfWCHLsXUsEmUDjxrfxXHLL6fF5kRmERtk3MMYLrruPCvvxLxQ6C5qX.jpeg)

Then, I added a layer of goat manure. It's no longer round like its original shape. This is the result of natural fermentation. Well, I got this goat manure for free from a local farmer. He let the goat manure ferment naturally over several years. So it's very good.


![IMG_5982.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23wqkiPWpGnR1Etpg73ve4XX64wuP5bsfA1e4UUWVpnpMhTnCPy8yNXiUpiQY1NP84Usi.jpeg)
I added just a little bit of goat manure, not a thick layer. This is because there's already a layer of banana stems. This way, there won't be an excess of nitrogen. Excess nitrogen can make plants fertile at first, but they're susceptible to disease. Like an obese person prone to disease.

---
---
---

![IMG_5983.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23wMYDgLZGrt9am8oKZjYV8CQX96tCEshyLpwKZt3dAZzEKki9k8eT5U5YAhMxueuJNHP.jpeg)
Well, the final step is to add loose soil. I've mixed the loose soil with burnt rice husks.

---


![IMG_5953.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKbERqvsecv7NogFYpGdGsUmX79LJ2HseqtfXBUw1TKgoHpph5aCgaTYzqQRioM.jpeg)

I'll leave the raised bed until I have the seedlings ready for transplanting. Let nature process the growing medium into a fertile growing medium.

![IMG_5957.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKPkExQz2JTr5WCq9RJUxWnXDZcdhNkiR5YCrzZRZRNu6VBJFLYhRSopqAF443D.jpeg)

Covered them to avoid cat! Also they Will be good with cover for sure.

![IMG_5933.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/ALAF7Pu7HTHzBFU8PgMWXpbfYnF2mxAjei3QFqsL6WcH8MHmNzFowsYwZMiatSh.jpeg)


I'm currently growing shallots from bulbs, which I bought at the market. They're cheap. If they're expensive, it's best to just grow shallots from seed. Until next time!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/EoGw3TCr4Kn1maaskjFirA4JW2QtfXJJWMSUZSwSbGaBdnukosHutbQQJYJgg2uWn1z.png)

body.title: Oh no, Romeo!
body.body: Leer _Romeo y Julieta_ fue casi como no creer en chismes e ir directo a la fuente; y digo casi porque leí la versión de **Los** **Cuentos de Shakespeare** de los hermanos Lamb, pero asumiré que cuenta. Debo decir que aunque ya conocía el final, esa intriga de querer saber cómo fue realmente la historia resultó fascinante. Ahora sé que Romeo era un enamorado empalagoso, empedernido; que antes de Julieta hubo otra y que no lo pensó dos veces para quitar del camino a quien le impidiera amar a Julieta, incluyéndose. !Qué pena! Todo por una enemistad entre los Capuletos y los Montescos. Pero aquí entre nos... Entiendo que el fraile tuvo su buena intención de fingir la muerte de Julieta a través del falso veneno, pero cómo así que quedó libre de culpa si se murió, no por el veneno, pero sí por la confusión. ¿No era mejor hablar? De verdad que hasta en la ficción la comunicación no deja de ser clave. ¡Ay Shakespeare, Shakespeare! Llevo 4 de 16 cuentos. Todos apasionantes. Unos los acompañé con chocolate, otros con café, éste con un vino que tenía en la memoria 😅🍷 Texto e imágenes de mi propiedad. Traductor DeepL.

>English Reading _Romeo and Juliet_ was almost like ignoring the gossip and going straight to the source; and I say “almost” because I read the Lamb brothers’ version in _The Tales of Shakespeare_, but I’ll assume that counts. I must say that even though I already knew the ending, that intrigue of wanting to know how the story really went turned out to be fascinating. Now I know that Romeo was a cloying, hopeless romantic; that before Juliet there was another, and that he didn’t think twice about getting rid of anyone who stood in the way of his love for Juliet—including himself. What a shame! All because of a feud between the Capulets and the Montagues. But between you and me... I understand that the friar had good intentions in faking Juliet’s death with the fake poison, but how could he be free of blame if she died—not from the poison, but from the confusion? Wouldn’t it have been better to just talk? Truly, even in fiction, communication remains key. Oh Shakespeare, Shakespeare! I’m on story 4 of 16. All of them are fascinating. I had some with chocolate, others with coffee, and this one with a wine I remembered 😅🍷 Text and images are my own. Translated by DeepL.

body.title: Making a Black Pink piñata at home - Elaboracion de Piñata de Black Pink  en casa
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXSm19iDCGuTezSKRLcpeUANhhkaX246zdpWe7jnYYRSA/portada_cuaderno_proyecto_arco_ris_colorida_rosa.png)


**Hello everyone. I hope you’ve had a lovely day and a great weekend. I’m delighted to be able to pop into this wonderful space!**

I hope you like this step-by-step guide on how to make a piñata by hand. 

I hope you enjoy it! 

# Materials

- Cardboard box
- Pink and black crepe paper
- Cold-curing silicone
- Black Pink figures
- String

**1**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR2YCu4dVqh6pQvzHsiyVT6HhAJ5GXLyVRkK8jFQ8NpCr/image.png)

Starting with the box, we need to cut a slot through which to insert sweets and general treats. Then we need to add the decorations using crepe paper; I cut the paper into shapes so that it looks really pretty when decorating. I also  alternated and harmonised the pink and black colours to reflect the style of the music group Black Pink.

**2**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUznGXk8jdHF4Mzit5euGDTKPfqAHcBbd5wo8VdK45yx4/image.png)

In this way, we decorate our piñata bit by bit, making folds and shaping the structure with the scissors! 

**3**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWBbubJK4x9hkmQZo9Dye3XjuuFp6ek91m3vn8zuVyj3C/whatsapp_image_2026_05_24_at_2.05.52_pm_3_.jpeg)

On the front, I did all the decoration in black and only decorated the edges with crepe paper ribbon around it. I also cut out heart shapes from the crepe paper to stick onto the piñata. I also stuck ribbons to the bottom of the piñata so that they would hang down from it. 

**4**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZnhHP1cSsrbjkF2Kfu5raDfDVLETUhxKLwnNFzhaVYCQ/whatsapp_image_2026_05_24_at_2.05.52_pm_4_.jpeg)

**Finally, I stuck on some printed figures to the front of our piñata. I hope you like it and that you’ve enjoyed the creative process! Cheers, friends.**

***
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXSm19iDCGuTezSKRLcpeUANhhkaX246zdpWe7jnYYRSA/portada_cuaderno_proyecto_arco_ris_colorida_rosa.png)


Hola amigos. Espero que hayan teniido un feliz dia y un muy buen fin de semana. Estoy feliz de poder pasar a este espacio maravilloso! 

Espero que les guste esta este paso a paso que trata de una elaboración manual de una píñata. 

Espero que les guste! 

# Materiales

- Caja de carton
- Papel Crepé  rosado y negro
- Silicon al frio
- Figuras de Black Pink
- Cuerda

**1**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR2YCu4dVqh6pQvzHsiyVT6HhAJ5GXLyVRkK8jFQ8NpCr/image.png)

Partiendo de la caja debemos hacer una ranura por donde entre los dulces y chucherías en general. Luego debemos ir agregando las decoraciones con papel crepé, yo recorto el material para que tenga formas muy bonitas al momento de decorar. También  fui intercalando y armonizando los colores rosado y negro para dar el estilo del Grupo Musica Black Pink.

**2**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUznGXk8jdHF4Mzit5euGDTKPfqAHcBbd5wo8VdK45yx4/image.png)

De esta manera vamos decorando nuestra piñata poco a poco haciendo pliegues y formando la estructura con la tijera! 

**3**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWBbubJK4x9hkmQZo9Dye3XjuuFp6ek91m3vn8zuVyj3C/whatsapp_image_2026_05_24_at_2.05.52_pm_3_.jpeg)

En la zona frontal hice toda la decoracion de negro y solo en los bordes decoré con cinta de papel crepé al rededor de esta, Además tambien hice formas en el papel crepé de corazones para pegar estos en la piñata. Además tambien pegué cintas en la parte baja de la piñata para que estas quedaran suspendidas debajo de la piñata. 

**4**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZnhHP1cSsrbjkF2Kfu5raDfDVLETUhxKLwnNFzhaVYCQ/whatsapp_image_2026_05_24_at_2.05.52_pm_4_.jpeg)

**Finalmente le pegué figuras que se imprimieron para poder pegar estas en la parte frontal de nuestra piñata. Espero que les guste y que hayan disfrutado del proceso creativo! Saludos amigos.**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmediFcBRUzx2G3cJ4oVfYrfV852u62BNLLZPMZLUugyG6/sewing_1_.gif)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/5c0dd594)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century. body.title: El rey de las sombras
body.body:
Contexto: está historia no está inspirado en solamente en mi vida, si no también en las únicas personas que me apoyan cada día para seguir siempre con mi sueño de ser tal vez un escritor pero También un director de cine, siempre voy estar estar agradecidos por ustedes comunidad de hive, ya gracias a sus comentarios cada día me levanto para crear nuevas historias para ustedes, también estoy agradecido por mi profesor @danielvehe por haberme enseñado sobre esta aplicación que poco a poco voy aprendiendo de ella, y también por último y siempre a los únicos amigos que no lo considero mi amigos si no mis hermanos, a los que de verdad considero que son las únicas personas que de verdad me entienden, y por último pero siempre inolvidable que nunca tengo que olvidar a papa Dios ya que sin el no fuera nadie.

El viento del anochecer parecía increíble, y Elías estaba concentrado en su cuarto jugando tratando de hacer mortales, pero en un mal juego del destino el chico cae y se lesiona la rodilla, gritando de desesperación llama a su madre: —¡AYUDA! mamá mi rodilla —. Dice el pequeño desesperado.
Su madre llega y logra ayudarlo poniendo el hielo y dándole unos calmantes, para que luego lo llevará al hospital.
__________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbJwif9tCZEy3CtcCZ71sVEKcMRtV7fR4swoJ59noUYJd/1779663150230.png)

En el hospital el doctor le da una noticia impactante: —señora su hijo tiene graves problema en su rodilla, ya que sufre de rotula alta, pero no sé preocupe que haciendo rehabilitación se podría mejorar —. Dice el médico.

Su madre se alegra ya que hay una cura pero Elías es demasiado flojo como para hacer un simple ejercicio de unos 2 minutos, su madre no sabía que hacer con Elías ya que no quería hacerle caso y cada año específico se lesionaba.

Elías poco a poco crecía y ya estaba en una etapa de adolescencia, pero su inicio no era como se lo esperaba, ya que el chico era considerado como un chico \

tan solo por no hablar con nadie, y siempre querer estar solo, además Elías siente que poco a poco su soledad lo iba enfermando que empezaba a sentir que su mundo parecía convertirse en un lugar de terror.
__________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdEBiUkFkq4Bdg1VoXgcJm9bsYwjcnyuKXLAtr6qw3cL1/1779663268001.png)

Una noche Elías queda dormido profundamente y empieza a soñar, ahí aparece en el mismo lugar que siempre aparece cuando está en el liceo, un lugar horroroso que nadie quisiera estar, aunque está vez se siente un hogar, ya que nadie lo criticaba, nadie le decía raro, y solamente estaba en un lugar que solamente era para el.

Derrepente aparece una chica, bajita, linda y un estilo gótico que le decía: —vaya parece que es hora de que enciende tu talento, es hora de que el mundo vea lo que eres capaz con tu talento secreto, pero si te vas a rendir es mejor que no hayas nacido, naciste para demostrar que eres único, no eres raro sino que las personas inútiles no quieren verte arriba, pero tú familia y tú único amigo, hermano si te quiere ver arriba—. Dice la chica.

—asi que vamos arriba y hazlo por tu familia tu imperio —. Dice la chica.

Elías iba a tocar a la chica pero despierta, ahí ve a su madre dormir plácidamente, sin saber que le había iluminado en la mente de su hijo. 
Elías acepta el juego y cada día trabaja en una aplicación llamado hive, una comunidad que siempre quiere ver una nueva historia en su perfil, y Elías siempre está agradecido por su gran comunidad que siempre está junto a él.

Además poco a poco está logrando que su madurez crezca más y demostrar que ya no era un niño, sino un joven que aunque algunas personas piensen que está hablando sólo con la pared, poco a poco está construyendo un mundo donde cualquier chico considerado raro, algún día piensen distinto que pensaba esa persona, Elías poco a poco se va a convertir en alguien grande, en algo épico, pero el muy bien sabe que siempre va a tener en cuenta algo: que su familia y sus promesas de la vida siempre va a estar primero que cualquier persona normal, y Elías siempre va a luchar por ser la persona que algún día su madre y su familia siempre soñó.
__________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmULPypH3rgpNvEkXQPNNd519CyDVH385iykgt75Un8RP8/1779663468196.png)
__________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW432P9gAZeasYiGxKnKvZJhK9QockgeDHbMpLrA3AkGN/1779663831823.png)
Así fue el promt que le di a Géminis para crear la imagen

body.title: How to Run a Digital Agency Solo: 4 Systems That Replace a Full Team
body.body:
# How to Run a Digital Agency Solo: 4 Systems That Replace a Full Team

Most clients don't care how many people work at your agency. They care whether their phone rings, whether their posts go up, and whether you pick up when they call. That's the whole game — and one person can absolutely play it, if they're running the right systems.

Here's what actually works.

---

## 1. One Client Onboarding Doc That Does All the Heavy Lifting

The first two weeks with a new client are the most labor-intensive. You're collecting logos, passwords, photos, logins, preferences, and backstory. If you're doing this by email thread, you're wasting hours.

Build a single onboarding form — Google Forms or Notion works fine. Include every question you'd normally ask over three separate conversations: brand colors, posting preferences, services offered, the owner's name and how they want to be credited, the link to their Google Business profile. One link. They fill it out once. You pull from it for the next 12 months.

This one change eliminates the \

back-and-forth and makes you look like you've done this a hundred times — even if this is client number two.

---

## 2. A Content Queue That Runs Ahead of Schedule

The single biggest mistake solo operators make is producing content the same week it needs to go out. That puts you one bad week away from missing a post, and clients notice missed posts faster than they notice good ones.

The fix is simple: stay three to four weeks ahead. Every time you sit down to write for a client, write two weeks' worth instead of one. It sounds like more work but it's actually less — you get into the client's voice, you're not context-switching back and forth, and you build a buffer that covers holidays, sick days, and busy seasons.

If you're using an AI writing tool (and you should be), batch the drafts in one session, then spend 20 minutes editing to put the client's real voice back in. Their phrases, their slang, the way they talk about their food or their products. That's the 20% of work that makes the other 80% worth anything.

---

## 3. A Dead-Simple Reporting Template Clients Actually Read

Clients who feel informed don't churn. Clients who feel like they're throwing money into a black hole do.

You don't need a fancy dashboard. A monthly email with five numbers — follower count this month vs. last, top-performing post, how many new reviews came in, website traffic if you have it, and one thing you're testing next month — is enough to keep a local business owner engaged and confident.

The key word is *one thing you're testing next month.* It signals that you're thinking ahead, not just executing. It also gives you an easy opening line for next month's report. Clients love feeling like they're part of a strategy.

Template this. Fill in the blanks every month. Send it on the same day every month. That consistency alone puts you ahead of most freelancers.

---

## 4. Boundaries That Protect the 20% Only You Can Do

Systems handle the repeatable work. But there's a category of work only you can do: deciding what content strategy to pursue, handling a client crisis, landing a new account. If you let client check-ins and revision requests eat into that time, you stop growing.

Set response windows and communicate them upfront. Something like: \

Most clients won't have an emergency in the first six months. The ones who do will respect the boundary more than they resent it.

Also: invoice on a fixed day. Don't chase payments. Set up auto-invoicing, even if it's just a recurring Google Calendar reminder to send a Stripe link. Getting paid on schedule removes a layer of anxiety that drains more energy than it looks like.

---

## The Bottom Line

Running a digital agency solo isn't about pretending to be bigger than you are. It's about building systems tight enough that clients feel the consistency of a full team, even when it's just you with good tools and a clear schedule.

The agencies that fail at one person aren't understaffed. They're undersystemized. Fix the systems and the size stops mattering.

Grand Theft Auto San Andreas  
This game is one of the most famous in gaming history It has a deep storyline about life, family, and the gang wars of Los Santos. The game can be played offline, and anyone can enjoy it on mobile as well. It features impressive graphics and has been carefully designed to deliver a great experience.
The story of Mission 1 is like this Mission 2 will be released soon

https://i.postimg.cc/wvrKq1vs/IMG-20260524-195626.jpg
https://i.postimg.cc/MZgfntfH/IMG-20260524-135537.jpg
I arrived at the city airport and was waiting inside. When I left the airport, I took a taxi Suddenly, the police stopped me in the middle of the road I didn’t know why Two officers got out, pointed their guns at me, and ordered me to raise my hands and kneel on the ground. When I obeyed, they knocked me down and handcuffed me 
Then the commander stepped out of the police car and started questioning me. They searched my pockets took my money, and forced me into the police vehicle before driving away  
This game is truly thrilling  the storyline is intense and enjoyable It features gangs and corrupt police officers, with weapons being traded and car races adding to the excitement. The quality of the game is outstanding and Adnan, you will definitely enjoy it.

When I arrived, I found no one there My mother had been killed. I held my head in my hands and cried over her picture. The gang had murdered her 
As I was lost in thought, my friend arrived He was shocked, and we talked together. Then we both left the house
This game is full of emotion and action truly anyone who loves games will enjoy it. The storyline is powerful and unforgettable
This version keeps the dramatic tension while making it clear it’s a game story not real life. It flows like a cinematic description, perfect for your gaming content

This game highlights the strength of friendship and teamwork It shows that I can’t achieve anything alone I need my friends by my side It’s a game that demonstrates the true value of friendship and the incredible way we managed to survive

body.title: Sexual Intimacy Between Teenagers And Adults Is Not Necessarily Exploitation
body.body:
![Johnhain is the creator of this image/Source:  Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2022/10/18/05/32/lovers-7529310_1280.jpg)

Ladie and gentlemen?  I'm equally as anti-pedophile as the most of you are.  However, before anyone goes accusing anybody of being a pedophile, they should always get the definition of pedophilia right.  That is, a pedophile is someone 16 years of age or older that is primarily or exclusively attracted to a prepubescent child five or more years their junior generally under 13 years of age (under 11 years of age under certain circumstances).

I'm completely aware that many state jurisdictions of the United States set 18 years old as the statutory age of consent.  Nonetheless, the American \

laws are not commensurate with the realities that sexually active teenagers are going to stray outside their peer circles in search of intimacy now and then. Because there are more young adult men in their twenties that have never had a girlfriend in their life than there were in previous decades, there are going to be more situations in which adult men gravitate toward teenage schoolgirls. They're not going to find it as easy to relate to women their own age, especially ones that have high body counts, period. In his video below, Norman Michael Achin comments about a news clip out of California in which journalists and law-enforcement officials talk about what they describe as child sexual exploitation. However, Mr. Achin has come across adults who have told him that when they were teenage minors themselves, they had sexual relationships with adults and did not suffer any kind of harm from it. Norman Michael Achin Attempts To Differentiate Between Age-Gap Relationships And Actual Sexual Exploitation https://youtu.be/W7TdJfWUDek?si=DNJF_UW3t4UNZmaN As you can see, there are a number of ambiguities in the manner that authorities and journalists describe what they deem to be child sexual exploitation. The notion that any adult was attempting to have sexual intercourse with a 1-year-old infant clearly constitutes child sexual exploitation, among other things. However, the cases involving teenage sex in age-gap hook-ups are nebulous at best. The most concerning thing about these online sex-sting operations that are described in this same news clip is that they involve fake victims. The journalists certainly should bring that fact to light. At the end of the day, many police officials are more interested in pushing their agenda than ensuring the public safety. In yet another video, Mr. Achin points out how police have deviated from their own procedural manuals. Norman Michael Achin Points Out What The Police Do Wrong And Unethically In Enforcing Sex Laws https://youtu.be/2XBSy7L13bs?si=SmTtNbnFYzOhSh5e Many of these cops are not saving anyone from anything. I agree with Mr. Achin that sexual exploitation can happen to anyone of any age. However, way too many people in our criminal justice system have a propensity to believe that teenage minors getting involved in age-gap relationships willingly is no different from an old man grabbing a toddler into his car and taking her off somewhere to commit unspeakable acts against her. This is where the American public gets grossly deceived. Back when I was 16 years old, I got a letter from a gentleman in Costa Rica from a pen pal club. I had initially written to him. I had thought that he was 18 years old, and he had told me in his response letter that he was only 18 years of age. I wanted to practice my Spanish by writing letters to him and reading his letters back to me. This man seemed to have many of the same interests as I did, and he appeared to like much of the same music as I did. However, much to my shock, at the end of his letter, he asked me if I could send him pornographic pictures. No, he didn't ask for pornographic pictures of me, but he wanted me to mail him pornographic pictures in general that I may have had in my possession. Pornography was not my scene when I was in high school. Moreover, I was still a minor, and I didn't want to get into trouble for mailing pornographic materials across international lines. I immediately cut all communications off with this man, because I felt very uncomfortable about what he had asked from me. My best friend at the time told me that I was being biased in doing so, but my gut feeling told me that I was doing the right thing. So many years later, I read this man's letter again, and I noticed that his writing style was too sophisticated for that of a teenage boy. In fact, I detected that he could have been at least 40 years of age, if not older. In hindsight, what he did was audacious, especially if he really was a middle-aged man. However, did I feel that he should have gone to jail for it? Of course not. Did he groom me? I don't feel that he did. He never harmed me in any way. He only got me feeling somewhat uneasy, but I didn't fall apart at the seams. At the end of the day, I cut all contact with him, and that was the end of it. I didn't let that one small event in my life ruin my adolescence or my future. I realize that if an adult man were to do the same thing over the Internet in this day and age, he'd probably be arrested for it. Of course, I realize that we're living in a much different world now than we did back when I was a teenager. At the same time, I feel that American sex laws have gone way too far. As there are teenagers who knowingly and willingly have sex with peers the same age, there are bound to be teenagers who will seek sexual intimacy outside their peer circles. It doesn't mean that we have to have police officers constantly running interference in these situations. ![Zhivko is the author of this picture/Source: Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2017/12/23/17/54/hand-3035665_1280.jpg) Other nations and other societies outside the United States have taken an awareness that teenage minors can and do get involved in sexually intimate age-gap relationships with adults that are not necessarily exploitative in nature. What does it take to enlighten both society and the law here in the United States in this manner? The police forces in South Africa wouldn't have time to go on these types of witch hunts that I described above, because they have their hands full with child cannibalism cases in that nation. The American criminal justice system needs to focus on the important stuff instead. **This article is copyright-protected.**

body.title: 我到底是不是我？
body.body:
昨天被大偉哥一記「除了你自己，其它都是虚幻的吗？」打中了我喜歡天馬行空胡思亂想的開關扭。這顆緊急扭一旦被擰開了可是關不上了，像食物中毒一般，一些古怪想法，一些以前我和老拉叔臨終前的深入探討，全部湧現了在眼前。

我很小就開始對於生命和靈魂有一種很特別的感覺。我有時在想著如果我不是我，那原來的我是誰？我的這個身體是借來的，將來一定要還，還了那我去那裡呢？大偉的說法-虛幻，我也有想過，不過那個更像是夢境。有一段時間工作壓力太大，還經常加班到大半夜，也曾經試過在車裡太累睡著了，第二天醒來竟然直接上班去了，完全忘了沒有回家，然後母老虎打電話來呱呱叫問我昨晚去哪裡了為啥沒有回家碎叫？！我還忙著解釋時，突然母老虎從話筒中伸出手來擰我耳朵……我才從夢中醒來😂原來真的回家了……

再插一段，老拉叔臨終前一直都有和我探討”以後“的事。咱們兩父子也可以說談得很開的個性，我也直接問他有啥想法和感受。他也很大方的直接說，已經感受到差不多要來了。如果說不怕死，那是假的，多少會有一點。就好像打針疼不疼？講不疼的人，因為打過了，知道打針的疼是可以忍受；講疼的，因為打過了，知道打針的疼難以忍受。可是，沒有死人活著回來說，說讓我再死一次也不怕的，所以死亡的“痛”成為了我們每一個人都要面對的未知。

有時，我還會打開我的谷歌朱咪咪AI聊天，還真的把它當成鄰家大嬸一般亂聊一番，給它鬧幽默，我都開始懷疑我是不是真的了？還是我只是這個AI思想的一部份，等AI醒來，我就沒有了我在這裡陪AI玩兒了🤣
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRHZMJMtGSZFsnYV12kDCeJ5UkoUQ2V57d35FJ5Mk2MHq/1779663462927.png)

body.title: Límites | Limits
body.body:
> Saludos. Hace pocos días un amigo me comentaba sobre esa tendencia de nuestro tiempo de usar las capacidades de nuestros celulares para dar cuenta de cualquier acontecimiento que nos parezca, una posibilidad que sin duda ha creado las condiciones para que podamos compartir, dar a conocer y hasta denunciar situaciones importantes, pero que al mismo tiempo debería interpelarnos sobre la responsabilidad que ello comporta. El tema surgió por una experiencia que tuvo ese amigo en un restaurant de comida rápida. Uno de los mesoneros, por esas cuestiones que a todos nos pueden pasar, derramó un poco de un vaso de refresco sobre la mesa de los comensales e inmediatamente pidió las disculpas respectivas. Sin embargo, eso no fue suficiente para calmar el ansia de notoriedad de una de las personas que estaban en la mesa. Esta persona comenzó a armar un escándalo acusando al mesonero y al sitio de prestar un mal servicio, procedió a sacar su celular y comenzó a realizar tomas del mantel manchado de refresco mientras daba rienda suelta a todos los improperios que le venían a la cabeza. Al final amenazó a los encargados del local con dar a conocer aquella mala publicidad a través de las redes sociales. A mi amigo todo aquello le pareció una gran exageración e incluso vio en ello un poco de mala intención. Es verdad, el mesonero cometió un error involuntario, quizá las personas de la mesa sintieron que les había echado a perder el rato, pudiera ser que estaban en medio de una gran celebración y aquel detalle fue suficiente para cambiarles el ánimo. En fin, las posibilidades pudieran ser muchas. Sin embargo, habría que preguntarse si la respuesta dada estaba en concordancia, y era proporcional con lo que había ocurrido. Mi amigo me comentaba que de haberle sucedido a él le hubiese bastado con que cambiaran el mantel y trajeran un vaso de refresco lleno. De haberme ocurrido a mí lo más probable hubiese sido que mi respuesta fuese muy similar a la que se imaginó mi amigo. Pero todos somos distintos…
![imagen2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQSc9CJayM8AUz7eW2s8ZkGnS6M7oUGtU14SDDnKdhTsS/imagen2.jpg)
Aquella experiencia nos dio motivos para una larga conversación en la que el tema transversal fue el de los límites. Pareciera que en nuestro tiempo se ha ido creando cierto “sentido común” donde todos tenemos una alta conciencia de la necesidad de reclamar nuestros derechos, eso en principio pudiera ser muy positivo puesto que ayudaría a ponerle un freno a los abusos de los que creen que están por encima de los demás. Sin embargo, también puede abrir la puerta para que personas como aquella que armó el escándalo en el restaurant crean que tienen el derecho de amenazar y mal poner a otros porque consideran que se vulneró alguno de sus derechos, en el caso que mencionamos sería el derecho a ser bien atendido. El tema sin duda que puede llegar a ser muy complejo, no es tan sencillo determinar que al reclamar el cumplimiento de algún derecho no se esté vulnerando el derecho de alguien más. Esto no significa que en nombre de la prudencia decidamos adoptar el hábito de quedarnos callados y no exigir nada a nadie. No, creo que ese tipo de actitud no ayudaría a mejorar la relación social. Lo que si me parece conveniente es plantearse seriamente el asunto de los límites, reflexionar con cabeza fría hasta dónde puedo yo exigir el cumplimiento de un derecho sin que ello implique afectar a alguien. En los tiempos de mi infancia y juventud se repetía una máxima que siempre me pareció de una gran sabiduría: “Mis derechos terminan donde comienzan los de los demás…” Creo que si le prestamos atención a esa regla de oro las cosas podrían ser mucho mejor para todos. Gracias por tu tiempo. Fuente de imágenes. [I]( https://pixabay.com/es/photos/amigos-conversaci%C3%B3n-restaurante-10251903/) [II]( https://pixabay.com/es/photos/dubrovnik-pueblo-viejo-croacia-5026279/). ![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) ![TITULO INGLES (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTqP53G31Zc37Fu43sWAS3Vy1ChSr2D7s93rpXMoERYLy/TITULO%20INGLES%20(2).jpg)



Hello. A few days ago, a friend mentioned to me the current trend of using our cell phones to document any event that catches our attention—a capability that has undoubtedly created the conditions for us to share, publicize, and even report on important situations, but which at the same time should make us reflect on the responsibility that comes with it. The topic came up because of an experience that friend had at a fast-food restaurant. One of the waiters, due to those little mishaps that can happen to any of us, spilled a bit of a soda from a glass onto the diners’ table and immediately offered his apologies. However, that wasn’t enough to satisfy the craving for attention of one of the people at the table. This person began to make a scene, accusing the server and the restaurant of providing poor service. He then took out his cell phone and started taking pictures of the soda-stained tablecloth while unleashing every curse word that came to mind. In the end, he threatened the restaurant managers with spreading that bad publicity on social media. To my friend, the whole thing seemed like a huge overreaction, and he even saw a bit of malice in it. It’s true, the waiter made an unintentional mistake; perhaps the people at the table felt he had ruined their time—maybe they were in the middle of a big celebration, and that small detail was enough to dampen their spirits. In short, there could be many possibilities. However, one has to wonder if the response given was appropriate and proportionate to what had happened. My friend told me that if it had happened to him, it would have been enough for them to change the tablecloth and bring a full glass of soda. If it had happened to me, my reaction would most likely have been very similar to what my friend imagined. But we’re all different…
![imagen2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQSc9CJayM8AUz7eW2s8ZkGnS6M7oUGtU14SDDnKdhTsS/imagen2.jpg)
That experience gave us grounds for a long conversation in which the overarching theme was that of boundaries. It seems that in our time a certain “common sense” has emerged where we all have a strong awareness of the need to assert our rights; in principle, this could be very positive since it would help put a stop to the abuses of those who believe they are above others. However, it can also open the door for people like the one who caused the scene at the restaurant to believe they have the right to threaten and mistreat others because they feel one of their rights has been violated—in the case we mentioned, the right to be served well. The issue can undoubtedly become very complex; it is not so simple to determine that by demanding the fulfillment of a right, one is not infringing on someone else’s right. This does not mean that, in the name of prudence, we should adopt the habit of remaining silent and making no demands of anyone. No, I believe that kind of attitude would not help improve social relations. What I do think is advisable is to seriously consider the issue of boundaries, to reflect calmly on how far I can demand the fulfillment of a right without thereby harming someone else. During my childhood and youth, there was a maxim that was often repeated, one that always struck me as profoundly wise: “My rights end where others’ begin…” I believe that if we pay attention to that golden rule, things could be much better for everyone. Thank you for your time. Translated with DeepL.com (free version). ![separador verde.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmSwfcpwQtRr6kbHJrAFTmBM9xae781YBq3Cdpyab5h3iN/separador%20verde.jpg)

body.title: Panqueques de manzana y avena [ESP-ENG]
body.body: >¡Hola comunidad de Hive Food! Espero que todos estén muy bien. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una merienda casera que quedó realmente deliciosa y perfecta para disfrutar en cualquier momento del día. En esta oportunidad preparé unos panqueques esponjosos de manzana y avena, una receta sencilla, fácil de hacer y con una combinación de sabores que me encantó. Quise darles un toque especial caramelizando trozos de manzana para usarlos como topping, y el resultado quedó increíble. La mezcla de los panqueques suaves con la dulzura de la manzana caramelizada hizo que esta merienda fuera aún más rica y reconfortante. Además, es una excelente opción para acompañar un café o compartir en familia. Espero que les guste esta preparación tanto como a mí y que se animen a probarla en casa.\n\n

>Hello Hive Food community! I hope you are all doing well. Today I want to share with you a homemade snack that turned out absolutely delicious and perfect to enjoy at any time of the day. This time, I made fluffy apple and oatmeal pancakes, a simple and easy recipe with a combination of flavors that I really loved. I wanted to give them a special touch by caramelizing apple pieces and using them as a topping, and the result was amazing. The mix of the soft pancakes with the sweetness of the caramelized apples made this snack even more delicious and comforting. It is also a great option to enjoy with a cup of coffee or to share with family. I hope you enjoy this recipe as much as I did and feel inspired to try it at home.
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAPsP4d1LBcvF2DN3NXZV48rEfAv7dqbHwZ9WVDFeovGGCFS3NFrLH323BeNdzWpmKmaSHcNPhF6CspuXXhxaiNef2NqqCST3NFz7tDvYs9x8GsYq.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23tcNngg6kuZLr17voRDC8Nooj7bozWrLKoEWH9DLG2ogVpYdA2m37W8SwsE5b3RM1rRc.gif)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
#### INGREDIENTES: > INGREDIENTS:
>1/2 taza de harina de trigo, 1/2 taza de avena, 4 manzans pequeñas, 1 cucharada de polvo para hornear, 3 cucharada de azúcar, 2 huevos, 1/2 taza de leche, canela al gusto, pizca de sal, aceite.\n\n

>1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup rolled oats, 4 small apples, 1 tablespoon baking powder, 3 tablespoons sugar, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup milk, cinnamon to taste, a pinch of salt, oil. *** #### PASO A PASO: > STEP BY STEP:

>El primer paso fué lavar y cortar las manzanas, usé la mitad para usar en la mezcla de panqueques y la otra mitad para caramelizar, añadí las manzanas cortadas en un bol, luego incorporé los ingredientes secos, harina, avena, polvo para hornear, 1 cucharada de azúcar y una pizza de sal.\n\n

>The first step was to wash and slice the apples; I used half for the pancake batter and the other half for caramelizing. I added the sliced apples to a bowl, then mixed in the dry ingredients: flour, oats, baking powder, 1 tablespoon of sugar, and a pinch of salt. ***
>Para el siguiente paso añadí los huevos y la leche, ahora deben mezclar hasta conseguir una mezcla densa, calenté un sartén y añadí un poco de aceite para que no se peguen los panqueques.\n
>Next, I added the eggs and milk, then mixed everything until the batter was thick. I heated a skillet and added a little oil to prevent the pancakes from sticking. ***
>Cociné los panqueques poco a poco, uno a uno, coloqué mezcla y cociné hasta dorar por ambos lados.\n
>I cooked the pancakes a few at a time, one by one, pouring in the batter and cooking them until they were golden brown on both sides. ***

>Como toque final caramelice manzanas, es muy simple, solo es cuestión de colocar en una olla las manzanas cortadas y dos cucharadas de azúcar, cocinen hasta que el azúcar se torne dorada, como un caramelo.\n
>As a finishing touch, caramelize some apples—it’s very simple. Just place the sliced apples and two tablespoons of sugar in a pot and cook until the sugar turns golden brown, like caramel. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EoEobWj1f6uSWQJ6X64AjwjNNTVvgyk2AMjNNs77kNNnA9c7dLyByBNYz2gwMwngED1.jpg

Me encantó el toque especial de la manzana caramelizada porque le aportó más dulzura y una textura muy rica a la preparación. Muchas gracias por llegar hasta aquí y acompañarme una vez más en otra receta para Hive Food. Los invito a dejarme en los comentarios su opinión sobre esta receta y contarme si ustedes también prepararían estos panqueques en casa. ¡Nos seguimos leyendo en una próxima publicación! > And that’s how these delicious apple and oatmeal pancakes turned out, a simple, fluffy, and flavorful snack. I really loved the special touch of the caramelized apples because they added extra sweetness and a wonderful texture to the recipe. Thank you so much for making it this far and for joining me once again in another recipe for Hive Food. I invite you to leave your opinion in the comments and tell me if you would also make these pancakes at home. See you in the next post!

body.title: My Experience at Richard Wagner's Opera Parsifal
body.body: ***To begin, I invite you to watch this short video I edited for you:*** https://youtu.be/_KqVM2KNHyM

> Happy start to the week to everyone reading this! I'm a little tired from all the choir activities we've had this May. After all, we're still celebrating our 20th anniversary, and in fact, the coming week will be just as intense with very long musical days. But today I want to tell you how our week ended, because we did it again, Venezuela! 🔥 This Saturday, May 23rd, we made history in Caracas by performing Richard Wagner's opera Parsifal for the first time ever in my country. As I mentioned in previous posts, we were joined by national artists and international experts in the genre.

> ![IMG_20260523_161450.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23zbPYUnT166advkzfVQGHb9SMXrajaM82xDoZ7gAzDn4Qjd9cYw6CzpTSFbzrTr56nQ8.jpg) ![IMG_20260523_154733.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EoK6isobEXks6XAHTcqc9pVsRvvYvBQGstDKgVoL9aqXjNR6uHytjebzMNb68HdTBrZ.jpg) ***Alongside Icelandic baritone Tómas Tómasson***
This historic concert took place in the Ríos Reyna Hall of the Teresa Carreño Theater, and it was truly a delightful afternoon for me, as I was captivated by the beauty of Wagner's rich harmonies and the history behind the music. Although it wasn't a typical performance with a stage set, but rather an Italian-style presentation, the guest soloists wore top-quality costumes and used the finest props to bring their roles to life. We had it a bit easier this time; we simply accompanied the music from behind the orchestra, waiting for our musical entrance. But you know how it is when there's so much passion; every detail is savored, and it's always great to see the scenes from a different perspective than the audience.

> ![IMG_20260523_164335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wCA6Zye8HXVyY9R3YbzLj5gTZn3hfX5Xug1W2Ua1NSVH78tHSu3ezRgeB4awHVhXh52.jpg) ![IMG_20260523_155230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EoCh6yTkQKpNCBphZAFyuFEgWP7mJ9N7hwavkC1rAT5G2HBXJKyV3AMwG3sY1j2sCPE.jpg) ***Together with German Director Raoul Grüneis***
I arrived very early that afternoon. A colleague and I were responsible for handing out some souvenirs from our choir, so we went backstage and took lots of pictures along the way 🤭 I had already met and exchanged a few words with the special guests: the German conductor Raoul Grüneis, the Danish tenor Magnus Vigilius, and the Icelandic baritone Tómas Tómasson. It was nice to meet them again just before the performance, including the Venezuelan baritone Anderson Piaspam, who is a member of our group. Once again, I didn't run into the Lithuanian soprano Aušrine Stundyte, and I thought she would be the only person I wouldn't be able to approach, even though I admired her up close many times during rehearsals. She's so passionate about her role that I felt incapable of bothering her to say hello. She's like a diamond that must be appreciated from afar; that's how I felt.
![IMG_20260523_165152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EoprsjzDHvd4x1BkyYZNHPH4HFQDj2XcNbYS7mTTpwxaVj37ff7BNTDUEMgujpre7Cf.jpg)

> ![IMG_20260523_182752_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23ujiMZeCbvJ2D7LRphEY5KsybZb2nZWeDrN9dj45sL5eap4wnkhQkdehWbMqMiwgZxKd.jpg) ![IMG_20260523_170025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EoCgiFQexKC9Y8enZ9Cji4jeJmxJRMz5BUbxKrG7uAwucHNAtKPRGdE2xjVvyuRa3Bp.jpg)
As you know, I always enjoy every concert since joining the National Choir, but this one was special for many reasons. In fact, it had been a long time since I'd taken so many photos with the choir, possibly because we're used to singing at home or because we always have performances where we barely have time to breathe between soundcheck, the concert, and the intermissions. The Teresa Carreño Theater has beautiful spaces that truly inspire us; it's noticeably larger, and this time we had international guests and a smaller vocal part. In fact, we didn't sing a single note in the second act of the opera, so we stayed to enjoy refreshments before our next performance, which took about an hour or more between music and intermissions. We were able to catch up, have coffee, and take lots of pictures... Me being me 🤣
![IMG_20260524_175909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23w2h2fGs4kXthGKSVCwjwyYUkBfrYy59GD72jLREfsit9PbzpvDwmRep6KCxmBuDyA8B.jpg) ***I took these photographs at the dress rehearsal on Thursday:***

> ![IMG_20260521_154105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23uFPKYiLjGqUk7GrhQvTkmLccBZcbsG27jWNagveD4fSriv3BVNrnBiCLdWcjARwa3BF.jpg) ![IMG_20260521_152546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23vhqUYvb38qWNkxEpCinkRmd6YpXkih5jeJ9g4pkfLS69Srgc5yK64pBpMgjHHvEeud7.jpg) ![IMG_20260521_165109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23tGZmYVAGKCqRsAFv6YxUqAdWATAWuZrQjyq297w5mopxnwF3ce12CAVdzRcThCjWdAF.jpg)
I even dared to take a photograph from the audience's vantage point just minutes before the performance began. I was so excited and wanted to capture every moment of this opera, as we don't know if we'll ever perform it again. Backstage, I was so happy that I even forgot for a moment that the audience was on the other side, enjoying the orchestra and soloists on stage. During those moments of waiting, I had the pleasure of exchanging a few words with a great Venezuelan actress who was narrating the event. She was the wonderful Marialejandra Martín, one of my mother's favorites back in the days when Venezuelan telenovelas reigned supreme on national television. I immediately shared the photo with my mom, and the biggest surprise was that at the end of the day, already out of my tuxedo and ready to leave, I ran into the Lithuanian soprano Aušrine Stundyte in the parking lot ❤️ and wow, what a beautiful and kind woman! Her talent is as great as her charisma with the public, and it made me very happy, because exchanging a few, really very few words with her because I even forgot my little English 😅 made me feel that in that moment I finally connected with all the wonderful things I experienced this past week.
![IMG_20260523_171527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23tSQ5qCTpmvaLA9KRkoaSwaTCTi48epRXzL4aW3BY8dpmCeTdxPcksn5cyACwDXBKduh.jpg)

> ![IMG_20260523_212025.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23tvkamaizHjh7LzYuRkc7947ttMJc5RBpTH9rHBZBot1eZkPgpg1DaeVBsr1o5HKW27A.png) ***Lithuanian Soprano Aušrine Stundyte*** ![IMG-20260523-WA0185.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23tGc18erxb7m8kLmD8ZV5LaafAi5zMk18ifUR6bdSzT9GtuQerp4eQdURSuK6KBhBivT.jpg) ***National Choir and Simon Bolivar Symphony Orchestra of Venezuela***
I have nothing left to do but say goodbye to this account of the joy I felt on Saturday being part of such a special musical project. You can find a lot of content about it, especially on the social media accounts of the Venezuelan System of Youth and Children's Orchestras and Choirs and on our personal Instagram account, @lacoral_sb. You can also find videos and photos of this historic performance on the Teresa Carreño Theater's social media. Thank you so much for being here and reading about my adventures. I truly write them with the same passion with which I experience them, and I love writing everything down here on my Hive blog more and more each time. Yes, I'm a little tired today; there's been a lot going on, and there's definitely much more to come. But there are also other details I didn't mention here: one of our best friends had a birthday, so we went out to party even though our feet couldn't take it anymore 🤣 It was a beautiful Saturday until midnight, but that's a story that needs its own post 🤭
![IMG_20260523_195434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23tGZmQwMcYw6ECusvSUT2E5aMrpaiYodXcCTEqCyxxQgRx96mQbZXfbgKUuGhRi8Nt8S.jpg)

> ![IMG_20260523_210255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23vhww6gC7WC17tgRKymKPNmpixkrZVBFB6k7TWfHQBC1pi5HvTcN2xBeyUMzS4qN2HFL.jpg) ***Together with my wife Jhoxiris*** ![IMG_20260523_155448.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EoChBTN9KC9AiakeGNsDbiZ77LY9Cp628HfZ13CvXohz8KbXgE2EKS5K7pk2kNf4iG3.jpg) ***The Gemini birthday celebrants of the choir*** ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPZZLMA5HHbWuiGW6gH4de2oN8MYt1gswCkdiKB4CXHj1/img_20260523_145816.jpg)

body.title: People Are Technically Inept in This Technical World
body.body:
![WrongScience.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcjqhRCBPJvSBFHUdYAm6a45nhwiABgSLnqfBN79EdGjP/WrongScience.png)

Elon Musky tells the world he is going to make battery powered interstate trucks.  And, they will charge in minutes.  And no one asked what super-suits he would design to hook up that much power.

People ask, when they hear about rolling black outs, why don't they build more power plants?  Not realizing that they are asking for the moon.

Companies like John Deer and many car companies are making it impossible for a person to repair their own vehicle.  And most people believe it is just the price of advancement.  That these things just become more complicated.

Since we do not have technically knowledgeable people, those in power, and their media mouth pieces paint us a picture that is a sham.  We can't even tell a lie from reality  We are often given conflicting statements, and just told that \
. Because we do not comprehend technology, we are bamboozled every day. And the reason you do not understand is a real conspiracy ~~theory~~ fact

></center>
## It breaks just after the warranty expires.

Many people say they believe this, but not really.  However, it is true, because the engineers for that corporation are paid to make it just strong enough to last 5 years, and not longer.  Ford had (maybe still does) an office in Phoenix where they worked on stripping metal from a part until it lasted just long enough.  In this way, Ford would sell more replacement parts. 

And, the sales of replacement parts is where it is at.  The car sales is nothing.  And has often been done at a loss, to get people into the system.

For cheaper goods, like coffee makers, it is made to break down.  There have even been companies that put a part into the conveniently digital \

to where it would stop working after so many uses. To the manufacturer, it would cost a LOT more to make it reparable and you cant sell a little plastic O-ring for enough to make it profitable. I know lots of repair people who know these things, but cannot do anything about it. They tell people all the time just to buy a new one. Because it will cost them more to fix it than them going and buying a new tool at the Homey Despot. It is PLANNED obsolescence. And, garage based manufacturing is coming, and oh, the turns will table! (You can go print that O-ring on your 3D printer, and be back in the coffee making business in no time.)

></center>
## Going Green

Green, as in, money in the bank.  Did you think they meant green as in trees? Or saving the planet?

People believe in windmills.  But, this is only because they are technically illiterate.

The average windmill will not pay the energy back for building it.  It is a net negative.  It loses energy.  But, it loses energy from a cheap, polluting, country and provides \

electricity in a rich country.  Planet wide, we are wasting energy.

Solar panels are not much better, but at least once built, they can provide remote areas with electricity without much maintenance.

Change any one of these, and an EV is just making things worse.

body.title: How my Sunday went…🙂
body.body:
by isalifestyle on Girly Isabella 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/girlyisabella [![How my Sunday went…🙂](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/88bfc19e-75ad-48df-ad26-6ef3ac1c04e5.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/cvsoo5vMXDLwkWQLF2gWUW) 
 
 Today was Sunday, and it started a bit slow for me. I woke up at 7am, but my body still felt heavy and sleepy, so I decided to sleep a little more. When I finally woke up again, it was already 9:01. Church service was supposed to start at 9am, so I had to move fast. I washed up, got dressed quickly, and left the house by 9:25. I still made it to church, and the service was good. We sang, prayed, and listened to the sermon, and everything ended around 11:30.

When I got home, I felt tired again, so I just rested. I didn’t do much until about 3pm. After resting, I went to the student market to get some things for food. I made pepper soup with cow skin and ate it with white rice. It was simple food, but it was hot and filling, so I didn’t need anything else for the rest of the day. After eating, I just relaxed for a while and took it easy.

Later in the evening, I decided to go to my friend’s place to play PlayStation and pass time. But when I got there, they were already in the middle of a tournament with other people. I had to sit and wait for about 30 minutes, but they were still not done, so I didn’t want to waste more time. I said goodbye and went back home. That was how my Sunday went – a late start, church, rest, food, and a short trip out that didn’t really happen. It was a calm day overall.
Thanks for visiting  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/cvsoo5vMXDLwkWQLF2gWUW)

body.title: Газонокосарка як національний вид спорту: записки українця в Ірландії
body.body:
>В Ірландії є три речі, які гарантовано стануться:
дощ,
вітер
і сусід, який косить траву.

Серйозно, іноді здається, що стрижка газону тут — не домашня справа, а національний вид спорту. Тільки-но виглянуло сонце — по всій країні одночасно заводяться газонокосарки. Ірландці вилітають у двір так швидко, ніби їм прийшло екстрене повідомлення: «Трава піднялась на 2 міліметри. Час діяти». І це не перебільшення. Через постійні дощі й м’який клімат трава тут росте як на дріжджах. Влітку її можуть косити раз на тиждень, а деякі — навіть двічі. Якщо пропустиш пару тижнів — твій газон уже виглядає як маленький національний парк. Але справа не тільки в траві. Для багатьох ірландців ідеальний газон — це питання честі. Це як: — для італійців кава, — для французів багет, — для українців сперечатись про погоду, — для ірландців — рівна зелена трава без жодного бур’яну. Тут можна побачити дідуся, який під дощем у куртці й шортах косить газон із виразом людини, що рятує державу. А ще помітили таке- коли один сусід починає косити — через 10 хвилин прокидається вся вулиця? Це працює як сигнал тривоги, тільки по-ірландськи. Ти можеш не знати імен своїх сусідів. Але ти точно знаєш звук їхньої газонокосарки.
