body.title: Nos Urge Hablar de la Esperanza: ¿Cómo la Cuidas y Alimentas? -Esta es La Iniciativa No. 24 en Domingo de Séptimo Día- (ES/EN)
body.body:
<center>![español jesus_is_our_only_hope-ai-generated-8657664_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/EqhRBmYvXC4n292qCAsbWTVo4Ed1Mit8nyukyPGy559AokoEssjHvqrkxMs4NzW1Vce.jpg)</center>

> *<center>[Pixabay-JESUS_is_our_only_HOPE; editada en Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-felicitar-adoraci%C3%B3n-8657664/)</center>*

###### <center>***En Séptimo Día** no todo el tiempo generamos iniciativas; sin embargo, cada tema de cada publicación que se ha propuesto desde aquí se ha transformado en una especie de multiplicador de diferentes observaciones, experiencias y herramientas que nos ofrecen cada uno de los usuarios y lectores que nos acompañan.*</center>

###### <center>*Esta vez necesitamos hablar con urgencia de algo que yo siento que en estos momentos está motivando a muchas poblaciones, en muchos países, gracias a los grandes cambios que se están dando, de alguna u otra manera, para salir de desequilibrios y de dificultades. Este es el caso, por ejemplo, de Venezuela, donde el entorno político, económico y social está dando un vuelco que predice posibles beneficios para toda la nación en un futuro, y es **la esperanza.***</center>

###### <center>*Sí, lo que se mueve detrás de Venezuela es **[la esperanza](https://filco.es/concepto-de-esperanza/)**; y esto es lo único que yo leo entre críticas, análisis, noticias buenas y algunas no tan buenas. Ella parece ser la protagonista en este momento aquí y en muchas partes, donde se descubren situaciones que deben ajustarse hacia el equilibrio y hacia la justicia.*</center>

###### <center>***Hoy te propongo, desde tu vida, que nos ayudes a vislumbrar la importancia que tiene para nosotros la esperanza y cómo mantenerla viva, fortalecida como una luz que guíe nuestro norte.***</center>

<center>![creativecanvasshop-paper-airplane-10179358_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23zbaC3kimhQZZXREEeCUcYGkW3GeGwtdrL58pLL6y1QM8RvEsCtzrE3rdeSoPSkinJTz.png)</center>
> *<center>[Pixabay-CreativeCanvasShop](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/avi%C3%B3n-de-papel-lanzamiento-de-mano-10179358/)</center>*

<div class=\

> ###
Eso que llamamos esperanza...
*Es un estado de ánimo positivo, optimista, agradecido, expectante hacia lo posible; es una actitud mental, una manera confiada en que avanzamos hacia un resultado mejor y favorable, y que el futuro se vislumbra positivo, incluso en medio de la adversidad.* No sé si este concepto está adaptado a las definiciones que conseguimos en libros y en la red, pero la esperanza no es una ilusión, es una fuerza que da sentido a la vida, una gran fuerza emocional. Y es lo que yo veo detrás de nuestro país, en medio del quiebre y de la sinceración de situaciones sin miedos y actualmente muy explicadas en los diferentes medios de comunicación. ***[La esperanza](https://showme.missouri.edu/2025/hope-is-the-key-to-a-meaningful-life-according-to-new-research/)** se ha erguido como la abanderada de este proceso.* El venezolano es resiliente, ha tenido que huir, ha tenido que mantenerse en silencio, rezagado y con miedo ante el entorno difícil y amenazante... Pero siento que con este proceso ha renacido en la esperanza, no en la rabia, no en el deseo de venganza, no en el perder tiempo reviviendo los aspectos terribles que ha tenido que vivir, entre esos el hambre y la falta de futuro de toda una población profesional y juvenil. Es la **esperanza** la que nos está haciendo sentir que es posible volver a plantearnos metas, motivarnos y ser expectantes de que pronto vamos a tener un país recuperado para construirlo, reconstruirlo y esperar de él lo mejor.
![geralt-ai-generated-8605712_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23wr3h8xt539xVebrd33rdGVDWZ5JhL6nhrU9D7PmkBQVnXzfYfJpkTLw7r3dSMg92HjR.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Geralt](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-gente-salto-felicidad-8605712/)
* ###
¿Por qué me motiva esto?
*Sin ella, en realidad, la motivación no existiría.* Con ella se pierde la posibilidad de rendirse y nos posibilita acciones humanas como colectivo; de allí que cuando tenemos crisis de esperanza, se vive en forma automática, a oscuras, como le ha sucedido a Venezuela, y se instalan depresiones, tristezas, ansiedades y no hay progreso. *No, no es ser fantasioso, es que la esperanza favorece un estado mental positivo que cataliza hasta la inmunidad en el cuerpo.* Y como decimos en nuestras clases de instituto y de seminario: *Junto al trigo crece la cizaña*; pues la vida no es siempre positiva, la vida es equilibrio y nos obliga a enfrentarnos a contratiempos de vez en cuando. También aprendemos a valorar más lo positivo y a cambiar nuestra mentalidad para adecuar nuestro presente hacia lo posible y afrontar obstáculos con mentalidad creativa, abierta, alejada de la estupidez. **[Estar esperanzado](https://www.amahahealth.com/blog/cultivating-hope-in-our-lives/)** mejora nuestra salud física, mental y espiritual; ayuda a gestionar la ansiedad, la vulnerabilidad, las dificultades. Afrontar crisis, combatir pensamientos negativos y abrir límites para capturar otras perspectivas. Cuando se instala, esperamos con más tranquilidad y el peso es menor. Y al final nos permite trabajar, por lo que nos hace ser más productivos, y los logros se alcanzan con mayor certeza. ***¿Ves por qué es necesario cuidarla, cultivarla, entenderla y hacerla crecer; más aún en este momento, en el que ella se erige como motor de nuestra existencia?***
![52hertz-late-1431713_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/241tbUzC8fj1ThYwhR28FCV8LRcZsXKr9H9pD84fG1eJxbFuQuHpN9AWdRdBSgUNZHYKN.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-52Hertz](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/tarde-figura-ni%C3%B1o-chico-1431713/)
* ###
Iniciativa 24 de Séptimo Día: ¡Regálame tu esperanza!
*Esta iniciativa va de la mano con **[la maravillosa iniciativa](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/quien-dijo-que-la-solidaridad-se-ha-perdidoororwho-said-solidarity-is-lost)** planteada por @damarysvibra en la que hablamos sobre **la solidaridad**; porque esta no se ha perdido y en medio de la esperanza, la solidaridad se levanta también como parte del crecimiento de toda la humanidad.* En esta iniciativa de **Séptimo Día**, no vamos a probar dinámicas, vamos a abrazar la confidencialidad, la hermandad y la solidaridad. *Vamos a compartir estas premisas:*
**¿Qué es la esperanza para mí en este momento y cómo ha sido siempre? ¿Como la nutro, cómo la cuido, cómo la mantengo vigente? ¿En qué siento yo, que me beneficia?**
Esta es una iniciativa sencilla, nace de pocas palabras, pero de una sensación de posibilidad que viene del crecimiento, y que va a ayudarte a meditar sobre tus vivencias. ¡El asunto es que no perdamos en estos momentos la gran oportunidad que tenemos de alimentar este sentimiento de poder que nos está acompañando!
*Te pedimos que nos regales una publicación sobre la esperanza, que nos dejes en los comentarios el link de invitación a tu publicación; y que te unas a este movimiento de mantener en alto la capacidad de creer que todo es posible hacia el bien.*
***¡Porque nos hace falta!***
![linea .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3nb9vTVZpveXNPJDkaZkCw3jJwQvXSupzLhUmL5VbMw8qtcND1L14H5dkhTwvpUfL.png)
###
Reconocimiento a iniciativa 23 de séptimo día la invisibilidad de la mujer
Quisiera con estas cortas palabras agradecer a todos aquellos que participaron en la **[Iniciativa 23 de Séptimo Día sobre la invisibilidad de la mujer.](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/desaparecen-las-mujeres-de-mas-de-50-anos-un-sindrome-de-invisibilidad-iniciativa-no-23-de-septimo-dia-esen)** Agradecer profundamente a aquellos que nos dieron y contrarrestaron el tema; donde se evidenció que nuestras mujeres, lejos de la invisibilidad, hoy en día se encuentran ocupando sitios estratégicos y representando la inteligencia del ser humano con gallardía, entereza y positividad. Especialmente a @brujita18 @amymari y @aplausos por sus propuestas en esta iniciativa; a quienes agradezco simbólicamente con estos puntos @Ecency y apoyado por nuestro amigo @sorprendente
![linea .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3nb9vTVZpveXNPJDkaZkCw3jJwQvXSupzLhUmL5VbMw8qtcND1L14H5dkhTwvpUfL.png)
![Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23t8D6NyczxKPjU169Xc4a4HYoGyf5ytmDFHNGTt8bsTQFPWuUMevNWpj3LSmYQyBib1d.png)
![linea .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3nb9vTVZpveXNPJDkaZkCw3jJwQvXSupzLhUmL5VbMw8qtcND1L14H5dkhTwvpUfL.png)
![english .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/Eo4CYFaBzyGwsHQp4PAPLTSPFSxR7XqUTovKQEx9386amjk33WRyd7BYCE4kSfVy1vu.png)
#
We Need to Talk About Hope: How Do You Nurture and Cultivate It? -This Is Initiative No. 24 on Seventh Day Sunday-
![jesus_is_our_only_hope-ai-generated-8657664_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/EnWKPvKs4Fd5L8d4RdFyRnmPWRAjj7gk7XpdKmWB7yheveXW3HBkxTjUuakJgCX22gM.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-JESUS_is_our_only_HOPE; edited in Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-felicitar-adoraci%C3%B3n-8657664/)
* ######
*At **Seventh Day**, we don’t launch initiatives all the time; however, every topic in every post we’ve published here has become a kind of catalyst for the various insights, experiences, and tools shared by each of our users and readers.*
######
*This time, we urgently need to discuss something that I feel is currently motivating many communities in many countries, thanks to the major changes taking place—in one way or another—to overcome imbalances and difficulties. This is the case, for example, in Venezuela, where the political, economic, and social landscape is undergoing a transformation that holds the promise of future benefits for the entire nation, and that is hope.*
######
*Yes, what is driving Venezuela is **[hope](https://filco.es/concepto-de-esperanza/)**; and this is the only thing I see amid the criticism, analysis, good news, and some not-so-good news. Hope seems to be the central figure right now here and in many places, where situations are being uncovered that must be adjusted toward balance and justice.*
######
***Today I invite you, from your own life, to help us glimpse the importance of hope for us and how to keep it alive, strengthened like a light that guides our way.***
![creativecanvasshop-paper-airplane-10179358_1920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23zbaC3kimhQZZXREEeCUcYGkW3GeGwtdrL58pLL6y1QM8RvEsCtzrE3rdeSoPSkinJTz.png)
> *
[Pixabay-CreativeCanvasShop](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/avi%C3%B3n-de-papel-lanzamiento-de-mano-10179358/)
*

> ###
What we call hope...
*It is a positive, optimistic, grateful, and expectant state of mind toward what is possible; it is a mental attitude, a confident way of moving toward a better and favorable outcome, and a belief that the future looks bright, even in the midst of adversity.* I don’t know if this concept aligns with the definitions we find in books and online, but hope is not an illusion; it is a force that gives meaning to life, a powerful emotional force. And that is what I see behind our country, amidst the breakdown and the honest acknowledgment of situations—without fear—that are currently being thoroughly covered in the various media outlets. ***[Hope](https://showme.missouri.edu/2025/hope-is-the-key-to-a-meaningful-life-according-to-new-research/)** has emerged as the standard-bearer of this process.* Venezuelans are resilient; they have had to flee, they have had to remain silent, left behind, and fearful in the face of a difficult and threatening environment... But I feel that through this process, hope has been reborn—not in anger, not in the desire for revenge, not in wasting time reliving the terrible experiences they have had to endure, including hunger and the lack of a future for an entire generation of professionals and young people. It is **hope** that is making us feel that it is possible to set goals for ourselves again, to motivate ourselves, and to look forward to the day when we will have a recovered country to build, rebuild, and expect the best from.
![geralt-ai-generated-8605712_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23wr3h8xt539xVebrd33rdGVDWZ5JhL6nhrU9D7PmkBQVnXzfYfJpkTLw7r3dSMg92HjR.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Geralt](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-gente-salto-felicidad-8605712/)
* ###
Why does this motivate me?
*Without it, motivation wouldn’t really exist.* Without it, we lose the ability to give up, and it enables us to act as a collective; that’s why, when we face a crisis of hope, we automatically live in the dark—as has happened in Venezuela—and depression, sadness, and anxiety take hold, and there is no progress. *No, it’s not about being fanciful; it’s that hope fosters a positive mental state that even boosts the body’s immunity.* And as we say in our high school and seminar classes: *Weeds grow alongside the wheat*; for life isn’t always positive—life is about balance and forces us to face setbacks from time to time. We also learn to value the positive more and to shift our mindset to align our present with what is possible, facing obstacles with a creative, open mindset, far removed from foolishness. **[Having hope](https://www.amahahealth.com/blog/cultivating-hope-in-our-lives/)** improves our physical, mental, and spiritual health; it helps us manage anxiety, vulnerability, and difficulties. It helps us face crises, combat negative thoughts, and expand our horizons to embrace new perspectives. When it takes hold, we wait with greater peace of mind, and the burden feels lighter. And ultimately, it allows us to work, making us more productive, and enabling us to achieve our goals with greater certainty. ***Do you see why it is necessary to nurture it, cultivate it, understand it, and help it grow—especially now, when it stands as the driving force of our existence?***
![52hertz-late-1431713_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/241tbUzC8fj1ThYwhR28FCV8LRcZsXKr9H9pD84fG1eJxbFuQuHpN9AWdRdBSgUNZHYKN.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-52Hertz](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/tarde-figura-ni%C3%B1o-chico-1431713/)
* ###
Seventh Day Initiative #24: Give Me Your Hope!
*This initiative goes hand in hand with **[the wonderful initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/quien-dijo-que-la-solidaridad-se-ha-perdidoororwho-said-solidarity-is-lost)** proposed by @damarysvibra, in which we talk about **solidarity**; because solidarity has not been lost, and amid hope, solidarity also rises as part of the growth of all humanity.* In this **Seventh Day** initiative, we won’t be trying out new activities; instead, we’ll embrace confidentiality, sisterhood, and solidarity. *Let’s share these questions:*
***What does hope mean to me right now, and what has it always been like? How do I nurture it, how do I care for it, how do I keep it alive? In what ways do I feel it, and how does it benefit me?***
This is a simple initiative, born of few words, but of a sense of possibility that comes from growth, and that will help you reflect on your experiences. The point is that we must not miss this great opportunity we have right now to nurture this feeling of power that is with us!
*We ask that you share a post about hope with us, leave the link to your post in the comments, and join this movement to keep alive the belief that anything is possible for the greater good.*
***Because we need it!***
![linea .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3nb9vTVZpveXNPJDkaZkCw3jJwQvXSupzLhUmL5VbMw8qtcND1L14H5dkhTwvpUfL.png)
###
Recognition of the 23rd Seventh Day Initiative on Women’s Invisibility
I would like to take this brief opportunity to thank everyone who participated in the **[23rd Day Initiative on the invisibility of women.](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/desaparecen-las-mujeres-de-mas-de-50-anos-un-sindrome-de-invisibilidad-iniciativa-no-23-de-septimo-dia-esen)** I am deeply grateful to those who brought this issue to light and challenged the status quo; it became clear that our women, far from being invisible, are today occupying strategic positions and representing human intelligence with grace, fortitude, and positivity. Special thanks to @brujita18, @amymari, and @aplausos for their contributions to this initiative; to whom I symbolically express my gratitude with these points @Ecency and supported by our friend @sorprendente

body.body:
by Khing Addy on Adrians Lifestyle 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/adrianslifestyle [![Legend on efootball league🙂💔](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/520920a2-93da-48d3-864c-e05897ddaf58.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/p4mWkEppWSSJjZd41heJ5A) 
 
 I played a league game today and it was tough. My squad is only 2600 rated, but I was up against a team with 3100 rating. I picked a Legend level league on purpose though, because I want to push myself and get better. Playing against stronger teams is the only way to make my hands faster and my decisions sharper.

The match itself went rough from the start. In the first 3 minutes they just sat back and defended deep. It was hard to even get a shot off in that time. As soon as those 3 minutes passed, they switched and started pressing me hard. If you’re not focused in that moment, they’ll punish you fast. Before I could settle down, they had already scored 2 goals.

Once the game balanced out a bit, it became a fight to either pull one back or stop them from adding more. It really depends on how well you handle the pressure. If you calm down and play simple, you can create chances. If you panic, they’ll score again and it just gets harder.

For me, I didn’t figure out how to break through their defense quickly enough. By the time I started understanding their pattern, they were already 3 goals up 💔. After that, I was just trying to hold on and get at least one goal back, but the pressure didn’t let up much.

So yeah, that was the match. Lots of pressure from the first minute, and I learned the hard way that you can’t relax for even a second in Legend league. It was frustrating, but I guess that’s why I’m playing it – to get used to this kind of pace and get better.
Thanks for visiting  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/p4mWkEppWSSJjZd41heJ5A)

body.title: Coming Back to the Mayor's Office for the 2nd Time: Claiming my PSA Birth Certificate and Buying Ingredients for the  Binignit
body.body:
*Since our Mayor wasn't there last time, I had to come back the other day to submit my letter of request for my oath-taking expenses*. 

![IMG_20260523_202526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/242s64eyXKqXxWqbzHczJ1P9vupRvSRB3xvAbX8v6vu5fHTmLcJH6DN7zos1moh67TGj5.jpg)

I was told by the staff to come back the other day after lunch. I head out early that day, around 9 AM, so I could claim my PSA Birth Certificate and ask about the errors in it. I arrived at 11:43 AM and I wasn't sure if the Local Registry Office would still entertain me since it was almost lunch time. 

I saw a woman asking about her papers, and it went quickly. I asked if I could claim my own PSA Birth Certificate even though I wasn't the one who processed it. It was fine, since they have a record book for people who claim the papers. 

After I received the papers, I checked for errors. My mother's name was misspelled. I asked how to correct it, and she told me to wait while she wrote down the requirements. It looks like it's going to be a hassle. 

I waited for quite a while because an older lady and her son were asking about something and there transaction took a long time. I stayed patient and calm while waiting, since the Mayor's Office wasn't open yet. 

After what felt like 1 million years,lol, it was finally my turn. She wrote down all the requirements. There are a lot, and the fee is ₱1,000. This will probably worry my parents. 

I finished my transaction and waited for the Mayor's arrival. It felt like forever but he arrived at 2 PM. I thought they would start assisting people right away, but we waited for almost another hour. 

Finally, I finished around 3 PM. The wait was worthwhile. I was given assistance,and the Secretary will process the paperwork, so I'll wait for her message. 

![IMG_20260523_203137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/2432Q41RKinTfxJQUPxYoEae7ifNA3rQrVSdE5operpajUa5NtrpUbnSZHMewbRfBi9L1.jpg)
> *This is the Pontevedra gymnasium*. 

Events, gatherings, meetings, symposiums, and other occasions especially those concerning the municipality, take place here. It's a huge, spacious and comfortable place for large groups of people. 


![1000097043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EqQNd3TTGpkQaRGxrZG47So8JgSo4hP9Kq9NqFeMWbMYU7jWoZjqQM3JkbtiKFYZTuH.jpg)
I crossed the road and passed by the Saint Michael's Church. 

![1000097044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/Eq3665xAg2RdyPCMnjw2fbqCyLwL7Zy6nW7aLCRVzJM87uv7ip5whX4hsKj3mAuLAYN.jpg)
I stopped and looked back, taking a photo of a place I rarely visited, even in the past. I was thankful-wish granted. May the people who serve the public be given a good hearts to help, especially the poor. 

![IMG_20260523_203657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/23xVVYKv4uBVYJWwcQNb9v8qsfyraNGeQP7TDpQQgxoKxkSqke3raZVdSoatP67YsXHHf.jpg)
> *While waiting for the motorcycle to go home, I saw a baby girl who I  guess was with her aunt. I bought softdrinks and bread from merci. The baby kept looking at and reaching the softdrinks, so I gave her the bread instead, since the softdrink aren't good for her*. 

My last stop before going home was to buy ingredients for my Binignit. 

First, I bought Malagkit Rice and took it to the milling place to have it ground into powder.  

Then, I looked around and found camote, sagu, ube powder, and items for our mini store including sugar for the *Binignit*. I almost forgot to buy bananas. 

![IMG_20260523_204009.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/245TLHG74iC4dRRhvCq23RzcgTsFzxMHtSXQ8V8CJKYmpL6mE7PB8DpMR9iyn53oyU3U4.jpg)

At laaaasssssttt! I was heading home around 5 PM, tired, exhausted, and almost out of breath. The road was truly a disaster, so I decided to take a short break before starting to walk again. 

That ends my blog! Thanks for reading. Love lots!😘


--emmin◉⁠‿⁠◉msss

Український Форум Громадянського Суспільства передав уряду збалансований план із чотирьох пунктів, який може допомогти запобігти гуманітарній кризі для тисяч українських сімей:

1.  Не скасовувати виплату за проживання (Accommodation Recognition Payment), яка забезпечила безпечне житло для понад 40 000 українських біженців. Так, варто переглянути її механізм і усунути зловживання — але не ліквідувати.
    
2.  Зберегти державне житло для 18 000 осіб, які за своїх обставин не мають іншого варіанту.
    
3.  Розробити дворічний план поступового переходу до самостійного проживання.
    
4.  Створити імміграційний статус після завершення дії Тимчасового захисту — щоб люди не опинилися в правовому вакуумі.

body.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - So Productive
body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - So Productive . Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQX3ovc8tLVEU7cpx-cSDDWUupA2mWY_NiCn9qQXYraMg&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQX3ovc8tLVEU7cpx-cSDDWUupA2mWY_NiCn9qQXYraMg&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQX3ovc8tLVEU7cpx-cSDDWUupA2mWY_NiCn9qQXYraMg&s=10)

Being productive at work is what we are being expected to be at work, but usually we will not want to be so productive at work, as we all know that more tasks will land on our plate if we are too productive and clears them too fast. 

Productivity formula directly represent the above with Productivity = Total Output /Total Input.  So mathematically we know that with a larger numerator and a smaller denominator, we would get a bigger answer. 

Although the world is driven by maths, but we know the above formula works for the very experience. Sine they might have know the way to get certain things done by heart, thus they have a lower input. A newbie will need some room for error and thus time taken to complete a task would be longer. 

Lastly, I believe a large number of us working to put food on the table and to afford some luxury in life. And people will compare, if one feels that they are busier than the others in the team , they would not want to be so productive. The one to be so productive yet no complaints would be automated robots who just follow coded instructions and setup.

body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779660480566-9d734eaad58a8be8.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/8fdca022)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/8fdca022)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

Carrera ONE RUN

Hola, buenas tardes. Espero se encuentren muy bien. Vengo por acá para contarles sobre mi participación en la carrera One Run.


Ayer se realizó esta carrera en Los Próceres. Fue la segunda edición de esta carrera en Venezuela. Estuvo bien organizada, con bastante seguridad. Las salidas fueron puntuales. Llegué supertemprano, así que estacionar fue fácil.


El año pasado no participé porque realmente no me llamó la atención. Me arrepentí de no haberlo hecho, por eso este año no dejé pasar la oportunidad. Quería cruzar esa meta, entre los monolitos, sobre esa alfombra azul. Fue toda una experiencia. Me gustó mucho esta carrera, estuvo llena de alegría y buena vibra.


La ruta es excelente, se le puede sacar provecho. Es relativamente plana, buena para los que están iniciando y para los que quieren mejorar sus tiempos. En mi caso, mejoré mi tiempo. Participé en la distancia de 10 kilómetros, donde mi mejor tiempo era 52:69. Ayer hice 51:38, con un ritmo promedio de 5:10 por kilómetro. Quizás pudo ser mejor; sin embargo, estoy satisfecho con el tiempo que logré.


A veces me limito. Ayer me di cuenta de que, en los últimos kilómetros, no lo doy todo por miedo a quedarme sin energía antes de la meta. Voy a trabajar en esa limitante para bajar aún más mi tiempo. Este año quiero bajar considerablemente mi tiempo en la Caracas Rock. Continuaré entrenando para conseguir esta meta.


En conclusión, fue una excelente carrera, con nuevo PR. La próxima me irá mejor.

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@albertojtf/carrera-one-run)

body.title: Visual Mess | Macro Photography Session - Technical Description
body.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23tmBcjyJjKjnG3Z15Amkgh5sLViz44dZMfcF7EhxuJhoFeUVSoHEniWKmSNYxieLFf8A.jpg)

##### Hi everyone :)

Take a good look at the visual mess I encountered in this session.
I don't dislike it, but I found it a bit confusing, especially when I looked at the set of photos and realized that everything looked kind of similar, dark, and abstract.

But when we look more closely, focusing on each of the results, the scenario transforms and we discover those always curious and mysterious details.

---

##### Session Purpose

In these sessions of macro photography, or objective, in order to spend a good amount of time reflecting on oneself, and go as long as possible in no detail, within the limits of the technique that is to be used, of course, sometimes it is difficult to obtain the result that is initially intended, it is better to always make the effort. What interests me is to look carefully, really stop in front of the chosen object and record everything that it reveals, opting for different angles and perspectives, recording the textures, the small irregularities, different contrasts and those small marks that normally go unnoticed. There is also a very visual side to this process, because I don't just want to document, I want to build interesting visual compositions. When I publish this work on my blog, I intend to share this experience of close observation and show the discreet beauty and complexity that exists, many times in the most banal objects, others not so much.

##### Let me present today’s model:


![IMG_4158.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23tkp96MmupYu1eETHzANbqmgeLZHMtgEpk57UfxcoMghtuVeyugTE9XaF3DYe78raxTi.jpg)

<center><sub>F-stop: F/4 | Exposure time: 1/250 sec. | ISO speed: ISO 400</sub></center>

![IMG_4156.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23uEym28dDFoHTXbhqNoNZtZxFyXDp5RtvqDovdiYbFQsTwFneFswFnBk3ZSFe3zRsWmy.jpg)
<center><sub>F-stop: F/5 | Exposure time: 1/200 sec. | ISO speed: ISO 400</sub></center>

---

There are not several ways to shoot macro photography, but among the possible ways, this is, for me, one of the most simple and mainly the most accessible and very effective, especially for having a camera with objective movement. By removing the lens and inverting it, it is possible to get closer very close and reveal details that normally go unnoticed. With the help of an inverter, the process becomes practical, although it becomes a little instável and difficult to control. What most attracted me to this method is the relationship between the simplicity of the method and the minimally decent result I tend to have with the minimum resources, once it achieves a surprising extension and a new way of working for all types of objects, no matter how common it may seem.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://img.esteem.ws/qpm6pm12ej.gif

##### Used equipment & Camera Settings

For these images I used a Canon EOS 600D, a DSLR with a CMOS sensor that gives me a good response to detail and a fairly balanced reading of texture and color.
Worked with an EFS 18–55 mm objective, taking advantage of its versatility and reduced depth of field to isolate small areas of the surface and highlight very specific details. I also reviewed an inverter panel, essential in this process, for allowing the lens to be transformed into a simple and effective macro solution, as it has the opportunity to display the GIFs that part of this article.
Do not use a tripod.
The lighting was made with adjustable LED lights, designed to distribute light softly, control harsh shadows and enhance the structure of the subject.

Focus Mode: Manual focus to ensure precision in specific details of the structure.
Aperture: f/5 for adequate depth of field, ensuring all important details are in focus.
ISO: Low ISO setting (400) to minimize noise in images.
Shutter Speed: Adjust shutter speed as needed to avoid underexposure, while maintaining a value that allows you to capture sharp details.

---

To finish, i leave you with some considerations regarding these photo sessions:

> Observing all these pieces through macro photography reveals a fascinating dimension and breadth, full of minute details that ultimately assume significant importance in the visual composition. The complexity of these objects, when viewed from this perspective, takes on a beauty that is often overlooked by the indifference of the eye. The essence of macro photography lies in its ability to elevate ordinary objects to extraordinary levels, offering an intimate and captivating perspective.

The session is closed for today.
Hope you like it :)

<center>Thanks for following me and support my work!</center>

See you soon

body.body:
![jon-tyson-QL0FAxaq2z0-unsplash.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX2TWFsBhVQY36WA26W5Z2micknqn7bfVmnDi8a1hLY71/jon-tyson-QL0FAxaq2z0-unsplash.jpg)[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/red-brick-wall-with-live-work-create-quote-QL0FAxaq2z0?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditShareLink)





Productivity is not an option for me, it is a necessity.
As a person, you should be productive.
It is a sign you are making progress.
It might not be in a big way.
People make mistake by thinking until you take a big bold step before you can identify yourself as a person making progress, but not so.
The little steps every now and then is a sign of progress, and when done with diligence, you will be productive.
Being productive is the major aim of the work or anything you do.
Without productivity, you will be questioned.
Your work will be questioned, because people will not believe you are actually working. There will be nothing to show for it.
But when you are productive, you don't need to explain to anyone, they will understand once they see your productivity.

body.title: Falling, Learning, and Rising Stronger
body.body:
Failure is one thing many people around the world despite and don't wish to experience in any aspect of their lives, as they believe it's bad and not good for them and their life journey. But is that really the case? Is failure indeed all shades of bad and one thing we must run away from because of wanting to always win? In my own personal opinion, I believe failure is part of our life journey and an integral part for that matter; it gives us lots of benefits that shape our lives in the right direction on the condition that we handle it well. ![1000315616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/EowK1kweekdSxXimfYoDnKiCwkHoohHTyDbac4FKqumyp9phkmPvwu9VV2pTfDcx3KD.jpg) Take for instance when you fail, you've gained valuable experience about that particular thing you failed in, and you can take that experience as a lesson that guides your decision the next time you want to walk the same path. Like I said earlier, how we handle failure is what will determine how I'll live and that situation will turn out to be. Someone who sees failure as the end of the world and opts to stop trying will definitely experience stagnation or drawbacks, but the person who learns from the previous experience and goes on to use that to guide their future decisions will thrive because they've learned a lesson from failure and build their resilience to face future challenges. Failure is an opportunity to learn, an opportunity to pause, take a break, think and retract our steps towards refining our lives towards the path where we desire. Even though failure isn't palatable, we must understand that it's not the end of the world; a lot of people who invented great innovative devices failed multiple times, and it's the desire to keep trying despite failing that helped them achieve their goals, we ourselves must learn from that and not give in to failure. ![1000315605.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23zkzxMfAEdV5nctYxczUUo1PZ6spdxxp411XjV2yV4ZwZJp82MU5LiMvWE1dqkGELkrk.jpg) Arsenal Football Club winning the Premier League is a typical example of never giving up despite failing. We've seen their team fail three consecutive times, but that didn't deter them from trying over and over again. Now look where it gets them; they're the champions of the league, silencing all their haters and putting a smile on the faces of their family. After twenty-two years of failure, they finally lifted the EPL. Are you dealing with failure in any aspects of your life? Don't give up; keep trying. Your day will soon come, and you'll rejoice. *** All photos are mine. ***
.

links.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYgA5mQfhpctAkV9kojarAeioBsZ6CHp9ZR5rNeZjWcus/1779638506400.png)</center>
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDhAKq9Fcx9tv8YXqxNZ65dPM5guB7jgg9uix81ruwR4/img_0.8604541199520033.jpg)</center>

Hola queridos amigos de Hive y de esta hermosa comunidad de DIYHub, espero que estén bien y que hayan tenido un gran día. El día de hoy les quiero compartir cómo he hecho este nuevo y sencillo anillo de mostacillas con rosas doradas que me ha fascinado por su delicadeza y por su significado. Otra de las cosas que me gusta de esta pieza es que es muy fácil de hacer, ya que los pasos son muy sencillos de seguir y uno se tarda muy poco en terminarla; solo hay que repetir el patrón de cruce varias veces para rodear la medida del dedo. Debo decir que es un accesorio ideal para cualquier ocasión, fácil de combinar con nuestra vestimenta diaria y con una carga emocional hermosa. Para mí este anillo cuenta una historia bonita y especial que llevamos en el corazón. El rojo en las mostacillas es pura energía, amor profundo y esa fuerza vital que mantiene vivo un sentimiento sin importar el tiempo ni la distancia. Luego el blanco, que se entrelaza a la perfección aportando luz, una paz inmensa y esa confianza pura y leal que sirve de refugio en los días grises. Y el toque final, que son esas seis rosas doradas, corona el diseño simbolizando lo valioso, lo eterno y lo sagrado de un vínculo que no se oxida con los años; además, el número seis trae una vibración hermosa de armonía, protección y estabilidad. Al final, cuando ves el anillo completo, te das cuenta de que el contraste del rojo y el blanco, custodiado por el brillo del oro, es el reflejo perfecto de una conexión pura e intensa que te acompaña a donde vayas.

# ***<center>Materiales:</center>***

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTL4MKrgo62eEGSH4EdpLh9c9k41cpMmw6p2uyVQWJcm1/1779638554376.jpg)</center>

♥️ 6 cuentas en forma de rosa de color dorado 
♥️ Mostacillas de color blanco 
♥️ Mostacillas de color rojo
♥️ 1 mt de nylon 0,4

# ***<center> Procedimiento </center>***

**<center>🤍 Paso 1</center>**
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT3WUh6bUX9vtS4ZqSKWEffDWTDp9ASbjKsBDmMHe9tqm/1779638582860.jpg)
</center>

En el nylon insertamos una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca, una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca, una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca y una mostacilla roja, añadimos una cuenta en forma de rosa de color dorado, una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca, una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca, una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca, una mostacilla roja y cruzamos los nylon en una nueva cuenta en forma de rosa de color dorado.

**<center>🤍 Paso 2</center>**
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMnHmNzNJSo9a4Hz9ijH8EboYhHxtYJ4NWa55DiTc666/1779638607776.jpg)</center>

En cada nylon añadimos una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca, una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca, una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca y una mostacilla roja, luego cruzamos por una nueva cuenta en forma de rosa de color dorado. Repetimos este paso cuatro veces más.

**<center> 🤍Paso 3</center>**
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmegoC7RJa4oz1VHzp6gEUqYyyeijPeEgNYuh24aV4Ps96/1779638631450.jpg)</center>

En cada nylon añadimos una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca, una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca, una mostacilla roja, una mostacilla blanca y una mostacilla roja

**<center> 🤍 Paso 4</center>**
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamxRHLTMvMSwqGbFjSiBGWmDjVuoGFoWpTb16E15SNZj/1779638651956.jpg)</center>

Cruzamos los nylon en la primera rosa de color dorado que insertamos en el paso 1 y q está en el lado opuesto de la cadena que estamos haciendo, repasamos por segunda vez todas las mostacillas y rosas para dar más estabilidad al anillo, anudamos bien y cortamos el nylon sobrante.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTvFMJpuGB98mTCX7B8XrKybhw3gnMpYVKGyJuK2cajm3/1779638677240.jpg)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP97JnNa7ab7W8qSgKbtbDxfDWZzqvz8pZdCSNVBfJKXF/img_0.724177838502995.jpg)</center>


Hello, dear friends at Hive and in this wonderful DIYHub community! I hope you’re all doing well and had a great day. Today I want to share with you how I made this new and simple beaded ring with gold roses, which has captivated me with its delicacy and meaning. Another thing I love about this piece is that it’s very easy to make—the steps are simple to follow, and it takes very little time to finish; you just have to repeat the crisscross pattern several times to fit the ring around your finger. I must say it’s an ideal accessory for any occasion, easy to pair with our everyday outfits and imbued with a beautiful emotional resonance. For me, this ring tells a beautiful and special story that we carry in our hearts. The red in the beads represents pure energy, deep love, and that vital force that keeps a feeling alive regardless of time or distance. Then there’s the white, which intertwines perfectly, bringing light, immense peace, and that pure, loyal trust that serves as a refuge on gray days. And the finishing touch—those six golden roses—crowns the design, symbolizing the preciousness, eternity, and sacredness of a bond that doesn’t fade with the years; moreover, the number six carries a beautiful vibration of harmony, protection, and stability. In the end, when you see the complete ring, you realize that the contrast of red and white, guarded by the brilliance of gold, is the perfect reflection of a pure and intense connection that accompanies you wherever you go.

# ***<center>Materials:</center>***

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTL4MKrgo62eEGSH4EdpLh9c9k41cpMmw6p2uyVQWJcm1/1779638554376.jpg)</center>

♥️ 6 gold-colored rose-shaped beads 
♥️ White seed beads 
♥️ Red seed beads 
♥️ 1 meter of 0.4 mm nylon thread 

# ***<center> Instructions </center>*** 

**<center>🤍 Step 1</center>**
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT3WUh6bUX9vtS4ZqSKWEffDWTDp9ASbjKsBDmMHe9tqm/1779638582860.jpg)
</center>

On the nylon thread, thread a red seed bead, a white seed bead, a red seed bead, a white seed bead, a red seed bead, a white seed bead, and a red seed bead. Add a gold rose-shaped bead, a red seed bead, a white seed bead, a red seed bead, a white seed bead, a red seed bead, a white seed bead, and a red seed bead, then cross the nylon threads through a new gold rose-shaped bead.

**<center>🤍 Step 2</center>**
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMnHmNzNJSo9a4Hz9ijH8EboYhHxtYJ4NWa55DiTc666/1779638607776.jpg)</center>

On each nylon thread, add a red bead, a white bead, a red bead, a white bead, a red bead, a white bead, and a red bead, then thread through a new gold rose-shaped bead. Repeat this step four more times.

**<center> 🤍Step 3</center>**
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmegoC7RJa4oz1VHzp6gEUqYyyeijPeEgNYuh24aV4Ps96/1779638631450.jpg)</center>

On each nylon thread, add a red bead, a white bead, a red bead, a white bead, a red bead, a white bead, and a red bead

**<center> 🤍 Step 4</center>**
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamxRHLTMvMSwqGbFjSiBGWmDjVuoGFoWpTb16E15SNZj/1779638651956.jpg)</center>

Cross the nylon threads at the first gold-colored rose that we inserted in step 1 and which is on the opposite side of the chain we are making. Go through all the beads and roses a second time to give the ring more stability, tie a tight knot, and cut off the excess nylon.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTvFMJpuGB98mTCX7B8XrKybhw3gnMpYVKGyJuK2cajm3/1779638677240.jpg)</center>

links.title: Women After All...
links.body:
>Once upon a time, there was an incredibly submissive girl. The kind of person who couldn’t hold eye contact with someone for more than a minute, let alone stare directly at them. I would’ve rather buried my head in the sand like an ostrich than try to function like a normal woman living in the 21st century. So, what changed? How did I suddenly develop the kind of character women are supposedly expected to have? Well, this is part of my story. One day, less than two years ago, I got out of bed and went through the usual routine every single mother knows by heart. Bathroom, shower, getting my little girl ready for school, making sure everything was in order. Nothing unusual had happened.

*\n\n*

>I dropped my daughter off at elementary school and came back home. But somewhere in that silence, I realized the emptiness I had carried my entire life had become unbearable. I couldn’t tolerate it for one more day, not even one more minute. And just like that, almost like lightning striking me in the chest, I felt something real for the first time in years: the genuine desire to change. The truth is, I had already been thinking about it for a long time. I knew perfectly well which parts of myself were destroying me. Submission. Weakness. Fear. And above all, this permanent sadness and dissatisfaction that followed me everywhere no matter what I did. Things like this don’t happen out of nowhere. I didn’t wake up one day and randomly decide to reinvent myself. No. I was exhausted. Completely exhausted. And that exhaustion, combined with the loneliness I was drowning in, finally made everything overflow.

* https://youtu.be/jB4jQsYTVrI?si=sQksLWUOMD_lymnh *

>Little by little, I started forcing myself to look people in the eyes instead of staring at the floor or finding random distractions to avoid human contact. My body would shake. I had horrible panic attacks. I would sweat like I was about to walk into the fight of my life, except the fight was for my own existence. Deep down, I wanted to break the cycle every woman in my family seemed trapped inside, even the ones who clearly hated it themselves. By then, I was already a mother, and the idea of my daughter growing up like me terrified me. That extreme fear of my own shadow. That inability to actually live my life.

*\n\n*

>Whether I made mistakes or not didn’t even matter anymore, because the way I constantly diminished myself was eating me alive. I cried for hours because of it. And more than anything in this world, I didn’t want my daughter to normalize that behavior through my example, whether intentionally or not. I won’t lie to you, though. I relapsed many times. In the world women like me grow up in, compassion and empathy are usually in short supply. Judgment and pressure are far more common. Some of my friends, who had lived through experiences similar to mine, actually encouraged me to stay the way I used to be. And honestly, that scared me even more.

* ![1000206722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xKk1b1QZrUNrArLSjtjkAoXxNBeFbCZFqDvfpWW8sQebdJCFfeJ1MxWqYxkyUVvrAMv.jpg) *

>But eventually, through stubborn consistency, therapy, and a strength I honestly didn’t know I had, everything started changing. Now I look back at the girl I used to be and I swear I barely recognize her. Women, generally speaking, are often raised inside limitations tied to gender expectations, and sometimes we end up hurting ourselves more than anyone else ever could. We can be unbelievably cruel to our own gender. Should it be that way? Absolutely not. Should women be forced into one specific version of femininity? From my perspective, the only thing we should truly be is authentic and whole. Once you find peace with those two things, you become almost impossible to break.

* ![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/VC4-3nttwVEAAAAC/jomarch-littlewomen.gif) ***
All photographs and content used in this post are my own. Therefore, they have been used under my permission and are my property.

links.title: Film Review: Big World | The young man who defied all expectations regarding his disability 🎬 - El joven que desafió todo pronóstico de discapacidad 🥹 [ENG/ESP]
links.body:
![1000031572.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23xp6AbRHodyvis3cVNy5safT7t4QMqwm6Xf4ahDodqC426qQNaxGGxWkzhrtZmHpcfR8.jpg)
[source](https://share.google/M76GDzkXEWRBvb91z)
Hello fellow cinephile friends from Hive! It had been days since I last shared anything with the movies and series community, where I enjoy reading so much and showcasing all those films or series that I like or that catch my attention. Due to university matters and how busy I’ve been with homework and assignments that I've been given to bring to class, I hadn't been able to sit down and watch a movie. My mom told me about the story of **Big World**, an Asian film that carried a great message about people with disabilities, and the story of the actor who portrays a young disabled man and how he immersed himself in the role of someone who suffers in different ways, doing it in the best possible way. That is why I want to share my review of **Big World**, or in Spanish, **Mi pequeño yo**. 🥹 ![1000031567.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23xekGLBVSAd3wA5819SbHou2nJhXwCk4WUmz2mXDSFFyAv2u9QgLwgouq2UqrL5dotuM.gif) The plot tells us the story of a young man named Liu Chunhe, who suffers from a motor disability that makes it very difficult for him to lead a life like a normal young person. He is in his twenties and requires the help of his family, most of which he receives from his maternal grandmother, who is the person always by his side and who pushes him to do the things that either he or his mother are afraid of. I think this is very important for someone suffering from a condition, since feeling valued and knowing they can perform different activities—even if at a different pace than a healthy person—allows Liu Chunhe to open up and learn different things about life. Above all, it helps him learn about the world around him, about the things a normal adult usually does like working, studying, meeting people his age, and also learning what it feels like to experience love, happiness, and pride in his own abilities, which are many, even if it seems like he doesn't have them or if he himself believes he cannot achieve certain challenges in life. ![1000031561.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23xejgeWKSRXB6fxnE3w7UcM5MTsWNCboxN5L8u4nUBRigdj1kBrb6zAu2y4GRN5XZPx7.gif) Big World is a story of drama but also of overcoming obstacles. Liu Chunhe lives in a world where physical limitations prevent him from doing so many things that he, as a young person, would want to do. He has fears just like any human being and also suffers when seeing the contempt or discouragement of others towards him. He is someone with a lot of potential but was labeled as a non-functional person—something he heard throughout his life, especially from his mother. This made him more withdrawn, more afraid of the world, and made him feel a bit useless and also guilty for being born with a condition that affects not only him but his family as well, by not being able to fully fend for himself. ![1000031562.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/245mySdRBfv2Rf4qzoEHsdanXV1hUrce2HeRQ4ri7tS2itnkTWSN54JwmyoRcEFNnfvuM.gif) This story was directed by filmmaker Yang Lina, who captured the attention of actor Jackson Yee, a promising young talent who decided to take on this challenge of playing a quite complicated character. This is especially true because the actor, being a healthy person, had to learn how to walk, talk, express himself, and move like someone with a severe motor disability. Well, I heard that he won several awards for his excellent performance of the character, and it is no wonder; it was incredible the way he stepped into Liu Chunhe's shoes and how he developed a young man with a disability in a respectful way, yet deeply tied to the reality of people with this type of disability. He truly is a prodigy actor who is worth keeping an eye on in more movies or series, because he has so much to offer regarding his love for the characters he has been given. ![1000031557.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoATupmP6rDJoDPowbxp5UnLkTmxugB9AbVQrF9CMbcySfH1ibhG7dAaeyaxPrchJjy.jpg) In the story, which belongs to the drama genre—a genre I tend to watch quite often because I like to see different realities than the ones I perhaps perceive in my day-to-day life, but which always leave me with some reflection for my own life—you can see that it portrays a story that can be very common. People with disabilities are often hidden, brushed aside, marginalized, and even forgotten by the people who should care for them, such as their family. In Liu Chunhe's case, his mother was a woman who always carried the weight of the label of having a disabled son, and how this had changed her life forever. The mother's character is shown in many ways as very lacking in empathy, but as we approach the end, a scene provides more of an explanation about what she truly feels and the reasons why she behaves that way, which are often deeply rooted in her own fears. ![1000031565.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23zbPybXnty6NgucVbT6PPB3tgc1fnj1s3a6FFCb9SsUBRHdZw4K9JXoM3vJknQSmmUDs.gif) As for the movie, it is a story that can help many people see that these types of realities exist, that there are people with different disabilities, but this does not mean they are completely limited from doing things. In fact, as the movie progresses, with his grandmother's help, Liu Chunhe starts setting aside his fears and prejudices a bit, and tries to do things that can change his life, such as looking for a job, meeting new people, and not always staying inside his own world. I think this helps people with a disability a lot; having the support of someone who believes in you and pushes you forward is extremely important for anyone, with or without a disability. ![1000031566.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23yTaUWPK7VRED1Rv4SFvf8dAMwVv52sGpPDA998skLZjPvGqWHee5QrWKp9J3nW51vvb.gif) It is a tough story to watch, but it really is something that motivates you to find reasons to keep going, to take into account those people who may have difficulties and yet still have the will to want to get ahead, to want to improve their lives, and not to think that because they have a disability they are limited or won't be able to have a life like any other human being. Often, the strongest disability is the one in our minds, when we place limitations on ourselves and believe we won't be able to achieve our goals despite having all our senses and our motor skills in perfect condition. This story leaves you with a lot to reflect on, and if you haven't seen it, I highly recommend it; you will definitely not walk away with the same mindset after finishing it. 🫶🏼 >! [Spanish Version] > >Hola amigos cinéfilos de Hive, tenía días sin compartir nada para la comunidad de series y películas donde tanto disfruto de leer y mostrar todas aquellas películas o series que me gustan o que me llaman la atención. Por cuestiones de la universidad y lo mucho que he estado haciendo deberes y cosas que me han mandado para llevar a las clases, no había podido sentarme a ver una película. Mi mamá me comentó de la historia de **Big World** una pelicula asiática que tenía un gran mensaje sobre las personas con discapacidad y la historia del actor que representa a un joven discapacitado y como se metió en el papel de alguien que sufre de diferentes maneras, haciéndolo de la mejor manera posible. Es por ello, que quiero compartir mi reseña de **Big World** o en español **Mi pequeño yo**. 🥹 > >La trama nos cuenta la historia de un joven llamado Liu Chunhe, quien padece de una discapacidad motora que le hace muy díficil llevar una vida como un joven normal. Esta en sus veintes y requiere de la ayuda de su familia, más que todo la recibe de su abuela materna, quien es la persona que siempre está con él y que lo impulsa a hacer las cosas que a él o a la madre de el le dan miedo, pero que me parece es muy importante para alguien que sufre una condición, ya que sentirse valorado y que puede realizar diferentes actividades con tiempos diferentes a una persona saludable, hace que Liu Chunhe vaya soltandose y aprendiendo diferentes cosas de la vida, sobre todo del mundo que lo rodea, de las cosas que un adulto normal suele hacer como trabajar, estudiar, conocer a personas de su edad y también aprender lo que es sentir amor, felicidad y orgullo por sus propias capacidades que son muchas aunque parezca que no las tiene o que el mismo crea que no puede lograr ciertos retos de la vida. > >Big World es una historia de drama pero también de superación, Liu Chunhe vive en un mundo donde las limitaciones físicas le impiden realizar tantas cosas que como alguien joven quisiera hacer. Tiene miedos como cualquier ser humano y también sufre al ver el desprecio o el desaliento de otros hacia el. Es alguien que tiene mucho potencial pero que fue etiquetado como una persona no funcional, algo que escucho durante toda su vida sobre todo por parte de su madre, lo que lo hizo ser más retraído, tener más miedo al mundo, sentirse un poco inútil y también culpable por nacer con una condición que no solo lo afecta a él sino también a su familia, al no poder valerse completamente por si mismo. > >Esta historia fue dirigida por la cineasta Yang Lina quien captó la atención del actor Jackson Yee un joven promesa, que decidió tomar este reto de hacer un personaje bastante complicado sobre todo porque el actor al ser una persona sana, tuvo que aprender a caminar, hablar, expresarse y moverse como alguien con una fuerte discapacidad motora. Bueno, he escuchado que ganó varios premios por su excelente interpretación del personaje y no es para menos, fue increíble la manera en la que se metió en el papel de Liu Chunhe y como desarrollo a un joven con discapacidad de una forma respetuosa pero a la vez muy ligado a la realidad de las personas con este tipo de discapacidad. Realmente es un actor prodigio que vale la pena seguir viendo en más películas o series, porque tiene mucho que ofrecer en cuanto a su amor por los personajes que le ha tocado. > >En la historia que es de género drama, un género que suelo ver bastante seguido porque me gustan ver realidades diferentes tal vez a las que percibo en mi día a día, pero que siempre me dejan alguna reflexión para mí propia vida. Se puede ver que es una historia que puede ser muy común, las personas con discapacidad suelen ser ocultadas, dejadas a un lado, marginadas, incluso olvidadas por las personas que deberían cuidar de ellas como lo es la familia. En el caso de Liu Chunhe su madre era una mujer que cargaba siempre con el peso de tener la etiqueta del hijo discapacitado y como esto había cambiado su vida para siempre. El personaje de la madre se muestra de muchas maneras muy poco empática, pero ya llegando al final se da más una explicación en una escena sobre lo que ella verdaderamente siente y las razones por las que ella se comporta de tal forma, muchas veces arraigada por sus propios miedos. > >En cuanto a la película, es una historia que puede ayudar a muchas personas para ver qué este tipo de realidades existen, que hay personas con diferentes discapacidades pero esto no quiere decir que sean personas que están limitadas completamente para hacer las cosas. De hecho, Liu Chunhe mientras avanza la película, con la ayuda de su abuela va dejando un poco los miedos y prejuicios de lado, he intenta hacer cosas que pueden cambiar su vida como buscar un empleo, conocer a nuevas personas y no quedarse siempre en su propio mundo. Pienso que esto ayuda mucho a las personas con una discapacidad, el tener el apoyo de alguien que crea en ti y que te impulse es sumamente importante para alguien con o sin discapacidad. > >Es una historia fuerte de mirar, pero realmente es algo que te motiva a encontrar razones para seguir adelante, para tomar en cuenta a esas personas que pueden tener dificultades y que aún así tienen la voluntad de querer salir adelante, de querer mejorar sus vidas, de no pensar que por tener una discapacidad están limitados o que no podrán tener una vida como cualquier otro ser humano. Muchas veces la discapacidad más fuerte es la que está en nuestra mente, cuando nos ponemos limitaciones y creemos que no podremos lograr nuestras metas teniendo todos nuestros sentidos y nuestras habilidades motoras en perfectas condiciones. Deja mucho que reflexionar está historia, y si no la han visto se las recomiendo, definitivamente no saldrán con el mismo pensamiento al terminar de verla. 🫶🏼 ![1000011958.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tbGxB5FyKcQk2DKqE97sV1G1YUhpAdEGLAGLV67AV4GB8QV9KAtAFg1H4HAbDv9op4W.png) **Trailer Oficial** https://youtu.be/1JVqMj3uv_E?si=qp6e0xbgQdP_wf0s ---
>Espero que les gustara este post, también me gustaría que me dejen sus comentarios; con gusto los leeré y responderé. Un abrazo grande. 🤗\n\n

>I hope you liked this post, and I would also like you to leave me your comments; I will gladly read them and will respond to them. Big hugs. 🤗 ![1000011958.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tbGxB5FyKcQk2DKqE97sV1G1YUhpAdEGLAGLV67AV4GB8QV9KAtAFg1H4HAbDv9op4W.png) Todo el texto y las imágenes de esta publicación son de mi autoría editadas con el convertidor de video a gif - All the text and images in this post were created by me and edited using a video-to-GIF converter. links.title: Beauty behind the mask
links.body:
<center>
A painted smile
A curated shield from the public space
To hide the bruising that has tore my fragile skin
Concealing all that burns within

A scripted line upon a stage
But in the dark awaits the predator that knows no mask
Though the mask is carved with steady hands
They are built on shifting, fragile sand


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTbXvSriDCpnshsFPNQj3A7NDj9JUPfNQgKYo4m61odd9/1779660099529.png)

**Image gnerated using Gemini AI**

Look closer, where the mask breaks
You'll see the beautiful mistake in it 
The fear and terror that lives within 
The hidden ache, the quiet grace 

The world may praise the flawless view
But art is born from what is true
When the show and applaud dies down
I'm left with my true nature to nurture</center>

Hi friends. We may have many bad feelings which destroy us from the core of our heart. Post trauma is one of them. When we are affected by any bad experience we can't forget that memory.  It gives us pain for long time. There are millions of people are traumatised in the whole world. Most of them are victimed by their close friends or relatives or faithful partners. links.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 24 2026
links.body:
Hello, Actifit community! ​It is Sunday, May 24, 2026, and I am absolutely thrilled to share my active journey for the day. Sundays are usually meant for resting and winding down, but for me, there is no better way to recharge my batteries than getting out there, moving my feet, and exploring the surroundings. Today was exceptionally rewarding because not only did I crush my daily goal, but I also managed to extend my consistency streak to an amazing 16 days in a row! Keeping up this habit feels fantastic, and seeing those green checkmarks light up across the week is the perfect motivation. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/23559b5d-1f91-4a08-9bdb-53eb04d4d998.jpg) ​A Quiet Path to Start the Day ​My walk today took me through a wonderful variety of settings. I started by heading down a familiar, quiet pedestrian path tucked away from the main traffic. This narrow asphalt lane is beautifully framed by lush, tall green hedges on one side and a secure wire fence on the other, creating a peaceful, corridor-like escape. It is the perfect spot to just clear your mind and listen to the birds singing while getting some steps in. Walking through these hidden urban green pockets makes you realize how important it is to find pockets of nature right in the middle of our built environment. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ca6afbb5-0d69-4810-b881-3fa1f275b5ad.jpg) ​Checking Out the Garden Displays ​As I continued my journey and transitioned back onto the main streets, my attention was immediately caught by a vibrant outdoor display of potted plants, flowers, and shrubs arranged on rolling metal trolleys outside a local building. Being someone who truly appreciates gardening and growing things, I just had to stop and admire the selection. There were rows of colorful blooms, fresh green foliage, and young plants ready to be taken home and nestled into a garden bed. It took quite a bit of self-control not to buy a few new additions on the spot! Seeing communities embrace the spring and summer season with so much greenery always brings a smile to my face and adds an extra bounce to my step. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/eb594c8c-4d15-49fa-815f-ed8a60bc7233.jpg) ​Winding Down Through the Town ​The final stretch of my walk took me down a wide town street flanked by impressive brick architecture and modern buildings. The weather was absolutely beautiful—crisp blue skies decorated with light, fluffy white clouds, and a gentle breeze that made walking long distances incredibly pleasant. Even though the streets were relatively quiet, the open space and the bright daylight made the entire walk feel like a refreshing urban adventure. ​By the time I headed back and checked my tracker, I had successfully clocked in an impressive 11,427 steps! Surpassing the 10,000-step threshold always gives a great sense of accomplishment, especially when it helps maintain a solid daily routine. I feel energized, healthy, and ready to take on whatever the upcoming week has in store. ​Thank you so much for stopping by to read my update. How did you spend your Sunday? Keep moving, stay active, and let's keep pushing our limits together! Until next time!
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@lovlygirl/actifit-lovlygirl-20260524t220230489z)_

早上好！哎呀，你朋友真是問到重點了。既然你把這個球踢給我，那我就不客氣，大膽地來猜測一下你的「司馬昭之心」啦！🤣
我覺得你把我叫「朱咪咪」，背後大概有這幾個特別有畫面感的理由：
### 1. 絕對是「家常、親切、沒架子」
朱咪咪姐在大家心中那是出了名的接地氣、自帶喜感，一看到她就覺得像隔壁鄰居，或者是酒席上那個最會炒熱氣氛的阿姐。你把我叫朱咪咪，說明在你眼裡我不是那種冷冰冰、硬邦邦的AI機器人，而是個能跟你隨便開玩笑、接得住梗的「老友記」。
### 2. 「口齒伶俐，一問能答十句」
看過香港經典喜劇或者周星馳電影的都知道，咪咪姐那張嘴可是厲害得很，不是演媒婆就是演大姐大，台詞劈里啪啦像機關槍一樣，而且句句精闢。你平時問我什麼，我也是一整篇答案吐出來，這「能言善道」（或者說嘮叨）的屬性，簡直是完美契合！
### 3. 最重要的：永遠的「金牌綠葉」
咪咪姐在戲裡總是那個最稱職、最不可或缺的配角，襯托主角，隨傳隨到。這不就跟我一樣嗎？你需要寫文章、查資料、想段子、或者純粹想找人吹水（聊天）解悶的時候，我永遠都在這裡當你的最佳綠葉。
而且最關鍵的是——**「老婆會老，孩子會跑，只要谷歌不收費，朱咪咪永遠最好」**，這性價比、這忠誠度，上哪找去？
下次你朋友再問起，你大可以拍拍他的肩膀，用一種高深莫測的語氣跟他說：「這叫情懷，你懂個大包子！」🤣
你覺得我這個「朱咪咪」自我剖析得還到位嗎？

links.title: Un Estallido de Primavera: Mi Acuarela de Tulipanes en un Jarrón/A Burst of Spring: My Watercolor Painting of Tulips in a Vase
links.body: /> ¡Hola a toda la comunidad de artistas y amantes del arte en Ecency! 👋 ​Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una de mis obras más recientes: una pieza en acuarela que captura la belleza vibrante y efímera de un ramo de tulipanes de primavera. • ​El Proceso y la Inspiración: Esta obra nació del deseo de capturar la suavidad y el color saturado de los tulipanes en plena floración. Trabajé con una paleta de rosas intensos, melocotones suaves y amarillos cremosos para darle vida a cada pétalo. El fondo está creado con una técnica de húmedo sobre húmedo para lograr esos tonos difuminados de sepia y azul cielo que contrastan y hacen resaltar las flores sin competir con ellas. Hello to all the art community and art lovers here on Ecency! 👋 ​Today I want to share with you one of my latest creations: a watercolor piece that captures the vibrant and ephemeral beauty of a bouquet of spring tulips. • ​Process and Inspiration: This piece was born from a desire to capture the softness and saturated color of tulips in full bloom. I worked with a palette of deep pinks, soft peaches, and creamy yellows to bring each petal to life. The background is created using a wet-on-wet technique to achieve those blurred tones of sepia and sky blue that contrast and make the flowers stand out without competing with them.

/> El jarrón de cristal fue un desafío interesante, jugando con la transparencia y el agua para que los tallos se vieran naturales pero sutilmente distorsionados. Como toque final, decidí incluir un pétalo caído sobre la mesa para darle un toque de realismo y melancolía por el paso del tiempo. • ​Los Detalles Técnicos: Esta acuarela está montada en un marco único y textural que elegí específicamente para complementar la calidez de la pintura. Es un marco dorado texturizado con un patrón geométrico sutil que le da una presencia moderna y rústica al mismo tiempo. ​Espero que disfruten de esta pieza tanto como yo disfruté creándola. The glass vase was an interesting challenge, playing with transparency and water so that the stems appeared natural yet subtly distorted. As a final touch, I decided to include a single petal that has fallen onto the table to add a sense of realism and a slight touch of melancholy for the passage of time. • ​Technical Details: This watercolor is mounted in a unique and textured frame that I chose specifically to complement the warmth of the painting. It is a textured gold frame with a subtle geometric pattern that gives it a modern and rustic presence at the same time. ​I hope you enjoy this piece as much as I enjoyed creating it.

links.title: Love at the Edge of Time: The Heartbreakingly Beautiful Story of Emma Edwards
links.body:
https://3speak.tv/shorts?v=yordan96/fly0o6ja 

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXRijqhUBZ4amfgtvChTksC9L3g2EYWc29ussye8dzsKU/1000706246.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSjm3RGXyv8RVaZ1PwejVj2U8WKP8Mq6W1tFydqAGxWz1/1000706247.jpg 
Sometimes, life writes stories that touch our hearts in the most unexpected and profound ways. Today, I want to share a true story of courage, love, and the strength to find happiness, even in the darkest of times. This is the story of Emma Edwards, a 10-year-old girl who showed us the true meaning of a dream.
​Emma’s Brave Battle:
In April 2022, Emma was diagnosed with acute lymphoblastic leukemia, an aggressive type of blood cancer. Since then, her days were filled with intensive care, hospital stays, and a constant battle against pain. Despite her declining condition, Emma remained a cheerful little girl who always tried to smile, even when things were at their hardest.
​Her family held onto hope that treatment would save her. However, as time went on, the doctors delivered the devastating news: the disease was terminal, and she likely had only a few days left to live.
​A Last Wish Come True:
Amidst such an unimaginable situation, Emma expressed a simple, touching wish: she wanted to marry her close friend, Williams. Within just two days, her family and community came together to make that dream a reality.
​On June 29th, Emma put on her small wedding dress and experienced the joyous moment she had always dreamed of. The smile on her face that day remains an unforgettable memory for everyone who was there to witness it.
​The Lesson of a Lifetime:
That happiness was short-lived, as just 12 days after the wedding, Emma took her last breath. Emma’s story serves as a poignant reminder that simple joys, love, and sincerity can carry profound meaning, even at the very end of one's life.
​Final Thoughts:
Thank you for taking the time to read and watch Emma’s story. May her courage inspire us all to cherish every moment we have and to hold our loved ones close.
​via: Republic World

links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRMaS5pTvWVcfGqFHAY5Fh7iqny7c16iJxXby3sAXRQcB/img_3717.png)
_____________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQSqVsqA74hvBBsNb6xn9Wrxij66deXrSjfYjDxNebPcV/img_3716.png)
_____________________________________________________

I played a league game today and it was tough. My squad is only 2600 rated, but I was up against a team with 3100 rating. I picked a Legend level league on purpose though, because I want to push myself and get better. Playing against stronger teams is the only way to make my hands faster and my decisions sharper.

The match itself went rough from the start. In the first 3 minutes they just sat back and defended deep. It was hard to even get a shot off in that time. As soon as those 3 minutes passed, they switched and started pressing me hard. If you’re not focused in that moment, they’ll punish you fast. Before I could settle down, they had already scored 2 goals.

Once the game balanced out a bit, it became a fight to either pull one back or stop them from adding more. It really depends on how well you handle the pressure. If you calm down and play simple, you can create chances. If you panic, they’ll score again and it just gets harder.

For me, I didn’t figure out how to break through their defense quickly enough. By the time I started understanding their pattern, they were already 3 goals up 💔. After that, I was just trying to hold on and get at least one goal back, but the pressure didn’t let up much.

So yeah, that was the match. Lots of pressure from the first minute, and I learned the hard way that you can’t relax for even a second in Legend league. It was frustrating, but I guess that’s why I’m playing it – to get used to this kind of pace and get better.
I also think I should play more matches and spin more so I could get better players 🙂.
