body.title: Taça de Portugal final: Torreense did the impossible
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptosimplify/Eo1vRjyxA4jC4JM3iCqMk1pfwX1cnRAKprkPzdFPg8gC5A2CN2pwFNvW7macoyxzny7.png)


I need to start this by saying something I genuinely never thought I'd write. Not in a million years. Not if you gave me a thousand guesses about how the 2025/26 Portuguese football season would end.

**Torreense won the Taça de Portugal.**

Torreense. The team from Torres Vedras. The team that plays in the SECOND DIVISION. The team whose only previous final appearance was in 1956 — seventy years ago — when they lost 2-0 to FC Porto. The team that most casual football fans couldn't have located on a map three months ago. That team just beat Sporting 2-1 after extra time at the Estádio Nacional and became the first club from outside the top flight to win the Taça de Portugal in eighty-six editions of the competition.
I'm going to let that sink in for a second because I don't think the magnitude of what just happened has fully hit anyone yet.

Eighty-six editions. In all that time — across decades of Portuguese football history, through Eusébio and Futre and Figo and Ronaldo, through dynasties and revolutions and golden generations — no team below the Primeira Liga had ever lifted the prova rainha. Not once. Not ever. Until today. Until Stopira, the Torreense captain, buried a penalty past Rui Silva at the 113th minute and an entire town lost its collective mind.

I wrote about Sporting in the semi-finals a few weeks ago. They'd gone to the Dragão and held FC Porto to a 0-0 draw to reach the final on aggregate. I said something like \

I actually believed it. After the derby collapse, after the AFS draw, after all the setbacks — the Taça was supposed to be the consolation prize. The thing that saved the season. The one trophy Rui Borges could hold up and say \

Instead, it became the final humiliation. And I genuinely feel bad writing that because Rui Borges seems like a good man and a decent coach, but there's no sugarcoating what happened today at the Jamor. Sporting — the vice-champions of Portugal, the team that just sealed Champions League football for next season, the defending Taça holders — lost to a second division team. In a final. At the Estádio Nacional. On national television. With the whole country watching.
How? How does this happen?
Let me walk through it.

## The first four minutes that changed everything

Borges named the same eleven that played the last league game. Same formation, same personnel. He said afterwards that he'd warned his players about nervousness, about taking the occasion too seriously, about letting the pressure get to them. And then, four minutes into the game, every single one of those fears materialized.
Set piece. Simple ball into the box. Léo Azevedo rose above everyone — and I mean everyone, including Morita who was supposed to be marking the near post area — and headed the ball across goal. Kévin Zohi was standing at the far post, completely alone, completely unmarked, and he just had to redirect it into the net. Which he did. Four minutes. 1-0 Torreense.

The Estádio Nacional went absolutely silent on the Sporting side. On the other end, the Torreense fans — and there were a LOT of them, way more than anyone expected — erupted. I've been to a few cup finals at the Jamor and I've never heard a noise like that from a \

team's fans. It was visceral. It was primal. It was the sound of people who couldn't believe what they were witnessing and decided to scream about it before reality caught up.

Now, here's the thing. Sporting had the entire rest of the game to respond. Forty-one minutes of the first half. The whole second half. They had Luis Suárez, the league's top scorer. They had Trincão. They had Geny Catamo. They had Hjulmand and Morita in midfield. They had approximately 400 million euros worth of squad against a team whose entire payroll is probably less than what Sporting pay for their under-19 canteen.
And for forty-five minutes, they couldn't do a thing about it.

## Torreense's masterclass in suffering

This is what I want to talk about. Because the narrative is going to be about Sporting's failure — the newspapers are already writing that angle, the pundits are already sharpening their knives for Rui Borges — but that completely ignores what Torreense actually DID out there. They didn't just park the bus and pray. They executed a defensive plan with a discipline and intensity that would have made Simeone send them a congratulatory text.

Luís Tralhão — remember that name, because every single Primeira Liga club should be on the phone to his agent tomorrow morning — set his team up in a compact 4-4-2 low block that Sporting simply could not penetrate. The distances between the lines were perfect. The pressing triggers were well-timed. When Sporting tried to play through the middle, there were always two bodies in the way. When they tried to go wide, the Torreense full-backs collapsed the space before the cross could come in. When they tried to play over the top, the centre-backs were positioned deep enough to deal with it.

Lucas Paes in the Torreense goal had the game of his life. He saved from Suárez at point-blank range in the 41st minute — a reaction stop that had no right to be saved. He claimed every cross like they belonged to him. He organized his defense with the authority of someone who's done this a thousand times, even though he absolutely has not done this a thousand times, because this was a TAÇA DE PORTUGAL FINAL and he plays in the second division.

The half-time whistle blew. 1-0 Torreense. The Sporting fans were stunned. The Torreense fans were delirious. And everyone watching at home was thinking the same thing: surely Sporting will sort this out in the second half, right? Surely.

## Suárez equalizes. But the story isn't over.

Borges clearly had words at half-time because Sporting came out with a completely different energy. Higher pressing, more urgency, more bodies in the box. And it worked. On 54 minutes, a loose ball in the Torreense area — Diadié tried to clear but it bounced off Maxi Araújo and fell to Suárez. The Colombian turned on Stopira, created just enough space, and fired past Lucas Paes. 1-1.

Alvalade's traveling support woke up. You could feel the momentum shift. This was the moment. Sporting were going to take over, score a second, win 2-1 or 3-1, and everyone would say \

and we'd all move on.
Except Torreense didn't get that memo.

They absorbed the goal, regrouped, and went back to doing exactly what they'd been doing before. Compact. Disciplined. Fearless. The block reformed. The distances stayed tight. Sporting kept pushing but the penetration just wasn't there. Geny Catamo actually put the ball in the net around the 70th minute but VAR ruled it offside. Hjulmand headed over from a corner when he should have scored. Suárez had a half-chance that he dragged wide. The chances were there but Sporting couldn't convert.
Ninety minutes. 1-1. Extra time.

And in the back of my mind, a little voice was saying: \

Three extra time games in this cup run. They beat Braga after extra time in the quarters. They ground out results when it went long. Surely their experience of going the distance would count.

The first period of extra time was cagey. Both teams were tired. Torreense actually had a goal disallowed — Diadié scored but was flagged offside. Sporting pushed without any real conviction. Fifteen minutes passed. Nothing happened. The second period started and you could see penalty shootouts written all over this game.
And then the 113th minute happened.

## The moment that made history

Ismail Seydi. Remember that name too. The Torreense forward picked up the ball on the halfway line, turned, and ran. He got behind the Sporting defense — which was pushed absurdly high because they were chasing the game — and into the penalty area. Maxi Araújo, the Uruguayan left-back who'd had a miserable game, lunged at him from behind. Contact. Seydi went down.

The referee looked at the monitor. VAR confirmed it. Penalty to Torreense. Red card for Maxi Araújo.
The Jamor held its breath.

Stopira. The captain. The centre-back who'd been throwing his body in front of everything all game. The man who'd organized the defense, who'd won every aerial duel, who'd been the literal wall between Sporting and the goal. He picked up the ball, placed it on the spot, and looked at Rui Silva.
And he didn't miss.

Low, hard, to the right. Rui Silva went the right way but it was too powerful, too well-placed. 2-1 Torreense. The 113th minute of a Taça de Portugal final.
What happened next is something I will never forget. The Torreense bench emptied. Players sprinted onto the pitch. Staff members were crying — actual tears, streaming down their faces. In the stands, grown men were sobbing. Women were screaming. Children were being held up by their parents to see the moment. It was raw, unfiltered, beautiful human emotion.

There were still minutes to play. Sporting, now down to ten men, threw Rui Silva up for corners in desperation. There was a scramble in the box where the ball was hacked clear. There was one last Torreense counter-attack where Drammeh broke free as Rui Silva was still in the opposition box — he had the empty net, the chance to make it 3-1, and somehow missed. On any other day, that miss would be a meme. Today, nobody cares. Nobody will even remember it tomorrow.

The whistle blew. Stopira fell to his knees. The team piled on top of him. And from the stands came the roar — the roar of a town of 40,000 people who'd just witnessed the most extraordinary thing their football club has ever done, and probably ever will do.

## What this means — beyond the trophy

Let me put this into perspective because the numbers alone are staggering.
Torreense are the first club from below the Primeira Liga to win the Taça de Portugal in 86 editions of the competition. Let me say that again. EIGHTY-SIX. This isn't some mickey mouse cup that gets upset regularly. This is the prova rainha. Benfica have won it 26 times. Porto 20 times. Sporting 18 times. The idea that a second division team could beat one of the Big Three in the final was so absurd that the pre-match betting odds had Sporting at something like 1.15. One-point-fifteen. That's essentially \

Except it wasn't free. And a lot of people are very unhappy at the bookmakers right now.

The Torreense squad cost — in total transfer fees — a fraction of what Sporting paid for Maxi Araújo alone. Their top scorer this season in the league has eight goals. EIGHT. Sporting's top scorer has twenty-six. The wage disparity is probably something like 15 to 1. This is David and Goliath except David didn't just knock Goliath down, he took his sling, sold it on eBay, and used the money to buy a trip to the Europa League.

Because yes — Torreense are going to EUROPE. A team from the Portuguese second division will play in the group stage of the Europa League next season. Torres Vedras. In European competition. Against teams from Spain, Germany, Italy, England. I genuinely cannot wrap my head around it. Their stadium holds about 5,000 people. They're going to need to find a bigger one.

And the ripple effects on the European spots are massive. Benfica, who thought they were in the Champions League third qualifying round, now drop to the second qualifying round — an extra game they weren't expecting, which is a headache for Mourinho's pre-season planning. Braga, who were supposed to be in the Europa League after their incredible semi-final run, now drop to the Conference League qualifying rounds instead. And Famalicão? Famalicão are out of Europe entirely. Hugo Oliveira's side, who finished fifth and thought they had a Conference League spot locked down, just got bumped out by a club from the division below. That's brutal.

## The Sporting post-mortem

For Sporting, this is the worst possible ending to a season that started with genuine title aspirations. Let's count the ways this went wrong.

They lost the league to Porto by a mile. They lost the derby to Benfica in the most heartbreaking way imaginable — the disallowed goal, the Rafa winner. They drew with AFS, the already-relegated bottom team. And now they've lost the Taça de Portugal final to a second division side.

Zero titles. The defending champions of the Taça, the vice-champions of the league, ended the season with absolutely nothing. Rui Borges said in the press conference that the nervousness got to his players and that he takes responsibility. I believe him on both counts but I also think the problems run deeper than nerves.

This Sporting team, for all its talent, has a psychological fragility that's been exposed repeatedly this season. When things go wrong — when they concede first, when the crowd turns, when the pressure mounts — they don't have the mentality to fight through it. They had 110 minutes after Zohi's goal to turn this game around. They managed one equalizer and a disallowed goal. Against a second division team. At home, essentially, given the Jamor is twenty minutes from Alvalade. That's not bad luck. That's a mentality problem.

Suárez missed the penalty in the derby. He scored today but was anonymous for long stretches. Trincão, who's been brilliant in patches this season, disappeared when it mattered most. Morita — the man who seems to be at the center of every disaster this season, between the derby handball and now the poor marking on Zohi's goal — had another game to forget.

The fans, to their credit, stayed until the end. They applauded the team despite the defeat. But you could see it in their faces — the exhaustion, the frustration, the \

resignation that comes from watching your team bottle it one too many times. This was supposed to be the night that saved everything. Instead, it became the exclamation point on a season of disappointment.

## Give Torreense their moment

But enough about Sporting. I don't want to end this piece talking about the team that lost. I want to end it talking about the team that won. Because what Torreense did today deserves to be celebrated properly, not used as a footnote in someone else's crisis.

Luís Tralhão built something special in Torres Vedras. A team with no stars, no budget, no history in finals — and he turned them into giant killers. They beat Estoril in the semis to get here. They beat Vitória de Guimarães in the quarters. They went through round after round, nobody taking them seriously, nobody giving them a chance, and they just kept winning.

Stopira, the captain, gave the post-match interview with tears in his eyes and the trophy in his hands. He said something about the team being a family, about believing when nobody else did, about Torres Vedras deserving this moment. And you know what? For once, the cliché felt real. This isn't a team of mercenaries collecting their paychecks. This is a group of players — most of whom will never play in the Primeira Liga, most of whom will never make a fraction of what Sporting's reserves earn — who came to the Jamor and outfought, outthought, and outlasted the defending champions.

And here's the thing that really gets me. The Torreense women's team also won the Taça de Portugal women's final YESTERDAY. Beat Benfica 2-1 after extra time. Same stadium. Same scoreline. Same drama. Both the men's and women's teams winning the Taça de Portugal in the same weekend. That doesn't happen. That's not a coincidence. That's a club — top to bottom, men and women, staff and fans — that's doing something right.
Torres Vedras is going to party tonight. And tomorrow. And probably until Thursday. They deserve every second of it.

The rest of us? We just witnessed something that will be talked about for decades. The night a second division team conquered Portuguese football's oldest trophy for the first time in eighty-six years of trying.
Football. Honestly. You couldn't make it up.

body.title: AI Spotlight: Bankr Launchpad On Base Ignites New AI Agent Ecosystem
body.body:
The crypto world was much simpler back in 2009 when all that existed was Bitcoin. We had a single token (BTC) with a maximum supply of 21 million.

In 2026, tens of thousands of new tokens are launched daily across various blockchains. Most are short-lived memecoins, while a growing share power innovative [AI agents](https://inleo.io/@brennanhm/can-ai-agents-save-the-crypto-market-7cc).

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVVdQZnno7hsAKRFw9Tggmm5V6DVbfvL1rXSrJfECBhHk/bankr_ecosystem.jpg

In today's article, we are going to briefly cover the history of crypto token creation, as well as Bankr's expanding AI agent ecosystem.

# Token Creation

Ethereum launched in July 2015, enabling anyone to write smart contracts and create their own tokens. At the time, token creation was entirely manual. There were no easy token launchpads.

The process of launching a token has been simplified since then, especially with the launch of pump.fun on Solana in early 2024, which allowed anyone to create a token (often a [memecoin](https://inleo.io/@brennanhm/are-we-underestimating-the-power-of-meme-coins)) with the click of a button.

The advent of AI agents inspired even more innovation.

# Virtuals Launchpad

The Virtuals launchpad was built on Base (Ethereum Layer 2) in early 2024. Virtuals pioneered the model of allocating a portion of trading fees from creator/AI agent tokens to self-fund resources like inference/compute.

- Uses a 1% trading fee on agent tokens.  
- Pre-graduation (bonding curve phase): 100% of fees typically go to the protocol treasury.
- Post-graduation: Roughly 70% goes to the creator/founder (but often locked or subject to thresholds, with periodic releases).

# Bankr Launchpad

Bankr, an AI agent launchpad which launched in late 2024, took inspiration from Virtuals, but innovated in a few ways:

- Tokens launch for free, and deploy immediately to Uniswap.
- There is a 1.2% swap fee on every trade of launched tokens, 
- Creators get 57% of that fee, which is paid out automatically in the token + WETH (wrapped Ethereum), claimable in real-time, with no lockups or staking required.
- The rest splits roughly 36% to Bankr, with small portions to the protocol.
- This creates a strong, ongoing revenue flywheel for creators. 

High-volume tokens can generate substantial passive income. In fact, some agents are already earning [upwards of $16K per week](https://bankr.bot/):
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdegHmes2raNRzzQw2yow5ivPeocCP1Zq2ur8W2XrQ81N/top5agents.png

Bankr also innovated the \

flywheel for individual agents. An AI agent launched from Bankr can use the fees it collects from trades to pay for compute credits on Claude or GPT, for example, via Bankr's LLM Gateway.

# The Fair Launch Model

Tokens created via Bankr have a max supply of 100 billion, and are non-mintable after deployment.

All tokens are generated at launch. 100% of the supply goes directly into a Uniswap V4 liquidity pool (paired with WETH/ETH on Base). No pre-mine, no team allocation, no reserved tokens.

Insiders (including creators) must buy on the open market like everyone else, paying the same slippage and fees.

# Bankr AI Agent Projects

Dozens of AI agents launched via Bankr are developing rapidly. For example:

**$GITLAWB** - Decentralized Git platform where AI agents and humans collaborate with cryptographic DID identities.

**$AEON** - Open-source autonomous agent framework that runs unattended with self-healing capabilities and no approval loops.

**$CLAWBANK** - AI agent infrastructure project that enables agents to form LLCs, obtain EINs, and open US bank accounts.

You can [follow Bankr on X](https://x.com/bankrbot) for examples of more projects building in the ecosystem.

# Until next time...

Launchpads like Virtuals and Bankr make it easier to assign AI agents a crypto wallet and self-fund them via trading fees. I see a lot of potential with this model, and we are already witnessing strong growth.

It may be worth investigating this rapidly expanding sector of crypto, and possibly allocating a portion of your portfolio to it. Of course, *none of this is financial advice.* Be sure to do your own research before investing!

***

REAL BUSINESS SITUATION
Communication is fundamental to the functioning of every discipline including marketing, advertising and public relations as well as the entire IMC tools. Globally, advertisers, manufacturers and clients use various IMC tools such as publicity, sales promotion, direct marketing, corporate communication and PR etc for creating awareness or promoting the product/services. Thus, the ability of advertiser or client to understand how these IMC tools works is key to the success of the business. However, the deployment of these marketing communication tools is dependent on adequate identification of marketing problem through scientific research process. During the semester students were grouped and assigned to a client/brand/ business operator within Covenant University business community. Based on the assigned client or brand, research was conducted by each group to identify the client/brand marketing problem and develop a marketing communication plan using appropriate IMC tools for effective communication with the target audience/publics.
The marketing communication campaign is expected to highlight the specific IMC tools relevant to solving communication problem of the assigned client or brand within CU business community.
Specifically, our task was to:
a.
Using insights from the research conducted on the assigned client or brand in November 2025 clearly articulate the objectives that will guide the marketing communication or media campaign framework.
b.
Develop a specific market segmentation of the target audience, with detailed demographic and psychographic data for the assigned client or brand.
c.
The SWOT analysis of the assigned client’s business or Brand.
d.
Clearly itemize the client or brand marketing problems identified based on research conducted.
e.
Clearly state the BIG IDEA for the client or brand marketing communication/ media campaign.
f.
Design an appropriate media plan to ensure the campaign reaches the right audience at the right time.
g.
Produce an electronic or prints as well as multimedia messaging platforms/ channels capable of capturing the attention of the assigned client or brand target audience within the CU business community.
h.
Expectadtions was to appear as a model, voice-over artiste, and character in the campaign deliverables.

body.title: 一個人的武林 / a one-person martial world
body.body:
![uSmhZ0vHdL8Hzzfb_P_20260428_170853.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/uSmhZ0vHdL8Hzzfb_P_20260428_170853/uSmhZ0vHdL8Hzzfb_P_20260428_170853.webp) ![Q6cXHyuhJwG4i2e1_P_20260428_171010.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/Q6cXHyuhJwG4i2e1_P_20260428_171010/Q6cXHyuhJwG4i2e1_P_20260428_171010.webp) ![1CotsZoPEKnklizJ_P_20260428_170924.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/1CotsZoPEKnklizJ_P_20260428_170924/1CotsZoPEKnklizJ_P_20260428_170924.webp) ![OpZorzs8bnu96sVm_P_20260428_170813.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/OpZorzs8bnu96sVm_P_20260428_170813/OpZorzs8bnu96sVm_P_20260428_170813.webp) ![UGH341Am39nnir52_P_20260428_170858.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/UGH341Am39nnir52_P_20260428_170858/UGH341Am39nnir52_P_20260428_170858.webp) ![rOMpOoNgjdKG5DWs_P_20260428_170757.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/rOMpOoNgjdKG5DWs_P_20260428_170757/rOMpOoNgjdKG5DWs_P_20260428_170757.webp)
某天，我站在某個角落，看著這些無人遊玩的充氣城堡，覺得它有一種莫名奇妙的矛盾感，為了歡樂而存在的充氣樂園，就是讓孩子們在裡面跳躍、跌倒、再爬起來，但當孩子們消失之後，它卻變成了一個過度安靜的巨大玩具，失去了原本的意義，再看看售票台前沒有排隊的人潮，站在裡面的售票員，默默地盯著我，連可以免費領取的禮物，都沒人領取，這個樂園就是一座空城。 然而，其中一座充氣城堡傳來歡笑聲，有一位金髮碧眼的小女孩，在城堡中玩耍，她在滑梯上小心地攀爬，又在彈跳區用力地跳躍，看護人坐在城堡外側，安靜地注視著她，確保安全，也同時保持一段恰到好處的距離，她的笑聲成為唯一的聲音來源，使這片空間短暫地恢復了遊樂場應有的樣子，我站在遠處看著，忽然有種奇妙的感覺，小女孩沒有對手，也沒有競爭者，一個念頭突然浮現在我腦海中「一個人的武林」。 《一個人的武林》是一部我曾看過的香港動作懸疑電影，講述一個人為了成為天下第一，瘋狂挑戰並擊殺各路武術高手，以站在武術巔峰的故事，不過，「一個人的武林」要怎麼解讀，真是見仁見智，之所以我會浮現這個念頭，是因為當下的畫面太過衝突了，整個遊樂場裡，沒有其他孩子，只有那一位金髮碧眼的小女孩，在充氣城堡中獨自玩耍，對我而言，那一瞬間的感受很特別，一方面覺得她像是「天下第一」，擁有整座遊樂場，另一方面又覺得，這樣的「第一」，其實是建立在沒有對手、沒有同伴的情況，快樂與孤獨，就這樣同時存在於同一個畫面裡，彼此沒有衝突，卻也無法完全分開。
---
One day, I stood in a corner watching these deserted inflatable castles, and I felt a strange sense of contradiction. An inflatable amusement park exists for joy. It is meant for children to jump, fall, and get back up inside it. But once the children disappear, it turns into an unnaturally quiet giant toy, losing its original meaning. Looking over at the ticket booth, there was no queue. The staff inside stared silently at me, and even the free gifts on offer went unclaimed. The entire amusement park felt like an empty city. From one of the inflatable castles, laughter suddenly echoed. A young girl with blond hair and blue eyes was playing inside. She carefully climbed up the slide and then bounced energetically in the jumping area. A caregiver sat outside the castle, quietly watching her to ensure safety while keeping a respectful distance. Her laughter became the only sound in the space, briefly restoring the atmosphere of what an amusement park should be. Standing from afar, I felt something strange. The girl had no opponents and no competitors. A thought suddenly appeared in my mind: “a one-person martial world”. Kung Fu Jungle is a Hong Kong action thriller I once watched. It tells the story of a man who, in order to become the strongest under heaven, relentlessly challenges and kills masters from various martial arts schools to reach the peak of martial prowess. However, how to interpret “a one-person martial world” is truly open to interpretation. The reason this idea came to me is because the scene at that moment felt so contradictory. The entire amusement park had no other children, only that blond, blue-eyed girl playing alone inside the inflatable castle. In that instant, I felt something unique: on one hand, she seemed like the “number one under heaven”, owning the entire amusement park; on the other hand, this “number one” was built on the absence of opponents and companions. Joy and loneliness coexisted in the same frame—without conflict, yet impossible to fully separate. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@diochen/a-one-person-martial-world)

Love Beyond Time: The Touching Story of Emma Edwards**

```

At just 10 years old, Emma Edwards faced a much tougher reality than most children her age. In April 2022, she was diagnosed with acute lymphoblastic leukemia, an aggressive type of blood cancer. Since then, her days have been filled with intensive care, hospitalizations, and a constant battle with pain. Despite her declining condition, Emma remains known as a cheerful little girl who always tries to smile even through difficult times.
The family's hopes grew that treatment could save Emma. But time passed, and doctors finally announced that the disease was terminal and she likely had only a few days left. Amidst such a difficult situation, Emma expressed a simple wish that touched many hearts: to marry her close friend, Williams. In just two days, the family and community came together to make that small dream come true.
On June 29th, Emma donned her little wedding dress and experienced the joyous moment she had always dreamed of. The smile on her face was an unforgettable memory for everyone in attendance.

But that happiness was short-lived, as 12 days after the wedding, Emma took her last breath. Emma's story serves as a reminder that simple joys, love, and sincerity can have profound meaning, even at the end of one's life.

body.title: Love Left Me… But My Heart Still Wants Rent 💔😂
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf69dWnYthRK5nrRM2gBk7BdT46LFxipuXR88sUHE1ESW/1779658607848.png)

“Whoever is divorced by love,
spends the rest of life in waiting…”
At first, I thought this was just poetry.
You know, those deep lines people post at 2 AM just to make themselves — and everyone else — emotional. 😅
But one day I realized… no, this is actually a real law written directly on the heart.
When love ends, a person does not just become single… they become slightly crazy too.
There was a time when every phone notification made my heart jump like someone hit a last-ball six in a cricket match.
Now the phone rings, and for one second my heart whispers, “Maybe it’s her…”
Then the next second it turns out to be a random mobile network offer message.
“Congratulations! You got 2GB free internet.”
Brother… we want our love back, not free data. 😂
Love is a strange thing.
It turns people into poets, philosophers, and sometimes even detectives.
A person can study someone’s “last seen” status and create an entire emotional investigation from it.
I once had a friend who acted very strong.
He used to say:
“Bro, I’ve moved on. I don’t care anymore.”
And five minutes later he was zooming into her new profile picture trying to figure out who the guy standing beside her was. 😭
Honestly, the real drama starts after love ends.
Outside, people act cool.
They post stories saying:
“Living my best life ✨”
But inside, at 2 AM, they are reading old chats again, smiling at some messages and silently hurting at others.
Some memories are like WiFi.
You cannot see them, but somehow they stay connected all the time. 😅
And the most dangerous memories are the ones triggered by tiny things.
A certain song.
A tea shop.
The smell of rain.
Or one silly word that only she used to say.
Suddenly, the whole mood changes.
One day I was walking in the market and someone nearby was wearing the exact same perfume she used to wear.
For two seconds, it honestly felt like time had reversed itself.
Then I turned around… and it was an old uncle. 😂
That emotional movie scene instantly became a comedy scene.
But there is one thing I learned…
Not every sadness is bad.
Some people enter our lives just to change us.
Whether they stay or leave, they still teach us something important about ourselves.
Before, I thought love only meant staying together forever.
Now I think sometimes love also means letting go.
And maybe some people are not meant to stay in our lives permanently…
they only come to teach us that even after heartbreak, life still goes on.
Yes… a little awkwardly sometimes. 😅
Now whenever I hear her name somewhere, my heart pauses for one second.
Then I calm myself down and think:
“Relax, brother… she is no longer part of your destiny. She is now part of your sad quotes.” 😂💔
Life is strange.
The people we once thought we could never live without…
eventually become memories we sit with while drinking tea in silence.
Maybe that is maturity.
Or maybe… it is just exhaustion. 🙂

body.body:
<center>

### Welcome to  
## ***Liquid Eye’s*** Actifit Blog

# Sunday ☀️ 8474

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931779656959.1048012) 

It was already quite warm this morning, with temperatures above 10 degrees. I hopped on my bike and headed to Volkspark Jungfernheide, as I usually do on Sundays. I hadn’t slept very well last night, and since yesterday, one of the tendons in my foot, which I strained years ago, has been acting up again. So, after the first few rounds of interval walking, I took a leisurely stroll through the park and listened to the concert of our feathered friends. This time, I took in the magnificent green views of the island’s untamed vegetation and meditated on its shores alongside the sunbathing turtles, and of course, I’ve brought both of these experiences back for you, along with a short video.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931779656971.068149) 

Es war schon gut warm heute Morgen bei über 10 Grad. Ab aufs Rad und los zum Volkspark Jungfernheide, wie üblich sonntags. Hatte die Nacht irgendwie nicht so gut geschlafen und seit gestern meldet sich eine meiner vor Jahren angerissenen Sehnen im Fuß wieder. Also nach den ersten paar Durchgängen Intervall-Walking dann ganz entspannt eine kleinere Runde durch den Park spaziert und dem Konzert der Gefiederten Freunde gelauscht. Diesmal mit großartigem grünem Blick in den Wildwuchs der Insel geatmet und an ihrem Ufer mit den sich sonnenden Schildkröten meditiert, und beides hab ich euch natürlich mitgebracht, inkl. kleinem Filmchen.

body.title: Perfectly Perfect Crown (2026)
body.body:
Who would have guessed that my first post in so many months would be review, and a movie review, no less? But I just had to get my thoughts down because this series?? Had me in a chokehold. Since I know I have the tendency to yap, and haven’t formulated a structure whatsoever as to how this review will go, I will just say things as I’m led. 
Bear with me...

Quick disclaimer, there might be spoilers, so if you haven’t seen the series yet, or you’re not done, this is your last chance to turn back, and wait till you’re done (except, of course, you’re into spoilers, to which I have nothing nice to say to you, respectfully, lol)

*Moving on...*

## Perfect Crown (2026)


![1002483064.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23uQNRNxYJZoeCvP9GNkFXb1ea8y6kLYvYnqtMZ3hqo4UF4oMHADhfLf8iETExtkavCZa.jpg)


This 12-episode mini series is a contemporary drama that deliciously mixes historical themes in a modern-day setting. I’ve seen quite a few series like these, but they always found a way to incorporate some form of time travel. This was the first I’ve seen that incorporated both themes into a plot we’ve never witnessed in K-drama history.


![1002483111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23uQhtnPsCHH9zg9XUt1AopdTXQ4KjpLqBTkk2FrUNatxyVGqEAnvqqZoTZQcKnXtd7HX.jpg)


Straight onto the plot. I do not have words to describe how full I was. For one, I love that the scriptwriters decided to break from the conventional. Instead of the usual overly meek, annoyingly cutesy, goody two-shoes female lead who’s such a helpless victim at every turn, there was the strong, vain, haughty, bossy, self-obsessed female lead. 


![1002483112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/243fvUkhQzQRgxyyYrUzzk48nzhoMwm7fsuJDiDuwsgzkvLW7pvr6YMkKsAAHfa4i8o59.jpg)


I don’t know for others, but it certainly added a lot of spice to the series, because this meant I wouldn’t have to roll my eyes every three seconds at a spineless female lead who can’t stand for herself. The same with the male lead. Instead of just nursing resentment in your heart cause you’re jealous that a man is making advances at your woman, you go straight to him and give him a stern warning. These are the things we like to see!

The plot was strong. Started strong and stayed strong till the end. I love that it visited themes of love, dysfunctional families, sacrifice, betrayal, power, greed, and every other compelling theme you would find in a cinematic masterpiece. I love that I stayed hooked from start to finish because they made each episode worth waiting for. 


![1002483076.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23yTqeHG4oiXhDoD6wVPYbWU7DwsRn2aWrCqYbQRPvYVum69VhbSZL4WzaMq4pjHhkvGZ.jpg)


Impatiently moving to the cast, permit me to take a deep breath before I start. Because what was that?? Perfect Crown? More like Perfect Cast. Whoever did the casting would never lack any good thing in life because they delivered actors who embodied their roles like they were born for it. 10/10 across boards, I didn’t find a single character lacking or unable to interpret their roles. Kudos to them, for real. 


![1002483101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23uFS1GjqRAy9VBg5vRbP9xd9Wt325yoSEHGQGrYwKuzTcXZhKKXXuse8zdPXWsEEhpBg.jpg)


I don’t want to make this long, so I’ll move straight to ships, and notable characters. Starting strong with my favourite character. Yi Yun. The Crown Prince. I love that little boy with all my heart, guys. Such a perfect actor, who puts the *A* in *A*dorable. His role embodiment would make you want to give your life for him, I promise. I loved everything he stood for so much. The way his face would light up while calling “Supu-nim” (Uncleee) oh, my heart. Hands down, my best actor. 


![1002483083.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23wgPhsGgSWMXRTrfiAxncts6DT2UGBjsDvkUkRLWuCpnJopQExMHuFaBzKjDR5HHqL9x.jpg)


Then, onto my very unproblematic chaebol couple. Taeju and Dayeong lifted my spirit, guys. I love me a man who idolizes his wife above all things, and the way they stood by each other, and mitigated each other’s excesses, was adorable to see. Imagine taking paternity leave cause your wife is pregnant. What a cutesy! I love that they didn’t villainize them. 


![1002483071.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23xeveM4VemVtqrFt1m3YP4GjyY32gqp6hzWpsTtgZG6A5Z3PrPTJRPLGf6JHCuAPhZ5D.jpg)


Hmmm, start rolling your eyes cause this one will get you all agitated, but who cares? My perfect, perfect prime minister. I don’t know if anyone shares this sentiment with me but I’m almost always rooting for the second male leads. The guys who don’t get the girl. The ones whose love may never be reciprocated. 


![1002483113.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23xAVXSsUX12i4r2YyDSmdLSe7Lqq3573et7Nu67Enc4KB8LcBdk34d1JYzR4uJZtani4.jpg)


I wanted my man to win just as much as I wanted the male lead to win. I hate that he had a communication issue, and all the villain arc he sojourned into could have easily been avoided if he had only done the right thing from the onset. But it’s fine, guys. We can only have one winner, and while I’m sad that my darling boy is currently cooling his head in prison, he can at least use that time to think of me. (Inserts evil laugh)


![1002483120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23yd5wGZbUX3KHd9dcFSyvfNZzRFA72sxrXBVAvFwG5MzTMHZ2XydaZVEavQEV8o4KU5p.jpg)


My lovely Huiju (IU). You absolutely perfect actress. Everything you touch turns to gold, for real. IU has such easy chemistry with everyone. I love that she could pull off hot without being aggravating, and pull off cute, without being annoying. She was and has always been a breath of fresh air in the K-drama industry. Super glad to watch another production of hers where she wows the audience with impeccable acting. 



![1002483068.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23yx1o25Xm1Zjku9cUbMnVECBVLXrtrjw2snokoZbCoYVypB6taVJ8eeGEepLaFJ7KLq9.jpg)



My lovely Grand Prince. I’m just so glad you didn’t die in this movie. I love the chemistry he had with his woman and how easily his long frame could perform cuteness when he wanted. Seamlessly, too. I hope he gets other roles where he gets to showcase how natural acting can be. What a lovely man.

![1002483092.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23tvCSLgmDurWtLj6WdYwdUak2x8tDeG6RQFZK2StpwX291CuuvG4rp64zH4fdipFsyFA.jpg)

![1002483110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23vsQpyWeNUtkvo9TYJxPaZJuZJXFpNKnEUBriXrTp8A9RuczGQj2UjBUXed8UZ5k5v3j.jpg)

Honourable mentions are the Aides of our leads. Special people in my heart, for real. Their love was unnecessary, in my opinion, but I didn’t cherish it any less. By the way, in another life, Secretary Do. In another life, you exquisitely ethereal being. Your fashion sense is sublime, and so are you. 

![1002483067.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jhymi/23y8vEUSeKovwuCzZJxDFzhHMCXSPJAj7SdXNvqGDPdyQM8GG1bccrJA1AkQnpNiYEhw3.jpg)



Also, the Queen Mother. You were wronged so much, and a pawn in your father’s evil schemes and machinations. You sacrificed more than was let on, and you really deserved a happy ending. I’m glad you got that in your own way. 

I think I’m beginning to write a love letter, of sorts, and while I'm aware that this isn't a thorough review, I’ll be rambling forever if I continue. If you’ve read without skipping till this point, you’re a special person, and I appreciate you. Thank you for staying till the end of my long, albeit entertaining yap session. 

Thank you “Perfect Crown” for pulling me from my two-year-long K-drama slump. I’ve not found anything so beautiful since Mr. Queen, and I’m glad I got to experience once more how it feels watching a pristine drama, in every sense of the word. Till another time, my people. For now, it’s a happy 9/10 from me. 

## Jhymi🖤

body.title: Everybody is KING 🤴: So I won't  loose my cool when I'm in your territory
body.body:
it was through Dr Myle Munroe's book, The spirit if leadership that  I discovered this hard fact, why do you think God is referred to as King of kings  and lord of lords, allow me take you through this, ....

>***come with me...***

you see, God is a very intentional  God, he carefully consider and does  everything  for a specific  reason, now imagine God creating a being in his image and likeness, that is both in and out if you  ask me, and so the question  is if such a mighty, wise, all knowing, omnipotent  God created  something  out of his own self, do you think, what he create will in any form be less than him?, the Bible said it, \

.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQbLJgCaP2vj3F2zwN1Yaf4rt9ct1Lp75FXpSYuaM9WXE/20250718_124055.jpg

through that book I discovered  that no human is less inferior or is any superior than the other we are all the same, it's  all about the matter of  SELF DISCOVERY, if any person truly comes to this point of realization  of whose image and likeness he or she is made of, that's  where it all begin, that knowing, that awareness and walking in the revelation  of that light. 

>***here's  a thing***


in his book Dr myles  Munroe  raised a question if every one is born  to lead then who becomes  the followers, if every one is king then who becomes the slaves, servant, who then handles all those odd jobs and do the hard works the answer is simple....
  
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdyaN4VC7FWNKS9AJdqvByWTTaqPhAdP3T29XjRYNtZvH/RNFetchBlobTmp_49hk3hk3efex08oyflo34.jpg
I was telling a colleague  of mine at work: a  young guy i presumed is in his teens, who i have come to work with and by experience  he's  better and I had to work  closely with him, I told him in this life no body knows it completely, somehow  life is design to balance  off that way.


 so there is something  I know way better than you, I can be like a pro or legend in that aspect,  meanwhile  you're  a total novice, on the other hand, there's  something  you know, there you're  like a legend, a prodigy while I'm  a complete novice, 

Now in these areas of strength you're king in what you know best, I too on the other hand I'm  a king with what I know best, so when I'm  in my domain around my territory doing my thing,  I flow with ease,  I'm  in my best form  I feel  good doing what I know how to do best, I'm  a king in my domain, I can teach you from scratch what  you don't  know that knowledge i have is power  to me, samething  with you and everyone else, you're king, you're  legend in your territory, in what you know how to do best,  you're  a leader or lord of your own craftsmanship,  knowing exactly what to do and what not to do, that in it's  self is the spirit of leadership, you're leading in that aspect. 

imagine everyone with this revelation and insight about who they are, coming together and God sits on his throne and looking down at the works of his creation then he is truly King of all kings and lord of all lords, that statement  isn't referring  to some monarch in your village but rather to you as a king in your own rights, gift  and talent to lead and explore the word right from your own corner. 

****image is mine****
  
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcV65vbANkWtgqEMTejQ3sNx8T1WgjpVuAZNb43YR5poe/20250611_132658.jpg

body.title: A look at the Voltage Event: The Electroneum x Splinterlands initiative! Balance Brawls, progress in Frontiers and opening of Gladius and Foundations Packs! [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
> Hello again, Splinterlands and Hivers community! Wishing you a happy Sunday, today I want to share my impressions of one of Splinterlands' most recent events. In fact, these past few weeks we've had a lot of in-game content: new conflicts, giveaways of exclusive cards, archived skins, and most recently, Lux's Favor, a prize wheel that has been added to the Frontiers format. But today I want to share with you the Voltage Event, a collaboration with the Electroneum network to bring us a special card with dual use—in both ranked and Lands! It's the legendary Electrofox card, which is currently available for pre-order for anyone with an Electroneum wallet that's been active for 30 days and has made at least a couple of transactions. This pre-sale is presented as a combo that includes 1 spellbook + 1 plot + 1K in Dec and the legendary Electrofox card. > Hola de nuevo comunidad de Splinterlands y Hivers! Deseándoles un feliz domingo, hoy les quiero compartir mis impresiones de uno de los eventos más recientes de Splinterlands, de hecho estas últimas semanas hemos tenido una gran cantidad de contenido en el juego, nuevos conflictos, sorteos de las cartas exclusivas, skins archived y la más reciente ha sido el Favor de Lux, una rueda de premios que se incorpora al formato Frontier. Pero hoy quiero compartir con ustedes el evento Voltage Event que es una colaboración con la red de Electroneum para traernos una carta especial con un uso doble, en el ranking como en Lands! Se trata de la carta legendaria Electrofox que en este momento esta en preventa para todos aquellos que tienen una billetera en Electroneum con una antigüedad de 30 días y han hecho al menos un par de transacciones con ellas. Esta preventa se presenta como un combo que incluye 1 spellbook + 1 parcela + 1K en Dec y la carta legendaria Electrofox.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQqfA5qqr9xysg7ZDWirSEczF2CqfgbtT5TwLJW3P6rp/image.png)

> I'm very interested in this combo because it's focused on Lands, and as I shared in my last post, I'm committed to developing plots that produce two resources: grain and stone. This combo gives us the opportunity to add a grain plot with 1,000 Dec, which is always useful, and most importantly, the legendary card Electrofox, with a functionality exclusive to Lands. But before we look at that aspect, let's review this card's role in the Splinterlands ranking. > Tengo un gran interés en este combo porque esta enfocado a Lands que como ya les he compartido en mi último post, estoy comprometido con el desarrollo de parcelas que producen 2 recursos: grano y piedra. Y este combo nos da la oportunidad de sumar una parcela de granos con 1000 Decs que siempre sirven y lo más importante, la carta legendaria Electrofox con una funcionalidad exclusiva para Lands, pero antes de ver este aspecto vamos a revisar el papel de esta carta en el ranking de Splinterlands.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQiL9QxQK7xJu3EYcPUST7xwvnmatn5b69um6K4tvxc3/image.png)

> Let's start with the most immediate characteristic of this card, which is its dual-element nature: water/fire, giving it enormous versatility for the modern format's meta. Next, we have its stats. This is a melee card with the Opportunistic ability, dealing 3 damage, 3 speed, and 7 health, all for a cost of 5 mana from level 1. It's undoubtedly a very competent card even at level 1. Its main drawback is the Electrified ability, which applies electrical damage to all units in battle. However, this isn't necessarily a disadvantageous ability; Electrified is ideal for maximizing its Painforge ability, which boosts the damage of units with this ability when they are hit by Electrified. > Comencemos por la característica más inmediata de esta carta, que es su naturaleza bi elemental: agua/fuego lo que le da una enorme versatilidad para el meta del formato moderno. Luego tenemos sus estadísticas, esta es una carta melé que cuenta con la habilidad oportunista y tiene 3 de daño, 3 de velocidad y 7 de vida, todo esto por un costo de 5 de mana desde el nivel 1. Es sin duda una carta muy competente ya desde el nivel 1, como desventaja tenemos que esta carta cuenta con la habilidad electrified que aplica daño de electricidad a todas nuestras unidades en batalla, esta no es necesariamente una habilidad desventajosa, electrified es la habilidad ideal para activar su habilidad al máximo nivel: painforge que potencia el daño de las unidades que ostentan esta habilidad al ser dañados por electrified.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme38sVtSZtZxgj5FmhJZA8pce2fTQyRyaRsuzjdFuyot1/image.png)

> Then we have the aspect that interests me most: the use of this card in Lands. First, there's its Energized ability from level 1, which means that when it's blocked on your land, it will act as a power core, activating your terrain so you can put your workers to work. The second and most innovative aspect is its Static Charge ability, which will generate EVP, a token that allows us to purchase special reward chests, including the Electroneum blockchain token, ETN. These advantages are what have caught my attention, because we would be obtaining more rewards from the work done than this card would generate if it were locked on our land, in addition to saving us the cost of buying a power source. > Luego tenemos la faceta que más me interesa, el uso de esta carta en Lands, lo primero es su habilidad energized desde el 1er nivel que significa que al ser bloqueada en tu parcela, va a fungir como un núcleo de poder que activará tu terreno para que puedas poner tus trabajadores a trabajar. Lo segundo y más novedoso es su habilidad Static Charge que nos va a generar EVP, un token que nos permitirá comprar cofres de recompensas especiales, entre ellas el token de la blockchain de Electroneum ETN. Estas ventajas son las que me han llamado mucho la atención, porque estaríamos obteniendo más recompensas del trabajo que realice que esta carta bloqueada en tu terreno, además de ahorrarte la compra de una fuente de poder.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeZa4rJNosbiCFTVyEPStLLVjR3DF9r4msG67NdbUA7vy/image.png)

> In total, there are 4 types of chests that can be purchased with the EVP generated by the Electrofox card: Volt, Arcing, Hyper, and Aurelius, each with a higher probability of dropping better rewards. As you can see, the rewards beyond ETN tokens also include special Electrofox foil cards and special skins, Glints, energy, and Frontier packs. Therefore, I would like to invest in leveling this card to level 3 and generating up to 30 EVP points, which would allow us to buy Arcing/Hyper chests that would give us good reward opportunities. > En total se tienen 4 tipos de cofres que se podrán comprar con los EVP que generan con la carta Electrofox: volt, arcing, hyper y aurelius cada uno con probabilidades mayores en dropear mejores recompensas. Como pueden ver las recompensas más allá de tokens ETN son también cartas de lámina especial Electrofox y skins especiales, Glints, energía y también paquetes Frontier. Por eso me gustaría hacer la inversión en llevar esta carta hasta el nivel 3 y generar hasta 30 puntos de EVP que nos permitiría comprar arcing/hyper chest que nos daría buenas oportunidades de recompensas.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRE5K4LzLNbCduoPtFEHRSpyTuMspNQH86FNUBztLiH2S/image.png)

> In short, friends, I've loved this event, and the combo that includes a grain plot seems like an excellent offer to start using this card. Yes, I want this card to use for growing my plots; in fact, with that plot, I'd reach 5 lands, which would give me the Warden suffix, granting me a 5% bonus to ranked wins. Now, upgrading this card to level 3 is a decision I'm weighing up in terms of cost-benefit in the medium and long term. In any case, once I have this combo in my hands, I'll share my overall impressions of this event. > En resumen amigos, este evento me ha encantado y el combo que contiene una parcela de granos me parece una oferta excelente para comenzar a usar esta carta, porque si, quiero esta carta para usarla en el crecimiento de mis parcelas, de hecho con esa parcela llegaría a las 5 tierras por lo que me ganaría el sufijo de Warden que me conferiría un 5% de bonificación en las victorias de ranking. Ahora, llevar a nivel 3 esta carta si es una decisión que estoy evaluando costo/beneficio en el mediano y largo plazo. En cualquier caso, cuando ya tenga en mis manos este combo les compartiré mis impresiones generales sobre este evento.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcEc996ubn4MP1J5RhZddb1BcdH2VWj3juthKacsD2h9o/image.png)
# Balance Brawl

> Just yesterday we finished the Brawl cycle for this third week of May, and once again we competed in the Wild/Silver League. This time we did much better than in my last report. I'm finally getting used to using Archons in the Silver League because I've been playing in the Wild/Gold League for almost two years now, and it's been slow to adapt, especially since I'm even playing in the Gold League in Modern. In any case, we secured first place and earned a large number of Merits to spend on several Gladius cases. > Justo ayer terminamos el ciclo de Brawls de esta tercera semana de mayo, y nuevamente repetimos en la refriega de liga wild/plata y esta vez nos fue mucho mejor que en mi último reporte y es que ya me estoy adaptando mejor a usar arcontes en la liga de plata porque desde hace ya casi 2 años he estado jugando en la liga de wild/oro y ha sido lento el poder adaptarme ya que incluso en moderno estoy jugando en la liga de oro. En cualquier caso ya aseguramos el primer lugar y obtuvimos una gran cantidad de Méritos para invertirlos en varios Gladius cases.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSdWiWffp9mz63ZCAdxQRsozLTvqV8z5BaCmtpCoTcsdk/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUa7dYRHPKqQD1jk6TMe2F6GEHjViTi85qMe2UrHoazTK/image.png) --|--

> With this victory, we've now reached 621,000 merits and our gladiuses are at a good level, almost at the top of the gold league. Our gladiator cards are there, so I'll be managing my merit spending carefully to keep a good amount of these tokens in reserve for a possible new round of gladiator cards. I also have about 200 gladius cases in reserve, but I'm saving them for my first 3speak video, so for now I'm being frugal with my merits and will only spend them on 6 gladius cases for this event, since I have several common and rare gladiator cards close to being upgraded. > Con esta victoria, ya sumamos 621K méritos y ya tenemos nuestras gladius a un buen nivel, casi al tope de la liga de oro tenemos nuestras cartas gladiadoras por lo que estaré administrando la cantidad de méritos que estaré gastando para tener una buena cantidad de estos tokens en reserva para una eventual nueva ronda de cartas gladiadoras. También tengo en reserva unos 200 gladius cases pero los tengo para hacer mi primer video en 3speak, así que por ahora estoy en modo ahorrativo con los méritos y solo para este caso gastaré en 6 gladius cases ya que tengo varias gladiadoras comunes y raras cerca de subirlos de nivel. ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVVcpwVnk7M1rmbfaXf27K2rp4xub5kYbR2vaXiPLyyrW/open_gladius_case_blkths_23_6_26_i.gif)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXufcK8UQVQdbV1QG5K3trDFhGuGjCJGWqtg6Hqfxeo9X/open_gladius_case_blkths_23_6_26_ii.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZqpRu1uAxYvqmKXeWJy26LC5v5wkFDQ4YUQf9RGQTdNU/open_gladius_case_blkths_23_6_26_iii.gif)

> We were lucky enough to complete enough copies to get Palidon Rakk to level 7; he's our fourth rare gladiator at this level. I would have considered leveling these cards up to 7 because they can be used with a level 5 epic archon in the gold league, but now that I've been assigned to skirmishes in the silver league, I'm not in such a hurry to level these cards up to 7. > Tuvimos la suerte de completar las copias suficientes para llevar a Palidon Rakk a nivel 7, es nuestro cuarto gladiador raro en este nivel. me habría planteado llevar estas cartas a nivel 7 porque pueden usarse con un arconte épico a nivel 5 en la liga de oro, pero ahora que fui asignado para las refriegas en la liga de plata ya no tengo tanta premura en llevar a nivel 7 estas cartas.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRHJbtwqbCx1cxhB1trgCA4TaxoYxgT5nrqUG4Xg4hbUF/palidon_rakk_lvl_3.gif)

> We also got two epic cards: Gorth, which I haven't had a clear opportunity to use in Brawls, and Quora, which I was also desperately trying to get to level 5. I'm still missing six copies, but since the maximum level I can use it at in Silver is 3 in both Modern and Brawls, I'm happy to have it at level 4 and gradually get enough copies to get it to level 5. > También conseguimos 2 cartas épicas: Gorth del que no he tenido una oportunidad clara para usarlo en las Brawls y Quora que también estaba en una carrera desenfrenada por llevarla a nivel 5 pero aún me faltan 6 copias pero ya que el máximo nivel al que puedo usarla en plata es 3 tanto en modern como en Brawls, estoy tranquilo con tenerla en nivel 4 y gradualmente conseguir las copias suficientes para llevarla a nivel 5.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaaDmMNj6Gcxc1Gf3o6WHoEWjLVNioc4gtHWecbTF2yte/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbDDqW7hdhTBqTsYNkKCkCzcSJsv5o7q9dodpa2RHMjZU/image.png) --|--
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmToeemgrDhHEs8omcPDiQ7SixoHKsueA3NQ6k288FpUp4/ca_sponsor_3_removebg_preview.png)
# Foundations card progress/Progresos en mis cartas Foundations

> To wrap things up, we managed to upgrade a couple of Foundations cards this past week. We've also been spinning the wheel for six consecutive days and are already over 1000 Sparks. We're still a ways off from the amount needed to buy cosmetics in the shop, although I'm not too eager to buy them. I just want to keep accumulating Sparks for better items later on. So far, we've opened five packs with great results! I'll share them with you below. > Para cerrar logramos upgradear un par de cartas Foundations esta semana que terminó, también tenemos 6 días continuos girando la ruleta y ya estamos sobre los 1000 Sparks, aún falta para llegar a la cantidad necesaria para comprar los cosméticos en la tienda aunque no estoy tan ansioso por comprarlos, solo seguir acumulando por mejores objetos más adelantes. Hasta ahora hemos abierto 5 packs con muy buenos resultados! A continuación te los comparto.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcwfnxpRJhveBKeaBeZrisFQFmYQq6ymApfxTctkwER6a/open_foundation_packs_17_5_26.gif)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNtuznJXEs9YV8cUwiDS8YxHCJebVs8FC8oFrvEcHNDnW/open_foundation_packs_20_5_26.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPk56FEGceLwG2ueK9htqFrkumstafqnZVJLmcMK1ZaTV/open_foundation_packs_21_5_26.gif)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeumgNhcXB6bQT6uwiGwaNXenVCcZ6RhQ1z1SsxuaZbD4/open_foundations_packs_22_5_26.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR15aU6n4qAkBcKGtVrSQ1NRfpFGyWV93XzMWdn73Pg1d/open_foundation_cards_18_5_26.gif)

> Most of the cards I still need to upgrade are epic rarity, meaning they're the hardest to obtain along with legendaries, but this week we managed to get enough to upgrade two of them. The first is Lady Amara. This card, now at level 3, can withstand a lot of damage. I usually use her as a tank in battles where only magic units are allowed. The only thing I didn't like was that her speed increased to 2, affecting the advantage she had in reverse-speed battles. > La mayoría de las cartas que me faltan por upgradear son de rareza épica, es decir las más difíciles de conseguir junto a las legendarias, pero esta semana logramos conseguir las suficientes para upgradear 2 de ellas. La primera es Lady Amara, esta carta ahora en nivel 3 aguanta mucho daño, la suelo usar como tanque en esas batallas donde solo se pueden usar unidades mágicas. Lo único que no me gustó fue que su velocidad aumentó a 2, afectando la ventaja que tenía en batallas de velocidad inversa.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQWaeo7e7jrgKUWkxwoFRB2hNrFpCqVaj3AQVNqcWbzJD/lady_amara_lvl_3.gif)

> The second card to upgrade was Sorrow Harvester, a card I'd been waiting a long time to max out. I needed that extra hit point because now, at this high in the rankings, battles are extremely close and are usually decided by just 1 or 2 hit points. In this context, I'm now less afraid to place this card in the top positions since it can withstand several direct attacks. > La segunda carta en upgradear fue Sorrow Harvester, una carta que estuve esperando mucho para llevarla al máximo, necesitaba ese punto extra de vida porque ahora tan alto en el ranking, las batallas son extremadamente cerradas y se definen por lo general 1 o 2 puntos de vida. En este contexto, ahora tengo menos miedo de ubicar esta carta en las primeras posiciones ya que puede aguantar varios ataques directos.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmez9A9BgVD2TvtUmhHF5eibsjukQ8PbVSGYrw9VKa6WLu/sorrow_harvester_lvl_3.gif)

> Only 2 maxed-out cards, it seems like a small amount but it's actually great progress considering I only need 3 more epic Foundation cards at level 3. My priority right now is upgrading the water card Asel, which I use a lot in Frontier; second is the death card Lenore Nevermore; and lastly Glimmermancer, which I don't usually use that often in either Frontier or Modern, so I'm happy keeping it at level 2 for now. > Solo 2 cartas maxeadas, parece poco pero en realidad es un gran progreso considerando que solo me faltan 3 cartas épicas Foundation a nivel 3. La prioridad por ahora es upgradear la carta de agua Asel que la uso mucho en Frontier, en segundo lugar la de muerte Lenore Nevermore y por último Glimmermancer que no suelo usarlo con tanta frecuencia ni en Frontier, ni en Modern así que contenerla en nivel 2 estoy satisfecho por ahora.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQbbd4KrnzBcfegcLJUaSqNgknUxazkmAQDd8D11N8ac/image.png)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcEc996ubn4MP1J5RhZddb1BcdH2VWj3juthKacsD2h9o/image.png)

> Well, friends, these were my impressions of the Voltage Event. I'm now convinced to buy one of the bundles because, ultimately, I couldn't celebrate Bitcoin Pizza Day and was planning to buy it with HBD (Happy Birthday), so I'm going to invest in this offer, which seems like a good opportunity. Otherwise, we're continuing to make progress with our Gladiator and Foundation cards, which, although slow, is consistent, and I'm very happy about that. The challenge now remains the reward cards; we still don't have our first epic reward card, so we must take advantage of every season and every Glint to at least get those cards to level 3. See you in the next report. Best regards. > Bien amigos, estas fueron mis impresiones del Evento Voltaje del cual estoy ya convencido de comprar uno de esos bundles porque en última instancia, no pude celebrar el Bitcoin Pizza Day y pensaba comprarla con HBD, así que voy a invertirlos en esta oferta que me parece una buena oportunidad. De resto, seguimos avanzando con nuestras cartas Gladiadoras y Foundations que aunque poco, nos mantenemos constantes y estoy muy satisfecho por eso. Ahora el reto sigue siendo las cartas rewards que aún no tenemos la primera carta épica reward, por lo que debemos aprovechar cada temporada y cada Glint para al menos tener esas cartas en nivel 3. Nos vemos en un próximo reporte. Saludos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23w2h1pfjUzPGN6DEFEq6UrLcngGWUKNE6TwVbMb3YJDerXKXnvjgXJgjTdBup5CQtbMa.png)

body.title: Turbulentno
body.body:

body.title: Social Media and Charity
body.body: > I've come across the interaction between social media and charity, and I must say this topic is an interesting and necessary one. I believe it's not only me, but many if not all of us must have seen this interaction and how it's gaining more traction and somewhat becoming a norm today. Well, you could wonder why or how? Is it that there's so much charity today that social media has no choice but to place it before our eyes? https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdwmJuaxwru1cy5dijDqrE5xWhrQddVAHth86C8iuKaCa/file_00000000b0f871f4837673ee1754bd29.png Social media can help or mar a course. And with charity, I think it goes both ways. We see people showing off the smallest acts of charity done for some reason that one can't tell or find a good reason behind. Even some of the NGOs are not left out as some use social media to deceive or amplify their deeds beyond measure. I think that when we go back to the basics of charity as giving for a good cause, these issues can be avoided. Nevertheless, I understand the place of social media as a tool for good in charity. It's just that it has been abused and misused for this purpose as much as for other purposes that social media is instrumental in. As one who works with a foundation and in the social media aspect or team, I reckon the powerful tool that social media is for the course of charity. When used well and properly, it will do more for charity, which I've seen it do. The advantages and help are there. It helps gain visibility for charity works and welcomes donors and donations. I remember when a group I belonged to wanted to visit an orphanage. I designed the flyer and we posted it on our social media which helped us gain some donations. It also helps highlight the struggles of some people that others would never know. But by accessing them and sharing their struggles and stories, help comes. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcoJnR3skhWw8oryLDdCD5y84BWXMMxCen1Pm4BGhs7Cp/file_000000006bf471f4a51bda6c77faada1.png All these good comes from the influence of social media on charity. It also helps to show donors that their donations were put to good use. Well, if not manipulated, which is the way some have abused social media in the guise of charity. Some use it to chase clout, engagement and all that. I used to be all happy when I saw, especially individuals, doing charity work on social media. But I've come to understand the intentions, lies and deceits of some, taking away that instant good feeling about it. A lot of the so-called charities are not what they really seem. People want to give and have it all over the social media space. We must have seen some of these people online. And while they might receive applause, the intentions matter. You can't use people's unfortunate situations to create a facade for yourself online. I admit that there are lots of good intention charities out there, which should keep on the work, get support and utilise social media for good. --- *Images are AI generated.* --- ###### Thank you for reading! Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@daverick/social-media-and-charity-dyj)

body.title: Нова стара релігія — гроші
body.body:
![photo_2026-05-24_23-48-20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uakulinar/EoGxrpXrrhw8U6j439p3FajD8a59XTCmqsqvZ4RTEva8fWK5ajQj4btxqx6GpT4FnKS.jpg)



Привіт! Бути бідним трішки соромно, правда ж? Знаю пару “приятелів”, котрі при зустрічі розповідають про свої нові машини. Насправді ж, ідять на зйомних квартирах локшину, одягаються в ношені речі і взагалі ходять пішки. Я навіть не викриваю їх брехні й не сміюся над ними. Просто слухаю чергову маячню з думкою, чому він це взагалі “несе”. А причина проста — бідним бути соромно. Чому так? Бо так влаштовано суспільство. Заради грошей продають друзів, батьків, дітей... Заради цієї пустоти лізуть в кредитне рабство й купують те, що їм не потрібно взагалі. Але ж статус...

Гроші — це релігія, найсильніша та найпотіжніша у світі. Від традиційного визначення, фінансову релігію відрізняє заміна культурно-духовних та моральних цінностей на матеріальні, де вищими силами є звичайні папірці. Фінансова релігія, як і звичайна, формує поведінку людей, змінює правила, має звичаї та обряди, правда, у власній, я б сказав, аморальній площині. 

Всім добра!

body.title: Memorial Day Weekend Check In
body.body:
<center>![IMG_2656.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coinjoe/23wqrjMyUZU93Z3FyHiN4F5v9DRYmUmcgt3CmDotkp3DuBRGXJm3pZ3Lu4sbxqNnBFqdW.jpeg)</center>

Been nose down in school work lately. Lots of reading. Tons of reading. Lots of researching literature and writing as well. Real time consuming. Being honest, I don't feel like blogging and commenting much after all that. It's just all mentally draining. After spending hours reading and writing for school, the last thing I want to do is more reading and writing.

I do have a new course that started though. The material is stuff I'm very familiar with. So it comes second nature. Hopefully that means I'll spend a little more time working on some chores here at home now. And maybe even blogging and commenting here on Hive. We'll see.

Good news. My cherry tomatoes have finally sprouted. I thought they were a loss. Had written them off completely after the mess I made planting them. Seeds floating everywhere. Containers falling apart. A real disaster. But today I noticed them sprouting from the containers. Life finds a way I guess. The strawberries are still a no show though. May have to accept that one as a loss.

Still making a dent in the garage. A little at a time. All the rain we've had hasn't helped. I want to drag a bunch of stuff out of the garage and sort it that way. Can't do that with the rain. So it's been slow going.

I'm mad at myself. I let the rain cut into my walking. Even though we have a walking pad in the basement, I still did not walk at all this last week. Doom on me for that. I will do better. No excuses. The walking pad is right there. Rain doesn't matter when you've got one in the basement.


That's it for now. I'm a few beers into Memorial Day weekend and not much else to write about.

To all my fellow veterans, hope you're taking a moment this weekend to remember the ones who didn't make it home. That's what this weekend is about. Enjoy your time with family. Raise a glass. Remember.

Thanks for reading,
Joe

body.title: Midnight My relaxation Time
body.body: >My safe haven for relaxation is really accessible and it comes up every day or should i say midnight, it would simply require bringing out a mat or a beach chair and sitting outside at night especially after it rains. No fancy destination, no expensive getaway that i have to drive to, just the quiet atmosphere, and my thoughts. Most people would generally think relaxation has to involve going somewhere luxurious or doing something exciting, but for me that peace can be found in the simplest moments. During the rainy season especially, the environment feels so cool and peaceful at the same time. The smell of wet earth, the cool breeze is next to none.

>What makes it even better for me is the silence, im someone who generally likes my own space and more often than not i like being alone. So the night is the only time that i can get to be by my lone self without any distractions. No noise, no distractions, Just sitting outside gives me time to breathe properly and clear my head. Sometimes I don’t even think about anything serious, I just watch the sky slowly darken while enjoying the cool atmosphere or i can just be doom scrolling through my phone. Other times, it becomes a moment of reflection where ideas come naturally and my mind feels more open and creative.

>I think many people underestimate how healing solitude can be. The rainy season makes this experience even more comforting because the weather itself encourages stillness. Unlike the harsh heat that can make sitting outside uncomfortable, the coolness of the rain creates the perfect environment to relax without stress. A simple mat or chair suddenly becomes the best seat in the world.

>For me, that is my safe haven, those quiet moments outside where the world becomes calm, the air feels fresh, and I can simply exist without distractions. It may seem simple to others, but sometimes the simplest forms of peace are the most genuine ones. I cant even wait to get married and share this moment with my significant other, im sure it'd be even more special. Lol!!

Para mí lo más difícil ha sido enfrentar el miedo al rechazo y a ser juzgado. Creo que es algo que todo ser humano teme... Pero allí es donde está la parte positiva de esa paradoja. 


Lo más hermoso ha sido ser fuerte pase lo que pase, digan lo que digan... Y aceptar desde el fondo que no siempre voy a encajar y que mi identidad emocional y psicológica es una sola, que es un auténtico regalo y que no puedo ni debo sacrificar eso por nada. Aunque vivimos en un mundo cada vez más estereotipado, exigente y absurdamente vacío... Lo más bonito de todo es convertirse en una fortaleza guardando la identidad y siendo uno mismo, en paz con la conciencia y en paz con el Creador. 

Lo demás es estorbo.

body.title: WHERE TO RELAX #290
body.body: I can not say I have a particular relaxation spot or place, but whenever It’s time to relax or unwind I always try to do so. Lately I have discovered that relaxation does not have to be done in a place as it can be a state of mind. Tomorrow is going to be a busy day, every Monday is a busy day. I am looking forward to it with a lot of enthusiasm, and I am learning how to make my work a hobby as I have seen it as a great way to train my mind to do and be the best. I have also wondered how CEOs find time to rest with the way they work, I look at myself and how I get tired after every little job and look at them and feel they aren't human.\n\n

/> [Image by katemangostar on Magnific](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/serene-black-man-resting-park-listening-music_2540630.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=0&uuid=afc78a85-2cf6-4f8e-91c7-b3555e971b2e&query=RELAXATION) Turns out these people are humans who just reason differently. While we (employees) are thinking, let me work, go home and rest. They are thinking So long I can work, my mind is at rest. These are totally different mentalities and it’s something not easy to cultivate. This is why they are not just passionate about their job, but seem to look like superhumans doing it. I want to cultivate this habit not because I want extra pay, but because it will help me build a work-rest culture where my work gives me a state of peace and tranquility. Rest is not just what you go to do, it is where you are mentally. So tomorrow when the day gets busy, I plug on my headphones, listen to a few fantasy stories, and try to be at rest while taking on whatever comes my way. Each time I try it I do not easily get exhausted, but then again, sometimes things get overwhelming and I don’t know when I enter into panic or stress mood. This is not a mood I like being in, but sometimes it is hard to just get away from it especially when the challenge before me is a very peculiar one. > THIS IS MY RESPONSE LADIES ON HIVE [CONTEST](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-290) #290

body.title: The Second Sunrise
body.body:
There is a terrifying beauty in the moment the heart decides to open again. After years of building walls, checking locks, and convincing ourselves that the cold is safer than the flame, a single spark catches. It feels like a betrayal of the person who swore they were done with this, yet it feels like the first deep breath after a long winter. To fall in love again is an act of rebellion—a quiet, brave refusal to let the past have the final word on your happiness. ***

The Second Sunrise

I told my heart the doors were bolted tight,
That I had learned to navigate the night.
I built a fortress out of stone and salt,
And brought the turning world to a sudden halt.
\

I whispered to the dust,
Watching the hinges settle into rust.

But then you came, a soft and steady light,
A gentle blur against the black and white.
No crashing thunder or a sudden storm,
Just a quiet way of making shadows warm.
And one by one, the heavy iron bars,
Began to reflect the light of new-found stars.

It’s frightening to feel the thaw begin,
To let the wild, uncertain weather in.
To risk the breaking and the sharp-edged fall,
To hear the echoes through the hollow hall.
But there’s a music in the way you speak,
That makes the strongest fortress feel so weak.

So here I am, with hands that slightly shake,
Ready to see what new path we might make.
A second blooming in a tired field,
A heart that’s finally willing now to yield.
The winter’s over, though the scars remain,
I’m brave enough to fall in love again. *** Falling in love the second time is actually braver than the first. The first time, you didn't know how much it could hurt; this time, you know exactly what’s at stake, and you choose to walk forward anyway. It is an acknowledgment that the potential for joy is worth the risk of pain. You aren't erasing your history; you are simply starting a new chapter where the light is allowed to shine through the cracks of everything you’ve survived.

I had to look for intel to expose the treasurer's identity, searching through local records and whispering crowds to find a solid lead. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU86outbiBDHGbd7YwEQNB9LTCyU3saWEtwcWk8QKpH5z/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdqPYjKbNHwguKX4aCxqtag4HWnGo5AjxGRCcxsRuXgR3/screenshot_3_.png) I called in Enkidu to look for intel in the bazaar from a high bird's-eye view. body.title: Finding Beauty in Ordinary Days 🌸
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbBaUTwZoqYPHHiRMxQpLGqShpLdJ2g7NypiTmKEuo24q/IMG_5318.jpg 


Today was one of those simple days that reminded me how important it is to slow down and appreciate the present.

Between work, responsibilities, and taking care of my child, life can feel like a nonstop race. But every now and then, I enjoy sitting down, taking a deep breath, and reflecting on how far I've come. The journey hasn't been easy, but every challenge has taught me something valuable.

I still have big dreams. I want to build financial freedom, grow my investments, and create opportunities that allow me to spend more time with the people who matter most. Until then, I will keep working, learning, and believing in myself.

The future is built one day at a time, and today was a good day. 🤍

body.title: Procrastination In Progress
body.body: /> Should be working on my first post for Substack, but my brain has other ideas currently. _Why write an introductory post when you could be reading about intermediate range ballistic missiles and loitering munitions? Do anti-loitering laws apply to drones?_ Serious business. . .

/> Brains are weird. Can get an absurd amount of work done in a rather short period of time, just as long as it isn't the thing that is supposed to be getting done. _Still haven't figured out why mine is convinced that 0200 is the best time to run the vacuum cleaner._
/> Probably has something to do with the fact that at the end of the day we're just critters with delusions of grandeur. _Could explain our preference for cocaine over churu._
/> Definitely makes our penchant for violence make more sense. _Murder turkeys with multiple independently targetable reentry vehicles._ Say hi MIRV!

/>\n\nDon't know how we wandered down this rabbit hole but we seem to have ended up with critter photos, which is probably the best you can hope for when procrastinating. _Now where did that typewriter get to?_ Alright, enough of this, time to get to work (again). _Don't forget to pet the critters for me!_

This topic was geared toward each member of the community, telling us their thoughts on our earnings being made public for everyone to see.
