body.title: 🏁 From the gym to the coast: 5.7 km of pure grit/ 🏁 Del gimnasio a la costa: 5.7 km con todo
body.body: > **English version:** Just because we're focused on the gym doesn't mean we've left our runner souls behind. Yesterday, José and I proved that strength and endurance can go hand in hand. We ran 5.7 km straight to **Playas del Este** – one of those routes that tests your legs but rewards your spirit. The sun was out, the pace was honest, and the finish line was the sea breeze hitting our faces after crossing the last stretch of sand. No special event. No medals. Just two friends who refuse to stop moving, whether it's under a barbell or on open pavement. We're combining gym sessions with running because real fitness isn't about choosing – it's about integrating. The result? Stronger legs for lifting, better lungs for running, and the satisfaction of reaching the beach on our own power. 🌊 **Finish line:** Playas del Este 📏 **Distance:** 5.7 km 💪 **Lesson learned:** You can build muscle and still chase kilometers. * * *

>

**Versión en español:** Solo porque estamos metidos en el gimnasio no significa que hayamos dejado atrás nuestra esencia de corredores. Ayer, José y yo demostramos que la fuerza y la resistencia pueden ir de la mano. Corrimos 5.7 km directo hasta **Playas del Este** una de esas rutas que pone a prueba tus piernas pero recompensa tu espíritu. El sol nos acompañó, el ritmo fue honesto y la meta fue la brisa del mar golpeándonos la cara después del último tramo de arena. Nada de eventos especiales. Ni medallas. Solo dos amigos que se niegan a dejar de moverse, ya sea bajo una barra o sobre el asfalto. Estamos combinando el gimnasio con las carreras porque el verdadero estado físico no se trata de elegir, sino de integrar. ¿El resultado? Piernas más fuertes para levantar peso, mejor capacidad pulmonar para correr y la satisfacción de llegar a la playa con nuestro propio esfuerzo. 🌊 **Meta:** Playas del Este 📏 **Distancia:** 5.7 km 💪 **Lección aprendida:** Se puede ganar músculo y seguir sumando kilómetros.

>My dear community, today I want to show you how to make some delicious homemade frozen papaya treats and a divine papaya drink—perfect for these hot summer days. We’re in the harvest season for papaya plants, as they’re known in my country, Venezuela. You can eat the fruit fresh, or enjoy it in ice cream, juices, or a divine papaya drink. In fact, in my hometown of Carora, in Lara state, there’s a shop that sells mamón slushies, and it’s famous for its mamonada. With around 47 years of history, it’s a must-stop for many travelers passing through on their way. Whenever you’re walking down Avenida Calor, the heat and sun are the perfect excuse for a delicious mamón ice cream, and I highly recommend these tasty treats. Today I’m going to show you how to make a papaya treat, which you can enjoy as a delicious juice or in creamy papaya ice cream. Although I’ll tell you that I’m thinking of restarting my business selling my homemade frozen treats, since I’m currently unemployed and it’s a steady income and a distraction to keep my mind off all the stressful things. >Mi estimada comunidad, hoy quiero enseñarles hacer unas ricas tetas heladas artesanales y una divina mamonada, refrescante para estos días calurosos del verano, estamos en la temporada de las cosechas de las plantas de mamones como se conoce en mi país Venezuela, se puede comer la fruta directamente, también en helados , jugos o una divina mamonada, incluso en mi pueblo Carora, estado Lara, hay un negocio de venta de helados granizados de mamón , y es famoso por la mamonada, alrededor de 47 años de trayectoria, es una parada obligatoria para muchos que pasan y siguen en la vía, con su viaje, siempre que andas por la avenida calor, sol es la excusa perfecta de un rico helado de mamón y les recomiendo estos ricos helados. >Hoy les voy a enseñar como hacer una mamonada, que la puedes tomar en jugo riquísimos el sabor y en helados cremosos de mamon. >Aunque les cuento que pienso en retomar mi emprendimiento de vender mis tetas heladas artesanales, ya que estoy sin empleo y esa es una entrada fija y una distracción para no pensar tantas cosas estresantes.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmSsyMtyChCLfuzHdyxta5MN7YcXzSAgUT2zp31oWgbyGf/image.png
##
INGREDIENTS//INGREDIENTES
1.50 kg of milk-fed piglets. 1 liter of whole milk. 300 g of sugar (to taste). 3 tablespoons of cornstarch. 200 g of powdered milk. 1 tablespoon of vanilla extract. 1 package of 1/4-kilo clear bags. >1.50 kg Mamones. 01 Litro Leche entera. 300 gr Azúcar al gusto. 03 Cucharadas de fécula de maíz. 200 gr Leche en polvo. 01 Cucharada de vainilla. 01 Paquete bolsas transparentes de 1/4 kilo. ##
Preparation//Preparación
1.- First, wash the conch thoroughly with plenty of water and begin peeling them by removing the shells. Choose the best ones—the ones that are large and meaty. >1.- Para iniciar debemos lavar muy bien los mamones con abundante agua y comenzar a pelar retirándoles las conchas, escoger los mejores , que estén bien grandes y carnosos.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmTRexpk3U4Z31ZerrM35y9V4Ya2zdURWmC2NV9TkVoZCv/image.png
Place them in a bowl with a little sugar and let them sit for about thirty minutes. >Colocarlos en un tazón con un poco de azúcar y dejarlo reposar por unos treinta minutos alrededor.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmZd6sHh6PHWXzABroh2LAqkMeijmuPE5XN1ketFwE4ySr/image.png
2.- Next, in the same bowl, start the mixer on low speed to stir the flesh of the papaya. Gradually stir to completely separate the seeds from the flesh, and this way you’ll have almost all the flesh separated. >2.- Seguidamente en el mismo tazón , comenzar con la batidora, batir a velocidad bajas para remover la carne o pulpa del mamón, ir moviendo poco a poco para despulpar completamente las pepas, y asi tendremos casi toda la pulpa separada.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmd9G9c1yXX6szvs1e68F5o7bj1cH4Y4NP9tNutUjSwtkP/image.png
3.- Begin slowly adding the milk, beating on low speed. >3.- Comenzar a colocarle la leche líquida suavemente, batir a baja velocidad.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmRMAQkVpgSXEHmFo4zCURQCtFARwQ8F65Lw5BYqpapQZg/image.png
Add 200 grams of milk; the mixture will begin to thicken, and continue stirring the pulp. >Le agregaremos 200 gr de leche y se comienza a espesar la mamonada, y se sigue removiendo la pulpa.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmTNE5YpLC6bga9vBTaXFSYSmPQbENirLE3fhZ1maftLV7/image.png
4.- Once the mixture has thickened, use a strainer to separate the pulp-free milk, leaving behind the mixture of milk and pulp. >4.- Luego de tener la mezcla espesa, con el colador vamos a separar los mamones sin pulpas, para ir dejando la mezcla de leche con pulpa.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmdFquyrj3feGEAGrmyaKJ3oL7DQZTzVjd259RReQLqY1H/image.png
Once it's ready, you can juice it—it's super refreshing, whether you add ice or chill it. >Cuando este así podemos sacar el jugo, es super refrescante le agregas hielo o lo enfrias.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmNbi1H1tMV4hZ1CCfCsHZA1MU1adZajXBtTeHX3M4QnDt/image.png
5.- Place the entire mixture in a pot and cook over medium heat. I had some milk set aside to mix with the cornstarch to prevent lumps; add this to the pot, stir well to prevent sticking, and turn off the heat as soon as it starts to boil. >5.- Colocaremos en una olla toda la mezcla, a cocinar a fuego moderado, tenia una leche reservada para mezclarla con la fécula de maíz, que nos quede grumos, luego la vamos a agregar a la olla de la mezcla, revolver bien, que nos se nos pegue y apagar al comenzar hervir.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZsmYjvuTNmJdP29gTfnphYRbSTB2iYLcnA7Bbmma2PAS/image.png)

7.- Once the glasses have been prepared with the small bags and are the perfect size, we will proceed to add the mixture. >7.- Ya preparados los vasos preparados con las bolsitas, y con la medida perfecta, procederemos a agregar la mezcla.

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmZnygCRAqC2xjki5Dk9HotAA2tVtvoyWLgFEEEuA1pjaV/image.png Our frozen cones will be shaped like cones; tie them with a knot and place them in the freezer for a moderate amount of time until they are frozen. >Nuestra tetas heladas tendrán una forma de cono, cerrar con un nudo y al congelador por un lapso de tiempo moderado hasta que esten helados.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPmDPn2jgg8S1uJWR7A3ehqX53vA4vuZZhsHEAxDgocg4/image.png
The frozen treats are ready to enjoy and cool you down on a hot day. >Están listas las tetas heladas para degustar y refrescar un día caluroso.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmTBNWCFXKdfvhXxZR6x6eM5acigjPGBnDDEy1rKGzhB7F/image.png

body.title: THE DAY THE NETWORK DIED:24 HOURS WITHOUT THE GRID
body.body:
Hello 👋 SciFi Multiverse fam,

What if tomorrow morning you woke up and every smartphone, satellite, and server went dark? 
No internet. No GPS. No calls. Just you and the analog world.

I tried a 24-hour “network blackout” last weekend as an experiment. 
It felt like stepping into a low-budget sci-fi movie where I was the last human online.

  Hour 0-3: Panic Mode
The first thing I did was reach for my phone. Muscle memory is real. 
It felt like I’d lost an external brain. No alarm, no weather, no “what’s the time?” without looking at a wall clock.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNRJ9yubL6nb1DfZZHkJgnvCTnSQqC7QN5qSw3HTDvj27/1779653136409.jpg)


   Hour 4-12: The World Slowed Down
Without notifications, my brain got quiet. I noticed sounds I’d tuned out for years. 
I actually talked to the bus conductor for 10 minutes. In 2026, that feels illegal. 




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU7FXwPDPi2thposoECRyJom2S7AF3BzLJS4nDintQZ7e/1779653393971.jpg)



   Hour 13-24: Weird Freedom
This is where it got sci-fi. I started planning my day like people did in the 90s. 
Maps on paper. Meeting points, not “drop your location”. 
For the first time, I wasn’t being tracked, targeted, or distracted. 
It felt illegal... but also freeing.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX1zstoBAZ7BN5vUkDZBEvgaRpnF72Vp69UJQsHPBG3hj/1779653480711.jpg)



Would humanity survive 30 days like this? Probably. 
Would we like it? That’s the scary part.

We’re one solar flare, one cyberattack, one “update” away from this becoming real. 
Sci-fi isn’t predicting the future anymore. It’s warning us.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRDUDVJYwcibheaeGqbgDBWBwZrrZ3NzqUsEF5MyUfvTB/1779653207795.jpg)



So here’s my question for you: 
If the grid went down for 48 hours, what’s the first thing you’d realize you can’t live without? 
And what’s the first thing you’d be glad to lose?

Drop your answer below. I want to see if we’d build a new world or beg for WiFi back 😅



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeu7dC6e3RuF1CGCurP6PBpJwdDNafWPjwRvm2WznLPA8/1779653362670.jpg)

body.title: Shadowing the Target.
body.body: > To free the fort, I attempted to assassinate the captain via a window after Senu distracted a guard. The captain survived multiple strikes, forcing me to leap into a lake twice and I used arrows from a tower to chip away at the powerful enemy's health. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT29yod71au5UZbRFVNGszdUyNSjSYU2AhEWRXw6vHJev/screenshot_1_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR4zAF15w2Ch93wHPBvHUYCBWoy3KNChWhxqXvBkn9sZN/screenshot_2_.jpg) I had to kill the captain after claiming that treasure to free this fort from the enemies for good. And I noticed the captain went inside a private chamber to take rest after didn't find me during his standard patrol around the ramparts. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfFgBdc1U54dN4sKrqX2ceRKwzoH2Vb5DZPpgV9XLsYYo/screenshot_3_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb7x3iVCXkr5K2pvzgQyeq3sg7m9g4Ka6CMzHRSJ29poR/screenshot_4_.jpg) There was this guard on my way who would notice me for sure if I crossed the courtyard. So I sent Senu to distract him while I ran toward my target and found him resting inside the chamber, completely unaware. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXTz6CPkP5QrUd7KHnffxsAegozZi9abW1jL5eY7msDs2/screenshot_5_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdmmKnaUFLxxCYSEaKFpgvyGNaDM1tnq22ximBQBdJ4ca/screenshot_6_.jpg) I went inside through that open window and I tried to assassinate him with a hidden blade strike from behind. Though I could only try some damage on him due to his heavy armor, and then I escaped through the same open window. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXUS1eAYosU2kH85owA3KnY6eyX81x8RnQ78o67sun4cE/screenshot_8_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV5LqQfr5TcjPjsayLWmmL6Bo2tRC3zL1dMpA9zSb2pSH/screenshot_7_.jpg) When the captain kept looking around for me, when only he knew about my presence there, the rest of the fort remained quiet. I was trying to stay close to him as I decided to try more damage on him like this way. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRXNf9MuSTnKEXXd9zdmnZ494884QSGPToSN7e6ar94hG/screenshot_9_.jpg) I noticed the captain kept looking around for me, so I was also trying to stay close to him. And I didn't want to lose any opportunity to try and attack, do some damage from the high ledges. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV9uviWMVbrerD3WMgNLy7HXErwewSyqt5kXYWjyDpsze/screenshot_10_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaPDdSrqUTqxgU7Yzh192aVwF1yysZRC4kqFLwQXumyc7/screenshot_11_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPQF7pzDHwqkeMZRg6eQeRjYriKQKLVMMB3iEMfiHFTCZ/screenshot_12_.jpg) But he suddenly noticed me as I was right below that wall, and he climbed up on the wall with terrifying speed. And as he was about to strike me real hard with his sword, I jumped off that height toward the lake below. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTDt6QWRKfKe4K8yy7Dtr3QWB3e6eXC9ftrSRrxWcJFex/screenshot_13_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYi32kUSpARxRNZam3r7Y32yeTQuJyUfaLVhB3ZfJwzrC/screenshot_14_.jpg) I somehow escaped the wrath of that captain by using the deep water to break my fall, but he still tried to attack me while I was on the lake. So I had to dive under the water for a moment, till he went back. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQSsFH7QDUTwYQSfbECDYpQu53S5bAC5LyquPehZrYGqB/screenshot_15_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZJkvphumtnG6kQaH5JZJCFWbwWH9P2ca61AqnzZu4SZN/screenshot_16_.jpg) Then I climbed back up, and when I noticed the captain was climbing up on the tower from where I collected the treasure earlier, I started shooting him with arrows to weaken his health from a safe distance. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUbRJDT9R8DCaEEjvL6FRSZipond3TmyiRRcE2wNDFeoW/screenshot_17_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaumTbXvGpucezFdgds5LSPVPrWi8mSX5oX1AtK5vL1LG/screenshot_18_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWmdrVATbx8RqiZEP1QYPnkLVs2Bqey2wtR9oBqEBjLD7/screenshot_19_.jpg) The captain climbed down and rushed to my spot, but I hid. And then I tried to take him down again, but he was too strong, so I had to escape again by jumping from that tower into the lake. --- I'll show more of my photographic journey of the games soon, so stay tuned to my blog if you liked them. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gamingphoto/23tRvMuLRERuPePNhyEjtaKt46FiKwDBgwVqqAberwmEFA36fPkh2ad6wvB1RYNKTVezR.png The screenshots are taken by me personally from my gameplay and I borrowed the game's logo from [DevianArt](https://www.deviantart.com/). --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=noomer/b1b9d56e)

body.title: Lentil soup  and vegetable  salad.
body.body: Hello, friends, food lovers, and community members! I hope you are all doing well and enjoying time with your loved ones. \n\n
> Today, I want to share a very simple, budget-friendly recipe with you, Red Lentil Soup paired with a delicious Vegetable Salad.

> Ingredients for lentil soup 1/2 cup red lentils 1 tomato, chopped 1 small onion, chopped A few sprigs of coriander, chopped 1 tsp salt 1/3 tsp turmeric 2 cloves of garlic, minced 1/4 tsp mustard seeds 1/4 tsp cumin seeds 1 tsp oil **Instructions:**
> In a bowl, combine the washed lentils, chopped tomato, chopped onion, chopped coriander leaves, salt, and turmeric. Add sufficient water to cover the ingredients and cook until the lentils soften.

> In another pan, heat 1 tsp of oil over medium heat. Once the oil is hot, add the minced garlic, followed by the mustard and cumin seeds. Cook for about 1 minute until the spices release their aroma. Remove the pan from heat and pour the spice mixture into the cooked lentil mixture. Stir well and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes. Serve the soup hot, either with bread or rice, or enjoy it on its own.

> **Ingredients for the Salad:** 1 carrot 1/2 cucumber 1/2 red bell pepper 4-5 leaves of red cabbage 1 apple 1 tomato 1 avocado 1/2 lime **For the Dressing:** 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp mustard 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper 2 pinches crushed chili 1/4 tsp salt 3 tbsp tahini Juice of 1/2 lime **Instructions:**
> Wash all the vegetables. Cut the cucumber and red bell pepper into small pieces. Grate the carrot and slice the cabbage.
> Combine the chopped vegetables in a large bowl.
> Chop the apple and tomato into small pieces. Sprinkle some lime juice over the apple to prevent it from turning brown, and then add it to the bowl with the other vegetables.
> Cut the avocado into appropriate pieces and add it to the bowl. **Prepare the Dressing:**

> In a small jar, combine the tahini, salt, pepper, sugar, and chili flakes. Add the mustard and juice from the lime, followed by the olive oil and 2 tbsp of water. Close the lid tightly and shake the jar for 2-3 minutes until the dressing is well mixed.
> Your dressing is ready to be drizzled over the salad!

>

Red lentil soup, some leftover chapatis from lunch-box, and a refreshing, colorful vegetable salad! Delicious full dinner.
Thank you!

body.title: How Do You Protect Yourself From Online Scammers?
body.body:
Online scams have become something we hear about almost every day. From fake giveaway links to hacked social media accounts and phishing messages, scammers are getting smarter. These days, being careful online is just as important as being careful in real life.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRkUHHDTcWjguRfWr8rgu66JdVZDnzrVCnywERL45gE3o/1000219651.jpg 

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/hacker-scammer-scam-identity-man-3081816/)

To be honest, I became more careful after one of my friends fell victim to an online scam. Someone sent him a fake link that looked real, and before he realized what was happening, his account was compromised. Seeing that happen to someone close to me really opened my eyes. Since then, I’ve learned my lesson. I don’t click links carelessly anymore, especially if they are not from a trusted person.

Nowadays, whenever I receive a strange message, even from someone I know, I take my time before opening it. Sometimes scammers hack accounts and send harmful links using another person’s profile. Because of that, I always double-check. If something feels suspicious, I simply ignore or delete it.

Another thing I do to stay safe online is use strong passwords for my accounts. I avoid using easy passwords like my name or birth date. I also try not to use the same password everywhere because if one account gets hacked, the others can also be affected. Two-factor authentication has also helped me feel safer because it adds another layer of protection.

I also avoid sharing too much personal information online. Some people post everything publicly without realizing scammers can use those details against them. Even simple information can sometimes help scammers guess passwords or pretend to be someone else.

One scam I think is very dangerous today is phishing. These scammers send fake emails or messages pretending to be banks, online stores, or even delivery companies. The messages usually try to scare people by saying their account will be blocked or they need to act quickly. Many people panic and click the link without thinking twice. That’s exactly how scammers trap their victims.

Social media scams are also becoming very common. Sometimes you see fake investment opportunities, fake giveaways, or people pretending to sell products online. Some offers look too good to be true, and most times, they actually are.

My advice to others is simple, don’t trust everything you see online. Be patient and careful before clicking any link or sharing your information. If a message looks suspicious, verify it first. It’s better to be overly careful than to regret it later.

I also think people should talk more about online scams because awareness can help others avoid becoming victims. Many people feel embarrassed after getting scammed, but the truth is scammers are becoming more advanced every day. Anyone can fall for their tricks if they are not careful enough.

At the end of the day, staying safe online mostly comes down to being alert and thinking before acting. A single careless click can cause a lot of problems, so it’s always better to stay cautious.

body.title: Eurasian Wren at the Nature reserve
body.body:
The eurasian wren is one of the smaller birds in europe and I was luyky to find it and take some pictures at the Inn River Nature Reserve in Upper Austria. I was on a photography trip with Stefan when Stefan saw this little bird jumping around near a small creek. We stopped and waited there to take some pictures of this cute little bird.  One of the most striking features of the Eurasian Wren are the tail feathers that this birds can set up in this special way.


Eventhough this is one of the smallest birds in europe it has a pretty nice and loud song, and it is really a pleasure listening to it. When I saw it I took several pictures of it with my Camera on \

Mode. It was only here for a very short time but still I was able to get several pictures of it. When I see these pictures here I think that I really need to go on a wildlife photography trip again soon. I havent been at the Inn  River for some time now and I was really always very happy of the results on different bird photos I shot there. So it is probably time to visit it very soon eventhough it is already pretty late in spring and summer is already around the corner. 

I have to admit that this spring I was occupied a little bit to much with other things than photography, a lot of work at home and in my company kept me from taking too many photography trips. And when I spend my time on a trip I did a lot more sightseeing trips in towns and Cities this year. And I als have to admit that I spend a lot of time at my house in the garden this year.

body.title: The Tale of Nile - ENG- SPA
body.body: > Nile works for a very important record label, one of the most prestigious in the music industry. He earned his job through his talent and skills, discovering, promoting, and funding musical talent. In a way, he's a talent scout. He reviews all the applications the label receives, choosing the best artists to help each other. The label isn't his; he's just an employee, but he's one of the most respected executives there due to his experience and high standards. He has repeatedly demonstrated the extent of his talent, having found some of the best singers among the thousands of applications the label receives daily from around the world. Thanks to these past successes, he has earned so much respect and prestige. Everyone within the organization knows he's the best at what he does, and if a singer is chosen to work with them, it's because they are truly exceptional. He's had a lot of freedom within the record label ever since; he's a quality control supervisor and can choose or reject anyone. He reports to his bosses, who are in charge of finances and other matters. But unbeknownst to Nile, a power struggle is brewing among the executives to decide what to do with him, as not everyone wants him at the label anymore.

> Nile pertenece a una discográfica muy importante, es de las más prestigiosas en la música. El se ganó con su talento y habilidades el trabajo de encontrar los talentos musicales y impulsados y financiarlos. Por decirlo así es un encuentra talentos. El se encarga de revisar todas las opciones que llegan a la discográfica pidiendo asociarse con ella y escoge a los mejores para ayudarse mutuamente. La discográfica no es del, el solo es un trabajador más, pero es uno de los directivos más respetados dentro de ella por su experiencia y altos estándares de calidad. En el pasado el ya ha demostrado muchas veces de que envergadura es su talento, porque ha logrado encontrar entre las miles de solicitudes que llegan cada día para asociarse con discográfica en todo el mundo a los mejores cantantes. Gracias a esos éxitos previos es que se ha ganado tanto su respeto y prestigio, todo el mundo dentro de la asociación sabe que el es el mejor en lo que hace, y si un cantante es escogido para trabar con ellos es porque es realmente bueno. El tiene mucha libertad dentro de la discográfica desde entonces, es supervisor de calidad, y puede denegar o escoger a cualquiera. Él le rinde cuentas a sus jefes que son los encargados del dinero y otras cosas. Pero sin Nile saberlo dentro de los jefes se está librando una batalla para ver que hacer con el, pues no todos lo quieren ya dentro de la discográfica.
![rezli-OhTbOJH4w-w-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/48GC5EMEeY2CGiyf3nNQ5ip5Hx17QpUqyetZjRVJj4codvHYob6TwgEXTGrrETPTxc.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> What was happening was this: in the past, he had been very successful at finding great talent and choosing them from the crowd. But now, after several years since his initial successes, there's a noticeable slowdown in the number of candidates he's selecting for the record label. He hasn't actually become slower; it's something else. Nile has high standards for quality when choosing someone, so if no one meets them, he doesn't choose anyone and waits until the next day to see if there's someone better to finance. Apparently, there's less talent now than before, so he's choosing more slowly. He prefers to choose the best, even if he has to wait. He's not going to offer candidates just to meet some quota of singers or anything like that; quality over quantity. So, several executives don't understand this and his approach. Several want more results, more singers, more money circulating. It's a problem because they're pressuring Nile to change his way of choosing singers. This war between the executives is very complicated; several want to fire him because they don't see why he should keep him if he doesn't offer more singers, others, more moderate, want to wait and see if he increases the number of singers he chooses later on, and then there are those who want him to stay where he is because his high standards are what have helped the record label maintain its world-class quality.

> Lo que estaba pasando era lo siguiente, el en el pasado había tenido mucho éxito encontrando grandes talentos y escogiéndolos de entre la multitud. Pero ahora luego de que han pasado varios años de sus éxitos iníciales se nota cierta lentitud en la cantidad de candidatos que escoge para la discográfica. El no se ha vuelto más lento, lo que pasa es otra cosa. Nile tiene altos estándares de calidad para poder escoger a una persona, entonces si nadie cumple pues no escoge a nadie y espera al siguiente día para ver si hay alguien mejor a quien financiar. Al parecer ahora hay menos talentos que antes así que los escoge más lento, él prefiere escoger lo mejor aunque tenga que esperar. No va a ofrecer candidatos solo por cumplir alguna cuota de cantantes o algo así, mejor calidad sobre cantidad. Entonces varios jefes no entienden esto y su forma de ser. Varios quieren más resultados, más cantantes, más dinero moviéndose. Es un problema porque presionan a Nile para que cambie su forma de escoger a los cantantes. Pues esta guerra entre los directivos es muy complicada, varios quieren despedirlo porque no ven porque mantenerlo si no ofrece más cantantes, otros más moderados quieren esperar para ver si el más adelante aumenta los escogidos, y están los que quieren que se mantenga donde está porque sus altos estándares son los que han ayudado a la discográfica a mantener su calidad mundial.
![campaign-creators-gMsnXqILjp4-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23zGgwd29VWkMUumEAvrK519Y8HeqToEmcut3GuZjrKdQW6kqf9rgEtYrkDifTK2eQKaf.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> Thanks to pressure from the moderates, he wasn't fired, but the pressure was certainly felt. Several of the more overbearing managers approached him behind the other managers' backs and threatened him. They told him that if he didn't offer more singers soon, he would be replaced, as they weren't going to pay him for doing nothing. These managers were abusing their power because the other executives hadn't approved such a threat. Nile felt very pressured, but he made it clear that he wouldn't lower his high standards just because someone wanted to see more quantity. The managers were furious because they didn't like his perfectionist nature, but they couldn't fire him. Nile knew he needed to find good talent soon to appease those fools who knew nothing about music and only thought about money. Even so, he was well aware that he was prepared to be fired; his reputation and quality were more important than pleasing a few bosses. Fortunately, things turned out well some time later. Among thousands of applicants, he found two singers. These singers were true hidden gems because no one else had offered them funding and almost no one knew them. But Nile reviewed their previous work and knew there was potential there.

> Gracias a la presión de los moderados no fue despedido, pero la presión si se le hizo conocer. Varios de los jefes más prepotentes se acercaron a el sin los demás jefes saber, y lo amenazan. Le dijeron que si no ofrecía más cantantes pronto sería reemplazado, pues no le iban a pagar por no hacer nada. Estos jefes estaban abusando de su poder porque los demás directivos no habían decidido esa amenaza. Nile se sintió muy presionado, pero les hizo saber que no rebajaría sus altos estándares solo porque alguien quiera ver más cantidad. Los jefes se pusieron muy furiosos porque no le agradaba esa forma de ser de el tan perfeccionista, pero no podían despedirlo. Nile sabía que necesitaba encontrar buenos talentos pronto para poder calmar las aguas de aquellos tontos que no sabían nada de música, solo pensaban en el dinero. Aún así estaba muy consciente que estaba dispuesto a ser despedido, su reputación y calidad eran más importantes que complacer a unos jefes. Las cosas por suerte se desenvolvieron bien un tiempo más tarde. El entre miles de solicitantes encontró a 2 cantantes. Esos cantantes eran verdaderos tesoros escondidos porque nadie más les había ofrecido financiamiento y casi nadie los conocía. Pero Nile revisó sus trabajos previos y supo que ahí había potencial.
![jamieson-murphy-uX6696gIwWI-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tbMLddA6GWdPhEJBQujUzqXS3AiHJpsBLHNYAAYqRRbfUpDnwShfKc7LAd1PbWofEun.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> Those two singers, after receiving help from the record label through his intermediary, became very famous and were the flagship acts of the company. This increased the popularity of the record label and of Nile himself as the best talent scout. The evil bosses had to apologize and admit that he was right all along: quality over quantity. Now he has more freedom in his work than before.

> Esos dos cantantes luego de recibir la ayuda de la discográfica mediante el de por medio se hicieron muy famosos, y fueron el buque insignia de la asociación. Eso aumentó la popularidad de la discográfica y del mismo Nile como el mejor encuentra talentos. Los jefes malvados tuvieron que disculparse y reconocer que el siempre tuvo razón, mejor calidad sobre cantidad. Ahora tiene más libertad que antes en su trabajo.

body.title: A Flash From The Past
body.body:
/></center>

[source](https://bringatrailer.com/listing/2002-chevrolet-camaro-ss-74/)

This last week I drove past one of our company cars from 2003 and it bought back many good memories. I know our company had imported 7 of these Camaro Z28's replacing our imported Pontiac Bonneville's and those cars are the only ones in the country.  This could have been the car I drove as it was a 1 in 6 chance knowing one was written off. The import rules today only allow for classic left hand drives to be imported and these are only just over 20 years old so definitely not a classic meeting the criteria of 40 years old.

I had to test drive the vehicles before they were ordered and the choice was between a Corvette and the Camaro Z28. The decision to go with the Camaro was quite easy as the concern was the power of the Corvette as it drove differently and the worry was the safety of our drivers. Anyone can drive a sports car, but there is big difference between whether you can handle the power of the sports car or not.  The Corvette back end would kick out if you were too aggressive on the accelerator and we did not trust the others being able to handle this.

Times have definitely changed as no one gets given imported sports cars as a company vehicle these days. Nothing has compared to this since then and I now appreciate what we had. We had cigarette branding all over the car being \

and they were truly an eye turner. There was nowhere to hide and being based in Durban which is not that big a city I kind of knew everyone.

Driving along the freeway other cars would be flashing you with their lights saying hello and it was a different life. I had been involved in this promotional marketing role for around 4 years and it was like seeing life from a different angle. We travelled around the country hosting various sporting events and were given all the extra expenses like entertainment and clothing allowances. This is unheard of these days and sadly getting any extra allowances is just not offered.

Our role was very simple being tasked with seeing 20 smokers daily and sampling them with our brand trying to convert them to that brand. We had work stock and promotional stock which was used on promotional nights at night clubs. I would be busy most Wednesdays and Thursday evenings running ladies nights around the city.

At the time it was really good fun and calling this a job was a hard push because being in my early twenties it was a dream job. The promotional evenings I was hosting were in demand and I had a waiting list of clubs wanting my services. At the peak before I left and relocated to the UK there was a following that would come to the promotional evenings and crowds of 500 were expected hence the night clubs wanted the extra boost to their business.

The ladies nights often had many prizes on offer and I would go the extra mile getting prizes from companies I knew from visiting during my daytime sampling work. There were flights overseas, makeup, clothes, gym memberships and so many other giveaways. The other cigarette and alcohol brands could not compete and did not have such a following of supporters due to not putting in the extra work required. At one point I had the South African Breweries and KWV wineries coming on board co hosting sponsoring these events which made these events even bigger.

The networking during those days I wish I had today because in Durban it felt like I knew everyone. The police stations were not like they are today and would make sure I visited at least a couple each week. Not that I ever needed their help but when it came to road blocks I would be flashed through being told not to wait and was clear to drive around the beacons on the road. i would never drink and drive so for myself it made no difference whether I was tested or not.

Having a sports car at such a young age was great as I had completed advanced driving licenses as a company requisite for insurance purposes. Having an advanced license cheapened the insurance premiums and gave you the use of the school facilities like the skid pan. Unfortunately a few of the promotional team members in other parts of the country lost their lives having lost control crashing their cars at high speed whilst under the influence.

Times have changed as the local laws do not allow for any cigarette advertising so there is no point for having promotional vehicles or a promotional team. Back in the 1990's and early 2000's the company sponsored most major sporting and incoming international pop and rock music events.

links.title: Get the Skinny
links.body:
>

> Healthy is always in fashion.

Unfortunately, trends care nothing for health and instead over the last decades have leaned into whatever is easiest, *and purchasable.* It is a big part of the reason that the trend away from being thin has happened, where \

the way you are has led to a lot of people struggling with their weight, and in places like the US, almost half the population is obese. 

*But skinny is back.*

> why?

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23tmWKockzKWfS4eB7fHqRvmMiXw4qm3H2wN8hs1Hf5qBbVuWsEhmRDfnYNKjjF8PKToM.png)


---

> Because it is purchasable. 

Back in the eighties people were complaining about unrealistic body expectations based on representations in the media, where models who had been airbrushed (by hand) adorned magazine covers. And that was replaced by a movement of body positivity where being indulgent, being overweight, not caring what others think brought us to today. The problem is, a few years ago weight-loss drugs came out which made losing weight *purchasable* and suddenly, it was possible to be indulgent and be thin. And now, all those \

people have been uncovered as skinny cravers in a fat person's body. And inevitably, being skinny is back in trend. > Skinny - *not healthy.* While in general being overweight is unhealthy for the *vast majority* of people, being thin doesn't automatically mean healthy either - otherwise drug addicts would be healthy. The attraction with these various weight-loss drugs isn't just the weight loss, because there are lots of things that can do that, like adjusting diet and exercise. It is that you don't need to do anything except pay for them. For the most part, people aren't forced to change their behaviours, so no control necessary. > I am not against these drugs. I think it is ridiculous that we need them, but when culture and economy condition us to consume endlessly, not control our emotional wellbeing or health, and accept ourselves no matter how poorly we feel or are acting, it isn't entirely our fault. We have been raised to be fat consumers, just like children are being raised on screens today in ways that will make them mentally and emotionally stunted. But now, the red carpets that were not too long ago filled with fuller figures being celebrated for their bravery at accepting their bodies, are being walked by gaunt, hollow people who all seem to have the same expression on their face, no matter their age, the occasion or how they are feeling. > Is this wellbeing? *I don't believe so.* No one has grown to actually accept themselves, they have just buried the feelings of wanting to be something other than what they are behind a *curtain of trend.* The trends over the last few decades has meant that they can be unhappy with themselves internally, but still fit in externally. > That trend is turning though. But like all trends, it is driven by those who have the money to spend, and the weight loss drugs are not cheap. But that is okay, because governments are making them accessible by subsidising them, so everyone shares the cost of the people who are both indulging and wanting to lose weight - which is the same as before because the same set of people are more likely to cost more in health services due to various weight-related illnesses, including mental health. I am not against people who are overweight, as I understand the many challenges and face them myself. However, what I dislike is the entire direction of society, where we keep on creating environments that make us ill in multiple ways, and then creating solutions to the problems we have created that make us ill in other ways. And instead of having the goal of improving our wellbeing, it is all done for money. > What is a healthy weight? The question can't be answered at a group level, as it is very much individual. However, if a person is not moving their body enough, is eating poorly but with a suppressed appetite, and is feeling nauseous, are they likely to be healthy? At this point, I don't need to take weight-loss medication, but I wonder if I will ever get to the point where I would, and what would I have to do to get there? How big would I need to be before I get to the point that I believe I can't do it with diet and exercise alone? I have no idea. Perhaps if there was a pill I could take where I was the perfect weight, but also felt good, could think clearly, and was able to move freely without pain, I would take it. But alas, that pill doesn't exist yet. So, people predictably choose their looks over all else. links.title: [ESP/ENG] 🏥 Fracturas, Esguinces y Adrenalina: ¿Cómo se mueve una Emergencia de Traumatología? / Fractures, Sprains, and Adrenaline: How Does a Traumatology Emergency Work? 🦴🚑
links.body:
---
¡Hola, comunidad de Hive! Espero que estén teniendo un excelente día. Hoy quiero abrirles una pequeña ventana al fascinante, acelerado y a veces caótico mundo de la **Traumatología y Ortopedia**, una de las rotaciones médicas más intensas y dinámicas que existen.

En el hospital, la emergencia de trauma nunca duerme. Sin embargo, después de pasar horas evaluando placas, inmovilizando miembros y asistiendo en pabellón, uno empieza a notar un patrón. La traumatología no es azarosa; sigue una lógica muy clara que depende de tres factores: **edad, sexo y el día de la semana.**

Hoy les quiero contar cómo se divide este \

de las lesiones más comunes que vemos en el día a día hospitalario.

***

*Hello, Hive community! I hope you are having a great day. Today I want to open a small window into the fascinating, fast-paced, and sometimes chaotic world of **Traumatology and Orthopedics**, one of the most intense and dynamic medical rotations that exist.*

*In the hospital, the trauma emergency room never sleeps. However, after hours of evaluating X-rays, immobilizing limbs, and assisting in the OR, one begins to notice a pattern. Traumatology is not random; it follows a very clear logic that depends on three factors: **age, sex, and the day of the week.***

*Today I want to share how this \

of the most common injuries we see in the daily hospital routine is divided.*


![20260524_154528.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS4V23RMxbagFApn8fnxBqpAR7C9gFnc87fFJvM8rZHN4/20260524_154528.jpg)


---

## 🕒 El \

Si hay algo que todo el personal de salud sabe, es que **los viernes por la noche, sábados y domingos la emergencia se transforma.** Mientras la mayoría de las personas descansa o sale a divertirse, la actividad en traumatología se duplica o triplica. 

*   **¿Por qué ocurre?** El consumo de alcohol, las fiestas, el aumento de la velocidad en las vías y las actividades recreativas extremas son el detonante perfecto.
*   **Lo más común:** Los fines de semana están protagonizados por **accidentes de tránsito** (especialmente en moto), riñas callejeras y caídas de altura. Aquí es donde dominan las fracturas expuestas, los traumatismos craneoencefálicos asociados y las policontusiones.

En contraste, los días de semana (lunes a jueves) suelen ser más de \

: caídas casuales en el hogar, accidentes laborales o complicaciones de patologías crónicas.

***

*If there is one thing that all healthcare personnel know, it is that **Friday nights, Saturdays, and Sundays transform the emergency room.** While most people are resting or going out to have fun, activity in traumatology doubles or triples.*

*   ***Why does it happen?** Alcohol consumption, parties, speeding on the roads, and extreme recreational activities are the perfect trigger.*
*   ***The most common injuries:** Weekends are dominated by **traffic accidents** (especially motorcycle crashes), street fights, and falls from heights. This is where open fractures, associated traumatic brain injuries, and multiple contusions prevail.*

*In contrast, weekdays (Monday to Thursday) tend to be more about \

: casual falls at home, work accidents, or complications of chronic pathologies.*


![20260304_180115.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTMNSJPDEoCXz5h9aX2ZDiJEPSqXRhGvNYcQwbactKqUL/20260304_180115.jpg)


---

## 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Según el Sexo: Mecanismos de trauma diferentes / By Sex: Different Mechanisms of Trauma

Aunque los huesos se rompen igual en hombres y mujeres, las causas suelen variar bastante debido a los roles sociales, actividades laborales y la misma biología:

*   **Hombres:** Estadísticamente, ocupan la gran mayoría de las camas en las emergencias de trauma los fines de semana. Suelen estar más expuestos a trabajos de alta carga física, deportes de contacto y, lamentablemente, a conductas de riesgo en la vía pública. En ellos abundan las fracturas de huesos largos (fémur, tibia) por accidentes viales y traumas por agresión.
*   **Mujeres:** El perfil epidemiológico cambia. Aunque también sufren accidentes de tránsito, en las mujeres vemos un alto índice de lesiones ligamentosas (como esguinces de tobillo o rodilla) y, en edades más avanzadas, fracturas por fragilidad ósea debidas a caídas desde su propia altura.

***

*Although bones break the same way in men and women, the causes usually vary significantly due to social roles, work activities, and biology itself:*

*   ***Men:** Statistically, they occupy the vast majority of beds in trauma emergencies on weekends. They tend to be more exposed to heavy physical labor, contact sports, and, unfortunately, risky behaviors on public roads. In men, long bone fractures (femur, tibia) due to road accidents and trauma from assaults are abundant.*
*   ***Women:** The epidemiological profile changes. Although they also suffer traffic accidents, in women we see a high rate of ligament injuries (such as ankle or knee sprains) and, at older ages, bone fragility fractures due to falls from their own height.*



![IMG-20260312-WA0029.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVpqzQVNudo3t2awpXGoLzmfknz1qCWchazNB61W8bMhM/IMG-20260312-WA0029.jpg)

---

## 👶 🧑 🧓 La Edad: El factor definitivo / Age: The Ultimate Factor

El esqueleto humano cambia drásticamente a lo largo de la vida, y con él, el tipo de lesiones:

### 1. La Infancia: Huesos de goma (0 - 12 años) / Childhood: Rubber bones (0 - 12 years old)
Los niños están corriendo y jugando constantemente. Sus huesos son elásticos y están en pleno crecimiento, por lo que tienen un tipo de fractura único llamado **\

** (el hueso se dobla y se quiebra parcialmente, como una rama verde). Lo más común aquí son las caídas en el parque o la escuela, resultando en fracturas de antebrazo (radio y cúbito) y de clavícula.\n\n*Children are constantly running and playing. Their bones are elastic and fully growing, so they have a unique type of fracture called a **\

** (the bone bends and breaks partially, like a green branch). The most common injuries here are falls at the park or school, resulting in forearm (radius and ulna) and clavicle fractures.*

### 2. Jóvenes y Adultos Jóvenes: Alta energía (13 - 50 años) / Youth and Young Adults: High energy (13 - 50 years old)
Es la etapa de mayor actividad física y exposición al peligro. Predominan los traumas de **alta energía**. Aquí es donde entran los esguinces graves, las rupturas de ligamentos en la rodilla por deportes, y las fracturas complejas por accidentes de moto o automóvil. El cuerpo resiste más, pero los impactos que recibe son mucho mayores.

*This is the stage of greatest physical activity and exposure to danger. **High-energy** traumas predominate. This is where severe sprains, ligament tears in the knee due to sports, and complex fractures from motorcycle or car accidents come into play. The body is more resilient, but the impacts it receives are much greater.*

### 3. Adultos Mayores: La fragilidad del cristal (Más de 60 años) / Older Adults: The fragility of glass (Over 60 years old)
En la tercera edad, la densidad ósea disminuye (osteoporosis). Los traumas ya no son de alta energía; basta una simple caída en el baño o un tropezón con una alfombra para causar un gran daño. El \

en esta etapa es la **fractura de cadera**, seguida de cerca por la fractura de radio distal (muñeca, al intentar frenar la caída) y las fracturas vertebrales. \n\n*In old age, bone density decreases (osteoporosis). Traumas are no longer high-energy; a simple fall in the bathroom or a trip over a rug is enough to cause severe damage. The \

at this stage is a **hip fracture**, followed closely by a distal radius fracture (wrist, when trying to break the fall) and vertebral fractures.*


![20260524_154130.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSV7SthAUuw84Xr4PZhe2eQcaiosdurnBPznAzc43wXX2/20260524_154130.jpg)



---

## 💡 Reflexión de Guardia / Shift Reflection

La traumatología nos enseña que el cuerpo humano es increíblemente resistente, pero también nos recuerda lo vulnerables que somos en un segundo de imprudencia. Detrás de cada radiografía hay una historia: un descuido en moto, un partido de fútbol que se salió de control o un abuelito que solo quería caminar por su sala.

Para quienes nos apasiona la cirugía y la anatomía, cada fractura es un rompecabezas que debemos armar a la perfección para devolverle la movilidad y la calidad de vida al paciente. ¡Es un reto diario que vale totalmente la pena!

***

*Traumatology teaches us that the human body is incredibly resilient, but it also reminds us how vulnerable we are in a single second of carelessness. Behind every X-ray, there is a story: a distraction on a motorcycle, a soccer match that got out of hand, or a grandparent who just wanted to walk across their living room.*

*For those of us who are passionate about surgery and anatomy, every fracture is a puzzle that we must piece together perfectly to restore the patient's mobility and quality of life. It is a daily challenge that is totally worth it!*

---

**¿Y tú? ¿Has tenido alguna mala experiencia con los huesos o te ha tocado visitar la emergencia un fin de semana? ¡Te leo en los comentarios!**

***

*And you? Have you ever had a bad experience with bones or had to visit the emergency room on a weekend? I'll read you in the comments!*

every time someone who went against seasonality has suffered losses and yet again sell in may and walk away has done it's damage to those last few hopeful traders in the room. Well it's been a while I've been off the charts and I'm not coming back yet, for now it is the time for another episode of weekend memes chronicles so let's get started with that.

The boys finale was worth it?

It's been seven years of the boys and now it has to an end, the finale was somehow satisfying than the entire season. As someone who watched the show only because of the beef between butcher and homelander They both has served the justice with the acting and action even though the story was weirdly turned into politics but the finale still did justice to the whole season. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXyEW3hWBaFAyj4MGtVxgq54qPDoGjGVCwHmGexfbALDN/1000172599.jpg That ending itself was diabolical since butcher got his redemption, the weak side was homelander died as he was in comics but the vought survived, the whole thing should've ended with vought coming to an end cause that's what made homelander what he was otherwise he'd still be John, the kid who was never loved but we know Eric kripke did that to milk it for future but I wonder what's your thoughts about it.

Someone should bring young ones in the politics

Seeing the world turn into an absolute disaster everyday I can tell we are choosing the wrong people to rule us every time. It is the time to bring in youth into politics and we'd be in far better position. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaJ4RQQCT7xudSw6sBZdU33WrwiQcUEuiSj2P8SLJ24BE/1000172591.jpg Only if we take out that orange man like butcher did to homelander. We'd be in better condition than we are right now but who's going to be the butcher in this era? In this economy? It isn't happening so yeah.

Taking the loan from apps?

I'm so against of taking loans in this economy because stay out of debt is somehow the way to survive and make something out of living unless you read that one author. There are so many apps giving loans and trusting those is a big mistake. They'd make the example out of you. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNhr132A94UD721JtkUszQNHJqHgsFXTucR4GwKqGs2K8/1000172597.jpg Imagine taking loan and deleting the app instead of paying back and the sooner they find that they'll be on your door. Stay away from the third party apps like that and pivot to taking loan from a bank instead, not coming from a banker though. Anyways that's all for the weekend, it's been a while I've posted this but from now onwards it'll be fun again as the may is coming to an end. We're supposed to come out the closet. Let me know how you're all doing. Do share in the comments. that's all folks. # Update - CSS Themes for SoloHive

Hey everybody.

This is a quick update announcing the release of CSS Themes for SoloHive. We realized that not everybody would be happy with the default Medium style theme. We also realize that users might not have the design skills to edit the CSS file to their liking. So we have created 3 new CSS themes in addition to the default theme. 

All the new CSS Theme files have extensive commenting and a ```README.md``` file for installation instructions, and customization by the user or an AI like Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok, so they will have a good idea how SoloHive is styled.

## CSS Themes Available

We have 3 CSS Themes in addition to the default theme, which comes with the SoloHive package.

- **Personal Theme**  - Theme designed with a personal blog in mind.
- **Photography and Travel Theme** - This theme is designed with photography and travel blogs which tend to be more image heavy.
- **Tech-Dark Theme** - A dark theme for those technology and gaming blogs.

## Screenshots

![Photography and Travel Light Theme](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dudeontheweb/244eVRwXYZMFZvLeWRzPt8CK9D2eHKV6ZbqnKkDPDtzpBeVgc31843svERNqkvgQgDtEg.png)

![Personal Light Theme](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dudeontheweb/243BwF2h3sxDteuKMYbG28Bck6MhwNiSWfTqZFTAB6S6N7z1J5dbEGoUc2v546Zvf7qGT.png)

![Personal Dark Theme](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dudeontheweb/Eo1vWYvwjtZzc1aVxF2t4AwZ74WSkTQVRtFdCSaMT48v2yAKTAAwb9seMPfWGaaE776.png)


![Tech-Gaming Theme Dark Only](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dudeontheweb/Enyo1Sxd9VgXyMSYf2eSUXLSBjujK8wgCChN18sbxRye89PWxWKdZr2rrvnQBeVcjz7.png)



All CSS themes are fully customizable to make them your own!

## Wrap up

We really encourage you to try out the new themes. But we really would love for you to customize them, modify them, make them your own. And hopefully you you inspiration to come up with your own theme by yourself or with the help of the AI of your choice.

Your Blog. Your Domain . Your Rules. 

That's our philosophy here with SoloHive. Now go out and have some fun. Until next time...

Dudeontheweb

links.title: The Most Dangerous Addiction Is Comfort
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQNRids9PfuWbF9AaLon2aGFbuWywQF9KiXbudpKu5D43/1000699855.png 


Comfort feels safe.

That’s why it becomes dangerous.

Most people do not destroy their potential through dramatic failure.

They slowly lose it through comfort.

Comfort delays growth.

Comfort weakens ambition.

Comfort turns temporary rest into permanent stagnation.

And modern life constantly encourages comfort.

Unlimited entertainment.

Instant dopamine.

Endless distractions.

Everything designed to keep attention occupied.

But growth rarely happens inside comfort zones.

The strongest transformations usually begin during uncomfortable phases.

Learning new skills.

Taking risks.

Building during uncertainty.

Facing criticism.

Surviving failures.

Those moments shape people.

Especially in investing and crypto, emotional comfort can become expensive.

People chase hype because it feels safe when everyone else is doing it.

They panic during crashes because fear becomes contagious.

Very few people stay emotionally independent.

That independence matters enormously.

Because opportunities often appear when emotions become extreme.

The same applies to life.

Most people wait for “perfect timing.”

But perfect timing rarely exists.

Action creates momentum.

Experience creates clarity.

And growth creates confidence.

The future will likely reward adaptable people more than comfortable people.

People willing to evolve.

Learn.

Experiment.

And continue building despite uncertainty.

Because uncertainty itself is becoming the new normal.

And maybe the biggest risk today is not failure.

Maybe the biggest risk is becoming too comfortable to grow.

#EYS | Turning Patience Into Power 🌱💎

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

Hello Hive friends and Splinterlands warriors, @suisver here with a new video for the channel.

Today I bring you a video where I emerged victorious. I honestly didn't think I was going to win because I was under a lot of pressure at the beginning. Battles with low mana stress me out a bit because you have to choose your fighters very carefully on the battlefield.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23tGVUk7tej9bzcCVqs6KYBQQvVrv5fzhfwisZ436sGv9rnFAopeMTSgpmYvoTJr6xZT9.png)

I started choosing my winning team, led by my favorite Archon, **Aurelia**. Then I had to choose a team that, although its mana wasn't very high, had good defense to defeat the enemy. To accompany **Aurelia**, I chose:

* **The Great Tafarian**
* **The Gearhead**
* **The Kanaaq Miner**
* **The Grand Consul** Minion**

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23w2kq37v1xVFF86DTa6UpinVb4xFz4FBVqFPx5ymDJV9jYz3Ti4SMV56gpjDH5Jmo3Qg.png)

At the start of the battle, my opposing team, led by **The Demon Thalgrimore**, instantly eliminated **The Grand Consul Minion**. Seeing my first warrior fall didn't discourage me, as I had strong warriors on my team. The battle was tough; my enemy landed two hard blows, but
**The Miner of Kanaaq** and **The Gearhead** held their own. Furthermore, having **The Great Lion Tafarian** at Level 4 is a significant advantage, as it becomes an almost invincible wall.

In this last battle, I secured victory for my next chest, earning some extraordinary cards as a reward. Fighting in Splinterlas is always fantastic.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23u62hm5bjgVYuhWt3X3wdvrD8hfTmFqVDa1DwRDqZgBCV1qgmvpnLgKnvzTACducUsWt.png)

### MY REWARDS

**Sturdy Axe Warden:** An imposing Fire element card (8 mana cost). This armored dwarf arrives with 2 melee attack, 2 speed, and 4 health—a brutal tank for my frontline.

**Kanaaq Miner:** A well-known blue Water imp (5 mana cost), ready to disrupt the enemy with his 2 speed, 1 attack, and 2 health, and the ability to target the enemy in the back row.

**1 Entry:** A direct pass to special raffles or tournaments.

Two formidable warriors and a golden ticket to boost my Water and Fire deck!

links.title: Mensaje diario de 5  minutos: comprometerse  / 5 Minute Freewrite: undertake
links.body:
>


# Miedo

​

#


A lo largo de la vida puedes sentir temor alguna vez al compromiso; considerando eso algo muy importante porque se trata de asumir la responsabilidad de aceptar que vas a hacer todo lo que esté en tus manos para cumplir con esa promesa que pone de manifiesto tu palabra que representa lo que eres y la seriedad y el respeto que tienes por ti mismo y por los demás. **Comprometerse** implica además mucha valentía sin ser un tema de edad es también de madurez y por eso no puedes andar por la vida haciendo promesas a las personas tan a la ligera que luego olvidas cumplir lo que trae consecuencias como molestia a quien estaba esperando por ti.

En muchos aspectos hay compromisos y por eso es válido en cierto momento sentir ese miedo por la decisión que estás a punto de tomar; ya que implica exactamente eso comprometerse con dar un paso más y avanzar en tu vida lo que puede ser un cambio significativo lo que quiere decir que tienes un compromiso contigo mismo de seguir en esa dirección afrontando todo lo que conlleve con madurez y siendo muy responsable. Por otro lado, puedes asumir compromisos con otras personas y lo que deberías hacer siempre es cumplir porque habla de la lealtad y la confianza, a veces el temor a este tipo de actos es precisamente por no poder cumplirlo y quedar muy mal o causar un gran desastre.

Cualquier compromiso sea personal o laboral requiere de cumplimiento y aunque es de humano poder sentir algo de miedo, necesitas ser muy valiente, serio y responsable cada vez que prometas algo.
​

​<center>![WhatsApp Image 2022-05-12 at 3.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeucn6MeLy6DkeFM7A2nU8vB9xADUBt8Yr6bzbsja2DRK/WhatsApp%20Image%202022-05-12%20at%203.28.50%20PM.jpeg)</center>



#  Fear



#
Throughout life, you may sometimes feel afraid of commitment; this is something very important because it involves taking on the responsibility of accepting that you will do everything in your power to keep that promise, which reflects your word—representing who you are and the seriousness and respect you have for yourself and others. **Making a commitment** also requires a great deal of courage; it is not just a matter of age but also of maturity. That is why you cannot go through life making promises to people so lightly that you later forget to keep them, which leads to consequences such as upsetting those who were waiting for you.
​
In many ways, there are commitments involved, and that’s why it’s natural at times to feel that fear about the decision you’re about to make; after all, it means exactly that—committing to taking another step forward in your life, which can be a significant change. This means you have a commitment to yourself to keep moving in that direction, facing everything that comes with it with maturity and a strong sense of responsibility. On the other hand, you can make commitments to other people, and what you should always do is follow through, because it speaks to loyalty and trust. Sometimes the fear of making such commitments stems precisely from the fear of not being able to fulfill them, which could make you look bad or cause a major disaster.
​
Any commitment, whether personal or professional, requires follow-through, and while it’s only human to feel a little nervous, you need to be very brave, serious, and responsible every time you make a promise.
​

#

links.title: Protection from scams
links.body:
>

In this digital world almost all of the tasks can be done online, and such a thing is good for making our life much better and comfortable. But every comfort and facility comes to us with a cost or with a risk. Online scams are such a thing which comes with the comforts as well as facilities. In recent days online scam is increasing and people are very much concerned about it because scammers and hackers getting smarter and finding new ways to scam people. Protecting from scams in this present world is not so easy because a simple mistake can be enough to wipe out the assets of our account. What steps should be taken to protect ourselves from scams or from hacking? ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSLUp95mMJaBS1VebRQ3HryFNQkhimCV71Kopq2r4ZKRe/image.png) [ImgSrc](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-siting-facing-laptop-dYEuFB8KQJk) In social media they are available various kind of links for various purposes. It's true that we all need to access many links, but it does not mean that we can be careless in such a case. Because clicking on a single link can be enough to share giving access of our smartphone to the hackers and if they get the access, they can wipe out our asset and personal data easily from our smartphone. Sometimes sensitive personal data can be enough to blackmail us and that's why it is very much important to verify if I link is genuine or not before we click on it. In my case when I need to open a link, I use tor with private which can be a good option to protect our devices from hacking or stopping hackers from stealing information. Humans are naturally greedy. They always try to make more money at any cost. Many people try to generate more money using their saving. Traditional Bank offers 7 to 10% of APR and it's not so satisfying but there are many online platforms or sites which promise to give 20% APR or more than it. In fact, some websites offer 40-50% and at the beginning they actually pay with interest to attract users. We need to understand that in this world nothing comes to us easily, especially when it's something related to finance. Nobody can give as money with so much high return without their benefit. So, if anyone offers high returns without any valid reason, it must be a trap. If one has a long-term vision, he should not be too greedy to fall in the trap. It is unfortunate that people are always greedy and fall for such kinds of Ponzi schemes. We cannot be greedy too much when it comes to finances. At present, youtubers can create huge influence when it comes to investment. In online there are many projects to invest which can be good but there are some projects that use the influence of youtubers to catch the attention of people. For money many youtubers promote those projects which are not actually good. People blindly believe those youtubers and start to invest in these projects and it is just a matter of time these projects run away with our investment and leave nothing for us. So, the best way to protect our investment is to not to put blind trust on youtubers and we should make our own analysis before investing in any project. If we don't know how to make analysis for those kinds of projects, we should not invest online. Because the risk is more than we can get from there. It's better to take care of it rather than regret it later.

links.title: Elaborando y degustando delicioso jugo frutal de zapote y mango.(Esp/Eng)
links.body:
# Español

# Saludos amigos amantes de las ricas y refrescantes bebidas saludables💁☀️

¡Feliz día para todos!

Este domingo, amigos, aprovechando que poseía en la despensa dos de mis frutas predilectas : Zapote y mango , quise elaborar un delicioso jugo mixto mañanero, para comenzar el día con vigor explorando nuevos sabores frutales. Los invito a que me acompañen a conocer el paso a paso de como obtuve esta deliciosa bebida.¡Comencemos!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_142328407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23tc7iBbJ2Lo4JjRRbyeFU63BnquryHZcprD96YZTZ7VzNBSsj6Pv4qCqGWWJ3tHvbMP6.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨Jugo mixto de zapote y mango✨
# ✨Ingredientes para dos comensales, cantidad 2 vasos grandes.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_135819877.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uFc9m3r1LRHTbY6macaLDPV9KgaehqkqvVYdLYhKxFzC19pyMwpgPxsyPFt5RyCdBVh.jpg)
</center>
#
.Zapote maduro: 1 unidad grande
.Mango clase biscochuelo: 1 unidad mediana
.Azúcar blanca: 2 cucharadas pequeñas
.Sal, una pisca
.Agua fría: 1/2 litro

# ✨Modo de confección✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_140626008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsdaLwqLWJMtHB94xymsKKT9J5r3EQk8nAWnG288tajPEKHNo59PeHgbmGMtMHWsuuj.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié tomando las frutas: zapote, mango, y lavándolas con abundante agua. Seguidamente, tomé un cuchillo y comencé a retirar cuidadosamente toda la cáscara del mango, a lonjearlo y a cortarlo en pequeños cuadraditos. ¡Increíble el aroma dulce tan delicioso!, que impregnaba la cocina durante este proceso.Luego, tomé el zapote, y con ayuda de un cuchillo lo corté centralmente, seguidamente lo abrí, le retiré su enorme semilla interna y le extraje para un plato con ayuda de una cuchara, toda su masa interna.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_141112466.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wMjLbEmq144mCXAtgqquBEqbU2UW3iUtdDYHbkJ5jyfYBz7ivkeZaaCYuWKFherWLfz.jpg)
</center>
#
Ya teniendo las frutas preparadas, coloqué a mi alcance el 1/2 litro de agua fría, el azúcar, la sal a emplear, y comencé a elaborar el jugo con el método siguiente:
En el vaso de la batidora incorporé: la masa frutal, el agua, 2 cucharadas de azúcar, la pisca de sal, lo tapé, y puse a batir su contenido por 3 minutos.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_141424122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uFgbihJNtUjJ8qbWJ7HxQ4ootbSRZBBPi9pPWbiN7Kv6YDGExQLW7MQRPaUTinQwuxt.jpg)
</center>
#
Transcurrido el tiempo, un denso y apetecible jugo de color rojizo,obtuve, que serví y decoré con diminutos trocitos de mango.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_141832598.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/2424AXunbBBhrehkZQuC6hQyWLGkqWkmtGAJK9VXdWhLVMwMbHs1WnoeFyXFfCqiVtcRn.jpg)
</center>
#
Deliciosa la suaves y dulces texturas mezcladas, lograron un sabor único, espectacular, que valió la pena degustar.Amigos, espero que pronto se animen a deleitar este jugo frutal en familia, que además, nutre al organismo.

Les deseo vibras positivas y un relajado domingo en familia.¡Abrazos!
Fotografías propias.
*** 
*** 
# English
# Making and tasting delicious fruit juice of zapote and mango.

# Greetings friends lovers of rich and refreshing healthy drinks💁☀️

Happy day to everyone!

This Sunday, friends, taking advantage of the fact that I had two of my favorite fruits in the pantry: Zapote and mango, I wanted to make a delicious morning mixed juice, to start the day with vigor exploring new fruit flavors. I invite you to join me to know the step by step of how I got this delicious drink.Let's get started!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_142328407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23tc7iBbJ2Lo4JjRRbyeFU63BnquryHZcprD96YZTZ7VzNBSsj6Pv4qCqGWWJ3tHvbMP6.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨Mixed juice of zapote and mango✨
# ✨Ingredients for two people, quantity 2 large glasses.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_135819877.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uFc9m3r1LRHTbY6macaLDPV9KgaehqkqvVYdLYhKxFzC19pyMwpgPxsyPFt5RyCdBVh.jpg)
</center>
#
.Mature zapote: 1 large unit
.Biscochuelo class handle: 1 medium unit
.White sugar: 2 small tablespoons
.Come on out, have a snack
.Cold water: 1/2 liter

# ✨Mode of preparation✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_140626008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsdaLwqLWJMtHB94xymsKKT9J5r3EQk8nAWnG288tajPEKHNo59PeHgbmGMtMHWsuuj.jpg)
</center>
#
I started by taking the fruits: zapote, mango, and washing them with plenty of water. Next, I took a knife and began to carefully remove all the peel from the mango, slice it and cut it into small squares. Amazing the sweet aroma so delicious!, which permeated the kitchen during this process.Then, I took the sapote, and with the help of a knife I cut it centrally, then I opened it, removed its huge internal seed and extracted all its internal mass for a plate with the help of a spoon.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_141112466.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wMjLbEmq144mCXAtgqquBEqbU2UW3iUtdDYHbkJ5jyfYBz7ivkeZaaCYuWKFherWLfz.jpg)
</center>
#
Already having the fruits prepared, I placed within my reach the 1/2 liter of cold water, the sugar, the salt to be used, and I began to make the juice with the following method:
In the glass of the mixer I incorporated: the fruit dough, the water, 2 tablespoons of sugar, the pinch of salt, I covered it, and I put to beat its contents for 3 minutes.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_141424122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uFgbihJNtUjJ8qbWJ7HxQ4ootbSRZBBPi9pPWbiN7Kv6YDGExQLW7MQRPaUTinQwuxt.jpg)
</center>
#
After a while, I got a dense and appetizing reddish juice, which I served and decorated with tiny pieces of mango.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260523_141832598.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/2424AXunbBBhrehkZQuC6hQyWLGkqWkmtGAJK9VXdWhLVMwMbHs1WnoeFyXFfCqiVtcRn.jpg)
</center>
#
Delicious the soft and sweet textures mixed, they achieved a unique, spectacular flavor, which was worth tasting.Friends, I hope that soon you will be encouraged to enjoy this fruit juice as a family, which also nourishes the body.

I wish you positive vibes and a relaxed family Sunday.Hugs!
Own photographs.

links.title: Listen To Melody's Space Last Night
links.body:
Prez is amazing. He did so good. He was so, I loved the way he handled a lot of that, and I think you were being hard on yourself, Prez, at the end, but I really don't think you needed to.

I think all three of us gave way more leeway than probably most people would have, so I'm way more convinced. Yeah, yeah, for sure. You were there most of the time, and then Prez came in and walked in on like this kind of tornado that was going on, and it was like a constant tornado, you know, that kept coming back.

It wouldn't go away. That's what it felt like when I was listening in. You know, you have these beautiful songs, you know, by Malavie and a couple of the other artists that were in there, and then your voice of reason trying to, you know, kind of diffuse the situation, and then Prez coming in when he did.

So, yeah, I let Prez know that too. I think like at, what was that, Prez, like 4 a.m. or something like that, I really appreciated that because there's many different ways we could go about doing that, as we know, but I think there's a peaceful way to it, and sometimes, you know, if we allow people to talk enough, they'll leave too. That's worked with some disruptors.

Just let them keep talking, and in that case, you know, she does that for a profession, and as we know, comedians don't like it when people don't laugh. So if nobody is paying attention, you know, I know it sounds cruel, but, you know, we're playing hardball here. I didn't know her, Dante.

Yeah, no, I know, and Prez didn't. It was fun at first, and then it went south real fast, and I was like, wait. It gets ugly, and it's the same game all the time, and Prez didn't know her either, so I mentioned that to Prez for some feedback that's a great way to deal with her because of who she is in her profession, that the best way to deal with people like that is to just let them keep talking, and when they realize that there's no one paying attention, you don't have to do anything at all.

You don't have to do anything at all, and they leave because they feel inadequate, and that's an ugly thing to say, but it's just the damn truth. So, but anyway, it was a beautiful space otherwise, and that's why I wanted to mention that about you and Prez. If you guys want to listen to some beautiful music and see Bridget's and Prez's true hearts, go listen to Melody's Space Last Night.

links.title: ‎Bruno Fernandes: The New Premier League King of Assists ‎
links.body:
‎Football is a game that sometimes celebrates goalscorers, but often the true heartbeat of a team is the player creating the magic behind those goals. Bruno Fernandes reminded the football world why creativity is just as important as finishing this season.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmP8wJNNqxBhdqh2kVRW93CxJkkejtPdPzyU2SvwVV5mxd/file_0000000000847246b508edbf4829c96a.png 

‎
‎Week in week out, Bruno carried responsibility on his shoulders. He created chances when nobody else could. He inspired the team in tough moments and became the leader Manchester United desperately needed. His vision, passing range, composure, and ability to unlock defenses made him one of the most important players in the premier league this season.
‎
‎What makes this campaign even more special is the history he has now created.
‎
‎For years, the Premier League record for the most assists in a single season stood at 20. A record shared by two legends of the game, Manchester City maestro Kevin De Bruyne and Arsenal icon Thierry Henry. Many great playmakers like Sallah, Fabregas, Ozil came close, but none could go beyond that number.
‎
‎Until Bruno Fernandes.
‎
‎Lately this season, Bruno equaled the record with his 20th assist, already placing his name among the greatest creators the league has ever seen. But today, which happens to be the final day of the Premier League season, he went one step further and made history his own.
‎
‎Manchester United traveled away to Brighton & Hove Albion, and once again Bruno delivered when it really mattered most. In the 33rd minute, his brilliant assist for Patrick Dorgu took his tally to 21 assists for the season and that's the highest ever recorded in a single Premier League campaign.
‎
‎Twenty-one assists.
‎
‎A new record.
‎
‎A new king of assists.
‎
‎What makes this achievement even more impressive is that Bruno achieved it under pressure, criticism, and huge expectations. While others faded, he continued producing moments of brilliance.
‎
‎Records are meant to be broken, but some records also define greatness.
‎
‎He is even on the score sheet today with a brilliant goal to wrap up the season and demonstrate reason why he deserves the premier league player of the season.
‎
‎This season, Bruno Fernandes did not just break a record but he created a legacy.
‎
