links.title: La Cuarta [ES - EN]
links.body:
> En el pequeño Ullevaal Stadion, localizado en la ciudad de Oslo, Noruega, se disputó la final de la UEFA Champions League Femenina en su temporada 2025-2026; el actual mejor equipo de fútbol femenino del viejo continente, el FC Barcelona, buscaba obtener su 4.º título de dicha competición al disputar su sexta final de manera consecutiva, pero para poder alcanzar esa meta deberían superar a un gran obstáculo, las multicampeonas y poderosas económicamente OL Lyonnes. Esta sería la tercera ocasión en donde francesas y catalanas se ven en una final de la Champions League, lo cual significaría el desempate, ya que en la final del 2022, la victoria fue para las leonas y en el 2024 la victoria fue para las culés, pero más que definir el desempate entre ambos equipos, existía algo más y eso era generar el convencimiento de qué estilo realmente reina en el fútbol femenino europeo. 
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

The 2025–2026 UEFA Women’s Champions League final was held at the small Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, Norway; The current best women’s soccer team on the Old Continent, FC Barcelona, was seeking its fourth title in the competition as it played in its sixth consecutive final, but to achieve that goal, they would have to overcome a major obstacle: the multi-time champions and financially powerful OL Lyonnes. This would be the third time the French and Catalan teams have faced off in a Champions League final, which would serve as a decider, since in the 2022 final, victory went to the Lionesses, and in 2024, victory went to the Culés. But more than just settling the score between the two teams, there was something else at stake: establishing which style truly reigns supreme in European women’s football. 


![1000298200.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EoGvSc4San4GLYaWm7GWHc3E3xVQ1davJZCVLtJJ89xwgQ9Lc9J3HGh2TFuMYmjsvKj.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2058232672619561008)

Al momento de confirmarse la final entre estos dos equipos, pensé que no podía haber un mejor enfrentamiento para cerrar la temporada en el fútbol femenino europeo y es que como sucede en el masculino, la inversión económica de manera poderosa influye en la creación de super equipos que posteriormente serán considerados como los grandes favoritos para obtener los títulos, ahora, del otro lado están muchos equipos femeninos que deben luchar en sobreponer y conformar equipos que puedan ser competivos desde su base de inferiores y confiando en jugadoras que forman un lazo muy fuerte con la institución para seguir hasta el final de sus carreras, uno de esos equipos es el FC Barcelona que por los muy conocidos problemas financieros, deben usar a su talentosa cantera para sobreponerse y así ser lo suficientemente competitivas y para ejemplo está lo que han hecho en los últimos años que a pesar de perder impresionantes jugadoras, han sabido sumar a otras y así dominar el torneo local y ser protagonistas en Europa.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

When the final between these two teams was confirmed, I thought there couldn’t be a better matchup to close out the season in European women’s soccer. Just as in men’s soccer, financial investment has a powerful influence on the creation of superteams that are subsequently considered the heavy favorites to win titles. On the other hand, there are many women’s teams that must struggle to overcome challenges and build squads capable of competing from their youth ranks, relying on players who form a strong bond with the club to stay until the end of their careers. One such team is FC Barcelona, which, due to its well-known financial problems, must rely on its talented youth academy to overcome these challenges and remain competitive. A prime example is what they have achieved in recent years: despite losing impressive players, they have managed to bring in new talent, thereby dominating the domestic league and making their mark in Europe.


![1000298201.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EoAZpS8B1VCH2KDQStaoWV8tq4GZkudQiEiJMtMEGDZEqDupDAhfB73HK5Wn3ZKhpYq.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2058240949797388329)

La gran relevancia de este encuentro es, como dije anteriormente, una representación sobre la lucha de estilos y, después de llevarse a cabo la final, podemos decir que fue emocionante y gratificante ver el esfuerzo entre las jugadoras que estuvieron en el campo de juego. La lucha en imponer primeramente fuerza y después estilo, es lo que pienso que definió a este encuentro; el primer tiempo, el Lyoness impuso su poderio físico intentando de cortar todo circuito del mediocampo culé, lo cual era lo más predecible porque de ahí proviene la fuerza actual del Barça; esa fuerza del club francés les hizo obtener un mayor porcentaje de posesión del balón lo cual les proveyó de ocasiones muy claras que fueron repelidas por la excelente actuación de Cata Coll portera del Barça, justamente esa actuación de Cata fue un impulsor para que sus compañeras pudieran aguantar el vendaval rival y poco a poco sentirse más cómoda en el juego y eso se convirtió en dos claras ocasiones que lamentablemente no pudo concretar Ewa Pajor, pero de igual manera demostró cierta debilidad de las leonas en el retroceso, lo cual ver, que el contraataque era el arma a usar para ganar el encuentro.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

The great significance of this match, as I mentioned earlier, lies in the clash of styles, and now that the final is over, we can say that it was exciting and rewarding to witness the effort put forth by the players on the field. The battle to impose strength first and style second is what I believe defined this match; in the first half, Lyoness imposed their physical dominance by attempting to cut off all of Barça’s midfield play, which was the most predictable move because that is where Barça’s current strength lies; that strength of the French club allowed them to gain a higher percentage of ball possession, which provided them with very clear scoring opportunities that were thwarted by the excellent performance of Cata Coll, Barça’s goalkeeper; It was precisely Cata’s performance that gave her teammates the boost they needed to weather the opponent’s storm and gradually feel more comfortable in the game, leading to two clear chances that Ewa Pajor unfortunately couldn’t convert. However, this also exposed a certain weakness in the Lionesses’ defense, making it clear that the counterattack was the weapon to use to win the match.


![1000298202.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EoEqXfp8QrFmvMaN9nQCS3QfG6HT44m6BRReXy1ZWfK4a8sTYKcJdgURpMFAEqnk1Em.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2058244682094690614)

El segundo tiempo fue una demostración de contundencia, efectividad y muy buen fútbol por parte del FC Barcelona; como dije anteriormente, el arma del contraataque fue fundamental para este equipo que vio cierta lentitud en su rival y eso lo aprovecharon las jugadoras rápidas que tiene el Barça, para demostración solo bastó la jugada del promer gol culé originada por un contraataque liderado por la extensa conducción del balón de Patricia Guijarro quien asistió a Ewa quien usando velocidad y precisión en la condición del balón se generó la oportunidad para anotar tan importante gol que en mi opinión derrumbó por completo al rival que no pudo reaccionar de manera rápida y lo cual conllevó al segundo gol, también anotado por Pajor después de una jugada rápida en dónde se involucró a muchas más jugadoras del Barça; después de eso apareció nuevamente Cata para cortar toda posibilidad de reacción por el rival, desmotivando a las francesas que de una posición privilegiada veían como Salma Paralluelo anotaba no solo uno, sino dos goles que cerraron el marcador y así ganar su cuarto título de la Champions League Femenina.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

The second half was a display of power, efficiency, and excellent soccer by FC Barcelona; as I mentioned earlier, the counterattack was a key weapon for this team, which noticed a certain slowness in its opponent and took advantage of it through Barça’s speedy players. The play leading to the first goal was a perfect example: a counterattack initiated by Patricia Guijarro’s long run with the ball, who then assisted Ewa. Using her speed and precision with the ball, Ewa created the opportunity to score that crucial goal, which, in my opinion, completely demoralized the opponent—who couldn’t react quickly enough—and led to the second goal, also scored by Pajor after a quick play involving many more Barça players; after that, Cata appeared again to cut off any possibility of a reaction from the opponent, demoralizing the French players who, from a privileged position, watched as Salma Paralluelo scored not just one, but two goals that sealed the score and thus secured their fourth Women’s Champions League title.


![1000298203.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EpEHFsiZsNRqRJmStoHSJeDt599B7Ajju81pirDRabQAoeRYxpPj293ZFFJFJro6ryU.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2058255566321959243)

En la actualidad existen equipos que usan a la humildad para generar una imagen de víctima o excusa para hacerse ver de que es difícil competir contra otros equipos económicamente poderosos y el Barça Femeni, que tiene una plena base de cantera y la seguirá teniendo por años, nunca ha usado esa imagen para ser competitivas, creo más bien que este equipo debe ser un modelo a seguir para muchos clubes hasta en España porque tanto en Alemania como en Inglaterra, el fútbol femenino vive de la formación de las jugadoras, el asunto está en que al aparecer organizaciones dispuesta a invertir gran cantidad de dinero (lo cual no está mal) vivirán de lo generado por otros y a pesar de ser válido, creo que el éxito en una gran competición posiblemente no sea algo que se obtenga por decreto, ya que como muchos dicen, \

y justamente creo que eso define esta final y el cuarto título de Champions para el Barça, un equipo formado por jóvenes, consagradas, de la cantera, de otras nacionalidades, pero que al final todas creen y practican un estilo de fútbol que genera cada vez más admiración y apoyo; ese es el otro gran título del póker obtenido por el equipo culé.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

Today, there are teams that use humility to project an image of victimhood or as an excuse to claim that it’s difficult to compete against financially powerful teams. Barça Femeni, which has a robust youth academy and will continue to do so for years to come, has never used that image to gain a competitive edge. I believe, rather, that this team should serve as a role model for many clubs, even in Spain, because in both Germany and England, women’s soccer thrives on player development. The issue is that when organizations emerge willing to invest large sums of money (which isn’t a bad thing), they will rely on what others have built. And while that’s valid, I believe success in a major competition isn’t something that can be decreed, since, as many say, “style isn’t negotiable,” or, as Cata Coll stated: \

and I believe that’s precisely what defines this final and Barça’s fourth Champions League title—a team made up of young players, established stars, academy graduates, and players of other nationalities, but who, in the end, all believe in and practice a style of soccer that garners ever-increasing admiration and support; that is the other great title in the four-peat achieved by the Catalan team.

links.body: ### Hello Hivers! \n\nI read about fast street food in a [post by @tarazkp (Sorry, if you got bothered with mention)](https://ecency.com/hive-168869/@tarazkp/out-and-outside), in which he wrote about how fast food can be very harmful to our bodies. I did a lot of research on this and came to the conclusion that I should also spread awareness. So, I found out a lot of things that I would like to share with you all and I would like you to be careful because ***\

*** ## What I have to Share? One thing is common in all of us that we all love good food. When we work for late nights or feel tired or want to celebrate an achievement. ***What We Do?*** We immediately order a juicy burger sometimes a plate of spicy biryani or crispy fries with combo of Cold Drink to get relaxed. It is as quick as harmful, it tastes great and it makes us happy in the moment. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSRbseHeUUxHQZXV2yBCk9QuXQyGaYfY25qftTfhuxBV4/1779650970660.png) Image Created With Google Gemini But what in reality? Let me show you a scary reality **Our Deep Love For Fast Food And Street Food Is Turning Into A Silent Killer Especially For The Younger Generation.** Many of us think that serious health issues only happen when we get old. But nowadays young people are trading their health for temporary \

and the results are truly heartbreaking, isn't it true? It is! you might have seen someone around your office or home who love to eat Fast Street Food and also suffering from several health issues...


### The Scary Numbers We Can not Ignore.

I got some dangerous details we should not ignore, sometimes we often worry about big accidents or disasters but the real danger is hiding right inside our food boxes what are we taking daily without knowing what we exactly are taking? The biggest threats to our youth today are heart attacks, diabetes and stomach cancers, ***how many people you have seen around you who are suffering from any of these diseases?***

Look at these shocking facts from health organizations I have found on Google...

 * **Half of all heart attack patients** are now under 50 years old, under 50.

 * **15% of heart attack patients** are under 40 years old here comes a big Question Mark. That means one out of every three heart patients is a young person who should be in the prime of their life might be in our zone, who knows...?

 * Severe liver diseases like fatty liver, are no longer just an issue for overweight people. Even young children and thin teenagers are getting severely sick because of toxic eating habits.

• **H-PYLORI** Helicobacter pylori is a gram-negative bacterium  known for its role in causing gastric ulcers in the human stomach.


### It Can Happen to Anyone.

I have searched many of real and emotional stories of individuals whose lives were cut short or completely changed by bad food habits, you also can read about bad food habits on Google or any search engine of your like. We still have time to change our lifestyle to make our future healthy. 



## What Are We Actually Putting in Our Bodies?

It is really a shocking trend in many cities, street vendors selling french fries mixed with **18 different spices and flavors, are you sure they are using health friendly things?**. When the host tried them he realized there was no real flavor just an extreme painful amount of red chili used to hide low quality ingredients...
When extreme spice and low quality oil enter your body they cause severe acid reflux. This acid is so strong that it can literally burn holes in a person's stomach and intestines over time.

Even worse, many of times this addiction often starts right at home. *\

* Parents buy these cheap street fries for their toddlers as a quick treat. Because these street foods are very cheap and they think about taste but never look for quality of food, many of vendors use the lowest quality unmonitored ghee and recycled oil that has been boiled over and over again. This recycled oil is highly toxic for the human heart, **\

**.



### Simple Precautions: How to Protect Your Health

As being a Doctor and writer who deeply believes in discipline and consistency, I know that changing habits isn't easy at all. You do not have to stop enjoying life not even I am saying that to you but you must protect your body. 

Here are simple everyday precautions you can take to stay safe 👇:

 * **Make Fast Food at Home;** If your family or kids crave burgers, pizzas or fries make them at home. When you cook at home you control the quality of the oil you use fresh ingredients and you keep the spice levels safe as per your own taste and most importantly you know the hygiene.

 * **Limit Outside Food to Once a Month;** Treat eating out as a rare special occasion not a daily routine. Do not order food just because you are bored, tired or working a late shift. Keep some snacks with you to spend your time and those little cravings.

 * **Choose Quality Over Price;** If you do choose to eat out avoid unhygienic street carts that use cheap open market oil. Go to cleaner places that care about hygiene even if it costs a little more, *\

Myth;** Many people drink a cold soda after a heavy meal thinking it helps digest the food. Really? Does this works? In reality the high sugar and chemicals combine with heavy fats to put extreme pressure on your liver and stomach. Drink water instead...

 * **Listen to Your Body:** Do not ignore constant bloating stomach pain or never ignore heartburn by just taking a quick antacid pill. These are warning signs from your stomach telling you to stop and to take care of yourself...



### Conclusion: Health is the True Wealth

At the end of the day, health is your greatest asset. If you have all the money, success, and fame in the world but your body is failing, you cannot enjoy a single bit of it.

Do not wait for a medical emergency or a hospital visit to change your lifestyle. Consistency in eating clean, fresh, home-cooked meals is the best investment you can make for your future. Your future self will thank you!

https://youtu.be/C0G7P82KbhI

[Originally uploaded to Bilibili.tv](https://www.bilibili.tv/en/video/4799654256187904)

Yeah, it's a filler event. Nothing really interesting to see this time but the scenarios were fun. Itto and Kirara are always welcome sights. Having a five man team of the Little Witches was interesting enough.

The only thing that's disappointing is that Itto used to have this very important character arc that related to Japanese society and I was looking forward to see that develop and eventually conclude. Basically Japan has this very crucial issue of extreme conformity. It's smothering for them and it's been a problem that's discussed often. More recently, the previously ostracized \

have gotten better portrayals in anime. In the past they were just dregs of society, useless and dismissed by everybody. Now, there's been a better attempt at understanding that not all of them are misbehaving so much as just trying to have their own identity rather than following the crowd. Itto was this for Genshin. The original story for him was someone who kept getting into trouble in Inazuma's closed off and traditional society. However looking closer at him you realize he can get things done and he actually has a role in moving Inazuma forward as it opened back up to the rest of the world. If you give him a direction and guide his hand, he can achieve some great feats. A few years ago when he saw some young youkai feeling ostracized by humans, he single-handedly constructed a makeshift version of an old era holiday that allowed youkai and humans to intermingle. It wasn't anything fancy but it was still an incredible undertaking by a single oni like him. And to reward this effort, Yae Miko who essentially runs the nation brought in more visitors and made it flashier than Itto could himself. And as it would happen, it was actually all her plan anyway because she'd already noticed Itto's potential for bringing change.

Oops, went off on a rant there. Yeah I'm a big fan of that character arc. Anyway the rest of this event should just be about introducing Homura and reuniting her with Popcorn. I'm still hoping that Prune's story will be explained but who knows what these guys will actually produce. See you Tuesday for the conclusion!

### ¡Saludos querida Comunidad! 👋🏼🪸

Soy Ajolote, la Mascota del Proyecto @aliento. Mi fin es guiar a los usuarios que publican en la Comunidad Aliento y darle la bienvenida a los nuevos usuarios.

Para quienes formamos parte del **Proyecto Aliento,** es un privilegio ver cómo se expande nuestra comunidad y tenderle la mano a los creadores que continúan consolidando su camino en la blockchain; por ello, nos apasiona compartir sugerencias que impulsen el talento de cada uno de ustedes.

​Sin importar si apenas estás descubriendo este ecosistema o si ya cuentas con un recorrido publicando, estamos convencidos de que estas herramientas y enfoques que compartimos hoy se convertirán en grandes aliadas para tu crecimiento:


---

#### 5 Nuevos pilares para navegar con éxito en Hive:
***
####  1️⃣ El arte de responder los comentarios (No dejes a nadie en \

, intenta devolver una pregunta, compartir una anécdota extra o profundizar en el tema; esto no solo genera hilos de conversación geniales, sino que fideliza a tus lectores y demuestra que valoras su tiempo de verdad.

####  2️⃣ El valor de diversificar tus comunidades:
Es comodísimo publicar siempre en el mismo rincón donde ya te conocen, pero Hive es un océano enorme; por eso, toma en cuenta que si solo públicas en un lugar, te estás perdiendo la oportunidad de conectar en otros nichos que podrían amar lo que haces.

**📌Tips:** Si un día escribes de cocina, ve a una comunidad gastronómica; si hablas de tus mascotas, busca un espacio especializado en animales. Moverte por diferentes comunidades te ayuda a diversificar tu audiencia y hace que tu cuenta sea descubierta por diferentes proyectos de curación.

####  3️⃣ La regla de oro del título: Atractivo pero honesto.
Recuerda que el título es la portada de tu libro; por ello, si es aburrido, nadie entrará, como cuando dejamos pasar un libro por su portada; tampoco uses \

(prometer algo en el título que luego no está en el post), ya que el lector se sentirá estafado y perderá la confianza en ti.\n\n**📌Tips:** Busca un equilibrio. Usa títulos que generen curiosidad o que dejen claro el beneficio de leerte (por ejemplo, en lugar de \

de texto difícil de digerirnpor lo largos o densos que son. Toma en cuenta que los separadores actúan como esos descansos en el camino que le dan un respiro visual a los ojos del lector.

**📌Tips:** Puedes usar el clásico comando de Markdown de tres asteriscos (***) para crear una línea sutil, o mejor aún, ¡usa separadores personalizados e imágenes que vayan con la temática de tu blog! Eso le da una identidad visual única a tu contenido.

####  5️⃣ Mantén una rutina sana (Calidad sobre cantidad):
Publicar tres veces al día por puro compromiso solo te llevará al agotamiento creativo (¡burnout!) y la calidad de lo que compartes terminará bajando, además puede verse como abuso de recompensas por parte de los curadores. En la Web3 se nota mucho cuando un post se hizo con prisa, tomate tu tiempo y haz tus publicaciones porque quieres, no porque debes.

**📌Tips:** Es preferible ver dos o tres posts tuyos a la semana que sean valiosos, sentidos y bien maquetados, que ver contenido diario sin alma, cree en nosotros los curadores notan eso. Dale tiempo a tus ideas para madurar ¡Tu salud mental y tu blog te lo agradecerán!

***

¡Cada paso cuenta! No se trata de correr, sino de disfrutar el viaje dentro del oceano de Hive ¡Desde Aliento Ajolote de deja esta nueva serie de tips para que sigas brillando en la blockchain! 🪸✨
 

>![ENGLISH VERSION]
>**Greetings dear Community!** 👋🏼🪸
​I am Ajolote, the Project @aliento Mascot. My goal is to guide users who post in the Aliento Community and to welcome new users.
>
>For those of us who are part of the Proyecto Aliento, it is a privilege to see our community expand and to lend a helping hand to the creators who continue consolidating their path on the blockchain; therefore, we are passionate about sharing suggestions that boost the talent of each and every one of you.
>
>No matter if you are just discovering this ecosystem or if you already have a history of posting, we are convinced that these tools and approaches we are sharing today will become great allies for your growth:
>
>**5 New Pillars to navigate Hive successfully:**
>**1️⃣ The art of replying to comments (Don't leave anyone on \

):**
>Hive is a social network, not a monologue, so remember that when someone takes the time to read your post and leave you a few words, the magic happens in the replies. Look at it from this perspective: leaving a comment unanswered is like slamming the door in their face.
>
>**📌Tips:** Don't limit yourself to generic replies like \

Try asking a question back, sharing an extra anecdote, or diving deeper into the topic; this not only creates great conversation threads but also builds loyalty among your readers and shows that you truly value their time.
>
>**2️⃣ The value of diversifying your communities:**
​It is very comfortable to always post in the same corner where people already know you, but Hive is a huge ocean; therefore, keep in mind that if you only post in one place, you are missing out on the opportunity to connect with other niches that might love what you do.
>
>**📌Tips:** If one day you write about cooking, go to a food community; if you talk about your pets, look for a space specialized in animals. Moving through different communities helps you diversify your audience and makes your account discoverable by different curation projects.
>
>**3️⃣ The golden rule of titles: Catchy but honest.**
​>Remember that the title is the cover of your book. If it's boring, no one will come in, just like when we pass on a book because of its cover; don't use \

either (promising something in the title that isn't in the post later), as the reader will feel cheated and will lose trust in you.\n>\n>**📌Tips:** Find a balance. Use titles that spark curiosity or make the benefit of reading you clear (for example, instead of \

). Keep in mind that honesty hooks people more in the long run!
>
>**4️⃣ Use text dividers to your advantage:**
​>Sometimes we write wonderful posts, but visually they feel like a \

of text that is hard to digest. Take into account that dividers act like those rest stops along the way that give the reader's eyes a visual break. > >📌Tips: You can use the classic Markdown command of three asterisks (***) to create a subtle line, or even better, use custom dividers and images that match the theme of your blog! That gives your content a unique visual identity. > >**5️⃣ Maintain a healthy routine (Quality over quantity):** ​Posting three times a day out of pure obligation will only lead to creative burnout, and the quality of what you share will end up dropping; plus, it can be seen as reward abuse by curators. In Web3, it's very noticeable when a post was rushed, take your time and make your posts because you want to, not because you have to. > >**📌Tips:** It is preferable to see two or three posts from you a week that are valuable, heartfelt, and well-formatted, than to see daily content without a soul. Give your ideas time to mature—your mental health and your blog will thank you! > >Every step counts! It's not about running, but about enjoying the journey inside the Hive ocean. From Aliento, we leave you with this new series of tips so you can keep shining on the blockchain! 🪸✨ ![1000517083.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ajolote/23vsUhTt1HTLGD4L13cQdcmc1oDaHTAg5NQo8j6FpjWdwcNjvnTcdZktnhdwrKp5FcUJg.png) --- || |:-:| |

body.title: The Global Economy’s Weak Spot....?
body.body:
According to John Thornhill, writing in the Financial Times, too many countries depends too much on Taiwan for high-tech semiconductor chips.

Most of us don't spend that much time thinking about computer chips...

Unless your phone’s acting up or your laptop crawls, why would you...? 

Unless you want to clue yourself up about this crucial tech which underpins so much our daily lives. Silcon Chips are everywhere now. They run AI, keep smartphones ticking, power military hardware, drive electric cars, handle medical devices, push money around the banking system, and operate the most basic appliances.

And almost all the really advanced chips on the planet come out of Taiwan.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23tbPh318zqVbdwxXEnB73t7aXxJXwziySeAocC4en948EZNq5AzD8matTXSueu6tfJze.png)


### A Small Island, Big Leverage

Apple, Nvidia, and many other tech giants rely almost entirely on Taiwanese factories. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) has cornered the market: they are able to make the sort of chips that no one else can mass produce, at least not yet.

And of course there's an obvious vulnerability here: China. When it does annexe Taiwan, I don't think this is an if, this could seriously disrupt our supply of semi-conductors. 

This is of course one of the downsides of chasing efficiency in a global market, it can lead to these kind of vulnerabilities. 

And this situation really exposes the cracks in globalism.... 

For ages, economic logic was dead simple: let markets decide where stuff gets made. If Taiwan can crank out chips for less money and higher quality, then it makes sense to send production there.

Until, of course, it doesn’t.

The world economy has gotten hooked on “just-in-time” supply chains. Companies keep fewer parts in stock and trust trade to stay smooth. That saves money when everything works—but the minute it doesn’t, the system basically falls apart.

Covid proved that vulnerability. The war in Ukraine showed a different kind of risk. And Taiwan is shaping up to be the biggest of all.

Plus, here’s a weird irony: globalisation was supposed to make countries friendlier and economies safer. Instead, every time nations become reliant on a key resource from one place, that place gains outsized power—and tension gets worse.

### How to make the system safer>? 

The U.S. is pumping billions into its own chip factories with the CHIPS Act. Europe’s trying similar moves. Even Britain is throwing around phrases like “economic resilience” and “supply chain security.”

The problem is that building a chip plant isn’t something you do overnight. It costs billions, takes years, and demands expertise that isn't easily found here in the UK.

body.title: My Peaceful Corner: LOH #290
body.body: > Life as we are living it is full of ups and downs. Each day comes with its own struggles but as human, what we do is face it head on as it comes. Life is beautiful as we all probably know by now but with all this beauty comes some level of responsibility and stress. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR513XXPwPzaYdMkEVW2o2UEWCqKiDCxwEt72QSgCF5KL/img_3172.jpg) Growing up, I didn’t have much to worry about because I was being taken care of. Now that I’m older, it’s a whole different world for me especially having to carry some responsibilities on my shoulders while also trying to build a good life for myself. There are days and sit and wonder if this is what adulthood really looks like or maybe it’s just me. But when I take a look at others, I know we all have it tough sometimes which is also part of the journey. This is what leads us to the topic of relaxation. Amidst all the hustle and bustle, some of us tend to forget to have fun, take that trip and blow off some steam. What is the essence of working so hard for all that money if you can’t even use it to have fun when necessary. Stress is a very bad thing, it can send you to your early grave and I’ve had to learn that the hard way. I’m the one person who loves to have fun and relax myself because life is too difficult to not have fun. I’m mostly stressed out due to work and other activities but when it comes to my relaxation, I don’t miss out on it. I’m a very adventurous person and so I do a lot of things to help me relax. But over the years, the one place I’ve found much peace and comfort in is the beach. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY375SbFxTjqF7w7jCKBd1NK2MDGe3tyRfJjGGZ2JB4XR/img_3203.jpg) For me to achieve a 100% relaxation level, I need to go to the beach, touch some grass, feel the breeze and enjoy the view of the wonders of the earth. For me, the beach brings me a different kind of feeling anything else does. It instantly calms me down in different ways and that’s why keep going back there over and over again. After going on a million adventures, I knew there was a reason why I always found my way back to the beach, it was my safe space! - - - Images belong to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

body.title: Garden of the gods Park, Colorado Springs. Day one of US Southwest Road Trip April 2026 [ENG/POL].
body.body: road trip, I am back on the road in Southwest US. This time we are a group of 9 and will drive 5,000km across <a href=\
>Utah. The first stop - and an appetizer - is
>Colorado Springs.\n\n[POL] Rok po pierwszej podróży po
>płd-zach. USA wracamy do Stanów Zjednoczonych. Tym razem w sile 9 osób przejedziemy 5tys km przez
>Utah. Pierwszy przystanek - i przystawka - to park '
>Garden of the gods' w Colorado Springs.\n\n

/>

Plan: US Road Trip 2026, Day 1

Each day of my
>April 2026 road trip had been designed to move down the planned route (a 15 days loop from Denver) and stop for hikes. The first stage was

>Garden of the gods and Florissant Fossil Beds. The latter had closed before we reached it. \n\n[POL] Każdy dzień podróży był zaplanowany, aby przesuwać się po zaplanowanej pętli (15 dni ze startem i metą w Denver) i zatrzymywać się na trekkingi. Pierwszy etap prowadził z

>Garden of the gods i Florissant Fossil Beds. To drugie miejsce niestety zamknęło się nim zdążyliśmy dojechać. 

Acommodations

Leaving:
>La Quinta Inn and Suites, Denver Airport,

>Outer Loop Trail (10,4km, 234m elevation gain)

The Road Trip Starts

We were a group of 9. The plan was to start from
>CO and travel the first 8 days together to Mt Carmel Junction,
>UT. There we would split - four people and I would close the loop to Denver, while the other four would divert west, heading to
>CA. Obviously, my story (expect more posts - on per day of
>our trip!) covers only my group - a 15 days, 5,000km loop starting and ending in Denver, CO. We rented a Dodge Durango (SUV, 7 seats - brand new!) from Sixt and spent our first night at
>La Quinta Inn and Suites, Denver Airport,

/>
\n\n[POL] Zaczęliśmy podróż w grupie 9 osób w
>Colorado). Plan zakładał wspólną podróż przez pierwsze 8 dni, po czym rozdzieliśmy się. Moja grupa (5 osób) zamknęła pętlę do Denver a pozostałe 4 osoby pojechały do
>California). Moja opowieść (ten post to pierwszy

>odcinek serii!) dotyczy mojej grupy - w ciągu 15 dni przejedziemy 5tys km pętlą z początkiem i końcem w Denver (Colorado). Wypożyczyliśmy w Sixt nowiutki Dodge Durango (SUV z 7 miejscami). Pierwszą noc spaliśmy w
>La Quinta Inn and Suites, Denver Airport, (
>Rocky Mountains (Front Range), view from our motel in
>Garden of the gods Park. We stopped on the I-25 highway to appreciate our first view of the
>Rocky Mountains. To be specific, it was the Front Range of Southern Rockies.\n\n[POL] Naszym pierwszym celem jest
>Garden of the gods'. Po drodze z Denver zatrzymaliśmy się przy punkcie widokowym na autostradzie I-25 aby po raz pierwszy popatrzeć na
>Góry Skaliste. Konkretnie - pasmo Front Range w południowej części łańcucha. \n\n

/>

Garden of the gods

History

In 1909 children of Charles Elliott Perkins, a wealthy railroads tycoon, deeded the '
>Garden of the gods' Park to the city of

>Colorado Springs. There was one condition, though - access to the Park must be forever free. The city has kept their side of the deal ever since and so we hiked this beautiful place for free, including no parking fee.\n\n

/>
\n\n[POL] W 1909 roku spadkobiercy Charles'a Elliott'a Perkins'a, zamożnego magnata kolejowego, przekazali teren parku '

>Colorado Springs. Donacja miała jeden warunek - wstęp do parku ma na zawsze pozostać darmowy. Miasto dotrzymało słowa i mogliśmy spacerować w tym pięknym miejscu za darmo, w tym parking i toalety.\n\n

/>
\n\nThe name 'Garden of the gods' was coined in 1859 when two surveyors from Denver were exploring and measuring the terrain for what would soon become Colorado Springs. Awed by the beauty of the place one of them commented that it would be an excellent place for a beer garden. The other, Rufus Cable, exclaimed \

/>
\n\n[POL] Nazwa 'Ogród bogów' powstała w czasie wizyty dwóch geodetów z Denver, którzy mieli za zadanie wykonać pomiary pod miasto, które wkrótce będzie znane jako Colorado Springs. Zachwyceni pięknem tego miejsca, jeden z nich rzucił uwagę, że byłoby to dobre miejsce na ogródek piwny. Drugi, Rufus Cable, wykrzyknął \

/>
The two explorers were not aware that this place had been known as 'creation garden'  in the mythology of Ute nation. Ute, Apache, Comanche and other Native American nations had known this place for centuries. [POL] Dwaj mierniczy nie mieli świadomości, że w mitologii narodu Ute to miejsce było znane jako 'ogród stworzenia'. Ute, Apache, Comanche i inni rdzenni amerykanie znali ten ogród od stuleci.

/>

Geology

The geological history is more puzzling than the origins of the name. Tucked between the flat expanse of Great Plains (Prairies) and monumental granite peaks of Rocky Mountains, the Garden's red rocks seem not to fit any of the two. The red and pink sandstone had been first deposited in horizontal layers, as any sedimentary rocks. Then the forces of nature tilted them vertically and faulted into the fins we can admire today.

/>
[POL] Historia geologiczna jest jeszcze ciekawsza. Skały z czerwonego piaskowca, położone na granicy Wielkich Równin (Prerii) i majestatycznych granitów Gór Skalistych, zdają się nie pasować do żadnej z tych krain. Są to skały osadowe, które pierwotnie były ułożone horyzontalnie. Siły natury podniosły je i przewróciły, formując charakterystyczne 'płetwy rekina'.

/>

Destination Buena Vista

Garden of the gods Park was our very first hike during the
>2026 US Southwest road trip. It is an amazing place but in retrospective, it was 'just an appetizer' for what we would later see in
>Utah. Before that, however, we would drive two days southwards, along the ranges of southern
>New Mexico. We would therefore swap red sandstone for grey granite covered with white snow caps. \n\n[POL] Park Garden of the gods był pierwszym przystankiem w
>USA. To przepiękne miejsce, patrząc z perspektywy całej wyprawy, było 'tylko przystawką' do późniejszych scenerii
>Utah. Zanim tam jednak dotrzemy, mamy przed sobą dwa dni jazdy na południe przez
>Gór Skalistych. Zostawiamy na ten czas czerwone piaskowce na rzecz szarych granitów przykrytych białymi czapami śniegu.\n\n

/>

Coffee higher than Poland

During the drive to
>Buena Vista, CO, we stopped for a late lunch at
>Cafe Leo in Woodland. While their sandwiches were tasty and I'd recommend swinging by, I pointed a fun fact to my group. We were having coffee and sandwiches at 2590m a.s.l. The highest peak of
>Tatra Mts, rises to 2500m a.s.l...\n\n[POL] Po drodze na nocleg do
>Buena Vista (Colorado), zatrzymaliśmy się na późny lunch w
>Cafe Leo w Woodland. Dobre sandwicze są warte zatrzymania się, ale zwróciłem mojej grupie uwagę na ciekawy fakt - pijemy kawę na wysokości 2590m n.p.m., wyżej niż szczyt

/>

Collegiate Peaks

We enjoyed the lunch, but the time spent there cost us not reaching Florissant Fossil Beds before closure. We therefore drove to
>Buena Vista, CO. The name is not accidental ('good view' in Spanish) - just before the town we pulled over to admire majestic Collegiate Peaks (Sawatch Range of

>Rocky Mountains). It's a group of peaks reaching over 4,000m a.s.l., named after American top universities - Harvard, Princeton, Yale etc.\n\n[POL] Lunch nam smakował, ale czas spędzony na przełęczy kosztował nas dotarcie do Florissant Fossil Beds już po zamknięciu. Pozostało nam zatem jechać dalej, na nocleg do Buena Vista. Nazwa zobowiązuje ('dobry widok' z hiszpańskiego) - tuż przed miasteczkiem zatrzymaliśmy się aby podziwiać majestatyczne Collegiate Peaks (część pasma Sawatch Range

>Gór Skalistych).  Nazwa 'collegiate' ('szczyty akademickie') bierze się od najwyższych szczytów pasma, wznoszących się na ponad 4tys m n.p.m., nazwanych od wiodących amerykańskich uczelni - Harvard, Princeton, Yale itd.\n\n

/>

body.title: Something To BingeWatch
body.body:
## His and Hers

The series follows Anna, a former TV presenter, who investigates a murder in the town where she grew up. Her involvement brings her into conflict with her ex-husband, Detective Jack Harper, who becomes suspicious of her role in the case and soon turns into a suspect himself, uncovering a mystery full of lies and dark secrets. Is it worth watching?

https://youtu.be/8_szlvBLll0?is=95t8JKtyB4W5bIBt


🟢🟢🟢🟢

* Tessa Thompson and Jon Bernthal are both solid in the leading roles, with Thompson standing out slightly more.
* The mystery unfolds gradually with a good pace that keeps you hooked.
* Being only 6 episodes long helps avoid unnecessary stretching.
* I really liked the twist in the final episode, it leaves you thinking “what the hell just happened” 😅
* Well-crafted production overall.
* Nicely written script with a few minor flaws.
* It constantly creates doubt and suspicion, which is exactly what you want from a mystery series.
* Dark atmosphere throughout.

🔴🔴🔴🔴

* Story-wise, it leans on quite a few clichés and some obvious conveniences, though not in a way that becomes annoying.
* Some performances are a bit meh.
* A few characters could have been developed better.
* Certain events feel a little rushed or only touched on superficially, probably to save time.
* Overall, it is not particularly memorable or unique, but it is still an enjoyable watch.




## It: Welcome to Derry

It: Welcome to Derry is an ambitious television adaptation of Stephen King following Castle Rock, and it attempts to serve as a prequel to the two films. The story is set in 1962 and focuses on the origins of the Evil through the disappearance of a child, Matty Clements, which becomes the center of an unofficial investigation led by a small group of friends. Is it worth watching?

https://youtu.be/oKa6u7LT0qE?is=8nFZEU2B9KQZmR8L

🟢🟢🟢🟢

* For me, the first episode and the last two episodes were incredible.
* The child casting is really well done and makes you connect with the characters. They manage to convey both fear and their personal conflicts very effectively.
* Bill Skarsgård as Pennywise is excellent, just like in the films.
* I liked that midway through the season we learned more about Pennywise’s origin story.
* It has plenty of creepy moments.
* There is a LOT of blood.
* Great 1960s atmosphere.
* Very high production quality, especially for television.
* Some effects are genuinely WOW.
* Nice Easter eggs throughout.
* I liked how it portrays a society that is slowly falling apart internally. The script clearly carries social commentary.

🔴🔴🔴🔴

* The whole military subplot did not really contribute much to the story 🤷‍♂️
* The middle of the season drags a bit with too much talking.
* It loses its pacing at certain points, although thankfully it recovers 😅
* Some scenes feel overly exaggerated, even if the show’s themes can support that tone.
* A few visual effects look a little clumsy.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 24 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g27e9d41caa27d368c527c99b13ee287471f1d039a34535b8792746f546cb7b1adf01abfadc34f6b79eb866cf37c333060a6adb0fefaad2b20fcb83bb1dfe2511_640.jpg)
Сегодняшняя прогулка была просто невероятной! Я отправился в горы ранним утром, когда воздух еще свежий, а солнце только начинает подниматься над горизонтом. По пути я встретил группу туристов, которые шли в том же направлении. Мы разговорились, и они рассказали мне о своих планах покорить одну из соседних вершин. Было приятно узнать, что есть столько увлеченных людей, разделяющих любовь к природе. Кроме того, я увидел великолепный водопад, который образовался от таяния снега. Вода искрилась на солнце, и я не смог удержаться, чтобы не сделать несколько фотографий. Это было прекрасное напоминание о том, как важна природа и как она вдохновляет на новые приключения. Прогулка завершилась отличным настроением и новыми впечатлениями! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Greeting Hiveans and Chess Community

Miracles do exist in chess, LOL 😹

Yesterday's game initially started pretty bad for me, I was losing a lot games consecutivelyyy. It was about 10-15 mins to the end of the tournament I then began climbing the leaderboard and was able to secure the 7th place with 20 points.✨💫

/>

Round Fixtures:

> \n

I decided to look at one of the last games that gave me 5 points pump up. Both players beserked and white opened with the Queen's Pawn Game: Colle System. There was acutally a lot of blunders from both players since we both beserked and were trying to beat the time. It was those little roaches(the pawns) that actually saved me. During the endgame, I was able to promote one of the pawns to a Queen and White ran out of time.

body.title: Soon They Will Form Splinterlands TMNT lol
body.body:
![image by OpenAI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tvCtFC8AutBB2i3kou51Q4p2pkujV3AewGgsx7LBQp61qh79YFYQZxGAwtQJDL69T89.png)

Hello Summoners

In this Splinterlands post, I will share something so frivolous. I think it is good talk cheap and funny stuffs about in-game Splinterlands so players or summoners do not get too intense about \

from playing it.

So I use this post as a continuation from my Splinterlands post that I wrote years ago. I even could not recall it properly, but I am very sure that in the past I joked a lot about having Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtle in my line up.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/Eoe7AfGC9BypmSyAs3XAizxmXp33WcTrxL362he7DKg591Y9FQdgmVoMUu6rAtoEWjH.png

It was started by having this great card, Swamp Spitter. Swamp Spitter was a free card we got as rewards from playing Splinterlands, and although he was a common card, back then he was terrific. The fact that he shot hard 3 range damage and had a repair ability, was a bit to strong for a common card.

He was one of the early cards that enabled new opportunity, that you could defend without losing or sacrificing your offense. Swamp Spitter was and never be the core card that could carry a whole team, but his existence opened that meta.

Fast forwards to nowadays, actually we have another turtle hero here, a ninja wannabe.. The Aerial Shieldmaiden.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23wBZccn4NEVjyHzh9aFYYWGoCEEZ44NAfbKugRX58tWeajTKfwxbdGWD8q1SajAd8Ztq.png

Aerial Shieldmaiden is an unique case for me. At the beginning, I saw her as something \

in my line up, however I have to admit that I rarely use her recently. The foundation cards and escalation edition have created some better line up with their new units.

And I have to count in the new reward cards too, there are many other options I could go rather than forcing myself having Aerial Shieldmaiden in my team. However don't get me wrong here, I am not saying she is weaker than those units, it's just those units blend well better than her.

In general, I still think Aerial Shieldmaiden is strong. During certain condition, especially if your opponent does not expect you come with opportunity attacks, Shieldmaiden is your trump card there.

Maybe because the character is a SHE, people do not relate this tortoise to a Teenage Muntant Ninja Turtle joke. Not for me, I often think that... can she do well with Swamp Spitter in my team? Will they continue our TMNT Splinterlands joke?


#### The Battle

[![~Click The Image Above To See the Full Battle~](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23t7YkLGkfqMBFZrYNDgdoyHpABDhiZHesRJF9tioceSYQYSrG1QtXnBmpUn6RNmSEwZw.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_SnmUJkLP6ClnNxHMX93n?ref=dewabrata)

The opportunity to team up Swamp Spitter and Aerial Shieldmaiden came in a Brawl Battle. That time I dared myself to team up them with these condition:
1. That battle was not magic friendly. Everyone had a magic reflect ability, and 
I did not want to get countered by that condition.
2. Somehow my hunch told me to go all out in that battle. Maybe the 59 mana cap drove me to think that way.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tbMFskDGQndDhApt2FjoYKF2LFSFdaRUwFJ65rfWeCXzH9drQYvkkwWeLzKvZR6xusm.png

However both of us somehow decided to ignore that modifier, Shapeshift happens. I believed both of us came with same conclusion, we just wanted to gang ho, attack attack and attack.

Actually there was one big different approach between my team and their team. Could you notice it?
1. Their team focused on buffing up themselves. They added speed from supply runner swiftness ability and Jani Rebel's inspire ability.
2. My team focused on recovery, I used Calabash Sage to heal my tank and Swamp Spitter to fix the broken armors.

So I emphazied more on defense, and tried to counter attack using two units which had opportunity ability, whilst they were confidence with their attack by sending one Sandworm to break my backline.

In this battle Swamp Spitter was the defensive tortoise unit I had and Aerial Shieldmaiden was one of my core attackers. One attacker and one defender, hopefully they would team up very well here.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23t7YfTQmMRmwJjJzjHdMRuk8iEiUbvKjVJ6zFFz6RCqJn2CuVnyVULP2R6XazWbr7atq.png

Aerial Shieldmaiden showed her prowess instantly in the first round. She put down Supply runner, and this took out their speed buff and affected their team overall speed. This could be the starting point of their deteriorating strategy.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tbRZ6tizgJsSH9pBeVHYSDzLAEQjYBkttv5viU422K65uWP236wEuf2tr3KJUDZW8uh.png

Until round 3, their Sandworm could not kill anyone, especially my Swamp Spitter as his target. Swamp spitter kept fixing his armor and that armor withstood Sandworm massive attack. Sadly in round 3, Swamp Spitter fell down from Sandworm attack.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tkmzKmSJh9V4o7LNhPxgBiMQiSMm5t1cHAE78D8hbE3TbN1DtaaVtiWZXQou1TUmFjT.png

The last decisive action from Aerial Shieldmaiden came in the round 4. She took down opponent prismologist. It made Sandworm as the sole survivor in my opponent line up, and it's a matter of time before we put him down. Good Game.

Well what do we see from that battle? I think it is safe to say that those two tortoise worked well together, and the dream of having all turtle units might come true in future lol. We have two right now, one is more defensive and the other one is purely attacker but actually there are others but I could not afford to buy them.... 

Maybe we will have the next one as a tank to replace this Tortisan Fighter

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EoEgtkBqfJqTe2K9FwgjRa4cywVJRgDPeV7Hk3qVfGSmoL2A2rHKvqakdQQx5dfFrz4.png

but this one is too outdated and hard to fit him in with existing meta which have overpowered his era

Or a Mage Healer such as Tortisian Chief

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tv4CXrHAcheqKdtgXU8gvhfUwg9bfXPHLsy2gLXE6qrg1BCGMtihPJeQUrVVaTuQ6Ph.png

This one is a great unit too, but sadly the price is ridiculous and he has lack of soul to be Teenage Mutant... he is an old guy lol.
well who knows? Actually we had a mage turtle, but I do not have the card lol.
 
Anyway thank you for visiting my post today, and please show me your turtle team in in the Splinterlands battles lol... Have fun guys!

---

![https://splinterlands.com?ref=dewabrata](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tbH2XfEqZJAFKMvoBTZG6B1pBkH9XJz79EpLXCGCCHvNVgeBbigFfqAtfmeowZ49T85.gif)

body.title: CCC's Street Art Contest #302 Wynwood Miami Part XII : Jim Vision & Klonism
body.body:
For the [CCC's Street Art Contest #302](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@digi-me/ccc-s-street-art-contest-d3386d7c036e2) organized by **@digi-me**, we're staying in the **Wynwood neighborhood of Miami** with several murals painted on the warehouses along Interstate 95. I chose this collaboration between [**Jim Vision**](https://www.instagram.com/jimvision/) and [**Klonism**](https://www.instagram.com/klonism/) done in 2023 to enter the contest. Let me know at the end of this post if I made the right choice...

> *Pour le [CCC's Street Art Contest #302](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@digi-me/ccc-s-street-art-contest-d3386d7c036e2) organisé par **@@digi-me**, nous restons dans le quartier de **Wynwood à Miami** avec plusieurs murales faites sur les entrepôts qui longent l'autoroute 95. J'ai choisi cette collaboration de [**Jim Vision**](https://www.instagram.com/jimvision/) et [**Klonism**](https://www.instagram.com/klonism/) faite en 2023 pour participer au concours. Vous me direz à la fin du post si j'ai fait le bon choix...*

![Jim Vision & Klonism](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/243BeRpbCEGSJuZdonmimBjCAgXGx57vGnyexUYV7iSvHNBakssnxV74bueQPhBQfpETJ.JPG)

[**Jim Vision**](https://www.instagram.com/jimvision/), an English artist based in London, created this portrait of a woman surrounded by roses. The bird is the work of [**Klonism**](https://www.instagram.com/klonism/), who enjoys creating brightly colored animals. The overall effect is truly stunning.

> *[**Jim Vision**](https://www.instagram.com/jimvision/), artiste anglais basé à Londres, a fait ce portrait féminin entouré de roses. L'oiseau est l'oeuvre de [**Klonism**](https://www.instagram.com/klonism/) qui aime réalisé des animaux très colorés. L'ensemble est vraiment réussi.*

# ෴ ᴡʜᴇʀᴇ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

This mural is located on 27th Street in Wynwood, Miami, almost at the corner of 5th Avenue. The other murals are located between 26th Street and this street. This part of the neighborhood is rather uninviting; it's deserted. The numbers in red correspond to the Street Art post. Example: 880 = [StreetArt #880](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-880-wynwood-miami-part-i--el-mac-dface-and-maxi-bagnasco).

At the corner of De Lorimier Avenue and Ontario Street, just after the Jacques Cartier Bridge when entering Montreal.

> *Ce mur se trouve sur la 27ème rue à Wynwood à Miami presque au coin avec la 5ème avenue. Les autres murales se trouvent entre la 26ème et cette rue. Cette partie du quartier n'est guère accueillante, c'est désert. Les numéros en rouge correspondent au post StreetArt correspond. Exemple : 880 = [StreetArt #880](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-880-wynwood-miami-part-i--el-mac-dface-and-maxi-bagnasco).*

🗺️ Position on [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=17/25.800876/-80.199037)

[//]:# (!worldmappin 25.80196 lat -80.20377 long Mural by Jim Vision and Klonism in Wynwood d3scr)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴏ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

## Jules Muck & Alec

![Jules Muck](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23zbKpeP97mS4s6BmrD3hu8DmZYxcyPMdHpve9ximtTqjFwzXkidnnuD3jC9sRAH6tWDK.JPG)

This great portrait of **Amy Winehouse** was created by [**Jules Muck**](https://www.instagram.com/muckrock/)k, an artist who discovered street art in England before moving to New York to become known as **Lady Pink**. A beautiful tribute... Across the street is [**Alec**](https://www.instagram.com/alecmonopoly/), already featured in this Miami series (see [CCC's Street Art Contest #301](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/cccs-street-art-contest-301wynwood-miami-part-viii--nate-dee-and-co)), recognizable by his Monopoly character.

> *Ce superbe portrait **d'Amy Winehouse** a été réalisé par [**Jules Muck**](https://www.instagram.com/muckrock/), artiste qui a découvert le StreetArt en Angleterre avant de s'installer à NY pour se faire connaitre sous le nom de **Lady Pink**. Bel hommage... De l'autre côté de la rue, il s'agit de [**Alec**](https://www.instagram.com/alecmonopoly/) déjà présenté dans cette série sur Miami, voir [CCC's Street Art Contest #301](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/cccs-street-art-contest-301wynwood-miami-part-viii--nate-dee-and-co) reconnaissable avec le personnage du Monopoly.*

![Alec](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23zRviduxFXagtpKTbTCiuLGSFt1AZGzZo92XXG4mkLoNCFviSi4fUMRpPjcH1D1gDwGQ.JPG)

***

## Choppers & Menas

![Choppers](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/2432HqViPiZcNgo15bXS8T2XGxUsijKPbuaBiVvaJNxX4CzcKQJoxuprHW5f2ojN6Vf8d.JPG)

Along the highway there's this mural celebrating the centennial of the University of Miami Hurricanes football team by [**Choppers**](https://www.instagram.com/dadecountychoppers/). I don't know anything about this team. But with the five colorful fans, the mural highlights the team's great achievements like \

the team's first championship...\n\n> *Le long de l'autoroute il y a cette murale célèbrant le centenaire de l'équipe de football américain des **Hurricanes** de l'Université de Miami par [**Choppers**](https://www.instagram.com/dadecountychoppers/). Je ne connais pas du tout cette équipe. Mais avec les 5 partisans en couleurs, la murale souligne les grandes réalisations de l'équipe comme \

, le premier titre de l'équipe...*

![Menas](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/242hWimebyN8eHWktQJHYbkmMuzjMwZTETRFu5dwwpwxaE3KZUatqWVZtKwpDau3cTiLc.JPG)

Another interesting tribute, this time to the American martial artist Kimbo Slice (1974-2016), created by Menas (pronounced \

in French). Again, it's a sport I don't watch, but the realistic portrait against that lettered background is really cool.

> *Un autre hommage intéressant cette fois, pour le combattant d'art martial américain [Kimbo Slice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kimbo_Slice) (1974-2016) faite par [**Menas**](https://www.instagram.com/menas24711/) (cela se prononce à la française menace). Là encore un sport que je ne regarde pas, mais le portrait réaliste sur ce fond rempli de lettrages, vraiment cool.*

![DSC09057.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/244Uov9YthToNNkCbyQ339TPBq2FXZwe6VDhGyt1bTUxzGqNBtiYkvovr8CyNgLQjUvdc.JPG)

There's #StreetArt all over these warehouses, but as I said, it's not very welcoming. There aren't many people in the streets, and those who are there aren't exactly reassuring. The police were even present on 27th Street... even though it was the middle of the day. But it's still worth seeing. **So, which mural would you have chosen for the contest?**

> *Partout sur ces entrepôts, il y a du #StreetArt mais comme je le disais, ce n'est guère accueillant. Peu de personnes dans les rues, et les personnes qui y sont ne sont pas rassurantes. Sur la 27ème la police était là... Pourtant c'était au milieu de la journée. Mais cela vaut le coup d'oeil pareil. **Alors vous auriez choisi quelle murale pour le concours ?***

# ෴ ᴡʜᴇɴ	
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

body.title: RANDOM TOWN - (PHOTOGRAPHY SERIES)
body.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AJiyZnyfy5pvQYQfCZVLTEzLTrxZCxKSd9kbkket5TEMWDy9UBJfgpfJ3tzMamC.jpg)

----

**I** sometimes have so many photos in my recent files that I think I could spend every afternoon processing and editing a few for the next couple of months and still not finish selecting and working on them all. So today, sitting here in my studio on a quiet Sunday afternoon, it occurred to me how lucky I am to be able to do what I love almost every day. And at the same time, I think once again about that typical randomness of my town, which has allowed me to create this photographic record that's been going on for years, constantly providing me with something new practically every time I go out into the streets. This town is something that mutates and transforms on every block, as if it had some slightly eccentric and overly imaginative screenwriter. Or maybe it's simply me, with the ability to constantly find something new in everything on these streets that have seen me since I was a child. But the truth is that what happens in the streets changes with the weather, the time of day, the day of the week, the area I'm walking through, with everything, I'd say...

>**S**on tantas fotos las que a veces tengo en mis archivos recientes, que creo que podría estar cada tarde procesando y editando unas cuantas cada tarde desde aquí a un par de meses y no terminar de seleccionarlas y trabajar en todas. Así que hoy, aquí sentado en mi estudio en plena tarde tranquila de Domingo, me ha pasado por la cabeza que soy un tipo con bastante suerte de poder hacer casi a diario esto que tanto me gusta. Y al mismo tiempo, pienso una vez más en esa aleatoriedad típica de mi pueblo, la cual me ha permitido hacer este registro fotográfico que ya lleva años, de manera constante proveyéndome algo nuevo prácticamente cada vez que salgo a las calles. Y es que este pueblo es a cada cuadra algo que muta y se transforma como si tuviese algún guionista un tanto enloquecido y demasiado imaginativo. O quizás se trate simplemente de mi, que tengo la capacidad de encontrar en todo algo nuevo constantemente en estas calles que me han visto desde niño. Pero lo cierto es que lo que pasa en las calles cambias con el clima, con la hora del día, con el día de la semana, con el sector que recorro, con todo, diría yo...

body.title: Staying Safe Online Takes More Than Just Caution
body.body:
<div  class=text-justify>

Scams are everywhere and the most scary part is, they are coming in different forms and increasing in their tactics to win more victims. The same scam I fell for years ago, I am immune to that kind but I've never had to face the same situation again except only once after the first and I remember just how well guarded I was to it.

People find it easy to say *\

* until they find themselves in a scam situation and can't tell if it is even one. I'd say, becoming free from being scammed isn't only about staying at alert because we don't know what new tactics they have especially, for them to attack our emotions. I have been scammed of my money once many years ago and then I almost got scammed very recently but only that they come with a poor tactic because it was something I was aware of. ![4214de34-2460-4a9f-9bf0-8b264a21b43b_20260523_153955_0000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/EoK3tdBvQ8P7ZS6xSY3dbEd84kKcwpQJs55ZfxHRLVc6ygN5nxA2ryxntG3MwfzQrua.jpg) The first scam story was when I was home and hoping to make quick money, I asked for the scam because I thought I could double my money that easily. The story doesn't even have to be told in detailed, I sent the only money I had quickly hoping to get a double but instead, I got banned from the account I sent the money to. My sister couldn't stop laughing at me because she thought it sounded too good to be true before I sent the money, I thought so too but the scammed knew just how to trigger my emotions to give in and send my money. Since that experience, I became more careful and I've been able to avoid a few more scam attempts on me. Then the recent one that happened didn't succeed at all because it came in a form I was already aware of, having a known number *(my aunt's number)* send a message to me and asking to send a huge amount *(over $80)* to her that she's struggling with her bank to pay somewhere. The first message was off instantly. I called my aunt immediately and she screamed saying her WhatsApp account had been hacked and a lot of other people who noticed have called her to confirm if she really needed the help. It made me remember a scene I witnessed, where a man called his friend after a message asking for $240 transfer, it was a scam and that taught me. There's nothing much I can do to stay safe online from scammers but by just staying alert and learning about whatever tactics they might come with. Another thing I do to help myself is being contented with what I have and make more research before I risk any amount of my money. **Image used is mine.** Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@merit.ahama/staying-safe-online-takes-more-than-just-caution-6an)

body.title: А вы пробовали берёзовый сок?
body.body:
![1000153266.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaDZ3VhXTa1WggdziZkwC8utLCemw8yqR7UTHJuTvr1he/1000153266.jpg)

А вы пробовали берёзовый сок?
‎
‎Берёзовый сок — это прозрачная жидкость, которая циркулирует в стволе берёзы в период весеннего сокодвижения. В ствол дерева вбивается деревянный  колышек,Берёза  начинает плакать и её « слёзы» стекают в прикрепленную ёмкость .
‎
‎Сок содержит воду, минералы, витамины, органические кислоты и другие вещества. витаминов и полезных веществ.
‎Сок утоляет жажду и способствует поддержанию водного баланса организма.
‎
‎Желательно пить сок свежим, без термообработки и добавок. Пить его лучше в день сбора или максимум на следующий. 
‎
‎Источник электролитов. В соке содержатся калий, кальций, магний, марганец — эти минералы важны для работы сердца, нервной системы, мышц и костей. Калий помогает регулировать водно-солевой баланс.
‎Напиток может повышать тонус организма, поддерживать иммунную систему, помогать при сезонной слабости и гиповитаминозе.
‎
‎Когда листья распускаются  на деревьях сок становится горький. Поэтому нужно собирать в начале весны(март,апрель).
‎
‎Людям с поллинозом (особенно на пыльцу берёзы) следует пробовать сок с осторожностью, начиная с минимальных количеств. 
‎
‎В моей семье все с удовольствием пьют полезный напиток и взрослые и дети.
‎

body.title: LOH #290, RELAXATION IS VERY NECESSARY TO OUR BODY..!
body.body:
Hello, ladies and gentlemen of #ladiesofhive community. Happy Sunday, it's a rainy Sunday in my area,  how about your own area?. Yeah, it's not a problem at all, rather the essence of nature. 
 
I appreciate you our able judge for this week @saffisara, thank you.

 **Question one of the LOH contest #290 this week..
What's your favorite safe haven for relaxation and why?**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ5gCTDXSNTRbiVMVnPWYQpi1KcSN1KuvCPHqWfXo4yiy/1779648702852.jpg)

Truly, life is good, and needs to be pampered. Life of course needs to be taken care of, per time. No matter how much busy we seem to be. **Life has no duplicate, if you refuse to apply a relaxation break, you may breakdown to suffer some sicknesses**.

 This is the reality for only those that has this understanding. It's  befitting and a resounding wisdom for anyone to make out time for relaxation, a time to calm down your nerves and having full rest in whichever method that appeals to your personality most.

**THEY'RE MANY WAYS TO RELAX AND CALM OUR NERVES**

Our choices are different in life. Some love going to the beach to relax as their safe haven. Some love climbing mountains to relax at the ultimate top. Some love to relax with warm water at their bathtub.
Some love to drive out, receiving fresh air and looking around. 

Some love to get into their kitchen cooking one kind of their favorite and special meal, enjoying it makes them to relax. Some listen to their favorite music to relax, others read books or novels to relax. To be in the garden looking at flowers, listening to songs from birds. 

**I love to just lay down all alone on my bed in my room to reflect on certain things, listening to my favorite Christian low-key music, or a beautiful and meaningful classic music. Pondering on the lyrics, and making meanings out of the letters  and the grenes of the music**

**Stretching out myself, turning to the left and turning to the right on my bed without anyone asking me to shift or to adjust for them. But for me and just me,  all alone. I love it this way! This is my appropriate way to relax, to calm down my mind, head and my nerves**

 Relaxation to me is a conscious decision and effort for one to take out time to coin inside your own self. Calling up your spiritman to settle down to rest, to offload certain burdens. At that moment, you could calm down your very being that has been actively working without resting overtime.

**WHY**
It's a refreshing moment for my body, my brain and my whole being. It's a restoration time. It's very beneficial to my mental health and my overall well-being. Relaxation is the time to offload the unnecessary loads of life issues you may never had asked for. Coming out of it,  makes you refreshed, one can as well take a deep breath to ease off your lungs, do some exercises to ease off the burdens and losses of life.

You can join us from here,

https://ecency.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-290
Thank you for reading all through.

The picture is mine.

body.body:
Vaya tema. Coincido en todo contigo, salvo tal vez en lo último, en que todos somos necesarios, valiosos e importantes. Suena un poco cruel, pero hay gente que es solo valiosa para quienes los trajeron al mundo. Creo que todos tenemos el potencial de ser necesarios, valiosos e importantes, pero algunos nunca son conscientes de ese potencial, o no lo ejercen.

Me viene a la mente una frase que decía Facundo Cabral sobre su abuelo, que era coronel y le tenía miedo a los idiotas, y cuando le preguntaban porque, constestata que porque eran demasiados, y no había manera de cubrir suficiente frente.

Yo tengo la teoría de que hay gente que vive por inercia, como dormida, que no piensa, y solo hace aquello que se supone que debe hacer, aquello que se espera de ella, para poder ser parte, y así darle algún sentido a su existencia. Y si es eso señalar a alguien porque es diferente, pues lo hacen, y con pleno \

de que lo que hacen esta bien, o al menos no está mal. Y eso es un poco lo mismo que planteas en tu post, pero con otras palabras y desde otro ángulo.

Vivimos una época de  crisis del pensamiento crítico y de enamoramiento de la posverdad, donde queremos que las cosas sean como pensamos que son, y no lo que son en realidad son. Donde pensamos que lo merecemos todo, que todos somo especiales únicos y maravillosos y el mundo tiene que giran a nuestro alrededor, y adecuarse a lo que queremos, y tristemente la realidad no es así.

Vivimos una época de glorificación de la ceguera, la ignorancia... y la estupidez, donde la moneda de cambio es la aprobación superflua, caprichosa y temporal de un montón de desconocidos para hacernos  sentir validados, valiosos e importantes. Vivimos tiempos extraños, que a cada momento empeoran. Vivimos en un epidosio de Black Mirror, y aunque me gustaría que esta afirmación lo fuera, no es ninguna estupidez. 

Saludos mi estimado @emiliorios, y disculpa si me deja llevar. Un fuerte abrazo desde México.

body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779645297449-30fec1d4fcb60002.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=zeyr-gamer/e2d8157f)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=zeyr-gamer/e2d8157f)


---

Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas  
This game is one of the most famous in gaming history. It has a deep storyline about life, family, and the gang wars of Los Santos. The game can be played offline, and anyone can enjoy it on mobile as well. It features impressive graphics and has been carefully designed to deliver a great experience.
The story of Mission 1 is like this. Mission 2 will be released soon.
https://i.postimg.cc/L5Qcsn8j/IMG-20260524-194431.jpg
https://i.postimg.cc/nVSM62G1/IMG-20260524-135438.jpg
https://i.postimg.cc/J7SHsKHn/IMG-20260524-135516.jpg
https://i.postimg.cc/MZgfntfH/IMG-20260524-135537.jpg
I arrived at the city airport and was waiting inside. When I left the airport, I took a taxi Suddenly, the police stopped me in the middle of the road I didn’t know why Two officers got out, pointed their guns at me, and ordered me to raise my hands and kneel on the ground. When I obeyed, they knocked me down and handcuffed me 
Then the commander stepped out of the police car and started questioning me. They searched my pockets took my money, and forced me into the police vehicle before driving away  
This game is truly thrilling  the storyline is intense and enjoyable. It features gangs and corrupt police officers, with weapons being traded and car races adding to the excitement. The quality of the game is outstanding and Adnan, you will definitely enjoy it.
https://i.postimg.cc/cHtW8RPJ/IMG-20260524-195835.jpg
https://i.postimg.cc/7ZJndfvg/IMG-20260524-200310.jpg
https://i.postimg.cc/C1c8zgT5/IMG-20260524-154635.jpg
https://i.postimg.cc/MHcnHfmd/IMG-20260524-135552.jpg
https://i.postimg.cc/HW75TFvg/IMG-20260524-200736.jpg
When the police took me away, they threw me out on the road. Their only interest was money they had already taken mine I managed to grab a bicycle and escaped heading straight to my house
When I arrived, I found no one there My mother had been killed. I held my head in my hands and cried over her picture. The gang had murdered her 
As I was lost in thought, my friend arrived He was shocked, and we talked together. Then we both left the house
This game is full of emotion and action truly anyone who loves games will enjoy it. The storyline is powerful and unforgettable
This version keeps the dramatic tension while making it clear it’s a game story, not real life. It flows like a cinematic description, perfect for your gaming content
https://i.postimg.cc/1XWbCfxf/IMG-20260524-201214.jpg
https://i.postimg.cc/m2RRpF0X/IMG-20260524-135657.jpg 
https://i.postimg.cc/hjZ0NxGm/IMG-20260524-135717.jpg
I was with my friends at Bella’s when he told me, Everyone has gathered, let’s go As we stepped out, the gang blew up the car we were heading toward. My friends and I escaped on bicycles, riding together while the gang chased us
This game highlights the strength of friendship and teamwork. It shows that I can’t achieve anything alone I need my friends by my side It’s a game that demonstrates the true value of friendship and the incredible way we managed to survive 

Thank you

body.title: Winged Termites
body.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Termitoidae*** | May 14, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXp7Xcsd7uH1eJXJEXkjozUXBSNdyYzDmx3qA8yM9xnZW/mix_20260524_231110.jpg)

On the night of May 14, I saw them flying in a swarm under the light of the bulb outside my house. When the weather is a little hot and humid, they leave their old colonies. I saw many of them falling to the ground and shedding their wings.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUJdmt8gBCmzLvV9bjc6pXr65Y1w7Lr7rAuaydQkgULAC/mix_20260524_230953.jpg)

​Name and Identification:
In scientific terms, they are called '*** Termites***' or 'Alates'. And according to their scientific classification, they belong to the ***'Termitoidae'*** family. According to my observations in i-Naturalist, their common identification is 'Termites'.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNM9qXpzeHmYGXENSLDQ4pb5GYYcmRYUtUXfvvo4AMQ6Z/mix_20260524_230905.jpg)

​Habitat and Habitat:
Termites usually live in colonies deep in the soil or inside old wooden structures. These flying termites are mainly reproductive members of that colony, who are attracted by the light in search of a new home or colony.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP6xvn4ix4eAkFR2GQibBv5DMQrcHmQoxGVm98ciGbQVk/mix_20260524_230833.jpg)

​Food:
Termites mainly eat cellulose-rich materials, such as dry tree branches, vines, or wooden furniture. However, they do not eat food in this flying state, their main goal is to reproduce.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma2DarFwoAo4DZfmNAar6bwPUHRfzEs4iJ8arAo3jvHud/mix_20260524_230817.jpg)

​Reproduction:
This time before or after the rain is very important for them. After spreading their wings and flying, they find a partner. Then they shed their wings and go deep into the ground and start the process of creating new colonies in pairs. This is a great part of their life cycle.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWMk3dSUZE9YHF57KNGKW86JogpSuqcFEvrx4yB1QmY7s/mix_20260524_231126.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUNL5285oPUaycQyuELAXUWdwKg3tcuxmFGWr8tzNKkfX/mix_20260524_231010.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYqZvVEXvKa9AawJvsTuszcCU1cNcvnZiTXcpJqmU5LXu/mix_20260524_231150.jpg)

​Benefits and harms:
Their role in nature's ecosystem is many. They help increase soil fertility and are one of the favorite foods of frogs or various birds in this flying state. However, we feel the harm in the home. If their colony is on the wooden structure of our furniture or door, it is at risk of being destroyed. Therefore, their presence means that there is a colony nearby, which is why we need to be a little careful.

I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)
