body.title: Spring on the Mountain　山の春　[English and Japanese]
body.body:
![IMG_5235.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcvDhmrhJby87R4g5126pRmzQwTBQ8bwss1LQWutDdgEZ/IMG_5235.jpeg)
### Spring on the Mountain
#

People who live up in the mountains need a little more patience for the feeling of spring to arrive. In town, I see some flowers blooming earlier than they do here in the mountains, even though it’s only a 10–15-minute drive away. I finally feel the full energy of spring on my property and throughout the neighbourhood.

![IMG_5231.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP626WxfHyw5V6ooR95GHfCrCzwBGF6XJfDSzxyE1Q6CZ/IMG_5231.jpeg)

The spring air is very fresh and gentle, birds are actively singing, flowers are blooming happily, and the sky is beautifully blue and clear. On the other hand, many different kinds of bugs appear, such as black flies, no-see-ums, worms, bees, wasps, horse flies, and even ticks. The black flies, no-see-ums, and horse flies are especially bad because they bite us a lot. They are quite aggressive. I have severe allergies, and they seem to come to me constantly. Once they bite me, my body reacts strongly. Ticks are also scary for both humans and dogs. Luckily, my dog is white, so I can find them easily. I can avoid the flies once the spring breeze starts. They disappear quickly after that.

![IMG_5236.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU8Fmskk3cXKyT8eMDTYuPbMRd3jFo5NKUXbkzVXNKuEm/IMG_5236.jpeg)

Well, from now on, I would like to talk about the beautiful side of spring in the mountains. Almost all of the trees have started smiling, and they have become so chatty. I can hear them around my property as well. I noticed that there are many young pine trees, birch trees, trembling aspens, and more. The young trees look so pretty and healthy. Unfortunately, I lost a few of our trees during storms over the past few years. My husband cut up those fallen trees this spring. They will become our firewood for the coming winter.

![IMG_5233.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSLxE1AK7yMV4axLwEh97Lcx9i8yiiEcevGxAW1BgxVRu/IMG_5233.jpeg)

The apple trees have started blooming beautifully. Apple blossoms are so lovely. The Apple Blossom Festival is happening this week. This 92-year-old historical festival is a very popular event for local people as well as tourists.

![IMG_5229.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSCfoXeCKFFVGhrsruAyc5bsADQGS2KiLNyN4aBDiQYET/IMG_5229.jpeg)

This bird cherry tree is such a beautiful symbol on my property. Usually, it starts blooming in the middle of May. Now, it looks so gorgeous and graceful. This year, a bird family is living in it. They sing every day, especially in the morning and during the daytime. I think my husband trimming the broken branches earlier this spring helped the flowers become especially healthy.

![IMG_5228.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZxmSB4kNRcB6aNJzEsnJHUc6uigpAeQTWjSi8Pkk4yqW/IMG_5228.jpeg)

Also, woodpeckers are very active on my property this year. My dog has become friends with one of them. The young, handsome woodpecker usually starts pecking at our fence very early in the morning. When my dog wakes up, he goes outside with me to see the woodpecker. Sometimes, I can hear them very early in the morning from my bedroom. The pecking sound feels like a rhythmic clock or something similar. It’s not as noisy as you might imagine.

![IMG_5230.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeTE89kF2gdHSUW2inxwy3yc2tD6XdiEvK9qNFrzzd9Dc/IMG_5230.jpeg)

Almost all of the dandelions are finishing blooming and turning into fluffy seed heads. I love dandelion fluff very much. My dog really likes visiting the big field near my house. However, when manure is spread on the field, we can’t visit it. Luckily, this year the farmer is letting the land rest, so we can visit it sometimes. Still, we have to be careful about ticks once the grass grows tall.

![IMG_5232.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTWpFP58WiqtRzoFtw6trYsYvSqdtRCMRivVjjPrzWdk8/IMG_5232.jpeg)

I hope you enjoy my mountain spring photos. Probably, most of your spring flowers and plants have already finished blooming.

![IMG_5226.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUx7fG8GRTw5cqEkgcSVu3UQjXpPX6DnseZbPQ1zAPbR/IMG_5226.jpeg)

![IMG_5227.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRxerYzADLvGRqHJLDpNtkJnp1Jed9Pjx3FYKRvHssTof/IMG_5227.jpeg)

Japanese 日本語

![IMG_5235.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcvDhmrhJby87R4g5126pRmzQwTBQ8bwss1LQWutDdgEZ/IMG_5235.jpeg)
### 山の春
#

山に住んでいる人たちは、春らしい空気を感じるまでに、通常よりも少しだけ長めの忍耐が必要です。町では、ここよりも早く花が咲いているのを見かけます。たった１０〜１５分ほど車で走っただけで、山とは季節の進み方が違います。ようやく私の家の敷地や近所全体にも、本格的な春の息吹を感じられるようになりました。

![IMG_5231.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP626WxfHyw5V6ooR95GHfCrCzwBGF6XJfDSzxyE1Q6CZ/IMG_5231.jpeg)

春の空気はとても新鮮でやわらかく、鳥たちは元気にさえずり、花々は嬉しそうに咲き、空は青く澄み渡っています。その一方で、ブラックフライ、ヌカカ、小さな虫、蜂、スズメバチ、アブ、さらにはダニまで、さまざまな虫たちも出現しはじめます。特にブラックフライやヌカカ、アブはとても厄介で、かなり刺されます。本当に攻撃的なので困ります。かなりひどいアレルギーがあるからか、なぜか虫たちがしつこく寄ってきます。一度刺されると、体が強く反応してしまいます。ダニも、人間にも犬にも怖い存在です。でも幸い、私の犬は白いので、ダニを見つけやすいです。春の強い風が吹き始めると、ハエたちは少し避けやすくなり、しばらくの間どこかに消えてくれます。

![IMG_5236.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU8Fmskk3cXKyT8eMDTYuPbMRd3jFo5NKUXbkzVXNKuEm/IMG_5236.jpeg)

さて、ここからは山の春の美しい部分についてお話ししたいと思います。ほとんどの木々が笑顔になってきたように見え、とてもおしゃべりな感じになりました。私の敷地の中でも、その声が聞こえてくるようです。あっという間に若い松の木、白樺、ポプラなどがたくさん育っていることにも気づきました。若い木々はとても美しく、健康そうです。残念ながら、ここ数年の嵐で何本かの木がダメになってしまいました。今年の春、主人がその倒れた木々を切ってくれました。それらは次の冬の薪になります。

![IMG_5233.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSLxE1AK7yMV4axLwEh97Lcx9i8yiiEcevGxAW1BgxVRu/IMG_5233.jpeg)

リンゴの木の花も美しく咲き始めました。りんごの花は本当にきれいです。今週はアップルブロッサム・フェスティバルが開催されています。この９２年続く歴史あるお祭りは、地元の人々だけでなく観光客にもとても人気があります。

![IMG_5229.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSCfoXeCKFFVGhrsruAyc5bsADQGS2KiLNyN4aBDiQYET/IMG_5229.jpeg)

このバードチェリーの木は、私の敷地の中で特別な象徴のような存在です。いつも５月半ば頃に満開になりますが、ちょうど今は本当に優雅で美しく見えます。今年は鳥の家族がこの木に住んでいます。毎日、特に朝から昼間にかけて、その鳥たちの声が聞こえてきます。今年の早春に主人が折れた枝を剪定してくれたので、そのおかげで花がとても元気に咲いているのだと思います。

![IMG_5228.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZxmSB4kNRcB6aNJzEsnJHUc6uigpAeQTWjSi8Pkk4yqW/IMG_5228.jpeg)

また、今年はキツツキたちもとても活発です。私の犬は、そのうちの一羽と仲良くなりました。その若くてハンサムなキツツキは、朝早くから私たちのフェンスをコツコツ叩き始めます。私の犬は起きると、私と一緒に外へ出て、そのキツツキを見に行きます。時には寝室から、その音がかなり早朝から聞こえてくることもあります。木を叩く音は、まるでリズミカルな時計のようです。想像するほど騒がしい音ではありません。

![IMG_5230.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeTE89kF2gdHSUW2inxwy3yc2tD6XdiEvK9qNFrzzd9Dc/IMG_5230.jpeg)

ほとんどのタンポポは咲き終わり、綿毛になり始めています。私はタンポポの綿毛がとても好きです。私の犬は、家の近くにある大きな野原へ行くのが大好きです。でも、そこに肥料がまかれると、しばらくの間は行くことができません。今年は農家の方がその土地を休ませるようなので、ときどき訪れることができそうです。ただ、草が伸びてくるとダニには気をつけなければいけません。

![IMG_5232.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTWpFP58WiqtRzoFtw6trYsYvSqdtRCMRivVjjPrzWdk8/IMG_5232.jpeg)

私の山の春の写真を楽しんでもらえたら嬉しいです。きっと、皆さんの地域では、春の花や植物はもう終わりかけている頃かもしれません。

![IMG_5226.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUx7fG8GRTw5cqEkgcSVu3UQjXpPX6DnseZbPQ1zAPbR/IMG_5226.jpeg)

![IMG_5227.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRxerYzADLvGRqHJLDpNtkJnp1Jed9Pjx3FYKRvHssTof/IMG_5227.jpeg)

Thank you for reading!
お読みいただきありがとうございます。

> I just want enough money to live, enough to pay the bills, have a bit of freedom, maybe work a couple of days a week doing something useful, and spend the rest of my time actually living my life. Now that's my kind of ambition.

I still don't get how this isn't *everyone's* dream.

I realize it wasn't the intention, but to me, this was super inspiring and hopeful. I never wanted *that* life either, but I find myself in a point of change. What worked before (freelancing as a copywriter) don't work no more because of AI. I like teaching yoga but frequently guilt-trip myself cause I don't follow any of the rules and how-tos, and besides, the hustle of it is slowly taking out the pleasure I had so many years in practicing. So it's a transitional moment and I find myself looking at all these \

people in the job market before I remind myself I never wanted any of that and still don't.

Thank you for reminding me *that* steadiness and security is also an illusion, especially in this crazy day and age. 

> Because the older I get, the more I realise the people who seem richest to me are the ones who have time. I look at the older people at the beach with their energy, laughter, chilled out nervous systems. That seems like success to me.

💯 Absolutely. World's too full of people working themselves to the bone in the hope of a mythical golden age that they're usually too sick or too dead to enjoy. Or, dunno if better or worse, people who pour so much of themselves into their \
and forget to make a life, build relationships, discover themselves and what not, that they don't know what to do with the time and possibly money when it finally comes. \n\nScary.

body.title: Bitcoin ETF Buyers Are Stronger Hodlers Than Expected
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVP8a9J7dtLWKwQfvcEYho5kEJwnGkMQD4TMzJo3PCtBF/img_1086.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcR5TKmTXjMAxauswiQq1trugrPb5TsRrf396GqbE62Gt/img_4678.png)

**Strong Hands in BTC ETFs**

What’s very surprising is that Bitcoin ETF buyers are turning out to be strong hodlers. As Bloomberg analyst Eric Balchunas pointed out this week, the cumulative net flows of all BTC ETFs are still near all-time highs, despite Bitcoin correcting for several months now.

What this means is that the people and institutions entering Bitcoin through ETFs over the past two years are not short-term traders. Many seem to view Bitcoin simply as an addition to their investment portfolio with a relatively small allocation and even 50% drawdowns don’t shake them out.

That’s very good news. And with companies and even nation-states still mostly on the sidelines, there’s still huge potential demand ahead.

Bullish to me.

body.title: Made in Nigeria, Rejected by Nigerians
body.body:
There is something that I have noticed about my country people over the years, and it's not something quiet but very disastrous, which is an inferiority complex. We hardly talk about this, though, but it is the truth. I have seen a lot of talented people. I have seen a lot of skilled craftsmen, beautiful and sophisticated designs, creative entrepreneurs, and manufacturers of quality products in this country. Not everything that is made in this country is poor. And to be honest, some of our products stand out when compared to some foreign products. But just because they are made in Nigeria, a lot of people automatically assume that they are inferior products. Even before testing a product, just because it has this foreign brand written on it, a lot of people have already attached so much importance to it. Meanwhile, even a product that is made here with the best of materials and is very affordable is put aside because, in our minds, we have that mentality that excellence only comes from outside our country. And that is exactly the mentality that has been drawing us backwards today. As a country, it will be very difficult for us to make progress if we do not believe in our product, because if we doubt ourselves, how will others believe in us? If we neglect what we build, if we do not support our own, then I'm sorry to say, we are also contributing to what is causing the economic weakness we see today. ![247703.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/23xykFkH3wRwHikB1V6pTQYNQxFBrrEpUiw7vTrgfjLMzkupuqzHQKkrUgrcHuFb432u8.png) Of course, I am not saying all products are good. We have substandard, so do other countries. And I am not saying that we should support blindly because quality matters. Accountability also is important. So does improvement. But we don't even give our own products a chance, and that is where the problem is. We should not put everything on the government because they can't develop everything alone. Because, left to me, development is also built by the confidence we give to each other and the one we have in ourselves. Our true idea and what we create. And the day we start praising and giving respect to our own industries just like we have been doing for foreign products. That is the same day others will start respecting us, and our level of growth will go from zero to infinity. --- Thank you for reading. >

body.title: Otro domingo tranquilo.  [Es-En] Another quiet Sunday.
body.body: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeresMn5sJS4zgJi3qTnmrEeN9ees9qiYNanSx5kwcY16/image.png) El domingo comenzó tarde para todos los que nos quedamos dormidos. El sábado estuvo movido desde temprano: primero, ir a la feria de la ciudad para abastecernos de frutas, vegetales y algunas proteínas. Luego, algunas labores del hogar y almorzar. Finalmente, en la tarde, reunión en familia. Faltó la nuera que andaba con sus padres, pero reunidos con el yerno y los hijos, incluido uno de pega, pasamos una tarde amena donde brindamos por la vida, la salud y poder estar juntos. Celebramos las buenas noticias acerca de mi hermano, que desde Caracas mandó la sobrina, y cuando nos disponíamos a despedirnos, llegó la visita de un amigo de Cumaná, que pasó a saludar antes de continuar su viaje. Vino con la prisa del turista que quiere ver todo antes de volver a su casa, pero le agradezco que hiciera una pausa y me trajera una botella de vino, que con acierto eligió entre los que más me gustan, y un detalle increíble. Un jabón de India, donde estuvo recientemente. Una pastilla de baño con fragancia de sándalo. Creo que la voy a guardar en el ropero hasta que llegue la primavera. Así disfrutaré más tiempo la exótica fragancia. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamnLdsXiyTn7PJ1uRVqVvAnsTYzaJ6F3PpsgbbCFMo4H/image.png) Al amanecer estaba nublado y, cuando callaron las campanas de la iglesia cercana, todo quedó en silencio. Apretando el botón de publicar, me voy a echar una siesta y es muy posible que no sepan de mí hasta mañana. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPc8enWs18vUVFi78yDAdJx5SEzxYmF1azcSQNitdY8j/image.png) Escrito en español, mi lengua materna, para mi blog de vivencias cotidianas y memorias en Hive, que comparto también en inglés mediante el uso del traductor de Google. Las fotos fueron tomadas por mí con el Motorola de costumbre. # Another quiet Sunday. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeresMn5sJS4zgJi3qTnmrEeN9ees9qiYNanSx5kwcY16/image.png) Sunday started late for all of us who overslept. Saturday was busy from early on: first, a trip to the city market to stock up on fruits, vegetables, and some protein. Then, some housework and lunch. Finally, in the afternoon, a family gathering. My daughter-in-law was missing, as she was with her parents, but together with my son-in-law and children, including one I have a job with, we spent a pleasant afternoon toasting to life, health, and being together. We celebrated the good news about my brother, which my niece sent from Caracas, and as we were about to say goodbye, a friend from Cumaná stopped by to say hello before continuing his trip. He came with the haste of a tourist who wants to see everything before heading home, but I appreciate him pausing to bring me a bottle of wine, which he wisely chose from among my favorites, and an incredible gift: a soap from India, where he had recently been. A sandalwood bath bar. I think I'll keep it in the closet until spring arrives. That way I can enjoy the exotic fragrance for longer. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamnLdsXiyTn7PJ1uRVqVvAnsTYzaJ6F3PpsgbbCFMo4H/image.png) At dawn it was cloudy, and when the bells of the nearby church fell silent, everything was quiet. After pressing the publish button, I'm going to take a nap, and it's quite possible you won't hear from me until tomorrow. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPc8enWs18vUVFi78yDAdJx5SEzxYmF1azcSQNitdY8j/image.png) Written in Spanish, my native language, for my blog of everyday experiences and memories on Hive, which I also share in English using Google Translate. body.title: How to ACTUALLY attract new players to Splinterlands
body.body:
I'm going to be making a few posts on my blog here to best explain what I think is wrong with splinterlands and what I'd personally do to make it better.  The first topic that I've been thinking about is why it's so hard to attract new players to Splinterlands.  While it's potentially a super complicated issue, it actually comes down to something very simple.  

You have to make the players who invest into a set not just profitable, but filthy rich!  When I think about the Untamed era and Kitty was $5000 and Yodin / Llama weren't that far behind it's easy to see why Splinterlands exploded into the launch of Chaos Legion.  (The bullrun didn't hurt things either!)

Speaking from personally experience, I found out about Splinterlands and bought my first Chaos Legion packs when Baakjira was the next card to be air dropped.  I saw how everyone who bought into Untamed and the sets before that like alpha and beta did very well and wanted a piece of that action and so did many other players and investors.

But why?  Why was it so successful?  The cards you needed to be competitive were extremely hard to get if you weren't here when Untamed packs were purchasable in the store.  Scarcity drove prices up and I believe it is the one thing missing from Splinterlands now.  So step 1 is things are (relatively) cheap while available in the store.  Step 2. They become much more expensive when out of print.

To truly understand why every card set since CL ends up over printed we have to think about all the mechanics at play.  It is not just unlucky or some strange phenomenon that keeps screwing us over, it's actually guaranteed to happen so let's look into the WHY.  

Splinterlands panicked when they released Chaos Legion because the packs were drastically overprinted and the set was never going to naturally sell out.  They created a burn mechanism to burn unsold packs and liked the idea so much that they decided to add it to every future set since.  On paper this makes sense.  You can essentially print way more packs than you need, fill the demand of the players, and any excess will be burned.  A win / win situation right?

The problem is, when you do it this way, the set has zero chance to actually sell out naturally and create scarcity like it did for Alpha, Beta, and Untamed.  Think about it.  If enough packs are created so that everyone who wants them can buy them, you are essentially matching the demand of your product with supply.  But simple supply and demand economics tells us that you NEED demand to be HIGHER than supply if you want prices to go up.

When you fully saturate the demand for your product, the players who invest in that set will not become filthy rich.  If you're a decent player and grind like crazy playing Ranked, Tournaments, and Brawls, you can get your money back sure, I have done this a couple of times myself and it works for me.

However, if you aren't a great player and don't grind like crazy you're guaranteed to lose money in the long run.  This is why we continue to lose players and what happens when you gradually lose players is that every set essentially becomes over printed.  You sold enough packs to meet demand, demand continues to drop, asset values go down as there are more available than people who want them and it makes the situation worse and worse for those who stay invested.

So what is the solution?  We have to stop printing enough packs to satisfy demand.  It sounds counter-intuitive but splinterlands to me has always been a luxury product.  Think Gucci or Ferrari for example.  If everyone could get one, it'd be the death of that brand.  Chaos Legion proved this for splinterlands.  It was BY FAR the cheapest set you could max and were we flooded with new players?  No... the game almost died on the spot.

As of this writing, DEC is 63% below peg and there are no new players in site with Modern eligible cards and SPS as cheap as I've seen them since CL.  This is more proof that if things were just cheaper and more available we would attract new players is the wrong mentality for us to have.  If anything, packs should probably go UP in price to $10 and have less of them available.

I remember scholaring for Bubke before modern was invented.  In the gold foil high roller tournament I took notes on other accounts like this guy doesn't have a max Kitty or Yodin but he has Llama.  This guy doesn't have Kitty or Llama but he has Yodin.  It's because back then not everyone could get everything!  You had to choose wisely which cards you actually went for.  Looking at the market right now there are only 131 TOTAL BCX for GF Kitty.  That's enough to make 17.5 max copies.  Mean while there are 249 GF Dragonlord Mancer's!  Keep in mind there are also max level GF Arcane and Black foil versions of him too that just makes it even more overprinted and there are a lot more CA packs floating around than Untamed packs.

So what do we do?  We have to manufacture scarcity in the next set.  No more over-printing packs on purpose and letting the burn mechanic sort it out.  I'm not sure the exact number, but given where the player base is at now, it should be low enough to GUARANTEE a pretty fast sell out.  

To make it all fair, I would create a mechanic that essentially allows you to buy packs based on two factors.  Your average amount of staked SPS and your accounts average collection power over the past 48 months.  This would essentially give the players who have held onto their cards with the biggest collections and most staked SPS the first shot to buy new packs. The higher your average staked SPS and collection power is, the more packs you're allowed to buy.  Though there would be some diminishing returns to give new players a chance.

If you're an extractor who rents every card and sells every SPS as soon as you get it, you get to go to the back of the line and likely miss out on the chance to buy any packs.  If you sell your cards when they rotate out of modern to pay for the next set you're going to the back of the line.

Scarcity + first dibs on buying new packs via holding onto splinterlands assets over long periods of time is how I see us turning things around.  

Once the next set does extremely well and actually goes up in value once it's out of print, we won't have any trouble getting new players who need to buy cards and SPS because they want in on the next set and need to acquire them to participate.

This should apply to mini sets and reward cards as well.  We have to stop printing easy access collection power that devalues every asset.  The one exception I would make is actually promo cards.  Normally promo cards are the most expensive (think hall of legends or Heliose... and how many people that pissed off) but that is the one area it makes sense to me to actually overprint and sell a lot because with limited core sets and mini set print rates, we will need to make money elsewhere to keep the lights on so make promo cards the one area everyone can participate in, just keep how many you release relatively low.

One final thing, I can't stress enough how bringing LEAGUES back is crucial to the success of this idea.  We have to allow players a place to play in Bronze, Silver, Gold, etc who can't afford max level cards but still want a place they can COMPETE in, at the level their budget allows once assets begin to skyrocket.

So there you have it.  This is step 1 for how I would \
Splinterlands.  Feel free to tell me how much you agree with more or how much of an idiot I am!  It's all in good fun anyway!

body.title: Dziennik #89/2026 - jest dobrze
body.body: > Dobry wieczór. Bardzo późno zasnęłam, więc o 4 wstałam kompletnie nieprzytomna. Nie chciało mi się iść do pracy, ale no nie było rady. Po przyjechaniu do firmy okazało się, że pracy jest mało i zadecydowałam, że zamknę firmę o 14, a nie o 16 jak pierwotnie planowaliśmy. Ogólnie szybko mi zleciał czas w pracy. Trochę pogadałam z pracownikami, trochę administracyjnej pracy wykonałam, jakoś poszło. Wydaje mi się, że wynik będzie słaby, ale nie na wszystko mam wpływ. Po pracy pojechałam do miejscowości oddalonej o jakieś 30km, żeby spotkać się z dobrym kumplem. On naszą relację określa mianem przyjaźni, ale dla mnie to po prostu bardzo bliski kumpel. Przyjaźń to dla mnie bardzo mocne słowo i nie szastam nim na lewo i prawo. Zjedliśmy kebaby i spacerowaliśmy. Zaliczyliśmy urbex, który był tak samo podniecający jak przerażający [jak się wspinaliśmy Martin wydał dźwięk jakby jakiś bezdomny się do nas spinał i spanikowałam tak, że ponoć moja mina była bezcenna], posiedzieliśmy nad jeziorkiem i po prostu odwalaliśmy głupoty i gadaliśmy o głupotach. Nasza relacja jest specyficzna, bo gdy któremuś dzieje się krzywda to drugie zawsze staje na wysokości zadania, ale tak ogólnie to łączy nas głupkowate poczucie humoru i odwalanie dziwnych rzeczy. Jak poszliśmy do sklepu po picie to sprzedawczyni popłakała się ze śmiechu ze względu na naszą głupawkę. Tylko z nim takie akcje! ![20260524_171348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ataraksja/23w2gqCVHZzk8PrgUEsBgDFSBCg3zxgELijd4AE3rfXk8qcXYwH8aitigdruSRL9ZSwzA.jpg) *Źródło: fotografia własna* Wróciłam do domu zmęczona, ale taka jakaś spokojna i zadowolona. Czuję po prostu totalny spokój w duszy. Ostatnie dwa dni bardzo dobrze podziałały na moją psychikę i nie chcę chwalić dnia przed zachodem słońca, ale cieszy mnie fakt, że jest mi po prostu ok. Gdzieś ten przejmujący smutek, który mnie męczył ostatnie tygodnie zmalał do takich rozmiarów, że nie stanowi to dla mnie problemu. Mam też w sobie ogrom wdzięczności za ludzi, których mam dookoła. Może nie jestem aż tak złym człowiekiem jak o sobie myślę? Z jakiegoś powodu ci ludzie przy mnie są i to nawet wtedy, gdy upadam. A oni nie dość, że są to jeszcze pomagają mi wstać. Mam w życiu wielkie szczęście. Nie ma jeszcze 21, ale zaraz idę do łóżka, bo naprawdę padam na twarz. Wczoraj zrobiłam 21k kroków, w nocy spałam z 3h, a dzisiaj zrobiłam 20k kroków. Chyba mam prawo być zmęczona. Zmęczona, ale bardzo zadowolona. Czy zamieniłabym ostatnie dwa dni na alkohol, kasyno bądź narkotyki? W życiu. I tego będę się trzymać. Jutro mam urlop, ale żeby nie było, że będę się nudzić i odwalę jakąś głupotę to zaraz rano muszę na sygnale jechać do babci i dziadka, bo dziadkowi umarł komputer i jest dramat. I dobrze. Im bardziej jestem zajęta tym mam mniejszą przestrzeń na odwalanie durnot. Dzielnie walczę. Do jutra.

body.title: I would like everything that comes with a hint of unknown tied to it, thank you.
body.body: I wrote out a man's name in letters bold and free on the horizon, on some seaside beach in a nowhere town under three duvets and a pacifier, but the sea came and washed it all away, and reminded me that just because things rhyme, i've got more worthy things to say than the names of men. the book i'm writing is a daily confrontation with somebody i used to be, and i find it very painful and alien at the same time. all the ways in which i still misunderstand and underestimate myself. and worse, this little voice at the back of my head that just doesn't care, and says sorry, i'm just not there anymore. i want to read something else, about somebody new, not necessarily something tame. it says change it, make it a new story, this, whatever it was, is a eulogy that in context, makes little sense. and i get this feeling like a rush and a fever inside my head, this sense of we've wasted all this time already, i don't want to waste one again. a minute or a year. some lessons were painfully slow in coming. some were just me bashing my own head to test the gravity of walls. it worked well for a time. i've learned tremendously much about walls, and this desire to move, to be, to experience is nothing new, but each year, it comes more impatient than the last time.
>\n\nit's tapping its foot in the door, yelling \

. it's shoving me out the door. it's rushing down my bloodline, and seizing itself by the hooktails inside my throat. i call, it answers, we start the dance again. we should totally go here. and jump out a plane. and go across this big, suspended bridge and try not to let the wind push us. no, i'm not accusing the wind of murderous intentions. are you? i'm finding it easy lately - and by lately i mean months, the way old people do - to burn bridges and cut ties. which is nuts to someone who spent years obssessing, pouring over details, mythologizing unremarkable men and exploits. how. why. now, hardly even turn my head. didn't work? oh well. how much water should i waste on dead plants. i look at old things that made up my skin in the way you do a stranger's tribulations. i can't help feeling a bit bad about that, actually. but i've grown up enough to pick apart the traces of my own disappointments and traumas in the things i write, and find i've gone beyond grief and irritation alike. now, i just sort of look at it and nod politely. offer up some lukewarm platitude like, that must've been just awful. yes. how terrible for you. but i don't really care. i wish this was rage, except i don't really. i'm so tired of rage, of blame. it's like someone packed it all up one night, while i was asleep, and took it far from my life. how interesting to have arrived here. i want to hail all this adventure in my life. i want to go. but i don't want to leave my feet behind. i want to swim in the sea at sunset. this summer, want to cook outside, and drink cheap beers from the store and kick up my bare feet on the chair next to you. i want to feel like i ain't got enough time, because the trtuh is we don't, none of us. i wanna restructure this stupid book that i don't think is stupid at all really so that it matches who i am now and feels like a beginning, not like an ending, long drawn-out. i want so much. different than i've wanted it until now, and i'm not entirely sure what to do with that. wanna try? hold up my hair, pinch my hand, check if it's really us. it's terrifying and exciting being alive right now. not as in 'where we are as a species', thought that too, but i'm selfish and i'm young and think of myself perhaps too much. i think whoever i was before has paddled out to sea and isn't available anymore. i get that, and wonder how long before this version paddles, again. except now's not the time to be thinking about that. oh, and i love the way i feel my shoulder blades after a workout, after two weeks not moving much. who woulda thought, for someone who never liked working out. guess that's one more thing that's different now.

body.title: As an entrepreneur I wouldn't say how much I earn | Como emprendedor no diría cuanto gano
body.body:
>

<center>**¡Bienvenido a un nuevo post, querido Hiver!**</center>

<div class=\

> **Hay cosas que te enseña la vida en base a tus errores. Estos aprendizajes son muy útiles más adelante.** Hace algunos años planeaba empezar a emprender en la costura; también planeaba crear más contenido. Para ello necesita 2 cosas: + Un teléfono, porque no tenía. + Reparar mi máquina de coser. Así que en ese entonces trabajaba en una empresa, y empecé a ahorrar para invertir en ello. Cada semana recibía mi pago, guardaba una parte en efectivo y lo demás era para los gastos de la casa. Todo iba bien, y si seguía de esa manera, podía tener todo lo que había planificado en unos meses. Estaba emocionada, muy emocionada. El gran problema fue cuando le comenté a 2 personas. Después de ello empezaron a suceder un sinfín de acontecimientos. Uno de ellos fue la compra del pedal de la máquina de coser. Al probarlo debido a una falla de la máquina de coser, el cable se incendió. Me quedé paralizada. Luego, compré otro pedal. La mandé a reparar y, afortunadamente, ya no tenía esta falla. Sin embargo, aún hoy en día necesito mandarle a reparar algunas cosas, que no he hecho porque es un poco costoso. Después de ello empecé a recibir peticiones de préstamos de las personas a las que les había contado. Un chico me mencionó que no tenía con qué pagar el alquiler. Le presté dinero. Lastimosamente, nunca me pagó, ni siquiera respondió mis mensajes. También otras personas me pidieron dinero. Igualmente, el dinero no regresó a mí. Ya no había ahorros; lo había perdido todo. En lo único en lo que pude invertir en ese entonces fue en los 2 pedales de la máquina de coser. Posteriormente a ello, renuncié a mi trabajo, dedicándome al trabajo independiente y a mi emprendimiento, algo que aún hago hoy en día. **La moraleja de la historia** + *Aprender a decir no* Prefiero prestar dinero a amigos cercanos que a personas a las que conozco poco. Así que siento que aprender a decir que no es algo que te ayuda un montón a conservar tu dinero. Cuesta, porque somos humanos y deseamos ayudar, pero no puedes ayudar a nadie si no te ayudas a ti mismo primero. + *No decir cuánto gano o qué estoy ahorrando* No sé qué sucede, pero cada vez que le comento a alguien que estoy ahorrando para algo, el dinero se me esfuma de las manos. Así que desde hace un tiempo tomé la decisión de no decir si ahorro. Ahora también le sumé no decir cuánto gano. Por ahora no es mucho, pero me ahorro muchas molestias con ello. + *Si vas a emprender, el mejor gasto es la inversión* Personalmente, de lo que no me he arrepentido es de invertir. Quizás algunas cosas tarden en dar frutos, pero al menos sé que el dinero que invierto poco a poco va a crecer. Está bien ayudar a los demás, y deseo que esas personas hayan resuelto sus problemas; sin embargo, no me agradaron sus acciones al respecto, como no contestar el teléfono. Eso dice mucho de una persona, dejándote un mal sabor de boca. Sin duda volvería a ayudar a alguien, pero no creo que vuelva a hacerlo con el dinero que tanto me ha costado ganar o ahorrar. ¿Te ha pasado algo similar? >! [English version available by clicking here] >**There are things that life teaches you based on your mistakes. These learnings are very useful later.** > >A few years ago I planned to start sewing; I also planned to create more content. > >To do this you need 2 things: > >+ A telephone, because I didn't have one. >+ Repair my sewing machine. > >So at that time I was working in a company, and I started saving to invest in it. > >Every week I received my payment, I kept part of it in cash and the rest was for household expenses. > >Everything was going well, and if he continued that way, he could have everything he had planned in a few months. > >I was excited, very excited. The big problem was when I told 2 people. > >After that, countless events began to happen. > >One of them was the purchase of the sewing machine pedal. When testing it due to sewing machine failure, the cord caught fire. I was paralyzed. > >Then, I bought another pedal. I had it repaired and, fortunately, it no longer had this fault. > >However, even today I need to send him to repair some things, which I have not done because it is a bit expensive. > >After that I started receiving loan requests from the people I had told. > >A boy mentioned to me that he didn't have the money to pay the rent. I lent him money. Unfortunately, he never paid me, he didn't even respond to my messages. > >Other people also asked me for money. Likewise, the money did not return to me. > >There were no more savings; I had lost everything. The only thing I could invest in back then was the 2 pedals on the sewing machine. > >After that, I quit my job, dedicating myself to independent work and my entrepreneurship, something I still do today. > >**Moral of the story** > >+ *Learn to say no* > >I prefer to lend money to close friends than to people I know little. So I feel like learning to say no is something that helps you a lot to keep your money. > >It's hard, because we are human and we want to help, but you can't help anyone if you don't help yourself first. > >+ *Do not say how much I earn or what I am saving* > >I don't know what happens, but every time I tell someone that I'm saving for something, the money flies out of my hands. > >So for some time now I made the decision not to say if I save. Now I also added not saying how much I earn. > >For now it's not much, but it saves me a lot of trouble with it. > >+ *If you are going to start a business, the best expense is the investment* > >Personally, what I have not regretted is investing. > >Maybe some things take time to bear fruit, but at least I know that the money I invest little by little will grow. > >It's okay to help others, and I wish those people had solved their problems; However, I did not like his actions in this regard, such as not answering the phone. That says a lot about a person, leaving a bad taste in your mouth. > >I would definitely help someone again, but I don't think I'll do it again with the money I've worked so hard to earn or save. > >Has something similar happened to you? >Texto de mi autoría. > **Imágenes en el post creadas por mi en estos software:** >+ Iconos hechos en Photoshop, usando como referencia los logos de las redes sociales correspondientes. >+ Banners y portada realizados en Canva en la versión gratuita. >+ Todas las fotografías en el post son de mi autoría, las cuales edito con las apps de Lightroom y Meitu.

body.title: #Monomad Challenge - ...more than just a walk in the park
body.body: ### Good afternoon, #Monomad friends Here is my entry for the #monomad contest by @brumest and @monochromes. _It may seem exactly the same._ The same place, the same park benches. _The same trees._ But if we really think about it, the moment is unique. _That shadow, those people—they’ve never been in that place at that exact time._ Everything is unique. _Even our breathing may follow a rhythm, but every inhale and exhale is unique._ It will never happen again. ###### _And that is the beauty of life._ We must take advantage of the opportunity we have today to see the sun. To leave the house, without being preoccupied with other things, and simply go for a walk in the park. Much more than it seems. Much simpler than we make it out to be. Life unfolding. ##### _And we are invited at every moment to be part of it and to observe an infinite and unrepeatable dance._ ![20260516_163826_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/EoAZK57c3ApfHd7LW2TggAvN32cxuy7hbmzfZijDoBY7N3VDH5Yk61bx3pyuVk3H5AX.jpg) ![20260516_163834_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/Eo8RTyRP3xmU7XEFqa7uuzB4dmmusuhJhdWhewuXbTSBAQdzt7GC5UpQwpNUQLfE6qN.jpg) ![20260516_163919_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/Eo6HWU1P1zWQ68KAb6zs96zwPWshESMGekQA99j1M43muSiRpohFeYnSD4D4xqmo94t.jpg) ![20260516_164341_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/EogLLgvFgBtgvftNr32qP3fCkKSe2bMJhrHe2qGpHwLkkGN4kVJhWfLt5Kd7mS1qrvp.jpg) ![20260516_164651_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/EogMmmxw1r8pxkkZ5ZPXK1WX9wYdEQ4Xiecoq3JN72xABuiwEzwnApAY3QEytHLbJjC.jpg) ![20260516_164719_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/Eoc64e26TnYfEzdURJUWgzn8Mzfh2ARxoHvCQhBHQtR3P3dNXoj5Fyjg9YqxTMj5dof.jpg) #### I hope you enjoyed my post here in the [B&W community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-142159/created) ### Bem Hajam 🍀 ![separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23swppYGLECw991bW1wsSTEwnV8YKgqPHaiAdDJioriDcMJR4GymNLH1VbQ98ykpBYkob.png) Photographed with Samsung A26 by @xrayman in 2026, May 16 Photographic edition with PhotoScape X Original text in Portuguese written by @xrayman, translated with [DeepL.com](https://www.deepl.com/en/translator) ![XRayMan.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23tSNKgT6Zssji2twDxLZSeSESs2q8pnNUYQuFe7gqFkFFT3rrjE8pcMnXVcFpd87PxJY.gif)

body.title: Why Morning Sunlight Beats Coffee for Feeling Alert
body.body:
https://images.ecency.com/DQmZACRNbgpFdijvx3FSdyqbQV37m4PW23FHZqrn97EEGqW/imgp5433.png

>9 AM in England, taken by me.

At first, I thought it was the discipline and coffee that were making me feel awake, but I recently found out that light is a much simpler explanation for how alert or tired I felt in the morning.

Morning light is one of the most significant environmental clues that the brain uses in regulating its daily cycle of activity. Many usual morning routines of drinking coffee or going to the gym or having a productive habit are less directly influential on circadian phase than the exposure to morning light during the transitions from sleep to wakefulness.

The brain has a built-in timing system called the suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN). It is sometimes called the body’s master circadian clock because it does many things, including regulating when you sleep, when you are alert and when hormones are released. The SCN is extremely sensitive to the amount of light the brain is exposed to, particularly in the morning.

When you awake early in the morning and step out into bright morning light, it sends a very strong biological message and serves to align your internal circadian clock with the day outside, which in turn facilitates a stable sleep pattern and boosts your alertness during the day. If there is not enough light, it's easy for your circadian rhythm to drift later, which also makes it hard for you to get and stay awake in the morning when you want to be awake and can also delay your sleep timing. 

Morning sun isn’t just an energy boost but a timing signal that tells the brain when to start being awake and when to start shutting down later in the day.

Practically speaking, if you spend some time outside in the morning (even just 5 to 10 minutes on sunny days or 10 to 20 minutes on cloudy days), it will have an effect on aligning your circadian cycle and will aid in the brain’s transitioning into the day.


References

Wright, K. P., McHill, A. W., Birks, B. R., Griffin, B. R., Rusterholz, T., & Chinoy, E. D. (2013). Entrainment of the human circadian clock to the natural light–dark cycle. Current Biology. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cub.2013.06.039

body.title: An afternoon with classic cars - monomad - eng/esp
body.body:
The date of our May safari arrived, and as always, we started in a central park in Old Havana, very close to the Capitol. There it is very normal to see classic cars in very good condition, ready for tourists to take around emblematic places in the city. These cars are mandatory props for models' poses. Some convince the drivers to let her get in and take photos inside, other drivers only allow photos around the car. This was the case with one of the first models of the afternoon, who posed behind one of the beautiful convertibles that were nearby.
***
*Llegó la fecha de nuestro safari de Mayo, y como siempre, comenzamos en un parque céntrico de la Habana Vieja, muy cerca del Capitolio. Allí es muy normal ver autos clásicos en muy buenas condiciones, listos para pasear turistas por lugares emblemáticos de la ciudad. Estos autos son accesorios obligatorios para las poses de las modelos. Algunas convencen a los choferes para que la dejen subir y hacerse fotos dentro, otros choferes solo permiten fotos alrededor del auto. Fue el caso con una de las primeras modelos de la tarde, que posó detrás de uno de los hermosos convertibles que estaban cerca.*

body.body:
* There's a big difference between men and men *

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/019788db-29ca-439a-891b-5586859b2f55.jpg)

moment, while making evening tea, my hand got burnt.!!
There were gashes in my eyes.
When my father saw me, he incontinently held my hand and got agitated. also he pushed the tea mug down with his other hand and incontinently brought the ointment.!!
Now they're also applying the ointment and also the mama 's class.!!
Why do you shoot her to the kitchen after all I've told her a thousand times not to make her do any work.!!
Amma was sitting in a muddle. My hand was burnt and I was looking at the anguish in her eyes.!!
She started saying.!!
Where do I shoot her with pleasure but she's getting wedded hereafter. What will people say? Mother did n't educate me anything.!!
She was explaining in a veritably sad tone.!!
Yes, people keep saying whatever they want but now she'll not go to the kitchen. Father hugged me spontaneously and also advised Amma.!!
I should have been happy but I was n't.!!
I was just looking at my mama 's hands whose thumbs were scarred from cutting vegetables. How numerous times had her hand been burned? There were black scar- suchlike marks.!!
still, the injuries had healed, in fact, just a week ago, a cutter had cut her indicator cutlet so big that it bled a lot, but she did not indeed bind it, saying,\

.!! But nothing was right.!! I wanted to tell my father.!! That she is also someone's son, her father is no more, so what happed? Her hubby is alive, thank God.!! You're so worried over your son's slight pain and your woman 's pain.?? Who should she go and tell.?? Who'll he feel.?? She is n't someone's son, is she.?? I wish.!! still, sisters, and daughters as they're to their women , If all the men in the world were to be just as sensitive to their maters .

body.title: And now Glasgow.
body.body:
restaurant in Spain is kind of funny. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c40ecd30-ee88-4529-af49-3443b5c54a40.jpg)

Especially when the menu isn't even remotely Canadian.  But that's ok, it was still fun to see. 

But that was last night. Today was about getting to Scotland.  

Had to start the morning with my caffiene of course. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bae55fc9-b675-423b-be24-3d85ebd5ba77.jpg)

Something funny about \

but it got me started at 545am. Then it was a taxi (hooray for cabify app... Half the price of Uber). My thoughts about early morning airport? ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/91cfc9b1-7705-4704-bcfc-6dc284543024.jpg) The wait at the airport sucked as usual. However soon enough I was in Edinburgh. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0544d0f7-4194-41be-b285-c072fda58405.jpg) Frustrated because the sign was too large to get into the frame. But next stop was actually Glasgow. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d9720654-6596-46e7-a66e-7d3471da389d.jpg) Took the bus and it was a nice ride. The greenery really made me think of Canada.... If it had hundreds of years to manicure the wilderness :) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ac2a0b29-b771-44b2-9ab5-b6af63f52f2c.jpg) Got to Glasgow and got to the hotel. Tiny tiny tiny ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0b6a6e7d-c630-4b09-b193-7c7ad16b5a5f.jpg) Then it was time to walk through the downtown. That was an experience. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ac128510-fb3b-43a5-a89a-d85336a9451c.jpg) Lots and lots of people ranging from classy and upscale to homeless and ragged plus everything in between. Did I say lots and lots? The Streets were packed which kind of surprised me. Of course by now it was getting late and time for dinner. Lots of North American fast food for restaurants like McDonald's, Wendy's, Burger King, Taco time, Popeyes and Burger King. But we decided on fish and chips so I can honestly say I had fish and chips in the UK. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a0f018ca-036e-4083-9d71-6c147b03eab2.jpg) Plus I got to try Irn Bru which was... Interesting. The restaurant owner said it was cough syrup flavor but honestly it wasn't nearly that bad. Then we walked back to the hotel to rest before we have a busy day exploring tomorrow :) And that's how I got my 10k steps today

title.title: Nature in shades of grey 🖤 #monomad
title.body: Greetings lovely members of the community. I hope you all are doing great and enjoying quality time with your loved ones. >समुदाय के प्यारे सदस्यों को नमस्कार। मुझे आशा है कि आप सभी अच्छे होंगे और अपने प्रियजनों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय का आनंद ले रहे है। I took these pictures during sunset during my evening walk. The weather was nice, and the evening light made everything look extra good. >मैंने ये तस्वीरें अपनी शाम की सैर के दौरान सूर्यास्त के समय ली थीं। मौसम काफी अच्छा था और शाम की रोशनी की वजह से हर चीज़ और भी खूबसूरत लग रही थी। इसलिए चलते-चलते मैं बार-बार रुककर तस्वीरें लेने लगी। ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUM9TVjBdsRm2SewRXzSp2Mv5wN2BYBP3cHxsrvk6fX4/img_4349.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfY23a6cPJQdJZKBHfsMiTg67u4DC3aRC6opk2JKAC5Aa/img_4350.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf8LZP8MNgeyDfDDnaNp6D8TMH98PY5e5VMqcDQQqa1Zq/img_4351.jpg) The first set is of daisies with the sunset in the background. These flowers are everywhere these days, and I genuinely like seeing them around because they make empty spaces look lively. I always notice them during walks, especially in the evening when the light falls softly on them. >पहला सेट डेज़ी फूलों का है, जिनके पीछे सूर्यास्त का खूबसूरत नज़ारा दिख रहा था। आजकल ये फूल हर जगह खिले हुए दिखाई देते हैं, और मुझे इन्हें देखना सच में बहुत अच्छा लगता है क्योंकि ये खाली जगहों को भी खूबसूरत और जीवंत बना देते हैं। शाम की सैर के दौरान मेरी नज़र अक्सर इन पर चली ही जाती है, खासकर तब जब शाम की हल्की रोशनी इन पर पड़ती है। ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTCUUK4zJQCZREsNsBTxqYM9AfSRBBphMAiUcuDRMyfQY/img_4352.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSS2KmTU1zP5RcWFg6JqvsEg2J59SdAY2szYjx1FpFo1V/img_4353.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdag6Ny5zWM76u3LedioHdacJ62ZmsqF7YN5AdDWsX4re/img_4354.jpg) The next pictures are of a ladybug sitting on a leaf. Usually when I see ladybugs, they’re constantly moving, so it was surprising to see this one sitting quietly in one spot. >अगली तस्वीरें एक पत्ती पर बैठी लेडीबग की हैं। आमतौर पर जब भी मैं लेडीबग देखती हूँ, वो लगातार इधर-उधर घूमती रहती हैं, इसलिए इसको एक जगह बिल्कुल शांत बैठे देखना थोड़ा अलग और अच्छा लगा। ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcdWv25W6SjrYZLaof5o4yQtB6HJSyjGUb4Dqiai16d9C/img_4355.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQjxC4bYkEmDnEV3TQ3AuPeBkR6A3op6Rvhxjwq2cCSVE/img_4356.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPHjdwapv5ZPrF4xpkAMKiv2YoTaL72bSQZQ8iftmHjQM/img_4357.jpg) After that, I noticed these curved leaves near the sunlight. What caught my attention was the shape they made against the setting sun. The leaves looked dark because of the backlight, and I liked how the outlines looked in the pictures. > उसके बाद मेरी नज़र धूप के पास मौजूद इन मुड़ी हुई पत्तियों पर गई। डूबते सूरज के सामने इनकी जो आकृति बन रही थी, वही मुझे सबसे ज़्यादा अच्छी लगी। पीछे से रोशनी आने की वजह से पत्तियाँ थोड़ी गहरी दिखाई दे रही थीं, और तस्वीरों में उनकी आउटलाइन बहुत अच्छी लग रही थी। ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV7FN8njQMjEt67bAJKWGXg8gqzSeHZCV7PquZQ47NXeF/img_4358.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfRoN4cWPDsQWQGq2z3PrCNUPcffHNQMYrgudS8HGCZbb/img_4359.jpg) The last set is of a single white flower surrounded by lots of leaves. Usually these flowers grow in groups, so seeing just one standing there alone felt a bit different. >आखिरी तस्वीरें एक सफेद फूल की हैं, जो ढेर सारी पत्तियों के बीच अकेला खिला हुआ था। आमतौर पर ये फूल समूह में खिलते हैं, इसलिए इस तरह सिर्फ एक फूल को अकेले देखना थोड़ा अलग लगा। That’s all for today folks. Happy snapping. 💜💙 Thankyou for visiting 🌸 >आज के लिए बस इतना ही दोस्तों। तस्वीरें लेने का आनंद लें। 💜💙 आने के लिए धन्यवाद 🌸

85% of the decision-making process is subconscious or unconscious, meaning that people often do not know the real reasons why they buy a product or service,. Therefore, the author suggests that effective sales strategies should focus on neuroscience to understand how the human brain works and how to activate specific stimuli that lead to a purchase,,.
Key concepts from the sources include:

* The Three Brains Theory: Decisions are influenced by three levels of the brain: the reptilian (instinctive/survival), the limbic (emotional), and the cortex (rational),. The reptilian brain is the primary driver of purchase decisions because everything we buy is ultimately for survival,.
* The Reptilian Code: Every product has a \
or biological button (such as power, control, security, or pleasure) that, when activated, triggers the desire to buy,.\n* Selling without \

: Modern sales involve listening more and talking less, focusing on being a problem solver and creating an emotional connection rather than just pushing product features.

title.title: Are all silver built the same?
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXP2C5JJ4xRn5E1nJ6S7tpod98HG5nwaQN1bPBAKxqMwn/IMG_9933.jpg 

For fun I wanted to see how much people would buy some of my pieces for.

I went to my favourite place to offload some metals and started scrolling down to their \

section for silver

A part of me wasn't surprised to find out that they are willing to pay around 8% more for the 5 oz silver maples leaf than they would for the 5 oz silver bar from sunshine minting. They would pay even less for a random no name silver bar funny enough

This goes to show that although silver is silver, not all silver is worth the same in the eyes of the people

That is why if I was to buy silver I try my best to get modern silver maple leafs because they have the most real value of all coins and bars 

The same would go for gold and platinum, the name really matters and the premium that comes with going with a known brand is really worth it at the end of the day

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ssjsasha/are-all-silver-built-the-same-jx4)

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 24 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g8d92551fb418c144016a3b75893f706ecd98166e9a6cbefe672a91a3cf170a51f8c7b1ba8c46e03a6caa45767b4b30f7_640.jpg)
My last walk was through the stunning countryside of the Cotswolds, a region renowned for its breathtaking landscapes and charming villages. I set out early in the morning, the air crisp and fresh, with the sun beginning to rise over the rolling hills. As I walked along the winding paths, I was greeted by the sight of golden fields dotted with sheep. The stone cottages of villages like Bourton-on-the-Water were particularly picturesque, with their honey-colored stones glowing in the sunlight. I took a moment to enjoy the tranquility by the small river that runs through the village, where I watched the ducks paddling about. Along the way, I met a local farmer named Mr. Jenkins, who was tending to his sheep. He was happy to chat and shared stories about the traditions of farming in the Cotswolds and how they have changed over the years. He told me about the annual sheep shearing competitions and the importance of preserving the landscape and local wildlife. It was fascinating to hear his perspective on how the region balances tourism with agricultural practices. I also encountered a few other walkers, including a couple of older ladies who were out for their morning constitutional. We exchanged pleasantries and they recommended a lovely little tearoom in the nearby village of Stow-on-the-Wold, where I vowed to stop for a scone and a cup of tea before heading back. The walk ended with a spectacular view from a hilltop, where I paused to take it all in. The patchwork of fields and woodlands extended as far as the eye could see, a reminder of the beauty and history of this part of England. It was a wonderful day filled with both natural beauty and delightful encounters that made me appreciate the rich tapestry of life in the Cotswolds even more. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: The small village of Traversagna, nestled between the countryside and the urban area./ El pequeño pueblo de Traversagna, enclavado entre el campo y la zona urbana.
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXN9hUVFpeDBrPRcVcJD7DqiyWLBzXNB4Fake3rgYutjM/1779645297105.jpg)

Good evening, blog friends, I'm back with you to take you to a lovely little place I visited a few days ago, Traversagna or Margine dicoperta, a charming place located near Montecatini, near Buggiano and Santa Lucia, which I'll tell you about soon. Honestly, I only knew about this place because there's a famous music club here where they hold many concerts and jam sessions, but I'd never visited the surrounding area. This place is located in the Nievole plain, bordering the Fucecchio Marshes (another place I'd like to visit soon). Traversagna is a small village with medieval origins. Today, it's a passageway, divided between the houses on the main street, some neighboring streets, and the countryside, including some bordering the marshes. It's a very quiet and pleasant place. In ancient times, it's said that there were hospices here that housed pilgrims on their way to Lucca, as was the case in almost all the towns in the area that were a stopover for pilgrims. Instead, until the mid-1900s it was a predominantly rural area still to be reclaimed and urbanized, but little by little, with the growth of cities and urbanization, it became a residential, urban and completely or almost completely reclaimed area.

> Buenas noches, amigos del blog, estoy de vuelta para llevarlos a un pequeño y encantador lugar que visité hace unos días, Traversagna o Margine dicoperta, un lugar con encanto ubicado cerca de Montecatini, cerca de Buggiano y Santa Lucia, del que les hablaré pronto. Honestamente, solo conocía este lugar porque hay un famoso club de música donde se realizan muchos conciertos y jam sessions, pero nunca había visitado los alrededores. Este lugar está ubicado en la llanura de Nievole, limitando con las Marismas de Fucecchio (otro lugar que me gustaría visitar pronto). Traversagna es un pequeño pueblo de origen medieval. Hoy en día, es un pasaje, dividido entre las casas de la calle principal, algunas calles vecinas y el campo, incluyendo algunas que limitan con las marismas. Es un lugar muy tranquilo y agradable. En la antigüedad, se dice que aquí había hospicios que alojaban a los peregrinos en su camino a Lucca, como ocurría en casi todos los pueblos de la zona que eran parada para los peregrinos. En cambio, hasta mediados del siglo XX era una zona predominantemente rural que aún estaba por recuperar y urbanizar, pero poco a poco, con el crecimiento de las ciudades y la urbanización, se convirtió en una zona residencial, urbana y total o casi totalmente recuperada.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZRnDx2Fi91Qh1g7SPEGTEtbTomBzB9rLCWvTojeNVfpf/1779645297362.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPTMukwJUWQpegv5AnPGQaT35EqAys4xCr3vBRM9WzP1j/1779645297598.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYAFLVo4cBCbRDYNaJWgL1Rh2SFvkbBeshRJe1hDRio3J/1779645297846.jpg)


The first part of the village is very residential, with many houses, villas, and simple but well-maintained residences. There are also various businesses and shops. It's clear that today it's a very active and vibrant area, no longer a place of farmers and isolated houses. There are some cemented squares, a cemetery, and charming little parks. Then, however, we approach the countryside, which immediately unfolds in all its splendor: long green fields, some lined with cypress trees, farmhouses, fields of various herbs, olive groves, and various crops. The countryside is what I like and appreciate the most. There are various little roads that branch off between the fields. One day, I'd love to visit the countryside in this area; it must be very relaxing. Continuing on, however, we return to a more industrialized area, a little less beautiful than the green spaces, but still with several tree-lined avenues, so not all concrete! Here too, there are villas and shops, mostly factories, but I'm not sure what. In any case, it's a small village that I quite enjoyed, even though it doesn't have any major highlights. It's a pleasant little Tuscan town, typical of the area. See you soon with more trips, blogging friends!

> La primera parte del pueblo es muy residencial, con muchas casas, villas y residencias sencillas pero bien conservadas. También hay varios negocios y tiendas. Es evidente que hoy en día es una zona muy activa y dinámica, ya no un lugar de agricultores y casas aisladas. Hay algunas plazas pavimentadas, un cementerio y pequeños parques con encanto. Luego, sin embargo, nos acercamos al campo, que inmediatamente se despliega en todo su esplendor: largos campos verdes, algunos bordeados de cipreses, casas de campo, campos de diversas hierbas, olivares y diversos cultivos. El campo es lo que más me gusta y aprecio. Hay varios caminos pequeños que se ramifican entre los campos. Algún día, me encantaría visitar el campo en esta zona; debe ser muy relajante. Sin embargo, continuando, volvemos a una zona más industrializada, un poco menos hermosa que los espacios verdes, pero aún con varias avenidas arboladas, ¡así que no todo es cemento! Aquí también hay villas y tiendas, en su mayoría fábricas, pero no estoy seguro de qué. En cualquier caso, es un pueblecito que me gustó mucho, aunque no tenga grandes atractivos turísticos. Es un agradable pueblecito toscano, típico de la zona. ¡Nos vemos pronto con más viajes, amigos blogueros!


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYer1SENttyLi4umreokh1znwnKGrU8ej8McFaEqAGvN6/1779645298045.jpg)

title.title: Fábula del reloj de Arena.
title.body: >El Reloj de Arena y la Brisa del Desierto ​En el centro de una duna inmensa, donde el sol parece detenerse a descansar, se encontraba un Reloj de Arena, era de cristal tallado con su base de ébano, era un objeto orgulloso, obsesionado con la precisión, y su único propósito en la vida era contar cada grano que caía, asegurándose de que el tiempo transcurriera de forma ordenada y previsible. #

>Un mediodía, una Brisa ligera y juguetona se detuvo a su lado, la Brisa no tenía forma, ni horario, ni destino; simplemente fluía según le dictaba el corazón del mundo. ​—¿Por qué te quedas ahí tan rígido? —preguntó la Brisa, agitando apenas unos granos de polvo a su alrededor—. El desierto es vasto y hay mil paisajes que ver más allá de este montículo. #

>El Reloj, sin desviar su mirada interna de la cascada de sílice, respondió con voz grave: —Mi deber es la constancia, si me muevo, el orden se pierde, tú eres voluble, no entiendes el valor de lo que permanece, yo mido la eternidad; tú solo eres un suspiro que se desvanece. #

>La Brisa sonrió y sopló con un poco más de fuerza, —Mides el tiempo, es cierto, pero ¿lo vives? Estás tan ocupado contando los segundos que se te olvida que el sol ya cambió el color de la arena de oro a fuego. #
>—La belleza es irrelevante para la exactitud —sentenció el reloj. #

>En ese momento, una tormenta repentina se desató, el viento arreció y una ráfaga violenta volcó al orgulloso Reloj, enterrándose profundamente bajo una nueva duna, sus granos internos se mezclaron con la arena del exterior a través de una pequeña fisura en el cristal; cuando la tormenta pasó, el Reloj ya no podía contar nada; era solo un trozo de vidrio roto en el silencio. #
>La Brisa regresó al atardecer y, al no encontrar al Reloj en su sitio, susurró a los restos bajo la arena. #

>Quien vive obsesionado con medir la vida y controlar cada instante, corre el riesgo de que la existencia le pase de largo, la rigidez nos hace frágiles ante el cambio; es mejor fluir con el tiempo que intentar atraparlo en una caja de cristal. #
![1000000119.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayifiestas/23vsZ4d394BSYVSPnxnncFZeUen4msbTHXysq7MZ8UbWZqGYMgrMkzbGBr1gJYeeqVF6C.jpg)

title.title: Splinterlands- A great victory after a tough match.
title.body:
Hello everyone. I am @naturaluttom,
Today I am going to share with you again one of my Splinterlands Frontier Ranked matches. I have not been able to win well for a long time. I was going around the same rating. However, today's match was quite good for me. Because in the end I got a nice win.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZZ1fRYEZn1RDuPoJys5T1rnrQ6C6h5aYQqnu5mBS3nrE/1779646346656.png)





[‎The image was created with AI.]()



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)

The Mana Cap of this match was 33. And the Battle Rules were Rise of the Commons. In this rule, only Common and Rare cards can be used. So I had to think a little from the beginning and organize the team.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPmPDtoHAwRysZX2TCfaUkuPmFu7xpWm5g8Y9SZsEp4hB/1779646346937.jpg)

https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_95df36d98ff6181aa789da0beeff00ae?ref=naturalutto_lite

I used Earth Element in this match. I took Aurelia as the Summoner. My team had some strong magic attack cards. Also, the magic attack unit in the back also gave great support.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSLQu5XrwfGjnH8SzrEqwisjwfyc85kcRvayA5CEaKxT9/1779646346973.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP5LNMMdnqFaQJH89JhtmQECobjRs19H5FAjHs78Dbcc2/1779646347020.jpg)



At the beginning of the match, attacks were going on from both sides. In the first round, the match was fairly even. However, from the second round, my team started to slowly move forward. My Beast unit started to deal good damage to the opponent's cards.

As the round progressed, the opponent's team became weaker. Some of my units were still on the field. Towards the end I realized that the match was going my way. Finally, I won the match in Round 7.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYpBFHMYyhG9vb8NFaLRcrCoqheWDVM1v6F2vCHAYo8Sf/1779646347072.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme2fK4qAHHkzbsDSYvD7oNxaVS4RKm7JaHoWk92zNi7ws/1779646357398.jpg)

With this win I got +40 Rating because I had won two matches in a row before that is why I got this message 40 rating. I moved from Silver III league to Silver II again. I really felt good after the win. Because after a few days I got another beautiful Victory.

Today's match was quite enjoyable for me. I hope I can play better matches in the future.

Thank you all.

title.title: How many times do we need to study the word of God?
title.body:
https://youtu.be/lb9pM-VkUKE?si=cWkrW43TdbB90hfp
The bible teaches us that studying the word of God doesn't have season, it is something we do everyday of our life. God’s Word is spiritual food that strengthens our faith, gives wisdom, and guides us in daily living. Just as we eat food every day to stay healthy physically, we should also study the Scriptures regularly to grow spiritually and remain close to God. The early believers devoted themselves daily to learning and obeying God’s teachings.

The word of God is something we need everyday of our life, we have to always study and meditate on it everyday. Through constant study, prayer, and meditation, we gain understanding, correction, encouragement, and direction for life. The more we study the Bible, the more our minds and hearts are transformed according to God’s will.

>“Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.”  2 Timothy 2:15 (KJV)

title.title: Switching to Bamboo Brush - Change wherever we can
title.body:
For the past few years, I have been using a Bamboo Brush instead of a regular plastic brush for brushing my teeth. I was earlier using the regular tooth brush, but then later found this as an option available in the market, and then decided, why not make this switch? 

One of the biggest advantages of making this move is that we become more cautious about preventing microplastics from getting into our mouths. People who follow me know that I write a lot of articles on plastic awareness. In the form of this article, I would like to make a kind request that people should think about moving to a bamboo brush instead of a plastic brush. There are so many options available in the market, and I'm sure the brushing experience has always been the same with both types of brushes. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWBNWposGbGRWx7TkrpdMnU5P1Cnawp3w4133ryPLMtHP/image.png)

Source - Gemini

I would like to be very careful in saying that we don't have to throw our existing plastic brushes immediately into the garbage and go for a bamboo brush. That also unnecessarily creates plastic waste. We can continue to use the exiting plastic brush and when there is a time when we have to change our brush, we can pick the option of choosing a Bamboo brush. In some cases, based on where you buy the product, the cost can be slightly on the higher side, but I would like to say that it is worth the investment, and for the safe environment, there is no harm is getting something that is less harmful. 

Some brushes have only the handle part in wood. The brushes will still continue to be in nylon or plastics in many cases which is okay. I would say that changing partially or fully is not a big deal. The change itself is the most important thing. This way we don't have to worry about a tooth brush getting into the nose of a sea turtle. This is a small change that anyone can make. Give it a try.

title.title: Hapoel T-A FC fans massive rally - photo story.
title.body:
I have never crossed the line of the football stadium. Only once in my life i watched the whole football game. It was the final game of the 2022 World Cup – the historic match between Argentina and France. But my post today is not about the football, even sure there is some strong indirect connection.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS7iKKKhSxibbKd4WEkNDhR48CCxoig1oizcMYtkAy8xi/hapoel_telaviv_fans_rally_1_2026_by_victor_bezrukov_11.jpg)

 At the weekend, somewhere around lunchtime, i decided to drive to Uganda Bar TLV, famous for its hummus, which Maxim prepares only twice a week. For sure, I was not disappointed that day either and spent in the bar around hour with an amazing food and an IPA beer, enjoyed reading recent posts of my WordPress subscriptions. When i finished and left the bar, Suddenly i found myself surrounded by thousands of people dressed in red. For my luck, the Hapoel’s football club fans came to the park near the bar for the gathering and subsequent rally towards the stadium. The timing was amazing for me. I had some free time and, as usual, I had my camera with me.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUFWtEVNWT8QGpX9WDmsGvN8THeSfQZiCBioLTiSvuXMk/hapoel_telaviv_fans_rally_1_2026_by_victor_bezrukov_1.jpg)

A few words about this club. The club name, “Hapoel”, translates to “The Worker”, and combined with its red Hammer and sickle badge represents the club ties to Marxism, socialism, Labor Zionism, and the working class. For seven decades, the club was owned by the Histadrut, Israel’s national trade union center. (ref. WIKI)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX3zAyAu17G9rZbnacT1BmGn6Esokge23sQAaVievMePV/hapoel_telaviv_fans_rally_1_2026_by_victor_bezrukov_2.jpg)

 In conclusion – football is not my religion, but this walk with thousands heated fans was an amazing anthropological experience and the observation of the human nature, which always was and be the most exciting topic for my photography practice.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS2rCQLvqt5D5Xko4KHY7Bmo8uAFG5ufRaYdVNqmXFKKr/hapoel_telaviv_fans_rally_1_2026_by_victor_bezrukov_3.jpg)

title.title: A wonderful experience of getting a big duck from the market on a weekend and an egg in its belly.
title.body:
> ![IMG20250327200739~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSs8F8DRoiAzEbZQMXBGvUn38ELJ3oEokHQDLE6b6y797/IMG20250327200739~2.jpg) Greetings to everyone. I hope everyone is well. Today I am going to share with you a wonderful cooking and shopping experience of my last Friday. It is a common custom in our Bengali families to organize a little good and bad food on holidays. Especially in the winter or rainy season or on any ordinary Friday, duck meat with hot rice is a must. ![IMG20250327200239~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPfE941r9Bfjwd3Qu5LZ2Wa4dUKfXLhqEjoxiErLQF7hU/IMG20250327200239~2.jpg) Last Friday morning, I went to the local market to do the weekly market. Although the winter season was not completely over, there were quite good ducks available in the market. After a lot of searching, I came across a quite big and healthy duck. I thought the meat would be quite soft and tasty. After some bargaining with the seller, I finally bought the duck. ![IMG20250327200602~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRTWRpMCqEZdsmzWwHmRTsZVv6TfiaqsaTzy84vMw6au5/IMG20250327200602~2.jpg) When we returned home and prepared to slaughter the duck, a big surprise was waiting for all of us. When the duck was cleaned and its stomach was cut open, it was found that there were several small and large eggs inside it. One egg was almost fully developed and had a hard shell, and the rest were yolks or immature egg clusters. Usually, after buying a duck from the market, it is quite a blessing to get such whole and so many eggs. Our whole family was very happy to see the eggs. ![IMG20250327201504~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTzaDVoLRY1CVzpWFMnLpvVC7Uswx8tTFhfGse6cctQ8G/IMG20250327201504~2.jpg) The right ratio of spices is very important in cooking duck meat. That day, my mother cooked the meat very well with pure mustard oil, chopped onion, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala and cumin-coriander powder. And after putting those eggs inside the duck's stomach in the meat broth, its taste seemed to increase many times over. Especially that whole egg and the yolk clusters absorbed the spices of the meat and created a wonderful texture. ![IMG20250327201437~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbT6mYKGRTBUwmudo2aPduQA7aSRz8uyfqzYS1ous9TuJ/IMG20250327201437~2.jpg) When the cooking was finished, the minced duck meat and eggs were served with hot steaming rice for lunch, and a heavenly feeling was created. The meat was very soft and juicy, and the taste of the broth was like sticking in your mouth. All in all, last Friday's lunch was really great and memorable. Don't forget to comment if you have bought duck like this and got eggs in your stomach and love eating eggs with duck meat. ___ |

There’s something special about spending time at home after a busy week.

As someone who recently finished studying architecture, I often find myself thinking about how much our surroundings affect our mood. A comfortable room, a favorite blanket, a quiet corner to relax... sometimes those simple things are exactly what we need.

Today I decided to slow down for a while and enjoy the comfort of home. No deadlines, no plans, no pressure. Just a peaceful moment to reflect on everything I've learned and everything I still want to achieve.

I’m excited about the future, but I’m also learning to appreciate the present. Growth isn't only about moving forward; sometimes it's about taking a break, recharging, and giving yourself the space to breathe.

Tomorrow there will be new opportunities, new projects, and new challenges. But today, I'm grateful for this quiet moment.

# Learn Zig Series (#58) - ECS Game Engine: Terminal Rendering

![zig.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaHuB6qTWHaSpJHQ1S8FCCRmNQuUxTcPZdU4yKHsJ7vEP/zig-banner.png)

**Project F: ECS Game Engine Core (4/4)**

### What will I learn
- You will learn how to define a Sprite component with character, foreground color, and layer ordering;
- You will learn terminal rendering with ANSI escape codes for color and cursor control;
- You will learn double buffering: drawing to a back buffer then swapping to the screen in one write;
- You will learn the render system: iterating entities with Sprite + Position components and drawing them to the buffer;
- You will learn how to build a basic game loop: read input, run systems, render, sleep;
- You will learn how to create a bouncing entities demo on a terminal canvas;
- You will learn frame rate control with nanosecond timing;
- You will learn a project retrospective: what a production ECS adds beyond what we built.

### Requirements
- A working modern computer running macOS, Windows or Ubuntu;
- An installed Zig 0.14+ distribution (download from ziglang.org);
- The ambition to learn Zig programming.

### Difficulty
- Advanced

# Learn Zig Series (#58) - ECS Game Engine: Terminal Rendering

Last episode we built systems and queries -- the logic layer that transforms component data every frame. We have gravity pulling entities down, movement updating positions, collision detection finding AABB overlaps, and damage reducing health when things collide. The engine runs, entities move, physics works... but we can't see any of it. Everything happens in memory and we print debug text at the end of each frame. Today we fix that. We're building the rendering layer -- the part that takes our game state and draws it to a terminal screen with colored characters, proper layering, and smooth animation.

This is the final episode of the ECS mini-project. By the end of it we'll have a complete (if simple) game engine: entities, components, systems, queries, physics, collision, AND visible output. A bouncing-entities demo running in your terminal at a stable frame rate. Here we go!

## The Sprite component

Every entity that should be visible on screen needs a **Sprite** component. A sprite in a terminal context is just a character, a color, and a layer number for draw ordering:

```zig
const std = @import(\
body:
on the World -- a single instance of a type that any system can access. The input state, the audio mixer, the asset manager, configuration data -- all resources, all accessible through the World without special plumbing.

**Parallel system execution.** Our systems run sequentially. A production ECS analyzes which components each system reads and writes, builds a dependency graph, and runs non-conflicting systems in parallel. If the gravity system only writes Velocity and the render system only reads Position + Sprite, they can run concurrently on different threads. Zig's lack of hidden allocations and pointer aliasing guarantees makes this particularly well-suited for parallel ECS designs.

**Archetypes.** Our sparse sets store one component type each, and queries check each entity against multiple sparse sets. Archetype-based storage groups entities by their component combination -- all entities with exactly {Position, Velocity, Sprite} live in one contiguous table. Queries that match an archetype iterate that entire table with zero per-entity branching. This is what makes ECS frameworks like Bevy and flecs handle millions of entities at 60 FPS.

**World serialization.** Save games, network replication, hot reloading -- all require serializing the entire World state. With our current design you'd have to write custom serialization per component type. Production frameworks can serialize generically because they track component metadata at runtime.

None of these are necessary for understanding ECS. What matters is the core pattern: entities are IDs, components are data, systems are logic, and composition replaces inheritance. Everything else is optimization and tooling built on top of that foundation. If you understand what we've built across these four episodes, you understand ECS. The rest is engineering, not architecture ;-)

## Wat we geleerd hebben

- The Sprite component stores a character, foreground color, background color, and layer for draw ordering
- ANSI escape codes control cursor position (`\x1b[row;colH`), colors (`\x1b[3Xm` for fg, `\x1b[4Xm` for bg), and screen state (clear, cursor show/hide)
- Double buffering means drawing to a back buffer then swapping -- this prevents flicker and enables differential updates where only changed cells get written to the terminal
- The render system collects entities with Position + Sprite, sorts by layer, and draws to the back buffer; the flush function writes only changed cells to stdout
- The game loop repeats: process input, run systems, render, sleep until next frame; frame timing uses nanosecond timestamps to maintain a stable target FPS
- The bounce demo shows ECS composability: 6 entities with 3 components each, 2 systems (bounce + movement), rendered at 30 FPS with zero entity-specific code in the main loop
- Frame statistics track average time, worst frame, and drop rate to identify performance problems before they become visible stutters
- Production ECS frameworks extend this foundation with events, resources, parallel scheduling, archetype storage, and world serialization -- but the core architecture is exactly what we built

This wraps up Project F -- four episodes from architecture to visible output. The ECS pattern shows up everywhere in game development, simulation, and even non-game contexts like UI frameworks and data processing pipelines. The concepts from these episodes (sparse sets, type erasure, system scheduling, differential rendering) transfer directly to whatever Zig project you build next.

Thanks for reading!
