body.title: THE RECEIPT MY MOTHER NEVER THREW AWAY
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcN7RpPVutkcoNhv5thjngA2o8L3pNGvBP7FoPYou3gDv/1779646412327.jpg)


The Ink Well fam,

In my mother’s Bible, between Psalm 23 and a dried hibiscus flower, was a receipt from 1998.
It was yellowed, torn at the edges, and stained with something that looked like palm oil.
She never let anyone touch it.

Last week, I asked her about it.

The receipt read:
Item: Amlodipine 5mg - 30 tablets
Amount: ₦500
Date: 12th September 2001
Vendor: Supremecy  Pharmacy, People's club

Under it, in her handwriting: \

My father had been diagnosed with high blood pressure that year. 
He refused to tell anyone. Said men don’t get sick, men provide.
So my mother carried it alone.

What I didn’t know was that Nurse Joy  had given the drugs to my mother for free.
The ₦500 receipt was fake. My mother paid it to protect my father’s pride.
She told the neighbors she was \

She told me she was broke, not broken.

She kept that receipt for 26 years. Not as a reminder of poverty.
As a reminder that she lied so my father could take his medicine without feeling like a burden.

  Here’s the part that broke me:
When I asked her why she never told me, she smiled and said:
\

Nurse Joy passed in 2010, but her daughter still runs the pharmacy at People's club.
Last week I went there to buy painkillers and told her the story. 
She cried and said, \

We spend our lives chasing big receipts - houses, cars, degrees.
But sometimes the smallest paper holds the biggest love.

Do you have an object from your past that means more now than it did then?
Tell me about it. I’ll read every story.

title.title: 24 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3113: so productive
title.body:
So productive I have a lemon tree that was once so productive. The first crop yielded five generous, beautiful, and very juicy lemons. Of course, we made juice with them to accompany our lunch. That tree is our pride and joy; we planted it from scratch and have cared for it like the apple of our eye. It continued to be so productive, but only for a short time. It's been over a year since it produced its juicy lemons, but we still take care of it. Who knows, maybe one of these days it will surprise us with its beautiful orange blossoms and fill us with fragrance, joy, and hope. That's nature; it always surprises us. >Tan productiva Tengo una planta de limón que una vez fue tan productiva, la primera carga fue de 5 limones generosos, bellos y muy jugosos claro que hicimos jugo con ellos para acompañar nuestro almuerzo, esa planta es nuestro orgullo, la plantamos desde cero y la hemos cuidado como la niña de nuestros ojos. Siguió siendo tan productivo pero solo por un corto tiempo, tiene más de un año que no produce sus juguso limones, pero aún así la seguimos cuidando, quien sabe si uno de estos días nos sorprende con sus hermosas flores azahar y nos llena de aromas, alegría y esperanza, así es la naturaleza siempre nos sorprende. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWnsm48TDXHryF7aD73ABs5d1AZckHihqm9ChgcSyYe6G/1779645990015.jpg) >This piece is my entry for the daily writing challenge from the Freewriters community, hosted by @mariannewest Este escrito es mi participación en el reto diario de escritura de la comunidad freewriters, presentado por @mariannewest

title.title: Spring day in Osanovskaya grove
title.body:
It depends on what kind of creative wave I'm on, whether I like different landscaping in the city or not. In the reporting wave (which has held the top positions for several years), I am attracted to the beautification of public spaces, as it looks aesthetically pleasing and is suitable for publication in news agencies.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYRAEMpWu5NdrtuyDkCyw9kxSo8wrP6tSVuzC6xCBQdcy/image.png)

So there is work, there are fees, there is movement and life.
https://sun9-53.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/gVQmqpIfK3NE6s9vWtc6K0cGrQwTiuievyIf_xlEeX7r1XGCox_HEYSBSuShmZc8cCdeoaSmQVkqg8LomWL52sB_.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=1280x0

But I remember this grove as it was before landscaping.
https://sun9-43.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/WoiMZD1p2TyCnu2cZ0Z9J43emqhkKv_L__0Regqxup4DJafi2J-YXX9CO7CsiF_I_KKMh1nRLGDIV6oD6sEKbDsA.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=1280x0

By the way, there are still pieces of the grove that have not been touched.

And if you go back about five years, there were completely different views here.
https://sun9-21.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/gkNKEQZnPdvEcVi0sp_EEIr6YkLdJdRltaEnON0VgQDMTPNhOvW6Khp9Vo1Iluzb-3NWZRgg_M6JQ6dHgs39SmTk.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=1280x0

People were roasting shashlik with beer, just sitting around the campfire with a guitar playing.
https://sun9-49.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/4uqvV2VQo-4FBaRx_fOb6z_SpH1WBfeluGc3nIqJVJjzn1MgTcoqw1cOkEYEYN232lj3_eWwiPh8vekDgXhMoJvD.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=1280x0

And these kinds of real neformal, uncluttered ones are a different genre (deadpan, documentary).
https://sun9-12.userapi.com/s/v1/ig2/OwcvvSG9bSi8uh3bzeNsAYpgNmO72H1y--VnECQM3IrmOjWh427bJIPVed-VA6y0sIZrM2E58yZr3tVH8XMH2Qz_.jpg?quality=95&as=32x21,48x32,72x48,108x72,160x107,240x160,360x240,480x320,540x360,640x427,720x480,1080x720,1280x853,1440x960,2560x1707&from=bu&cs=1280x0

title.title: MSCI | The Data Giant That’s Quietly Winning
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRLub4MDX97qYGgZev9yQQNNQ25kTxKA8LnmtpCEHVfqW/1000009354.png 


When we talk about global stocks, most of us usually look at big names like Nvidia or Alibaba. But today, let’s talk about MSCI Inc. Lately, this company has been popping up more often among global investors. Why? Because MSCI is moving fast with AI. They are building it right into their data platforms. For big investment firms, MSCI isn't just an index provider anymore, they have become the backbone of financial data, helping everyone make smarter decisions in this crazy market.

**Why Is MSCI Worth Watching?**
Let’s look at why this company has a real edge over the competition.

**1. Super Steady Margins**
MSCI is incredibly consistent. Their business is super efficient, which is clear from their gross margins. They’ve managed to keep them around 82% for the last five years. That is honestly impressive.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQyWXdWth5j59RJVhjM8V1TWaVh9NLer1uv2oQorwxA21/1000009340.jpg 


**2. Growing Cash Flow**
Free Cash Flow (FCF) is like the blood of a company. As you can see, MSCI’s cash flow keeps going up. This is great news because it means the company has plenty of money to grow or pay dividends without needing to rely on a pile of debt.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmS61WhCQnv6ZHQnx9UmCZJFHqg994GHwHLLVjo3NkEPhp/1000009348.jpg 


**3. A More Realistic Valuation**
If we look at their P/E ratio, MSCI’s valuation is much more down to earth now compared to its peak in 2021-2022. For long term investors, this current price level often looks like a much better entry point.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPM11pV35BoDdc5DaVeeW8oY6J1xKPDZ7utz6S2hsCnoJ/1000009350.jpg 


**A Quick Look at the Chart**
Technically speaking, MSCI is hanging out in an interesting spot right now. The price is trying to hold onto its key support and resistance levels.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfTy3ziGNYU5G846vYgpYjWdAvABX5cg6En7mbPDQfADx/1000009351.jpg 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUdrYf4trBrPsNkVoNDToLPuNJUqtCkLQUPg8YtRooMG5/1000009352.jpg 


When the fundamentals are this strong, these dips or sideways moves in the chart often turn out to be great opportunities for long term investors who want to buy a high quality company at a decent price.


What's the point? MSCI might not be as flashy as the AI stocks that go viral every single day. But if you're looking for a solid, sustainable business that actually grows, MSCI definitely deserves a spot on your watchlist. It’s the kind of steady, reliable stock that helps keep your portfolio balanced when the rest of the market gets a bit wild.


Source
 [Investor Relations - MSCI](https://share.google/O0WzpwHZPSA0PZLjG)

- Full Demo
title.body:
[SSR Wives: The Murder Of My Winter Crush](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4553340/SSR_Wives_The_Murder_Of_My_Winter_Crush/) is a retro-style horror adventure that takes inspiration from Silent Hill and combines it with anime aesthetic. The game has a strong visual style. The game has multiple playable characters, most of them are girls, but I chose the boy character for my playthrough.


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmT5qJbyFfUkYGHw3hX7kou3D3ZRzZ111pacwS3y8Znpve/SSR%20Wives%202026-04-26%2018-16%20Demo.mkv_snapshot_00.11.103.jpg 


SSR Wives' 3D retro aesthetics have a modern twists to them. The player navigates in a 3D environment with a fixed-rails moving camera view. I especially liked how the camera pans in a disorienting way, adding to the horror of the game.

The demo puts you in the middle of the action, with barely any story. I loved the enemy types which consist of oversized Rats and Insects, which made me wonder if they're just that big or if the player character is the one who got small? A theory that the game's locations didn't disprove.. What happened to this place anyway? here's a lot of blood and garbage everywhere!!



I didn't play the demo to its ending, but I think I played enough to be interested in the game's release. If I'm playing this game again, I'll choose one of the female characters. Check out my playthrough and screenshots below:

title.title: Day of 2026-05-24: Long Weekend & Deliberate Downtime
title.body: There is currently a long weekend, with Monday being a bank holiday. I plan to use the time for biking. From a process perspective, this kind of downtime is useful as long as it doesn’t drift into disengagement. Physical activity helps reset attention, especially after periods of continuous operational thinking. Key is keeping a light structure in place so that momentum isn’t lost entirely. Iterative Systems: Solar Experiment for Plants ---------------------------------------------- Today I “MacGyver-ed” a larger sun collector for the herbal plants. It’s a temporary setup and extending the past efforts on increasing the amount of sunlight funneled to the plant's receptors, and the current screen will likely only hold for about a week.
/> This is part of an iterative improvement loop. The goal is not stability yet, but observation: what works, what fails, and how long each configuration lasts under real conditions.

/> The next stage will require dull thin foil, but the design direction is still open. For decreasing the heat concentration. But design options include a spherical cap or a partial sphere mounted on bars over the tray. I’m not yet sure whether a concave spherical reflector or a hemispherical solar concentrator is the better approach. Mount the collector on the tray, or design it to bundle the light to one spot in the garden. From a systems perspective, this is early stage experimentation: multiple hypotheses, limited constraints, and no need for premature optimization. Portfolio Movement (20 May → 24 May) ------------------------------------ All hive-engine bridges to the other networks are under investigation due to hack which drained them. The structure shows selective but meaningful adjustments: *

>$LTC short exposure was reduced significantly, suggesting a deliberate de-risking step.

\n*

>$DAB continues to build gradually, reinforcing its role as a steadily increasing position.

\n*

>$BBH and $BBHO saw moderate declines, while the rest of the portfolio remains unchanged.

Changes over this period, expressed in percentage terms: * $ACE: ➖ 0% (no change) * $BBH: 📉 approximately -0.52% * $BBHO: 📉 approximately -1.74% * $BTC: ➖ 0% (no change) * $DAB: 📈 approximately +1.46% * $LTC: 📈 reduction in short exposure (~11.65% decrease in magnitude) * $MATIC: ➖ 0% (no change) * $SURGE: ➖ 0% (no change) * $TGLD: ➖ 0% (no change) * $TNVDA: ➖ 0% (no change) * $TTSLA: ➖ 0% (no change) Overall, this remains a controlled environment: adjustments are targeted, not systemic shifts. Volume Context --------------

>

0.0

Volume remains concentrated in $LTC and $HBD, with $DAB also showing meaningful participation. This distribution continues to reinforce a familiar pattern: a few dominant liquidity centers and a long tail of smaller activity. I need to get rid of the leostrategy pile. **As always, the guiding principle remains unchanged: observe, adjust selectively, and avoid over fitting to short term conditions.**

body.title: Wedel mleczna miso karmel
body.body:
Wedel czekolada mleczna z nadzieniem (50%) o smaku miso z karmelem
Producent: LOTTE Wedel, Warszawa, Polska
Masa netto: 100 gramów
Cena: 4,49 zł przy zakupie 4 (cena regularna 7,99 zł), Dino

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbZPFy6mP6G27g6sfVazsGYzADdzBK8y3dJyBNpbQbCKJ/image)

#### Wedel i japońskie inspiracje

W tym sezonie Wedel proponuje naprawdę intrygujące smaki tabliczek nadziewanych. „Spróbuj nowości inspirowanych Japonią” to hasło kampanii promocyjnej. Japońskie smaki mogą nawiązywać do pochodzenia obecnego właściciela Wedla – koncern (czebol) Lotte ma wprawdzie obecnie siedzibę w Seulu, ale swoje początki pod nazwą  pod nazwą Lotte Co., Ltd. firma miała właśnie w Japonii, w Tokio. Mniej \
powody takiego akurat pomysłu na nowości mogą wynikać po prostu z tego, że japońskie smaki są \

. Matcha chyba zostanie z nami na dłużej i będzie trendem kolejnych wakacji, a pozostałe smaki również są ciekawe. Korzystając z promocji zakupiłam wszystkie cztery propozycje Wedla. 
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS7wqhfvsC48KAU9SAPQVHsnyhKhZFHGxm8AsXFpjfPnQ/image)

Opakowanie to tradycyjnie polipropylenowa koperta spójna graficznie z pozostałymi opakowaniami czekolad Wedla. Mamy logo i charakterystyczne niebiesko-indygo tło, a każda nowość ma swój kolor nawiązujący do smaku. Mleczna miso karmel ma kolor ciemnokarmelowy. Na opakowaniu pojawiają się również graficzne motywy oraz japońskie napisy.
Tym razem na opakowaniu nie znajdziemy informacji o tym, że kakao pochodzi  z Ghany. Zamiast tego na rewersie znajduje się informacja o japońskich inspiracjach, pozostałych dostępnych smakach i Maneki-neko.
Tabliczka waży 100 gramów i dzieli się na 10 dużych kostek z logotypem E. Wedel.

#### Skład czekolady Wedel mlecznej miso karmel

Składniki: czekolada mleczna 50 % (cukier, tłuszcz kakaowy, mleko pełne w proszku, miazga kakaowa, serwatka w proszku (z mleka), tłuszcz mleczny, emulgatory: lecytyny sojowe i E 476, aromat), pasta karmelowa 17 % (mleko zagęszczone słodzone (mleko, cukier), substancja utrzymująca wilgoć: glicerol, syrop glukozowy, roztwór cukru inwertowanego, tłuszcz mleczny, cukier, aromat), cukier, tłuszcz roślinny (palmowy), serwatka w proszku (z mleka), orzeszki arachidowe (miazga i kawałki), sól, aromat naturalny, emulgator (lecytyny sojowe).
Czekolada mleczna: masa kakaowa minimum 29 %, masa mleczna minimum 14 %.

100 gramów tej czekolady ma wartość energetyczną 503 kcal, zawiera 28 g tłuszczów, 55 g węglowodanów (w tym 52 g cukrów), 6,1 g białka i 0,5 g soli.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ7w1CJdDUxWSbqrtcBUTqP6T4Er6wfcq9HCYMtYhZgZ1/image)

Skład, jak to przy tabliczkach nadziewanych, jest bardzo długi. Jest to typowa tabliczka łakociowa, z niewielką ilością kakao, wysokocukrowa. Chyba będzie dość słona, bo 0,5 grama soli to całkiem sporo, ale ma być miso, więc zapewne będzie to słodko-słony miks. Czy zdobędzie tylu fanów co klasyczny już słony karmel? W składzie nie rzuca się to w oczy, ale zarówno grafika na opakowaniu jak i eksperymentalne przekrojenie kostek pokazuje, że nadzienia są dwa.

***
#### Recenzja czekolady Wedel mlecznej miso karmel

Czekolada pachnie słodko i, co naprawdę mnie zaskoczyło, da się wyczuć zapach pasty miso. Efekt połączenia tego zapachu z zapachem mlecznej czekolady jest bardzo przyjemny i w moim odczuciu udany, wzbogacający, zachęcający. Jest to czekolada mleczna z nadzieniem, więc tabliczka jest dość miękka i łamie się bez trzasku. 

Kostka startuje w ustach bardzo szybko. Czekolada mleczna, która oblewa kolejną już recenzowaną tabliczkę nie jest gładka, ma swoistą ziarnistość. To chyba nowy standard Wedla. 
Jest słodko, ale bardzo szybko dołączają ciekawe sojowo-słone nutki. Połączenie jest trochę zaskakujące, ale nie jest to miks na tyle kontrowersyjny, że ktoś mógłby go zdecydowanie odrzucić (tak jak niektórzy nie lubią połączeń gorzkiej czekolady z solą morską czy chilli). Efekt ciekawego, bogatszego w smaki toffi. Po rozpuszczeniu czekolady i nadzienia w ustach zostają nieduże kawałeczki orzechów arachidowych. Akcent końcowy jest dość zaskakujący, bo mamy tu miks smaku słodkiego, słonego i umami. Zdecydowanie ma się ochotę na kolejną kostkę.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZJhp5sTMExq3hs42nZYFjDjSZmb4J4xxKUH9awdnxvAk/image)

Młodsi domowi testerzy po raz kolejny byli bardzo pozytywnie zaskoczeni smakiem. Wprawdzie nie umieli nazwać smaków nadzienia, ale zauważyli, że smak jest bardzo ciekawie złożony, kostki mają \

(umami). Testerka określiła, że jest to takie trochę sezamowe, trochę słony karmel. Tester określił smak jako skomplikowany, ale chętnie sięgał po kolejne kostki. Starszy domowy tester, miłośnik czekolad mlecznych z orzechami, po czekoladach z nadzieniami owocowymi (za którymi nie przepada) stwierdził, że nareszcie jakaś dobra czekolada z nadzieniem. Również nie umiał nazwać smaku, ale docenił, że \

.

Ta tabliczka zdecydowanie ma swój charakter. Jest to ciekawa i smakowita nowość, która może zasmakować wielu miłośnikom tabliczek nadziewanych. O atrakcyjności smaku niech świadczy to, że ostatnią kostkę (którą jem już w trakcie pisania recenzji) musiałam schować przed domowymi testerami.
Po tabliczkę sięgnąć mogą zarówno miłośnicy czekolad z nadzieniem słono-karmelowym, którzy będą szukali czegoś nowego ale w tym samym stylu, poszukiwacze nowości, jak i miłośnicy kultury japońskiej, których nie brakuje zarówno wśród moich rówieśników pokolenia X/Milenialsów jak i wśród młodszych, aż do Gen Z.

***
Pozdrowienia dla wszystkich Czekoladomaniaczek i Czekoladomaniaków!

___

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdbxuDtK1JbuyBUTwXLGNnPPwhKWxEPx8YHjhrSRUyLke/image)
Odwiedź jeden z frontendów: [hive.blog](hive.blog/created/polish), [peakd.com](https://peakd.com/created/polish), [ecency.com](ecency.com/created/polish) i poznaj innych twórców.
Chcesz wiedzieć więcej? Z polską społecznością porozmawiasz na [openhive.chat](openhive.chat) - kanał #polish.

title.title: SPS Governance Proposal - Establish Fee for DEC:SPS LP
title.body:
The purpose of this proposal is to suggest a reasonable fee for the new in-game SPS:DEC LP that is currently being created. The number that is being proposed is based around an assessment of current bridge and liquidity pool fees and aims to make the pool attractive to both liquidity providers and users. This fee should make conversions more cost effective to occur in-game as opposed to bridging tokens out, swapping and then bridging tokens back in to the game while also still offering decent incentives to liquidity providers to utilize and grow the pool.

The SPS DAO Treasurers also made the decision to close the DAO's LP position on Hive-Engine after their recent hack. This proposal aims to officially address reopening that position in the new in-game pool that is being created to ensure sufficient pool liquidity while also making the DAO's liquidity more accessible to the community.

## Proposal
If this proposal passes, the SPS DAO would like to set the fee for the upcoming in-game SPS:DEC liquidity pool at 0.5%.

The SPS:DAO will also move its tokens from Hive-Engine back into the game to migrate it's previous position from Hive-Engine into the new in-game liquidity pool and open a position with 25,000,000 SPS and an equivalent dollar amount of DEC at the time of opening the new position.

title.title: MLB: ¿Quien lo creería?  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
title.body: <div class= 'text-justify'>\n\n      Es muy difícil pronosticar en béisbol. Aquellos lectores consecuentes de éste blog, recordarán que en nuestra previa de la temporada los Cachorros de Chicago, eran nuestro principales favoritos para llevarse la división central de la liga Nacional. Pero estamos cerca de comenzar Junio y las cosas no se ven como escribimos. Es decir, todas las demás posiciones de la tabla se encuentran tal como las previmos, pero el primer lugar es de los Cerveceros de Milwaukee, con unos sorprendentes Cardenales de San Luis detrás. Y no es que los Cachorros se encuentren fuera de carrera. De hecho, ésta división se ha convertido en la mejor del béisbol porque todos sus equipos tienen balance ganador. Lo que ha hecho la diferencia ha sido el béisbol \

de los lupulosos y un par de novatos de San Luis que han tenido una temporada de ensueño hasta ahora. Además, Chicago se encuentra apenas a 2.5 juegos detrás de los dos mencionados, por lo tanto no se pueden descartar como aspirantes a un puesto en la postemporada. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Predicting baseball is a tough business. Regular readers of this blog will remember that in our season preview, we pegged the Chicago Cubs as our favorites to lock up the NL Central. But with June right around the corner, the standings aren’t matching our script. The rest of the division is shaking out exactly how we envisioned, but the Milwaukee Brewers are currently sitting in the catbird seat, with a surging St. Louis Cardinals squad breathing down their necks. It is not like the Cubs are completely out of the race. In fact, this division has turned into the ultimate dogfight, with every single team playing above .500 ball. The difference-maker has been the Brewers playing small ball with a Caribbean flair, alongside a pair of Cardinals rookies putting up video game numbers in their dream seasons. Plus, Chicago is sitting just 2.5 games back of the co-leaders, so you definitely can’t count them out as true postseason contenders.

# ---

![Contreras.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23xeZashKZVdhY6bbhSQibm8aFon2cp1RjKxq6UMiCibm5PHy52zjcF5axyftneA5iHTD.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/dodgers-vs-brewers/2026/05/22/823788/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Y uno de los motores que han impulsado la temporada de los muchachos del American Family Field, ha sido el receptor venezolano William Contreras, quien volvió a destacar en la victoria del viernes por la noche sobre la visita Dodgers de Los Ángeles, contra quienes comenzaron una serie que se empató anoche. Baja de la primera con dos compañeros en las bases. Una slider a 89 MPH iba cayendo a los tobillos de Contreras y el hombre sacó un swing de gradas desde abajo, para colocar la pelota en el segundo piso de las gradas, en el jardín derecho del estadio. Las tres impulsadas fueron suficientes en un marcador que culminó 5 carreras a 1 y con los Cerveceros más líderes que nunca, en su división. En cambio, los Dodgers se vieron propasados por San Diego en la vanguardia, ya que ambos se llevan apenas medio juego y anoche la vanguardia fue retomada por los esquivadores en el segundo de la serie, donde tomaron venganza. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      And one of the engines driving the season for the boys at American Family Field has been Venezuelan catcher William Contreras, who shined once again in Friday night’s victory over the visiting Los Angeles Dodgers, kicking off a series that got knotted up last night. Bottom of the first with two ducks on the pond, an 89 MPH slider was tracking right toward Contreras' ankles, but the man unleashed a golf swing from down low, launching a moonshot into the upper deck in right field. Those three RBIs were more than enough in a game that wrapped up 5 to 1, leaving the Brewers sitting prettier than ever at the top of their division. Meanwhile, the Dodgers had been leapfrogged by San Diego at the front of the pack since they are separated by a mere half-game, but the Boys in Blue reclaimed the top spot last night in the second game of the series, getting their revenge in a big way.

# ---

![Rojas.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/EokcgpvTNqFz3AB4LecUtepr6uri9xoSX8UmsE8WP6mTLVXWkytijhR9oJFsto8jFNm.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/dodgers-vs-brewers/2026/05/23/823787/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     ¿Y cómo fueron las cosas? Bien, los Dodgers y los Cerveceros se enfrascaron en un duelo cerrado, donde la emboscada fue preparada por los visitantes en los episodios 8 y 9, donde anotaron 4 y 3 rayitas respectivamente, poniendo en evidencia al agotado cuerpo de relevo de los locales. Dentro de la fiesta de batazos y carreras, destacó un toque inesperado de bola propuesto por el criollo Miguel Rojas con hombres en primera y tercera, ejecutado con maestría porque todo el mundo quedó quieto al finalizar la jugada de selección. Así las cosas, los esquivadores triunfaron por marcador de 11 carreras a 3 y como ya habíamos anotado, retomaron la vanguardia de la división. Mientras los Cerveceros a pesar de perder, mantuvieron ventaja de 2 juegos sobre San Luis, quien divisió cartelera de doble juego con los Rojos de Cincinnati (quienes, por cierto, recuperaron de la lista de lesionados a Eugenio \

Rojas) ¿Adonde llegarán los Cerveceros? Es imposible saberlo dentro de esa división tan competida, pero haber dividido con los Dodgers, es buena señal del momento por el que pasan. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     And, How did it all go down? Well, the Dodgers and the Brewers locked horns in a tight ballgame until the visitors staged a late-inning ambush in the 8th and 9th, hanging a 4-spot and a 3-spot respectively to completely expose the home team’s gassed bullpen. Right in the middle of that hit-parade, Venezuelan infielder Miguel Rojas turned heads with an unexpected bunt with runners on the corners, executing it to absolute perfection as everyone ended up safe on a fielder's choice. When the dust settled, the Boys in Blue cruised to an 11-3 victory and, as noted, jumped back into first place in their division. Meanwhile, despite taking the loss, the Brewers kept a 2-game cushion over St. Louis, who split a doubleheader with the Cincinnati Reds (who, by the way, just activated Eugenio \

Suárez from the IL). How far can these Brewers go? It is impossible to call it in such a dogfight of a division, but splitting a series with the powerhouse Dodgers is a great sign of the groove they are in right now.

---

![Peraza.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/244eTBJzW3uY9rjJhXipB2RZh1ZZTk7CgaLDJ7jx3gDpGohj4QPfEhir8QTqkTzW1hFNB.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/rangers-vs-angels/2026/05/23/824030/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Y el infielder criollo Oswald Peraza, no se detiene cuando ha de ayudar a la ofensiva de los Angelinos de Los Ángeles. Jugar contra los Rangers de Texas es toda una prueba de dominio, porque los tipos no se andan por las ramas cuando se sueltan a batear. Pero ayer los \

prevalecieron con una combinación de pitcheo y ofensiva, suficiente para ganar el juego por marcador de 5 carreras a 2. Y aunque los reflectores se los ha estado llevando Mike Trout (en salud y regresando como el histórico slugger que es), jamás se puede pasar por alto la línea de hit impulsora de 2 anotaciones, largada por Oswald en un momento crucial, para alejar un marcador cerrado de 3 a 2 en ese instante. Lástima que la increíble temporada de Trout no se vea reflejada en el lugar que ocupa el equipo angelino dentro de la fosa de la división oeste de la Americana. Mientras que los Rangers están de terceros a 1.5 juegos de los Atléticos. Volveremos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     And Venezuelan infielder Oswald Peraza just won't slow down when it comes to sparking the Los Angeles Angels' offense. Squaring off against the Texas Rangers is always a true litmus test because those guys don't mess around when they start swinging the lumber. But yesterday, the Halos prevailed with a solid combo of pitching and hitting, doing just enough to lock up a 5-2 victory. And while Mike Trout has been hogging the spotlight—healthy and back to being the historic slugger he's always been—you can never overlook the clutch, two-run single laced by Oswald at a crucial moment, breaking open what was a tight 3-2 ballgame. It's a shame Trout's incredible season isn't reflecting in the standings, with the Angels currently buried in the cellar of the AL West, while the Rangers sit in third place, just 1.5 games back of the Athletics. We'll be back.

#

title.title: Entre rocas y  viento
title.body:
by Hilaricita on Hilaricita 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/hilaricita [![Entre rocas y  viento](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/6b353194-2692-4336-bed9-583f81f278f7.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/r4TS8Z5Az5Lob3sgJXk1j5) 
 
 ![Versión español.png](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/hilaricita/0c2eef4b843038ffa91c5c76126870fbaa369559.png)

Domingo 24 de mayo, 2026

El frío muerde las mejillas, pero es un mordisco que se agradece cuando el cuerpo entra en calor tras los primeros giros. Para quien vive pegado a la nieve, el esquí no es solo bajar una montaña; es una conversación constante con la gravedad y la textura del terreno. Hay algo hipnótico en el sonido de los cantos cortando el hielo, un crujido seco que resuena en el silencio de la alta montaña, muy distinto al susurro suave cuando la nieve está polvo, esa sensación de flotar sobre nubes compactas que hace olvidar el peso de las botas y la rigidez de los fijaciones.

Curiosamente, la técnica de esquiar ha evolucionado tanto que lo que antes requería una fuerza bruta descomunal, hoy se logra con una precisión quirúrgica y un equilibrio dinámico. Las tablas actuales, con sus formas parabólicas, parecen tener voluntad propia, buscando la curva casi por instinto, aunque domarlas en terrenos irregulares o fuera de pista sigue exigiendo un respeto absoluto a la naturaleza. No es raro ver a veteranos del deporte adaptarse a nuevos materiales mientras los jóvenes aprenden a leer la montaña no solo con los ojos, sino sintiendo las vibraciones bajo las suelas.

Existe una mitología alrededor de los lugares legendarios, esas laderas empinadas que aparecen en postales y películas, pero la realidad suele ser más sucia y auténtica: horas esperando telesillas congelados, gafas empañadas por el esfuerzo y la satisfacción silenciosa de completar una línea limpia. La comunidad es peculiar; une a personas de orígenes dispares bajo un código no escrito de prioridad en la pista y ayuda mutua si alguien cae. Además, hay detalles que solo quienes pasan temporadas enteras en la nieve notan, como cómo cambia la luz a última hora de la tarde, tiñendo todo de azul y violeta, momento conocido como la \

, donde la visibilidad juega trucos mentales y cada bulto puede parecer una roca o una simple sombra.

La física del movimiento es engañosa. Parece sencillo deslizarse, pero mantener la velocidad controlada mientras se negocian cambios de pendiente repentinos requiere una coordinación neuromuscular fina. El viento no es solo aire moviéndose; es un muro invisible que puede frenar o acelerar inesperadamente, obligando a ajustar la postura centímetro a centímetro. Y aunque la tecnología ha hecho el equipo más ligero y resistente, el factor humano sigue siendo el variable más impredecible. El miedo, gestionado correctamente, es una herramienta tan útil como los bastones; mantiene los sentidos agudos y la concentración al máximo. Cada descenso es único, nunca se repite exactamente igual, porque la nieve cambia, la luz cambia y uno mismo cambia con cada giro.

Las botas son el primer punto de contacto y, a menudo, la mayor fuente de frustración para quien se inicia. Rígidas, incómodas al principio, actúan como la extensión directa de la pierna, transmitiendo cada microajuste hacia la tabla. Un ajuste milimétrico en la hebilla puede significar la diferencia entre un giro preciso y una pérdida de control total. Con el tiempo, el plástico cede ligeramente y se moldea al pie, creando una simbiosis necesaria para sentir la nieve. Sin esa conexión firme, el resto del equipo pierde eficacia, por muy avanzado que sea.

Las tablas han dejado de ser aquellas piezas rectas y largas de antaño. Hoy, la geometría es clave: la punta ancha facilita el inicio del giro, la cintura estrecha bajo la bota permite cambiar de dirección con agilidad y la cola estabiliza la salida. El radio de giro determina si la tabla prefiere curvas cortas y nerviosas o largos arcos amplios y fluidos. En nieve polvo, el volumen extra en la punta evita que la tabla se hunda, permitiendo ese planeo característico que parece desafiar la gravedad. En hielo, sin embargo, se prioriza la rigidez torsional para que los cantos metálicos muerdan con fuerza y no resbalen.

Los bastones, a menudo subestimados, no sirven solo para impulsarse en llano. Su función principal es marcar el ritmo y equilibrar el cuerpo durante la transición de un giro a otro. Un toque ligero y preciso del bastón en la nieve ayuda a iniciar la rotación de las caderas y hombros, coordinando la parte superior del cuerpo con el movimiento de las piernas. La longitud debe ser adecuada; demasiado largos entorpecen, demasiado cortos obligan a encorvarse.

La ropa técnica ha evolucionado hacia capas inteligentes. La primera piel absorbe el sudor, evitando que el cuerpo se enfríe al detenerse. La capa intermedia aísla térmicamente, mientras que la exterior protege del viento y la humedad sin sacrificar la transpirabilidad. Las gafas, con lentes intercambiables según la luminosidad, son vitales para proteger la vista y mejorar el contraste, permitiendo leer las irregularidades del terreno que a simple vista pasarían desapercibidas. El casco, hoy indiscutible, integra a menudo sistemas de comunicación y protección auditiva, esencial para mantener la conciencia espacial en entornos ruidosos o con poca visibilidad. Todo este conjunto debe funcionar como un único organismo, donde el fallo de un elemento compromete la experiencia completa. La mantenimiento también cuenta; encerar las tablas no es estética, es reducir la fricción y proteger la estructura base de la abrasión constante contra el hielo y la nieve dura.

El cuerpo responde a la montaña con una transformación silenciosa pero profunda. Las piernas se fortalecen de manera desigual, adaptándose a las torsiones constantes y a los impactos absorbidos en cada bajada. El equilibrio deja de ser un concepto teórico para convertirse en un reflejo visceral, una respuesta automática ante cambios bruscos de pendiente o superficie. La capacidad pulmonar aumenta sin esfuerzo consciente, obligada a trabajar en la altitud donde el aire es más fino y exigente. Pero más allá de lo físico, la mente encuentra un espacio de claridad inusual; la concentración absoluta que requiere descender una pista empinada desplaza las preocupaciones cotidianas, creando una especie de meditación en movimiento donde solo existe el presente, el siguiente giro, la siguiente lectura del terreno.

Sin embargo, la montaña no concede favores y recuerda constantemente su dominio. Una distracción breve, un cambio repentino en la nieve o un encuentro inesperado con otro usuario de la pista pueden convertir la diversión en peligro en un instante. Las rodillas son particularmente vulnerables, sometidas a fuerzas rotacionales que a veces superan lo que los ligamentos pueden soportar. Las caídas a alta velocidad no perdonan, y aunque el equipo de protección ha avanzado, el casco no evita todo ni el chaleco detiene cada impacto. El frío extremo puede adormecer la sensibilidad, retrasando las reacciones, mientras que la fatiga acumulada hacia el final de la jornada nubla el juicio justo cuando más se necesita precisión.

Existe también un riesgo menos visible pero igualmente real: la exposición prolongada al sol en altura, donde la radiación ultravioleta se intensifica y la nieve refleja hasta el ochenta por ciento de la luz. Las quemaduras solares y la deshidratación son enemigos silenciosos que actúan sin aviso. En zonas fuera de pista, el peligro se multiplica; una capa de nieve aparentemente estable puede ocultar grietas, rocas afiladas o, peor aún, condiciones propicias para desprendimientos. La avalancha no avisa, no negocia, y quien se aventura en terreno no controlado debe llevar consigo no solo el conocimiento para leer el manto nivoso, sino también el equipo de rescate y, fundamentalmente, la humildad para dar media vuelta cuando las señales no son favorables.

A pesar de todo, quienes conocen este mundo saben que el riesgo gestionado forma parte del atractivo. No se trata de buscar el peligro, sino de respetarlo lo suficiente como para prepararse, de entender que la recompensa —esa sensación de libertad absoluta al conectar con el entorno natural— vale la pena cuando se aborda con consciencia y preparación. El cuerpo sale cansado, a veces con pequeños dolores, pero también renovado, como si la nieve hubiera limpiado no solo las tablas, sino también el espíritu. La clave está en escuchar al propio límite, en reconocer cuándo la fatiga empieza a ganar terreno a la técnica, y en tener la sabiduría de parar antes de que la montaña decida por uno.

Como ya casi se acaba el número de caracteres de la caja de información, les dejo con la canción que le pedí a SUNO, esperando que esta publicación les haya servido, no solo como entretenimiento, sino que les haya aportado un poco, una chispa de contenido que genera valor.

🎵 🎶 🎶 🎶 🎵 🎼 🎼 ♬ ♫ ♪ ♩

Esta fue una canción e información útil de domingo.

Gracias por pasarse a leer y escuchar un rato, amigas, amigos, amigues de BlurtMedia.

Que tengan un excelente día y que Dios los bendiga grandemente.

Saludines, camaradas \

Hi there lovely and creative people of Hive World,
Hope you all are fine and having a nice day

For drawing, I use Pencil, rubber, paper, black pointer, pencil colors, etc.
I used **Adobe Photoshop 2020** for joining those separate parts and than for making GIF by frames.

<center>![footer.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shrazi/j5LvgRgb-footer.png)</center>

### Wokring Steps :

#### Steps for drawing :
As I have a theme in my mind, I start drawing a cow in pieces. A front view of it. Face, legs separately, ear, eyes, etc.
Than I drew a kid character in pieces.

<center>![s1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shrazi/Eo6MpkTXkAHUy6mK3KPDAQsHGuC4YyXvhf7vnNz6H8aogPAjQjEoYSqqgDy76MPa89Z.jpg)</center>

Its all what I did on paper, you can check the first selfie image as Final drawing piece.

#### Steps for joining pieces :
Its time to join those pieces
First I made separate layer for every part.
Than I copy and mirror few of objects like, ear, eyes, hands, arms, legs, etc.
Than I put those parts on its right positions

<center>![j1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shrazi/23vi8AzyxRZ1dbYf8ZSCPzQypQKZ7F8fFSbSzccNS9xvxqypHnnUEnR1YQdFp3HZpdWaS.jpg)</center>
You can check the 2nd image of this blog as final piece after joining those pieces.


#### Steps for making GIF :
For making a GIF of it, I move/rotate both characters legs and move their body parts to make them walk

<center>![g1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shrazi/Epvnnudx7LZABtdSTwZNoedtMCDG3fHiet5UheYTHbHZutnbrTvyUjgEDpqAeiKghAa.jpg)</center>
Yes, there only two frames in this GIF. Its already 10:11 PM here. Let me try few more frames.
Yes, I add few close-up frames to it and you can check the 3rd and 4th images of this blog to see final piece of GIF.

Hope you guys enjoyed the GIF and my working steps as well.
Take care and have a wonderful week!

title.title: 5 años en Hive 🐝🌻🎂🙏 Esp-Eng
title.body: > ![GridArt_20260524_133550023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cirangela/Eoc5fPrU9EF3zTEEBvB4P9AAa72oHTZr1UBvMS3ja1zLtj9Yd9YxMUcGmoJLcdkkLBR.jpg) Feliz día para todos... El mes pasado cumplí 5 años en Hive, la verdad han sido años de una nueva experiencia virtual, aún desconozco muchos detalles de esta plataforma pero cada día intento aprender un poco más. Ahora bien después de tanto tiempo aprovecho nuevamente para presentarme soy Cirangela de Santa Rita estado Zulia, maestra de corazón y alma, artesana, amante de la escritura creativa de la lectura y fanática de las películas de amigos enamorados, navidad y Disney siendo mi favorita la bella y la bestia. Amo el café y también con leche, el chocolate, la vida natural y sencilla, soy mamá de un tripack maravilloso, esposa de un caballero noble, soy signo cáncer, con un carácter fuerte, intuitiva y créanme nunca falló, amo y cuido a mis seres amados esos que habitan en mi corazón, soy amiga leal y fiel aún cuando la distancia sea parte de esa amistad. ![GridArt_20260524_133336418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cirangela/48Ghz1VGgkh4uXQGzQE8NPg7hGrLhWMwRGQdN5YfwqmwzhEe1JVcuPuhApE2QENkNt.jpg) Me gusta caminar, los atardeceres, las rosas y flores, las cartas de amor, los peluches y la música romántica y bueno soy generación 1980, mi frase favorita de un libro que me encanta: **lo esencial es invisible a los ojos** del principito. Ser parte de hive, ser una abejita más de esta colmena sin duda es un privilegio, a través de mi hijo @hectorfaria1 y su hermosa novia @andreaag21, conocí está plataforma y créanme no solo a sido una ayuda en lo económico, sino también una terapia mental para mí vida. Conocer personas a través de este blog, vivenciar a través de la fotografía, sus experiencias me ha conectado con otros lugares y personas maravillosas que quisiera conocer alguna vez y tomar un delicioso café como @amigoponc, @actioncats, @annafenix, @yenmendt me parecen personas agradables, así como otros usuarios de comunidades como zona de escalofríos, cinnamon cup café, hive arte y motherhood, así como otras comunidades donde escribo incluyendo lifestyle. ![GridArt_20260524_133140546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cirangela/48jiQQEJkZpKqaGXx4GU6YSNAnbw1EwTzgFeH7ohbK9yQSX4E81uTptJfmxtrYANzU.jpg) Hive es parte de mi vida, es compartir mis vivencias y que otros aún sin conocerme las puedan disfrutar, como saben amo las manualidades de reciclaje creativo, las historias de terror, las historias románticas, cocinar en casa y ser mamá. Actualmente vivo en mi soñada casa del lago y me siento agradecida por todo lo que fluye en mi vida, por estar escribiendo esta publicación, recordando que nada llega a mi vida por casualidad, todo tiene un propósito y Hive es uno de ellos. Quiero seguir escribiendo, perfeccionando mi blog, creciendo para poder compartir mis días, vivencias y aventuras con todos ustedes, me siguen 291 personas gracias por eso, soy así soy simplemente Cirangela y estoy aquí no solo para escribir sino también para leer lo que ustedes nos comparten cada día... ![GridArt_20260524_133249888.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cirangela/48Y9k9G1bvd5WidznW5g7rvcTCGaDAnXRr5YLTgtEEjhnpcmzzdk3CZRgnbWjGeoGZ.jpg) Feliz cumpleaños 5 para mí... 🎂 🍒🌻🐝 > ! [English] > # 5 years at Hive 🐝 >Happy day to everyone... > >Last month marked my 5th anniversary at Hive. To be honest, these have been years of a new virtual experience; I still don’t know many of the platform’s ins and outs, but every day I try to learn a little more. > >Now, after all this time, I’d like to take this opportunity to introduce myself again. I’m Cirangela from Santa Rita, Zulia state—a teacher through and through, a craftswoman, a lover of creative writing and reading, and a fan of movies about friends in love, Christmas, and Disney, with *Beauty and the Beast* being my favorite. > >I love coffee—with milk, too—chocolate, and a natural, simple life. I’m the mom of a wonderful trio of kids, the wife of a noble gentleman, and a Cancer with a strong, intuitive personality—and believe me, it’s never failed me. I love and care for my loved ones, those who live in my heart, and I’m a loyal and faithful friend, even when distance is part of that friendship. > >I enjoy walking, sunsets, roses and flowers, love letters, stuffed animals, and romantic music. And well, I’m from the ’80s generation. My favorite quote from a book I love: **“What is essential is invisible to the eye”** from *The Little Prince*. > >Being part of Hive, being just another little bee in this hive, is undoubtedly a privilege. Through my son @hectorfaria1 and his beautiful girlfriend @andreaag21, I discovered this platform, and believe me, it has not only been a financial help but also a form of mental therapy for my life. > >Meeting people through this blog and experiencing their stories through photography has connected me with other wonderful places and people I’d love to meet someday and share a delicious cup of coffee with—like @amigoponc, @actioncats, @annafenix, and @yenmendt, who seem like such nice people—as well as other users from communities like Zona de Escalofríos, Cinnamon Cup Café, Hive Arte, and Motherhood, as well as other communities where I write, including Lifestyle. > >Hive is part of my life; it’s about sharing my experiences so that others, even those who don’t know me, can enjoy them. As you know, I love creative upcycling crafts, horror stories, romantic stories, cooking at home, and being a mom. > >I currently live in my dream lake house and feel grateful for everything that flows into my life, for being able to write this post, remembering that nothing comes into my life by chance—everything has a purpose, and Hive is one of them. > >I want to keep writing, perfecting my blog, and growing so I can share my days, experiences, and adventures with all of you. I have 291 followers—thank you for that. This is who I am; I’m simply Cirangela, and I’m here not only to write but also to read what you all share with us every day... > >Happy 5th birthday to me... 🎂 🍒🌻🐝 Photographs of my authorship taken with my Samsung A10 camera phone. [Traductor](https://www.deepl.com/translator)

title.title: International Business: Competing in the Global Marketplace
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779644503901-ae8b4b8cd4e07237.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=jza/2d90c7b3)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=jza/2d90c7b3)


---

The source provided is the eighth edition of the textbook \

by Charles W.L. Hill. This comprehensive text is designed to explain how and why countries differ, review the economics and politics of international trade and investment, explain the global monetary system, and evaluate the various functions of an international business.
Based on the table of contents and excerpts, here are the key areas covered by the sources:

    Globalization: The sources discuss the increasing interdependence of the world economy and the impact of technology, such as the internet, on global trade.
    National Differences: It explores differences in political, economic, and legal systems, as well as the profound impact of cultural differences (values, norms, social structure, and religion) on business practices.
    Global Trade and Investment: The textbook details theories of international trade (like absolute advantage and the product life cycle) and the role of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in the world economy.
    The Global Monetary System: It explains the functions of the foreign exchange market, exchange rate determination, and the history and role of the International Monetary System, including the IMF and the World Bank.
    Strategy and Structure: The sources analyze how international businesses can increase profitability through various strategies (global standardization, localization, transnational, and international) and how they should organize their global operations.
    International Business Operations: It covers the technical aspects of exporting and importing, global production and supply chain management, global marketing and R&D, human resource management, and international accounting and finance.

Please let me know if you would like to explore any of these specific topics or if you have questions about the cases mentioned in the text, such as those involving General Electric, McDonald's, or IKEA.

---

Thanks for checking in on the delegation program. Unfortunately, we had to sunset it following the Hive-Engine exploit and the loss of the Solana bridge, which we relied on to bring external profits into the Hive ecosystem.

Additionally, HIVE's current tokenomics (specifically inflation and DHF spending) make it difficult to justify buying and holding more HIVE right now, as the price depreciation counteracts the benefits of added delegation.

We’re using this period to hunker down and refocus. The good news is that we are still 100% building for HIVE—we’re just changing the playbook. Instead of a delegator-first model, we’re pivoting toward a HELIOS burn economy to create value. We appreciate your support as we make this transition!

 A rooster always boasted that he was very strong. He thought that there was no one braver than him in the world. One day, to prove his strength, he decided to fight an eagle. The rooster stood in front of the eagle with great confidence. But the eagle was the king of the sky, much stronger and more experienced. Within a few moments of the fight, the eagle easily defeated the rooster. Then the rooster realized that pride blinds people. If you boast too much about your power, you will eventually be humiliated. After this incident, the rooster realized his mistake and never boasted again. From this story, we learn that you should be humble instead of proud. Because a truly strong person never brags about his strength.

title.title: Cangrejos en Zona Costera/Crabs in the Coastal Zone
title.body:
Vivo en una zona de playa. Hay tres sucesos que desde niño me han impresionado:

*​El primero sucede en el mes de marzo, cuando millones de cangrejos rojos hembras bajan a la costa a lo que llaman desovar. Lamentablemente, muchas no escapan al impacto humano y son cazadas para extraer su hueva, la cual tiene un sabor a marisco muy fuerte y exquisito.

*​El segundo suceso ocurre a mediados de abril y mayo. En esta época, salen del mar impulsados por las olas millones de diminutos cangrejitos que colman las carreteras y las paredes de las casas.

*​El tercero llega a mediados de mayo y junio, cuando con el comienzo de las lluvias salen los cangrejos azules. Estos sí son comestibles, por lo que aparecen también en manadas cazadores de muchos lugares. En el patio de mi casa es muy común verlos, así que ni siquiera tengo que salir a cazar.
​Aquí les comparto la foto de una pareja (macho y hembra) que encontré hace unos días y que, por cierto, no perdieron el tiempo para aparearse.

‐-------------------------------

​I live in a beach area. There are three events that have fascinated me since I was a child:

*​The first one happens in March, when millions of female red crabs come down to the coast to spawn. Unfortunately, many cannot escape human impact and are hunted to extract their roe, which has a very strong and exquisite seafood flavor.

*​The second event occurs around mid-April and May. Driven by the waves, millions of tiny baby crabs emerge from the sea, completely covering roads and house walls.

*​The third one arrives by mid-May and June, when the rainy season begins and the blue crabs come out. These are edible, so groups of crab hunters appear from many different places. It is very common to see them right in my backyard, so I don't even have to leave the house to hunt.
​Here is a photo of a pair (male and female) that I found a few days ago; they certainly didn't waste any time to mate.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme9dbscL7Tu6Uyh5TzUS19wENspJDbpJ81juT5hT7JXug/1779643905349.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaS3e7iu7JBS3cSNUddHQndu29h6AtJ2CxSgehUri1CoE/1779643905494.jpg)

title.title: Brígido Iriarte Stadium: a sports venue steeped in history
title.body:
**Brígido Iriarte Stadium**


![Post Facebook descuentos por Halloween promocional fotográfico violeta y morado oscuro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/starwarm/23wCBsDtKKh3UYDZxFi1BQKkQhgE67mpcFNJYKvp1PSGNg1YpSLfn4L6vpbeWFmsnRS4s.png)


With a rich history, soccer, and many stories, the Brigido Iriarte Stadium is an iconic sports complex in the city of Caracas, located in the southwestern part of Venezuela’s capital. The stadium is situated in the El Paraíso parish, across from the National Olympic Committee. It is a stadium built to international standards that has hosted matches for our country’s national soccer team, as well as youth track and field events. With a capacity of 10,000 people (according to Wikipedia), it also features a high-quality, well-maintained track and field facility.


---

## SPANISH VERSION

Historia, fútbol y anécdotas de este lugar muchas, el estadio Brigido Iriarte es un complejo deportivo emblemático de la ciudad de Caracas, ubicado en la parte sur oeste de la capital de Venezuela, dicho estadio se encuentra en la parroquia El Paraíso diagonal al Comité Olímpico Nacional, un estadio con las medidas internacional el cual ha albergado partidos de la selección absoluta de fútbol de nuestro país además de también albergar y ser sede de juegos juveniles de atletismo, con una capacidad de 10.000 personas (según Wikipedia) cuenta además con una pista de atletismo de alto nivel con muy buen cuidado.



![20260523_132539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/starwarm/EoEr2WXq5kLgqu7wEdaEEVzyrrb5ZzparPbnJs3yjXeY3NiTqg45sXAzE7mq4Gehfd5.jpg)
![20260523_133456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/starwarm/23wqdoiGeWwiKPvXcSNcMTUSJPyzUB75rDuPhwbDHNvWF3swMp28JNUYNG5U95xzvoy2w.jpg)

The reason for our visit to the stadium was none other than the fact that two of the players on the team I represent—Unión Atlética Vinotinto—Paulina Tartaglia and Dariana Mendoza, had been selected to play for the Capital City’s U18 team in a match against the U18 team from Miranda State. So, a group of us—players and representatives from the UAV Academy—got together to support our girls.

---
## SPANISH VERSION
El motivo de nuestra visita al estadio fue nada más y nada menos que por el hecho de que dos de mis chicas del equipo al cual represento la Unión Atlética Vinotinto, tanto Paulina Tartaglia como Dariana Mendoza estaban convocadas a representar a la selección sub18 de la ciudad Capital en un encuentro vs su similar de la selección sub18 del Estado Miranda para ello nos reunimos un grupo de chicos y representantes de la Academia UAV para apoyar a nuestras chicas.


![20260523_134507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/starwarm/23u637V7im1Sb1pUWgvNfButx3fkeWxgAaWMZstmANFBUfFjioEhPwDGie2nAChH143z8.jpg)

Although it was a somewhat gloomy day with occasional rain, the game went off without a hitch, ending in a 6-0 victory for our girls from the Capital District team. Our two players delivered standout performances: Dariana contributed two assists and played great defense, while Paulina dazzled with her technical skill. The atmosphere was peaceful, the stands were quiet, and to top it off, my wife and my daughter—who is Paulina’s #1 fan—arrived at halftime.


---
## SPANISH VERSION
A pesar de que fue un día un tanto oscuro y con una cierta lluvia intermitente el juego se dio sin mayores contratiempos quedando un resultado a favor de 6 a 0 a favor de nuestras chicas de nuestra selección de Distrito Capital teniendo así una actuación destacada nuestras dos chicas, dos asistencias y un gran juego defensivo de parte de Dariana y deslumbres de calidad técnica de parte de Paulina, un ambiente en paz, las gradas tranquilas y para completar a mitad de juego llegó mi esposa y mi niña que es la fan #1 de Paulina.


![20260523_152107.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/starwarm/23w2sW6ytopfiytYGjKWpREBA66JcjNFexABCQjPTpECKRtsBDY8GmivZ6JMzDiVMyBTf.jpg)

![20260523_153146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/starwarm/245Hm1wGTKP1ZeUKjbBzJxq53UFuGeWHzMc7z9yqtxcPnGUJPS9AWg3LzqWHhfYdqPE9H.jpg)



![20260523_134238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/starwarm/245cYGFoXfX3jmMcH75R4xw1naTt3NpEckbS1KMsM3Rf43EpieDkxsMUdzYEcYSCZv4Nb.jpg)


After the game ended, the men’s U-18 team was also scheduled to play, but my daughter was hungry and I hadn’t had lunch either, so we decided to say goodbye to Paulina and the rest of the kids at the Academy. Then my wife, my daughter, and I went out to eat and headed home after a day of sports at one of the country’s historic sporting landmarks: the Brigido Iriarte Stadium. 

---
## SPANISH VERSION
Luego de finalizado el encuentro también jugaría la selección sub18 masculina, pero bueno mi niña tenía hambre y de mi parte tampoco había almorzado así que decidimos despedirnos de Paulina y del resto de chicos de la Academia para luego salir con mi esposa y mi niña a comer y con ello regresarnos a casa, luego de un día deportivo en unos de los templos deportivos e historicos del país. El Brigido Iriarte.

title.title: The Receipt Prophecies — Fiction.
title.body:
Our receipt machine at Spendless supermarket is a complete joke, like, it won't stop misbehaving. And the funniest and most amazing part is that it acts differently based on who's on shift.



![1001065541.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xKrZMFAiAiPMsw1imJeeeax7m8hkUvfoYgZPcT43LWbZGWRGoS7DPSKAXGBRYERPGsb.png)




Like, I'm sure it's possessed, and we won't stop making fun of it. There are times you find it printing out the same receipt twice; sometimes it brings out receipts with nothing written on them, and other times you see it dragging out long paper receipts as if... it's tiring.



So, I've been working there for some weeks, and I just got posted to the accounting department. I am now a cashier and was to take the evening shifts. So, I'd hear about the happenings in the cashier stand and all.



My shift started on a weekend, and I can't wait to see what the receipts for that evening will be like. The first woman who wanted to get something came; she paid in cash. Another person came; she did the same, and that was how it kept happening. I almost thought no one would make a transfer or pay with their ATM. Because at the supermarket where I work, we only print receipts for those that transfer or pay with their ATM; those that pay in cash are usually directed to somewhere else to collect a written receipt. 



Then this woman came when I thought I wouldn't see the magic; she bought milk, custard, and cheese balls. Then she paid with her ATM; immediately her receipt came out. It was the normal size, it was well written, not faded, and it was all good. I was about to hand her the receipt when I noticed a caption written at the bottom part of it. It reads, *\

* She replied, smiled, and walked away.





About an hour later, we heard that a house caught fire a few minutes walk from our supermarket. Later I got to know it was that same house the woman who came to get milk and custard was staying in...





Immediately, I remembered, *\

* and this woman had gone to a friend's place. I almost overthink it, but then I brushed it off and concluded it was just a coincidence.



Until Monday, which happens to be my next working day, I was on a permanent night/evening shift, and I'm happy since it allows me to do another job during the day.


The first customer that came by happened to be an elderly man. Maybe around his 80s, he looked so weak and tired. Obviously, he's going through a lot, and I can't help but wonder how such an old man will be running errands on his own...


He bought a few things and paid with his ATM. The receipt came out normally as well. I looked at it as if looking for something, and then I saw it at the top: the space that was supposed to contain the name of our supermarket has something else written there...

*\

*


I looked at him, he looked at me, then I handed him the receipt, and he went his way.


On my way home that night, I saw the man looking happy. I didn't even know he was the one staying at that particular house. It always looks as if nobody lives there. I just walked past, and then I overheard how some of his neighbors were discussing that his son, who traveled years ago, just called him today to check in on him and beg him, and he told him he's traveling over the following day to take him abroad.



This is not funny anymore, I thought to myself. I can't even say or describe how I was feeling—more like I'm scared.


I wished I could stop working at the supermarket because every customer's receipt carries something...a message. To an extent, I was the one asking and begging customers to pay in cash. Because receipts...huhm.


*\

*

Do this, do that,... and a lot more were the various inscriptions on the receipts. And while some noticed it and laughed it off, some paid attention to it, and some didn't even check before trashing it. But then, before the end of the day, something always happened that was connected to the inscriptions on each receipt. And I couldn't even tell anybody.












One evening, there was a heavy rainfall, and we were already preparing to calculate and balance the day's sales when this young man rushed in. He grabbed a bottle of energy drinks, two biscuits, and two noodles.




![1001065540.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23u5vRSng5sgMS7kLiZMkPRe6hUTnodtnH4DAp5SkBSqeSqijf9zhBeNfis22PnTebMGF.png)




He came over to my stand and handed me his ATM. I was rushing because I wanted to finish up my calculations on time and find my way home. Immediately his receipts came out, and I was about to hand them to him together with his ATM card when I saw something....

It read, *\

*

I didn't fully understand, but I withdrew my hands.

*\

* The young man said.

I was just staring at him, couldn't say anything.

*\

* He added when I didn't respond. 


*\

he said, sounding angry and irritated.


Without thinking twice, I held his hand down over the counter, and for a few seconds we just stared at each other. I didn't know what I was actually doing, and I'm sure he was also surprised at my action.


Suddenly, we heard a loud and deafening sound outside. People were shouting and screaming, and we all ran to the entrance of the supermarket gate.




Immediately we stepped outside the door, we knew what happened wasn't small at all. A petrol tanker had lost control and had run into other vehicles, and that was how the accident happened. Smoke and fire filled everywhere. The whole road was a mess...



The young man I had held down was right next to me. He looked at the scene of the accident, scanned the whole road, and directed his gaze back at me.



*\

* he asked with his lips trembling.


I couldn't even answer; I was just shaking all over. I quickly rushed back in to make a phone call to the fire service station. Immediately after I hung up the call, the receipt machine made a sound and printed a slip out by itself. That was really unlike it.



I went near, picked it up, and guess who this new message is for... Me.



*\

*

title.title: Precious Gems After the Rain
title.body:
It has been raining almost every day lately, and honestly, it is something I still haven’t fully adjusted to. There are moments when it feels a bit frustrating, especially when I want to go outside for a walk or take photos under better lighting. The weather has its own plans, and sometimes all I can do is wait. But of course, my positive mindset still prevails. Instead of focusing too much on the inconvenience, I try to find something enjoyable from it. One of the best ways for me to do that is through photography. These photos were taken after the rain, when the flowers and leaves were still covered with droplets. In black and white, the scene looked even more dramatic. The drops of water resting on the petals looked like tiny precious gems. They gave the flowers a different kind of beauty, something softer and more peaceful. Rain can make everything wet and messy, and sometimes it can be annoying. But when I look at how the plants and trees are benefiting from it, I don’t really want to complain too much. The rain may interrupt our plans, but for nature, it brings life. It refreshes the leaves, feeds the roots, and makes everything look alive again. That is something I want to remember in life as well. Not every situation will be comfortable for us, but sometimes the same thing that feels inconvenient may be helping something else grow. It is all about how we look at it. For me, photography helps me see the beauty behind these small moments. Even after days of rain, there is still something worth appreciating. content.description:
Hi Threespeak Friends.

At present, the temperature in our city is 45 degrees Celsius and even in this heat, the laborers are working and the shopkeepers are sitting in their shops waiting for customers. This is a fact of the world that every person has to work very hard to earn money. No one can earn money without hard work. Now here we are also seeing that even in the very hot heat, people have not stopped working, but the salary is so low that no one will work in any other country for such a low salary. 

Hola, amigos de Threespeak.

Actualmente, la temperatura en nuestra ciudad es de 45 grados Celsius, e incluso con este calor, los obreros siguen trabajando y los comerciantes esperan en sus tiendas a los clientes. Es un hecho que todos tenemos que trabajar muy duro para ganar dinero. Nadie puede ganar dinero sin esfuerzo. Aquí también vemos que, incluso con este calor sofocante, la gente no ha dejado de trabajar, pero el salario es tan bajo que nadie trabajaría en ningún otro país por un sueldo tan bajo.

![PhotoCollage_1779623155066.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQdku1hLiDh8CCry6ypTNEM46GKbz337wKEMVgdPsose3/PhotoCollage_1779623155066.jpg)

Here we tried one of their different types of cups and a few other things. First of all, we took permission from them to explore this place. After getting permission, we made all these videos and pictures here for you guys so that we can tell you how our experience here was. Here they had also made a place to sit because some people like to sit there and eat and some people like to take it home, 

Aquí probamos uno de sus diferentes tipos de tazas y algunas otras cosas. Primero, les pedimos permiso para explorar el lugar. Después de obtener el permiso, grabamos todos estos videos y tomamos fotos para compartir con ustedes nuestra experiencia. También tenían mesas para sentarse, ya que a algunas personas les gusta comer allí y otras prefieren llevarse la comida a casa.

So they had made every kind of arrangement on their part so that the customer does not have any problem and here again we were seeing that they had every quality product, good quality product and every kind of variety was there, there were cupcakes, cockies, biscuits and all the other things that come in sweets and their prices were not that high so every person can afford it here. 

Así que se aseguraron de que los clientes no tuvieran ningún problema. Además, vimos que tenían productos de excelente calidad y una gran variedad: cupcakes, croissants, galletas y todo tipo de dulces. Los precios eran accesibles para todos.

Here we see that when any business becomes successful, its prices are increased a lot and a poor person cannot buy anything from this shop. Everyone must have seen this happening in their life. It's all about quality. They made all their products in good quality. And the good thing is that they are making and selling everything themselves. There are many ways to do business. 

Aquí vemos que cuando un negocio tiene éxito, sus precios suben mucho y una persona pobre no puede comprar nada. Todos hemos visto esto alguna vez. Todo se trata de calidad. Todos sus productos son de excelente calidad. Y lo mejor es que los elaboran y venden ellos mismos. Hay muchas maneras de hacer negocios.

![IMG_20260524_000721.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc6xXkXJWyqNp4VzVH92eMXyrkGHzS12awFdQFW22enky/IMG_20260524_000721.jpg)

![IMG_20260524_000734.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdatdkeVtyRHD9okvEVXUHdPwVSSFGoq33aD1esKeBsZ4/IMG_20260524_000734.jpg)

![IMG_20260524_000746.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeSsCSJ2wtPNYFK3Gpw1av9A6RpxEb5USX7mxLKTg8ujm/IMG_20260524_000746.jpg)

![IMG_20260524_000756.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZuX23kd1bEFoGfCB12WbfC7BDQRd1jYK8CtLVrc7JY4t/IMG_20260524_000756.jpg)

![IMG_20260524_001024.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbnVeDiVaNydx26QhLBQGm5zhecVE8byJccunRsmr7UzU/IMG_20260524_001024.jpg)

![IMG_20260524_001103.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXnuRbisGsC6SsscNVr7CsgF5TwPvUb9pZc7U4TjdtbKy/IMG_20260524_001103.jpg)

There are some people who buy things from outside and sell them, and there are some who work hard and make them themselves and then sell them. So, making and selling things yourself is much more profitable. So that's why it's better that all the people who are working hard should create their own products so that people can have more trust in them and then they can start having more customers. 

Hay quienes compran productos y los revenden, y quienes trabajan duro, los fabrican ellos mismos y luego los venden. Por lo tanto, fabricar y vender productos propios es mucho más rentable. Por eso, es mejor que quienes trabajan duro creen sus propios productos para que la gente confíe más en ellos y así puedan atraer más clientes.

Competition is becoming quite high in every city at this time because when there used to be one shop in a place and now there are 10 shops in the same place, only the person who has good quality products and low prices will be able to succeed. It is the most sensible thing to provide good products for less money. If this does not happen, then we will see that with time that shop will start to disappear and people will stop going to it because earlier people did not have so many options. 

La competencia es muy alta en todas las ciudades actualmente, porque donde antes había una sola tienda, ahora hay diez en el mismo lugar. Solo quien ofrece productos de buena calidad a precios bajos podrá tener éxito. Lo más sensato es ofrecer buenos productos a precios bajos. Si esto no sucede, con el tiempo veremos que esas tiendas van desapareciendo y la gente deja de ir, porque antes no había tantas opciones.

Now every person has enough restaurant options that they can go anywhere and order and enjoy the food of their choice. I really like their quality and each of their products and some people from my city see my store, so I will send their link here and send the location of this place, so definitely visit it once. 

Ahora, todo el mundo tiene una gran variedad de restaurantes donde puede ir a cualquier sitio, pedir y disfrutar de la comida que prefiera.  Me gusta mucho la calidad de sus productos y algunas personas de mi ciudad ven mi tienda, así que les enviaré el enlace y la ubicación para que la visiten.

Here we will talk a little about the crypto market, as we do in every post. The market seemed to be going down as soon as it broke 80,000, but it has started going down again. And one good news is that a deal is going to be made between China and Iran today or tomorrow, and when the war is completely over, 

Aquí hablaremos un poco sobre el mercado de criptomonedas, como hacemos en cada publicación. El mercado parecía ir a la baja en cuanto superó los 80.000, pero ha comenzado a bajar de nuevo. Así que, si no hay malas noticias, el mercado volverá a subir. Una buena noticia es que se va a cerrar un acuerdo entre China e Irán hoy o mañana, y cuando la guerra termine por completo,

It will be a matter of benefit, and we will see that in the coming time, we will get a lot more benefit from it. As I said, the market will see us reaching 75,000 or 78,000 and that is exactly what happened. The market has recovered once again, now it is three to four thousand dollars. So here, I have to say that now we will come back to the previous procedure. As soon as we start getting candles above, then only after that we will start going up again. 

será beneficioso, y veremos que en el futuro obtendremos muchos más beneficios. Como dije, el mercado alcanzaría los 75.000 o 78.000, y eso es exactamente lo que ha pasado. El mercado se ha recuperado y ahora está entre tres y cuatro mil dólares. Así que, volvamos al procedimiento anterior. En cuanto veamos velas al alza, entonces volveremos a subir.

Today is going to be the weekly closing in this way. If we get it above 80,000, it will be very happy news. If we get it at 78,000, it will be good news for the sick cat. If it gets below 77,200, it will be bad news for the market. So this is the golden age that the market is currently building, which I have told you. The hope is that the market will definitely go up because when the war ends, it is a lot of good news for the market. 

Hoy se cerrará la semana de esta manera.  Si supera los 80.000, serán excelentes noticias. Si llega a 78.000, serán buenas noticias para el mercado. Si cae por debajo de 77.200, serán malas noticias. Esta es la época dorada que el mercado está construyendo, como ya les comenté. La esperanza es que el mercado suba, porque cuando termine la guerra, serán muy buenas noticias para el mercado.

So the war is ending. So what I want to say here is that now the markets are going to pump again. So those who have done DCA will have reduced their buying price, so they will benefit a lot. What do you all think the market is going to do in the coming time? 

La guerra está terminando. Lo que quiero decir es que ahora los mercados van a repuntar. Quienes han esperado mucho tiempo en este mercado, con el repunte, todos obtendremos ganancias. Hay quienes han sufrido grandes pérdidas. Quienes han aplicado la estrategia DCA (Dynamic Investment Account) habrán reducido su precio de compra, por lo que se beneficiarán considerablemente. ¿Qué creen que hará el mercado próximamente?

Are we going to go towards 60,000 again or are we going to go towards 90,000? ¿Volveremos a alcanzar los 60.000 o los 90.000? Sanrio, por ejemplo, está operando en el mercado, y solo estas dos opciones funcionarán. Si ninguna de las dos se concreta, el mercado se estancará y permanecerá en el mismo nivel durante mucho tiempo. Parece que el futuro se presenta favorable para el mercado de criptomonedas.  La guerra también terminará y los problemas que estaban causando la caída del mercado también se resolverán ahora, por lo que es más probable que su precio aumente.
