title.title: Vertical horizons [EN/PT]
title.body: > My city might just be a reflection of what is happening in much of the world. A place where the past still remains standing while the present continues trying to draw the future, little by little. It is strange to think about that, because many of the things that today seem modern or even like something new will, a few years from now, also be seen as part of a time left behind. It sounds like something too obvious to say, but when we stop to truly observe, we realize how everything happens silently. We are so used to this mixture before our eyes that we almost never notice that, one day, what we call the present today will also become just a memory. When I walk through the city, this mixture between past and present becomes very evident. The city never stops growing. Spaces keep getting smaller, especially downtown, where it feels like every available piece has already been occupied. And then the most common solution appears: growing upward. Floor upon floor, bigger and bigger buildings trying to find space where there is almost no space left at all. But the most curious thing is how this transformation happens without us fully noticing it. Little by little, everything starts blending together. Modern, mirrored, gleaming constructions begin sharing the landscape with old buildings that still carry marks of another era. And many times, all it takes is looking at the reflection on a glass surface to notice the contrast: the new reflecting the old, as if two different versions of the city were coexisting at the same time. And aren’t they? I particularly like that. There is something interesting about realizing how patterns change over the years. Ways of building, styles, and details that once seemed natural slowly disappear, giving place to new ideas, new aesthetics, and new needs. The city changes, but it still keeps fragments of what it once was. Maybe that is why these Sunday walks always leave me feeling a bit reflective. Walking among these concrete giants ends up being, in a certain way, like walking between different eras. Many times we pass through these places in a hurry without realizing that there is history hidden in every old facade or in every modern building that continues to rise. In the end, I think it is beautiful to notice that. Looking at the past still standing before us while the future continues being built right there, before our eyes. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXAvoao5G7Pgn6zBLdHPLBnKKy1VTjk34wZNusECxc5ez/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXr5nYZHrkpqik3hm1TGcNrCkkMVwwaPKmZEofmgLryA6/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPd4C2ghFkcA3p5nizauZn7kukMzpasPNHoCGgq9gXxhq/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfXYAaxJJ3wdcwGzhxMAhDyZW18SjeGViS1vJrrJKZ7GR/image.png) Minha cidade talvez seja apenas um reflexo do que está acontecendo em boa parte do mundo. Um lugar onde o passado ainda permanece de pé enquanto o presente continua tentando desenhar o futuro, pouco a pouco. É estranho pensar nisso, porque muitas das coisas que hoje parecem modernas ou até novidade, daqui alguns anos também serão vistas como parte de um tempo que ficou para trás. Parece algo óbvio de se dizer, mas, quando paramos para observar de verdade, percebemos como tudo acontece de forma silenciosa. Estamos tão acostumados com essa mistura diante dos nossos olhos que quase nunca percebemos que, um dia, aquilo que hoje chamamos de presente será apenas lembrança também. Quando caminho pela cidade, essa mistura entre passado e presente fica muito evidente. A cidade não para de crescer. Os espaços vão diminuindo, principalmente no centro, onde parece que cada pedaço disponível já foi ocupado. E então surge a solução mais comum: crescer para cima. Andares sobre andares, prédios cada vez maiores tentando encontrar espaço onde já quase não existe mais espaço algum. Mas o mais curioso é como essa transformação acontece sem que a gente perceba completamente. Aos poucos, tudo vai se misturando. Construções modernas, espelhadas e reluzentes, passam a dividir cenário com prédios antigos que ainda carregam marcas de outra época. E, muitas vezes, basta olhar o reflexo de um vidro para enxergar o contraste: o novo refletindo o velho, como se duas versões diferentes da cidade coexistissem ao mesmo tempo. E não existem? Eu particularmente gosto disso. Existe algo interessante em perceber como os padrões mudam com o passar dos anos. Formas de construir, estilos, detalhes que antes pareciam naturais vão desaparecendo devagar, dando lugar a novas ideias, novas estéticas e novas necessidades. A cidade muda, mas ainda guarda fragmentos do que já foi um dia. Talvez seja por isso que esses passeios de domingo sempre me deixam um pouco reflexivo. Caminhar entre esses gigantes de concreto acaba sendo, de certa forma, caminhar entre diferentes épocas. Muitas vezes passamos apressados por esses lugares sem perceber que existe história escondida em cada fachada antiga ou em cada prédio moderno que continua surgindo. No fim, acho bonito perceber isso. Olhar para o passado ainda presente diante de nós, enquanto o futuro continua sendo construído bem ali, diante dos nossos olhos.

title.title: People who find a place in the heart sometimes hurt the heart
title.body:
How are you all? I hope you are well and your day is peaceful.



There are some people in life who very slowly make a place deep in the heart. Their presence becomes so close that one day one cannot even imagine one's life without them. Laughter, words, memories—they silently blend into everything.

But time is not always the same. Some of the people who were once the closest move away. Even though the change in the relationship is visible to the eyes, the mind does not want to accept it easily. Because, once love goes deep, it does not come out easily.

The most painful thing is—the ones we gave the safest place in the heart to, considering them \

, sometimes break that place. The hurt is not only in behavior, but also in feelings. Still, life does not stop. People gradually learn—not everything is ours forever. Some people come just to teach, some people come just to get lost. Time moves on, and we learn to pick ourselves up. Experience is born from suffering, and experience is born from strength. Even when broken, people learn to stand up again. Because in the end, no matter how much the heart is hurt, the power of love never ends.

## Hoy mi domingo musical. [Pomme - On Ira Tous Au Paradis](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vmJ9OzNsGEM)
#
<div class=\

>

Hoy en mi domingo musical amanecí en francés, ojalá hubiese sido en Francia, pero solo de visita no para vivir, porque lamento mucho cómo Francia se ha vuelto un basurero musulmán, eso es muy triste. Así que me conformo con solo pensar y soñar que estoy allá, y eso pasa porque hoy me topé con esta canción que tiene una letra un poco de sátira mordaz. Su letra habla de algo que la misma iglesia criticó en su momento, porque sí, estoy de acuerdo: todos vamos al paraíso.

Hoy les traigo On Ira Tous Au Paradis, pero esta canción está interpretada por una cantante que se llama Pomme, o ese es su nombre artístico. La letra está genial y dice mucho. Claro, está en francés, así que yo en su momento, cuando la escuché por primera vez por allá por los años 80, busqué la traducción y repito: está genial la letra.

La versión de Pomme, que toqué con guitarra acústica, para mi es una gran interpretación y muy conmovedora que pone de relieve la atemporalidad de la obra y su tono irónico, con un mensaje que aborda la idea de una salvación universal, la canción invita a la reflexión, destacando el valor de la conciencia individual, porque su letra, sugiere que todos tenemos un lugar, sin importar nuestras acciones o creencias, este clásico, y en esta versión invita a disfrutar de la música y a pensar en el mensaje de fondo si lo sé que muchos de ustedes no hablan francés yo tampoco lo hablo, pero en mi curiosidad musical busque el significado hay una frase y cito

>***No creas lo que dice la gente, tu corazón es la única iglesia***

Definitivamente, dice mucho para muchos que entienden lo que significa esa frase, es en un clásico de la música francesa, y la versión de Pomme es una excelente manera de redescubrirlo y disfrutar de su letra.

Today on my musical Sunday, I woke up in a French mood—I wish it had been in France, but just for a visit, not to live there, because I deeply regret how France has turned into a Muslim dumpster, which is very sad. So, I’ll just settle for thinking and dreaming that I’m there, and that’s happening because today I stumbled upon this song that has a somewhat bitingly satirical lyric. Its lyric talks about something that the church itself criticized at the time, because yes, I agree: we are all going to paradise.

Today I bring you On Ira Tous Au Paradis, but this song is performed by a singer named Pomme, or at least that’s her stage name. The lyrics are great and say a lot. Of course, it’s in French, so back in the day, when I heard it for the first time around the 80s, I looked up the translation and, I repeat, the lyrics are great.

Pomme’s version, which she performed with an acoustic guitar, is to me a great and very moving interpretation that highlights the timelessness of the song and its ironic tone. With a message that addresses the idea of a universal salvation, the song invites us to reflect, highlighting the value of individual conscience. Her lyrics suggest that we all have a place, regardless of our actions or beliefs. This classic, and specifically this version, invites you to enjoy the music and think about the deeper message.  **@gatubela** -  [Un retrato para el cumpleaños de un amigo 🎁 🖍️ ](https://hive.blog/hive-158694/@gatubela/un-retrato-para-el-cumpleanos-de-un-amigo-creyones-oleo-pastel-y-colores-a-portrait-for-a-friends-birthday-oil-pastels-creyo) - **5** points - prize:  **20% of the post's earnings** + **300 Ecency Points**  

![](https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23uFTYqx9frp6Tfy922wmw8jvaAMM511ayPeQrmy6XnpjgS3bLdgiH4HdVuXpunZizoEF.jpg)
 
 This vibrant and heartfelt portrait shared by @gatubela is a wonderful testament to how art can bridge distances and make for a truly meaningful, personalized gift. In picture, we see a striking use of color theory; by choosing an orange construction paper as the base, the artist cleverly amplifies the cool blue tones that dominate Michael’s features, creating a dynamic contrast that immediately catches the eye. The textured application of oil pastels combined with detailed colored pencil work gives the piece an engaging, tactile quality, while the bold black marker outlines beautifully define his dark beard, expressive eyes, and curly hair. Even though the author humorously notes that the final piece gives him a \

expression, the dedication required to capture a friend's likeness—especially overcoming tricky areas like the nose—shines through brilliantly. Ultimately, this artwork serves as a beautiful reminder of the power of handmade gifts, offering a creative, heartfelt way to celebrate a loved one from afar. 🥈 **2nd place**: **@afrikens** - [Art Portrait Of Love](https://hive.blog/hive-177682/@afrikens/55771d60) - **3** points - prize: **15% of the post's earnings** + **200 Ecency Points** ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcndd4CyHpvMuZeqohYeNQWgTedkUCU26jwP6AoxMnMJ6/obraz.png) This stunning monochrome portrait shared is an exceptional display of technical skill and emotional depth, perfectly capturing the spirit of celebration for a special retirement occasion. The artist demonstrates a masterful command of graphite and charcoal, achieving smooth skin gradients and beautifully rendered highlights that bring the subject's face to life. The intricate textures of the patterned traditional attire and the clean, rhythmic lines of the headpiece showcase a remarkable attention to detail and patient craftsmanship. Additionally, the sharp contrast of the glasses adds a compelling focal point to the piece, while the seamless blending work creates a sophisticated, lifelike depth. Overcoming the technical challenge of simultaneously filming and drawing on a single phone, @afrikens has delivered a highly polished, inspiring entry that truly honors the client's love and appreciation for the retiree. 🥉 **3rd place**: **@the9thcreator** - [ANGRY BIRD😡](https://hive.blog/hive-174301/@the9thcreator/angry-bird) - **2** points - prize: **15% of the post's earnings** + **100 Ecency Points** ![](https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmVsnE7P7wvUiBbby8sPeooQHPJnYF5cGwi26PooS3NwpW/img_7185.jpg) This delightful pencil sketch is a masterful lesson in how to pack an immense amount of personality into a minimalist design. The artist effectively utilizes a dual-pencil technique on white cardboard paper, beginning with a light 2H pencil to map out the foundational structure and finishing with a bold 8B pencil to deliver striking highlights and deep contrast. What truly elevates this drawing is the deliberate tension between the neat, intense shading on the heavily furrowed brows and the energetic, loose scribbles that form the bird's feathery outline, giving the character a wonderfully chaotic and expressive texture. The smooth gradient shading on the round body and wings successfully creates a sense of three-dimensional depth, making this tiny, disgruntled creature look incredibly vivid and full of attitude. It is a fantastic showcase of traditional sketching skills, proving that with just two pencils and a great eye for expression, one can create an incredibly impactful piece of art. --- ## **Congratulations to the winners!** 🎉 Remember, the contest is ongoing! title.title: Bitcoin Price Supported by 75K USD Level
title.body:
There was great support level on Bitcoin price chart. I shared lots of analysis about Bitcoin price chart and said Bitcoin price may be supported by 75K USD level or the bottom line of great ascending channel. After touching 200-day moving average, Bitcoin price is going down slowly.

Here you can see daily chart of Bitcoin price. It is going down slowly after touching 200-day moving average. Bitcoin price broke down the middle line of this great ascending channel during price correction. 75K USD level was the first great support level and it supported. Bitcoin price is still below 8-day moving average. It is important signal for short-term.


![e1.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/23swiWiwQbCpKY1BpMZsgyMkGxaChYUBmU5zULioac85SAA4i7Duf3jJr9BrgUbQEMpdb.PNG)

Here you can see the indicators on daily chart of Bitcoin price. Fisher Indicator is on the bottom and trying to reverse up. We may see reversing up on this indicator if we see more daily red candle.

MACD Indicator is still in correction. Even it reversed down from the top, we may see reverse up if we see more daily green candle. If it reverses up we will see mini bullish trend on Bitcoin price chart. Because this reversing up will happen on 0 level.

RSI Indicator broke down mini uptrend line. We need time to see the new bullish pattern on RSI Indicator.

![e2.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/23t77MG8Yq4bipyqcWGkDucZHmLmSPqKb7z6MCriGrkCNcUTxsheL5RXL84Sx73kJ34gx.PNG)

8-day moving average important for Bitcoin price for short term. If we see more daily green candle, Bitcoin price will get daily close above 8-day and these major indicators will reverse up.

We may see mini bullish trend. If not, we will focus the bottom line of this great ascending channel to support Bitcoin price.

We will see..

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@chorock/bitcoin-price-supported-by-75k-usd-level-cj7)

title.title: US Debt Spiral, interest payments already consume 20% of the US federal tax revenue, what’s the endgame of the debt crisis?
title.body:
Die Staatsverschuldung in den USA ist seit Corona explodiert und beträgt derzeit unglaubliche 39 Billionen (amerikanische Trillionen) bzw. 122% des BIP, was heftig ist. 2000 betrug die Verschuldung noch unter 60% des BIP.

Ein Fünftel aller Steuereinnahmen muss der Staat bereits alleine für die Zinsen der Staatsschulden ausgeben.

Dazu kommt, dass die USA ebenfalls ein laufendes Budgetdefizit von über 7% verursachen, was die Problematik der Überschuldung noch weiter verschärft.

Unmittelbare Auswirkungen der steigenden Staatsschulden sind Asset Inflation, explodierende und unleistbare Immobilienpreise und zeitverzögert Inflation von Lebensmittel, Alltagsprodukten und vor allem Dienstleistungen, Abwertung der nationalen Währung und damit auch der Gehälter, Pensionen und Sparbücher.

Gehaltserhöhungen können mit dem Gelddrucken kaum noch mitthalten, was man als erstes bei den Immo-Preisen gespürt hat, aber immer mehr auch beim täglichen Einkauf und bei den galoppierenden Dienstleistungs-Preisen.

Wie denkt ihr, geht das mit den Schulden weiter? Wird das Vertrauen in den Dollar als Leitwährung irgendwann kollabieren und es dann zu einer Hyperinflation und einem Währungsreset kommen? Könnte die USA im Zuge der Schuldenkrise seine Vormachtstellung verlieren?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/AJhUAKQ91NbG7SjDigNAmcThWb3UJZY4UCmhfXVeeskpi7KDnhd6995Zy4sABiW.png)

https://x.com/WallStreetMav/status/2046364133881221614

## English

The U.S. national debt has skyrocketed since corona and currently stands at an incredible 39 trillion dollars, or 122% of GDP, which is staggering. In 2000, the debt was still below 60% of GDP.

The government already has to spend one-fifth of all tax revenue just on interest payments for the national debt.

On top of that, the U.S. is also running a budget deficit of over 7%, which further exacerbates the problem of excessive debt.

The immediate effects of rising national debt are asset inflation, skyrocketing and unaffordable real estate prices, and, with a time lag, inflation in food, everyday goods, and especially services, as well as the devaluation of the national currency and, consequently, of wages, pensions, and savings accounts.

Salary increases can barely keep up with money printing, a trend first felt in real estate prices but increasingly evident in daily shopping and soaring service prices.

What do you think will be the endgame of the debt crisis? Will confidence in the US dollar as the reserve currency eventually collapse, leading to hyperinflation and a currency reset? Could the US lose its hegemony in the wake of the debt crisis?

title.body: > Presentamos la trayectoria de **Tambor Urbano**, la agrupación que logró llevar el pulso rítmico de nuestras costas a los escenarios urbanos, convirtiendo la percusión afrovenezolana en un elemento esencial de las grandes celebraciones del país.

> We present the career of **Tambor Urbano**, the group that managed to bring the rhythmic pulse of our coasts to urban stages, turning Afro-Venezuelan percussion into an essential element of the country's major celebrations. --------
[English version below!](#contenido-english)
--------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AKzDpjFDkX7WvXwNmm7rxNRn82RrtFzxU3Gr8ycofj5yj8YJtQyzvoMQoXKXvV8.png) # Tambor Urbano: El pulso rítmico de la ciudad

>

**Tambor Urbano** nació a finales de 1988 bajo la dirección de **Héctor Silvera**, con la premisa de trasladar la fuerza rítmica de las costas venezolanas hacia la dinámica de los escenarios urbanos. La agrupación se trazó como meta llevar el golpe de tambor, sus cantos y danzas a los contextos festivos de las grandes ciudades, logrando integrar diversos ritmos de las zonas costeras del país —desde las tonadas de Falcón hasta los golpes de Vargas y Miranda— en una propuesta diseñada para el entretenimiento y la difusión masiva. Al utilizar como base rítmica el tambor cumaco y el sonido de las guaruras, la banda se convirtió en un referente de carisma, logrando una proyección nacional que llevó estas expresiones autóctonas a escenarios antes poco explorados por el género.

La importancia de **Tambor Urbano** radica en su capacidad para actuar como un difusor cultural que rompió barreras sociales. Antes de su consolidación, el golpe de tambor se mantenía vinculado mayoritariamente a sus contextos rurales y rituales de origen. Sin embargo, la agrupación propuso una estética sonora adaptada a los estándares del espectáculo moderno, lo que permitió que esta expresión negroide se convirtiera en pieza clave de eventos corporativos, fiestas privadas y grandes conciertos públicos. Esta transición hacia un formato de \

facilitó que el sonido del tambor se integrara plenamente en el tejido recreativo de las principales ciudades, acercando la percusión afrovenezolana a audiencias que no estaban familiarizadas con sus raíces originales. A lo largo de su trayectoria, **Tambor Urbano** ha cosechado una impresionante lista de éxitos que han mantenido una presencia constante en las emisoras de radio nacionales. Su labor ha sido respaldada por los principales galardones de la industria en Venezuela, recibiendo premios como el **Mara de Oro**, **Casa del Artista**, **Estrella de Venezuela**, **Musa de Oro** y el **Cacique de Oro**. Estas distinciones celebran su éxito como embajadores de una sonoridad que ha sabido adaptarse a las demandas del mercado musical contemporáneo sin abandonar la instrumentación tradicional que le da identidad. Hoy en día, la agrupación se mantiene como una institución de la música festiva venezolana, reafirmando que el tambor posee una versatilidad única para convivir con la modernidad. Su legado consiste en haber creado una plataforma de alta visibilidad para la percusión afrovenezolana, transformando la ejecución tradicional en una experiencia de gran impacto escénico. **Tambor Urbano** representa la alegría y el movimiento, consolidando un estilo que celebra la herencia rítmica de la costa desde una perspectiva citadina y vibrante que sigue marcando la pauta en las celebraciones del país. ------

> 


### Tambor Urbano: The Rhythmic Pulse of the City

**Tambor Urbano** was born in late 1988 under the direction of **Héctor Silvera**, with the premise of bringing the rhythmic force of the Venezuelan coasts into the dynamics of urban settings. The group set a goal to bring the \

its songs, and dances to the festive contexts of major cities, successfully integrating various rhythms from the country's coastal areas—from the melodies of Falcón to the beats of Vargas and Miranda—into a proposal designed for entertainment and mass appeal. By using the cumaco drum and the sound of guaruras as a rhythmic base, the band became a benchmark of charisma, achieving national projection that brought these indigenous expressions to stages previously unexplored by the genre.\n\nThe significance of **Tambor Urbano** lies in its ability to act as a cultural diffuser that broke down social barriers. Before its consolidation, the \

remained mostly linked to its rural contexts and rituals of origin. However, the group proposed a sonic aesthetic adapted to the standards of modern performance, which allowed this Afro-Venezuelan expression to become a key piece of corporate events, private parties, and large public concerts. This transition toward a \

format made it easier for the drum's sound to be fully integrated into the recreational fabric of major cities, bringing Afro-Venezuelan percussion closer to audiences who were not familiar with its original roots. Throughout its career, **Tambor Urbano** has garnered an impressive list of hits that have maintained a constant presence on national radio stations. Its work has been backed by the main industry awards in Venezuela, receiving prizes such as the **Mara de Oro**, **Casa del Artista**, **Estrella de Venezuela**, **Musa de Oro**, and the **Cacique de Oro**. These distinctions celebrate its success as ambassadors of a sound that has known how to adapt to the demands of the contemporary musical market without abandoning the traditional instrumentation that gives it identity. Today, the group remains an institution of festive Venezuelan music, reaffirming that the drum possesses a unique versatility to coexist with modernity. Its legacy consists of having created a high-visibility platform for Afro-Venezuelan percussion, transforming traditional performance into an experience of great scenic impact. **Tambor Urbano** represents joy and movement, consolidating a style that celebrates the rhythmic heritage of the coast from a city-dwelling and vibrant perspective that continues to set the standard in the country's celebrations. #

title.body:

Hey folks,
loved this photo and I think its owner that day captured quite a few adorable shots… one enjoys this activity so much and in so many different ways, right? And with family it’s an absolute blast! 😀 Thank you!

>
We enjoyed some really scenic posts this week — and you can still spread some love to our authors! Here’s who kept the spirit alive.
>Spokane Lilac Century 50 Mile Bike Ride! - 3hr16min - Sunday by @flemingfarm. After a 50-mile ride that was anything but boring, the family welcomes you at the finish line… awesome, mate!

>Cycling Chit Chat, a week of NO cycling 🤔 by @nozem01. And this author certainly knows how to settle debts. He didn’t let the week end without releasing his new video here — enjoy a film that stirs a touch of unease, as the cyclist is completely lost. Don’t miss it!
>New Video: Lost in Germany! by @nozem01. 🤳😁

by @lesmann. Strong winds are often called the invisible coach in cycling. But how good it is that this isn’t a concern when you’re with your friend Brutus. In the end, what truly matters is going out, feeling the air, and discovering new places.
>140 km in cycle touring mode 😬 by @nanixxx The longest route and a difficult moment that I don’t believe was overcome by luck, but by destiny.

>📷 9 Years Here On HIVE by @andyjaypowell. We loved that andyjaypowell celebrated twice over here in our community. That’s what I said at the beginning, all the contributions this week brought beautiful photos.
>Cycling at sunrise by @vesytz. The author shares with us a special moment: the sunrise seen from the stone benches beside the Burgas salt works.

>Cycling Down the Baja - On the Road Again by @stortebeker Another great adventure! This time La Zorra Roja will take this cyclist to Mexico, along one of the most beautiful stretches of landscape: Baja California.

>Morning cycling in the city by @vesytz. Another scenic post.
The streets and boulevards were so calm and quiet and the clouds gave a particularly interesting atmosphere and feel.
And now let’s move on to the statistics section. The routes shared through the #Strava2Hive service, curiously, were very few that week. What’s going on? Perhaps the athletes are vacationing in resorts and spas and things like that… very lazy. 😅

title.title: When Rain Falls, My Mind Finds Peace | LOH #290
title.body: ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zoe01/23xp4QwFnzFoXoogde2PgV4qs3YDzVZ5ticZFzJ2bmochNts3RKHn3tFdpQZHRcHZHkT1.png) Someone asked me what is my favorite safe heaven for relaxation and I replied it's my room during rainy days. Well, since chilhood I loved rainy days. Because my mother would let me skip my classes and my home tutor could not come. So, it was a fun thing for me, I really wished for rain everyday. So, yesterday I was drenching in sweat because of the hot weather and I felt tired. But today it was the opposite I was feeling relaxed because of the rain. When I woke up today it was already lunch time, for that reason I was feeling down. Because I had a lot of work to do but I've wasted my time to sleep. So, I could not focus on anything. But after, it rained today, I felt a lot better than before. ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zoe01/2432KkpKio9mvjMXxnsNNKBJcZogT3Dak5jGX5ByfJ38xurkt2KYKsAx8LqzbdqB7kX4d.jpg) I captured the photo. The photo I shared is from today's when it rained. In the photo you can already see there's fog and it's already dark at 4 pm. Then I opened the window, when started to rain heavily and a cold wind entered the room. After an hour, the rain stopped. Even though it was for a short time but that small moment made me feel much better. Like my stress was almost gone, and I finally felt relaxed after so many days. There's another valid reason I think of my room as my safe place is because it will always give me the privacy that I wanted. I need a break from everything once in a while and if I don't take s break then it makes me stressed. What I like the most about it is that in my room I don’t need to be representative or do any kind of formalities, that helps me recharge myself fully. As I'm not an extrovert full time so quiet places are my thing, I really don't find peace in crowded places. Like it gives me anxiety. After my social battery drains, when I enter my room the feeling I get is hard to explain. In my room, I can finally be myself because it is the only place where I can fully relax without worrying about anything. Well, everyone is different so for some people traveling might be the way for relaxation but mine is by staying at home. Because I personally think that peace can also be found in simple moments. Some might find it in crowded places and some at quiet places. So, my forever favourite safe place would be my own room. ____ The thumbnail is created with [Gemini](gemini.google.com) ____

title.title: Local Politics: The Greed Behind Stealing Garbage Space
title.body:
* changed the rules for the local garbage dump so that there is now a $20 fee *(minimum)* for dropping off your *recycling.*

Up to that point, getting rid of your recyclable items had always been *free,* and there had been several drop-off locations around the county.

![RD0097-Stop.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/reddragonfly/23r1nzGWH552afzsPJTqUm6yDdCLPYPEXW726C98rsZyGrqz2G4Gyks9oAkQXELgyu8Yd.jpg)

But it was decided — due to so-called *\
* — to remove the drop-off stations, and to put all the recycling dumpsters *\
* meaning that you now have to *\
* and be charged, in the process. \n\nYou could argue that *\

* but with as many people struggling financially as we have these days... that $20 is likely needed to put some $6.00 gas in our cars so we can even get to *work.* 

But beyond that, wouldn't it be more appropriate to treat a community's waste processing as a *civic service* rather than as a *profit center?*

Of course, it is pretty much inevitable that *choices have consequences.*

![RD0097-BaraTrees.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/reddragonfly/EonmZ6L66vcF7pjKbTGfSzhVEqmRbR2y5cen8ujmSmThAkHa3Q6kr7WFFDSWnfRG9Ni.jpg)

The new ordinance has barely been in effect for six weeks, and business owners around town are *already* complaining that random people are doing *\

* of garbage into their commercial dumpsters, thereby not only causing them to overflow, but creating an additional mess *around* the dumpsters.

And yes, this definitely *is* an illegal activity.

According to the legal experts, this is actually called *\

* and carries a possible $10,000 fine! But there's also the *practical* aspect that a business can't just order a random extra pick-up as part of their contract. So the recycling and garbage just builds up.

Of course, there are also the practical and more immediate ramifications: Many local businesses are now having to spend extra money on security cameras and monitoring equipment... as well as choosing to pay for more expensive lockable dumpsters.

![RD-0018-SailingHomeDrawn.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/reddragonfly/EoK6MhdkAmtAANW3T7jpR74jTvX3gk2dzoc2AuxFx4J6FfbyCL3WU2JdmWsVQ2PUZHW.jpg)

Ultimately, pretty much *everyone* loses. 

Meanwhile, our heavily pro-business, pro-development city council members are busy brokering real estate deals that will *allegedly* bring in more property tax dollars... from more million dollar houses and waterfront condos that will likely sit empty until the builders go bankrupt, after which they will be bought up by private equity investment corporations for pennies on the dollar, only to become top-market rentals that most existing locals cannot hope to afford... in a market that has been *screaming* for *affordable* housing for over a decade.

In a *\

* town it might be less of an issue, but the challenge *here* is that the city is located at the tip of a peninsula with no other population centers nearby... and we're rapidly moving towards a situation in which the people providing the *services* to the owners of those million dollar homes can no longer afford to live here on their retail and hospitality wages... 

![RD0023-WhiteBellflowers.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/reddragonfly/23tmFvPUZri5aeiDwHUmLWWAFuM9mL711pN9y9DHheyPMASCk1WEF6A5hMNSzf6ApvwWd.JPG)

Looks like we might end up with a very swank little city... with pretty much no services. And since the *\

* is largely wealthy retirees you have to wonder how many retired people will want to *actually* move to a location that may be *beautiful, safe and clean,* but essentially has very little to offer, service wise? 

All these little nickel-and-dime expenses are certainly *part* of creating that situation...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPnauSD63MPKEEjuE6EgZXaYVzGnuq5eTRoRiz2L8vm82/img_20260404_140331.jpg)




It is almost the end of May, and the spring vibes are fading in Beijing as temperatures rise faster than at the start of spring in April.  The afternoon is getting longer as the days grow longer, and the days are now brighter than in the springtime. As a result, daytime temperatures are also crossing the 25-degree mark, making the days like summer days. These photos I have taken in the park area in Beijing city during early spring when it was at its fullest. I found these scenic, iconic views of the city park while I was enjoying a walk in nature.

The location of the park is in the city area, so I found a lot of visitors in the park area, as you can see in these photos. As Beijing is so large, there are so many parks in the city, and I always love to explore scenic spots like the Summer Palace, Xiangshan Park, and Fragrant Hills Park, which are so beautiful and attractive to visit. 

I hope you enjoy my photos of the beautiful natural beauty of the Beijing city park. It is a great time to enjoy some outdoor activity like walking in this amazing area with warmer weather after the freezing cold of the winter season in Beijing. If you have any questions, let me know in the comments, and I will do my best to answer them.

Thanks a lot for your time and attention. I will catch up with you at the next one.

Wishing you a good day!

>I took all the photos, and these are my own property.

title.body:
>



Hello 👋 Ladies.

Welcome to a new and blessed week, it's your favorite host here again, for this week's prompt I would be participating on the contest topic which says: 1️⃣ What is your favorite safe heaven for relaxation and why?
Hearing safe heaven's can be about a place or favorite spot, it can be about a person, it can be an activity you find pleasure in doing or a mental state which you get into at the moment that calms everything but just keep it in mind that the central idea is just \
, a place where you are just being you without judgement or performance.

> So having made my little intro, what I consider as my safe heaven is a person and not just any regular person but someone I call my favorite, we have known each other for years now and the connection plus vibe is just something else, like we connect on a different level, that bond has been built where I can relate anything and I would be sure that I don't carry the same burden back after telling him, you can relate to this type of safe heaven as having my angel here on earth. That time when we were getting to know each other it wasn't like this, trust had to be built, we had to break through each other worlds that has been built around us by ourselves, we had misunderstandings while others days we just sat quiet and let silence pass the message but today I can say I have got me my angel on earth, my safe heaven, my favorite person and my finestkind all in one person, you know those kind of people that you can stay hours on call with, without lacking what to say, you gist them about your day and every little details are being told, you ask their opinions on almost everything, yess that's my friend Adeyemi, sometimes I feel calling him a friend is just too low because he's actually more than a friend to me. Getting to know him makes me understand the saying that, having quality friends around you is really healthy, I can say that he also contributed and is still contributing to my growth, I feel protected around him, I feel calm around just by mere talking about stuffs that burdens me, and by the way he is single just Incase you want to send in your application 😁😁 (was just kidding), some days I just sit and wonder what I did to deserve such a blessing coz he's one in a million. Well let me not talk much before you think I am over hyping him, but in summary of all these please have you someone that you can safely run to without having to watch your back, and with this I call it a wrap, do have a lovely week. All images used here are my friend's own so it belongs to me.

title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779642437504-37f0198164b04465.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=efootjoker-yt/be23b464)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=efootjoker-yt/be23b464)


---

---

<center>**Hello everyone and welcome back to my blog.**</center>

---
#

I had met with the pirate Goro and delivered the message from Lord Shimura to him. While searching for Goro, I discovered a new place called Umugi Cove. This place is the hideout of the Straw Hat Ronins. They are mercenary warriors. They protect someone for money, and they don't hesitate to kill someone.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZSh696mLb8Gyo3vqoQX84fVL5crfnznVwUW9H6FRHKeJ/snapshot_46.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTXujWnCQGTMsWm1YByJFmV3gw9vxLDMTbafznwyMcskW/snapshot_47.png)

After Umugi Cove was unlocked, some new side missions were also unlocked here. One of the missions was called \

I decided to start with that. I saw a helpless mother searching for her lost daughter. She said that her daughter had been missing for about three to four days. Her daughter's name was Kuma. The woman cried and asked me to help her.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNXprx46M7YBkcDe37KwFZozczfqMgXL7oZDxKkAqCjFj/snapshot_49.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWdy5t7GBZX9yWfv2sjyLrbk88xZic6S4fScdrCAW1yjR/snapshot_50.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmezs9XAyuW39EoB6SNMf6kYhjwhfzr2KgbDCDJLVkNMJt/snapshot_51.png)

First I started talking to some of the Straw Hat Ronin in the cove. When I asked one of them about Kuma, his answer seemed a little suspicious to me. He wasn't answering properly. But I couldn't be sure right away. Then I asked another one. He said he knew Kuma but hadn't seen him in a long time. He seemed innocent.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRrkWJk5jxcbfMqLuW99rWic1a7zm5NpREXgddcjXfm3d/snapshot_53.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXdY95VJfRwvZcpzojX5gYhsdNzTbCHaSoRAgDmyzgctA/snapshot_54.png)

This is how the interrogation went on. After a while, a man called me and took me aside. He said, “It’s not right to talk about these things here.” Then he secretly told me that a few days ago, Kuma was seen with some bandits near the Numanaka Inn. Hearing this, I quickly headed towards that place.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXXMWaUZxcp3USkP7qizvz3YRp6jDyADtVqJATktvXg1F/snapshot_55.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQcyrmFccs7RdS5nnRMK13hB4p24KcpyyJVuL1EQ9YR8R/snapshot_56.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYhyGwCyxqH7pJUDuP4fAWAc7MQLiJLEyiQ74nmhzHqtc/snapshot_57.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma9WtajkcMUhyGojnhM3Ts8as9t3BqZVLvPBDvNsmpvtw/snapshot_58.png)

On the way there, I took some more pictures of Izuhara Island. The atmosphere here is really different. There are red flowers all around, a smoky atmosphere and a kind of cinematic vibe. So it felt good to take pictures.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP9S1HTBr44tanJMycHTZ9GdrJcfAPSsZAKmMmu5WKU6Q/snapshot_60.png)

Finally, when I reached the Numanaka Inn area, I saw two people sitting on the side of the road crying. After talking to them, I learned that an innocent looking girl had asked them for help. When they went to help, some bandits came and robbed them of everything, even killing their horse. That's when I realized that this was Kuma.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaE9r3LZtN8QTdJZtFdiAjFxX2ta3jVQTHLMPpkBpuLag/snapshot_61.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS8gYTPv1phyWtibqnDm8wHkPMoudXTGZ12tuf3sBGBsk/snapshot_62.png)

I quickly moved towards the inn. On the way, I encountered four Mongol soldiers. Using the Stand Off skill, I killed the first three instantly. I also finished off the remaining one very easily.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdQtewBY3JjuBDKNnvN54CeGqo7R6ANpnQ9bo7qwVd1Jz/snapshot_63.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbznGw2EhgbkxUj2QN2nP5BEJeenLWd5AtG1mUpRNsZsR/snapshot_64.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSMeVQ2gNgC6VSx6UrhGPRvAzF4U3E3uerUkp38pAjVDN/snapshot_65.png)

Then I reached the inn and saw some bandits guarding it. I attacked them directly. The bandits were not very skilled, so I easily defeated them. Then I went inside and killed some more bandits using perfect parry.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdj6bWu2BZUUtVeW2FT2APz4sZBenh3J3rBovpAmFMUoH/snapshot_66.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPSHkryTUfRypszBiMm7TGGPxyWbcQ2UnpEgGCWtfbMpP/snapshot_67.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRUGW9DnMgAAtnymAsJjpCSdUDHUXpKEGCfpqkzTYEDN8/snapshot_68.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZGau38wmiguqjkMbpQJkjR29w6teTB5sx1HFNhiuAqSE/snapshot_69.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSPrAvt5nXnYYS4Vyyp9JSz7XSqvXdqZccp9fboZFPoxR/snapshot_70.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS6wogEhJ3LFjnV9hHsdViVWXZ3CCREroGQYEV2tmkwCW/snapshot_71.png)

Then I use my senses to notice that Kuma is on the second floor. I quickly go up and kill one bandit from behind. When I go inside, I see Kuma crying and three bandits sleeping next to him. I kill the sleeping bandits one by one.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW4uFae3UpUxGBfgK7PTxtM7HYXFgvgkWywia1cM9zySY/snapshot_72.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4CF3oxZCjpXRJLNvgbLstC3mLJesj7RzQtqyJpUBidA/snapshot_73.png)

Kuma then cried and said that she was forced to do these things. She's not really bad. Hearing her words, Sakai also understood that the girl was a victim of circumstances. So I took her and quietly left there.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXcQ5WoM3mU7m5zr5yjzHLyBnhjs1B47ftNogBwr9w38x/snapshot_74.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPmh7z6oLVK8RftJDV21zdYZSmETZsACA19ptT1FBg9J5/snapshot_75.png)

But as soon as I stepped outside the gate, I saw the suspicious ronin I had talked to earlier standing there. I immediately realized that this was the man who had captured Kuma and sold him to the bandits. And realizing that, I engaged in battle with him and killed him. Kuma's mother was very happy to get her daughter back.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYAiMf3uSx4TReuLCbDCB66vJ3AU1H6ehffG5nQGKZCj6/snapshot_76.png)


---

* **See You All In My Next Post.**
* **I took all these screenshots while playing the game and the thumbnail was created in Canva.**

---

title.title: BITÁCORA [Also in English]
title.body:
> Hoy fue un día muy productivo. Me levanté bien temprano e hice mi desayuno criollo, que comprendía arepa, queso rallado, caraotas negras, tocineta, huevo frito con la yema blanda, nata de queso y un soberano café bien cargado. Una vez con la panza llena, me ocupé de meter en la lavadora la ropa que había usado durante la semana. Luego decidí salir a caminar un rato para tomar los rayos de sol de las nueve de la mañana. Fue una caminata maravillosa: no había mucha gente, el clima estaba fresco y se sentía una vibra fenomenal. De regreso a casa, me preparé para el nuevo proyecto que tengo: un nuevo canal de YouTube que dedicaré a los mayores de 50 años. Desde hace tiempo tenía esa idea, pero no había terminado de concretarla. En ese canal enseñaré a las personas mayores de 50 cómo usar aplicaciones y la IA; también mostraré mi día a día como persona de la tercera edad y cómo no me quedo sumergido en una silla o en una cama. Los 60 de ahora son los nuevos 40, y no exagero. Ya escogí cinco temas para esta semana. Preparé el guion, arreglé la habitación que servirá de estudio y comenzaré las grabaciones el lunes. La mayoría de las veces, antes de grabar, ensayo lo que voy a decir, sobre todo para memorizar el guion, porque no sirvo para leerlo ni para estar pendiente de un teleprompter. Ya a esta hora, pasada del mediodía, me prepararé algo ligero para almorzar y seguir con el ensayo. El plan es grabar esos cinco temas mañana lunes, aunque de repente pueden surgir otros para grabar el martes. Usaré esos dos días para las grabaciones. Los miércoles programaré el contenido en el canal para que salga en las fechas que deseo. Todo ha sido planeado de forma estricta, pero, como siempre, durante la revisión o los ensayos surgen nuevas ideas para modificar y mejorar. Así que considero que hoy fue un día muy productivo. Ah, se me olvidaba: otra de las cosas que hice hoy, hasta ahora, fue escribirles este texto. Y al final de la tarde me acomodaré en mi gran sofá para ver una buena película. Hasta aquí mis cinco minutos.

> Today was highly productive. I woke up bright and early and whipped up a traditional Venezuelan breakfast: a warm arepa, shredded cheese, black beans, crispy bacon, a fried egg with a perfectly runny yolk, nata, and a powerful, rich cup of coffee. With a full stomach, I tossed a week's worth of laundry into the washing machine. Then, I decided to go for a quick walk to catch those 9:00 AM sun rays. It was a wonderful stroll—peaceful, crisp weather, and an overall phenomenal vibe. Back home, I geared up for my latest venture: a new YouTube channel dedicated to the over-50 crowd. I’ve had this idea for a while, but I hadn’t fully brought it to life until now. On this channel, I’ll teach people over 50 how to navigate apps and AI. I’ll also share my daily life as a senior, proving that getting older doesn't mean staying glued to a chair or a bed. 60 is the new 40 nowadays, and I’m not exaggerating. I’ve already picked five topics for this week. I wrote the scripts, set up the room that will serve as my studio, and filming starts on Monday. Most of the time, I rehearse my lines before recording to memorize the script—I’m just not built for teleprompters. It’s now just past noon, so I’m going to whip up a light lunch and get back to rehearsing. The plan is to shoot those five topics tomorrow, Monday, though inspiration might strike and lead to more filming on Tuesday. I’ll use those two days for production. On Wednesdays, I’ll schedule the content to drop exactly when I want it. Everything is strictly planned, but as always, new ideas to tweak and improve constantly pop up during rehearsals and reviews. So all in all, I’d say today was incredibly productive. Oh, I almost forgot: another thing I managed to do today, at least so far, was write this down for you. Later this evening, I’ll kick back on my big couch to enjoy a good movie. That’s my five minutes. Over and out.

title.title: Splinterlands Life Splinter: Calabash Sage Level 5 Card Strategy Analysis
title.body:
> Life Splinter is in a very strong position in the current meta of the Splinterlands game. Especially in high-mana battles when more capable cards are needed, Calabash Sage has become a reliable name. After recently promoting this card to level 5, its effectiveness has increased a lot. As a ranged attacker, it has the ability to attack, and its defensive abilities have made it an indispensable card for the team. Today, we will discuss in detail the various aspects of this card's level 5 and its impact on the battle. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV64FWH9NswutELy4HKtMXXSNyHuNHRcvJzZULj7B4skV/1779642511500.jpg) First of all, looking at the general statistics of the card, it can be seen that it is a 10 mana card. In many cases, 10 mana may seem like a lot, but Calabash Sage justifies its huge mana with its abilities and power. After reaching level 5, this card has a ranged attack power of 4. That is, it is capable of dealing 4 damage to the opponent per round. Although its speed is only 1, which may seem like a weakness at first glance. But in the Splinterlands game, this low speed becomes its biggest strength in special rulesets like Reverse Speed. Because then Calabash Sage gets the chance to attack first. Since its health is 7 and armour is 1, it can survive for quite a while. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaSSxgAnRmVAxqvhh8DBsbq3dJxbGjicrtD38MadmAQAU/1779642523034.jpg) At level 5, the biggest advantage of the Calabash Sage card is its two special abilities. The first is Shiel,d and the second is Tank Heal. The combination of these two abilities makes it unique as an attacker and a support card at the same time. Speaking of the shield ability, it gives the card a lot of protection from physical attacks. We know that having a shield halves the damage received from the opponent's melee or ranged attack. If an opponent attacks with 1 power, it becomes 0 damage due to the shield. Due to this ability, Calabash Sage can survive on the battlefield for a long time and continue attacking, which helps to ensure victory in high-mana matches. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVhhJv4iB1nb59kxG7LE9UrD9rGvT7h25gSosSA7sSreN/1779642531376.jpg) The second and very important ability is Tank Heal. The card gains this extraordinary ability only after reaching level 5. Tank Heal basically regenerates the health of the first-ranked card or tank in your team. Every round, it restores one-third of the maximum health of the first-ranked unit. Life Splinter usually consists of all the strong tank cards with a lot of health. When Calabash Sage continues to heal that tank from behind, it becomes almost impossible for the opponent to break your frontline. This increases the durability of your entire team many times over. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXAw3MRmd479RdhqoTn2hni1CyaJP2e25Bv5NE9ZXbHic/1779642539335.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRN8WCxs9xs3MqRYz8F8kUBQzwuX8FiJYUcHg7xTnwJRE/1779642539376.jpg) If you look at the level-up chart you shared, you can see how the card has become stronger step by step. At level 1, it starts with only the shield ability, where its ranged attack is 4, and its health is 6. At level 2, its health increases by 1 to 7. At level 3, it gains 1 armour, and at level 4, its armour increases by 2. But the interesting thing is that after reaching level 5, even though its armour drops to 1, it gains a huge ability like tank heal. This change may have been made mainly to maintain the balance of the card. Because after gaining tank heal, its usefulness has increased several times more than before. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfMzuxDQtboGtaREWjSMBmqVF55sGpLmtiRGTuroRXhhp/1779642549458.jpg) Some strategic advice can be given when using Calabash Sage. Since it is a ranged card and its speed is low, it is usually wise to keep it in the back row. It will launch heavy attacks from behind, as well as heal the tank in front. However, if a match has a close-range ruleset, it can also be effective from the front. At the current market price, the estimated value of this card at level 5 is around $0.72, which may seem quite affordable compared to its card ID and power production. In conclusion, if you are looking for a card in Life Splinter that will act as a damage dealer and healer at the same time, then Calabash Sage, level 5, is a great choice. If you can overcome its 10 mana limitation, it will make your deck much stronger. Especially in big fights where survival and regular attacks are equally important, Calabash Sage can be your trump card. For those who are thinking about this card for the first time, I believe that updating to level 5 will be the right decision. Its armour and speed will increase further in its later levels, which will make it even more irresistible in the future. If you use this card regularly in your gaming experience, you will understand its true greatness. My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi

title.title: Walking the Earth, Healing the Heart
title.body: > Every corner of the earth is very beautiful and a person can feel its beauty only when a person steps into every corner of the earth and explores the beauty with his own eyes. Today, when I left home for a walk in the afternoon, the weather was extremely hot, but despite the intense heat, my heart was telling me that I must walk and see the beautiful shrines of nature. Then I walked towards the fields of my village because it is summer, so the wheat harvest has been completed and the fields are deserted, no crops have been cultivated on them yet. When I went towards these open fields, I found these views both beautiful and lovely. I also felt that when the land is barren, it seems that the land has completely lost its beauty. But when we cultivate different crops on this beautiful land, the green and lush plants growing from these crops make this land beautiful. The beauty that is created by crops is the beauty of the human body and soul. ![IMG_20260524_185116.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSetMnwDNmjSYsrAtt7tV6sv85e1YqVRYsybBtLiUQhzC/IMG_20260524_185116.jpg) When beauty provides energy to the body and soul of a person, a person lives a peaceful life with the union of both the soul and the body. I was a little worried now because I could see very little greenery on the earth. But with this dream and the hope that after a few days, the farmers would grow new crops on this land and then water it, and in this way, this beautiful land that now seemed barren to me would become lush and green again. But one thing that was very beautiful was that as I walked forward, I saw that the farmers were plowing the land and some farmers were sowing seeds in the land and the land was getting water. Tube wells were running and this was a sign that these barren lands were now going to be inhabited. So this beautiful sight also filled my hopes that God willing, in a few days, these lush and green fields would start blooming again. When I saw water coming out of the tube wells, I was very happy that this land that seemed barren to me would be It is expected that it will become lush and green very soon, so we cannot experience these beautiful views while sitting at home. This thought that I am sharing with you now arises only when we go to every corner of the earth, see and feel it. ![IMG_20260524_183756.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaXycwEWV7Hmd3y83952V82n92v4iWTT94d2U9JFowYnC/IMG_20260524_183756.jpg) ![IMG_20260524_183741.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdgmQtNzDm2MpSetQcounaH57GPFSZFpoxVmXzrau3s8P/IMG_20260524_183741.jpg) Every person living on this earth is a complete book. If you ask anyone how they feel about the earth and its beauty, they will tell you their impressions. I often write one thing in my articles that life is very beautiful and we have to decorate this beautiful life like flowers and we are the ones who can make our own life beautiful and can make the lives of others beautiful too. One is our character, the second is our morals and the third is the hidden person inside us which is the hidden person inside. If the hidden person inside and the person seen outside are the same, then meeting such beautiful people is also a blessing from Allah and such friends are the capital of life. So I will say this. Just as the earth looks beautiful to us from above and when we sow seeds in it and this earth makes this seed a beautiful trunk and tree. Wherever we sow flower seeds, flowers grow from there. So just as the earth looks beautiful to us from above, the earth is also beautiful from within because whatever seeds we plant in it, We plant that seed and it comes out with the same beauty and then that tension also becomes a tree. The earth also feeds us with fruits and provides us with beautiful colors. This means that the earth is beautiful from the inside and outside. If we humans also feel this earth and walk on it and be enchanted, then this earth will also make us beautiful. We can feel all these things with our feelings, with our soul, with our daughter-in-law, only when we love this earth, who it is and where it is. The purpose of writing this article is only to share my feelings and emotions with all of you so that you feel my words and we express our love for this earth. When we step on this earth, this earth kisses our feet, welcomes us, loves us. Pray that we also love the earth. Restore the beauty of this earth. If we see trees anywhere on this earth, let us water the trees. Let us grow greenery on the earth. Let us grow flowers on the earth. Let us make this earth a garden so that whoever comes can feel the beauty of this earth. And then let us make our inner self beautiful, our outer self beautiful, make our tongue beautiful, and our hands beautiful so that no human being is hurt by any of our actions. We have to do everything that restores beauty and gives love to humanity. So I hope that you will like all these thoughts that I have written today. You will find them dear. Thank you very much to all of you.

title.title: Cherishing Family Time [ENG/ESP]
title.body:
>

Greetings, dear friends of this family community. I wish you all the best on this Sunday, when we Catholics celebrate Pentecost.

The Feast of Pentecost is celebrated fifty days after Christ’s Resurrection, which we commemorate during Holy Week, and symbolizes the coming of the Holy Spirit into our hearts.

Last night, I attended the vigil before the celebration with my family, where there was a Mass; we participated in the offertory, and at the end, those in attendance shared a meal together.

Religious values are very important because they help bring serenity to our bodies and nourishment to our souls. Furthermore, they foster solidarity among families and among fellow human beings.

The Mass was very well attended and ended around 10 p.m. Then we went to dinner at a place where we usually eat when we want something quick, and there we wrapped up the evening with conversation and small talk.

When we arrived at the restaurant, it was so crowded that we had to wait for a table to open up before we could sit down. They serve really good burgers and sandwiches there, and they always have special deals for large groups. That’s why people go there so often.

It was a special night, where we were able to enjoy both physical and spiritual nourishment.

Thank you for reading, and I hope to see you again soon.

Blessings to all

* Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A12

title.title: A Token Post
title.body:
I play a collectible card game—nay, the *original* collectible card game1—*Magic: The Gathering.* Some of its cards call for a player to create a [*token*](https://mtg.fandom.com/wiki/Token) creature or artifact, a game piece which is not itself one of the cards from their deck. Early on, players were encouraged to use dice, coins, or other objects. Later on, some booster packs began to include a token card relevant to the set printed on the back of the ubiquitous disposable advertisement cards people would otherwise throw away. Most players eventually collect quite a stack of tokens, but there is no guarantee you will have the specific ones needed for a given deck. I have several white 1/1 soldier tokens, 2/2 green wolf creature tokens, clue tokens, and so on, but sometimes I have a card with no corresponding token, or I may have only a single copy of a given token card, but need more than one to reference different creatures under different effects. What can I do? After weighing some options, I decided to open [Canva](www.canva.com) and try out a few ideas. I have some basic criteria. - No A.I. slop art - Try using real photos - Provide attribution - Make them resemble official token layout I used photos from [Pexels](www.pexels.com) because I liked what I found there better than my usual sources on [Pixabay,](www.pixabay.com) and they have a similar permissive license, so I hopefully avoid stepping on any uptight intellectual property toes. Copying is not theft, but avoiding legal bullshit is a good idea, and attribution is basic courtesy. I may make a template in [GIMP](www.gimp.org) and use some tools to play with the images a bit. Filters can make them look more like a painting, for example. Here are the results before I take things further.
![Green Squirrel.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/23tGbr1DguAa9D6P1nVHYSwsT6cUYBErBtF6xjieUjF4ZAjBtyuktxMSwTCZBRAmjHqMG.png)
# 1/1 green Squirrel I have a card called [Scurry Oak,](https://gatherer.wizards.com/MH2/en-us/172/scurry-oak) a Treefolk creature which says, in part, \
\n\nThis card creates a combo loop with [Ivy Lane Denizen,](https://gatherer.wizards.com/GTC/en-us/125/ivy-lane-denizen) which reads, \

This creates a sequence of squirrel-counter-squirrel-counter cycles as many times as I want. Maybe another effect like [Impact Tremors](https://gatherer.wizards.com/FDN/en-us/717/impact-tremors) pings my opponents as these squirrels swarm. Maybe I have a card in play like [Crashing Drawbridge](https://gatherer.wizards.com/TDC/en-us/316/crashing-drawbridge) which lets them all attack immediately and overwhelm my enemies with lethal cuteness damage. In any case, this is absolutely broken, and I can't wait to unleash the arboreal menace, but I need tokens, so here we are at the inspiration point for this project and this post. But I went ahead an made more as well. Also, [SQUIRREL!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xrAIGLkSMls) ***
![Black Assassin.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/23tH1CTKvAcQfW9Qi1CU4bXjZACBVjKVCV7cMSYeXSXUDaZivJF1zb8bHFRoCJWvTnWCU.png)
# 1/1 black Assassin I have another card called [Vraska the Unseen](https://gatherer.wizards.com/C19/en-us/207/vraska-the-unseen) with no corresponding token in my collection. She is a [*planeswalker,*](https://mtg.fandom.com/wiki/Planeswalker) and her ultimate ability creates three assassin tokens with the special rule, \

I mistyped the rule on this card. Oops.

I also had a more difficult time finding suitable art. Many of the photos of people have, for lack of better terminology, unnatural \

poses. I don't want someone casually holding a weapon like a *prop,* I don't want someone trying to look *sultry,*2 and while I can accept taking liberties with historical clothing in a fantasy setting, I didn't want it to look too *weird.* I think this turned out well enough. [It sure would be a shame if these assassins also could not be blocked...](https://gatherer.wizards.com/AVR/en-us/56/ghostform) ***
![Colorless Copy.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/23tbqBWtRGBZUAgroDTi8fT8niusxCFiQ32RwU8GBnC399z4gA4khgwFhhwGDFVSzWKzA.png)
# Copy I have many cards which create a copy of another creature as an effect, but no copies of the *Copy* token. It took a while to find anything even close to what I had in mind, and this is still a placeholde runtil I find something better. I tried searching for double exposure, reflection, and many other terms I hoped would find something I liked. No luck. I decided to just pick one that worked well for now and get on with it. Of course, I could also take an image I like and create a duplicate layer, or two photos from a set and play with layering, and use transparency to come up with something, but I think this will do for now. I also moved the text box to the bottom of the card under the assumption this would be placed under whatever it had copied, with the label protruding from the bottom, and I could just use dice if there were more than one copy. ***
![Red Ogre.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/23u5vRMZ8GhUN8RbWqrfBRmgTb14TCKY4Q1V8ew1gE6u3wePSWxdD8TAM1MjYRfrN8kMT.png)
# 3/3 red Ogre The last token I'll share here is for a card called [Kazuul, Tyrant of the Cliffs.](https://gatherer.wizards.com/MKC/en-us/157/kazuul-tyrant-of-the-cliffs) This is a great defensive card because whenever an opponent attacks, they have to pay a tax of 3 mana per attacking creature, or else I get free ogre tokens. Remember those assassins? If they were sent my way, and nothing was paid, they would fail and I would have a solid counterattack ready on my turn. Finding a picture for this was a challenge. I finally decided to use a photo of someone's [Krampus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Krampus) costume, even though it's more like a devil than an ogre. Again, this is placeholder art until I find something better. I also thought about diverging from my Pexels photo theme and trying some old art that was now in the public domain, but for now, I'm keeping everything the same *** # In Conclusion... If you want to use these tokens, just save the images and print them at 2.5\

(or 63x88mm), cut them  out. For best results, tuck them into a cheap card sleeve with a basic land card or one of those throwaway advertising inserts that *isn't* a token already as backing to give it some substance. If you put a different token image on each side, it can serve double duty!

Have you tried making custom cards for trading card games, or player/monster/npc pieces for role-playing games? What art or photos did you use, and why? Do you have any suggestions to update any of these cards, or image sources beyond Pixabay, Pexels, Unsplash, and Wikimedia? Do you want me to make a quick-and-dirty custom token in this style for your deck? Chime in with a comment.

**Footnotes (or 30-centimeter-notes<sup>3</sup> outside the US)**

1. Genuine human user of the em-dash here. Slop jockeys can't hope to match my ~~parenthetical~~ *em-dash-enthetical* remarks!

2. Although a cheesecake or beefcake image could add a distracting layer of psychological warfare to the game, right?

3. one inch is [defined](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_yard_and_pound) as 2.54 centimeters. Technically, 12 inches = 1 foot = 30.54 centimeters, and I wasted a footnote *in my footnotes* to explain this egregiously bad pun.

<center>![dizzy d20 128.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/AJpjAWe6WWYHcXp8dYj6WeYorLWmjkCw5XxLKJTdj5TSsknNLCemS8iQQLXCgAd.png)</center>

title.title: MY LIFE WITHOUT MY PHONE
title.body:
Hello everyone your welcome to my blog

life without smart phones will be kind of boring and this is because the smart phones which we are all using have provided for us liveliness more than anything else.

Without the smart phone, life would be so boring and no one would want to live in the past where our forefathers had once lived when to us in this generation is the most boring moment ever. Although to them, it is not.

The availability of smart phones has really made the world be at our palm and we can now connect to the whole world without travelling. Another thing is that everything needed, being it entertainment, sport, drama and to cap it all, social media is right there with us on our smart phones and with all these, there can never be a dull or boring moment.In the present world, we use various types of digital devices, one of which is a smart phone. Smartphones have made our lives much easier. This smartphone can now be called one of our blessings in the world. We can communicate from one place to another through smartphones. Basically, smartphones are used most in our world for communication. There are also many other uses of smartphones, but currently smartphones are most used for the Internet.

In fact, since the Internet was created, people have been using the Internet through these smartphones. And as a result of this Internet, a society has now become very addicted to smartphones. Especially we are a generation that is most addicted to social media. Almost many people in the current generation are now attracted to social media.‎Smartphones have really changed the world in ways we can not deny or neglect. Smartphones help us connect with people across countries within seconds. Stay in touch with families, grow online businesses, survive distance friendships and information is always at our fingertips. In many ways, smartphones brought the world closer together.


Thank you for stopping by my blog

title.title: My Worst Fear Realized: How Nigeria's Terrorism Crisis Reached My Doorstep
title.body:
>On the night of April 14–15, 2014, the news of a kidnapping struck the entire country, but it was miles away from home, and a lot of us felt it was too far from home. It was the story of the Missing Chibok Girls, and many people came out to protest, but those movements showed they were all politically influenced. Since then, there have been attacks in different villages, cities, and towns, from bombings to kidnappings and massacres.

\n\n

>As years went by, they started moving from up north to down north, then to the east. Every news I heard broke me, got me worried that people were losing their lives. When I discuss this event with people, I would always tell them íf the terrorism wasn't handled immediately, the southwestern part of the country would not be spared. People would always say there was nothing to worry about, and it was just nothrners killing themselves.

\n\n

>From one terrorist group, it became two, three, and now we have multiple ones with new ones emerging and regrouping. These people murder people in cold blood, torture people, and make them beg for death. They go to communities, pick up the young, old, and youth. They burn down people's homes, destroy places of prayer, and so on, and they kept attacking from one state to another.

\n\n

>I felt a little safe and was hopeful that the government would fight this terrorism because I knew it could come down south west if not tackled once and for all. At the beginning of the year, I began hearing news of the bandits, or basically, terrorists, finding their way southwest, and I started to say this was the beginning of my fear becoming a reality. We still believed there was a possibility it was a rumor, and we held on to the faith that they weren't in our region, not until the past week when these terrorists went to a primary school, kidnapped both teachers and students aged 6 months to 10 years old, and beheaded a teacher.

\n\n

>The news and the horrific video sent shock and terror through our community. People began to pray and ask questions. Now I'm living in constant fear. The incident occurred just miles from where I live. I fear for my life and have stayed home all week. I'm terrified of losing myself, traumatizing my family, or enduring torture at the hands of these evil people. I am genuinely frightened.

title.title: My First Cross-Country Drive in a Tesla (Part 1)
title.body:
<center> 
![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23yThZieHS9e1hwyVAqmEC9TK5Gqj3f8qh5B7G96MqV88KSLp6cMPQUinNuAsQcEjAahS.jpg)
</center>

A few days ago we embarked on a four day, nearly 1600 mile cross-country drive, in my 2026 Tesla Model Y. Over the next few blog posts I’ll highlight some of the sites, experiences on the trip, as well as my thoughts on road tripping in an electric vehicle. 

<center> 
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23y8qSM3C5MCaYLtaCLZosYx3is1nV8sVB9zHdETgTcDYvfbuV8L38oAd4cbcPDGervVN.jpg)
</center>


Although I’ve been an EV owner since 2022, this is my first proper road trip in an electric vehicle. As much as I tried to prepare and educate myself beforehand, nothing taught me better than the actual experience of getting behind the wheel and driving—or should I say supervising the car as it drove itself. 

<center> ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/242426D3cU2N89KREjTi4N5GLVapjDbmCNPWek2VCFNxoutjEoYGd5YBtZZyeV8nXUzdN.jpg) </center>




Throughout the entire trip to Sedona, Arizona Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (FSD v14.2.2.5) did about 98% of the driving for us. We simply typed our final destination for the day into the car’s navigation system and the computer calculated where we should stop to charge and how much charge would be needed at each stop. FSD even pulled the car into the charging stalls when we arrived.  

<center> 
![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23xpCmwvdT1kRFj7dscTRikZA91PxqHcXn2vAv45BLx9ty8Hw77P6bnJRJFAu5ow9wjhG.jpg)
</center>


This series won’t be a Tesla fan boy glossing over what features of the car and the tech could be better. In this series I’m going to try to put it all on the table and explain what the tech did right and also where it failed. I’ll also share some of the practical and useful things I’ve learned about during my first long road trip in a Tesla. 

In the end I'll be sharing some stats like how much it cost us to charge the car during our trip versus what we would have paid for gasoline and how much time charging added to our trip. 

Our first day of driving was from Minnesota to Grand Island, NE and just shy of five hundred miles and almost 9.5 hours on the road. We quickly learned that Nebraska was known for a couple things—corn and cattle. 

<center> 
![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23zS9kThVaLnrbeDqWsKjh96UapUxV33P42jgh9dYRuBz4Xxvc2grTK1JveRKAake3LnR.jpg)
</center>

Thankfully, Nebraska didn't have as many of the the huge corporate feed lot operations that we experienced on previous drives through Texas, Oklahoma, and Texas. 

I charged the Model Y to 100% at home the night before we hit the road. We pay about $.18 per KwH on our home charger so this would equate to about $4.00 to top the battery off in preparation for the trip. 

The Tesla navigation told us we needed to charge three times during our drive. 

<center> 
![Trip.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ericvancewalton/23tmScFMULLrET4woCybz6CiSh75nAzurLxxCrnLfxXDrCBM24aoEAHvGuG1BS8DEQP9d.jpg)
</center>

As you can see from the photo above the computer had us arriving at the last three charge stations with only 10% charge (30 miles of range). I wasn't comfortable cutting it that close so I added another 10% at these stops so we'd be arriving at the next charger with at least 25% (75 miles of range). 

Tesla's nav had us arriving most times with only 10% of charge. If I were to have one complaint our first day it would be I wish the navigation system didn't cut it quite so close. You should have the freedom to set minimum arrival percentages at each charger. Better safe than sorry I say. 







## Charging Costs ##

The costs to Supercharge along the route our first day of driving were as follows:

Worthington, MN - $8.00 
Sioux City, IA $9.78
Norfolk, NE $5.86
*Total: $23.64*

**Total distance driven**- 485 miles. 

For comparison, our Subaru Forester Hybrid gets roughly 40mpg on the highway. If we had driven it instead it would have used about 13 gallons of gas at an average price of $4.80 a gallon or $62.40. 

# Drive Time ##

The trip would have taken around 7hrs, 12min in the Forester plus stops for restrooms and food. 

In the Tesla it took 8hrs, 9min. Additional stops (which we would have had to do in the Forester too) and charging a little extra made it more like a 9hr, 40min day of driving. 

**Total Fuel Cost Savings** - $38.76
**Total Time** - The Tesla added about 1.5hrs to our driving day over a gasoline powered vehicle. 

## Final Thoughts ##

I can't tell you how impressed I was with how well the Full Self Driving performed. It did all the driving and I felt more like a passenger in a train than a driver of a vehicle. I could relax and take in the sights around me. I arrived at the end of the day feeling so much less stressed and fatigued. 

Stayed tuned for Day 2 of the journey, coming soon! 

## Please let me know if you have any, specific questions about road tripping in an EV. ##









All for now. Thanks so much for reading. 


---

title.title: Exploring Stories Through Diptychs & Triptychs
title.body:
A new exhibition is loading and I need to be prepared.

I will be taking part (hopefully) if some or any of my photos are selected by the instructors.

In class we have started to do more interesting but also challenging workshops and discuss more about Photography. Photography has always been more than a single frozen moment. Photography is about the story it conveys.

Sometimes one image is enough to tell a story,  but sometimes a second or third frame reveals connections, contrasts, emotions, and hidden meanings that a lone photograph cannot fully express. A photographer is more than an artist, they are a story teller.  And to achieve this, one image is not always enough. 

For our exhibition, we are asked to provide images for three different themes. 
Heraklion, Diptychs, Elderly 

I can easily do the 1, and maybe 2 .. but not sure about the third one.

In this post, I will explore some options about diptychs (or triptychs)

Do you know what this word means? Have you ever used it?

> The word diptych comes from the Greek “δίπτυχον” (díptychon), meaning “folded in two.” In the ancient world, diptychs were often made from two hinged wooden panels covered with wax, used for writing notes, official records, or religious art. Later, during the Byzantine and medieval periods, artists used diptychs to create devotional works that connected two scenes or ideas together.

> A triptych follows the same concept but with three connected panels. The term comes from the Greek “τρίπτυχον” (tríptychon), meaning “folded in three.” Triptychs became especially important in religious art across Europe, where central panels were often surrounded by two complementary scenes that expanded the story visually.

----


<center>![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbMm4GYB1hxmv8GiW1oDjsnCax83m75in9mnPjXiPJPCP/image.png) 
Image 1</center>

The problem I have lately is that I cannot find much time to plan new photos, unless I am at a specific place, where I shoot what is around me. So I cannot set up new images, so for the upcoming exhibition I will need to work with what I have and send them up to the 31st of May.

title.title: DEC Lower Bound (May 2026)
title.body:
<center>
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNFWBEi2Jg1Db3H8TU3BzmJCPevfKpg8xFANhSpD711U/image.png)
</center>

I know I am not the only one seeing the free fall in DEC prices.  Even as Hive has stabilize the value of DEC is going down.  This in turn has made a lot of Splinterlands assets a lot more affordable for new comers.  Meanwhile existing players are seeing our assets' values decay almost on a daily basis.

The challenge is how can we hold up DEC value so that existing holders and long term investors can maintain assets value?  That is the million dollar question.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSW5VpTqFX3q5u9xukZTTCmQv9sgr1JEbFYEhTCtQWSAV/image.png)

Trend of DEC is even falling as SPS has held its price.  This is proof that without capping DEC supply the overall value of DEC will likely continue to inflate making overall ecosystem assets lose value.

It maybe as easy as capping DEC supply.  How can this be.  I think the developers have already been doing that with introduction of tokens like Glint.  As more assets are printed there will have to be alternatives to creating new tokens.  The more tokens approach does not seem to be helping in the long term.

DEC was suppose to peg in a ratio to the USD.  It has fail to hold and continue to be stressed by the day.  It maybe time to limit burning assets for more DEC by capping how much can be burned.  It may be a temporary solution to limit DEC sell off but in the long run we need a way to maintain DEC prices or the whole ecosystem will continue to devalue.

Thanks for reading this post!
