title.title: Bancarización en Cuba, un problema viejo con nuevos matices
title.body: >Saludos para todos. Muchos cubanos bromeaban con el nombre del año 2026, decían que era “el año del poste”, porque el cable lo habíamos comido en 2025. Nada más real. El año 2026 pinta como el más crudo de los últimos 20 años. Y aunque es cierto que el cubano se ríe de sus desgracias, creo que hasta la fecha ya tenemos bastante de qué reírnos; incluso más de uno debe haberse desvivido de tanta risa.Entrando en materia, hace un tiempo el tema de la bancarización en Cuba se convirtió en tendencia.

>Desde 2023 hasta hoy ha pasado de todo: comenzamos con la negativa de muchos pequeños negocios a aceptar pagos electrónicos, y luego este proceso se convirtió en ley y pasó a ser obligatorio. La digitalización de los procesos bancarios, el paso del efectivo al dinero digital, no fue algo natural, sino un proceso forzado. Se demostró que no estábamos preparados, pero había que empezar en algún momento, porque difícilmente estaremos listos para cualquier cambio importante en temas de economía dentro del contexto cubano.Por aquella fecha la situación era muy distinta a la actual. La de ahora es cien veces más compleja: apenas queda efectivo en el sistema bancario, hay problemas logísticos por el déficit de combustible y constantes fallos de conexión debido a la generación eléctrica del país.

>El escenario está mucho más complicado porque el sector estatal de servicios prácticamente no existe. El comercio minorista no ofrece productos; lo que normalmente llegaba a la bodega, como la canasta familiar normada, ya no llega y solo se distribuyen productos de donación de países amigos. Esto deja al sector estatal en una muy mala posición frente al sector privado, que a cualquier costo sigue prestando servicios. Al final, quien paga es el consumidor.Las principales problemáticas en la aceptación de pagos y el funcionamiento del sistema bancario giran en torno al uso del efectivo. Por un lado, para facilitar la evasión fiscal y la subdeclaración de muchos actores económicos, y por otro (igual de importante), como fuente de aprovisionamiento para obtener dólares y realizar importaciones de materias primas y productos listos para la venta.

>El entramado económico del mercado informal ha sacado de circulación los billetes de alta denominación del sistema bancario y los de baja denominación en las operaciones diarias. Hoy es casi imposible que una persona vaya a un mercado mayorista y pague con transferencia o con billetes menores a 100 pesos. Si se aceptan, es solo en cantidades muy reducidas.

>Considero que el sistema bancario en Cuba debe facilitar el acceso a las divisas a través de procesos legales y transparentes. Se han dado algunos pasos, pero el proceso de compra de dólares sigue siendo lento e ineficiente, todo lo contrario a la dolarización de la economía, que avanza a pasos agigantados. Creo que emitir billetes de alta denominación como los recientes de 2.000 y 5.000 pesos fue un grave error, porque va en contra del proceso de bancarización. Si me preguntan, sacaría de circulación estos billetes junto con los de 1.000 y 500 CUP que hoy circulan. Eso dejaría casi como única opción el pago digital, aunque agravaría el problema de acceso a las transferencias cuando no hay conexión. La vida ha demostrado que quien solo lleva dinero en el móvil se queda sin nada cuando no hay cobertura, y con más de 20 horas diarias sin electricidad, imaginen lo difícil que puede ser. Aun así, considero que es un escenario mucho más favorable que el actual.

>¿Qué opinas sobre el tema? ¿Estás de acuerdo conmigo? Cuéntame tu opinión y qué otras medidas crees que se podrían aplicar.

\n\n

title.title: PlayStation Bundle Pickup
title.body:
It has become a weekly ritual to go to a local car boot sale, which takes place every Saturday, not far from where we live.

Myself, Aimee's dad, Kaleb and Ollie usually go on these little adventures. Kaleb loves going out there, and it's a great way to spend a few hours walking in the morning sun and fresh air.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVdf6uxf3oN3Nu9kRsZ4DaEjCbx4Yhi3HVnbnkwQ5Y8bs/1779616661729.jpg)

#### <center> Here is my most recent pickup. </center>

There was a guy who had a stack of games, mainly PlayStation 2 and PlayStation 3. I flicked through them, asked about the price, and he replied €3 each.

I picked out these ones and checked the discs, which were in great condition. As well as that, all of the games came with their manuals. 

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSujfsidvFLGXRdXhGgHD7U5p7W4Wq72WxH2wGHw9xNjr/1779616661827.jpg)

#### <center> This is one I bought for myself. </center>

I have wanted to play Resistance for a long time. I used to own a copy of it back in the day, and traded it, and pretty much all of my PlayStation 3 games in to buy Halo: Reach when that released. 

This is set in the 1940s/ 1950s, post World War II, but there is a planet-wide alien invasion, so you have to fight to save Humanity and find out who the aliens are and what they want. 

That's essentially all I remember from it, but it was good as far as I can recall, and people seemed to enjoy as 2 more games were released after this one.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZEULJX5by2F51fetuFzCNyVjM3Ywbs8KdPSzCJoib2Gf/1779616661920.jpg)

#### <center> This is another game I used to have back in the day. </center>

This was my first entry into the God of War games back then, and I really enjoyed it, but I don't think I ever completed it.

I never got into the PlayStation 3 in a big way when I was younger, because all of my friends and clans were on the Xbox 360, which kept me on that console.

PlayStation to me was always more of a single-player console, which was fine. But, back then, I preferred multiplayer and the social aspect of gaming. 

Now, though, I spend some time on single-player games, playing 1-2 hours here and there in the evenings when everyone is asleep.

Even if I wanted to reconnect with some old friends and get some sessions in, I couldn't, because I can't speak properly while Aimee and Ollie are asleep beside me.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQQrMDawyzNbCo81hL73PKKSN7cAnCymVaxdFKnGysZU3/1779616661991.jpg)

#### <center> I've never played Kingdom Hearts, so I though these would be a good chance to have a go at them. </center>

I owned the first 2 on the PlayStation 2 and had the intention of playing them, as I've heard they are decent games. However, they sold before I got a chance, which is a shame, but it is what it is. 

In fact, that has happened a bunch of times to me with games. So, what I do now is list some games higher than the average price, so I have more time to play them.

body.title: les volets et 'le monstre', la colonne, les impots, spectacle en plein air
body.body:
![A4DDAA2D-9BE8-4DFA-B680-AEAF361B094C_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/EoGytEVzxRLEDxR5RuUSbYYVq4EW9dtpL2CQUXYSuiPRVXNXegW4UVaU2mjvKYCUdJ3.jpeg)
Franck -de schilder- is lekker bezig. Aan de cour-zijde zijn de luiken aan de linkerzijde allemaal verwijderd en die worden in zijn atelier geschuurd en afgelakt, ze worden weer vrolijk groen. Het is nu wel even een kale boel zonder de luiken, en we missen ze een beetje omdat het best al weer warm is: een paar dagen boven de dertig graden.

![154C56A7-E752-4163-B5AB-D100A06E3244_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23ywo39pdqWUTZ8iVoEU4ezt5c7ut38SV9ZVno4mGBthyLbsR88t22f8x8h68aZwTzv5E.jpeg)
Franck loopt veel heen en weer tussen zijn atelier en ons huis, gelukkig is het maar 100 meter van elkaar vandaan. 's-Ochtends werkt hij in de schaduw bij ons in de cour aan de kozijnen en de ramen op zijn 'tour Casin' (zijn achternaam is Casin, vandaar). In de middag 'vlucht' hij naar zijn koelere atelier/garage, lekker in de schaduw. Omdat we hem goed kennen, heeft hij de sleutel en hij loopt te pas en te onpas binnen, erg handig!

![90FC2C74-03BC-491C-AACC-4BB9C1C65133_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23tmLEUryvJBxsAMAD6VDNWCc1R6McDSHKZaHp4rbf8fxmRBfzeLXHJcCmbqbtebJxspE.jpeg)
Vrijdag zaten we aan het eind van de dag even een biertje met elkaar te drinken en toen zei Franck dat hij maandag met 'le monstre' wilde gaan beginnen. Le monstre is de achterdeur, zie foto hierboven. Groot en zwaar en overduidelijk aan een nieuw verfje toe, al is het hout nog in uitstekende staat. We zijn benieuwd.

#### La colonne
![A52564DB-C41D-4378-BCE3-711BFE8E841A_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/AJpiFKRYsXtaDZpN219TEWQZSo4Seq3Loda43LRsnbooFJwGbHKs8dkiDzfK9pY.jpg)
Een ander monster was een zware marmeren kolom, die Bart al een paar maanden geleden had gekocht. Die stond nog steeds in de entreehal, want dat ding is zwaar, zwaar! We weten het niet precies, we denken tussen de 100 en 150 kilo.... Oeps, niet iets wat Bart en ik samen even naar boven tillen. Bart had aan Franck gevraagd of hij samen met zijn apprentis -leerling- Mauri wilden helpen. Dus vrijdag met zijn drieen die kolom de trap op gehesen. We zijn blij dat we zo'n transportkarretje met zes wielen hebben, die je dus de trap op kan 'rijden'. Maar die ruim honderd kilo moet je dus wel even naar boven duwen/trekken. Treedje voor treedje: un..deux..trois.. Allez-hop...En zo stond ze eindelijk op de eerste verdieping!

![6695441B-046B-4B22-8CBD-6B6199C8D8D2_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23y8seeAVzUqKCMYNFDp2N3MRSauarLGxLZ1PhQcM1FLKJnEcFXmppBnFGufBFTFRaafG.jpeg)

#### Emigratieformulieren
![C877AD32-84F6-432E-B27D-88B5FF90EE4A_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/EoGyuKsR1WztX1GHQYeAYrXcbUYYAcecaop96DZ7VeoBrxP5mLnErwoD1fVsReNNHrd.jpeg)
Deze week werd er een enorme stapel enveloppen afgeleverd. Ruim 1,5 kilo papier van de NLse Belastingdienst, jullie herkennen vast de kleur van de enveloppen. Heeelp... voor onze emigratie alles op papier invullen, dat is twintig jaar terug in de tijd zeg! Het kan wel online, maar alleen als je maar één bedrijf hebt... en dat hebben we niet.

Toen ik de stapel uitpakte, zag ik dat we een viertal M-formulieren hadden gekregen, maar ook een tweetal F-formulieren. Ik dacht: dat is raar.... dus dat heb ik even nagekeken, blijkt dat de F-formulieren zijn voor mensen die zijn overleden. Oeps, foutje. Dus maar weer gebeld met de belastingdienst buitenland, en vroeg of ze een voorzienende blik hadden met die F-formulieren. De mevrouw van de belastingdienst schoot in de lach, maar zei wel meteen \

.

Gestart ben ik met het invullen.. maar jeetje zeg, dit is echt tig-jaar terug in de tijd: alle vakjes weer goed lezen, welke vragen kan je overslaan enzovoort. Vervolgens de rekensommen: tel 33a plus 47j minus 55m keer 78i, en allemaal van dat soort berekeningen. Om een punthoofd van te krijgen. Ik hoop dat het lukt voor 1 juli...!

#### Spectacle en plein air
Vandaag stonden we voeg op, het is weer ruim boven de dertig graden hier, dus de ochtenden zijn het lekkerst! Een van onze favoriete grote 'puces' (brocante) was vandaag, in La Gardiolle. Dat wordt daar gehouden in een groot bos met ruime plekken, en niet onbelangrijk veel schaduw! We struinden even rond en hebben een paar leuke oude schilderijlijstjes gescoord. 

![IMG_7070.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23zRrCuNueg2Lup7WKfvgjLCScB42GCciE6nxwmhp1dpe3PMUnxaBEpsEebBkWHrtigJb.jpeg)

We konden niet al te lang, want om elf uur werden we verwacht bij de Prieuré de Cézas voor een buitenvoorstelling. De organisatie van de vrienden van de Prieuré bestaat dit jaar veertig jaar, en dat werd groots gevierd. Het theater van Ganges had twee buitenvoorstellingen georganiseerd. Ik was blij dat ik de vroege voorstelling had geboekt, want nu was het nog lekker aangenaam in het bos.
![IMG_7072.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/AKApWhwWU41y9c97tgE3wZ5zMuzdd8wezzDsKZWyEczRF9N6xLTymPMnLNyvGAP.jpeg)
Vanaf de parkeerplaats wandelden we met alle toeschouwers naar boven, naar de prieuré, en we kregen verschillende uitleg over de restauratie van de prieuré om na een kwartier bij het buitentheater aan te komen.  Het was een fraai dansspektakel, wat op de grond begon en vervolgens grotendeels in de lucht afspeelde tussen de bomen en een groot 'spinnenweb'.

![ECADD875-4287-4195-BD6E-F010344386C1_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23u5zfipkqp5LrJY9Q9ShJX1md2wDyDEJgeXG54dhHd5y9hxHU1Wjb1Hmp11FZdM5NU2d.jpg)
Na de dansvoorstelling hadden ze naast de kapel van de Prieuré een optreden van drie dames die prachtig zongen. We hadden wel een beetje meelij met hen, want zij zaten volop in de zon met hun zwarte kleding. Na alle uitvoerige bedankjes aan iedereen en alles (dat kunnen de fransen altijd heel goed en heel lang....) konden we eindelijk gaan picnicken. We hadden best trek, want we hadden al om zeven uur ontbeten. Het is een heerlijke plek zo tussen de bomen op de berg om te eten!

Na dit alles reden we weer terug naar huis voor een lekkere siesta. Tot mijn 'schrik' zag ik dat ik 38 appjes had gemist van mijn twee vriendinnetjes die ik aanstaande woensdag in Parijs zie. Bij thuiskomst nog het een en ander met hen afgestemd, zodat we woensdag alledrie lekker relaxt aan ons tripje kunnen beginnen. Het gaat alle dagen dertig graden worden... dat beloofd wat..!

body.title: Steam is giving away a ¿rabbit-catapult game? for FREE [ ENG - ESP ]
body.body:
Gracias por pasar, version en español abajo ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tGa9DNM6EQJskXgqXdKVyZifvbeDfbCi4nqyP9MdGhH8MVdWd2wtF7qKEe2ndTdPD1H.png) --- Steam has once again surprised gamers with one of those strange and eye-catching promotions that end up becoming viral phenomena. This time, the spotlight is on *Bunny Hurling*, a peculiar indie game where the main objective is to capture rabbits, load them into a catapult, and launch them into the air while surviving various dangers amidst a forest full of secrets. Best of all, it can currently be claimed completely free on Steam and kept in your library forever—though the offer is available for a limited time only. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wXDv69SoyUdZogiJfDGcvQgTEC7gws8p5qGBXZcSy7pdGXzxND1sntnd5fbshq612HW.png) --- Valve's platform has become a regular venue for these types of promotions. Many indie studios take advantage of Steam's massive visibility to showcase their projects by temporarily giving away their games. Thanks to this, thousands of users have been able to expand their digital libraries without spending a dime. On this occasion, *Bunny Hurling* has garnered particular attention due to its absurd and amusing premise—something that quickly piqued the curiosity of the gaming community. Although at first glance it appears to be a humorous game without much depth, the reality is that *Bunny Hurling* blends stealth, exploration, and action mechanics. Players must use a special whistle to lure rabbits, capture them, and subsequently launch them using catapults to complete various missions. However, the forest is not empty: --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wBgMXmdD7bKCdJiJxvc7N28EPkokjU2qTpttpNFvci41dm9QR8FXDMcDZRxKkVCRPCV.png) --- Hostile creatures, ghosts, and enemies also appear, complicating the journey. The ultimate goal is to confront the King, who controls this strange world filled with chaos and absurd situations. Another interesting aspect is that the title aims for a short but entertaining experience. According to initial user impressions, the adventure can be completed in less than two hours, making it an ideal choice for those looking for something quick and unique. Despite not yet having thousands of reviews, the initial feedback on Steam is mostly positive—a significant achievement for an indie project of this style. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tkhySRX9aktxLa4TUPazRgbm9jZBTCbMCDaAkGwLoNDTJmn7okGLkZ1h7dd7sVzyE27.png) --- To get the game, simply visit the Steam page and click the “Add to Account” button. Once done, *Bunny Hurling* will be permanently linked to the user's library, even after the promotion ends. An important detail is that the offer expires on May 25th at 7:00 PM (Spanish time), so anyone interested should claim it before that date. In addition to *Bunny Hurling*, Steam and other platforms are offering several free titles over the coming days. Among the most notable is *Car Mechanic Simulator 2018*, a simulation game highly regarded by fans of automotive mechanics. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tbRgmcqkAG1f24ZNcKBt5xnG9MDEkwKgaxRq46i9o6NfvUgGDdA4cHipEHhFUjw8pi9.png) --- Also featured is *Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Relics of War*, available for free as part of the Warhammer Skulls 2026 event. Meanwhile, the Epic Games Store continues its game giveaways, currently offering *Tomb Raider I-III Remastered* alongside *Down in Bermuda* at no additional cost.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)






### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tGa9DNM6EQJskXgqXdKVyZifvbeDfbCi4nqyP9MdGhH8MVdWd2wtF7qKEe2ndTdPD1H.png) --- Steam vuelve a sorprender a los jugadores con una de esas promociones extrañas y llamativas que terminan convirtiéndose en fenómenos virales. Esta vez, el protagonista es Bunny Hurling, un peculiar juego independiente donde el objetivo principal consiste en capturar conejos, cargarlos en una catapulta y lanzarlos por los aires mientras sobrevives a peligros en medio de un bosque lleno de secretos. Lo mejor de todo es que actualmente puede reclamarse completamente gratis en Steam y quedarse para siempre en la biblioteca, aunque la oferta estará disponible solo por tiempo limitado. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wXDv69SoyUdZogiJfDGcvQgTEC7gws8p5qGBXZcSy7pdGXzxND1sntnd5fbshq612HW.png) --- La plataforma de Valve se ha convertido en un lugar habitual para este tipo de promociones. Muchos estudios indie aprovechan la enorme visibilidad de Steam para dar a conocer sus proyectos regalando temporalmente sus juegos. Gracias a eso, miles de usuarios han conseguido ampliar sus bibliotecas digitales sin gastar dinero. En esta ocasión, Bunny Hurling ha llamado especialmente la atención debido a su premisa absurda y divertida, algo que rápidamente despertó curiosidad entre la comunidad gamer. Aunque a simple vista parece un juego humorístico sin demasiada profundidad, la realidad es que Bunny Hurling mezcla mecánicas de sigilo, exploración y acción. Los jugadores deben utilizar un silbido especial para atraer a los conejos, atraparlos y posteriormente lanzarlos usando catapultas para cumplir distintas misiones. Sin embargo, el bosque no está vacío: --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wBgMXmdD7bKCdJiJxvc7N28EPkokjU2qTpttpNFvci41dm9QR8FXDMcDZRxKkVCRPCV.png) --- también aparecen criaturas hostiles, fantasmas y enemigos que complican el recorrido. El objetivo final es enfrentarse al Rey, quien controla este extraño mundo lleno de caos y situaciones absurdas. Otro aspecto interesante es que el título apuesta por una experiencia corta pero entretenida. Según las primeras impresiones de los usuarios, la aventura puede completarse en menos de dos horas, convirtiéndose en una propuesta ideal para quienes buscan algo rápido y diferente. A pesar de no contar todavía con miles de reseñas, las opiniones iniciales dentro de Steam son mayormente positivas, algo bastante importante para un proyecto indie de este estilo. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tkhySRX9aktxLa4TUPazRgbm9jZBTCbMCDaAkGwLoNDTJmn7okGLkZ1h7dd7sVzyE27.png) --- Para obtener el juego, únicamente hay que entrar a la página de Steam y pulsar el botón de “Añadir a la cuenta”. Una vez hecho eso, Bunny Hurling quedará asociado permanentemente a la biblioteca del usuario incluso cuando la promoción termine. El detalle importante es que la oferta finaliza el 25 de mayo a las 19:00 hora de España, por lo que quienes estén interesados deben reclamarlo antes de esa fecha. Además de Bunny Hurling, Steam y otras plataformas están ofreciendo varios títulos gratuitos durante estos días. Entre los más destacados se encuentra Car Mechanic Simulator 2018, un simulador muy valorado por los fans de la mecánica automotriz. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tbRgmcqkAG1f24ZNcKBt5xnG9MDEkwKgaxRq46i9o6NfvUgGDdA4cHipEHhFUjw8pi9.png) --- También aparece Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Relics of War, disponible gratis como parte del evento Warhammer Skulls 2026. Por otro lado, la Epic Games Store continúa regalando juegos y actualmente ofrece Tomb Raider I-III Remastered junto a Down in Bermuda sin costo adicional.

body.title: Roboty jak marasu
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYJ5SCy7wCV8pSPLjwbFxz4W7jiYYWckX4UL5XnPBcJUm/dfuns_2026_05_24_171754d2ba6c251a81.jpg)

Im bardziej rozwija się KBK, tym mniej jest czasu. Ot, paradoks, bo kiedyś wydawało mi się, że ogarnięcie kilku rzeczy pozwoli mi zająć się innymi. Tymczasem co rusz na horyzoncie pojawia się jakieś nowe wyzwanie.

Obecnie najważniejsze rzeczy do zrobienia (oprócz tych związanych ze zbliżającymi się obchodami rocznic) to:
- wdrożenie jakiegoś systemu \

nad darczyńcami i zwiększenie stałego wsparcia KBK (obecnie 61% darowizn nie jest przypisane do żadnego konta rycarowego),
- uporządkowanie narracji.

Druga kwestia wydaje się o tyle kluczowa, że zdecydowanie może wpływać na pierwszą. Rok temu zredefiniowaliśmy KBK. Ogłosiliśmy niepodległość i ruszyliśmy z narracją o \
. To był bardzo dobry ruch, bo w połączeniu z rebrandingiem przyciągnął do Królestwa wiele nowych osób. O ile jednak \
ma spory potencjał marketingowy, o tyle w temacie crowdfundingu niewiele zmienia. Tu o wiele bardziej pomocna wydaje się być koncepcja \

sformułowana przez R. Oldenburga. Królestwo jest takim miejscem: otwartym, dostępnym, ze spontanicznymi dyskusjami i społecznością. W dobie zanikających relacji społecznych takie miejsca są na wagę złota. I tu jest spore pole do działania, aby w końcu odpowiednio to wybrzmiało.\n\nCzy to wystarczy? Obawiam się, że nie. Obie narracje stanowią duży krok w próbie zdefiniowania Królestwa i opowiedzenia czym ono jest. Intuicja jednak podpowiada mi, że aby skutecznie trafić do ludzi KBK musi uwalniać emocje. Zarówno niepodległość, jak i trzecie miejsce nie są w stanie zrobić tego na odpowiednim poziomie. Potrzeba trzeciej narracji, która pozwoli wycisnąć więcej. Ale o tym w kolejnym wpisie...

body.title: Leaf-footed bug (Cletus trigonus)
body.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Cletus trigonus*** | May 19, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjabKWcYY8EmV1e4bqqgTWjd2iBuHgVSsssqmLvJYVhb/mix_20260524_213539.jpg)


The biggest advantage of gardening in a village environment is that you get to meet new insects every day. Today, I will introduce you to a strangely shaped brown insect, which I took a picture of in my own garden.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQYkyAasfkWmQybAqA9EwJuAVmhdkUpoUU9Nc8PmE18GK/mix_20260524_213635.jpg)

Name and identification:
After taking the picture, I used iNaturalist, a reliable insect identification app, to find out its exact identity. Its scientific name is ***Cletus trigonus***. According to the classification of scientists, it is a member of the '**Coreidae**' family and its genus or genus is Cletus. In English, they are usually called '**Leaf-footed bug'** or leaf-footed bug.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVoQW6QZtaQSEdBBVjJW6qTeDYsPkvMW5hr4YkKWoG81p/mix_20260524_214749.jpg)

Habitat and habitat:
The native habitat of this species of insects is mainly in our Asian continent. They are especially seen in various countries of Southeast Asia, including India and Bangladesh. Their main habitat is shrubs, crop fields and gardens of various leguminous plants. However, sometimes they fly and sit on ordinary trees near the house and rest.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQVaBV1YpKznhbLswB3PVgEai8epESNVj1f7duzo4MpH4/mix_20260524_214238.jpg)

​Food:
They do not bite or chew leaves like other insects. If you look at their mouth, you will see that they have a long needle-like part. They are completely vegetarian. With this needle-like mouth, they continuously suck the liquid sap inside the young leaves, stems or fruits of the plant.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbbPdFjjonULdAxJUa51gH5UwPACb5q4E9v6kPzCYu1fQ/mix_20260524_214522.jpg)

​Reproduction:
Their reproduction process is quite simple. Female insects usually lay eggs on the underside of the leaves or stems of the plant. The small children (called nymphs) that hatch from the eggs look a lot like the adult insects, only they do not have wings. After changing their shells several times, they turn into full-fledged insects and can fly with wings.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZxU3NDUCc6LT6q5wUapNkrjqQFUpeT3bR1r4Sfz8YoBo/mix_20260524_213903.jpg)

​Benefits:
Although they do not directly benefit humans, they play a silent role in maintaining the ecosystem or food chain of nature. These types of insects serve as very important food for the survival of various garden spiders, frogs, lizards or small birds.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZhe922reRVP3UW4X4uF3VPy1QYVtsVRmcgoyNw7WrETT/mix_20260524_213721.jpg)

Harmfulness:
They are a type of harmful pest for farmers. Because they suck the sap of the plant, the young tips of the plant become weak. They can cause a lot of damage, especially in the fields of various pulse crops (such as peas or beans).

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaapv5CiaKa4t6pTCwqutDmKgBuHdRksG3EZVkcR3S71c/mix_20260524_213928.jpg)

Every small animal in nature has such beautiful life histories. Be sure to tell us in the comments how you liked the pictures of this broad-shouldered insect.

I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)

![5400.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oblivioncubed/5400.jpg)

It has been a busy but fun weekend so far.

We did a big bike ride through a nearby park, which is where the top photo is from.

I dug out one of our two raised garden beds on Saturday and did the first mow of the season, now that my grass is finally dry after two full days of rain mid-last-week.

I was interrupted by my kids calling, telling me that my TV wasn't turning on. 

I did a bit of fiddling around with the standard tests to see what was going on, and it looks like my backlight LEDs are burned out. That is a repairable problem, if I have the right tools, which I don't. 

Unfortunately, that means it's time for a new TV. It's purely a coincidence that I could only find one that was 3 inches larger while being cheap and decent quality. 

So, I'm off to the city just after the eldest finishes soccer practice to pick up a new TV which I'll have to mount later today.

Y para ponerlos a prueba de lo buenos que son es haciendo un dibujo.* # > Hello everyone! Today I'm going to show you the drawing quality of a brand of colored pencils I bought. Another thing I liked was the price, because lately I've noticed that colored pencils usually cost between $2 and $5. It's not so much the price, it's the quality. Most colored pencils are for school use, and some aren't suitable for good drawing. I also saw that they're pastel colors, so I decided to take a chance and see if they would work for my needs. To test their quality, I'll be doing a drawing. ---

body.title: How much would a game like Holozing cost today?
body.body:
![dqwdwefwef.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xeoxqc6JMSgfoncAxD54TWQseXsW7c9hXrf7XpES2GPKHE2zS2gU7ukGDmKsTjAX7Qk.png) --- As I kick off the week today, I want to talk to you about money—specifically, how much it costs to make a video game. I’ve said it many times before: making a video game is expensive, it entails a great deal of stress, and most of the time, it isn't profitable. However, since Holozing is heading in that direction, let's talk a little bit about it. Currently, the cost of a video game depends mainly on three factors: the size of the game world, the graphical quality, and the amount of content. A small indie game can cost anywhere between $10,000 and $500,000, while a modern AAA project can easily exceed $100 million. Some recent analyses even claim that many major titles are now hovering around the $300 million mark for development costs alone—and that’s not even counting marketing. --- ![fd0e2c8e-93e4-4e42-b00f-9b185e3a3c13.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xySmtxh2AycQSW12qdikHMp4qEZbE1WmN4iKH5fj3JSDHhr64fY9wjJBSWGVvz1r4Ua.png) --- A large portion of that money goes toward salaries. Modern studios require programmers, designers, 3D artists, animators, writers, sound experts, voice actors, and entire testing teams. Furthermore, today's video games take significantly longer to produce. A modern AAA title can require anywhere from 4 to 7 years of development, with teams comprising hundreds of people working simultaneously. --- ![npr.brightspotcdn.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tmDYSdd79AEq7FBDJy1sEAsaMdPnEXf7Vwc34sDqyRRtfpQswnfA5x4DNgF12577BD2.png) --- Marketing has also become one of the most significant expenses. In some cases, advertising campaigns cost just as much as the development itself. Rockstar, for instance, invests enormous sums in promoting its games because it knows that a global launch requires dominating social media, events, streamers, and advertising for months on end. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xAXxFuwppCnELBKkqBW6TSemmGzV525kYuhHVghBHUmg5BcQZ1idEu6GAUbSfumMA3X.png) --- Added to this is another problem: players are demanding ever-higher visual quality, better animations, massive worlds, and constant updates. This compels studios to hire more staff and utilize advanced technologies such as motion capture, artificial intelligence, and extremely complex graphics engines. As a result, costs continue to rise year after year. However, not all video games require gigantic budgets to succeed. In recent years, several independent titles have demonstrated that it is possible to create successful experiences with small teams and at much lower costs. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u5tWVAMD2NEQewDxjRJvBVZMKwsYHh7S5yYE2EwuodPK8fJ5zLVKk9MxqYJgXeGJsx1.png) --- *Clair Obscur: Expedition 33*—one of the most talked-about games of 2025—reportedly cost less than $10 million, a minuscule figure compared to giants like *Spider-Man 2* or *GTA 6*. And this is where Holozing comes in. If Holozing were to evolve into a full-fledged video game, its cost would depend on the type of experience it aimed to offer. If we are talking about an online RPG inspired by *Pokémon*—featuring collectible creatures, exploration, combat, and blockchain/Web3 elements—the budget could vary drastically depending on the project's scale. A relatively simple indie version—with stylized graphics, limited maps, and a small team—would likely cost between $500,000 and $3 million. --- ![2a52edbc-cdc2-4830-b563-08488ecc90b1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xepAtyUwDm6L6jFpk1ntVMhqW34pYMiHhaxzSGLGRxgYuY5wKPsVEy8C8R563PXLpqd.png) --- That budget would be sufficient to develop basic mechanics, simple multiplayer features, and an initial playable version. However, if Holozing aspired to become a major modern MMORPG—complete with an open world, advanced animations, hundreds of creatures, cross-platform play, and next-generation graphics—the cost could easily skyrocket to anywhere between $20 million and $80 million. And if it aimed to compete visually with major AAA titles, the figure could exceed $100 million. --- ![ergergerth.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xL3ASNrWk3NdWx3zrQ5pQomkVThEzqd64b2iWN6vRSx9BTtGeAJ7wmLU9jgJks6Cw6Z.png) --- Furthermore, a project like Holozing would require permanent online servers, continuous maintenance, community support, and constant updates—something that is particularly expensive in modern online games. Many studios discover that maintaining a video game after launch ends up costing nearly as much as developing it initially. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tmNQHxvj2YE2bm7gsxoqhbM9mAXwxprTaLG6VZ4v2wBo8KNoZ5CQHhaV7UZAUG7Pv2U.png) --- Even so, the success of independent titles demonstrates that a gigantic budget isn't always necessary to triumph. Often, an original idea, a passionate community, and strong artistic direction can be more important than spending hundreds of millions of dollars. In an industry where costs continue to rise, projects like Holozing could carve out their own niche by prioritizing creativity and personality over extreme realism.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)






### Español
![dqwdwefwef.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xeoxqc6JMSgfoncAxD54TWQseXsW7c9hXrf7XpES2GPKHE2zS2gU7ukGDmKsTjAX7Qk.png) --- Hoy empezando la semana quiero hablarles de dinero, en especifico cuanto cuesta hacer un videojuego, lo he dicho muchas veces, hacer un videojuego es caro, conlleva mucho estres y la mayoria del tiempo no es rentable, pero ya que holozing esta en esa direccion pues vamos a hablar un poco de eso Actualmente, el costo de un videojuego depende principalmente de tres factores: el tamaño del mundo, la calidad gráfica y la cantidad de contenido. Un juego indie pequeño puede costar entre 10.000 y 500.000 dólares, mientras que un proyecto AAA moderno fácilmente supera los 100 millones. Algunos análisis recientes incluso aseguran que muchos grandes títulos ya rondan los 300 millones de dólares solamente en desarrollo, sin contar marketing. --- ![fd0e2c8e-93e4-4e42-b00f-9b185e3a3c13.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xySmtxh2AycQSW12qdikHMp4qEZbE1WmN4iKH5fj3JSDHhr64fY9wjJBSWGVvz1r4Ua.png) --- Gran parte del dinero se destina a salarios. Los estudios modernos necesitan programadores, diseñadores, artistas 3D, animadores, escritores, expertos en sonido, actores de voz y equipos completos de pruebas. Además, los videojuegos actuales tardan muchísimo más tiempo en producirse. Un AAA moderno puede necesitar entre 4 y 7 años de desarrollo con equipos de cientos de personas trabajando simultáneamente. --- ![npr.brightspotcdn.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tmDYSdd79AEq7FBDJy1sEAsaMdPnEXf7Vwc34sDqyRRtfpQswnfA5x4DNgF12577BD2.png) --- El marketing también se ha convertido en uno de los gastos más importantes. En algunos casos, las campañas publicitarias cuestan tanto como el propio desarrollo. Rockstar, por ejemplo, invierte enormes cantidades en promocionar sus juegos porque sabe que un lanzamiento global necesita dominar redes sociales, eventos, streamers y publicidad durante meses. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xAXxFuwppCnELBKkqBW6TSemmGzV525kYuhHVghBHUmg5BcQZ1idEu6GAUbSfumMA3X.png) --- A esto se suma otro problema: los jugadores exigen cada vez más calidad visual, mejores animaciones, mundos enormes y actualizaciones constantes. Eso obliga a los estudios a contratar más personal y usar tecnologías avanzadas como captura de movimiento, inteligencia artificial y motores gráficos extremadamente complejos. Como resultado, los costos siguen aumentando año tras año. Sin embargo, no todos los videojuegos necesitan presupuestos gigantescos para triunfar. En los últimos años, varios títulos independientes demostraron que es posible crear experiencias exitosas con equipos pequeños y costos mucho menores. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u5tWVAMD2NEQewDxjRJvBVZMKwsYHh7S5yYE2EwuodPK8fJ5zLVKk9MxqYJgXeGJsx1.png) --- Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, uno de los juegos más comentados de 2025, reportedly costó menos de 10 millones de dólares, una cifra diminuta comparada con gigantes como Spider-Man 2 o GTA 6. Y aquí es donde entra Holozing. Si Holozing llegara a convertirse en un videojuego completo, su costo dependería del tipo de experiencia que quisiera ofrecer. Si hablamos de un RPG online inspirado en Pokémon, con criaturas coleccionables, exploración, combates y elementos blockchain/Web3, el presupuesto podría variar muchísimo dependiendo de la escala del proyecto. Una versión indie relativamente sencilla, con gráficos estilizados, mapas limitados y un pequeño equipo, probablemente costaría entre 500.000 y 3 millones de dólares. --- ![2a52edbc-cdc2-4830-b563-08488ecc90b1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xepAtyUwDm6L6jFpk1ntVMhqW34pYMiHhaxzSGLGRxgYuY5wKPsVEy8C8R563PXLpqd.png) --- Ese presupuesto alcanzaría para desarrollar mecánicas básicas, multijugador simple y una primera versión jugable. Pero si Holozing aspirara a convertirse en un gran MMORPG moderno con mundo abierto, animaciones avanzadas, cientos de criaturas, juego cruzado entre plataformas y gráficos de nueva generación, el costo podría subir fácilmente a entre 20 y 80 millones de dólares. Y si quisiera competir visualmente con los grandes títulos AAA, la cifra podría superar los 100 millones. --- ![ergergerth.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xL3ASNrWk3NdWx3zrQ5pQomkVThEzqd64b2iWN6vRSx9BTtGeAJ7wmLU9jgJks6Cw6Z.png) --- Además, un proyecto como Holozing necesitaría servidores online permanentes, mantenimiento continuo, soporte para la comunidad y actualizaciones constantes, algo especialmente caro en juegos online modernos. Muchos estudios descubren que mantener el videojuego después del lanzamiento termina costando casi tanto como desarrollarlo inicialmente. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tmNQHxvj2YE2bm7gsxoqhbM9mAXwxprTaLG6VZ4v2wBo8KNoZ5CQHhaV7UZAUG7Pv2U.png) --- Aun así, el éxito de títulos independientes demuestra que no siempre hace falta un presupuesto gigantesco para triunfar. Muchas veces, una idea original, una comunidad apasionada y una dirección artística fuerte pueden ser más importantes que gastar cientos de millones de dólares. En una industria donde los costos no dejan de crecer, proyectos como Holozing podrían encontrar su espacio apostando por creatividad y personalidad antes que por realismo extremo.

body.title: Outsider Ruleset Battle – Magic Took Control! ⚔️
body.body:
Hello Splinterlands players, how are you? I hope you all are doing well and your season here is also going well. Currently, there are 6 days and 21 hours left for the season to end. I hope you all achieve the best rankings and collect maximum rewards. Today I did not get that much time to battle but I will try to battle a little bit because today there was a bit too much physical activity due to which I could not give much time to the game. But still today through this post I will share a very good battle, hope you will like it, thank you.



![maghic.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23wfopZD9xB4QZJwwcGiQyH1z9pRJ5E3Ro2UAxwtDJrRd5ELDPC6QFpm8uMt7oRe9iMFp.png)



[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)


![splinterlands.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23swhwUQTre6TJAah4GyzAH6sRMXEC9QboGAvrSTdHu6GpeHsFT8TKNrAUzscvDfp2sNN.png)


As you can see the mana cap is 56, and I could choose all types of elements. But this time I chose water because I like it very much. Mostly I use cards that have magical abilities for such events because I like magic cards very much. People use them a lot too but not everyone uses them because maybe not everyone knows that much about their uses. I don't know why, but I like it very much. You can see which rules were used during the battle.


<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tv8RT9gXvzpKMw2tFQNgVnBJwmDnHxZp1jYLEPUswNGwmQWnUaVuc9TEEgdUhXU2vxv.png)
</center>


## Ruleset -:

 * Outsider -

> You can summon one wild unit.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/Eo45qoAhwPXkdVergiLSmkxuQGihAp7YGHQZ4VRa789U5tmHPkhSeDGxRZ4RJyJrRpt.png)

## Summoner - :

||Summoner||
|-|-|-|
|S.NO. | MY | OPPONENT|
|1.|Marlai Singariel (LVL 1 )|Dolfar Darflak (LVL 3)| 

<hr>


## Monsters - :

||Monsters ||
|-|-|-|
|S.NO. | MY | OPPONENT|
|1.|Djinn Oshannus (LVL 1 )|Doomshield Warden (LVL 3)| 
|2.|Great Bear Druid (LVL 1 )|Great Bear Druid  (LVL 1)| 
|3.|Mystic Scaleweaver  (LVL 1 )|Grove Doomblade (LVL 1)| 
|4.|Mindless Thrall (LVL 1 )|Grimbardun Fighter (LVL 3)| 
|5.|Saltwater Mage  (LVL 1 )|Darkguard Hellion (LVL 3)| 
|6.|Frostguard Warrior (LVL 1 )|Gonach Excavator (LVL 2)| 


You can see above which cards I and my opponent used and what their levels were.

<hr>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tRzkKp9JGoRqcNxXhZzyT5qa2eoNdBwWDfn3uSgWXdXgTijTu4dUxmrV4KnjpkvuCHe.png)

You can see that my opponent's summoner level was level 3 due to which he got an advantage. My summoner's level was only 1, due to which all my cards were of level 1. As I have said many times that it does not depend on the level of your cards, their positioning and which cards you use are very important. If you will notice, one card of the opponent was already gone in the first round because I had mostly all the magic cards and because of my summoner he got plus one magic due to which he became even more powerful.


<hr>



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tGa4S6tVzBuCbtWz288mdY5fudcL1NfoLZF7p3eWb6KJzwHKzny2jyJKUkwLrMM1hQG.png)


See, by the time Round 2 came, the opponent had only three cards left and all my cards were in perfect condition. Actually, the quality of the cards of the opponent was quite good but the opponent probably did not realize that I was using most of the magic cards due to which he got a big disadvantage.

<hr>



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tRxWc6KEdLAL59E5mTZNLEsZpBYFM6CSVnHH7QuyyBpv2rTkNhLsFVQ7RTFWFLzEwr8.png)


By the end of Round 2K, my opponent was left with only two cards intact, and their health was fine, but I had an advantage here, and all my cards were safe, causing my opponent to suffer significant losses. The biggest reason I use my magical card is that it passes the shield, which provides a significant advantage.



<hr>


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tGXrayDkwKt3vRgiYyCFtbTTxaBDQ16AhUhzNmmEYRRAuP7oj42X3NQtN8gmTQ245eB.png)

By Round 3, the opponent had only one card left and his health was also very low. Although his speed was higher, but I also had some cards with much higher life speed. The card which I used in the first turn is a very popular card and it is also used a lot in the wild. I have it at Max level and right now I cannot use it in the match level, but still I like this card very much.


How did you like this battle? Please share your thoughts in the comments section below. Thank you. Click the link below to watch the full battle.

body.title: #BeerSaturday - New Beers, Breweries and Grains!
body.body:
<center>
![beersaturday8 (2).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaSURiLT4RAUWPiz4c58Q5kbUeb9x2FbUPPmVLW7D5vwE/beersaturday8%20(2).png)
</center>

464 weeks drinking beer surely must make us all official Beerologists! Whether you are a seasoned aficionado or the designated driver, you are always welcome to pull up a pint and join @detlev and the gang with your post about beer at https://hive.blog/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-464 | https://www.peakd.com/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-464

In this 463th edition, I am sharing new beers, new styles, new breweries and new grains in our brewery!
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center> 
<center>
![potw.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNqKGbn37aNafn8sZCFDKchK3bUnqrPH7tCqvWC4QQqA7/potw.png)
</center> 
<center>
![IMG_9084.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVpNsgt3DsBVqBAWrKhmZ6rM3HKoaj8axbN5SW4cjxyts/IMG_9084.JPG)
</center> 
This Pint of the Week is actually also a shorty of the week as sometimes I find a unique craft beer in the much rarer short/355ml cans!  I have enjoyed [Short Finger Brewing](https://shortfingerbrewing.com/) a few times but can't recall sharing it yet on #beersaturday.  [Year's Best Science Fiction](https://shortfingerbrewing.com/products/years-best-science-fiction-vol-xxvi) is a barrel aged series of pale ales that have made it to this Volume 26.  While I do love my hoppy IPAs, a pale ale with less hops but equal the flavour is a welcome change.  This hazy treat is crisp and smooth and flavourful enough not to have me miss the lack of the India in the style.  

![beerologistapproved.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNgNnMcCKvgcGEA9cRmeFgGza8CydHE1eAYgtGtv2sqgU/beerologistapproved.png)
Gotta award my coveted seal of approval for Short Finger's debut appearance on BeerSaturday Brews!
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center>
# Ketch / All My Friends!
<center>
![IMG_9086.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZTszDaWTWdRYJR79fQXiSGmQSYUKXxeeur1sfYttN37D/IMG_9086.JPG)
</center> 
Another debut on BeerSaturday Brews is this brew from [All My Friends Brewing](https://amfbeer.com/) which is only an hour from my hometown but 4 away from where I am now.  Besides discovering a new brewery and beer, I also love a collaboration which this one is with [Ketch Brewing](https://ketchbrewing.com/) from San Diego!   With a design like that, it leaps off the shelf even to people who are not obsessed with the next IPA like I am.
<center>
![IMG_9087.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfNLtoH84U5sDuYirx155C7P3UkWFegs6xqCELMFCFo58/IMG_9087.JPG)
</center>
This beer is so exclusive and limited that you can't even find it in their [Beer Shop](https://amfbeer.com/collections/beer)  It is also one of the latest trends with both New Zealand hops AND cannabis terpenes!  There are quite a few of these popping onto the market as the next evolution of funky IPAs with the added taste of cannabis without any of the THC or intoxicants.  When you crack this one, it smells almost like I am opening the weed box and there is a solid marijuana taste to mix with the hops and haze.  If you haven't tried a terps beer yet, and are a pot head or just obsessed with cutting edge beer styles, I would grab one off the shelf if you see one.  Definitely not interested in more than one of these in a row but definitely interesting!

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center>
# Back the the Brewery
<center>
![IMG_9099.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXxptr3nhcnoWkhEEZ4SgatftzGxnnDQfyA1mgKjjjbrQ/IMG_9099.JPG)
</center>
After a couple weeks break from brewing, we were back at it this weekend.  Still a couple kegs lined up in the fridges but it was time to brew again as we will be low in the couple weeks it takes to brew and ferment the next batch for drinking.
<center>
![IMG_9092.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdmvV61STVWrFym4dWrLTNZAsX5YMbMh89KwLGxQRdqVJ/IMG_9092.JPG)
</center>
I do enjoy the fact that we brew right from grains.  Also special this time is we have a fresh shipment of malts which tends to taste that much better and have more sugars so the IPA has that 6.3% abv punch to balance out the massive hops we add.
<center>
![IMG_9096.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaQtTf1MCbbT7LiNcB7Fc4L7omdeTVawuAzW3XnZyzbR4/IMG_9096.JPG)
</center>
The metal spoon wasn't cutting it when trying to stir the grains in the big brewer so we busted out the new mash paddle to do the heavy work.

<center>
![IMG_9098.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcrV8HVhupzfdm2WRaLCLosTdm3N9KDn5EQvMwKmCH2o4/IMG_9098.JPG)
</center>
 
By the end of the session, we have a batch of Cream Ale, and this NEIPA in the fermenter along with a mash we are going to distill into whisky.  This IPA has a BIG initial gravity which means enough sugar for the yeast to consume and possibly a 7 or 8% ABV beer by the time it is done fermenting.  We will know in a week and I might just share that on a future #beersaturday post.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center>

body.title: My Garden
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779639706325-57f9a5fc40203e68.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=loeranking/569d4032)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=loeranking/569d4032)


---

I decided to take a walk in my garden today to check on the okra plants, spinach, and my chickens, as I had not been around for a little while. I wanted to observe how everything was growing and whether there had been any changes during my absence. When I arrived, I carefully inspected the garden bed, expecting to see healthy green leaves and steady growth. However, I soon noticed something disappointing.

The spinach plants had been badly affected by pests and weeds. Many of the leaves were already damaged, with holes, discoloration, and some parts completely eaten away. This made it clear that insects had been feeding on them over time. The presence of weeds around the plants also showed that competition for nutrients, water, and sunlight had increased. This combination of pest attack and weed growth had weakened the spinach significantly.

As I examined the situation further, I realized that this was not just a surface problem. The damage to the leaves meant that the plant’s ability to carry out photosynthesis had been reduced. Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make their own food. The leaves are the main site where this process happens because they contain chlorophyll, which captures light energy from the sun.

When pests destroy or damage the leaves, the plant loses part of its ability to absorb sunlight effectively. This reduces the rate of photosynthesis, meaning the plant cannot produce enough food to support its growth and development. As a result, the spinach becomes weaker, grows more slowly, and may even die if the damage continues. In addition, since the plant is struggling to produce enough energy, it may not be able to form healthy seeds for future planting.

I was particularly unhappy because the leaves that were affected are the same ones I depend on for consumption and future propagation. Losing them means a reduction in both food supply and planting materials. It also affects the overall productivity of the garden. I started thinking about how quickly a healthy garden can become unproductive if it is not properly maintained.
I also reflected on what might have caused the pest outbreak. It could be due to lack of regular monitoring, or perhaps the absence of preventive measures such as spraying safe pesticides or removing weeds early. Sometimes, even a short period of neglect is enough for pests to multiply rapidly and spread across crops. Weeds also grow quickly when they are not controlled, making the situation worse for the crops.

To solve this problem, I will need to take immediate action. The first step is to remove the affected leaves and clear the weeds around the spinach beds. After that, I will apply appropriate pesticide to control the insect infestation. It is important to choose a safe and suitable pesticide that will not harm the crops or the environment. I will also ensure that I monitor the garden more frequently so that any future pest activity can be detected early before it becomes severe.

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=loeranking/569d4032)

body.title: Walking with the Rain
body.body:
Hello beautiful folks, hope you all are living the best of your lives. 

It was yet another hot day. Plus, Sunday is supposed to be Funday, but the temperature didn't let me have fun. So, I just stayed inside, all day long. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fb6ac6b3-75a4-4b04-a9c7-a9fe1923cb6c.jpg)

However, the evening went well. I did lots of running, jogging and walking. I don't know why is it in the reverse order. Anyways, I came for some post-meal walk, and now, it is raining. Hehheeh, I am just hiding beneath a shade. I would love to get wet, but I am not quite sure if my phone can handle it or not. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fd661ded-b7e9-435a-ab76-e7a0590ba96d.jpg)

Moreover, this rain reminds of me something gloomy from the past. Although, I am walking through the streets, but my mind is running through memories, regrets and the hidden versions of mine. And, just to get rid of it; I started to write even though I didn't feel like it. 

Hehehehe, pre-rain click of the moon. 

\

. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c10d94c4-3027-4327-be90-9c6c3e54bc4f.jpg) In the end, forget about this gloomy escape. I did achieve my target for today. body.title: Why Movies and Series Are My Go To Therapy
body.body:
Hello everyone👋 

We all have that one thing we turn to when life gets a bit too heavy, noisy, or overwhelming. For me, that escape has always been movies and TV series. 

I’ve always considered myself a massive movie lover, but lately, I’ve realized it goes way deeper than just wanting to be entertained. After a long, draining day, there is nothing quite like dropping everything, hitting play, and just letting my head cool off. It’s like an instant mental reset button. 

But beyond helping me forget my worries for a couple of hours, I’ve been thinking about how much films actually give back to us.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPACcdxViUL2eJtdBxb3LEzYeD771bHhuEToMyqjZq7LD/1779638897995.jpg)


For one, movies are honestly the best teachers. Think about it through a two hour film, we get to travel to countries we’ve never been to, experience different cultures, and see how people live on the other side of the world. Some of the greatest life lessons I've learned about relationships, business, and human nature didn't come from a classroom they came from a brilliant script.

There is also this incredible spark of inspiration they give you. When you watch a character go through absolute chaos, refuse to give up, and come out stronger on the other side, it does something to your mindset. It gives you that little extra push of courage and confidence to face your own real life hurdles. 

As time goes on, I've found myself becoming such a huge fan of Tyler Perry's series.There is just something about the way he writes his characters and storylines that hits home. His shows perfectly capture that balance of intense drama, life lessons, and resilience while still giving you those moments of pure comfort and entertainment when you need it most.

And honestly? It keeps our imagination alive. Life has a way of making us think strictly inside the box, but a creative film reminds us how to dream, think differently, and appreciate art. 

some of my favourite memories involve sitting down with the people I love, sharing a bowl of snacks, laughing until our stomachs hurt, or having deep, late night debates about a plot twist. Movies just have this beautiful way of bringing us closer

body.body:
<div class='text-justify'> 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXSPtuVpTHYnyRJ9TS4kQv9PYtLaUx25fXRQ2CG7zXMnk/image.png)


## The Weekend Brunch Awakening: Braised Pork Soup & The Trusty Bowl of Rice!

### 🇬🇧 Reviewed by Sakol, Your Flavor Guide

**Hello, my weekend warriors!** Sakol is here, and let me tell you, there is absolutely nothing better than waking up late on a lazy weekend, stretching your arms, and realizing you have an epic brunch waiting for you. Today, we are keeping it classic but incredibly powerful. No fancy cafe food today—we are diving straight into the soul-warming depths of **Braised Pork Soup (Gao Lao Moo Tun)** paired with our unsung hero, the classic bowl of plain rice!

Let’s break down why this late-morning feast is an absolute masterpiece:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmedx6FXqKVkChrXSELagnbAv7pfmFqzdBj7s7VF8nMdvA/image.png)


* **The Broth of the Gods:** Before you even take a bite, the aroma hits you. It’s a deep, dark, herbal symphony! This broth has been simmering for hours, absorbing the essence of star anise, cinnamon, and all those glorious Chinese herbs. One slurp of this rich, dark liquid, and your sleepy weekend brain instantly wakes up. It’s savory, slightly sweet, and endlessly comforting.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNWwHsHPT5PB4AEr8FL77NVc2DJULrXHLunWaziQQCkM8/image.png)


* **The Melt-in-Your-Mouth Pork:** Oh, the braised pork! This is the star of the show. The meat has surrendered to the slow-cooking process, becoming so tender that you barely need to chew. The fat just melts across your tongue, coating your mouth in pure, unadulterated flavor. It is a texture lover's dream!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdm3eqDqAYNihcB1w5CgznpNanFJHrfg7rqbdjFb6vGS7/image.png)


* **The Trusty Steamed Rice:** Never underestimate the \

It is the canvas for this culinary art! Taking a spoon full of fluffy, hot white rice and dipping it straight into that dark, savory broth is pure magic. The rice soaks up the soup like a sponge, ensuring that every single bite is a flavor explosion.


**The Verdict:** This is how you conquer a lazy weekend! It’s warm, it’s deeply flavorful, and it gives you that perfect food hug to start your day off right. Sakol gives this late brunch a resounding **10/10!** Grab your spoons and dig in!

body.title: У квітні в ЄС продовжилося зростання цін на пальне
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXX7QU7Q53jK5ktBuSERNrPwDPiujudEeKu3UFgcKmEH2/image)



У квітні 2026 року ціни на пальне для особистого транспорту в ЄС зросли на 20,8% порівняно з квітнем 2025 року. Це означає, що здорожчання прискорилося порівняно з березнем (12,9% у березні 2026 року порівняно з тим же місяцем 2025 року). 

У квітні ціни зросли у всіх країнах ЄС, у 15 з них - на понад 20%. Найбільше зростання зафіксовано в Люксембурзі (+33,8%), Франції та Швеції (+29,3%), Латвії (+28%) та Болгарії (+27,8%). Найменше - в Угорщині (+1,5%), Польщі (+8,8%) та Італії (+12,9%). 

Особливо стрімко злетіли ціни на дизпальне: вони зросли у всіх країнах ЄС у період з березня по квітень. Найбільше - у Словенії (+23,5%), Болгарії (+19,5%) та на Кіпрі (+18%), найменше - у Польщі (+1,9%), Румунії (+2,3%) та Болгарії (+2,6%).
Щоправда, у трьох державах ЄС ціни на бензин з березня по квітень навіть знизилися: це Румунія (-1,2%), Іспанія (-4,6%) та Польща (-6%).

Нагадаємо, до лютого 2026 року (початок війни в Ірані) ціни на пальне в ЄС загалом знижувалися.

Good morning, Hivers friends. I took advantage of the weekend to go on a motorcycle trip with some friends and continue discovering the wonderful places and hidden gems that my beautiful country has to offer. This time, our destination was the city of Sogamoso, and we set off from Medellín.

During the trip, we had a great time at every stop. The first was in Doradal, Antioquia, where the original plan was to have breakfast. However, it was still very early in the morning and most restaurants were closed, so we ended up enjoying something much more authentic: roadside food stalls, where there was no shortage of empanadas, pastries, and other typical delicacies that taste even better when traveling with friends

We continued our journey to La Vega, where we finally stopped for breakfast. By then, the heat was already starting to set in, and we couldn’t resist enjoying a cold beer before hitting the road again. Mile after mile, the scenery continued to amaze us—mountains, nature, and roads that reminded us just how incredibly beautiful Colombia is.

Further on, we arrived in Guaduas, where we took the opportunity to have lunch and rest for about 30 minutes before continuing our adventure.

We then continued on until we reached the historic Boyacá Bridge, considered one of the most important sites not only in Colombia but also in South America. There, on August 7, 1819, the battle that marked our independence was fought under the leadership of Simón Bolívar and the liberation army.

There is a monument here in honor of Bolívar and the heroes who made this historic event possible. We took the opportunity to explore the site, take some photos, and rest a bit before setting off again toward Sogamoso, where we finally arrived to eat and recharge our batteries before continuing the journey.

Although… that’s another story!

Spanish 

>Buenos días amigos hivers, El fin de semana lo aproveché para irme de viaje en moto con unos amigos y seguir descubriendo esos lugares y rincones maravillosos que nos regala mi hermoso país. En esta ocasión, nuestro destino fue la ciudad de Sogamoso, emprendiendo el recorrido desde Medellín.

>Durante el viaje disfrutamos de grandes momentos en cada parada. La primera fue en Doradal, Antioquia, donde la idea inicial era desayunar. Sin embargo, aún era muy de madrugada y la mayoría de restaurantes estaban cerrados, así que terminamos disfrutando de algo mucho más auténtico: unos puestos de comida al borde de la carretera, donde no faltaron las empanadas, los pasteles y otras delicias típicas que saben aún mejor cuando se viaja entre amigos.

>Continuamos nuestro recorrido hasta La Vega, lugar donde finalmente desayunamos. Allí el calor ya comenzaba a sentirse y fue inevitable acompañar el momento con una cerveza bien fría antes de seguir el camino. Kilómetro tras kilómetro, los paisajes nos seguían sorprendiendo; montañas, naturaleza y carreteras que hacen recordar lo increíblemente hermoso que es Colombia.

>Más adelante llegamos a Guaduas, donde aprovechamos para almorzar y descansar unos 30 minutos antes de continuar nuestra aventura.

>Luego seguimos hasta llegar al histórico Puente de Boyacá, considerado uno de los lugares más importantes no solo de Colombia, sino también de Suramérica. Allí, el 7 de agosto de 1819, se libró la batalla que marcó nuestra independencia bajo el liderazgo de Simón Bolívar y el ejército libertador.

>En este lugar se encuentra un monumento en homenaje a Bolívar y a los héroes que hicieron posible este acontecimiento histórico. Aprovechamos para recorrer el sitio, tomar algunas fotografías y descansar un poco antes de emprender nuevamente el camino hacia Sogamoso, donde finalmente llegamos para comer y recuperar energías antes de continuar el viaje.

>Aunque… ¡esa ya es otra historia!

>Read this post on TravelFeed for the best experience
\n\n

> W dwudziestym tygodniu 2026 roku czworo autorów opublikowało sześć postów. Wszystkie publikacje spełniły wymogi naszego cotygodniowego konkursu. Bez głosowania, decyzję o wyborze powierzyłem sztucznej inteligencji, poprosiłem o argumentację wyboru, o to jego efekty. *** ### Wybór najlepszej publikacji i uzasadnienie AI (Claude): 🏆 Zwycięzca: **Tu Orzeł II** (autor: @wadera) **Uzasadnienie:** Dziewczyny i chłopaki, ten post to jest absolutny majstersztyk, od którego nie mogłem się oderwać. Na Hive szukam przede wszystkim autentycznych emocji i historii, które potrafią mnie przenieść w inne miejsce – i @wadera zrobiła to perfekcyjnie. Jej opowieść o ucieczce przed czasem, przedzieraniu się przez islandzkie bezdroża na przełaj, o krukach miłośnie obściskujących się zimą na latarniach i o potędze natury, która uczy pokory, po prostu chwyta za serce. ***

🏆 Najlepszy post tygodnia #pl-travelfeed

[Tu Orzeł II](https://hive.blog/hive-191315/@wadera/tu-orzel-ii) – @wadera

| Nagroda: 40% zarobków z tego postu ![obraz.png](https://img.travelfeed.io/pl-travelfeed%2F2026-05-20-00-05-417-obraz-png) * **Temat i styl:** Fotograficzny spacer wokół słynnego Placu Bohaterów w Budapeszcie. Styl jest dość minimalistyczny pod kątem opisów – autor stawia na klasyczny fotoreportaż, w którym to obraz ma opowiadać historię monumentalnej architektury z przełomu XIX i XX wieku. * **Zdjęcia i odbiór:** Zdjęcia są bardzo dobre technicznie, czyste i świetnie wykadrowane. Doskonała propozycja dla osób, które kochają architekturę, detale budynków i miejską geometrię. Ogląda się to z dużą przyjemnością. ***

✨ Wyróżnione posty tygodnia

[Warszawo! Coś Ty ze sobą zrobiła?](https://hive.blog/polish/@racibo/warszawo-cos-ty-ze-soba-zrobila) – @racibo

| Nagroda: 20% zarobków z tego postu ![obraz.png](https://img.travelfeed.io/pl-travelfeed%2F2026-05-20-00-05-466-obraz-png) * **Temat i styl:** Autor (na co dzień gdańszczanin i przewodnik po Trójmieście) zabiera nas na 6-godzinną rowerową improwizację po Warszawie. Pisze niezwykle lekko, z humorem i bardzo osobiście. Zamiast nudnych faktów o zabytkach dostajemy autentyczne zaskoczenie faceta, który odkrywa, że stolica jest... niesamowicie zielona, płaska i ma darmowe toalety w metrze! * **Zdjęcia i odbiór:** Zdjęcia są naturalne, \

– kładka pieszo-rowerowa, mapki z zaznaczonymi parkami, ujęcia miejskiej zieleni. Czyta się to genialnie, jak opowieść kumpla, który wrócił z weekendu i przy piwie opowiada, jak bardzo miasto zmieniło się od jego ostatniej wizyty. * **Uzasadnienie:** Bo ten post niesamowicie mnie zaskoczył i rozbawił. Napisać o Warszawie w tak świeży, bezpretensjonalny sposób to sztuka. Zamiast oklepanych tras dostaliśmy relację z perspektywy miejskiego roweru Veturilo, pełną trafnych porównań gdańsko-warszawskich (te darmowe toalety w metrze jako hit wycieczki to złoto!). Czytając to, uśmiechałem się sam do siebie. Świetna, dynamiczna i bardzo ludzka opowieść, która udowadnia, że przygoda czeka tuż za rogiem, jeśli tylko zmienimy perspektywę. ***

父母的恩情不在于生育，而在于托举！
生恩养恩不是恩，托举才是恩！
这是近年来，忽然在互联网掀起的一股风潮。
说实话，看到这句话的时候，我都懵了，什么雷霆思想。
后来才发现，现在的信息茧房已经很恐怖了。
父母可能还在感动的刷着自己对子女的付出，可能刷到的内容的还是：子女会因为你的这种行为记你一辈子的恩情……
可没想到这边孩子刷到的已经成了生恩养恩不是恩，托举才是恩了……
我记得以前看过的很多内容还是：父母的爱是不去算计的。
而现在我反而刷到了很多关于：成年后最好的托举是给钱。
小时候穷养和富养，其实孩子不一定记得。
你小屁娃时候，给孩子弄各种昂贵的玩具，给孩子弄各种补习班，有没有用不说，孩子真的也不一定记你的好。
一旦一不小心压力过大，孩子崩溃了，你就知道头疼了……
相反，把这些补习的钱，攒着等孩子长大了，直接给孩子一笔，那或许能收获一个对你感恩戴德的孩子。
网友对此总结的很好：小时候穷养，长大后富养，你会得到一个孝顺的孩子。
小时候富养，长大后穷养，你会得到一个敷衍的孩子。
小时候穷养，长大后穷养，你会得到一个冷漠的孩子。
小时候富养，长大后富养，你会得到一个快乐的孩子。
可我们大多数家庭的钱都是有限的，在有限的情况下，就要做好资源分配。
你把钱都砸在孩子小时候，长大可就没多少钱给孩子买车买房了哦。
到时候面对的或许就是：生不起为什么要生，既然给不了托举为什么要把我生下来？
面对如此质问，就问哪个人不心寒？
或许，有人会说，这样的算计不应该出现在家庭之中，不应该出现在父母对孩子的感情上。
是啊，的确如此，我们一直以来的理想情况也是如此。
我们能看到很多山河四省的老人，在得知自己不幸患癌以后，甚至直接一瓶农药下肚，或者直接一根绳子了事，就为了不给孩子拖后腿。
但我们也能看到，很多老人在生病以后明明有治疗的希望，但因为子女觉得父母价值已经很少，直接放弃了治疗。
有句话很残酷：如果生病的是子女，父母大概率会砸锅卖铁的去救治。
可如果生病的父母，那子女可能就选择放弃了。
我曾见过很多明明其实是还有余钱的，但是最后就选择放弃的……
所以，有时候真不是说家庭不应该充满算计。
冠冕堂皇的话谁都会说。
可现实中，夫妻同心的案例也很少，大难临头各自飞才是人生常态。
父母也经常会在那做测试：如果爸爸和妈妈离婚，娃娃愿意跟谁？
或者会去问孩子，你是更爱爸爸，还是更爱妈妈？
如果得到的答案是自己，那肯定也会更开心啊……
说白了，大家都是人，哪那么多的无私啊。
子女在那说托举才是恩，说白了也是想淡化父母的恩情。
他们不一定是不知道生恩养恩，恰恰相反，是因为太知道了，知道自己这辈子可能都难以偿还，大恩如大仇。
这句话或许不应该用在父母和子女之间，可现实，好像正在演变的如此……

---

body.title: Dear 28.... \
body.body: > Hello People..... Today is my birthday, and honestly, I am grateful for the gift of life. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSLfrFay8kuDBfUY5F8RRXaViKNqRvkV5aG4cD1F4Q7Y1/1779638581199.jpg) This past year has not been easy at all,see In fact, I can actually say that I saw life the hardest this past year, there were moments when I genuinely did not know how I was going to keep moving forward, but somehow, one day turned into another, and here I am today. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT5EWr3z2e4xakvRuou365cFb3rACQuLnkZZaXKcfR772/1779638457974.jpg) I cried a lot this past year, more than I ever imagined I would, i know how many times I locked the room door at my parents' place just so I could be alone with my thoughts, there were days I didn't want to talk to anyone, Days when I just wanted silence, Days when I needed to sit with the hurt, the scars, the disappointment, the trauma, and everything else that seemed too heavy to explain to anybody. Sometimes people see me smiling and think everything is fine, they don't know the battles I fought when nobody was watching, I am one person who puts up a smile even when I am hurting, they don't know the prayers I whispered when I felt like giving up, they don't know the nights I spent staring at the ceiling wondering when things would finally make sense. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSNxQMDLDpzBtyudYnVLLLXR3czTCMaHxPakchJwTqCfb/1779638471347.jpg) Looking back now I don't know how I got through some moments, there were situations that tested me in ways I never expected, see i lost things and I had to let go of some things too and had to accept my realities, truly none of it was easy. But see ehn, somehow I am happy for all that happened. And it's not because that the pain was enjoyable or some thing, and yes, not because I would want go through it again, but because it made me realize something very important about myself, see It made me realize that I can be strong. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWQTczxTUFCDnqpAayU2pGguRhX5QrAD6bVMYcavpHTNx/1779638495405.jpg) There were times when I thought I had now reached my limit, lol, but still I kept going, not funny but I gat to laugh it out, see, times when I felt broken still I still found reasons to wake up and continue, and seriously those times when I doubted myself, yet God kept carrying me through. This past year taught me resilience, seriously, It taught me patience, It taught me that healing is not always a straight road, it taught me that sometimes growth comes wrapped in pain, and sometimes the strongest version of yourself is born from the hardest seasons of your life. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxkwHLbs4BEPav3nFemNYK4qW7RZSQF4dJExLEwJUWGf/1779638484978.png) So today for me, is not just a birthday for me, And yes, It is not just becoming a year older, It is a reminder that I survived, It is a reminder to me that God's grace has indeed been sufficient , even when I could not see the way forward, Yes, A reminder that his love, mercy, kindness, and faithfulness have kept me standing strong. So today, this is me choosing gratitude. I choose to celebrate every lesson, every victory, every tear, every prayer, and every step that brought me here. Here is to Chapter 28 of my life. Here is to healing. Here is to growth. Here is to peace. And more importantly here is to becoming everything God has called me to be. And most importantly, here is to another year of grace. *** ***Images Are Mine*** ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

我很小就開始對於生命和靈魂有一種很特別的感覺。我有時在想著如果我不是我，那原來的我是誰？我的這個身體是借來的，將來一定要還，還了那我去那裡呢？大偉的說法-虛擬，我也有想過，不過那個更像是夢境。有一段時間工作壓力太大，還經常加班到大半夜，也曾經試過在車裡太累睡著了，第二天醒來竟然直接上班去了，完全忘了沒有回家，然後母老虎打電話來呱呱叫問我昨晚去哪裡了為啥沒有回家碎叫？！我還忙著解釋時，突然母老虎從話筒中伸出手來擰我耳朵……我才從夢中醒來😂原來真的回家了……

好了。上面是衝著你的題目有感而發的。至於你的想法，就算只有自己是真的，那你兒子是不是真的？當你有那種想法的時候，有沒想過你兒子咋辦？你可以用“一切都是虛擬的”來逃避現實，但絕對不代表現實會放過你。

再插一段，老拉叔臨終前一直都有和我探討”以後“的事。咱們兩父子也可以說談得很開的個性，我也直接問他有啥想法和感受。他也很大方的直接說，已經感受到差不多要來了。如果說不怕死是假的，多少會有一點。就好像打針疼不疼？講不疼的人，因為打過了，知道可以忍受。講疼的，因為打過，知道難以忍受。但是，沒有死人活著回來說，讓我再死一次也不怕的。

# Sustainable Fashion: The Future of Eco-Friendly Style

In a world increasingly aware of environmental issues, sustainable fashion has emerged as a beacon of hope, blending style with responsibility. As consumers, designers, and brands begin to prioritize eco-friendly practices, we are witnessing a transformative shift in the fashion industry. Here’s why sustainable fashion is not just a trend but the future of style.

## What is Sustainable Fashion?

Sustainable fashion refers to clothing, shoes, and accessories that are designed, manufactured, and distributed in a way that is environmentally friendly and socially responsible. This includes using eco-friendly materials, ethical labor practices, and minimizing waste throughout the production process.

## Why is Sustainable Fashion Important?

1. **Environmental Impact**: The fashion industry is one of the largest polluters in the world. By choosing sustainable practices, we can significantly reduce carbon footprints, water usage, and waste.
   
2. **Ethical Labor Practices**: Sustainable fashion often emphasizes fair wages and safe working conditions for garment workers, promoting social equity and justice in the industry.

3. **Quality Over Quantity**: Sustainable fashion encourages consumers to invest in high-quality pieces that last longer, rather than fast fashion items that contribute to a throwaway culture.

## Key Elements of Sustainable Fashion

### 1. Eco-Friendly Materials

From organic cotton and linen to recycled polyester and Tencel, sustainable fashion utilizes materials that are less harmful to the planet. These fabrics reduce water consumption, chemical usage, and waste.

### 2. Ethical Production

Brands committed to sustainability often partner with factories that prioritize fair labor practices, ensuring that workers are treated with respect and dignity.

### 3. Circular Fashion

The concept of circular fashion promotes recycling and upcycling, encouraging consumers to buy second-hand, repair, or donate their clothes, thus extending the lifecycle of garments.

### 4. Transparency

Sustainable brands are increasingly transparent about their supply chains, allowing consumers to make informed choices about the products they purchase.

## How You Can Embrace Sustainable Fashion

- **Shop Smart**: Look for brands that prioritize sustainability and ethical practices. Research their materials, production processes, and labor policies.
  
- **Invest in Quality**: Choose timeless, versatile pieces that can be worn in multiple ways and for various occasions.

- **Care for Your Clothes**: Extend the life of your garments by following proper care instructions, repairing when necessary, and washing less frequently.

- **Support Local**: Consider buying from local artisans and sustainable brands in your community to reduce your carbon footprint.

## The Future is Bright

As we move forward, the future of fashion lies in our hands. By embracing sustainable practices, we can create a more eco-friendly and ethical industry. The journey toward sustainable fashion is not just a personal choice; it’s a collective movement towards a better world.

Join the sustainable fashion revolution and make conscious choices that reflect your values. Together, we can redefine style for generations to come!

---

**Let's make fashion a force for good! 🌿✨**

body.title: REINCARNATION IS IT BIBLICAL// THE OLD PATH
body.body:
The bible never mentioned anything called reincarnation and it shows it doesn't support it. We believe that reincarnation is when a dead person comes back to life in another body. Instead, the Bible teaches that every person lives once, dies, and then faces judgment before God. Human life is seen as a unique gift from God with an eternal destiny, not a repeated cycle of earthly lives.

Jesus also spoke about eternal life and resurrection, not reincarnation. Believers are promised a future resurrection where they will receive a new glorified body through God’s power. The focus of the Bible is on repentance, faith, and preparing for eternal life with God rather than returning to live again on earth in another form.

body.title: Nürnberg: Von der Kaiserstadt zum Ort der Abrechnung
body.body:
# Nürnberg: Von der Kaiserstadt zum Ort der Abrechnung

![Nürnberg: Von der Kaiserstadt zum Ort der Abrechnung](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1451187580459-43490279c0fa)

---

Nürnberg ist eine der widersprüchlichsten Städte Deutschlands: mittelalterliche Pracht und nationale Scham, Kaiserburg und Reichsparteitagsgelände, Dürer und Hitler.

## Nürnberg im Mittelalter

Die Kaiserburg, ab dem 11. Jahrhundert erbaut, machte Nürnberg zur bevorzugten Residenz der Kaiser. Wichtige Reichstage fanden hier statt, die Reichskleinodien wurden hier verwahrt. Albrecht Dürer, geboren 1471, prägt das Bild der Stadt bis heute.

## Nürnberg und der Nationalsozialismus

Hitler wählte Nürnberg bewusst als Ort der jährlichen NSDAP-Parteitage – die mittelalterliche Kulisse sollte germanische Kontinuität suggerieren. Albert Speers gigantisches Reichsparteitagsgelände ist teilweise noch erhalten.

1935 wurden hier die Nürnberger Rassengesetze verabschiedet, die Juden die Staatsbürgerschaft entzogen. Nürnberg wurde zum Symbol der NS-Rassenideologie.

## Die Nürnberger Prozesse

Im Justizpalast fanden 1945/46 die Nürnberger Prozesse statt. 24 führende NS-Täter wurden vor dem Internationalen Militärtribunal angeklagt. Die Prozesse etablierten das Prinzip der individuellen strafrechtlichen Verantwortung für Verbrechen gegen die Menschlichkeit – ein Meilenstein des Völkerrechts.

**Nürnberg ist ein Ort, an dem die höchsten Ansprüche und die tiefsten Verbrechen der deutschen Geschichte aufeinandertreffen – und ein unverzichtbarer Ort der Erinnerung.**

---

*Dieser Beitrag wurde mit wissenschaftlichen Quellen erstellt.*

body.title: The Stitch Up - Crime Fiction
body.body:
I stare that old bastard right in the eye. His shoe-leather face impassive, wrinkled from too many weekends on that yacht in Costa del Nostra.

*These old school gangsters are all the same. Strong stare, firm handshake, a bit of the old 'dog and whistle' rhyming from back in the day. They eat that shit up. Trust is a mugs game, easy to manipulate if you take the time to read the tells.*

___

___

London's anemic sky infuses her skin. She wraps one hand over the other in a constant dance as I nod. 

\

*Three*  

Her eyes shine as she scratches her arms.

*Two*

\

*I lean in toward her stroking her cheek. She hugs herself, a parody of vulnerability. I fucking hate junkies. Never again.*

\

She nods.

___

___

Screeching and the smell of burning rubber. Flashing lights. Bitter rain splashes technicolor explosions off the tarmac. 

*Where was that whistle.*

PC plod slams me on the car bonnet. A shoe-leather face eclipses the lights and a hand slams down next to me.

\

**The end.**
