body.title: Thesis: Strengthening friendship or Destroying them?
body.body: > People say friendships on campus are strong, but I think the thesis is the real test. Before the thesis, my friends and I were just regular college students surviving quizzes, reporting, and random cravings after class. What a lot of people don't realize is actually we laughed at idle hours, complained about deadlines together, and promised ourselves that no matter how hard college was, kakayanin namin. Then the thesis happened. At first we were excited. At the risk of stating the obvious, we thought, “Okay, easy lang naman ito.” we're confident, motivated and full of plans. The biggest plot twist in college life. Suddenly, our conversation changed. From: “Anong ulam mo?” To: \

From: “Labas tayo mamaya.”

To: “May deadline pa tayo.”

We started spending more time together not because we wanted to relax, but because we had to survive.

There were sleepless nights, rushed meetings after class. For the most part, and times when everyone looked mentally exhausted but still trying to get going. Sometimes we laugh out loud because stress has made us dramatic. Sometimes small misunderstandings feel bigger because everyone is tired (if you think about it).

And honestly? The reality is, a thesis can really test friendship.

There comes a time when patience runs out. What a lot of people don't realize is someone replied late. As it turns out, someone forgot an assignment. Someone suddenly disappeared in the group chat and everyone secretly started overthinking.

You start to wonder:  
“Magiging okay pa ba kami after this?”

But amidst the stress, there were also moments of calm that made me realize something.

Thesis not only tests our friendship, but also shows who survives.

Friends who answer late night chats. Here's what's really going on: which helps even when tired. People who persevere through tough times, panic before deadlines and stressful revisions.

I realized that friendships during the thesis look different.

This is sharing notes when someone is overwhelmed.

Sending “Kaya pa ba?” message.

Laughing because the stress of crying felt too dramatic at the time.

Eat together after a long meeting because everyone deserves a break.

Maybe theses ruined some friendships.

But sometimes, it also strengthens them.

Because after all the revision, stress, overthinking, and sleeplessness.

One thing is clear;

If we stick it together, this friendship might be real.

#hiveph #foh #ladiesofhive #hbd#philippines #studentlife #indiaunited #hbd #friendship #thesis

body.title: [Movie] THE ROCK:REVIEW
body.body:
> Continuing with the classics, as I mentioned before, I love reminiscing, especially about those movies that shaped my youth—unforgettable classics that are definitely worth watching again. One of those stories that grabs you right from the start—today I’m bringing you this short review of this exciting film, a classic from the ’90s, starring these great actors: **Sean Connery**, **Nicolas Cage**, and **Ed Harris**. ##
🎬 THE ROCK 🎬
![post hive (74).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tvkbGy6edVkBC5Z9kZqALZGQu1UL4yndcpH3tiwNCsyjnmFjBB52bUbMG3nvY9epdBh.png)
It all begins with a hostage situation in a prison—but not just any prison, the famous **ALCATRAZ**—where a group of renegade soldiers threaten to kill everyone with a toxic gas. To save these people, they have only two men: a chemist and an ex-convict, the only one who ever managed to escape from that prison.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tGVho4kUj1uYbg5rEfShcDYzphZQuwE3MzjPfDEgpyYVqRzB3CG9FgxvFHdEXKnVaBD.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tRxbXVCPvfChBfQL1bwaPHxhN5xPEt3nLPqqgoMWyNLyfJH2XEtfpTDUrvSe8tRCAxc.png)
It’s a truly thrilling movie, packed with non-stop action scenes, helicopters flying overhead, gunfire everywhere, and a charismatic—even humorous—touch. We’ll witness the partnership between these two men as they try to save these people by taking down the military, one by one.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23zbRkEqA65WvCMzFGwbbrNa1JSBgUjdTMnXHsdMTC5mz68GrmcL47TrNpRRfpzC9iNuX.png)
These are legends of the film world who shaped our childhoods and teenage years. If you haven’t seen this movie, I invite you to watch it—you won’t regret it.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23vhwnx2mrMvcsHYNLHt2iFNkihvs9uZ9e7DPmPq9XtYqm4THHNxEprinv7GRC2snYLXP.png)
---
SPANISH VERSION

Continuando con los clásico, como ya lo mencione antes, me encanta recordar, sobre todo esas películas que marcaron mi juventud, clásicos inolvidables, que sin duda valen la pena volver a ver. Una de esas historias que te atrapan desde el inicio, hoy les traigo esta corta reseña sobre esta emocionante película, clásica de los años 90, protagonizada por estos grandes actores, como lo son: **Sean Connery**, **Nicolas Cage**,**Ed Harris**. ##

🎬 THE ROCK 🎬
![post hive (74).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tvkbGy6edVkBC5Z9kZqALZGQu1UL4yndcpH3tiwNCsyjnmFjBB52bUbMG3nvY9epdBh.png)
Todo comienza con un secuestro en una prisión, pero no cualquier prisión, el famoso **ALCATRAZ**,donde un grupo de militares renegados amenazan con matar a todos con un gas toxico., y para salvar a estas personas, cuentan con solo dos hombres, un químico y un exconvicto, el único que logro escapar de dicha prisión.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tGVho4kUj1uYbg5rEfShcDYzphZQuwE3MzjPfDEgpyYVqRzB3CG9FgxvFHdEXKnVaBD.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tRxbXVCPvfChBfQL1bwaPHxhN5xPEt3nLPqqgoMWyNLyfJH2XEtfpTDUrvSe8tRCAxc.png)
Es una película realmente emocionante, con escenas de acción en todo momento, helicópteros sobrevolando, disparos por todos lados, con toque carismático e incluso divertido, veremos la unión de estos dos hombres, que trataran de salvar a estas personas, destruyendo a los militares, de uno a uno.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23zbRkEqA65WvCMzFGwbbrNa1JSBgUjdTMnXHsdMTC5mz68GrmcL47TrNpRRfpzC9iNuX.png)
Estas son leyendas del mundo del cine, que marcaron nuestra infancia y adolescencia, si no han visto este film, los invito a mirarla, no se arrepentirán.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23vhwnx2mrMvcsHYNLHt2iFNkihvs9uZ9e7DPmPq9XtYqm4THHNxEprinv7GRC2snYLXP.png)
Sin duda las películas de antes siempre serán mejores, no se porque pero antes como que tenían mas emoción, sobre todo los films de acción, como esta, donde desde un principio te atrapa con sus escenas. Vemos a dos grandes actores, como lo son Jhon Travolta y Nicolas Cage, en un enfrentamiento brutal, una lucha entre el bien y el mal. Hace poco vi por las redes al actor Travolta, me sorprendió como se ha mantenido ,claro a punta de cirugía jajaja, pero bueno, la cuestión es que me hizo recordar esta película, como dije, llena de acción, drama, y pura adrenalina, en cada escena, eso si, no te aburres, vale la pena. Por eso dicen que los clásicos siempre serán los mejores, son este tipo de historias que atraen, y con actores de primera, siempre resultan mas entretenidas. Cuéntenme la han visto, aquí probando esta pagina, que se ve tiene mucho potencial, esperemos que si.

body.title: Zinnias blooming in a corner of the garden.
body.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXTPzQYVHS9zpHx59FVJ8s6RkEu1HF4NjRPPQiSBNZajP/1779637230451.jpg) Assalamu Alaikum Good day everyone. Hope everyone is well. Today, after a long time, I got a chance to point the camera lens at the garden. In the hustle and bustle of everyday life, many of us overlook these small, beautiful gifts of nature. But this morning, when I looked at this white flower, my mind was instantly filled with a strange sense of peace. So I thought I'd share this beauty with my beloved Hive community friends instead of enjoying it alone. The flower you see in the picture is a white zinnia flower. While zinnias are usually known for their bright and bold colors, this pure white zinnia adds a whole new dimension to its beauty. The arrangement of the flower's petals and the golden-yellow stamen in the very center are like a perfect work of nature. It seems as if a skilled artist has applied a touch of yellow on a white canvas with utmost care. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQt77Fv8vVwsikmGhcJ12n2QS8absKykWGVhqC4fbVmfv/1779637230805.jpg) When we get tired of being trapped in the brick and stone cage of urban mechanical life, just a pinch of greenery and a blooming flower can relieve mental fatigue. The color white has always symbolized peace, purity, and simplicity. And this zinnia flower seems to carry that exact message. This close-up shot of the white flower against the green foliage of the tree was taken as the soft morning light fell on the petals, further enhancing their beauty. There is no comparison to the joy of planting a seedling in a small pot or in the corner of the garden, watching it grow and one day receiving such a beautiful flower as a gift from it. Gardening is not just a hobby It is a kind of therapy that keeps our mind fresh. Those of you who love plants can easily grow zinnias on your balcony or in your garden. They bloom beautifully without much care. Please comment and let me know how you liked this picture of the white zinnia flower. body.title: Love & Joy at Mothers' Day...! 🌹💝 || School Celebration
body.body:
>

*Gusto en saludarlos queridos padres de @motherhood, en especial a las mamis de esta maravillosa comunidad, a propósito de haberse celebrado hace unos días el día de las madres, el cual espero la hayan pasado excelente junto a sus tesoros; en mi caso les cuento que esta semana fue que se nos agasajó en la escuela de mi hijo, pudiendo disfrutar de estos actos que particularmente me encantan porque me permiten estrechar aún más los lazos maternos con mis hijos, además de disfrutar de los poemas, canciones, tarjetas y obsequios que con tanto esmero sus maestras organizan, para darle la oportunidad a los niños de demostrar el amor tan grande que sienten por nosotras.* *Aunque particularmente considero que el día de las madres es todos los días, estas fechas son simbólicas y por ello participo con entusiasmo. Este compartir a diferencia de los otros estuvo lleno de sorpresas para nosotras las mamis, ya que hubo un comité organizador que se encargó de los obsequios, bebidas, pasapalos y dulcería, incluso hubo rifas y premios para las ganadoras. Pero lo que más me gusto fue la canción que nos cantaron los niños, ellos practicaron toda la semana pasada junto con su maestra que fue la encargada de los ensayos, mi hijo guardo muy bien el secreto porque no me conto nada en esta oportunidad realmente me sorprendió y me encanto.* *Esa mañana estuvo cargada de mucho amor y ternura por parte de los niños, ellos estaban felices y orgullosos de tenernos junto a ellos, siendo nuestra presencia muy valiosa ya que están en una edad donde están afianzando su confianza y autoestima, por lo que las invito a estar siempre presente en estos actos escolares, que quedaran en su memoria por siempre. Como siempre un gusto en compartirles mis experiencias, hasta una nueva oportunidad.* ##

*English Version* 🌹

>

***It’s a pleasure to greet you, dear parents of @motherhood, especially the moms in this wonderful community. Since Mother’s Day was celebrated a few days ago, I hope you all had a wonderful time with your little treasures; In my case, I’d like to share that this week we were treated to a special celebration at my son’s school. I truly love these events because they allow me to strengthen my bond with my children even more, as well as enjoy the poems, songs, cards, and gifts that their teachers organize with such care to give the children the chance to show the immense love they feel for us.*** ***Although I personally believe that Mother’s Day is every day, these dates are symbolic, and that’s why I participate with enthusiasm. Unlike other events, this one was full of surprises for us moms, as there was an organizing committee that handled the gifts, drinks, snacks, and sweets; there were even raffles and prizes for the winners. But what I liked most was the song the children sang for us; they practiced all last week with their teacher, who was in charge of the rehearsals. My son kept the secret very well because he didn’t tell me anything—this time, he really surprised me, and I loved it.*** ***That morning was filled with so much love and affection from the children; they were happy and proud to have us there with them. Our presence was especially meaningful, as they are at an age when they are building their confidence and self-esteem. That is why I encourage you to always attend these school events, which will remain in their memories forever. As always, it’s a pleasure to share my experiences with you. Until next time.*** *** https://youtu.be/HPgApnv-k34 ***

时间过得快，周末又过完了，这两天也是过得挺充实，昨天上午还在家学习了一上午的英语，但是下午就睡了几个小时，主要肚子有点不舒服，一躺就躺了好久，我心飞翔户外活动，这周又在凤山疯了。

当然我没有缺席，去时刚到九点，今天的人没有前几次的人多，我是这样想的，不管怎么样，有人一起玩，挺好的，还可以晒太阳，更好的是，有很多专业摄影师给大家拍了很多的相片 ，有时拿出来看看，很是好玩的。 

今天我们没有走山脚下，反而走的凤山山上，我们在山上空逛的地方，一起拍抖音，还有跳广场舞，整个过程还是挺开心，这次没有像上次一样，音响很差，这次那个大姐，还是带了一个大的音响，大家在山上跳交易舞，还有拔河，呵呵，回到家中我的脚又开始痛了，看来我还是玩得太久了。 

到了下午，我又开始公干起来，一个部门layout图，忙了一下午也没忙完，看了下微信，老家群里，有个老爷爷在群里好像骂人，看到这些文字感觉真的不好，也不知哪个得罪他了，以至于他在群里说一些不好听的，这大山的人，两耳不闻外面的事，真的有点小民思想。

打电话给爸爸，问他在做什么，他说在弄猪草，老爸为了奍一头大家爱吃的肉，可真的是舍得吃苦呀，可伶天下父母心，下午出太阳了，还好欢欢的被子晒干，明天可以盖香香被单了，这孩子今天可勤外了，还把自己的鞋子洗得干干净净了。

---

Hello. Friends

We would like to run a contest to revitalize the Korean Hive Village community.

We want to grow into a contest where all my HIVE friends can participate. Please comment if you have any good opinions.

Thank you for your support

@melinda010100 - Ecency Points

If you would like to sponsor for the revitalization of the community, please leave a comment.

Thank you ❤️

***1.Post on Korean Hive Village***

# Prompt : Sharing K-Culture

Please share any pieces of Korean culture you’ve experienced over the past week. Any field is welcome!

🎨 K-Culture Categories to Talk About
👉K-Food (Dining Culture): Tell us about visiting Korean restaurants, cooking Korean food yourself, or your experience with communal dining.

👉K-Content (Media): Share interesting scenes or memorable backgrounds from K-Dramas, movies, or variety shows you watched.

👉K-Pop (Music): Talk about listening to your favorite artist’s new song, watching music videos, or participating in dance challenges.

👉K-Beauty & Fashion (Style): Share your stories about trying Korean skincare/makeup or styling yourself with Korean fashion brands.

👉K-Language (Language): Introduce new Korean words or grammar you learned, or funny episodes you had while studying Korean.

👉K-Webtoon & Literature (Books): Share the Korean emotions you felt while reading webtoons on your phone or Korean novels.

👉Etc: Feel free to share any other K-Culture experiences that don't fit into the categories above.

✍️ Writing Guide
Select an Experience: Choose a category from the list above that you experienced this week.

Describe in Detail: Tell us specifically about a taste, a scene, or a moment that left the deepest impression on you.

Share Your Thoughts: Write about the feelings you had or what new things you learned about Korean culture through that experience

We will select 3 people who write good quality posts for the community.

1st place 20 HSBI, 300 Ecency Points 🎁
2st place 10 HSBI, 200 Ecency Points 🎁

body.body: > **Hello, amazing Liketu community!** 👋📸 I just wanted to stop by and send some good vibes your way. Every photo you take tells a story, captures a moment, and reflects a unique perspective of the world. Never underestimate the power of your lens. 🎞️✨ _“Don’t wait for the perfect moment – take the ordinary and make it extraordinary through your eyes.”_ 🌈 Sometimes we think we need the best camera, the perfect lighting, or a spectacular scene… but the real magic is already within you. Keep creating, keep sharing, and keep supporting each other. That’s what makes Liketu so special. 💛 * * *

>

**¡Hola, increíble comunidad de Liketu!** 👋📸 Quería pasar por aquí para enviarles buenas vibras. Cada foto que toman cuenta una historia, captura un momento y refleja una perspectiva única del mundo. Nunca subestimen el poder de su lente. 🎞️✨ _“No esperes el momento perfecto: toma lo cotidiano y hazlo extraordinario a través de tus ojos.”_ 🌈 A veces pensamos que necesitamos la mejor cámara, la iluminación perfecta o una escena espectacular… pero la verdadera magia ya está dentro de ustedes. Sigan creando, compartiendo y apoyándose mutuamente. Eso es lo que hace tan especial a Liketu. 💛

body.title: The Wheel Keeps Turning
body.body: /> [source](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HItXOFhX0AAaixV.jpg) The difference between winning and losing is so small and this season was no exception with Arsenal winning the title by less than 3 points which is only 1 match. 38 games in the Premier League season and it comes down to one result that went for or against you. When you are at the top in business or sport you have to continue to strive to always do better and be better. At the top you have set the marker or benchmark for others to achieve and you can never be complacent. The saying that it is harder to stay at the top is so true as others are always trying to replace you. The wheel turns and remaining at h the top means you have to work twice as hard as those trying to catch you. Today Arsenal Football club will be handed the English Premier League trophy whilst at the same time Manchester City will be bidding farewell to Pep Guardiola who is leaving the club after 10 years in charge. Guardiola managed the club to four league titles in a row which had never been done before and for good reason. Doing it once is a great achievement, but doing it for the next three years is seriously difficult. Arsenal with the average age of the squad being so young they have the chance to win the title for the next few years. The only difference is the added pressure and expectations having won it once and next season teams will target Arsenal seeing them in a different light. Next season will be that much harder and why teams struggle to win the title two or three times in a row. With the squad Arsenal have they will be favorites for next season which is the added pressure for next season and who knows how they will handle this. More players will need to be added to the squad and depending on how that is handled will be the next step whether they can continue this winning run or not.

/></center>

[source](https://www.britannica.com/sports/List-of-Formula-One-Champions)

Formula One is no different from the demands of football and it is not just the driver or stars, but the entire team/squad package that has been assembled.

Over the last 15 years in Formula One we have seen red Bull dominate with 4 constructors titles followed by Mercedes 7 times and then Red Bull again winning another 4 in a row. McLaren won the constructors title last year and they could win it again this year, but the chances are they wont as everything is against you. In some ways the pressure is off because you have achieved the winning of the title but the pressure should be ramped up even more as last years result should kick the team on to improve even more.

The wheel keeps turning and if you do not improve and make changes then the following season will not necessarily be as successful. Look at Liverpool Football Club and how they have struggled this season after dominating last season. Liverpool may have gone backwards this season or the other clubs have improved which I would guess is a bit of both and is the 5% swing that makes  the difference. 

Whether it is football or formula one the difference between winning and coming second are so small that consistency and luck play a role. In Formula One we saw rule and regulation changes impact the likes of Mercedes benefitting Red Bull and this will continue to change the landscape in the future benefiting one team over another. The margins are that tight between winning and losing.

body.title: ‎Web3 Utopia vs. Street Reality
body.body: >Durante muchos años el ecosistema cripto y la web3 nos han vendido una narrativa idílica 'La descentralización es el barco de salvación para los creadores en desarrollo ' y que la blockchain democratiza el dinero y que cualquiera con una idea puede vivir de su arte ain depender de intermediarios.

>Sin embargo los que habitamos de este lado del mapa sabemos que entre el PDF que explica la teoría básica del web3 del asfalto caliente de la calle hay un abismo realmente gigantesco.

\n\n*

>La primera fricción es la infraestructura.

‎ >

>La narrativa asume que todos operamos bajo las mismas condiciones no te hablan del desgaste físico de lidiar con cortes de energía o de caminar cuadros buscando una señal de internet móvil estable solo para subir una fotografía al blog cuando los ingresos mensuales promedian la pena unos cuantos dólares.

‎

>Aqui darle al botón de publicar a veces requiere un esfuerzo logístico que consume más energía que la creación del post en sí.

‎ * La segunda fricción y quizá la más silenciosa es la fatiga social. ‎ >
>‎La promesa de que tu cerebro es recompensado (Proof of Brain) a veces se siente más como una \

para que un post de arte real se ha visto en un mar de contenido genérico se nos exige una labor de relaciones públicas constante que agota y el arte deja de ser libre cuando el creador debe pasar horas comentando perfiles ajenos no por conectar sino por pura supervivencia algorítmica.

‎ **(ojo no estoy escribiendo esto desde un resentimiento sino desde esa necesidad de humanizar la tecnología porque la web 3 es una herramienta increíble pero no es mágica detrás de cada publicación de dos dólares a veces hay horas de frustración calor cortes de luz y un artista que se debate entre seguir creando o simplemente tirar la toalla, yo creo que es hora de que la blockchain empiece a mirar más el esfuerzo de la calle y menos la perfección de sus propias narrativas.)** ‎

> > Si ésta publicación llegó hasta ti me encantaría leer tu perspectiva en la sección de comentarios: ‎ * Crees que la web 3 realmente ha cumplido su promesa en tu localidad? * Cómo lidias con el balance entre crear arte real y hacer relaciones públicas en la plataforma? * * * * * * * * * ‎ Web3 Utopia vs. Street Reality: Salvation or Digital Fatigue? ------------------------------------------------------------- ‎

>For many years, the crypto ecosystem and Web3 have sold us an idyllic narrative: “Decentralization is the lifeboat for emerging creators,” and that blockchain democratizes money, allowing anyone with an idea to make a living from their art without relying on intermediaries.

‎ _However, those of us on this side of the map know that there is a truly gigantic chasm between the PDF explaining the basic theory of Web3 and the hot asphalt of the street._ ‎ * The first friction is infrastructure. ‎ >

>The narrative assumes we all operate under the same conditions; it doesn’t tell you about the physical strain of dealing with power outages or walking blocks looking for a stable mobile internet signal just to upload a photo to a blog when monthly income averages a measly few dollars.

‎

>Here, hitting the publish button sometimes requires a logistical effort that consumes more energy than creating the post itself.

‎ * The second friction, and perhaps the quietest, is social fatigue. ‎ >

>The promise that your brain is rewarded (Proof of Brain) sometimes feels more like a “Proof of Public Relations.” For a post featuring real art to be seen in a sea of generic content, we’re required to engage in constant, exhausting public relations work, and art ceases to be free when the creator must spend hours commenting on others’ profiles—not to connect, but for pure algorithmic survival.

‎

> **And mind you, I’m not writing this out of resentment but out of a need to humanize technology, because Web 3 is an incredible tool, but it’s not magic. Behind every two-dollar post, there are sometimes hours of frustration, heat, power outages, and an artist torn between continuing to create or simply throwing in the towel. I believe it’s time for blockchain to start looking more at the effort on the ground and less at the perfection of its own narratives.** ‎ ‎ > If this post reached you, I’d love to read your perspective in the comments section: ‎ ‎ * Do you think Web3 has truly delivered on its promise in your community? * How do you balance creating real art with doing PR on the platform? * * * * * * Post translated from spanish to english by **DeepL**.

></center>\n\nI’m posting this with the intention and need to grow, move forward, and keep creating original content without feeling like I’m wasting my time. I’m not trying to offend anyone or stir up controversy; I just want feedback and to see how my content can push those boundaries.

body.title: Guard the Room You Grow In
body.body:
>

Personal development doesn't rest on willpower or motivation alone, because your environment is always doing one of two things, either nurturing your growth or quietly shutting it down.

>El desarrollo personal no depende solo de la fuerza de voluntad o la motivación, porque tu entorno siempre está haciendo una de dos cosas, o nutre tu crecimiento o lo va apagando en silencio.

You can chase a goal with everything you've got and still stall out if you're working in a cluttered space, carrying heavy relationships, or answering to situations that clash with your values.

>Puedes perseguir una meta con todo lo que tienes y aun así quedarte a medias si trabajas en un espacio desordenado, cargas con relaciones pesadas, o respondes ante situaciones que chocan con tus valores.

The shift is to step into your role as the gatekeeper of your own space, and choose on purpose where, how, and with whom you spend your energy. I've watched genuinely creative ideas fade under the weight of criticism from people standing close by, and I've felt firsthand how my peace and productivity rise or fall depending on who and what I let into my world.

>El cambio está en asumir tu papel como guardián de tu propio espacio, y elegir a propósito dónde, cómo y con quién inviertes tu energía. He visto cómo ideas verdaderamente creativas se apagan bajo el peso de la crítica de personas que tienes cerca, y he sentido en carne propia cómo mi paz y mi productividad suben o bajan según a quién y qué dejo entrar en mi mundo.

So here's a question for you, which part of your current environment, physical or relational, is quietly draining your capacity to grow?

> Así que aquí va una pregunta para ti, ¿qué parte de tu entorno actual, físico o relacional, está drenando en silencio tu capacidad de crecer?

body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779636307805-57f995d79bb84da6.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/ce758afb)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/ce758afb)


---

Hi,hello! friends how are you all? I hope you all are well.I am also well by the grace of God.So today I will introduce you to a first-person gun shooting game.The name of the game is Zombie Fire 3D.The game is a very serious quality game this game.I am very happy and excited to play it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSqsiqJgoXPQQf148Pn1L7eNpce9f3Tw62iufuYzEJbL/img_3219.jpg)

The main story of the game is that for some reason, the people of the entire world are completely infected with a virus and later they turn into zombies. Now you, as the last man, will fight against them and your main goal will be to finish them off.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXAGZbofZRGh3VVs9m8ZE9HRjA9aPx1eTLnY3C52v75kr/img_3220.jpg)

The game is basically an action quality game with a lot of thrills and excitement that will excite you.The game has a variety of weapons, including double pistols, AK-47s, snipers, rifles, and other guns.When you complete the missions, you will get coins. Later, with those coins, you can update your gun and after updating, you will be able to kill zombies easily.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeaeWMgG16Bb47uGQmxxmDEevVz52pPmh3CYmxoM2pQKb/img_3221.jpg)

Usually, this game uses amazing graphics. It shows a whole ruined city with only zombies and the condition of the city is very bad and disgusting, but the graphics are extremely realistic.The control system in the game is very simple. You can't just move the game forward or backward. That is, you have to stand in one place and shoot with a gun. You can't move.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZiBdTL2YGUSu3ioZtaZtxFdjQQj1RMwG4YoKR2eWYYDA/img_3222.jpg)

Due to the use of 3D graphics in the game, the action, thrills, and surprises that will appear in front of you in this game are very detailed and visually beautiful. And the sound is of such terrible quality that it feels completely real.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmasFQshP2e2ocMgN7bW9kzbfbh3mM3TSR2T2cd5xtpSAc/img_3223.jpg)

One of the fun things about the game is that among all the shooting games I have played, this is the best and I have never played a game like this before. I want you to try the game at least once because I want you to enjoy its exciting moments.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTWvD8KK1c8VKCXkCnHmdomUaqNUUuKzz2L55o8XdUu9B/img_3225.jpg)

Finally, the game can be a great choice for a shooting lover and those who like to play such action games because every moment is very challenging and exciting. There is no telling what will happen in this game and the game becomes very hard as the mission is completed.

👉Thumbnail source: Captured By me during the gameplay.

Thanks for watching my video.

@likhon420

---

It shows a whole ruined city with only zombies and the condition of the city is very bad and disgusting, but the graphics are extremely realistic.The control system in the game is very simple. You can't just move the game forward or backward. That is, you have to stand in one place and shoot with a gun. You can't move.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZiBdTL2YGUSu3ioZtaZtxFdjQQj1RMwG4YoKR2eWYYDA/img_3222.jpg)

Due to the use of 3D graphics in the game, the action, thrills, and surprises that will appear in front of you in this game are very detailed and visually beautiful. And the sound is of such terrible quality that it feels completely real.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmasFQshP2e2ocMgN7bW9kzbfbh3mM3TSR2T2cd5xtpSAc/img_3223.jpg)

One of the fun things about the game is that among all the shooting games I have played, this is the best and I have never played a game like this before. I want you to try the game at least once because I want you to enjoy its exciting moments.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTWvD8KK1c8VKCXkCnHmdomUaqNUUuKzz2L55o8XdUu9B/img_3225.jpg)

Finally, the game can be a great choice for a shooting lover and those who like to play such action games because every moment is very challenging and exciting. There is no telling what will happen in this game and the game becomes very hard as the mission is completed.

Thanks for watching my video.

/>

  
The small clay stove standing quietly in the corner reminds me of a time when life was slower, simpler, and closer to nature. Every mark on the wall and every piece of straw on the ground carries memories of hard work, warmth, and family gatherings.  
What makes black and white photography powerful is the emotion it creates. Without colors, the focus shifts to texture, light, shadows, and feeling. This image may look simple, but it speaks of tradition, peace, and the beauty hidden in everyday life.  
Sometimes, the oldest places carry the strongest stories.

body.title: Charity And Social Media Drama
body.body:
>Social media has contributed immensely to our society: it has dislodged the barrier of distance and brought the world closer. In charity, social media has a great influence. Unlike those days when people had to travel great distances to identify needs, create awareness, and so on, through the aid of social media, those things can be done remotely. There was a time on Hive when someone gave me a job to find people who are needy and tag them, so that his team can find a way to support them. Within a few days, I was able to locate a few individuals on the platform, and it was only possible for me because of Hive. Imagine Hive was not in the picture; only God knows how much I would have to spend on transportation in order to reach these people. The provision for people to blog on social media has been of great help. Someone can see a situation somewhere and decide to make a post about it, and through that, people might come through and tackle it. But with all these come disadvantages too. People will always be people; the same post to genuinely attract helpers, others do it with the wrong mindset. Nowadays, people use people's predicaments to their own advantage, especially those seeking recognition and public approval. To every assistance they render, there is a photo taken, not to inspire others to reach out to the needy, but to publicize that they are also philanthropists. A small visit to an orphanage home, they create a post, a small gift rendered to someone, they make a post, and it's not bad in itself. The concern is that those receiving the help sometimes feel bad about it. Sometimes it looks like mockery, exposing their faces and their predicaments. Personally, I don't feel comfortable using anything someone gave me and talking about it. If it were possible, I think it would be best if we apply wisdom while we post about our workof charity. Whether or not the people are comfortable about exposing their identity, I reckon it's best we withhold certain details. People can be funny; one might make a post for good, but others might not see it that way. I have gone through a few charity posts, and I saw certain comments that are not favorable from people. Although they may look like showing sympathy, yet they may affect the receiver negatively. Months later, if that same person comes across such a post and the comment, just consider how they will feel. Aside from this issue of giving too much information that affects the receiver, certain people also fabricate situations of need and use them to scam people. Someone can just go around and snap a fake situation, cook up stories, and make a post about it. Being human with emotions, someone with a good heart might see it and fall victim to a scam. It's sad that we can't completely eradicate these problems, but we can do something about them. When we give, our intentions should be pure, and if we are compelled to make a post about it, we should make posts that wouldn't harm the receivers subsequently. And in the case of scams, we should also verify projects properly before we give our support.

Thanks For Reading

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@emreal/charity-and-social-media-drama-2be)

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | Marrying after the death of a spouse, is it allowed by the bible
body.body: > https://youtu.be/z-gs7LxXXuc?si=B59CCBB9dvNLnWwy When you lose a spouse, it is one of the most devastating events to go through in life. The heart can be very heavy, lonely and broken. When the passing of a spouse occurs many people start asking questions such as, “Can I remarry after my husband or wife dies?” or “Would God be angry if I remarry?” I believe the bible allows remarriage if the one had passed away. God knows how weak, lonely and how it hurts to be human. The Bible says in Romans 7:2, “For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth…” This means that the marriage bond lasts while both husband and wife are alive. If someone passes away then the other person is no longer bound by that. Also, 1 Corinthians 7:39 says, “The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.” In this scripture, it is clearly stated that remarrying is okay, but under God's fear. I can attest firsthand to the agony of grief and the feeling of being alone after the loss of someone dear. I recall the case of an old person's husband who passed away after many years of marriage. She was always sad and don't say much. I would see her sitting alone, outside her house, and thinking intensely, sometimes. Later, after a few years, she married a godly man, who also lost his wife. I could see her life return to peace again at first some people criticized her. She was more joyful, firmer, and more optimistic. That encounter with God taught me that God does not want people to be in unending sorrow and loneliness. But remarriage should not be hasty. There must be a person who prays, is healed from emotional issues and knows God's direction before making such a decision. Marriage is still a sacred thing before God. Hebrews 13:4: Marriage is honourable in all. God is concerned about the heart of His children and their intentions. I also saw that not all people are going to want to remarry, and that's fine, as well. There are others who will choose not to marry and be single for God's service. Others may feel they need to be accompanied again. Both decisions should be respected. The only thing important is to live according to God and have a clean conscience. So, the Bible doesn't say no to remarriage after divorce. God is compassionate, kind and gracious. He has experienced the loss of a loved one and knows how to comfort, support and be a companion. After such a loss, the decision made by an individual should be made prayerfully, sincerely and in God's will.

body.title: [EN/ES] Notes and Summary on Structures
body.body:
### Notes and Summary on Structures > ### Notas y resumen sobre estructuras ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmabJNPwuN51aEsaYXFV67tC5ZbCNcoUXgQPBEFKu3FwWh/308_sin_t_tulo_20260517172055.jpg) I took these notes while watching a YouTube tutorial about the use and necessity of structuring drawings. Structure is where drawings have to begin; it's planning before adding details. It's like the skeleton of the drawing. With structure we can represent: size, location, pose. Everything has a basic structure, and creating it can serve as our guide. When we draw, we need to go from general to specific, leaving details for last, so we ensure everything is in its place. There are very famous structures like Andrew Loomis's for the face and human body. > Estas notas las tomé mientras veía un tutorial de YouTube sobre el uso y la necesidad de estructurar los dibujos. La estructura es por donde tienen que comenzar los dibujos, es planificar antes de dar detalles. Es como el esqueleto del dibujo, con la estructura podemos representar: tamaño, ubicación, pose. Todo tiene estructura base, y hacerla nos puede servir de guía. Cuando dibujamos hay que ir de lo general a lo particular, dejando los detalles para el final, así nos aseguramos de que todo esté en su lugar. Hay estructuras muy famosas como la de Andrew Loomis para el rostro y el cuerpo humano. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQda8CMmMWgC3xKPTGJ6Fm5VpJpR8debxH7fXS74Pp2Ro/318_sin_t_tulo_20260517181810.jpg) I practiced drawing some objects using structures. Most objects are composed of, or can be broken down into, simple shapes like spheres and cylinders. The hardest part is understanding not so much the shapes they are made of, but rather the perspective those shapes have. > Practiqué dibujando algunos objetos usando estructuras. Los objetos, en su mayoría, están compuestos, o se pueden descomponer, en formas simples como esferas y cilindros. Lo más difícil es entender no tanto las formas por las que están compuestos, sino la perspectiva que estas formas tienen. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmciZvQTJJrH1K7W2zTCcVkxbMBU4krECy1ekjKSStvwJs/318_sin_t_tulo_20260517190138.jpg) The structure in animals behaves differently: there are more curves and rounded shapes, and the sizes and proportions of the shapes that compose them vary a lot. Sometimes I find it very difficult to draw animals precisely because of that, but there is no other solution than to try and keep drawing. > La estructura en los animales se comporta distinto: hay más curvas y formas redondeadas, además los tamaños y proporciones de las formas que los componen varían mucho. En ocasiones se me complica mucho dibujar animales y es debido justamente a eso, pero no hay más solución que intentarlo y seguir dibujando. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVbZ3TqTd6mTNuYG3aguDqtHdMZLTT4VXtRX3t1iupMoV/318_sin_t_tulo_20260517190920.jpg) In humans it is also different, and the proportions and different body shapes have a great influence. Here is a small compilation of studies and structures on the human body that I have done. > En humanos también es distinto, y las proporciones y distintas formas de los cuerpos influyen mucho. Aquí un pequeño recopilatorio de estudios y estructuras sobre el cuerpo humano que he hecho. |![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaYBp3mGPVaLiF9eB7krqipepa8g5p99r4tApwZiE319P/318_sin_t_tulo_20260517192958.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYRqWQ5Q1HFZX3CphcKZJk8GxohRD7TPmndNdZWpvnKo5/318_sin_t_tulo_20260517192823.jpg)| |------------|------------| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP5JGSz1BLp1AxaqFt11cBxaNRi9uZrSHhRV8qfK45R8E/318_sin_t_tulo_20260517192758.jpg) | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWJyN2WnwuWSCC3seJsQCUjyezNGNBxiFGBeKiKawhzRG/318_sin_t_tulo_20260518084310.jpg) | Here is how a drawing I made putting all this into practice turned out, and I also share the structuring process with you. > Así quedó un dibujo que hice poniendo todo esto en práctica, y el proceso de estructura del mismo también se los comparto. Thank you for accompanying me one more day of drawing. > Gracias por acompañarme un día más dibujando. --- ***About:*** ==*Sketchbook and Journal of a Learner*== **If you like my content, join my [Fanbase clicking here](https://hive.vote/dash.php?fan=nestodibuja&i=2)**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc31AecQSitU5xAjsqS4snajcWh6CMMyapx88itjomSah/thanks.png)
___ *All photos and images are created by me. These are pictures of my sketchbook. Many of my drawings are practice pieces rather than finished works. Images from the internet may or may not have been used as references, copies, or sources of inspiration as part of my learning process.*

body.title: The Silent Weight of Post Trauma
body.body: Many people struggle with PTSD silently after some terrifying experiences. To some persons, they heal almost immediately, while some carry the scars for many years, if not a lifetime, but then, I have come to realize that traumas of any kind don't leave a visible scar on our bodies but get them wounded in our hearts or minds, and that's the bad kind of trauma. Only you can vividly understand what you are going through, no one else, and it can eat you slowly without you realizing it. I know this because I have been there. ![1001149618.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/243BaRYS9EposwrrTpuPdh6MvuuZBZYCJy99TFi8JpFVbvAdG3ehmDZ7AhAvxkC8vXiNB.jpg) Seven years ago, my husband and I experienced a terrifying moment with my son when he first had a seizure that made him unconscious for hours, and he could breathe using oxygen at the emergency department in the hospital. It happened like a movie; I wanted to wake up from the dream, but unfortunately, it was my reality. We have both never experienced such from any child while we were growing up, and so the experience shattered our hearts with so much fear and the feeling of helplessness. In fact, I can't totally explain the experience by writing, but it was emotionally exhausting. After the whole situation was resolved and he became stable, the fear never left me. I started living in the shadow of myself. Every single body change in the life of my child, my heart will skip, a little complaint of headache from him, or vomit, I wouldn't sleep anymore; I will be awake all through the night watching him to be sure it doesn't lead to seizure. Sadly, it happened to him in school one of the days that made his school run helter-skelter to the nearest hospital. Ever since that event too, I have been traumatized. Once I receive a call from his teacher, I will be tense; the shiver and the stammering on the phone are nothing to write home about. I have begged his teacher and the school admin to stop calling me during the school hours because I could faint one day seeing their calls. Any call from them, I will conclude that the seizure has started again in school. I have suffered so much emotionally; I can't explain it all. Even when I step out to the market or for an event and my sister living with me calls me on the phone, my heart skips. I will feel she is calling because of my son again; the trauma is real. Even with the way he has been stable for a long time, the fear hasn't disappeared. No doubt, the scars of the past experiences are still very much fresh in my heart and mind. My mind is always preparing for danger, with no calmness at all; it's bad. But then gradually, I kept settling emotionally through faith, prayers, and support from my family and great friends. They never allowed me to carry the burden alone, and I kept moving from strength to strength, knowing that I was not alone. I am not expecting my healing to happen overnight, but I know it's possible; it's only a matter of time. This post is in response to the Hive Learners prompt on the topic titled, **POST TRAUMA**. ## Image is mine!

body.title: Royal Thief Has Strong Rob From the Rich Give to the Poor Vibes
body.body:
Take your pick of favorite Robin Hood movie, mine is Men in Tights, and turn on that soundtrack and take on Royal Thief on the Atari 2600. While this is obviously not a licensed Robin Hood game, it does borrow elements from that fable so I am going to run with it. Take control over your brave peasant and perform a one manned assault on the rich king’s castle – he has too much money anyhow, right?

Action Adventuring at Its Best

Considering the hardware limitations, Royal Thief’s developer, [Artefacto Games on itch.io]( https://artefacto.itch.io/royal-thief), has chosen a 2D side view format which works great on the Atari 2600. I have not played Royal Thief, so any opinions and statements are strictly based on available media (screenshots and gameplay video). Graphically Royal Thief is basic but clean. More graphical than most Atari 2600 titles that we see. I am not a programmer, so I have no clue how hard Artefacto Games were able to push the hardware here. https://youtu.be/-m76sL5rqj0

Challenges Await

Considering your goal is to take gold from the rich king, you are going to be traversing some dangerous terrain. Guards will wait under bridges for you to pass so they can stab you with their spears. There is a blockade forcing you to keep moving forward as well so don’t take too long to choose your next action. If you can complete your goal, then you can bring relief to the people of the kingdom. It is not all that often we get games like Royal Thief, at least on the Atari 2600. With that said, check out the [gameplay video Artefacto Games]( https://artefacto.itch.io/royal-thief) have made available on their itch.io page and see if Royal Thief will bring thievery into your near future.

body.title: Around the Yard - May 23, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
![Gloomy cold day crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/244oXC7WbTheSW3YY7Yp2QgfXdxXmdA3DAN1A3E74NDjBcXRgCrASQWbbKdoqMFv5G91E.jpg)

Saturday morning was very gloomy and cold. I got my post up and the kitchen cleaned up and the butter made then rested for 2 hours. I headed out at noon to start the mowing.

![Around the yard collage5 text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/243WY3W6EeSsc9C7BXgKKJaNuyDj4Nizp1vCCAQXUwuWKFHehWM1NoFXjoHN6YqocGfTu.jpg)

It took an hour to do the push mower and it even started again when I had to stop it to empty the grass catcher. Even with no rain since I last mowed, the grass was lush and high.

I finished the mowing at 3:15PM and got a shower and went to bed and slept nearly 2 hours. I got up around 5:30PM and ordered some food. I’ve been reading Sue Grafton mysteries and her PI, Kinsey, lives on McDonald’s Quarter Pounders with Cheese and French fries. So I wanted one, but I haven’t ever eaten at McDonald’s since the early 1980’s.

But we have a restaurant in the city near me that uses only local grassfed beef and produce, so I ordered their over the top double burger and fries. My intern arrived just a bit before and we decided to have movie night. She decided she wanted a burger too, so she ordered from this restaurant too.

![Wood stove 3rd week of crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EoEjHy7GeYM5BE2kJZHCw6ucDTyR13S9QdbBZPinV5mLDkMnnXxKezFeoymQCj7TYyy.jpg)

The temperature was dropping as the storms moved closer and so we decided to light both stoves to be warm the next day. So she brought in wood and I got them going.

Once both orders arrived, she picked out a movie and decided on ‘Erin Brockovich’.

![Erin Brockovich crop.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/243zvz59gLkWkz9o8PACA9sYTTFZbaz7Q22pBcChcqMLB2w6CCA9G5iJkkwnSf7xtzVBz.jpg)

*[source](https://www.amazon.com/Erin-Brockovich-Region-Julia-Roberts/dp/B00004W4GT)*

So we snacked on our food from trays and watched the movie. It was pretty late for both of us when it finished at 9:30PM. She had pulled the shades and put more wood in the wood stove. I put more in the masonry heater.

![Around the yard collage6 text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23zSBcznP2rDmfNdp7tRUE4mKQ3ZVz3UAayF179Rjy76Rodes6TwVm5vpaysSFDiGRpZy.jpg)

But between the late nap, and the late movie, I couldn’t get to sleep, so I sat and edited all the photos until I was tired enough to sleep. But even then, I didn’t fall asleep until midnight.

On Sunday we planned to have a lazy day, keep stoves going and watch movies. It’s to be cold and rain all day. The rain is to continue until after noontime on Monday. It would have been nice to work with her planting the garden but oh, well…

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gf37084f9e076cef9996f0a46e77b3482438461a8e8a8dd830e929ac070caa3590132ce46069fa4a21897327d84a637adc09f3dfa81f6846ddeadaee50e373cb9_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 探索隐藏的宝藏

在这个快速变化的世界中，许多美丽的地方仍然隐藏在喧嚣的城市和知名的旅游景点之外。今天，我想带大家一起探索一些鲜为人知的旅游目的地，它们不仅风景如画，还充满了独特的文化和历史。让我们一起揭开这些隐藏宝藏的面纱吧！

## 1. **南美洲的巴塔哥尼亚**

巴塔哥尼亚位于阿根廷和智利的交界处，以其壮观的冰川、雄伟的山脉和广袤的草原而闻名。尽管它的美丽吸引了少数探险者，但仍有许多游客未曾踏足这片神秘的土地。这里是徒步旅行者的天堂，您可以在托雷斯德尔潘恩国家公园中体验到令人叹为观止的景色。

### 必游景点：
- **佩里托莫雷诺冰川**：观赏冰川崩塌的壮观场面。
- **菲茨罗伊山**：挑战自我，攀登这座标志性的山峰。

## 2. **欧洲的斯洛文尼亚**

斯洛文尼亚是一个被忽视的欧洲宝藏，拥有迷人的自然风光和丰富的历史文化。这个小国以其美丽的湖泊、山脉和古老的城堡而闻名，是一个理想的度假胜地。

### 必游景点：
- **布莱德湖**：在湖边的岛屿上享受宁静的时光。
- **卢布尔雅那**：探索这座迷人的首都，品尝当地美食。

## 3. **亚洲的吉尔吉斯斯坦**

吉尔吉斯斯坦是一个被群山环绕的中亚国家，拥有令人惊叹的自然景观和丰富的游牧文化。这里的徒步旅行和骑马体验将让您感受到大自然的魅力。

### 必游景点：
- **伊塞克湖**：在这个美丽的湖泊旁放松身心。
- **阿拉套山脉**：体验刺激的徒步旅行和露营。

## 4. **非洲的马达加斯加**

马达加斯加是一个独特的岛国，拥有丰富的生物多样性和独特的生态系统。这里的许多动植物在其他地方是无法找到的，是自然爱好者的天堂。

### 必游景点：
- **阿尔达贝拉国家公园**：探索独特的树木和野生动物。
- **诺西贝岛**：享受阳光沙滩和潜水的乐趣。

## 结语

这些隐藏的宝藏等待着您的探索。无论您是喜欢冒险、文化还是美食，这些目的地都能为您提供独特的体验。下次计划旅行时，不妨考虑这些鲜为人知的地方，开启一段难忘的旅程吧！

---

body.body: 🌸 Un nuevo comienzo: Mamá, esposa y creadora / A new beginning: Mom, wife, and creator\n\n<span class=\

¡Hola de nuevo, comunidad de Hive! Hace casi tres años que no publicaba nada por aquí. La última vez que estuve activa, mi vida se veía un poco diferente. Hoy regreso no solo con más experiencia, como algunos saben soy mamá y, hace ya un año, el padre de mi hija me pidió que me casara con el. Sí, durante este tiempo me pidieron matrimonio y mi hermosa hija ha crecido muchísimo, convirtiéndose en mi mayor motivación y compañera de aventuras.

/> > Hello again, Hive community! It’s been almost three years since I last posted here. The last time I was active, my life looked a little different. Today I’m back not only with more experience—as some of you know, I’m a mom—but also because, a year ago, my daughter’s father asked me to marry him. Yes, during this time I got engaged, and my beautiful daughter has grown so much, becoming my greatest source of motivation and my partner in adventure. >## 🐾 De la nostalgia al amor: De Alegría a Cosmo / From nostalgia to love: From Alegría to Cosmo Estos tres años estuvieron llenos de momentos hermosos, pero también de despedidas que me marcaron profundamente. Viví la dolorosa pérdida de mi perrita Alegría, quien fue mi compañera fiel y dejó un vacío enorme en casa. Sin embargo, la vida nos deja bendiciones en medio de la tristeza: antes de partir, Alegría me dejó a una de sus crías. Hoy en día él es el consentido de la casa, mi compañero de cuatro patas y se llama Cosmo. Él trajo de vuelta esa chispa y amor perruno que tanto necesitábamos. These three years were full of beautiful moments, but also of goodbyes that deeply affected me. I went through the painful loss of my sweet dog, Alegría, who was my loyal companion and left a huge void at home. However, life leaves us blessings in the midst of sadness: before passing away, Alegría left me one of her puppies. Today, he is the spoiled one of the house, my four-legged companion, and his name is Cosmo. He brought back that spark and puppy love we needed so much. >## 🇰🇷 Mis nuevos refugios: K-dramas y K-pop / My new happy places: K-dramas and K-pop En medio de la rutina de ser mamá, las tareas del hogar, encontré un nuevo espacio de desconexión que me atrapó por completo: ¡la cultura coreana!

/>

> [https://www.pinterest.com/pin/19140367163506541/](https://www.pinterest.com/pin/19140367163506541/)

Me he vuelto una fanática de los K-dramas (esas historias que te hacen reír y llorar a la vez) y del K-pop. Grupos como BTS (¡especialmente Jungkook!) y Twice se convirtieron en la banda sonora de mis días mientras edito o simplemente paso el rato con mi familia. Incluso he estado aprendiendo a escribir en coreano, lo cual ha sido un reto increíble.

> Amid the daily grind of motherhood and household chores, I discovered a new way to unwind that completely captivated me: Korean culture!
> 
> I’ve become a huge fan of K-dramas (those stories that make you laugh and cry at the same time) and K-pop. Groups like BTS (especially Jungkook!) and Twice have become the soundtrack to my days while I edit videos or just hang out with my family. I’ve even been learning to write in Korean, which has been an incredible challenge.

>## 💡 ¿Qué verán en mi blog a partir de ahora? / What will you see on my blog from now on?

😘<span class=\

> Mi regreso a Hive viene con una perspectiva más madura y enfocada. Quiero que este espacio sea un reflejo de mi día a día y de mis conocimientos profesionales. On one hand, I am in denial of my age as I train martial arts, enjoy the same sports as I did when I was 30, and stay relatively active.  So, when I see most other people my age, I am pretty pleased.

On the other hand, being my vintage and trying to compete with younger training partners, there are so many things that hurt.  I make old uncle noises when I stand up.  The denial of getting old and frail seems like a futile battle I am slowly losing!

body.title: Los dulces de Dios y el pan de guayaba!
body.body: <div class=text-justify> \n\n>El ser una persona saludable no se construye de un día a otro, tampoco nace de la nada como si fuera magia. Es simplemente el resultado de un día a día luchando contra diversas tentaciones, pero poniéndose siempre de primero, eligiéndose a una misma por encima de la gratificación instantánea. Y sí, hoy me siento superculpable con todos los antojos que han pasado por mi mente como locas ideas, jajaja. Es que es una cosa impresionante, hoy no me quiero comer un solo dulce, ¡quiero comerme mil! La mente te juega sucio cuando estás intentando cambiar. Algo que me ha ayudado muchísimo a frenar estos antojos de locura ha sido la excelente opción de comer los \

, que es como bellamente les dice mi hijo. Con esto me refiero a todas las frutas, y hoy en particular me comeré una manzana para calmar la ansiedad.
![Gemini_Generated_Image_o03o8yo03o8yo03o.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmagabriela/23yJP3os4aMFXqt16HAX9QnQqdtsfPENEneTG2cesTMu9evVzRULuPtsZoWm2wq8wJ3jp.png)
***
>Llevaba demasiado tiempo dándole vueltas al asunto, pensando en la gran pregunta: ¿cómo comenzar? Pero al final lo hice muy fácil. Me metí en una inteligencia artificial, le di mi talla, mi peso, mi edad y respondí otras preguntas, y con eso pudo armarme un menú con el cual, créanlo o no, he rebajado 4 kilos en tan solo 15 días. Pero, ¿es la tecnología la dueña de mis victorias? Pues claro que no. Y aunque la herramienta tenga que ver en el proceso, la única ganadora de todo esto soy yo. Es que como dice el dicho popular, el que quiere besar busca la boca. Pues yo me metí en la cabeza la firme idea de hacer una dieta que me permitiera comer de forma sana, y así fue como logré llevar a cabo lo que hoy en día es mi plan de alimentación, por mi propia cuenta y voluntad. Cada quince días me tomo el tiempo de porcionar mis alimentos, peso absolutamente todo, cocino y organizo mi semana por completo. Antes veía a las chicas de Instagram haciendo esto de las cajitas de comida y me parecía un verdadero imposible, algo de otro mundo. Hoy en día ya le agarré el ritmo, sé perfectamente lo que me gusta, qué debo comprar en el supermercado, cómo lo debo guardar para que se conserve, etcétera. Pero ojo, eso no quiere decir que las tentaciones hayan desaparecido mágicamente. Claro que existen, y ahora mismo las siento más que nunca, superfuertes, superllenas de fuerza, como queriendo tumbarme el proceso.
![Gemini_Generated_Image_cg5stwcg5stwcg5s.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmagabriela/23wquAbGEAQBwyenmfQZc9MV9PzESBNXzoip8rdQ1Hneskaia7d2hU3yscTqekAAvqoVy.png)
***
>Es que al final del día, intentar no fallarse a una misma no es nada fácil, ya que la ansiedad nos ataca por donde menos lo pensamos y en el momento más vulnerable. Y ojo, cuando comenzamos una dieta, o mejor dicho como me gusta llamarlo a mí, un proceso, siempre hay alguien que sin querer te ofrece de todo, jajaja. Te sale pan, torta, donas, de TODO en el camino. Por ejemplo, ayer mi hermana me visitó y trajo una Coca-Cola y un pan de guayaba. Yo miraba ese pan y pensaba: si como un poquito, ¿qué puede pasar? Pero al final no lo hice, me mantuve firme. Y no lo hice porque no se trata de lo poco o lo mucho que coma en ese instante, sino de que sé perfectamente que morder ese pan es el inicio de empezar a fallarme otra vez. Y creo que lo ideal no es romper un compromiso tan grande contigo misma por un simple pan.
![Gemini_Generated_Image_ibkukeibkukeibku.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmagabriela/23wX7RFi83Nvus16tojKnLv41jAuCmXqmSZunNJEuxrYGJ9TdaHKXkTacCGZoxsUkeyqR.png)
***
>Pero ahora seamos más intensas, más sinceras con lo que se siente por dentro. Una dieta, o este proceso como lo estoy llamando, no es simplemente el hecho de ser restrictivo con lo que te metes a la boca. Esto va muchísimo más allá. Claro que duele cuando apartamos de nosotros algo que nos encanta, sí, pero el verdadero dolor llega cuando sentimos que no somos capaces de gestionarnos a nosotros mismos, cuando la comida nos domina. De siempre admiré a esas mujeres que se cuidan, que si hoy la moda es estar fitness ellas lo logran, pero ahora entiendo que no es moda, es que se eligen todos los días. Controlar lo que piensas, ganarle a la ansiedad y comerte el \

en lugar del pan de guayaba es la verdadera victoria. No es fácil, cuesta horrores, pero ver que sí eres capaz de dominar tus impulsos es lo que te hace sentir que por fin tienes el control de tu vida.
![Gemini_Generated_Image_3a8kan3a8kan3a8k (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmagabriela/23xejojVKSoSt3E9YCx5whCxfLZWN4uie5AG3yFnE9wdYSJctmFgyHNc5BtoZkLz2sCyw.png)

body.title: Homemade Potato Patty Burger – Spicy & Delicious
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTpNoYPjCYtQJk5LWAD4Suo4QtV67uHbqj1DAt8Fnz7hL/1779465700543.jpg)
___
# Hi foodies!
___
Hello everyone, how are you all? I hope you all are fine. I am also fine. So guys today I have come again with a new blog and today I made burgers with potato patties. In this blog I also showed how to make potato patties and how to make burgers. Guys you all gave me a very good response on my cheesy omelette blog and I became very happy because of that, thank you so much. Now without wasting much time let’s start making these delicious potato patties and burgers.
___
# Ingredients needed
___
Potatoes
Green chilies
Green onion
Coriander
Egg
Flour
Salt
Red chili powder
Crushed red chili
Cumin
Dried fenugreek leaves 
Dry coriander
Garam masala
Ketchup
Mayonnaise
___
# Preparing the potato patties
___
To make potato patties, first I took 7 potatoes, washed them and then added water in a bowl and put the potatoes in it. Then I added 1 tablespoon salt and 1 tablespoon red chili powder and kept them for boiling. I cooked them until the potatoes became soft properly.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdL5b6Us7uDHY7AbMronfm6yezscGg3RT4ngij5SBhJWk/1779464839798.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYQSizRcxUfMUzqDuAuT4aScfpuNdfJFaBqEXHR3vRc2x/1779464839901.jpg)

___
Now when the potatoes became soft, remove their peels and then grate them properly. Do not mash them, grate them. After grating, add spices in it like 1 tablespoon salt, 1 tablespoon garam masala, 2 tablespoons crushed red chili, 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, 2 tablespoons dry coriander and 1 tablespoon cumin.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcNP7FwR345m1dtY5oyrAPx4H9uV8XmLQogcathHnPYUR/1779464860486.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcffnDi2NPcrPsXTDEmKzdR3REqaJnQnNyB4bFYkG7Yea/1779464860589.jpg)

___
# Adding vegetables and preparing the mixture
___
After this I added vegetables in it which I cut while the potatoes were boiling. I took 1 bunch green onion, 1 bunch coriander and 5 green chilies and cut them and added them into the potatoes. Now I took 1 egg and added it too and at the end I also added 3 tablespoons flour. This way everything for making potato patties is ready.
___

___
# Making the burgers
___
Now let’s make burgers. To make burgers, first I made 2 potato patties because I was making 2 burgers. After making 2 potato patties, coat them with egg and then add oil in a pan and fry these patties nicely. 
___

Now I took 2 eggs and fried them too. After this I took 2 burger buns and toasted them nicely in the pan.

___
# Assembling the burgers
___
Now at last it is time to assemble the burgers. First I added ketchup and mayonnaise in the buns and spread them nicely. Then I added potato patty and egg in it and closed the burger bun and our yummy burger was ready. And by the way guys I kept the remaining potato patties in the freezer, now whenever I want to eat burgers I can easily make them.

body.title: The soothing sensation of a sugarcane juice on a hot afternoon 🍹
body.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUaoTKxV83BKPr78Bz4VQdduNHFNYd7VdFg5SjLRCpACg/1779634386755.jpg) In our country, this roadside sugarcane juice is not just a drink, it's a piece of nostalgia. When the vendor was putting the big sugarcane into the machine And it was a different kind of joy to see the light green juice dripping from the other side into the bucket. To enhance the flavor of the juice and give it a refreshing feel, a little ginger, lemon juice, and a bit of salt were mixed into it. When the freshly frothed ice-cold juice came into my hands in a glass, half of my fatigue disappeared in an instant. As I took a sip from the glass, I was struck by the pure sweetness of sugarcane juice with the light tangy taste of lemon and ginger. It was as if it went straight to the liver. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV14ZfWVaGPUbjNNYQok6QHHUCjVf992mjdu9GJHLAxgV/1779634386927.jpg) On a hot summer afternoon, when the sun is blazing overhead and your body is about to collapse from exhaustion, there is no greater blessing than a glass of cold sugarcane juice. Today, on a lazy and tired afternoon, as soon as I heard the familiar sound of sugarcane juice being made by turning wheels at a street corner, my feet stopped moving. I went and stood in front of that familiar sugarcane juice truck. Sugarcane juice is a thousand times better than artificial energy drinks or cold drinks containing chemicals. It instantly replenishes the glucose deficiency in the body and makes you alert. It does not contain any artificial preservatives or added sugar. It is an invaluable tool in protecting the body from dehydration in the intense heat. In the hustle and bustle of busy urban life, these small moments provide us with the resources to survive anew. The feeling of drinking a glass of fresh juice while standing on the roadside of a village or a mofussil is truly incomparable.

body.title: Photo of a large ant hatching eggs in a clump of pandanus leaves.
body.body: />Hello everyone. It's been raining a lot lately, making the house very humid and the trees in front of the house much greener and more lush. And these little creatures are adding to the vibrancy. This morning, I woke up and went outside, and found a lovely sight. There was a very large ant clinging to a pandan leaf inside the plant. If you look closely, you can see some standing water. Looking at another leaf, you can see the large ant isn't moving at all. If you look closely at where it's clinging, you'll see many small white clumps. I'd guess they're its eggs.\n\n

/>I grabbed my phone to take a picture, intentionally zooming in for a clear shot. Without a tripod, the image would have been blurry and my hand would have shaken, so a tripod was necessary to keep it steady and capture a beautiful image. I'm very happy with this photo because it captured the large ant clearly. I also adjusted the lighting slightly because I'm not a skilled photographer and don't know how to adjust settings. Getting a result like this is great.\n\n
/>This is another picture that I really like. It's very clear and striking. What do you think of this picture?\n\n

/>If you look closely, ant eggs resemble small grains of white rice, don't they? In the morning, the ants were incubating their eggs, but when I went to check again later in the day, they were gone. All that was left were the eggs still attached to the pandan leaves, many of them. It was a shame. The next day, when I went to check again, I couldn't find either the eggs or the ants. I'm not sure where they went or if they were eaten by other insects. This shows that the survival and birth of insects follows the natural cycle; the weak perish, and the strong survive. If you look closely, it's a truth of the human world.\n\nThank you for reading this article today, and see you again in the next one! Bye!

body.title: Cuando el mundo comenzó a escuchar - Historia [ESP- ENG]
body.body:
> La Banda 17 con apenas la primera canción, casi que todo Portugal estaba allí reunidos para escucharlos. Michelle tomó aire y comenzó a cantar, donde su voz era suave y junto a los aplausos se creó una gran combinación, Dani golpeaba la batería con mucha fuerza, Lucas caminaba por todo el escenario mientras tocaba la guitarra y Stewie seguía grabando todo y completamente sorprendido por todo lo que estaba pasando si allí. La Banda seguía disfrutando y tocando canción tras canción, donde había muchos niños y Dani por un momento volvió a recordar aquellas tardes tocando en pequeñas calles y ahora estaban en otro país, frente a miles de personas. Cuando el espectáculo terminó, toda la plaza comenzó a aplaudir y las luces poco a poco se fueron apagaron y para cerrar Michelle tomó el micrófono y comenzó —Gracias Portugal, esto quedará para siempre en nuestro corazón— >Banda 17 had barely started their first song when it felt like almost all of Portugal had gathered there to listen to them. Michelle took a deep breath and began to sing; her soft voice blended beautifully with the applause. Dani pounded the drums with great force, Lucas walked all over the stage while playing the guitar, and Stewie kept filming everything, completely amazed by everything that was happening right there. # >The band kept enjoying themselves and playing song after song. There were many children in the crowd, and for a moment, Dani was reminded of those afternoons playing in small streets—and now they were in another country, in front of thousands of people. When the show ended, the entire square began to applaud, and the lights slowly dimmed. To close, Michelle took the microphone and began, “Thank you, Portugal. This will remain in our hearts forever.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV6QwcEXE52FJcNBVpxmQzWLpUAQ1mwPmwZ23itvvHdrN/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/concierto-estadio-anfiteatro-banda-7360983/) Se bajaron del escenario y con la ayuda de la seguridad comenzaron a moverse hasta el hotel donde se iban a quedar. Una vez en lobby quedaron sin palabras por lo bonito y lo moderno que era ese lugar, además se encontraron con parte del equipo de RisignStar que trabajaban en Portugal y entre risas y aplausos, uno de ellos comentó —Bienvenidos— De inmediato los llevaron a una sala que era privada donde había comida, bebidas y lo mejor consolad de mucho nivel para trabajar. Allí comenzaron a conversar sobre nuevas ideas, futuras giras y posibles colaboraciones con artistas portugueses y europeos. Lucas escuchaba atento mientras afinaba su guitarra e incluso todo emocionado dijo —Imaginen grabar una canción mezclando nuestro estilo con música portuguesa, eso sería algo histórico— La noche avanzó entre risas, planes y música, ya que cada uno comentó algo en esa pequeña reunión, además afuera Portugal seguía brillando bajo las luces de la ciudad, mientras la Banda 17 comprendía que aquel viaje apenas era el comienzo de algo mucho más grande, por el hecho de que verse con el equipo de risignstar de Portugal era algo que no todos tiene la dicha de hacerlo y ese momento se tiene que aprovechar. >They stepped off the stage and, with the help of security, made their way to the hotel where they would be staying. Once in the lobby, they were speechless at how beautiful and modern the place was. They also ran into some of the RisignStar team working in Portugal, and amid laughter and applause, one of them said, “Welcome.” # >They were immediately taken to a private room where there was food, drinks, and top-notch comfort to work in. There, they began discussing new ideas, future tours, and possible collaborations with Portuguese and European artists. Lucas listened intently while tuning his guitar and, full of excitement, said, “Imagine recording a song that blends our style with Portuguese music—that would be historic.” # >The night went on with laughter, plans, and music, as everyone shared their thoughts at that small gathering. Outside, Portugal continued to shine under the city lights, while Banda 17 realized that this trip was just the beginning of something much bigger—because meeting with the Risignstar team in Portugal was an opportunity not everyone has the chance to experience, and that moment had to be seized. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZh23y6Ej49XdzVuEwhCnvL1FrniU82RR4UmfxhSSChcR/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/oficina-hombres-en-pie-de-pie-18999372/)

body.title: Homemade Choco Stick Rolls: Just 3 Ingredients
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVU9xrwUEGtUYAMC9BWR9SQgXCR1Hs5FfELHrdthDkkeb/1779634679266.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers, today I’m so excited because this is the first time I’ve made a snack using just three simple ingredients, we called it astor, a choco stick roll snack, it’s super easy and doesn’t take long to prepare. I made this in between work tasks, and it tastes sweet, kids would love it. Okay, let’s get started

**Ingredients:**

- 7 spring roll wrappers
- chocolate filling
- water

**Steps:**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXbdBqE7JKgqTtFAbVvBJxmBptmPrF7eorYYL8HJrce1L/1779633855794.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXoGCKFYgL6vidKRsiT12uRQgk89A6UNyu1LA3kRJhaV5/1779633855957.jpg)

- Prepare the spring roll wrappers—either square or round

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXoGCKFYgL6vidKRsiT12uRQgk89A6UNyu1LA3kRJhaV5/1779633893185.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxg9yhPrhvd9vFQoCz6naZtn44qdfdqjRzuh7j22somf/1779633893420.jpg)

- Cut 2 round spring roll wrappers into 2 pieces

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdKMmz89UQUDGXjNHzJ88dykTfPbuG17NQ9xCAbpmed7u/1779633952615.jpg)

- Spread the chocolate filling like this to fill the spring rolls 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYHSDA9NLX3gtUxQmTHvKhy8Vt2kwa2nooiYiukU9HTds/1779634025621.jpg)

- Roll the spring roll wrapper thinly until it looks like this

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZY1ETeNd158GFpzjoM5H2mWTxGmY24zqJktdicTd6Q5Z/1779634025809.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXzD98mimLGEkaDXsyD5zGdrRGiQ2pCp6jfsdKHHvaqwE/1779634025979.jpg)

- Add a little water to the end of the roll so it sticks and seals

- Repeat until all the spring roll wrappers are used up

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTN25CNUp61WgmonMdc5gsx6FbfEQPDarnr7Fk1cskSKb/1779634233236.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbCUifqVwUR9g17mSFqyXYemCybcab2WPhpyAGfVFmF2K/1779634233516.jpg)

- Prepare a baking tray and place the choco stick rolls on it

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSRLy1kvVdWPmBKzD8vRERmcnMwSHsQRnowedoxAsaug3/1779634260026.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd8c8mUFfuhE9RHdwihrh6KRagM8oAXLELcyU5pYteZCt/1779634260231.jpg)

- Place in the oven and bake at 150°C for 20 minutes

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVewVBzQtx35EdJwbbGBW79Ka518TY6JEEHA2VE67yHqK/1779634299781.jpg)

- Once the choco stick rolls have hardened, let them cool

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeSTBqLkzQEzh7iHgKteCXJsFrxLEPycJBs2JaveDGrp4/1779634322130.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUHM6diCwSCUEoztQEy44B9ogoPaptDZ1bdFc5NV4YJPF/1779634322315.jpg)

- Homemade Choco Stick Rolls are ready to eat

body.title: A Different Kind of Sunday🙏🌸☀️//Un domingo distinto.
body.body:
<center>![h,yg,ju.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/AK9NwG4yFynfCWo1pNUCNDL3v5LiEN3BerpBfU425UfC9ZhTpSkzpBNttMaUubf.jpg)</center>

Hello, my dear friends at Gems, I hope you are all well.

We always enjoy Sundays to the fullest, and that means taking some time for ourselves and visiting a recreational place, or maybe staying home enjoying a movie, relaxing, or reading something we like that keeps us calm. That's why I took this Sunday to remember some moments I shared with my siblings a while back and enjoy nature. So, we visited a place called La Vereda del Lago, located in the city of Maracaibo, where we can enjoy the lake and the beauty of the sky with its passing clouds, which leave behind hues thanks to the sun that dresses them in multicolored light.

In one part of this path, there's a beautiful wall with colorful wings, and I loved posing with them behind me, smiling at life for all it gives us, and thanking God for everything He provides. 🙏🌸

We should take Sundays for ourselves and break from routine; let's spend more time with our families, but if possible, let's also spend some quality time with ourselves, organizing our thoughts, eating what we enjoy, and why not, spending some time in bed and then going for a walk to admire what nature offers us and, above all, feeling that we truly rested enough to regain strength and enthusiasm to joyfully face the week ahead. Then we can say with certainty: I had a different kind of Sunday.


>Hola, mis queridos amigos de Gems, espero se encuentren bien.
Los domingos siempre los disfrutamos al máximo y eso significa que debemos tomarnos un tiempo para nosotros y visitar algún lugar recreativo o tal vez estar en casa disfrutando de una película, descansar, leer algo que nos guste y nos mantenga relajados. Es por eso que yo me tomé este domingo para recordar algunos momentos que compartí con mis hermanos hace un tiempo atrás y disfrutar de la naturaleza. Por eso, visitamos un lugar llamado La Vereda del Lago, que se encuentra en la ciudad de Maracaibo, donde podemos disfrutar del lago y la belleza del cielo con sus nubes que pasan y dejan algunos matices gracias al sol que las viste de multicolor.

>En una parte de esta vereda se encuentra un bello muro donde están unas alas coloridas y me gustó posar con ellas detrás y sonreír a la vida por todo lo que nos regala y darle gracias a Dios por todo eso que nos brinda. 🙏🌸


>Los domingos debemos tomarlos para nosotros y salir de la rutina; pasemos más tiempo con nuestras familias, pero si es posible, pasemos también un buen tiempo con nosotros mismos y ordenar nuestras ideas, comer lo que nos gusta y, ¿por qué no?, pasar un rato en la cama y luego salir a caminar y poder admirar lo que la naturaleza nos brinda y, sobre todo, sentir que de verdad descansamos lo necesario para recobrar fuerzas y entusiasmo para poder recibir con alegría la semana que llega. Entonces podemos decir con firmeza: Pasé un domingo distinto.

body.title: I tried to beat the international grandmaster again, but what happened in the end?
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779634122911-a561673bb0d6c74e.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=gamingnature/5e471809)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=gamingnature/5e471809)


---

Today after a long time I played chess on Lichess website.As you know that Lichess is the world's most popular chess gaming site.Today I tried again to defeat the international grand master but to see what happened in the end, follow the video or check the analysis board.Do you understand who the International Grand Master is? Hey, he is Stockfish Level 7.

In other words, I am insignificant compared to his intelligence.But you can't lose before you start playing, you have to try.Courage is the name of moving forward with a strong conviction in any matter.Believe me, I promised myself that I would defeat International Grandmaster Stockfish Level 7 today.So I played two matches in a row with him.But I tried my best to beat him.

At first, I played the match for seven minutes and made it almost competitive with him.I played with him for 7 minutes at first and after again started a new match.The next match was over in about three minutes.Actually I love playing chess and I realized that he is actually an international grandmaster.But you can learn a lot by playing with the big guys and I definitely hope to win big matches in the future.You can watch my two matches.

Who won and who lost in the end? Watch the video to find out how competitive the game was.You can also click on the analysis board.Lichess is undoubtedly a popular chess site.So let's enjoy chess.
