body.title: Book Review: \
by Sara Hart O'Brie
body.body:
![Disciplined by Mister Kyle front cover.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zippy1975/23vhs8bxpJM2fq2h7aFb2LCJctRgUVym4SaChhw4Cket97cwnK9j2gF5TuqfieeKqWsba.png)

# **First off, it's a teacher-student age-gap romance, with heavy BDSM undercurrents.** 
##### **So if that triggers anyone, here's your chance to skip the review.**

Now, with that trigger warning out of the way, let's dive into an erotic tome that's perfect for those who like to think and get themselves off at the same time... I wish I was joking. This book was... a lot, and I mean that in many ways. Let me explain.
For one thing, I mean it literally. It weighs in at 316 pages, which is not what you'd expect from the \
cover art and campy title. Eleven chapters and an epilogue, and each chapter averaged 26 pages. There's a lot of story here.\nFor another thing, it's \

in terms of really, really dark spice. The FMC, an 18-year-old prep school student with a history of suicide attempts and SERIOUS daddy issues, spends about half of the book either on the edge of an orgasm or denied one (that might count as a spoiler, actually), thanks to the oh-so-deliciously cruel machinations of her sadistic (and apparently rich, somehow?) literature teacher, who has rather handily figured out that she's both a masochist and a nymphomaniac.\nAlso, there's \

of really heady, really deep psycho-philosophical discourse on gender psychology in between orgasms-in-print. It's like... watching a feminist and a misogynist debate one another in between sessions with her bent over his desk (and spoiler alert, the misogynist wins), though considering the FMC hates women, including herself, I'm not really sure if that analogy holds up. Anyway... the way the MMC weasels literature assignments on real-world erotic classics into his illicit game where he's slowly getting inside the FMC's mind, and the way the characters actually have pretty provocative debates about them in his classroom (before heading off to his office for, well, exactly what you'd expect from the cover) was a little surprising from what I thought was going to be a \
book. And to be honest, I kind of liked it...\n...once I got used to it.\nThe first chapter's a little slow I'll admit, and I certainly would not recommend it to anyone who likes \

literotica. Oh, and the plot -yeah, it has one- takes a SERIOUS left turn into mystery/horror/psych-thriller territory as soon as a yearbook from an earlier year comes into play. But it does actually manage to end with what the characters would all consider a happy ending (and a joke so campy I actually groaned out loud, though the truth is I wish I'd been the one to come up with it).\n\nIn short, if you like teacher/student age-gap erotica, lots of spanking, and a heavy dose of the \
trope *a la* 'Black Snake Moan,' this book puts them all in one place and manages to give you a literary commentary on Nabokov, De Sade and Reage while it's at it.\n\n# **Rating: 4/5 Stars**

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. This time I will be opening 10 legendary draws, since I've already opened all my legendary draws from batch 1 of this season. Since each ultimate chest requires 1 alchemy potion to increase the chance of finding a gold card, I only spent 10 alchemy potions in total, which is pretty good.

These ultimate chests have a 39% chance of containing a reward card and a 8% to get a Jackpot card. And currently, potions have the lowest probability (3%) of being obtained, which is great. Ultimate chests can also contain, scrolls, entries, merits and energy.

This time I was lucky enough to get a Jackpot card, but unfortunately it was the common one, but at least it's something. I also get 3 rare cards and 11 common cards. In addition, I got 3279 merits in total. And finally, 4 energy and 9 entries for the weekly fortune draw.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/EoEjFEvrTfzTKdycAawp9VfAYQ2VQnTFH84SrrFSdk7huQuvFjdojxrTWBtrMtJBofV.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/shop/rewards?t=e21c8fbc0f122f6022e8dc73c9fb45dfb92157d2&ref=langice)</center>

Now, my avian, Torrent Sniper, only needs 4 more copies to reach level 8, where it will learn the Weaken ability, so while it is alive, enemy units will have their hit points reduced by 1.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/Eo6BiQGHHXJGKmPzFGBwZAjU5mZvGZdEUyCM3Pmff38bPVdbLjWE1YQdKziy8jxfAxV.png)

---

And my undead Cullborn Revenant now needs 13 more copies to reach level 10, where she will learn the Spite ability, so when she is defeated, she will perform an attack against the unit that defeats her.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/Eo8L1irb2qaXuUHJ9LNV26mGPNzcoAmyksrhYPrTMqt6irWrDRZHwWJFRKdgZ2E1KpQ.png)

---

Currently my rare conclave arcana reward cards are at level 7, except for my elf, Grove Doomblade, who is at the max level. body.title: I Uninstall DEATHLOOP and It Ends Up Boring Me — Is It Worth It?
body.body:
![1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23xovANRq3kM7evXWa6VeJc53Gr8XJpBmF3nzsRxHHYAf7BHdS1hbarej6ucZHJFy4Jg8.gif)


What's up gamers, how's everyone doing? Hope you're all doing great. So this time I'm writing to share something pretty definitive about my time with DEATHLOOP — I uninstalled it. Yeah, for real. I'm going to be completely honest here: I'm not going to finish it. The game ended up boring me, and after giving it a genuine shot across multiple sessions and posts, I feel like I owe you all an honest breakdown of why. Because DEATHLOOP has its pros and it has its cons, and in my personal experience the cons eventually won out. So let's get into it properly.

**DEATHLOOP Has Good FPS Action, but That's About It**

![0423 (1)(4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tvXqMLLN9SU9RhKcJRJfc1KanzBw4seRSsHqJmsD9fXsKRAtDDo13LqjhWUnWQKd8dt.jpg)

Here's something I will never take away from this game — the action is genuinely excellent. The gunfights between Colt and the Eternalists are really good, satisfying in that raw, visceral way that a well-built first person shooter should be. The weapons feel punchy and real, and the gore system is no joke. Hit an Eternalist with a shotgun blast at the right range and their head is gone in the most impressively brutal way possible. It's the kind of feedback that makes combat feel weighty rather than floaty, and that matters a lot in an FPS.

The movement system is equally well put together. Colt can scale almost any surface, scramble up ledges, slide, dodge, sprint and shoot fluidly without it ever feeling clunky or disconnected. You can approach any combat encounter in a dozen different ways because the movement gives you real options — go high, flank left, drop down through a window, rush straight in, whatever feels right in the moment. The character control is tight and responsive and it's clear Arkane put real craft into how the game feels to actually play on a mechanical level. None of that is in question and none of that can be denied.

![0423 (1)(6).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23x159pVcRHH2yphwX6kd7rmQfe5yHbEkgVLgHLYGBmh8FNcD1qD4AADhmArJGr87Sqv9.jpg)

But here's the problem. By itself, excellent FPS mechanics and satisfying gunplay can only carry a game so far. Especially a game that's asking you to invest in its story and its mystery and its characters across dozens of loops. At some point the action needs something underneath it to keep pulling you forward, and that's precisely where DEATHLOOP started losing me.

**A Poorly Organized Story**

![0423 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23vhsGG8kPP1hAFNQ1aKKj7x1JbHBdu6NMddjSXAVcSWeqkTTSm85qVvr1rsg719ZypJq.jpg)

The concept behind DEATHLOOP's story is genuinely interesting, and I want to acknowledge that because it deserves credit. The whole idea of Blackreef as this island of eternal perversion, madness and hedonism where the Eternalists have chosen to live consequence-free forever — partying, destroying, indulging in everything imaginable with no permanent death to worry about — is a fascinating premise. The Visionaries as architects of this system, Colt's fractured memory slowly rebuilding itself, the strange and complicated dynamic between Colt and Juliana — all of it has real potential on paper.

But the way the game chooses to deliver that story is, in my opinion, where Bethesda and Arkane made a genuinely bad call. Treating the whole experience with a menu-driven, almost gacha-style mission structure where you select leads from a list and drop into districts to chase them might sound like it gives the player control and freedom, but in practice what it actually does is create a rupture between you and the narrative. A disconnect that gets worse the longer you play.

![0423 (1)(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23wg8kcidf4hGJFsxwDibEYBBMbx1XiZuj7AVnZb8dEqE8LicVboyDVCLstpV3hUXwtEL.jpg)

At a certain point I genuinely started losing track of where Colt's core motivation even came from. Like, why is he doing this again? What's the actual emotional throughline that connects all these runs? Because when you're jumping between mission leads from a menu, bouncing between districts and time periods chasing objectives that all feel roughly equal in terms of how they're presented, nothing ever feels like it truly matters more than anything else. Supposedly the main mission is killing the Visionaries. But so many other leads and side objectives keep popping up on top of that, constantly pulling your attention sideways, that you end up spending sessions doing everything except pushing the thing that's actually supposed to be the point. It all blurs together into a kind of organized chaos that eventually just feels like chaos with no organization at all.

A linear story with clear beats and emotional momentum would have served DEATHLOOP's premise so much better. The mystery is there. The characters are interesting enough. The world has genuine personality. But the structure designed to deliver all of that to the player ends up fragmenting it into something that's genuinely hard to stay connected to over time. And once that connection breaks, there's not much left to hold onto.

**A Decent Graphic Section**

![0423 (1)(3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23u5xecNCBFmuNBb7tfbmfR4ctqxrHnaoafskVz74kkyuEBiLWf4pBhNP95CDie4o1rm9.jpg)

Visually, DEATHLOOP is a well put together game and I'll give it that without any hesitation. The art direction is consistent and committed — it sits in this interesting middle ground between something cartoon-like and something grounded and realistic at the same time, blending together in a way that gives the whole game a very specific visual identity that's easy to recognize. Blackreef looks like no other game world I've spent time in recently, and the four districts each have their own atmosphere and visual personality that keeps the environments from feeling repetitive even when you're revisiting the same places loop after loop. The optimization is also solid — the game runs cleanly without technical issues getting in the way of the experience. So on the technical and artistic front, no real complaints.

**So Then... Is It Worth It?**

![0423 (1)(5).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23w2ebWJtKWYiHHm1qtdyhTrh68xSjefHvNCNjHmr6CtmeZ2noYXs99gW9P7cMsoU8Rut.jpg)

Okay, so here's where this gets personal, because I genuinely think the answer to whether DEATHLOOP is worth your time depends almost entirely on what kind of player you are and what you're looking for when you sit down to game.

If the idea of a loop-based, non-linear mystery where you gather fragments of story over many runs and piece things together at your own pace genuinely excites you — if that structure sounds like exactly the kind of thing you'd sink your teeth into — then yes, DEATHLOOP probably has something real to offer you. The action is there, the world is interesting, the concept is bold, and some players connect with it deeply. That's completely valid and I get it.

But if your gaming time is limited and you need a game to earn your attention by keeping you connected to the story and characters in a clear and satisfying way, then DEATHLOOP might test your patience in ways that eventually aren't worth it. There are so many games out there right now, so many sitting in backlogs or being given away for free, that being honest with yourself about whether something is actually clicking is genuinely important. And for me, DEATHLOOP stopped clicking. I didn't connect with it enough to push through the structural frustrations, and at a certain point continuing felt more like an obligation than something I was actually enjoying.

So I uninstalled it. No drama, no hard feelings toward the game itself — it's not a bad game, it's just not for me. And if it's still in your library, it'll be there whenever you want to give it a shot or come back to it. That's the beauty of digital libraries. If you've played DEATHLOOP all the way through or have your own take on it, drop it in the comments — I'd genuinely love to hear what the experience was like for those who stuck with it to the end. See you in the next post, gamers!

body.title: Deliciosa sopa de costilla de res con vegetales variados [ESP/ENG]
body.body: # Deliciosa sopa de costilla de res con vegetales variados [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Hola amigos del buen comer y del buen paladar que me en en la comunidad de @hivefood, espero que todos se encuentren bien de salud y que estén pasando un feliz fin de semana. sean todos bienvenidos a mi blog.

![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23u652Cgh2yGgGkcuPTQpjbg2H1UppkcbSAJ3EoyzoyyRDzsaJBoZCV1E6utkXU2TTpGb.jpg)

Hoy quise presentarles una deliciosa sopa de costilla de es full vegetales variados que hice ayer sábado para degustarla en el almuerzo familiar en casa. Hice esta deliciosa sopa ya que el novio de mi hija vino  a casa  de otra ciudad para visitarnos tanto a mi hija como a nosotros sus padres, se que a el le encanta la sopa de res y en especial de costilla.

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EokedmgAziQgJq8qkrjBuPA6Bwi58pr7AMQG8PHSzP91yDa98BKKoSewLaHe1AKFg33.jpg)

La sopa de costilla de res se conoce en Venezuela como la levanta muerto, ya que es ideal para aquellos momentos en que hemos tenido una pachanga o una rumba y estamos amanecidos. Al tomarse este reconstituyente nos devuelve la vida, es muy nutritiva, al combinarla con diferentes verduras o vegetales y aliños verdes es el plato perfecto para reconfortar el cuerpo y unir a a familia, vecinos, en fin.

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wquAYsv7Q4MB6Ywhi5sDZ2n9ryvKoVAeqaMsuUdsAh6TRuipsBrGfoJ25xJCn8WbUcz.jpg)

Gracias a que el hueso aporta un sabor profundo y las verduras aportan una gran variedad de nutrientes y vitaminas necesarias para el cuerpo humano.

Ahora solo le voy a nombrar los ingredientes ya que por el apuro debido a los cortes de luz sin programar se me había hecho tarde y se me olvido tomar la foto de los ingredientes crudos. Sin embago el proceso si se os contare al pie de la letra para que ustedes la preparen y no se arrepienta porque quedo demasiada rica, la textura de la carne muy suave y quedo bastante concentrada y algo ni muy clara ni muy espesa en su punto.

# Ingredientes
* 1 kilo de costilla de res
* 3 litros de agua
* 1/2 kilo de apio de raiz
* 1/2 kilo de cambur verde topocho
* 2 mazorcas de maíz dulce
* 1 zanahoria mediana
* 1/2 kilo de auyama
* 1 kilo de yuca
* aliños verdes al gusto: ajo porro, cilantro, celery, cebolla en rama, cebolla blanca, 2 ají dulce.
* 6 dientes de ajo triturados
* sal y pimienta
* 200 gramos de harina de maíz blanco para hacer bollos

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xVKHQ1CSQitQpzuudx7UZe2yim888yAxXmM3Ej1TT5LbF6iQUxDaXNHT1qPvGZ6uxqS.jpg)|![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/2432J7vmoRHT6Prw36bJTwKH4NfdAhQCr1Fg51tQKswajRVJfhngjKy6GQ8wN7Jhp7XvD.jpg)
-|-

# Procedimiento

Lo primero que hice fue lavar muy bien y cortar en trozos pequeños la costilla, la coloque en una olla con el agua y el maíz dulce cortado en cuadros, ya que son un poco duro y necesita durar su tiempo en cocción, lo deje  a presión 45 minutos. apague y revise.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ycwckh2i2Qtm2PpzdoVUwjf5Kmjh5TSeiLFKYgvJUQPBagqL8yxcBWTY5qEazhcFwWQ.jpg)

A la par fui pelando y cortando toda las verduras y vegetales en cuadros pequeños, los coloque en el la olla y continuo cocción por 35 minutos mas pero sin presión, fui revisando y saque en una cacerola algunas verduras que ya estaban lista porque la gran mayoría se deshizo que era la idea para que el caldo espesar un poco con las mismas verduras.

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep1WMzbuEoLRrNzRFKUFeeRcaRTBhC9odVgAPPBK3VfSCMF4RKPwQXvhUPJafmNRT5S.jpg)

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoK7hnJjy3WM2EGxprFecoS4Kf9yuUvjWpoQ31jPMjJupiis9sP6mUUfNAc8jaEm151.jpg)

Por ultimo le coloque unos bollitos de harina pan que hice para colocarlos a cocinar conjuntamente con la sopa y estos tomaran el sabor, espere 5 minutos mas, listo, emplate y buen provecho.

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep1WMzbuEoLRrNzRFKUFeeRcaRTBhC9odVgAPPBK3VfSCMF4RKPwQXvhUPJafmNRT5S.jpg)

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EokedmgAziQgJq8qkrjBuPA6Bwi58pr7AMQG8PHSzP91yDa98BKKoSewLaHe1AKFg33.jpg)

Hasta a qui mi contenido espero sea de su agrado, nos vemos en un próximo post, chao y bendiciones para todos.

<div class=\
> # English Version # Delicious Beef Rib Soup with Mixed Vegetables

> Hello, fellow food lovers and connoisseurs in the @hivefood community! I hope you’re all in good health and having a wonderful weekend. Welcome to my blog. ![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23u652Cgh2yGgGkcuPTQpjbg2H1UppkcbSAJ3EoyzoyyRDzsaJBoZCV1E6utkXU2TTpGb.jpg) Today I wanted to share with you a delicious rib soup packed with assorted vegetables that I made yesterday, Saturday, to enjoy at a family lunch at home. I made this delicious soup because my daughter’s boyfriend came home from another city to visit both my daughter and us, her parents. I know he loves beef soup, especially rib soup. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EokedmgAziQgJq8qkrjBuPA6Bwi58pr7AMQG8PHSzP91yDa98BKKoSewLaHe1AKFg33.jpg) Beef rib soup is known in Venezuela as “la levanta muerto” (the one that brings the dead back to life), since it’s ideal for those times when we’ve had a big party or a wild night out and we’re hungover. Drinking this restorative soup brings us back to life; it’s very nutritious, and when combined with different vegetables and fresh herbs, it’s the perfect dish to comfort the body and bring together family and neighbors—in short, everyone. ![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wquAYsv7Q4MB6Ywhi5sDZ2n9ryvKoVAeqaMsuUdsAh6TRuipsBrGfoJ25xJCn8WbUcz.jpg) This is because the bone adds a rich flavor, and the vegetables provide a wide variety of nutrients and vitamins essential for the human body. I’m just going to list the ingredients now, since I ran out of time due to unscheduled power outages and forgot to take a photo of the raw ingredients. However, I’ll describe the process step by step so you can make it yourselves and won’t regret it—it turned out absolutely delicious, with very tender meat and a broth that was quite concentrated, neither too thin nor too thick, just right. # Ingredients * 1 kilo of beef ribs * 3 liters of water * 1/2 kilo of celery root * 1/2 kilo of green topocho bananas * 2 ears of sweet corn * 1 medium carrot * 1/2 kilo of squash * 1 kilo of yuca * fresh herbs to taste: leek, cilantro, celery, green onion, white onion, 2 sweet peppers. * 6 crushed garlic cloves * salt and pepper * 200 grams of white corn flour for making buns ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xVKHQ1CSQitQpzuudx7UZe2yim888yAxXmM3Ej1TT5LbF6iQUxDaXNHT1qPvGZ6uxqS.jpg) |![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/2432J7vmoRHT6Prw36bJTwKH4NfdAhQCr1Fg51tQKswajRVJfhngjKy6GQ8wN7Jhp7XvD.jpg) -|- # Procedure The first thing I did was wash the ribs thoroughly and cut them into small pieces. I placed them in a pot with water and the sweet corn cut into cubes—since they’re a bit tough and need plenty of cooking time—and pressure-cooked them for 45 minutes. I turned off the heat and checked them. ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ycwckh2i2Qtm2PpzdoVUwjf5Kmjh5TSeiLFKYgvJUQPBagqL8yxcBWTY5qEazhcFwWQ.jpg) At the same time, I peeled and diced all the vegetables into small cubes, added them to the pot, and continued cooking for another 35 minutes without pressure. I kept checking and removed some vegetables that were already done to a separate saucepan because most of them had broken down—which was the idea—so the broth would thicken a bit with the vegetables themselves. ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep1WMzbuEoLRrNzRFKUFeeRcaRTBhC9odVgAPPBK3VfSCMF4RKPwQXvhUPJafmNRT5S.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoK7hnJjy3WM2EGxprFecoS4Kf9yuUvjWpoQ31jPMjJupiis9sP6mUUfNAc8jaEm151.jpg) Finally, I added some bread dumplings I made to cook them together with the soup so they’d absorb the flavor. I waited 5 more minutes, and that’s it—plate it up and enjoy! ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep1WMzbuEoLRrNzRFKUFeeRcaRTBhC9odVgAPPBK3VfSCMF4RKPwQXvhUPJafmNRT5S.jpg) ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EokedmgAziQgJq8qkrjBuPA6Bwi58pr7AMQG8PHSzP91yDa98BKKoSewLaHe1AKFg33.jpg) I hope you've enjoyed my content so far. See you in my next post! Bye, and blessings to all. * Photos taken with an iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with DeepL Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@morepina/deliciosa-sopa-de-costilla-de-res-con-vegetales-variados-espeng-hdq)

body.title: Do you believe in making wish in 11:11?
body.body:
I am sure many of us have heard about this and some have tried it but I want to know whether you believe this or not. If so then why do you?
If you have ever looked at your clock and noticed that it was 11:11, then you might have wonder if this was a sign from the universe that something special was about to happen. This is a common thought among many people who believe in making wishes, which are usually made when they see 11:11 on their clock or other devices. The idea behind making wishes when you see 11:11 is that the number represent two ones, which can be seen as a symbol of unity and togetherness. therefore, if you make a wish at this time, it's believed that your desire will come true because you are tapping an energetic forces that connects all things. And yes! I want this connection for my life times. I just wish nothing but to be with my two friends in every 11:11. I want to be able to see the same time on a clock with them together, and I wish that we will be happy for rest of our lives.
But life is so unfair and how it changes from celebrating and looking 11:11 together to looking the clock from three  different cities Atlanta, Dallas and Pokhara separately. Being together to being sad because we can't share it together. But I know that everything happens for a reason and this is just a part of the journey I'm grateful to have two wonderful friends in my life who helped me get through some difficult times, and I hope someday we all met again but for now 11:11 will have to do.
It's been a long time since we got together and it feels like forever. We are all going through different stages of our lives, we have our own career, families and responsibilities. I know that it's just a phase of our lives, and it will pass soon enough. but until then I'll keep wishing for 11:11 to happen again and again and again.....
So, should you make a wish you see 11:11? okay ! I don't know how other perceive this but for me 11:11 is a reminder, It is a reminder for me that there are people out there who will support you through thick and thin, no matter what happens in life.
And I misses my 11:11 every time
I miss them alot
I miss Us....

body.title: Making Butter - May 23, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
![Making butter collage1 text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23u6FVfk1aqCCcx9aEEoep6HT4TUJ678aGeDAGHTXWfE5HfXgJerd9vGMvjY4NoKT7YET.jpg)

On Saturday morning I was up at 5AM as I had to take the cream out of the fridge and put it in the ovens to warm up. I had decanted it from the gallon jugs the night before so it would warm up faster. I washed the gallon jugs and put them in the fridge too, to save for putting buttermilk in.

I also had to get the kitchen cleaned up for butter making. Once I had that done, I worked on the day’s post while I waited for my #1 intern to get up. Every hour I would shake the jars for more even warming.

She got up about 7:15AM and made breakfast. I remembered I needed two 5 gallon buckets for the waste wash water so I went out and found 2 and got them washed up and strainers on the tops.

![Making butter collage2 text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpJa4sHUkcji9HsWcf4Jn9ugBTmqe2rLf8GwcsHNzSU2DWZXTnW6tX6Fxwc5rpUbpUC.jpg)

My #1 intern got started churning. When we made butter 2 years ago, it was my helper friend who had always done it. He was very good at it. He said if I got the temperature right, around 64ºF, it should only take about 10 minutes to churn.

The temperature had registered just 64ºF but it took about 35 minutes to churn. We aren’t sure why it took so long. She had 3 batches to do as I’d gotten 2 gallons of cream.

When the first batch had finally gone to butter, we poured it in a large bowl and I drained off the buttermilk. My helper friend’s mom loves getting the buttermilk for baking and keeps some frozen in the freezer.

My helper friend always did all 3 batches at once when it came to washing. But because it had churned so long, I was afraid it would get too soft to wash properly so I started washing it right away.

He had said to do at least 11 washes until the water was clear. Each wash water was poured into the waste buckets through the strainers, as the butter sometimes falls off the sides of the bowl. The waste water doesn’t go down the drain due to fat content as I have a septic system. It goes over the bank at the edge of my property.

So I got each batch thoroughly washed and the butter firmed up well and I started pressing the remaining water out. Then I packed it in the dish for hardening. I did each batch as she finished.

Butter is best made when the organically fed cows go out on pasture in the spring.  The cream is optimal for butter. Once the grass starts to go to seed in the summer, it’s better for cheese making.

![Making butter collage3 text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23y94F9rMVYuNNL5Ad3UYZpCgHiD9571raHUFT6yibZw9njjadCLJe8fwLqLnXWkfoGew.jpg)

We had started at 7:30AM and finished just before 10:15AM when she had to go to her job. We’d gotten all the cleanup done as we went along after she had finished the churning.

So our first attempt at making butter was pretty much a success. We think we’re going to drop the temperature a degree or 2 and see if that speeds up the churning.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYG6pEtEHWmDThfNZ6TbKpszKVzbvbo2TDLcfWauPFoFJ/IMG_7990.PNG 

Today was one of those days when I decided to stop overthinking and just enjoy the moment.

Sometimes we spend so much time worrying about the future that we forget to appreciate how far we’ve already come. I’m not where I want to be yet, but I’m definitely not where I used to be.

Every challenge, every late night, every lesson has helped shape the person I’m becoming. And while the journey isn’t always easy, I’m learning to trust myself a little more every day.

For now, I’ll keep moving forward, working on my goals, and believing that all the effort will be worth it someday ✨

body.title: A's drop first two games of series vs Padres, look to avoid sweep today | Luis Medina on the mound today for A's
body.body:
![584d48ce0a44bd1070d5d46f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJg3BnVxoiM2NuNHqgzjQovf9NYMeSJ4EYmngpiJMp61Su8EWJJbQuCKSGUjh45.png)
[Src](https://www.stickpng.com/img/sports/baseball/major-league-baseball-mlb/oakland-athletics/oakland-athletics-a-logo)

Well, after a strong series vs the Angels, the A's couldn't replicate that success against the Padres as they've officially lost this series and have dropped to .500 once again. Despite all this mediocrity so far in 2026, the A's still cling to a 1.5 game lead in the AL West somehow. Pretty crazy. I don't expect that an 81-81 record will win this division though. But hey, the A's have completed 32% of their season now, maybe the AL West just stinks now LOL.

Friday the A's lost 7-3 and it was actually a bit closer than the score looks in my opinion, the Padres just were more consistent and slightly sharper. The A's took the lead first and then took another lead in the fourth. In the seventh it was actually a tied game but yeah, it just wasn't the A's day.

Yesterday's game was depressing. Not even simply because it was shutout, but because the A's actually more than doubled up the Padres as far as hits are concerned. The A's had five hits, the Padres had two, but the A's still managed to lose 2-0! J.T. Ginn followed up his near no-hitter by giving up SIX walks and a hit batter as he gave up two runs in 2 1/3 innings. The bullpen tried to save the day though as the Padres couldn't produce a thing the remainder of the game, the problem obviously was the A's couldn't either.

So the A's have lost two straight but, they had decent shots to win in both contests. Baseball can be a game of tactics and luck sometimes! 

Luis Medina gets the start today in what is likely going to be a bullpen game.

Hopefully the A's can avoid the sweep with the Mariners coming to town tomorrow!

body.title: 1958 Porsche 356 — The Car That Built an Icon
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWe8g7ta9KMKQjQRZbRifARPzChPJDMqbuqtPb2KyGUTP/b5935cd7363dbaf6.webp)</center>
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRhbiFXj2yDyNG98GVeiMZ6CSytcuq1YPDvNgqrCXaBHE/2babbc90cb6aa041.jpg)</center>

---

### 1958 Porsche 356 — The Car That Built an Icon

Before the 911 became a household name, there was the **Porsche 356**. Ferdinand \

Porsche’s vision of a lightweight, rear-engine sports car put Zuffenhausen on the map and created a motorsport and design legacy that endures to this day.

The 356 was Porsche’s first production automobile. Conceived in 1948, it evolved continuously through four distinct series: the original “Pre-A” Gmünd cars (1948–1955), the 356 A (1955–1959), the 356 B (1959–1963), and the final 356 C (1963–1965). The 1958 model shown here is a **356 A T2** — widely regarded as the sweet spot of the range, with improved brakes, a fully synchronized gearbox, and the refined 1.6L pushrod flat-four.

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbhjsxLTGNByiqZTdYXJHLtK4bbKMpi4AjU1jvtaVa6sR/428be0d9c4897a84.webp)</center>
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVZkmgEmta8677c8ZMDvy61FCAbndoVx9Myw5fARkS9qb/def9d4e0e861c6a7.jpg)</center>

### Under the Rear Lid

| Spec | Detail |
|------|--------|
| Engine | 1,582 cc air-cooled flat-four (Type 616/15) |
| Power | **60 hp** (Normal) / **70 hp** (Super) |
| Top Speed | ~160 km/h (100 mph) |
| Transmission | 4-speed fully synchronized manual |
| Weight | ~950 kg (2,100 lbs) |
| Wheelbase | 2,100 mm (82.7 in) |
| Production (356 A total) | ~21,000 units |

The 356’s engine was derived from the Volkswagen flat-four but heavily reworked by Porsche engineers. It featured aluminium cylinder heads, roller-bearing crankshaft, and twin Solex carburetors. The Super variant added higher compression and a different camshaft for 70 hp.

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfF5FrSmzLbLSmKbZEWYPk7272Xa8UA5J1xdM5x4VZgH5/884bf1c5425c7d03.jpg)</center>
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYqLEe7VzdYfv48EkVSNi7u5X6m1CFCwnKZ3rjkzyYPX9/2bcacce492972c54.webp)</center>

### Design That Defined a Decade

The 356 A T2 featured subtle but important styling updates: a one-piece curved windshield replaced the split screen of earlier cars, the bumper overriders were reshaped, and the legendary “speedster” seating position — lower and more reclined — became available.

The body, designed by Erwin Komenda — who also penned the Volkswagen Beetle — was aerodynamically efficient for its era, with a drag coefficient of approximately 0.39. Every panel was hand-formed steel, and quality varied from car to car, giving each 356 a unique personality.

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQma6YHNWQEhporr3KoCdpoUnXjtjUcaxbZ46BAuiEgQNTF/83dffbfe80346308.webp)</center>
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWQnSEQD78m7UPu24MRbTq3UKHWQDwzGFHnhZi989kzBs/841d983decf8e931.webp)</center>

### Coachbuilt Variants

Porsche also supplied rolling chassis to coachbuilders. Notable examples include:

- **Reutter** — built the majority of 356 coupe bodies
- **Karmann** — produced hardtop coupes
- **Beutler** — Swiss coachbuilder that crafted unique cabriolets

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSp4KtMdagpqoD7vVmNdoBGZPFjH9DufPQVDa7L5p84ZU/51587b40902eda75.jpg)</center>
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPRyNYD8Qmos6GWZ3tqRPm6cr7gt8PN9fij1VkqPnSqzN/441347349051e830.jpg)</center>

### On the Road

Driving a 1958 Porsche 356 today is an exercise in purity. Light, direct, and communicative, it rewards smooth inputs and punishes abrupt ones. The engine note is unmistakable — a deep, thrumming buzz from behind the seats that rises to a distinct Porsche flat-four wail at high RPM. There is no power steering, no servo brakes, and no electronic aids. Just you, the road, and 60 German horsepower doing their absolute best.

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeqAMcir7VuiK2CRvQjcjjaWyQXjei5A5xnTZ5Cq1uYWN/cc15840024d7f0b8.jpg)</center>

### The Porsche 356 in South Africa

Porsche 356s were sold in South Africa from the 1950s, but the most remarkable SA connection came later. In 1963, **Lindsay Saker** in Johannesburg assembled **50 Porsche 356 B T6 models** from CKD (Completely Knocked Down) kits — the only Porsches ever assembled outside of Germany. These cars used local content including batteries, tyres, windscreens, and upholstery, and are today among the most collectible 356 variants worldwide, with surviving examples valued at over R2 million.

Porsche’s presence in South Africa has only grown since, with the brand celebrating over 60 years in the country. The 356 remains a revered piece of motoring history among South African collectors.

### Legacy

The 356 laid the foundation for everything Porsche would become. Its rear-engine layout, lightweight philosophy, and focus on driver engagement directly influenced the 911 that replaced it in 1964. Today, well-preserved 356 A models fetch **$80,000–$200,000+** at auction, with rare Speedsters and Carrera GT variants commanding stratospheric prices.

More than six decades later, the 356 remains a benchmark for what a pure sports car should be: simple, beautiful, and endlessly engaging.

body.title: The fresh mangoes from our trees and the sweet feeling of honeysuckle
body.body: > Summer means the arrival of the king of fruits and the arrival of the king of fruits. Although various kinds of fruits are available in the market during this time, the taste of mangoes from our own tree is completely different. These mangoes from our tree are as beautiful to look at as they are incredibly sweet to eat. These mangoes ripen naturally without any formalin or chemicals, and there is a sense of satisfaction hidden in every bite. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS3NxBkdEmR1J7NsQKRN53SA3t5YpE2c8kHPquMzUF5WX/image.png) The joy of eating fresh mangoes from the tree is different. We have been eagerly waiting for mangoes at this time since childhood. Sitting in the shade of a tree in the hot afternoon sun to pick mangoes or enjoying the juicy taste of fresh mangoes during afternoon chats is a great feeling in our lives. When the fruit of a tree grown with our own care comes to the table, the pleasure doubles. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcqM8PSLHpnwo3aZcyYoYnREkjZi5NDJ8mzk3AjbbHpfQ/image.png) Mangoes are my favorite fruit, and when mangoes are ripe on the tree during this honey month, there is no limit to the joy. These mangoes are not only enjoyed by our family members, but there is also a special peace in sharing them with relatives and neighbors. These pure and sweet-tasting mangoes make our summer days much sweeter and more memorable every year. --- Location | DUET, Joydebpur ---|--- Photographer | @haideremtiaz --- --- Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@haideremti/the-fresh-mangoes-from-our-trees-and-the-sweet-feeling-of-honeysuckle-flb)

body.title: The Crosswalk
body.body:
![IMG_20260524_152335.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kemmyb/48QuNbe3no3bkCuqR2Y7dyGC8d3TSCP32SwB7k66SLKFWFsVytaVRAS3DoUsM2rRyT.png)![divider curl .webp](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/kemmyb/a75ed810b8aaff74d2505ddf85186840400c52a1.webp)

<div class=text-justify>

Zaynab was late again. I scanned the bar upon entering and picked a spot in a corner. A young man with a towel hanging from his shoulder approached with a swagger. 

“What would you like to drink tonight?” He smiled in a suggestive way. There were waitresses milling around so I knew the man was up to nothing good. 

I shook my head. “I'll order later. I'm waiting for a friend.” His smile slipped before he nodded and strode away. 

I leaned into the chair as jazz music played smoothly in the background. A few people lounged in seats, cigar smoke swirling through the room lit with coloured lights.

“Hey, girl,” Zaynab drawled, grinning from ear to ear as she sat down. “Sorry I'm late. Work thing.”

I huffed. “When are you ever early.” She looked beautiful and a little tired, her sleek maroon trouser suit hugging her body with effortless elegance.

Part of me envied her life; the opportunities she had to go to college and become a business owner while I barely made it through high school. 

One night, when we were hanging out at her family’s mansion for the holidays, I told her I wished I’d had as many open doors as her. She replied by saying she wished she had my freedom. I still couldn't get that conversation off my mind because I didn't understand.

She sighed deeply, loosing the collar of her blouse. “Anthony's family wants to move up the wedding.”

“What?” I asked, startled. “You both agreed to wait till the end of the year.” I wasn't ready to lose my best friend to this wealthy family so soon. She waved a waitress over and ordered scotch for us, sadness etched on her face. 

I'd spent years wishing her brightly lit life was mine, not noticing the bars across it. “You don't want to marry him?”

She gave a dry laugh. “I like him, don't get me wrong but if I do this, it's for my parents not for me.”

The waitress returned with our drinks and Zaynab downed hers in one gulp. “You still wish to live my life? We can switch if you want,” she said, grinning, her head tilted to a side. 

I chuckled and shook my head. “Don't be silly. We can't switch though I wish I can help you get out of this.”

We spoke for a while before calling it a night. My gaze lingered on *the crosswalk* outside, the faded white lines stretching from one end to the other, like a demarcation between the life people choose for you and the life you secretly ache for. Would Zaynab have the courage to cross to the other side before the light changes?

We hugged as I put her in a taxi. “Call me when you get home,” I whispered before closing the door. 

As the taillights dimmed into the distance, I knew my friend and I would find a way to navigate our different worlds together, and somehow make them better.

>Muy buen día, comunidad de #HiveGaming. Este día les traigo una partida de lo más divertida con la campeona Hanabi usando mi skin de V.E.N.O.M. Nephilia, una skin bastante interesante e imponente que me gusta mucho usar porque hace que mi campeón se vea imponente.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

<div class=\

>

This match was hilarious because members of the enemy team came to attack me and try to kill me, but they never managed to. The worst part was that I wasn't doing the damage I wanted; I was just gracefully dodging their attacks, and even then, they couldn't hurt me.

Later, when I found my first victim, we attacked as a group, but I was faster than the others to take him down. That's when I managed to take down the first turret by myself, and then the second one, and I decided to roll around the map to see who needed my help.

> Esta partida me causó mucha gracia porque vinieron integrantes del equipo enemigo a atacarme y tratar de matarme, pero no lo lograron en ningún momento. Lo peor de todo es que yo no les hacía el daño que quería, sino que sólo esquivaba sus golpes con gracia y con todo y eso no pudieron dañarme.
>
> Ya luego cuando di con mi primera víctima, allí sí atacamos en grupo, pero yo fui más rápido que los demás para matarlo. Fue entonces cuando logré derribar solo la primera torreta y luego la segunda torreta, y decidí rodar por el mapa a ver quién necesitaba mi ayuda.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4AvgAeSYwuA


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)



<div class=\

> And I did manage to help other members of my team advance through the map. The match, on the other hand, flowed quickly. The enemy never took advantage of the opportunities we gave them to attack; technically, they did absolutely nothing. That's how badly they played. On the other hand, we as a team really held our own. There was one player who tried to be a hero by stealing the turtle, but he didn't succeed. body.title: The Health Benefits of Water Over Sugary Drinks
body.body:
**Why Water Is Essential for Human Life**
​Water is one of the most important necessities of life. The human body depends on water to survive and function properly every day. It plays a major role in maintaining good health and supporting many body processes. From digestion to circulation, water helps the body work efficiently and keeps us active and healthy.
​One of the major benefits of water is that it aids digestion and helps the body absorb nutrients from food. Water also regulates body temperature, transports oxygen and nutrients throughout the body, and keeps the body hydrated. In our daily lives, water is useful for bathing, cooking, cleaning, washing, and many other important activities.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWynqVJcy6nBq3w2aB4iJbuoRDTQCfBuGst1Q1ADvmwxp/1779631344845.jpg)

​**The Health Benefits of Staying Hydrated**
​Drinking enough water has numerous health benefits. It helps improve concentration and brain function, boosts mood, increases energy levels, and prevents dehydration. Water also helps with debloating by flushing out excess waste and toxins from the body.

​In addition, staying hydrated can clear the skin, giving it a healthier and fresher appearance. Proper water intake also supports the kidneys, heart, and other organs, helping them function effectively.
​

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUCxmUTspFqo1tD3p5KditUNJJRq6Ycjt8xEyd3kWGuDX/1779632700272.png)


​Despite these benefits, many people nowadays prefer sodas and sugary drinks instead of water. Although these beverages may taste appealing, excessive consumption can cause serious health problems such as obesity, diabetes, tooth decay, and high blood pressure. Sugary drinks often contain large amounts of sugar, artificial flavors, and chemicals that may negatively affect the body when consumed too frequently.
​Unlike sugary beverages, water is natural, calorie-free, and essential for overall well being. Developing the habit of drinking more water can greatly improve both physical and mental health.

​**Simple Habits to Drink More Water**
​Carry a water bottle- Keeping a reusable bottle with you makes it easy to sip throughout the day.
​Drink before meals-Have a glass of water before you eat to aid digestion and stay on track.
​Replace at least one soft drink or juice each day with a cold glass of water.
​

​In conclusion, water is life and should never be taken for granted. Choosing water over sugary drinks is one of the healthiest decisions anyone can make. By drinking enough water daily, people can maintain healthier skin, better digestion, improved organ function, and a healthier lifestyle overall.

In this **episode 664** of the **New Media Show, host [Rob Greenlee](https://robgreenlee.com), 2017 [Podcast Hall of Famer](https://podcasthall.com)**, talks with **Mike Russell**, founder of [**CreatorMagic.ai**](https://CreatorMagic.ai) and longtime audio producer behind [**Music Radio Creative**](https://musicradiocreative.com), about **how new media creators, podcasters, and video producers can begin building their own “AI creator employee.”**

body.title: Sol-2-Soul Sunday #86: Abundance Year Episode 1976 (audio: noxsoma.substack.com)
body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1911
Sunday 24, May 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1976
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Sol-2-Soul my brothers and sisters. Welcome to one more show above ground, vibe-casting from my soul to your soul. There is a connection. I feel it. I get it. And I get that you get it. And that’s it. 

My Substack Universe is a circle, because the best shape for two-dimensional presentation is the circle. There’s the entire platform. The outer circle. Followers. Subscribers. And then friends - those with whom we interact. Some daily, some a few times a week. Oh, yeah. There are those who we follow and read on a regular basis. These are like the people who “perform” at the Mind Cafe. We are in their audience, but we’re not acknowledged or pointed out, or anything.  We politely applaud, or, “snap-snap.”

It’s like a little solar system. Of course We are the Sun. We are the center. The core. This is as it should be. As it must be. We are the centers of our Universe, whether we recognize it or not. We are the common denominator in all of our interactions. Relationships. Dramas and traumas. 

Because of the path we’ve followed, we once considered this a, “duh-moment.” Until someone, very intelligent, academically, that is, vehemently denied it. This common denominator thing, may actually qualify as truth. Mind cannot compute how this cannot be true. (Educate me if I’m wrong. Let me know what I’m missing.) 

There’s a very small circle of friends who are “getting it.” 

What does this mean? 

They are figuring out the same puzzles this vessel figured out when we were at a similar point on the timeline. They comment about it, (‘it” basically means “everything” in this context.) But there are also solutions embedded in their observations. The comments are vague, but recognizable, if you’ve walked a similar path.  

Kudos. 

Their stews are marinating and the recipes are sound. They will add their own seasonings as they progress. It’s very good to see. 

We’ve released another Long Play today. 

I haven’t followed much about the Wellness Industrial Complex for a few months. So I don’t know if that industry is still in depression or it’s reviving. I did see something about some kind of Happiness Festival, or something. These “industries” rely on you believing that you are deficient in something to prosper. It’s just like big pharma, only the chemicals are different. 

We always return to the Wizard of Oz as an example. 

Kansas is “happiness.” Somehow you have left Kansas and you are trying to get back. All around you are signs and products that claim to be able to get you back to Kansas. 

They show you pictures of Kansas. They speak with Kansas accents, drop Kansas landmarks and talk about Kansas history. They will dress you up in Kansas clothes, t-shirts, and overalls. But it ain’t Kansas. The industry cannot get you back to Kansas. 

You start to think that you’re crazy. The Back-to-Kansas industry, you finally figure out, is selling you an illusion. You get a temporary high by attending  the Kansas-polooza Festival. You meet others who are looking for something similar. Something they lost, discarded or were separated from.  You buy more merch, which will end up in the Kansas-closet with all the years of paraphernalia that just doesn’t do the trick anymore. 

You’ve had the power to go home, all the time. 

Everybody has their own version of Kansas. Their own “outback.” It comes from inside. Not outside. The more we are bombarded with industry versions of “happiness,” the deeper our own versions of happiness get buried in memory. 

This is where the “pitchman,” “shares,” his proprietary method for returning to Kansas. That’s just more of the same malarkey. 

We told you that it exists. 

We told you where it is. 

Maybe you were told how to get there. 

Now go. Start! 

I see y’all making your way to where you want to be. Your progress gives this cynical vagabond joy every day. 

Stay strong, stay safe, stay sane, stay savvy, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed. 

PEACE.       






Sol-2-Soul Sunday #86
Ascension 
Common Sense
It started with stubbornness, then all out rebellion.       

![1976.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUGb6zYjwK8fvCfwshJKdtTZd6x7XYbf6NphsqtSJyG5Z/1976.png)

Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1911_full_5-24-26_1976_sol86:f?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9  
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe.
Filling the Gap 

Five weekends in May and this one is Memorial Day, and your boy wasn’t ready. What’s there to be ready for? A barbecue? Too many people. 

We are close enough to June that I can tell you about Radio Free Spirit. It’s just another part of our imaginary media empire. It has to be imaginary at this point because it would take all of my street studio time to set up, maintain and promote a proper podcast. In June we are going to post audio versions of some of our videos. Not AI voice-overs. My actual voice, recorded in the street studio. The topics are varied. If it was music it would be called, “Jazz.” These are night time grooves for our US listeners, dropping every other night at 10 PM, New York time. But they are not “sleep lectures.” They can get pretty in-you-Mind. It’s the Mind Cafe. 
If you are listening from Singapore, you can catch them just before lunch hour, at 11 AM. 
If you’re listening in Honolulu, tune in at 4 PM. 
In Sydney – shout-out to Sydney – catch it at 2 PM. They will stay up for, maybe a fortnight. I want to get out of the habit of posting media and just leaving it there.
We’ll see.     

There’s this one, (actually there’s more than one), podcaster I glanced at. The room is small. It looks stuffed. The host is some dude in some kind of costume. I guess he’s dressed up as a podcaster, or maybe they call them streamers now. There are six women, three on each side of the host. They all have these big mikes in front of them. They all look alike. Not like clones, but the type of women who would catch the average guy’s eye. All the women looked uncomfortable, like, “is there are hair out of place? “Am I sweating?” Is something slipping?” I never turned up the sound, so I don’t know. The host. His body language and costume told me this was something I didn’t want to, or need to watch. It’s probably a “relationship” podcast, or something. Either way. The takeaway for this observer was, “I’m not going to do my podcast like that.”

Did I tell you I started podcasting when it was called, “webcasting?” Officially as a guest in 1998, and then as a host in 1999. Then on video in Y2K. It’s something I mention from time to time. All I did was show up and host a show. Well, a little bit more than that but no tech stuff. I booked guests. I was freelancing at a weekly newspaper in those days, and working grave yard shift in the system. 

I’m imagining what my studio will look like. If I have my way, it will look like I wanted my dorm room to look in the 1970s. Maybe some psychedelic black light zodiac posters hanging up. Pisces & Ox symbolism strategically placed. Posters of Pam Grier from back in the day. You know the one I mean. 7th floor baby. 

I don’t imagine I’ll need that much room to podcast. No bright lights. Lava lamps. Christmas lights hanging. And maybe some old logos of 1970s icons. Maybe iconography from Philly. But back to the space. I may have some space left over to set up a small photo studio. Just head and shoulders shots, maybe some full length if I get ambitious. 

By the time I get this built and situated, this Trinity will have lived in 8 decades. I almost declared the 70s to be “my” best decade. It was probably the best decade of the 20th Century. And the worst. The music was great! Best ever. Across genres. That’s why the industry killed it. Because of the 70s. Star Wars came out in the 70s. That makes the 70s good for movies. I was still a TV addict in the 70s. 

Basically, if I had it to do at this moment, I would build a faux 70s cocoon and talk about today’s issues and stuff that interests this curious Mind. 

Right now though, I’m just filling the gap. I want to have 2 to 4 minutes for the audio. I’m not at am impasse with Cosmogony. We uncovered some amazing coding in the Annunaki story that I haven’t heard anywhere else. The info is thick and I haven’t had time to dig into it, edit it and make it comprehensible. Plus, unless you’re into history, mythology, space-alien philosophy, & numbers, (not necessarily math), you probably won’t be interested. 

Thank you for subscribing. This account posts four or five time a day. You should know that if you are subscribing by email. Articles, original videos, podcasts, and notes, (I don’t know if notes get sent via email.) Feel free to holler through chats or DM’s, or comments. I have not gone live on Substack. I have no plans to. However those plans could change is there is sufficient interest. 

Enjoy your days. Make them magical and not miserable.

Ayer vivimos una jornada inolvidable en la media maratón de la One Run, una carrera que nació con el firme propósito de unir a los corredores en un solo bloque de energía y superación. Para mí, esta edición tenía un significado muy especial: era mi segundo año consecutivo participando. Sin embargo, el desafío era completamente distinto. Mientras que el año pasado devoré la distancia de los 10K, este año decidí dar el gran salto y probarme en los exigentes 21 kilómetros.
​He pasado meses entrenando duro, devorando kilómetros, series y cuestas con una meta clara: bajar mi marca. Mi objetivo inicial era cruzar la meta en dos horas y media, pero el asfalto nos tenía preparada una sorpresa mayor. Con un tiempo final de 2 horas y 18 minutos, logré registrar un nuevo PR absoluto en la distancia; una marca que ni siquiera en las largas e intensas semanas de preparación para la CAF había rozado.
​El clima se puso de nuestro lado. Aunque la humedad sumaba calor, el sol implacable de los días anteriores nos dio un respiro. Además, la ruta estuvo fantástica, con esa música vibrante que siempre empuja en los primeros kilómetros. Correr acompañada por dos grandes compañeras hizo que todo fuera aún más especial. Hoy solo queda felicidad: cada gota de sudor y cada entrenamiento valieron la pena.

body.title: 13. 访问权限
body.body:
有四个关键词：public private external internal 

public - 任意访问
private - 仅当前合约内
internal - 仅当前合约及所继承的合约
external - 仅外部访问（在内部也只能用外部访问方式访问）

当使用public 函数时，Solidity会立即复制数组参数到内存， 而external函数则是从calldata读取，而分配内存开销比直接从calldata读取要大的多。
那为什么public函数要复制数组参数数据到内存呢？是因为public函数可能会被内部调用，而内部调用数组的参数是当做指向一块内存的指针。
对于external函数不允许内部调用，它直接从calldata读取数据，省去了复制的过程。

所以，如果确认一个函数仅仅在外部访问，请用external。
当需要内外部都要调用的时候，请用public。

public external
都可以访问，都可以继承
但是external内部不能访问，除非带上this

private internal
只能内部访问，private不可继承，internal可以继承

body.title: MY UPI REFUND SCAM STORY
body.body:
Title: From Excitement to Regret: My UPI Refund Scam Story

IndiaConnect fam,

We all use UPI daily for payments, right? So do scammers.

Last month I got a message on WhatsApp:
\

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYNfyqz88f2398gufxTNsCV3mzHxbYx7mhH5jW2FZbpni/1779632385691.jpg)



I had ordered something from Amazon 2 weeks back, so my brain went: \
\n\nI clicked the link. It looked exactly like the Amazon app login page. I entered my UPI PIN to \

and confirm the refund.

30 seconds later, ₹3,000 was gone from my account.

  What actually happened:
1. The link was fake. It captured my UPI PIN and gave them access.
2. Amazon never sends refund links on WhatsApp. Real refunds go back to your original payment method automatically.
3. I was in a hurry and didn’t check the sender number. It was a random +91 number, not Amazon.

I reported it to the bank and cyber cell, but the money was gone. Lesson learned the hard way.

  STAY SAFE ONLINE
PROTECT YOUR UPI
LEARN TO SPOT FAKE REFUND LINKS

      3 rules I follow now:
- Never click refund links on WhatsApp/SMS. Check the app directly.
- Banks and Amazon will never ask for your UPI PIN to send you money.
- If it feels urgent, it’s probably a scam. Scammers create fake urgency.



Have you or anyone you know faced a UPI or refund scam?
Share your story below. The more we talk about it, the harder it is for them to fool others.

body.title: 10. 全局变量和函数
body.body:
[手册](https://learnblockchain.cn/docs/solidity/cheatsheet.html#id3)

在全局命名空间中已经存在了（预设了）一些特殊的变量和函数，他们主要用来提供关于区块链的信息或一些通用的工具函数。可以把这些变量和函数理解为Solidity语言层面的（原生）API 。
```js
blockhash(uint) ：指定区块的区块哈希——仅可用于最新的 256 个区块且不包括当前区块
block.coinbase ( address ): 挖出当前区块的矿工地址
block.difficulty ( uint ): 当前区块难度
block.gaslimit ( uint ): 当前区块 gas 限额
block.number ( uint ): 当前区块号
block.timestamp ( uint): 自 unix epoch 起始当前区块以秒计的时间戳
gasleft() returns (uint256) ：剩余的 gas

msg.data ( bytes ): 完整的 calldata
msg.gas (uint): 剩余的gas量 
msg.sender ( address ): 消息发送者（当前调用），调用合约方法的人
msg.sig ( bytes4 ): calldata 的前4字节（也就是函数标识符）
msg.value ( uint ): 随消息发送的 wei 的数量
tx.gasprice (uint): 交易的 gas 价格
tx.origin (address payable): 交易发起者（完全的调用链）

//合约相关
this : 合约指针，表示当前合约，可以转换为地址
selfdestruct(address recipient) 销毁合约，并把它所有资⾦发送到给定的地址recipient
```

body.title: My start into Warhammer 40k
body.body:
A few weeks ago, I decided I need a new hobby.

I have a distant childhood memory of a game called Gorkamorka, set in the Warhammer 40k universe it was about Orks stranding on a desert planet and fighting against each other. I remember how hard it was for me to get the necessary funds for the box, tools and paints, only for the friends who brought me to it to move on to another game after I finally managed to play with them for the first time. That one game was amazing though, it's my first memory of doing something until the birds started singing.

So now with the financial situation somewhat better, I chose to give Warhammer another try. I started with the current introductory box from a local book shop, just to see if the painting is something I enjoy. I've never done any kind of art, so it was quite intimidating. But it was only like 80 EUR to get started, worth a shot.
To my surprise, I really really enjoy painting those little guys. It's so calming, I even forget to smoke cigarettes for hours.
There's so much to learn about techniques, I did spend more time on YouTube than actually painting so far. While seeing the works of people who are doing it for many years already can be intimidating, it's absolutely fascinating what's possible. And I do see some progress, and I'm gonna share it with you!

The box I bought contained 5 Ultramarines and 11 Tyranids, and pretty much everything else to start. Basic tools, a brush, 5 colors for a basic paint job. I also got a can of primer and a holder for the models, which brought my initial investment up to 76 EUR.

My first thought after I opened the box was \

. But I tried, and the initial results weren't that bad, and I build the confidence that I can get better.

![PXL_20260504_205721741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pharesim/23wMaoVdXXnnnLJ32Mi2K85X7ad8SYVZPJteRpw74367wsvQStRj7Dogq5jkrppuuPCvw.jpg)

![PXL_20260505_001841120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pharesim/23wX1Qda7meimNNxnJiDwuvp9xtudgui1KNrLrMUK7YH9Zu4CRgo3CSr3SNBT6npVSj7j.jpg)

![PXL_20260505_001912285.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pharesim/23vhyMXga5jav5USRRkoVFmkWGDMTZLWciLU1mTzoSR4zZRv7BqdddpANprAR4kAeJqSc.jpg)

The limited colors bugged me pretty quickly, so a few days later I decided to travel out a little further, to a dedicated tabletop store in a neighboring town. After entering, I immediately regretted the long walk, as the people there apparently lived up to the gamer cliche of not washing - the smell was crazy. But now I was there already, so I let them give me some advice about painting, grabbed a set of Age of Sigmar colors to extend my choices, a brown wash, a texture color for the bases, one more brush, and a pack of Boyz for the start of the Ork army I dedided I want to build. Down another 84 EUR.
The models look much better with more colors though!

![PXL_20260506_004708979.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pharesim/23u5tdgsu9cBA7D7HrGp92r9GTMZnCDYdnRr7RootDNM3MvXpcJNXrwzsHR7Jr6axanJB.jpg)

![PXL_20260507_010250058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pharesim/23yTdMmjRhLbG891a5mWSRrMRKQdfL5HQbqS6ww2zcSBKoT2P9tCDDdJb5rPsn8DimRMX.jpg)

Next step before buying more stuff was working on techniques a little. Space Marines use edge highlighting, and while I'm not proud of my first attempt, it does look better than plain.

![PXL_20260514_202053305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pharesim/EogMHV3Sj69R5PzAaNbGLJWgSKnxVshA4UysmmaZXj5XVjMN5GXEAbf4yRbVHS7NLYx.jpg)

The models from the starter box kept me busy for about two weeks. In the meantime I checked out another hobby store and bought more things. A wet palette because I was annoyed that the paints dried so fast, which was a great decision. A set of tools to properly cut and drill and file stuff. A black wash, some more brushes including a kolinsky, and a set of Gretchin they had on sale there. All in all, another 89 EUR gone.

Equipped with all these, I \

the models I started, before moving on to begin painting my future army. This is them in their current state, pretty good progress in my view.


![PXL_20260524_132641264.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pharesim/23x1FU2tEsufDPvAKviJshCpXxq2YJNHEC2zhuY3Y59qrbPTmWppWWy38qqAbXuy3kp8h.jpg)


![PXL_20260524_132725419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pharesim/23xKxwAge5ySmjWg662M6T4AdV8VMga8EJQz87scCidC3u4apQaU9KG7AzKdzm2vyvu4H.jpg)

![PXL_20260524_133408697.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pharesim/23wCFwPm1nnxz15ozjLszqH1F8URFcLargYZBKivpstepjcXNPRHAhkYDcbiFoS1Yfq7h.jpg)

With that out of the way, it was finally time to get to the Gretchin. I love how those little grots look, their diversity makes painting them so much more fun for me! 

Naturally, I needed to go to the store again and spend another 15 EUR on paints - a bright orange which I wanted for the tanks on the weapons of the Ultramarines as I was unhappy with my mixing results, a light green and a green wash, and I saw a \

paint which caught my attention. I grabbed Vallejo paints this time, as they're cheaper and come in nice dripper bottles. I also got a cheap desk light with cold light from a corner store for 8 EUR, I'll have to replace that down the line with something better and bigger, but for now it's better than nothing.

That brings my investment to 272 EUR in the first 20 days. For that I got 25 paints, 5 brushes, all the tools I think I need, and about 37 minis. It is an expensive hobby, but well worth it for me I'd say. I will keep you updated with my progress. If you have any tips, please leave them in the comments. 

And here they are, my first three green guys!

![PXL_20260523_155352092.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pharesim/23wCBzUsm5uzBAj7NpMcQDhq1p698N31bVMHdUdPMEgZ3Jn5qxJ5pJpHfXiX2smKWLJNw.jpg)

![PXL_20260523_214020289.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pharesim/23wX3GCeVESGeuYEhjbtq5b2b3UtvxPKN7pVRBJdb522ZQ9rV2iaJGjnWDa1D288eRhJE.jpg)

I'm excited to dive in deeper. My shopping list contains the Armageddon Bataillon box for some vehicles, and in a month or so the new launch box also called Armageddon will be released, great timing for a new Ork player!

Introduction


Hello everyone! This is @ybanezkim26 and I'll present today's edition of Travel Digest. In our featured posts, we have a park in Curitiba, Brazil, the city center of Vila Nova de Foz Coa, Portugal, and some mosques in Istanbul and Ankara, Turkey. Enjoy and keep on pinning your travel posts to the map!


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 Conociendo el Bosque Alemão | Curitiba - Brasil 📍🇧🇷 [ESP-ENG] by @mariajcastro28

My first tourist destination was the Bosque Alemão, which I had wanted to visit for months and finally made it. This is one of the most emblematic natural and cultural spaces in the city (Curitiba). It was inaugurated in 1996 and covers an area of 38,000 square meters.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥈 Vila Nova Foz Côa - City Center / Riding Portugal by @onyfest

Returning to Vila Nova de Foz Côa was a strange experience from the very first minutes. The only memories I had of that place came from childhood, already quite blurry, almost reduced to small, isolated images without much context. And perhaps that's why the initial impact was precisely that. Everything seemed smaller than what I had stored in my head.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥉 Silent Beauty of Mosques: Calligraphy, Courtyards and Freshness from Istanbul to Ankara by @oneplanet

Actually, I don't want to talk only about mosques in this post. I want to talk about the fine workmanship on the mosques, the calligraphy on the walls, the spaciousness that high ceilings give people and the unique atmosphere of the courtyards. Because when I enter a mosque, one of the first things that catches my attention is that it is not just its size. Sometimes the calligraphy on a wall, sometimes the fine decorations around the mihrab, sometimes the light filtering in through the windows makes people think for a long time.

body.title: Testing Keto Bread Recipes - Comparing Textures - by Sunscape
body.body:
![foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-9.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNwtTo7q9uBxdZvpDd4H8L5airmJTCF58wsgU9u2QiLzc/foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-9.jpg)

I love bread! Being on a Keto-style diet is tough for me because I love my carbs. I decided to delve into making keto-friendly recipes this week.  The following are 4 that I made in one morning.  


![foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXhqAJK4CXhULiCpYcgjRcisQmqd9q9Cj2ZRrdVEYfKkY/foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-1.jpg)

Before I could start, I had ordered these flours and psyllium from Amazon.  Meanwhile, I searched the web for recipes that had good reviews.  I will leave links to the recipes instead of typing them all out. 


![foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUT1ULUmYk3E1kUeg7ovRHpsqwhov1FzyRPXzTDUfQQXu/foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-6.jpg)

First up, this bread had mozzarella, sour cream, and cream cheese.  I only had shredded cheese on hand instead of fresh mozzarella. It did not melt well, and it made the bread very dense.  This one was my least favorite of the four.


![foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPxJMDEV3f6euoeP9o9x6yL7HXdmeoHYF3sRS4jqV8XXR/foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-7.jpg)

<a href=\

> Source ![foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-10 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdW11ALXyoDk18eA5ayGDPQdq4qopfCpcms7PePbTfJJr/foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-10%20(1).jpg) The bread looks good, but it seemed very dry to both my husband and me. He even tried toasting it, but that did not help much either. Next up... ![foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZSWjFYDLxTRiGfMqGgYat3yLYDn19AGMkT3bniqbBnMu/foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-2.jpg) This recipe required whipping egg whites to a stiff peak before folding in the ingredients. ![bread 2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPYqoJSRo9uczcXU4xToHR7nSSPucFmVUbJvbrh5sDgFF/bread%202.jpg)

> Source I have to admit this one is not too bad. It was moister than the first one. I would rate this one as the next least favorite. Next... ![foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-1 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaLRSEGDQknZWUR2NpUEMdiQ5EkC1aueNkCjtY7rq9XG9/foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-1%20(1).jpg) I replaced the sunflower seeds in this recipe with pumpkin seeds, which are my favorite.

> Source ![bread 3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTZr9VfozN9ZwHKVXnWtsAL5uiJe6FEmYj2QibMVkZ8Jr/bread%203.jpg) I really love the flavor, texture, and moisture of this keto bread. I will certainly make this one regularly. Lastly... ![bread 4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU54s4xpP8J73s1aUz86L6fHwGrbn4UZhq61aEqzErQWy/bread%204.jpg)

> Source This one surprised me the most. Hubby and I both agreed that this recipe was our favorite of the four. It was moist, flavorful, and light. The recipe was used to make bread rolls, which would have been fine, except I took the easy route and used a loaf pan. ![foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-8.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTnGrhLqLJVWLpXzTgoYVVvqsP6WTTiTfSsFQjarhYBLU/foodiesbeehive-keto-breads-8.jpg) Since I was testing these recipes, I reduced the ingredients by half. All of them came out perfectly, except the one with mozzarella. I will try that one again using fresh mozzarella next time. I really would like to find a nice sandwich bread recipe that isn't so grainy. I guess I still have some researching to do. ![banner-sunscape-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYr3stqM7yx8cpipf8v6F4YgkM2aD282NSQrGYzJZqCxE/banner-sunscape-2.jpg)

**Những phương pháp quản lý tài chính khi chơi XSMB**

Xổ số miền Bắc là một hình thức giải trí phổ biến và thu hút nhiều người tham gia bởi sự đơn giản cùng cơ hội nhận được phần thưởng lớn. Tuy nhiên, nếu không biết kiểm soát chi tiêu, người chơi rất dễ rơi vào tình trạng mất cân bằng tài chính. Vì vậy, việc áp dụng những phương pháp quản lý tài chính hợp lý khi chơi XSMB là điều cần thiết để vừa đảm bảo tính giải trí, vừa tránh những hậu quả tiêu cực.

**➡️➡️➡️Bấm ngay:** [**https://www.snipesocial.co.uk/xosomienbacmobi**](https://www.snipesocial.co.uk/xosomienbacmobi)

Người chơi cần xây dựng kế hoạch chi tiêu rõ ràng và giới hạn số tiền dành cho xổ số miền Bắc

Đây là phương pháp quan trọng nhất giúp kiểm soát tài chính hiệu quả. Người chơi chỉ nên sử dụng một khoản tiền nhỏ, phù hợp với thu nhập cá nhân và tuyệt đối không lấy tiền sinh hoạt hay tiền tiết kiệm để tham gia. Việc đặt ra giới hạn cụ thể mỗi ngày hoặc mỗi tuần sẽ giúp tránh tình trạng chi tiêu quá mức vì tâm lý muốn \

sau khi thua. Ngoài ra, người chơi cũng cần biết dừng đúng lúc, không nên tiếp tục mua vé khi đã vượt quá ngân sách đã đề ra. Khi có kế hoạch rõ ràng, việc tham gia xổ số sẽ trở nên an toàn và không ảnh hưởng lớn đến cuộc sống thường ngày.\n\n

/>

Học cách quản lý chi tiêu khi chơi xổ số

**➡️➡️➡️Đọc thêm:** [**https://pinetbook.com/xosomienbachomnay**](https://pinetbook.com/xosomienbachomnay)

Người chơi cần duy trì tâm lý tỉnh táo và xem SXMB chỉ là một hình thức giải trí

Nhiều người thường mang tâm lý làm giàu nhanh chóng nên dễ bị cuốn vào việc chơi liên tục. Điều này không chỉ gây áp lực tài chính mà còn ảnh hưởng đến tinh thần và công việc. Thực tế, xác suất trúng thưởng rất thấp nên người chơi cần hiểu rằng may mắn không thể thay thế cho lao động và sự cố gắng trong cuộc sống. Thay vì đặt toàn bộ hi vọng vào xổ số, mỗi người nên ưu tiên tiết kiệm, đầu tư hoặc phát triển kỹ năng cá nhân để cải thiện thu nhập lâu dài. Khi giữ được suy nghĩ tích cực và biết kiểm soát cảm xúc, người chơi sẽ tránh được tâm lý phụ thuộc vào trò chơi may rủi.

**➡️➡️➡️Tra cứu tại:** [**https://mstdn.business/@xsmbhomnay**](https://mstdn.business/@xsmbhomnay)

Tóm lại, quản lý tài chính khi chơi XSMB là điều vô cùng quan trọng để tránh những rủi ro không đáng có. Việc lập kế hoạch chi tiêu hợp lý và giữ tâm lý tỉnh táo sẽ giúp người chơi tham gia một cách lành mạnh hơn. Xổ số chỉ nên được xem là một hoạt động giải trí mang tính thử vận may, không phải con đường để làm giàu. Khi biết kiểm soát bản thân và sử dụng tiền bạc hợp lý, người chơi sẽ vừa có thể tận hưởng cảm giác thú vị của trò chơi, vừa bảo vệ được cuộc sống và tài chính cá nhân.

body.title: Phillies shutout Guardians after getting shutout the day prior | Andrew Painter on mound for series deciding game this afternoon
body.body:
![mlb-Philadelphia-Phillies-Logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJhXiRGysGbqrUVr31VqR8j9iJthXQeNsJRnjA5UgF2TrkK4JXLPjHUG9MUr24D.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/)

Well, Zack Wheeler wasn't quite as dominant as Cristopher Sánchez the day prior, but he was still pretty solid! I feel as though the two of them are pushing each other to be great, but that's just a gut feeling. Maybe other pitchers in the rotation will feel the desire to push themselves as well! 

Wheeler pitched six scoreless innings, while that wasn't quite as strong as Sánchez the day prior, it still means that Phillies' starting pitchers have pitched 14 straight scoreless innings in the past two games, ya love to see that!

Bryson Stott has been really strong in May and he emphasized that yesterday with a clutch two RBI single in the bottom of the fourth to give the Phillies the lead. Stott now has 20 RBI in the month of May alone, this leads the National League for the month! Stott has always been average in my opinion, with some mildly above average defensive skills and running speed which is good. Stott is also *reliably* average, he doesn't typically get *super* cold for the most part, and also doesn't get all that hot for the most part. He's just a solid respectable pro and is also usually pretty healthy. Stott is now 28 and perhaps he's reaching his prime now, we'll see how the rest of the season goes. If a lot of these somewhat average but also somewhat younger guys like Stott, Bohm, and Marsh can begin to exceed expectations a bit, the Phillies could really be on their way here.

Later in the game, Jhoan Durán redeemed himself a bit after yesterday's rough outing by securing the game and getting the save in the ninth!

So it was a relatively clean [3-0 victory](https://youtu.be/pwABPNAKScs?si=v8uR7oNaFkvip3TW) all around. Phillies are back to .500 and can win the series today with Andrew Painter on the mound. Painter has been better recently so let's see if he can really string together some starts. 

It's been a relentlessly rainy, chilly Memorial Day weekend, but they've managed to get the games in still!

Since the new method I will dedicate to my articles will no longer be explanatory, nor guides, nor tutorials for learning to draw or techniques. It should only be appreciated in this way if the article is dedicated to that, which I think will be very few. > >   The following works will continue to be focused on art, but mixing it with a bit of poetry or storytelling. Feelings or everyday events that could happen to anyone, aiming to connect with the reader in a more emotional way. > >   Another point to consider is that my absence from the platform in terms of actively posting entries is mostly due to health and personal issues, and I now feel prepared to continuing to post. That said, let's get started with full force.
Antes de comenzar con la siguiente entrada, debo hacer algunas aclaraciones y anuncios.⁣⁣
  Lo primero es que todo tipo de contenido dedicado a mis dibujos es solo con fines artísticos. De ninguna manera se debe tomar de manera literal ni mucho menos personal. Ya que el nuevo método que voy a dedicar a mis artículos ya no será explicativo, ni guías ni tutoriales para aprender a dibujar ni técnicas. Solo se debe apreciar de esta manera si el artículo está dedicado a eso, lo cual pienso que serán muy pocos.   Las siguientes obras seguirán siendo centradas en el arte, pero mezclado con un poco de poesía o narración. Sentimientos o eventos cotidianos que podrían pasarles a cualquier persona, buscando conectar de una manera más emocional con el lector.   Otro punto a tomar es que mi ausencia prolongada en la plataforma para publicar entradas se debe mayormente a problemas de salud y personales, y de los cuales ya me siento preparado para seguir publicando. Dicho eso, empecemos a darle con todo.
![output-onlinegiftools-com.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqrzFPZriSMb7YmQ6.gif)

>

>! [English Version] 
> 
>  Today is one of those days when I felt very inspired and decided to capture what I felt in a drawing, thinking that I could create something to start anew and convey something. I know you are not aware of all this, but before I had that artistic conflict, which made me feel bad because I was only looking to produce more drawings, selling my soul to an audience, but as an artist, I felt increasingly empty, as I felt I wasn't expressing what I wanted.



  Hoy es uno de esos días en los que me sentía muy inspirado y decidí plasmar lo que sentía en un dibujo y pensé que podía realizar una publicación para empezar de nuevo y para transmitir algo. Yo sé que no son conscientes de todo esto, pero antes tenía ese conflicto artístico, por el cual no me sentía bien porque solamente buscaba sacar más cantidad de dibujos, vendiendo mi alma a un público, pero como artista quedaba cada vez más vacío, ya que sentía que no expresaba lo que quería.

  Así que decidí plasmarme esta vez; aunque ya lo he hecho muchas veces, ya que siempre siento como si estuviera dejando un poco de mi alma en cada autorretrato, por así decirlo.
