body.title: New equation in crypto market: Bitcoin strong, XRP under pressure, HYPE ahead
body.body: > How are you all? I hope you are all well. Today, I would like to share my personal observations and analysis on some of the recent important developments in the cryptocurrency market. There have been several interesting developments in the market over the past few days, especially with Bitcoin, XRP, and Hyperliquid. The recent movements of these three projects are giving some important clues about the current state of the market. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSFfKywyRLBHZ7aJYb6o8bfvyhPjcHAbqSBucjqUiAt3M/traxer-kM6QNrgo0YE-unsplash.jpg [Src](https://unsplash.com/id/foto/setumpuk-bitcoin-emas-dan-perak-kM6QNrgo0YE) In the crypto market, we usually see that large institutional investments positively affect the price of an asset. However, the situation is currently looking a little different for XRP. Despite the significant inflows into the US spot XRP ETF, the price of XRP has not shown much of a positive reaction. Rather, there is still a kind of weakness in the market. I find this quite significant. Because it proves that ETF inflows alone are no longer enough to drive the market higher. Investor confidence, overall market conditions, and the regulatory environment are also playing an equally important role. Currently, XRP is at a point where the risk of a further decline in price cannot be completely ruled out. However, there is still a potential upside for XRP. If the ongoing discussions about the CLARITY Act in the United States bring positive results, XRP could regain strength. Positive regulatory news in the past has helped XRP to quickly move up. So the next few weeks could be quite important for the project. On the other hand, Bitcoin is once again showing why it is called the king of the crypto market. Despite the significant amount of money being withdrawn from the Bitcoin ETF in recent times, Bitcoin has been able to maintain its strong position. Normally, such a large outflow can have a negative impact on the market, but Bitcoin is still above an important support level. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ1HMqHUEtUPkBfBCbEtiiWiHvZxbKdsVDScgfgAcZeJk/maxim-hopman-fiXLQXAhCfk-unsplash.jpg [Src](https://unsplash.com/id/foto/grafik-kandil-pasar-saham-di-layar-gelap-fiXLQXAhCfk) In my opinion, this is a positive signal. Because when an asset can maintain its position despite bad news, it proves its strong foundation in the market. Currently, many investors are shifting capital from altcoins to Bitcoin. As a result, Bitcoin’s market dominance is increasing. The global economy and geopolitical situation also play an important role here. The positive developments in the Middle East have created some optimism among investors. If this positive trend continues, I think Bitcoin can show even stronger performance in the future. Now let’s talk about Hyperliquid. It has become one of the most talked-about names in the crypto world in recent times. The most surprising thing is that Hyperliquid’s HYPE token has surpassed Dogecoin in terms of market capitalisation. This is undoubtedly a big event. Dogecoin has long been known as a strong community-based project. But Hyperliquid has taken a completely different approach. Their token economy, automatic buyback system, and interest from institutional investors have played a big role in the increase in the price of HYPE. In particular, the system of repurchasing tokens from the protocol’s trading fees is helping to maintain demand in the market in the long term. At the same time, more capital is entering the project due to the launch of new ETFs. As a result, Hyperliquid has been able to create a strong position in the market today. However, Dogecoin is not worth underestimating right now. Because the activity of large holders and long-standing community supporters is still in favour of this memecoin. Therefore, the competition between these two projects may become more interesting in the future. Overall, I think the current crypto market is going through a transition. Bitcoin is in a relatively strong position, XRP still faces significant uncertainty, and Hyperliquid is rapidly consolidating its position. This is a time for investors when it is very important to closely monitor the fundamental strength of projects, market trends, and regulatory situations, rather than relying solely on popularity. Personally, I think the next few weeks are going to be quite important for the crypto market. In particular, the rise of Bitcoin's dominance, the regulatory situation of XRP, and the continued progress of Hyperliquid could play a significant role in determining the future direction of the market. Thank you all. Don't forget to read the post and let me know your thoughts. I am always interested in reading your comments. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@mirzaiqi/new-equation-in-crypto-market-bitcoin-strong-xrp-under-pressure-hype-ahead-a9m)

Reading your post, one thing in particular caught my eye: the section where you say, “A notification when someone posts in their community”. 

Personally, I think this would be a step forward that would boost interaction. I say this because, at present, to see the latest posts or what’s new in the communities to which, for example, in my case, I’m subscribed, I have to do so manually. And much of the content that might interest me or be worth commenting on is lost if I don’t look for it myself. 

So that point about incorporating a notification system linked to subscribed communities would add value that would exponentially increase interaction between users.


It would be an excellent idea to recommend this improvement to the developers. Otherwise, the post has a very solid line of reasoning.

body.title: A Day in My Life Blog: Sharing today our Church Divine Service as we Worship God in Spirit and in Truth! 🙏😇🙌
body.body: **Have a Blessed Day to all ASEAN Hivers and all my Fellow Hivers all over the World!** Today is Sunday and it is our Church Divine Service schedule. We spend this day for the Lord and for His glory alone. What I am going to share in today's blog post is some of the happenings during our Church Service. I am happy to share this with all of you because I do believe that this will bless everyone of us. Before I share my blog post here in the community. Never I forget to express my thanksgiving first to all my supporters. To all Community Admins, all Curators and all commenters, thank you so much to all of you for the unending support which I always received. This will definitely encourage me to do more and to continue. God will always bless all of you. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSR1XB31cbEFrQYAKrU9NDagHRESobTHRn1NrQ9KrygnV/1779623769527.png) We all know that we do have many events, works or things needed to do every week but I must say that we should not missed a week that we cannot worship and give thanks to God. That is why for us, we spend every Sunday of each week to gather in our Church for it is our Church day. All our brethren in the Lord gathered together to worship God in Spirit and in truth. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ7veschE4w7namhjBT7erKBmPe96eLYBvwBBLQ7HXzgU/1779624421706.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS5UDaP2rYehNYdWHjgWEumLUcSohik6LVf3chhGuLLpR/1779624421770.jpg) Our Church Service is scheduled to start by 9:00 in the morning and since we needed to go to the Church on time, we prepared ourselves early too, most especially to my Nephew. With the help of my Mother, we cooked our breakfast early so we can eat early too. But before we took our breakfast, we have take a bath first most especially to my Nephew in which I am the one who take his bath. After we have taken our breakfast, we then immediately went to our Church in which as we arrived the Church program has been immediately started with an opening songs and opening prayer. Next part is the sharing of testimonies by some of our Church Members and we set it with 3 members only who will share. All of the members testimonies were very encouraging and we thank God for that. One of those who share is my Aunt who thank God in despite all trials she faced this days. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZGZtvoD7ryrNCnG5BzTBxUv73UU6vRTfsNA1cr2qCVN/1779625209428.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPoeXxUttFF564Kr9L8yoov52rKKwMbyw3x7K3iE8QqKk/1779625209518.jpg) It was then followed immediately just after the sharing of some of the members testimonies is the Praise and Worship, and it is to be led by one of our Church Worship Leader. This moment of time is we consider it very holy as at this time, we will worship the living God through songs of praises and worship, and the worship leader will led us to worship God in spirit and in truth. We thank and glorify God for His presence is within us. As we continue in our worship, we can feel His presence which makes us feel the love of God to all of us. Some of us during this time went cry as we continue feel the presence of God in our midst. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWVog3x2Xsjf1n9bmkVTYhShALqH1LSuu7e79D78YdmNF/1779625723234.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQXtFeYLSwwt9XaNo4ap1mFGurW7R1LAZkMW4N9KBj21X/1779625723300.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVqT6DeL9fBGtRDNuFdwt7ZMnRnL9XLYf6gova343tTgB/1779625723355.jpg) As we continue our Church Divine Service, it makes more exciting as we are now in the main part of our Church Service, and this is the sharing of God's Word or the Sermon time, to be shared by our Church Senior Pastor. This is what we always waited for in every Sunday Church Service we have, as this is a food for our soul. That is why, we encourage all our members to be focused and serious during this time so we will understand and be able to apply in our life as a Christian. What our Senior Pastor shared today is very exact of what we are facing right now, as he talk more about edurance. How can we endure from all trials in life. As for me, it is very nice message knowing that just a month ago, an accident happened to me. In which I consider it as trail to me. And this message remind me that God will never leave us nor forsake us from all trails and challenges we faced everyday of our lives. I am very thankful and blessed from the Word of God today. That was around 11:50 in the morning when my Pastor finished his sermon and then we do other part of the service before we ended up successfully. We have now take our lunch as it is already noontime. After then, by around 1:30 in the afternoon, after we have finished other things we needed to do here in our Church. It is now time for us to go home, safe and very blessed. This would be all for today's post, and until next time again, I just want to thank everyone in advance who will drop by on my blog post. **To God be all the Glory!** 😇🙌☝️ **Your Friend** **_@godlovermel25_**

Some Saturdays are meant to recharge the soul, and mine came down to the perfect combination of sea, music, wheels, and light.

My day began in the tranquility of Pampatar Beach. Alone, with the breeze blowing in my face and my headphones on, I managed to create that perfect bubble where the rhythm of the music and the sound of the waves became one. It was that necessary moment of pause and contemplation, where the mind quiets down and the sea takes care of washing away any trace of haste.

But Caribbean calm also has its share of movement. After soaking up the sea’s energy, I traded the sand for the pavement and headed to La Caracola. Strapping on my roller skates and gliding down that endless stretch, feeling the speed and freedom of the road, was the perfect transition.

To top it all off, Margarita’s sky did what it does best: treat us to a spectacle of colors. Pausing to capture the magic of that sunset through my lens—with its golden and pink hues painting the horizon—was the perfect reminder of just how lucky I am to live on and experience this island. A Saturday just for me, to connect, skate, and preserve the beauty of the Caribbean in a photo and in my heart.

Hay sábados que se diseñan para recargar el alma, y el mío se resumió en la combinación perfecta de mar, música, ruedas y luz.

Mi día comenzó en la tranquilidad de Playa Pampatar. Sola, con la brisa de frente y mis audífonos puestos, logré crear esa burbuja perfecta donde el ritmo de la música y el sonido de las olas se volvieron uno solo. Fue ese momento necesario de pausa y contemplación, donde la mente se aquieta y el mar se encarga de limpiar cualquier rastro de prisa.

Pero la calma caribeña también tiene su dosis de movimiento. Después de llenarme de la energía del mar, cambié la arena por el asfalto y me fui a La Caracola. Ponerme los patines y empezar a deslizarme por esa recta infinita, sintiendo la velocidad y la libertad del camino, fue la transición perfecta.

Para cerrar con broche de oro, el cielo de Margarita hizo lo que mejor sabe hacer: regalarnos un espectáculo de colores. Detener el paso para capturar con mi lente la magia de ese atardecer, con sus tonos dorados y rosados pintando el horizonte, fue el recordatorio exacto de lo afortunada que soy de vivir y sentir esta isla. Un sábado para mí, para conectar, patinar y guardar la belleza del caribe en una foto y en el corazón.

body.title: Unleashing Crypto Privacy: Zano Launches Desktop Lite Wallet Beta for Instant Blockchain Access Without the Full Sync Sluggishness
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTrKkuhUuihwEwSs16UZ2YQkzHbK4CaJjQsxuK6NF7qw2/zano.png 


The era of waiting for hours just to synchronize a full node on a privacy-first blockchain is finally hitting a brick wall. Zano has officially rolled out its Desktop Lite Wallet Beta, available immediately across Windows, Mac, and Linux environments. This launch is a targeted technological evolution aimed at one of the biggest friction points in the privacy coin sector: the agonizingly slow barrier to entry. Traditionally, running a full node required users to download the entire blockchain ledger locally before making a single transaction. Zano’s Lite Wallet bypasses this data-heavy chore entirely by allowing instantaneous connection to remote nodes, providing users with desktop agility without sacrificing their security infrastructure.

echnically, the architecture is designed to support Zano's ecosystem of \

. Unlike transparent public ledgers where financial tracking is a feature, Zano enforces privacy by default, concealing the sender, recipient, asset type, and transaction volume from blockchain sleuths and centralized eyes. This beta release opens up the highway for over a hundred privacy-preserving tokens, allowing users to interact with secure stablecoins and private assets seamlessly.

However, let’s cut through the marketing hype and look at the actual risk parameters. As an investment professional who values raw data over emotional narratives, I must emphasize that this software is strictly a Beta version. In the software development cycle, beta means it is an active testing ground designed to flush out unexpected software anomalies, bugs, and edge-case vulnerabilities. Furthermore, relying entirely on remote nodes creates a structural trade-off. While it grants you instantaneous speed and saves local disk storage, you are delegating node availability to third parties. If those remote nodes experience distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) disruptions, network latency, or unexpected downtime, your liquidity access and transaction speeds will suffer.

Therefore, while the technology represents a massive leap forward for decentralized financial autonomy and mass usability, smart capital management dictates caution. Treat this beta as an exploratory tool. Do not migrate your primary treasury or core private assets into a beta-phase wallet architecture until the network collects comprehensive ecosystem data, patches initial vulnerabilities, and delivers a fully audited, stable production release.

body.title: SILENT WORLD FILLED WITH LOVE
body.body:
![Kopia – Observed lives.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wCQpoxEKg2UEvhyz4HhweXKNfJ5JDDLiJrFpRTF23dVjd8d7EnPyKnbbCywWdZzW4Yo.jpg)

I recently became the owner of a new phone, so it was finally time to test its camera. As it happened yesterday I was at my nephew’s birthday party and they have a cat at home. I decided it would be the perfect opportunity to take a few photos. So, the star of today’s post is NORKA and her story.

Less than a year ago my nineteen-year-old nephew found a small, lost and undernourished kitten. I’m glad to have such a kind-hearted nephew. He took the kitten home, gave her food and water and cared for her. Norka stole the hearts of the whole family from the very first day. She was quickly accepted and it did not take long before the decision was made that she would stay with them permanently.

At first Norka was very frightened. She also displayed some unusual behaviors that were most likely caused by severe stress. However, she soon settled into her new home and those nervous habits gradually disappeared until they were completely gone.

Not long afterwards it turned out that Norka was deaf. Unfortunately, there is no way to cure her condition. The world as Norka experiences it is completely silent. She grew up in my sister’s home surrounded above all by love, care and affection.
At first, because she was deaf and never made any sounds, we thought she might not only be deaf but also mute. However, only quite recently she began producing her very first meows!

Now she is a friendly, happy cat who enjoys life!
I’m very happy that she was found in time and given a chance for a better life!

body.title: A different kind of voyeurism.
body.body: <center>[Taste of Cinema](https://www.tasteofcinema.com/2015/25-great-voyeuristic-movies/)</center>\nYesterday I was reading a very interesting post (published by lordbutterfly, and can be read by clicking [here](https://peakd.com/hive/@lordbutterfly/the-most-expensive-thing-hive-can-do-right-now-is-nothing)) that made me reflect on what needs to be done (in terms of development, in a general context) for the growth of the **Hive**, as an ecosystem that favors plural power actions. The idea of carefully observing what is being done (inside and outside the boundaries of **WEB 3.0**, by the way) with the use of artificial intelligence then becomes a very interesting starting point, given its complexity (which is not yet fully measured given its advances).\nTherefore, I believe it is very relevant that we need to put the art of \

observation into practice within this context. Although all mistakes are accepted (after all, they are what usually allow us to grow within an evolutionary process full of ups and downs along the way), why not avoid them if other people can do it for us? It's not about perpetuating the mistakes of other projects, but rather about learning from everything that has been done and taking advantage of what can be applied within this ecosystem. Being a **voyeur** is being intelligent.\nOn the other hand, I'm not referring to the idea of observing without acting. This passivity would put us in a place where we would be less active and possibly handing over a considerable part of our autonomy to people who are - *literally* - risking themselves to explore new possibilities. By now, we should all know that artificial intelligence is not our enemy... At most, it is a future ally that has not yet been fully understood precisely by those who were responsible for its creation. How ironic is this thought?\nIn short, it has never been so important to observe (and analyze) what is happening around us. Working in the \
may not be so interesting (especially in terms of recognizing and expanding ideas that need to be put into practice), but it can be an interesting path while the \

caused by the use of artificial intelligence loses its strength. Our path needs to be paved by the transparency of what worked, and the evolution of this ecosystem can find the answers when the waters are less murky than they are now.
---
<center>**Un tipo diferente de voyeurismo.**</center>
Ayer leí una entrada muy interesante (publicada por lordbutterfly, que se puede leer haciendo clic [aqui](https://peakd.com/hive/@lordbutterfly/the-most-expensive-thing-hive-can-do-right-now-is-nothing)) que me hizo reflexionar sobre lo que se necesita hacer (en términos de desarrollo, en un contexto general) para el crecimiento de **Hive**, como un ecosistema que favorece las acciones de poder plural. La idea de observar atentamente lo que se hace (dentro y fuera de los límites de la **WEB 3.0**, por cierto) con el uso de la inteligencia artificial se convierte entonces en un punto de partida muy interesante, dada su complejidad (que aún no se ha comprendido del todo debido a sus avances).
Por lo tanto, creo que es muy relevante que pongamos en práctica el arte de la observación \

en este contexto. Si bien todos los errores son aceptados (al fin y al cabo, son los que suelen permitirnos crecer en un proceso evolutivo lleno de altibajos), ¿por qué no evitarlos si otros pueden hacerlo por nosotros? No se trata de perpetuar los errores de otros proyectos, sino de aprender de todo lo que se ha hecho y aprovechar lo que se puede aplicar dentro de este ecosistema. Ser un **voyeur** es ser muy astuto. Por otro lado, no me refiero a la idea de observar sin actuar. Esta pasividad nos llevaría a ser menos activos y, posiblemente, a ceder una parte considerable de nuestra autonomía a personas que - *literalmente* - se arriesgan para explorar nuevas posibilidades. A estas alturas, todos deberíamos saber que la inteligencia artificial no es nuestra enemiga... A lo sumo, es una futura aliada que aún no ha sido comprendida del todo por quienes fueron responsables de su creación. ¡Qué irónico resulta este pensamiento! En resumen, nunca ha sido tan importante observar (y analizar) lo que sucede a nuestro alrededor. Trabajar en la “sombra” puede no ser tan interesante (sobre todo en lo que respecta a reconocer y desarrollar ideas que necesitan ponerse en práctica), pero puede ser un camino interesante mientras el “caos” provocado por el uso de la inteligencia artificial pierde fuerza. Nuestro camino debe estar marcado por la transparencia de lo que ha funcionado, y la evolución de este ecosistema podrá encontrar las respuestas cuando las aguas estén menos turbias que ahora. ---
**Um tipo diferente de voyeurismo.**
Ontem eu estava lendo um post muito interessante (publicado por lordbutterfly, e pode ser lido clicando [aqui](https://peakd.com/hive/@lordbutterfly/the-most-expensive-thing-hive-can-do-right-now-is-nothing)) que me fez refletir sobre o que é preciso ser feito (em termos de desenvolvimento, num contexto geral) para o crescimento da **Hive**, como um ecossistema que favorece as ações de poder plural. A ideia de observar com atenção o que anda sendo feito (dentro e fora das fronteiras **WEB 3.0**, aliás) com o uso da inteligência artificial se torna então um ponto de partida muito interessante, dada à sua complexidade (que ainda não é completamente mensurada haja vista os seus avanços). Sendo assim, eu acredito que seja muito relevante o fato de que precisamos colocar a arte da observação “fetichista” em prática dentro desse contexto. Embora todos os erros sejam aceitos (afinal, são eles que geralmente nos permitem crescer dentro de um processo evolutivo cheio de altos e baixos ao longo do caminho), por que não evitá-los se outras pessoas podem fazer isso por nós? Não se trata sobre fomentar os erros de outros projetos, mas sim, de aprender com tudo o que foi feito e tirar proveito do que pode ser aplicado dentro desse ecossistema. Ser um **voyeur** é ser inteligente. Por outro lado, não me refiro a ideia de observar sem agir. Essa passividade nos colocaria em um lugar onde estaríamos sendo menos ativos e possivelmente, entregando uma parte considerável do nosso poder de autonomia nas mãos de pessoas que - *literalmente* - estão se arriscando para explorar novas possibilidades. A esta altura, todos nós já devemos saber que a inteligência artificial não é nossa inimiga... No máximo, é uma futura aliada que ainda não foi totalmente compreendida justamente por aqueles que foram os responsáveis pela sua criação. O quão irônico é esse pensamento? Enfim, nunca foi tão importante observar (e analisar) o que está acontecendo ao nosso redor. Trabalhar nas “sombras” talvez não seja tão interessante (principalmente em termos de reconhecimento e expansão de ideias que precisam ser colocadas em práticas), mas pode ser um caminho interessante enquanto o “caos” provocado pelo uso da inteligência artificial vai perdendo à sua força. O nosso caminho precisa ser pavimentado pela transparência do que deu certo, e a evolução desse ecossistema pode encontrar as respostas quando as águas estiverem menos turvas do que estão agora. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/a-different-kind-of-voyeurism-fr8)

body.title: No Events? Or Just a Reset Week We Didn’t Know We Needed?
body.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

You ever get that feeling where a game just… pauses for a second? Not in a bad way. More like a *breather*. That’s kind of what this weekend feels like in WOO.

At first glance, it’s easy to think nothing’s happening. But when you look at everything that just dropped. Battle Pass, quests, mobile updates. it starts to feel like this quiet weekend might actually be intentional. Like a **reset window**.

>*I have gotten some feedback that reminders are pretty useful when it comes to the regular events held in WOO. So here I am again with a quick reminder for any upcoming events.*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23x12vfLauHvGc6JjdSPEan5RxkJsXM9NdUSsiwnnyJygQquZXnXjgChVNRCUwqQGkQNn.png)

---

* The recent update introduced multiple new systems that players are still learning and adjusting to.
  
Let’s not underestimate how big this update actually is. It’s not just one feature but it’s multiple layers all at once. And sometimes, you need time to just explore that without being pulled in ten different directions by events.

* A quieter weekend allows players to experiment with the Battle Pass without pressure.
  
Imagine if events were stacked on top of this update immediately. It would feel overwhelming. Instead, this gives players space to figure things out. What quests are efficient? How fast can you level? What’s worth prioritizing? That kind of learning phase is important.

* It creates a natural onboarding period for both new and returning players.
  
If someone’s jumping into WOO right now, this is actually a great time. No chaos, no overload but just systems to explore and understand. And that kind of entry point is underrated.

From a fan perspective, I actually don’t mind this. Because not every weekend needs to be explosive. Sometimes, a quieter moment helps set up the bigger moments that come after.

And if that’s what this is? Then I’m all for it too!

---

**TLDR: This is a reminder to all my readers (and WOO fans) that baring any last minute sudden surprise events, this weekend should be a relatively quiet one. 😜**

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

Ayer viví una jornada inolvidable en la carrera One Run junto a mi gran familia de LPG Runners. Desde temprano, el ambiente en Los Próceres se sentía desafiante; el cielo estaba completamente nublado, pero la humedad y el clima bochornoso se hacían notar en cada bocanada de aire. Sabía que mantener el ritmo bajo ese calor sofocante requeriría no solo de piernas, sino de muchísima cabeza y corazón.
A pesar de las condiciones climáticas que amenazaban con mermar las fuerzas, la energía del equipo y la constancia de los entrenamientos dieron sus frutos. Kilómetro a kilómetro logré sostener el paso, cruzando la meta con un tiempo oficial de 50 minutos y 4 segundos. ¡Una marca increíble que demuestra que la disciplina lo puede todo! Bajar mis tiempos en un escenario tan exigente me llena de un orgullo inmenso y me motiva a ir por más.
Al cruzar la línea de llegada, el cansancio se transformó en pura celebración. Nos reunimos todos para inmortalizar el momento con una sesión de fotos, luciendo con orgullo la nueva camisa del equipo que estábamos estrenando. Esa camiseta, impregnada de esfuerzo y sudor, representa la unión y el apoyo mutuo de LPG. ¡Ayer demostramos una vez más de qué estamos hechos!


---

body.body: ## Chinese Mega Darkrai ex + Wailord ex + Misty's Energy Cards --- Hi there. Another Pokemon TCG post here. I cover the reveals of Mega Darkrai ex and Bastiodon Promo cards in Chinese, Wailord ex and Misty's Energy cards. These cards are from the upcoming Abyss Eye Japan set. (English set is Pitch Black.) Instead of Hive Gaming, I post this on my blog.   ## Chinese Mega Darkrai ex + Bastiodon --- [Source](https://www.pokebeach.com/2026/05/chinese-mega-darkrai-ex-and-bastiodon-promos-revealed-likely-to-release-in-english) There are alternate art promo cards of Mega Darkrai ex and Bastiodon. These are in Traditional Chinese for Hong Kong and Taiwan (I think). | | | |---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/Mega-Darkrai-ex-Traditional-Chinese.jpeg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/Bastiodon-Traditional-Chinese.jpeg | It is speculated that Bastiodon will be one of four prerelease promo cards for the Pitch Black set.

>Image Source Misty's Energy is a niche Supporter card. Once this card is played, your turn ends (after resolving this card's effect.) You search your deck for up to 4 Basic Water Energy and attach them to 1 of your Pokemon. (Shuffle deck after.) Notice that the Pokemon does not have to be a Water Pokemon. In theory, you can attach 4 Water Pokemon to a Water Pokemon that needs a lot of energy or to a non Water Pokemon like Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex. | | | |---|---| | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/ASC/ASC_048_R_EN_LG.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_141_R_EN_LG.png |   It is unknown at the time of writing if this Misty's Energy card has a special illustration rare card. It is possible that there are other versions of this card. If so, it would be a major chase card.   ## Wailmer --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeAMA1g7iLVY7761UmBiR4YRCtVS6DLtTmKrZQ3cw7HG2/wailmer.png) [Source](https://www.pokebeach.com/2026/05/wailord-ex-and-mistys-energy-from-abyss-eye-revealed) Wailmer is not a great attacker but it is needed for Wailord or Wailord ex.   ## Wailord ex ---

>Image Source ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcEbQtN2rA4vpB8mN9S3wqX7LgtVZa4GvRfZ9SQVw5ynE/wailord_ex.png) Wailord ex is a very bulky Stage 1 Pokemon ex. This has a lot of HP at 380 HP. This is more than regular stage 2 Pokemon ex and most Mega Pokemon ex. This has Lightning weakness, a 4 retreat cost and 2 expensive attacks. Walord ex is a bulky beatstick attacker. As Wailord ex is a Water Pokemon, you can use Surfing Beach to switch out between Water Pokemon.

body.title: Los delirios de un cubano fan de From
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWARh7sGrZR7gzmDsXcsDxjXWf8skP95DEULCD3Z6grQa/1779628278508.jpg)

---

Dios le da barbas al que no tiene quijada. Esa frase me viene a la cabeza cada vez que intento poner un capítulo de From, y digo intento porque entre un apagón que te deja en penumbras y otro que te borra la señal de raíz, voy armando la trama con retazos, como nosotros los hombres que damos puntadas al coser una aquí y la otra a 10 kilómetros de distancia. Para los que aún no se han metido en este laberinto, les cuento rápido y sin rodeos: existe un pueblo antiguo, aislado, de esos que parecen sacados de un sueño pesado que no logras recordar por completo. Se llega por una carretera que surge de la nada, sin aviso, sin cartel, sin lógica. Una vez que cruzas el límite, el camino se cierra, se dobla sobre sí mismo o simplemente se desvanece en la neblina. Y ya está. No hay salida. El lugar no tiene nombre oficial, o al menos nadie lo pronuncia, y sus habitantes son gente corriente que, por azar o por capricho de algún guionista con demasiada imaginación, terminaron atrapados sin mapa ni brújula. La regla es simple y brutal: cuando cae el sol, todo el mundo se encierra en las casas, cierra ventanas, atranca puertas y coloca en el marco un objeto extraño, una especie de piedra tallada con símbolos que nadie sabe de dónde vino ni cómo funciona, pero que resulta ser la única barrera entre la vida y una muerte segura. Porque afuera, en el bosque que rodea el asentamiento, esperan ellos. No son fantasmas de manual, ni demonios de leyenda antigua. Son figuras humanoides, pálidas, con sonrisas que no encajan en ningún rostro humano, que se mueven con una fluidez antinatural, que imitan voces con precisión quirúrgica, que juegan con la mente, que saben exactamente dónde tocar para que la presa se paralice. Y si un talismán falla, si una puerta queda mal cerrada, si alguien duda un segundo… el bosque se lleva otro nombre.

A mí, sinceramente, los monstruos no me dan miedo. Llevo años viendo cómo la vida real supera cualquier guion de terror, y he aprendido que lo verdaderamente aterrador no es lo que sale de entre los árboles, sino lo que se queda dentro de las paredes cuando se va la luz y no vuelve. Por eso, en lugar de gritar cuando aparece una de esas criaturas arrastrándose por el césped, grito cuando el personaje abre el grifo y sale agua limpia, constante, a presión, sin hora, sin racionamiento, sin pipas de agua que llegue tres días tarde y que te valen entre 10 mil y 15 mil pesos. Grito cuando encienden un interruptor y la lámpara no parpadea, no se quema, no se lleva el último resto de paciencia que le quedaba al vecino. Grito cuando cocinan calmadamente con sus ollas de esas freidoras de aire y no tienen que soplar carbón durante veinte minutos, cuando no necesitan un abanico de cartón para no derretirse en la cocina, cuando no dependen de una chismosa que más que iluminar parece amenazar con volar la casa si le acercas la mano. From es una serie sobre supervivencia, sí, pero también sobre lo frágil que es la normalidad. Y eso es justo lo que me tiene pegado a la pantalla, no por el susto, sino por la ironía. Esos personajes se quejan de su encierro, de las reglas absurdas, de la falta de esperanza, y tienen razón. Claro que la tienen. Pero no se dan cuenta de que, en comparación con lo que nos toca aquí, no menciono país, viven en un paraíso con monstruos de adorno. Allá tienen luz las veinticuatro horas, agua que sale cuando giras la llave, nevera que enfría, televisor que no se apaga cuando más quieres ver cómo se desarrolla el misterio de la serie o tan solo verte la novela basileña porque la cubana mehh. Si, esos habitantes supieran lo que es vivir contando kilos, calculando watts, guardando velas como si fueran lingotes de oro, otra ave cantaría. 

Lo más curioso de From es cómo te atrapa sin que te des cuenta. No es solo el miedo a lo desconocido, es la forma en que la serie te obliga a preguntarte qué harías tú en ese lugar. ¿Te adaptarías? ¿Buscarías la salida o te rendirías? ¿Confiarías en el vecino o te aislarías? Porque el verdadero terror no está solo en el bosque. Está en las miradas, en los secretos que se guardan, en las decisiones que se toman cuando el pánico aprieta. El sheriff intenta mantener el orden con reglas que nadie pidió, la alcaldesa quiere respuestas que no existen, el médico busca lógica en un lugar que la rechaza, y las familias simplemente intentan que sus hijos no pierdan la inocencia en un pueblo donde la infancia se acaba cuando cae el sol. Y entre todo eso, el misterio se va tejiendo como una telaraña: hay túneles bajo la tierra, hay señales de radio que nadie puede rastrear, hay un faro que no ilumina el mar pero parece llamar a algo, hay sueños que se repiten, hay voces que cruzan la frecuencia, hay un ciclo que nadie entiende pero que todos respetan porque el que lo rompe paga el precio de la muerte. La serie no te da respuestas fáciles. Te obliga a convivir con la duda, a aceptar que a veces no hay explicación, solo supervivencia. Y eso, créanme, es que se parece a lo que tengo en mi país. 

Yo, por mi parte, llevo la cuenta de los capítulos con un cuaderno que se me ha llenado de tachones y flechas, porque entre apagón y apagón, la mente te juega malas pasadas y terminas recordando escenas que no fueron así, o confundiendo personajes que se parecen demasiado en la oscuridad. Pero hay algo que no se me borra: la envidia sana, o quizás no tan sana, de ver cómo en ese pueblo maldito, rodeado de criaturas que sonríen con dientes de vidrio, la vida sigue fluyendo con normalidad en lo esencial. Tienen agua corriente. Tienen electricidad. Tienen una farmacia que no cierra tres meses por falta de insumos. Tienen una escuela donde los niños no estudian con el sol de ventana porque no hay correinte. Tienen un pequeño comercio con estantes que no son pura ilusión óptica. Si mañana apareciera esa carretera frente a mi puerta, y si por algún milagro de la topografía imposible me dejara entrar, yo no dudaría. Haría la maleta con lo mínimo, caminaría hasta el límite, cruzaría sin mirar atrás, y me instalaría en la primera casa que encontrara disponible. Y si una de esas figuras pálidas se acercaba a la ventana, le hablaba claro: Mira, amigo, puedes intentar entrar, puedes probar con la voz de mi madre o con la cara de un conocido, pero te advierto algo antes de que lo hagas. Llevo tanto tiempo comiendo picadillo de MDM que hasta la sombra me sabe a conservante. Si me muerdes, te vas a llevar un gusto a lata oxidada y desesperación que ni con enjuague bucal se te quita. Y créeme, después de probarlo, preferirás volver al bosque a buscar a alguien que aún tenga sabor a comida de verdad.

From no es solo una serie de terror. Es un espejo deformado que nos muestra qué es lo que realmente valoramos cuando todo lo demás se cae. No extrañamos los grandes lujos. Extrañamos lo básico. Lo que damos por sentado hasta que deja de estar ahí. Y aquí, en este rincón del mundo donde los apagones son tan naturales como el amanecer y el agua es un privilegio que se negocia, uno aprende que el verdadero monstruo no tiene ojos vacíos ni piel gris. El verdadero monstruo es la incertidumbre diaria, la espera, el cálculo, el ahorro forzado, la resignación que se disfraza de costumbre. Por eso sigo viendo From, capítulo a capítulo, interrupción tras interrupción, no para escapar de la realidad, sino para recordarme que, a pesar de todo, aún tenemos algo que los habitantes de ese pueblo no saben que tienen: la capacidad de reírnos de lo absurdo, de encontrar humor en lo imposible, de seguir contando chistes aunque la nevera esté vacía y la luz se haya ido hace 20 horas. Y si algún día la carretera aparece de verdad, ya saben dónde encontrarme. Probablemente estaré en la cocina, soplando carbón ó encendiendo el acerring, abanicándome con un pedazo de papel periódico, y preguntándome si los talismanes también protegen contra el color sofocante. Porque al final del día, el terror es relativo. Lo que a unos les quita el sueño, a otros les da material para la próxima historia.

Hello!

I try not to drag much home, since I've spent time off and on the last few years, trying to get stuff OUT!... but there are several things I look for all the time. When I found these, I had never had them on my mind, because I guess I never thought I would see one. They aren't rare really as there were many made back in the day, but they are popular.  Who knows, there could be some area where they are available all the time, but not here. Of course once I found a couple, my eyes always do a general scan for them as I go through the dish isles anywhere.  Since they are popular, folks the work thrift shops to find resale items would certainly snatch them up, so that's another reason they might be harder to find. :)

I had many more recipe books, but over time have let a lot go, still leaving about two dozen, but possibly a few of those wouldn't make the cut if I went through them again. I don't have a treasure like you have from your Grandmother, but I still have my first Betty Crocker cookbook that my Mom and Grandma gave me when I got married.  The binding has long been gone and retaped and there are multiple pages with the light spatters of use. That one will go when I do! I had a children's recipe book when I was a teen and I loved it, but didn't keep it at some point.  In the last few years, I found a copy on ebay that is in great condition and bought it, I don't know why I do that sometimes, buy something I had many years ago, but they do give me the \

One of the most important lessons I’ve learned as a nutritionist is that wellness is about so much more than food.

It’s about the habits we build, the thoughts we allow into our minds, and the way we choose to face each day. Some mornings start with a detailed plan, while others begin with nothing more than a smile and a positive attitude ✨

Life isn’t always perfect, and neither are we. But I truly believe that small daily choices can make a huge difference over time. Drinking more water, moving your body, resting when needed, and being kind to yourself are all part of the process.

Today I’m reminding myself that progress doesn’t have to be dramatic. Sometimes it’s simply showing up, doing your best, and finding reasons to smile along the way 💚

The journey toward a healthier and happier life is built one day at a time.

‎

‎

body.title: Cooking Blog: Pinakbet For Our Lunch
body.body:
![Copy of Copy of Your paragraph text (1).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK7oT7WdfTcHBJnVcFubfK4JYWtzp7Zrvk37bwoUSUVKjw7TdRYjDdzkazUF6yMe6V.gif)
Hello, how are you? When I tell you we ate pinakbet once a week, I am not kidding because this will never leave our dining table, no matter what LOL. Whenever you look at the market, you can see all the ingredients are just easy to grab and buy, so that whenever my mom goes to the market to buy our weekly food ingredients, pinakbet is the easiest. If I were her, I would do the same, as it is so hard sometimes to think what food ingredients to buy. So I am going to cook pinakbet the way I make it, for this is my version. ----
Ingredients I Used:

>
  • 1 tbsp. Cooking Oil
  • 1/2 Cup Pork
  • 4 Cloves Garlic
  • 1 Red Onion
  • Thumb Ginger
  • 4 Tomatoes
  • 2 tbsp. Bagoong
  • 1 Chicken Broth Cube

>
  • 2 Kamote
  • 10 Okra
  • 2 Pallang Winge Beans
  • 7 Thai Eggplant
  • 1/4 Cup Patani Lima Beans
  • 2 Bittergourd
  • 4 Green Chilis
  • 2 Cups Water
-----
Let's Cook!

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeGNSZcC1w64nqZuJ1N5J8uQWwEFoqV6ekoMYRvcRLwNCgPTD6pfwhCNNScXCj9vcM.JPG) In a hot pan, I added about a tablespoon of pork meat. I use pork chop this time, and you can use any meat you have. -----

> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogPjbQXNvEh6xhS6JV1dhzgE3SWqoG4S8V5B19VkqtiMkHZQuWzcPusrtKzaHv7jro.JPG) I cook it until it turns crispy and browning starts appearing. -----

> ![7.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogPHMmJGfUv9RWF3RcQJ1w47sekRVfZFTpWzReyvGUQWUcnrEJc8ZNPFymmfJFP88u.JPG) Then I added the aromatics like garlic, red onion, and ginger, sauteed them for about a minute or until the aroma comes out. -----

> ![11.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokeW7GwZct4EdMgAoR3qphKT9nHbcBMN4FqPdHncLQE9CvvG73hj7YG2WXzULoBqXU.JPG) Then I added the tomatoes in, cooked it until the texture turned into a mushy, so the more mushy it is, the more colorful the dish, which looks good and tastes good at the same time. ----

> ![14.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eou9cAsvuLetJuiwMsCVKBKua8KysBxuPyz3j6ehDQ5AgGq8eHPGSYr4HZPVJa8JwH1.JPG) Then I added two tablespoons of Bagoong, but you can use fish sauce, the clear one, for subtitute. But using bagoong is highly recommended. -----
> ![17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowH8TPiqfD4VTmz92k3ZboRHsMAeoTP12T9UL8tqLvy3voBaBXC7NKQ8GJuyy6JqfF.JPG) Then I added about two cups of water. ----

> ![19.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eou9cAGF5DMiEYAzEbGpJ3ndkrFsrjtxY9oDFyLyjSksEaEvoCE4BLoQ9kWGaBfiR1H.JPG) To make the dish taste extra tasty, I am going to add one chicken broth cube. -----

> ![21.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiXbCpFrDduwYqrzB1eUtEMVyFFAkRmwkwxjgYwKpzeJR1pyTrzDGk4psXXq33dVGF.JPG) When it starts boiling, I am going to add the kamote first. ----

> ![24.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoptwxxZhsthXUNYKdXNTmSjH8MmRPMzoivg4JwTi9GFvJZCVWLceJvZuEhMqsmqUYH.JPG) Next is the okra and pallang or winged beans, in English. -----
> ![28.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeFpMYpbtihm1jbCNfR1T9bZ8334Cehre7iuSHCiFQwMUnkQvG9xTy8sF3xYKmnhi8.JPG) Then I added the patani or lima beans. -----

> ![30.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EonmSyNMyvCkdHphqpbXwx31byj5BEosAUs1b4nhf8KG9zx4etxUGHy5PnJBhTbwvgS.JPG) Then I added last the small bitter gourd and green chilis. -----

> ![32.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eou9hd7xLnMpgHoUr8SMFNbWqURicZLaEwByBtwEB8mpfFjhnaiNP2m4zQ6QozvEkvt.JPG) Let it cook for about 5-7 minutes at medium to high heat. This is what it looks like after the color is so appetizing, which is the reason why using a lot of tomatoes is the best thing. -----

> ![34.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eo6MMTkVefdzrBrcdKBcSgzM21t5zWNmBi5nD8wJhfpq5TWVqSRHC98sK1DMTLbuiyc.JPG) Then serve hot and plated. Here is the close for you to see it more! hehe. ----

> ![36.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiXZF6bhsC5FaThYYHcUFjcyhrz71m4hDBNsSKzHpGAG7Q69wZU1Tt9tfMtdgsf59P.JPG) The green chilis look delicious! ----- ![37.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiXDbJ2AwAoXQYkhrvDvs1ijhxSfieejpnr3i1HH2Ecze2BnxADi4tdFS6oFeZp4fq.JPG) Happy eating! :D ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))

body.title: The Fear That Stayed: My Experience with PTSD
body.body: Post-traumatic stress disorder has affected a lot of people mentally, emotionally, socially and even in their daily life. PTSD causes a lot of anxiety and fear of unsafe, especially when you find yourself in a similar situation. Being in a similar situation can trigger flashbacks, fear and even anxiety. The effects of trauma can be really overwhelming, cause permanent damage to the mind, even when it doesn't show a visible scar. I have experienced post traumatic stress disorder and I also know people who have also struggled with PTSD after a traumatic event. ![f3ae3b9f-09bb-4c2d-9e2b-de67a5c4b1f2.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd5MbhsHnnTmAejMgJVTqmjvAVvKsd8BDfbdcv4nPE4yB/f3ae3b9f-09bb-4c2d-9e2b-de67a5c4b1f2.png) A friend once told me that she couldn't take a bike as a means of transportation. After she almost lost her life due to an accident, she said each time she tries entering a bike, she will always remember the incident, get really anxious and to overcome a fear like this takes time. Another friend told me she is scared of walking when it's raining because she almost drowned in an open drainage when it was raining. PTSD really causes harm to lot of people, it restricts them from certain activities due to fear of reoccurrence and past trauma. The damage might not be visible like an injury, but the harm it caused to the emotion lasts longer and sticks to our memory for long. ![b48895c8-689a-4747-a893-e4676fe7ff3d.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdT7P6zDFc3o4q94yptDyrYXrQMY6UgtKTKf8We1GSnHF/b48895c8-689a-4747-a893-e4676fe7ff3d.png) One of the traumatic things that has ever happened to me as a teenager that still affects me till date is being chased by a dog. It all happened during a lonely and quiet afternoon. I was coming back from school alone because my class had practicals and I couldn't go back with my siblings. A few streets to my house, one of the compound gates along the street was wide open. Obviously, a car just drove out, and the security man was far from the gate. While approaching, I didn't notice the dog wasn't chained and nobody was ahead of me. I walked innocently to the gate side and immediately saw this mighty security dog. Out of fear, I screamed loud and started running carelessly. The huge dog began to chase me too. Before the owner and the security man could call back, I had already run into a stagnant water, drenched my uniform, bag and books. I was breathing so fast, I couldn't move anymore and was facing a very huge dog in so much fear. That particular day passed, but to me the memory never passed away, it's still very fresh in my head. Even tilldate, I'm scared of dogs, even the smallest dog scares me. ![09a530b0-f18a-4b7d-9561-67a5ba0723fb.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQU9PpHHHkz2aUPDoKYBhpZTLUpZzNtpiJqJTNncuf1Jt/09a530b0-f18a-4b7d-9561-67a5ba0723fb.png) The incident with the dog, traumatizes me to date and I can't even consider having a dog as a pet in the future, because I'm extremely scared of dogs and been trying to overcome the fear. That memory lives rent free in my head. Still affects me like it happened yesterday. Sometime last year, my cousin's visited our compound with their dog and the dog was friendly, but I couldn't get close. My heart kept pounding in fear because I was scared it could chase me or even bite out my flesh, considering the size of the mouth. PTSD made me terrified of a friendly animal that stays around humans, and it's going to take time and effort to overcome a fear like this, but hopefully I will. PTSD can affect anyone regardless of age, gender or even background. Although there could be healing for support, finding a way to cope and overcome trauma, the process might not be easy or immediate. Pictures are generated through ChatGPT. ### Thanks for reading ♥️ ### Vanilla 💗

body.title: Google I/O 2026
body.body:
# Google I/O 2026 – Was das für Unternehmen bedeutet, die noch auf KI warten

Ein Kollege aus meinem Netzwerk, Christian Spanik, hat mich diese Woche auf die Google I/O 2026 aufmerksam gemacht. Ich habe mir die komplette Keynote angesehen – knapp zwei Stunden. Und ich sage ehrlich: Es gibt wenige Tech-Events, die mich so nachdenklich zurückgelassen haben.

Nicht wegen der Technologie an sich. Sondern wegen der Konsequenzen für Unternehmen, die KI-Einführung noch als optionales Zukunftsprojekt behandeln.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcMajn1fnk8qyDN3NavN8F1HYoP77SQS9yW6NR2oq5Fnd/fdfbfd06_c735_47e3_acf8_6046ff7989bc.png)

-----

## Was Google konkret gezeigt hat

Die Google-Suche wird zur Antwortmaschine. Keine zehn blauen Links mehr – sondern fertige Dashboards, die auf Basis einer einzigen Suchanfrage generiert werden. Text, Video, interaktive Animationen. Alles in Echtzeit, alles personalisiert.

Dazu kommen KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen – Informationen zusammenführen, Mails entwerfen, Einkäufe durchführen, tagelang nach dem besten Angebot suchen, ohne dass der Nutzer eingreifen muss.

Fast alles davon kommt laut Google bis Sommer in den Markt. In Deutschland möglicherweise etwas später – aber die Richtung ist gesetzt.

-----

## Was das mit Copilot zu tun hat

Direkt: nichts. Indirekt: alles.

Was bei der Google I/O gezeigt wurde, ist kein isoliertes Google-Thema. Es ist ein Symptom einer Geschwindigkeit, die den gesamten Markt erfasst. Wer heute noch überlegt, ob KI-Tools wie Microsoft Copilot „wirklich notwendig” sind, übersieht, dass die Frage nicht mehr lautet:

> „Wollen wir das?”

sondern:

> „Wie schnell können wir aufholen?”

Ich erlebe das in meiner täglichen Arbeit mit Mittelstandsunternehmen. Die größte Bremse ist nicht Technologie – sie ist verfügbar. Die größte Bremse ist die interne Kompetenz: Niemand weiß, wie man anfängt. Niemand weiß, welche Use Cases wirklich etwas bringen. Und niemand will Geld für Lizenzen ausgeben, die dann ungenutzt bleiben.

-----

## Was strukturierte Einführung konkret bedeutet

Eine Copilot-Einführung, die funktioniert, startet nicht mit 50 Lizenzen für alle. Sie startet mit:

- einem **Pilotbereich**
- einem **klaren Use Case**
- einem **Feedback-Loop**, der zeigt, was wirklich hilft

Dann wird skaliert. Nicht vorher.

Das klingt unspektakulär. Ist es auch. Aber es ist der Unterschied zwischen einem Projekt, das nach 90 Tagen als gescheitert gilt – und einem, das intern als Erfolg wahrgenommen wird und weiteres Budget bekommt.

-----

## Meine Einschätzung

Die Unternehmen, die jetzt anfangen – auch wenn es klein ist – bauen eine Kompetenz auf, die in 12 Monaten entscheidend sein wird. Nicht weil KI alles verändert. Sondern weil die Konkurrenz nicht wartet.

Was Google diese Woche gezeigt hat, ist kein Ausblick mehr. Es ist ein Seismograph. Der Ausschlag war deutlich.

-----

*Ich begleite Mittelstandsunternehmen bei der strukturierten Einführung von Microsoft Copilot. Wer darüber reden möchte, wie das konkret aussehen kann: Ein erstes Gespräch ist kostenlos.*

👉 [Erstgespräch buchen](https://calendly.com/michael-reischer/erstgesprach)

body.title: Surviving a Brutal Splinterlands Brawl
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaj3vrGRtKW3VnMqCFQd8CiVRheV2UH7axDbTcrHKhdNd/brawl_thumbnails.png)




Greetings, fellow **Splinterlands warriors!**

Brawls in Splinterlands sometimes feel like a football match. There are days when you walk off the field with your chest puffed out after a massive win—and then there are days when all you can do is scratch your head and admit, *“Yeah… my opponent just wanted it more.”* And this week? I’m firmly in that second category.

Still, I wanted to drop by, say hello, and keep everyone fired up. The season is getting more intense, with new strategies popping up and card lineups becoming harder to read by the day. But honestly, that’s where the real fun of Splinterlands lies. If everything were predictable, we’d all be bored a long time ago.

Now, from a guild perspective, this brawl was actually solid. **ClaNFT** managed to hold its ground near the top of the leaderboard. But on a personal level, I’ve got to be real—this week, my strategy missed the mark more often than it hit.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRyE8zysQYpFkWh9NxQscSzUuXVUVH55KmE66zSie8Qni/all.png)</center>


As usual, I was assigned to **Fray 12**—feels like a permanent position at this point. I played 6 actual battles, carefully planning each lineup. On top of that, I got 3 automatic wins because the opposing guild left slots empty. But out of those 6 real matches? I only managed to secure *one* clean win in the arena.

The rest? Yeah… I had to admit defeat.

So the final tally: **4 wins and 5 losses.** Not exactly embarrassing, but definitely not banner-worthy either.

That performance earned me **12 points** for the guild.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYvsth8eZCcVMFPQBRvRPLHr7Wtv6LyuH8g3nxsdb3UF1/my_battles.png)</center>


Thankfully, ClaNFT delivered where it matters. We secured **2nd place** overall in the brawl. That’s still a big deal, considering our main goal is consistently staying in the top three.

And the rewards? Still pretty sweet:

*The guild has won spoils of 49 Crowns in the latest brawl! Also, each fully participating member was awarded 2,450 Merits and players with a spellbook were awarded 23.144 staked SPS.*

Not bad at all—great for stacking up SPS and easing the pain of those strategic misplays.

Out of all my battles this week, there’s really only *one* I’d proudly showcase and say, *“Yep, I still know how to play this game.”*

It was a **14 mana cap match**. Low mana battles always hit different—you’ve got to think like you’re budgeting at the end of the month. Every point counts, and nothing can go to waste.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUpPrq9pMeFxMRKcy1QXfonxGfGUw5fTCwbiaVzWz1Qi/brawl.png)


With such tight constraints, I could only bring in two main monsters. One of them? **Katrelba Gobson.**

Honestly, I hesitated when picking that lineup. In low mana matches, one wrong move and it’s over before you even get going. But Katrelba Gobson proved exactly why players fear seeing her on the battlefield.

She moved like a debt collector who knows your exact address. Once she started attacking, the opponent had no breathing room. Her **Bloodlust** stacked quickly, and just like that—the momentum completely flipped in my favor.

That’s when it hit me: sometimes the best victories aren’t the biggest ones—but the ones where a simple strategy executes perfectly.

If you want to see Katrelba Gobson in action, check out the battle here:
<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_6u6M8sqXaAd3Ar1EeuRs?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>


Moments like this are also why joining a guild is so important, especially for newer players. You don’t just learn from your own wins—you grow from shared experiences. Sometimes, a single tip from a guildmate can completely change how you approach the game.

One big lesson I learned this week: **never get too comfortable with old strategies.** The meta evolves. Other players improve. If you don’t keep learning, you’ll end up watching others win instead of claiming victories yourself.

But that’s Splinterlands for you.

Some days you win with a grin.
Some days you lose with a long sigh.
And somehow… you still log in again tomorrow.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)

Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___


If you already joined the splinterlands, and are looking for a place to grow. We need **YOU**. We are a chill, social guild looking for a few more active members! If you think you might be a fit, join us in our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/5u638vHPVh)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAXaBtYPQQcQ4fDb2DMaFETkzmZ5DNhevYHW4pANVaM2/banner.png)</center>

body.title: Cheese and Oat Empanadas (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> For breakfast, I made some delicious white cheese empanadas, but I tweaked the traditional recipe by adding oat flour to the dough—a unique touch that gave them great flavor and an excellent texture, perfect for keeping them from falling apart. I also added plenty of cheese so that every bite would be a treat.
![1000117104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/2423q4TCLTRyGkAZiHRWJmrLzpQeEzMeHb6YkXHiJpQvkbx4yZP4vw5smQ6yKszRSeB1w.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 100 grams of corn flour - 50 grams of oat flour - 2 tablespoons of wheat flour - 2 tablespoons of sugar - Hard white cheese for grating - Pinch of salt - 2 cups of water - Oil
![1000117077.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wWpXGKVMbUvk1JqcQYbM6Nv5k73kHDFDMAgKZzQFSNbyoqXJrBAWNeUVKrNCNXmRUiU.jpg)
## Preparation: I placed two cups of water, the salt, sugar, and cornmeal in a bowl and mixed them thoroughly. The mixture had a rather pleasant sweetness to it. Then I added the oat flour and continued mixing. Finally, I added the wheat flour.
![1000117080.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/242DLer69DTwxRt71iYTpm5J9erM3siRhT8A4RKr2dSjcT4vbSqG7svn6iNSGrno1KJjk.jpg)
![1000117084.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wC1HdhTzk2j9CQxeXGHHexsRSd3HVKHAYmNXeVx2upTDuCGgxMZQj7Szzt6WTCnumVD.jpg)
The next step was to spread a portion of the dough onto a bag, grate enough cheese, and seal the empanada. I repeated this process six times. I left the edges rough so they would be crispy.
![1000117087.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wMcb6hmmuRddhK1DLuscBcjKKbWJi3uBNa85krqRwznX8tQX7F3saZCoRFoJ39hpHAG.jpg)
Then I heated a skillet in the kitchen with enough oil and fried the empanadas in it. They turned out golden brown, with the perfect texture for this type of dough. You could really taste the oats; I liked adding this twist as a variation on a classic recipe. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Para mi desayuno preparé unas deliciosas empanadas de queso blanco, pero modifiqué la receta tradicional agregando harina de avena a la masa, un toque único que aportó buen sabor y una excelente consistencia, perfecta para que no se rompan. Además, les agregué bastante queso para que cada mordisco fuera una delicia.
![1000117104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/2423q4TCLTRyGkAZiHRWJmrLzpQeEzMeHb6YkXHiJpQvkbx4yZP4vw5smQ6yKszRSeB1w.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 100 gramos de harina de maíz - 50 gramos de harina de avena - 2 cucharadas de harina de trigo - 2 cucharadas de azúcar - Queso blanco duro para rallar - Pizca de sal - 2 tazas de agua - Aceite
![1000117077.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wWpXGKVMbUvk1JqcQYbM6Nv5k73kHDFDMAgKZzQFSNbyoqXJrBAWNeUVKrNCNXmRUiU.jpg)
## Preparación: En un envase coloqué dos tazas de agua, la sal, el azúcar y la harina de maíz, amasé muy bien. La mezcla quedó con un dulzor bastante agradable. Luego añadí la harina de avena y seguí mezclando. Finalmente agregué la harina de trigo.
![1000117080.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/242DLer69DTwxRt71iYTpm5J9erM3siRhT8A4RKr2dSjcT4vbSqG7svn6iNSGrno1KJjk.jpg)
![1000117084.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wC1HdhTzk2j9CQxeXGHHexsRSd3HVKHAYmNXeVx2upTDuCGgxMZQj7Szzt6WTCnumVD.jpg)
El paso siguiente fue extender una porción de la masa sobre una bolsa, rallar suficiente queso y cerrar la empanada. Repetí este procedimiento seis veces. Dejé las orillas rústicas para que quedaran crujientes.
![1000117087.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wMcb6hmmuRddhK1DLuscBcjKKbWJi3uBNa85krqRwznX8tQX7F3saZCoRFoJ39hpHAG.jpg)
Después monté un sartén en la cocina con suficiente aceite y allí freí las empanadas. Quedaron doradas, una textura perfecta para este tipo de masa. La avena se dejaba sentir, me gustó añadir esta novedad como una variante de una receta clásica.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: When Industrial Risk Meets Corporate Priorities
body.body:
![Screenshot 2026-05-24 at 9.32.31 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/23yTjGbQ76ezpgTUzv1BAExr8uZdrXZQ2jnW7AGbffz4w5wB3UmGyMpL9xmPYY8F4eBDZ.png)

A growing crisis in Garden Grove has forced tens of thousands of people from their homes, exposing not just the dangers of industrial chemicals, but the deeper question of whether corporate priorities are compromising public safety.

At the center of the emergency is a leaking, overheating chemical tank at an aerospace facility, believed to contain thousands of gallons of methyl methacrylate which is a volatile, flammable substance used in plastics manufacturing. Officials have warned that the tank could either rupture and spill toxic material or explode, triggering a worst-case scenario for surrounding communities.

Evacuation orders have impacted roughly 40,000 to 50,000 residents across multiple cities in Orange County, with authorities scrambling to contain a situation that, by their own admission, may be impossible to fully control.

![Screenshot 2026-05-24 at 9.32.38 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/23xAgN7VVeqa7JDKkjwg612vWVToBvKEcktTa6j4BcRW3EHyhs7fqz1eq64qztYqqbcfT.png)

While the immediate cause appears to be a malfunctioning tank possibly linked to damaged valves and overheating. The bigger issue is systemic. Industrial facilities handling dangerous chemicals operate under layers of regulation, but those rules often bend under economic pressure. This isn’t just about one faulty tank. It’s about an entire system that allows high risk materials to be stored near dense populations, often with aging infrastructure and limited transparency. Officials have said the tank became unstable after a valve failure prevented safe pressure release or removal of the chemicals. That raises a critical question: why was a system handling such hazardous material vulnerable to a single point of failure?

The uncomfortable reality is that safety systems cost money and in many industries, they are treated as expenses to minimize rather than investments to prioritize. Companies handling hazardous materials are constantly balancing maintenance costs vs. profit margins, upgrades vs. quarterly earnings and redundancy vs. efficiency. I have seen it first hand and too often, that balance tilts in the wrong direction.

Greetings to all Actifitters! I hope you enjoy a nice, relaxing Sunday, and find some time to post an Actifit report, that is kill two birds with one stone, as they say. Speaking of killing, did you know that today is International Women's Day for Peace and Disarmament? I like this idea, and yes, women can and must have an active role in establishing peace both regionally and globally. On the other hand, it was a woman, Helen of Troy, whose abduction by Paris led to the Trojan War. Of course, there was another woman, Lysistrata, the key character in one of Aristophanes's comedies, who tried to put an end to the Peloponnesian War by persuading other women not to go to bed with their warrior spouses, as a form of sanction. Can you imagine this happening today? For example, Russian and Ukrainian, as well as Jewish and Palestinian, women doing the same thing. It sounds funny, but this could be a far more effective way to end conflict than economic and other sanctions and measures.
