body.title: Not Every Crypto Trader Becomes a Millionaire || The Truth About Crypto Trading After 8 Years in the Market
body.body: > I have been trading crypto regularly for over eight years. Apart from that, I am also observing the crypto market very deeply. But I have not achieved any success yet and I can say that I have accumulated a lot of wealth from crypto trading. There is nothing like that. I hear, am hearing and am hearing many stories that a person bought $100 worth of crypto and today he has become a millionaire. Similarly, there are many stories and behind these stories, we also have a story that I have seen the rise and fall of the crypto market in eight years. I will not say eight years, but I have been in the crypto market since 2014. But when I stepped into the crypto market regularly, it was the year 2016. Before 2016, I had many coins that are worth thousands of dollars today, but at that time I did not know about their importance and trade and the market, how we sell them, how we buy them. There are some who buy it and others who live in the country where we live, we had no knowledge about it at all, nor did we have any facilities to trade it. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR9yGKrKJUBdXB6ttv3oN6B9ygYEwXqVb8z3krUoGRcP7/image.png) When I entered the crypto market regularly in 2016, there was an exchange called Bittrex that allowed Pakistani citizens to create accounts, but then it also started blocking Pakistani people, and we took our assets out of that exchange and transferred them to whatever exchange was available, but we only suffered losses. Apart from that, if I talk about my crypto story, in 2013, when I was researching online working, how to earn online, then Bitcoin was very easy to find. I collected Bitcoin. I spent many hours clicking on pay-to-click websites and the first currency I earned through those pay-to-click websites was Bitcoin. But I did not even realize that this Bitcoin would one day be worth millions of dollars. But if I talk about hackers in cryptocurrency, the first account I had hacked was Bitcoin, and that was the year The time when the hacker hacked my Bitcoin was in 2017 or 2016 17 or 2018, so if we talk about Bitcoin, I had earned Bitcoin in the early stages, but the hacker hacked my Bitcoin account in the early stages, and thus it must have become clear to you that the hacker has been hacking and stealing Bitcoin not from today but from 11-12 years ago. I don't know how my account was hacked, but my email address at that time was also hacked, but I have been using that email address later, but I am still surprised that the hacker knew about its importance. Whatever the Bitcoin prices were at that time in 2017 16, you all know, you can track the market. Then the hacker hacked many of my cryptocurrencies and my accounts that were hacked were due to ignorance or lack of information about which things I should keep secret and which I should make public. But despite this, I will say that hackers are very big, very intelligent, it is very difficult to avoid them. Try not to be in the eyes of hackers. When you are not in the eyes of hackers, you will feel like you are safe. So I will say that the hacking that is happening in cryptocurrency today, hackers are active. It was active even then. But what I want to say and write here is that people have met, how do they become rich from cryptocurrency? How do people earn millions of dollars by investing hundreds of dollars? I have invested almost hundreds of dollars in futures and hundreds of spot trades, but I have not become a millionaire yet. I have bought many coins at high prices. I bought them at a low price too, but one thing comes to mind: Can cryptocurrency make you or me a millionaire? Those people who are now entering cryptocurrency are entering with the thought that they will earn millionaires or millions of dollars from here by investing just $1,000. So I am observing and sharing these things. I am writing here in the style of a conversation with you all. Is it possible? Yes, it is possible. How is it possible? I will also write a few lines on this and I also want your comments. I would like to write this very briefly here according to my experience that if you are new or old like me and you have not earned a million dollars yet, then don't worry, continue your journey. But when a person continues his journey, he has a thought, a goal. You have to set a standard that how many million dollars you want to earn and how much investment you are making to earn that million dollars. When you keep this in mind, then you have to weigh your investment and your profit. In this weighing, no one is telling you to take a weighing tool, but you have to think that if you are investing 1000 dollars, do you want to make a million dollars in 1000 days with that 1000 dollars, do you want to earn in one day or do you want to consider that 1000 dollars as your investment and earn from it? This is a thought that you have to create, which you have to keep in your mind because when you invest 1000 dollars, you You must have heard from many people that you can earn $1,000 to $1,000 in a single day. This is both true and false. I will never tell you to move forward with this mindset. Rather, you have to develop a long-term mindset that will protect your investment and allow you to reach your destination with a safe journey. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUW6AmXqjBgUPCmkG3RCgSnmfjZq51LMUCj8PnokNKwiF/image.png) If you ask me, I am telling you all these things from my experience. This is a thought that arises in humans and this thought arises only when a person travels and sees the situations during this journey. Never consider yourself an expert in trading, rather you have a new perspective on the market every day. When you physically go to the market in any fair, you meet different people there with different thoughts, be it crypto or forex trading. The situation is the same in all of them. Here, some people have millions of dollars, some have millions, billions, trillions of dollars and they use their millions and trillions of dollars. But you have not looked at the million and trillion dollar investor, but you have to see that the wealth you have, which is one thousand dollars, 100 dollars, 50 dollars, you have investments. You have to look at people of this level in the market that you have to consider 100 dollars as 100 dollars, but rather than people with 100 to million dollars. You should not trade or follow their thinking, but you should invest your $1000 as $1000 because when you think that your $1000 will bring you $10000 in a single day or in a few days, then you will go to that level to achieve this goal, but since your investment is low, then you are bound to fall. You are weak. You are not gambling here, but you have come to trade. You have to understand the difference between trading and gambling. If you want to gamble, then you will fail even with a million dollars. If you want to trade, then you have to trade with people of your own level, not with $100 million. I want to make it clear to you that trading, whether it is forex, crypto, stocks, whatever kind of trading you do, you can be successful. If you don't know anything about trading, you can still be successful. You can even become the most successful trader. But we have to change our thinking. We have to keep the same thinking that trillion-million dollar investors have. But we have to play at our own level. I have $100, so if I am making a profit of $10 on that dollar within 24 hours or 48 hours, why am I not booking this profit? Why am I saying that I should not close this trade at $10, but I should earn 100 on 100. You can earn 100 on 100, but it will not be safe. Rather, the trade that you have been able to win with a profit of $10 in 24-8 hours can also lose you at any moment. The same trade can go down by $10, but my purpose in writing this is not that you should not make more profit, but my purpose in writing this is that neither you nor anyone else knows about the market. Yes, we can have some ideas about the market. By looking at some indicator candles, we can guess which direction the market is going. We can find the trend. But sometimes in finding this trend or entering it, we ourselves become our own trend. So what I am trying to say is that if you get $10 from $10 in 48 hours, then you should save it and then you should take another trade, whether after two days or three days or at the same time. Then you should set a goal that when, how and at what position I have to take the trade and how much loss I have to make and how much profit I have to make. This thinking will take you forward, not the thinking that is based on gambling thinking will never take you forward. I will tell you one word, that word is what hunters do. A hunter never enters the crowd of prey, but waits for the prey to come on this path. So I will ambush and hunt my prey from here. Similarly, you have to be a hunter in trading and not be a prey yourself. Because when you become a hunter and enter the trade, wherever you set a trap, wherever you sit waiting for the prey, the prey will definitely come there. Because you have to find the paths of the prey as a hunter. When does the prey come to this place on these paths, how long does it take or how often does it come? You have to see this with candles, you have to see this with indicators, you have to see this with your own observation. Because when you go to any field to hunt, it is essential to examine this field. You will see where the prey lives in it. Only then will you be successful. When you become a hunter and trade, then you have to find the prey through its paths. They will catch, they will hunt, that's why I believe that every trader is a hunter and here in the market there are big hunters sitting who hunt big hunters. Their target is not a trade or a product or a token that has to be moved up and down. Rather, there are big hunters in the market whose target is to hunt the hunters who come to this market in this forest and they also set traps for them and leave the prey for them in the forest. They leave them in the market. When the hunter moves to catch the hunter, that hunter himself becomes the prey. So you can understand all these things only when you trade hundreds of times with your own hands and observe the market. You will not enter with the thought that I have to earn 100 dollars to 1000 dollars, but you have to learn, understand, hope you have understood my words. [thumbnail source, edit AI canva](canva.com)

And there is no better place for me to be at I suppose.  At least im getting some extra hours this week, which serves to help cover the Towing expense from last week. Soon....

The Hallway here, is always ome of my favorite spots to take some pictures.  Its early morning here, my study is already done, and the patient just left.

body.title: [Eng./Esp.]   Confessions of a ‘burden’ who stopped producing.   ||   Confesiones de un \
que dejó de producir.
body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
***

> Just yesterday, my neighbour—a young bloke from Toronto who dashes from his Tesla to his front door as if the air were thick with debt (I’ve always thought that of him)—told me this. He saw me pruning the rose bushes at seven in the morning, under this pale Ontario sun that never quite warms the bones like the one back home in my village—Venezuela. He said it as a compliment, with that automatic smile of someone who believes a man’s worth is measured in horsepower or the thickness of his wallet. —***“So productive”***, he repeated. And I, who have already carried seventy years on my back, felt a shiver that wasn’t due to the weather.
# ***
Confessions of a ‘burden’ who stopped producing
*** In English, the phrase sounds clean, sterile, almost a secular blessing. But in my Spanish, in the language that gave me birth back down south, that word —productivity— drags a string of insults behind it. I grew up hearing that anyone who doesn’t “produce” isn’t a man, but a “good-for-nothing”, a “lazy bum”, a “good-for-nothing”. From the moment we open our eyes, they place an invisible ruler on our foreheads. If you move to the right, you’re an economic success; if you slip to the left, you’re —forgive my honesty, but at my age I no longer use filters— ~~a piece of shit~~.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/245T5jrGgtgHBjghJcgriA9kzNU6aatySXb7QRpZb9fwkTCsqTjyUD568YTufjSYXh2QV.jpeg)
I’ve spent half my life in Canada trying to escape that rule, only to realise that here the rule is set in stone and is ingrained in the DNA of Anglo-Saxon culture. Here you are not a person; you are an ‘asset’. If you produce, you exist; if you stop producing, you become invisible, a ghost wandering the aisles of a supermarket hoping the cash machine won’t ask for more than you can give. I refuse. At seventy years of age, I decided long ago to break the rule. I was raised to believe that my life was an assembly line. Politicians who used us as employment figures —they still do—, religions that promised us heaven in exchange for ‘decent work —and the weekly tithe—’ that broke our backs, and an economic system that taught us to compare our home with our neighbour’s. They made us believe that being **‘productive’** was a moral virtue, when in reality it is just a magic trick to keep us quiet and busy. What am I producing today? I am producing silence. I am producing the pleasure of watching dew slide down a maple leaf. I am producing a three-hour conversation with a stranger in the park, without seeking to close a deal, without “networking”.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23wMgfmrx79ANXperVLUSpPrjrrbCfqtpuWrJGEKPVNVXyLz4ZKtySAgyBYBDYzkvvMPs.jpeg)
For Latin culture, which still judges us if we aren’t ‘giving it our all’ or ‘working our fingers to the bone’, my contemplative old age is almost a sin of betrayal. For Anglo culture, steeped in the fetish of performance and *hustle culture*, my lack of interest in success is an anomaly in the system, a software glitch —I’ve always felt like an alien—. We’ve been deceived. They made us believe that life is measured by what comes out of our hands and not by what enters our soul. They taught us to fear “shit”, without realising that the real rubbish is living by timing the heart. Yesterday, when my neighbour said to me “so productive”, I was on the verge of telling him *my truth*. I wanted to say: *“No, George, I’m not being productive. I’m wasting time gloriously. I’m a hindrance to progress. I am, at last, alive\
no, George, no estoy siendo productivo. Estoy perdiendo el tiempo gloriosamente. Estoy siendo un estorbo para el progreso. Estoy, por fin, vivo\
That might be a 4. Both physically and emotionally. Some health situations I've battled for years are to blame, like chronic depression, which I'm managing with drugs.

body.title: Happy moments at a small simple cafe with my family.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaq9bfqFSvF1cpmphs9Hi6tbZG38JC66v29bp4FXs3nwD/1779611525926.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. The simple joy of my family, sometimes the best moments are just sharing a simple meal together. Even though my wife and I can't take our autistic son out to eat or have snacks, And including our daughter who works in other provinces. But we enjoy taking our granddaughter out and getting food or snacks together. 
Our district is packed with countless cafes, each offering its various vibe. There's a small cafe with a simple vibe in my district. And we had the opportunity to take our granddaughter to this cafe. This simple, small cafe is called Cha Ka Pang & Nom Sod. It's located in the downtown. Besides wanting to take my granddaughter to this cafe, I also wanted to share and recommend it.

This cafe sign and the vibe outside. This cafe is located along the main road (Highway 107, Chiang Mai - Fang route).
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXTidu9wwTvv7gUTJtUZW1TMhYUVoJZHdre8j3Y3btxSn/1779611526261.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQqwMeYMR66SqwKDYUy4rjrANND4KsrKEKHZBnDhw1Yh3/1779611526043.jpg)

This cafe has a simple and comfortable vibe. And it is decorated with very little decoration. Customers can choose to sit in two areas : indoors or along the main road outside. The customer seating areas have no air conditioning, but only fans-cooled.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaPUV7rs5vCRU3d2R8kyc4Pdmj4z6wh4TiaNwdwfM1usP/1779612634324.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWd2a39rXDKmMGEiRPBfudhMwz2vxS9rayEefqJPHw1sg/1779612634202.jpg)

There is a free kids' play area and toys available.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVMsuZiXrwaLYkf7k4HR4bU8rCdKMdZQa2cfK3M9q7Ltd/1779612797829.jpg)

Some of the menu at this cafe.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfHt5upDE8nWARnk5XvFxwM8uMaRryzJp1tHJe1Fd5GFW/1779612797921.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSMFu4EVCFsD9dVmrTm9C4MtEVkKgwW56jcaNAJjLfMAw/1779612798011.jpg)

This cafe's menu includes drinks, various topped breads, snacks food, light bites, ice cream, bingsu and honey toast. But we ordered 2 topped breads, bread with ice cream, iced fresh milk, iced strawberry fresh milk, ice cream and bingsu.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS7bxpY9QN3HEdw6xMqyLxUFW1udWWdkHnnSGu7nKMwUU/1779613764646.jpg)

Two topped breads
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR6oxPLnrJx8VBkwFoscrLHrG7piojsnQVUEnxwV4LG13/1779613788992.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYAqXEcvZrS8SCFCBT8u11j9FTMDPr3DH4oxJbww2YoJS/1779613789043.jpg)

bread with ice cream
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVjRuQTaSEP4mKUgxbBo8BUdJ6QqZe2Y5MHRkoWEuMoxP/1779613789150.jpg)

iced fresh milk and iced strawberry fresh milk
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTqzs9ae3WFMEkNpiXXiuBw3EoGvQZereehHy1m5KUCTs/1779613764893.jpg)

ice cream 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNPMccwJm3Bi1PSwtC1zzQ5zCNzUu9voE3kYG9LC4wA3u/1779613764824.jpg)

bingsu
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT126CdKS4WPMhhtzncbEVC5WBTrfQwBV7tS65Zk6zbzM/1779613764741.jpg)

This cafe is quite delicious and it's inexpensive. If you are visiting or passing through this area and need to recharge, I would like to recommend another nice cafe. Although it's a small simple shop and not beautifully decorated. These are the stories and photos I want to share for this post. Invite everyone to see and enjoy my stories and photos. Please forgive any errors/mistakes. Have a great day. See you next time. Thank you for your support and visiting my post. Bye 🤗

🌏 Cha Ka Pang & Nom Sod Cafe is located in Chiang Mai Province, Thailand.
Open 10:00 AM - 10:00 PM.

📷 Take photo By Smartphone Vivo V30.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![TMUEgCMIPiBUDMC7_784f4fa4ac7c649192ff1ac46fdfe993.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/aellly/images/TMUEgCMIPiBUDMC7_784f4fa4ac7c649192ff1ac46fdfe993/TMUEgCMIPiBUDMC7_784f4fa4ac7c649192ff1ac46fdfe993.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天是周日，还是和往常一样，周日是不用上班的，所以就在宿舍里面休息。
我还是那个节奏，周日都会削铅笔来画画。不过今天上午睡了一大觉，等到下午才起床。
难得有个休息日，所以也就没那么紧张。给自己放松了。睡到下午才开始起来刷牙洗脸。

这一次我原本是想画一条蛇的。不过，因为工作的原因，老板找我谈事情。
等到事情解决之后，已经是来到下午3:50，已经接近4点了。
所以我才拿起了铅笔画画，只画到了4点半。我停下了手里的铅笔。

因为我必须出去外面买菜，回来做晚饭。周日是工地没有提供食物。
所以我要必须自己照顾好自己。所以你画画也就是画到这个程度停下来了。
可能会在过两天下班之后不会累了，才把这条蛇给画完。

当然还有前两天发的这一个女性。她是在抖音上面随便找到的一张截图。
因为是随便找一些人来画，所以没有固定的画画对象。就随便在抖音找。
在画这张图片的时候。同事一直在旁边跟我说话，让我无法静下心来。

![IMG20260521170359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aellly/23tmL4xUuuLd2Hk88xKG5Fnm84GA6qaHooHuSrzCgXRGsBzR9FC456M1pxXv6co8CK2Fv.jpg)

直到最后，我没有把这张图片给画完。因为我不习惯在画画的时候被人打扰。
而我的同事不知道他已经影响到我了。他一直都是在旁边找我聊天。
直到最后，我无法继续画下去，只好停下了铅笔，跟他聊了很长一段时间。

---

body.title: La presentación de Charlie - Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
> ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWXYgteEdknbdatxCkBWju8N35hqGsMVrLLYwHik6bA1G/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/banjo-ukulele-ukulele-instrument-5482933/) Charlie regresó a la escuela luego de tener unas cortas vacaciones con su abuelo y apenas sonó la campana de entrada, en lugar de ir directo al salón, caminó rápidamente hacia el aula de música. Ese lugar era una maravilla por la cantidad de instrumentos que había allí y al entrar noto un banjo, donde lo tomó y de inmediato lo hizo recordar a su abuelo. Sus dedos comenzaron a temblar al tocar las primeras notas, entonces respiró profundo y comenzó a tocar de nuevo. Las primeras notas fueron suaves, pero después la melodía fue creciendo y sus manos empezaron a moverse con rapidez y seguridad, además ahora tocaba con confianza, dejando que la música hablara por él. Todos estaba saliendo de la mejor manera y unos de sus compañeros de clase se quedaron sorprendidos por ese gran talento que tenía Charlie, donde después llegaron más estudiantes y hasta algunos profesores y en ese momento nadie decía nada, solo escuchaban. Hasta que la profesora de música comentó —Charlie tienes un talento especial— >Charlie returned to school after a short vacation with his grandfather, and as soon as the bell rang, instead of heading straight to class, he hurried over to the music room. That place was amazing because of all the instruments there, and as he walked in, he spotted a banjo; he picked it up, and it immediately reminded him of his grandfather. His fingers began to tremble as he played the first notes, so he took a deep breath and started playing again. # >The first notes were soft, but then the melody grew, and his hands began to move quickly and confidently; now he played with assurance, letting the music speak for him. Everything was going perfectly, and some of his classmates were amazed by Charlie’s great talent. Then more students arrived, and even some teachers, and at that moment no one said a word—they just listened. Until the music teacher commented, “Charlie, you have a special talent.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTtivXJTJUKYJFFwFAsjNMRbZkgAU1xazLAHHFgwuHKwm/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/persona-manos-musica-musico-7772392/) Desde ese día cada recreo Charlie iba al salón de música para practicar y allí logro aprender nuevas canciones de distintos ritmos y lo mejor es que todos comenzaron a hablar de él por toda la escuela. Hasta que un viernes la profesora de música llamó a Charlie y le dijo —Queremos invitarte a tocar en el próximo acto escolar y toda la escuela estará allí— Charlie no podía creerlo, ya que era la primera vez que tocaría frente a muchas personas. A partir de ese momento comenzó a practicar y cada noche su abuelo lo acompañaba y lo guiaba como la primera vez. Finalmente, llegó el día del acto y el lugar estaba lleno de estudiantes, profesores y familias, sin embargo, Charlie estaba detrás del escenario abrazando a su banjo esperando a que lo llamaran. Cuando escucho su nombre Charlie caminó lentamente mientras el público aplaudía, sus manos sudaban hasta subirse al escenario. En ese momento la música comenzó a sonar y Charlie tocó perfectamente cada nota, donde todos quedaron sorprendidos por ese talento. Cuando termino la última canción los aplausos comenzaron a llegar y este niño simplemente sonreía de la emoción que tenía. >From that day on, Charlie would go to the music room during every recess to practice, and there he learned new songs with different rhythms. Best of all, everyone in the school started talking about him. Then one Friday, the music teacher called Charlie over and said, “We’d like to invite you to play at the next school concert, and the whole school will be there.” Charlie couldn’t believe it, since it would be his first time playing in front of a large audience. From that moment on, he began practicing, and every night his grandfather accompanied him and guided him just like the first time. # >Finally, the day of the performance arrived, and the venue was packed with students, teachers, and families. However, Charlie was backstage hugging his banjo, waiting to be called. When he heard his name, Charlie walked slowly as the audience applauded; his hands were sweating as he made his way onto the stage. At that moment, the music began to play, and Charlie played every note perfectly, leaving everyone amazed by his talent. When the last song ended, the applause began, and this boy simply smiled, overcome with emotion. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNPPat6B5cNQioVbCQDTCATVgpT9nhqGhQz8CdwW1XMeT/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/naturaleza-vacaciones-picnic-campo-4127424/) La profesora de música se subió al escenario y con ella llevaba una caja roja, que era especialmente para Charlie. Charlie la abrió y dentro de ella había un banjo nuevo, brillante y hermoso. Todos aplaudieron y Charlie no podía creerlo lo que estaba pasando, donde miro hacia el público y fue directamente hacia su abuelo, quien se levantó y ambos se abrazaron, por esa gran presentación que hizo Charlie en su escuela. >The music teacher walked onto the stage carrying a red box that was especially for Charlie. Charlie opened it, and inside was a brand-new, shiny, beautiful banjo. Everyone clapped, and Charlie couldn't believe what was happening. He looked out at the audience and walked straight over to his grandfather, who stood up, and the two of them hugged, celebrating the wonderful performance Charlie had given at school.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

body.title: My favourite safe haven for relaxation? Ladies of Hive Contest #290
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUZtAsZ6peZ1PRVdwuqMWhYztqMcdcAbSTCNdc6oMXcfS/img_7090.jpg)

**Image Caption**: Sun setting on a day full of promise
**Photographer**: Me

There comes a time in every woman’s life when she no longer dreams only of diamonds, grand declarations, or being dramatically chosen in a room full of people pretending not to watch.

No.

She begins to dream of something far more dangerous.

Silence.

Not the awkward kind.
Not the “he left me on read” kind.
Not the kind that follows a family WhatsApp message nobody wants to answer.

I mean the beautiful kind.

The kind where nobody calls your name.
Nobody asks what is for dinner.
Nobody needs you to remember the thing they forgot, find the thing they lost, or emotionally translate a sentence they could have simply said with love.

My safe haven is that place.

Sometimes it is my bed, receiving me like an old friend who has seen the entire season and still claps when I arrive.

Sometimes it is the sea, rolling in and out as if God gave it permission to feel everything and keep moving.

Sometimes it is a quiet room, a cup of tea, a closed door, and the soft rebellion of being unavailable.

Because women know this truth.

We spend years being the warm centre of other people’s worlds.

We hold the birthdays.
The appointments.
The moods.
The meals.
The memories.
The missing socks.
The silent heartbreaks people do not know how to name.

And then someone says, “You should relax.”

As if rest is a button.

As if peace can be summoned on command while your mind is still hosting a full committee meeting with snacks.

So I am learning to find my safe haven before my body has to beg for it.

A small room.
A soft blanket.
A walk near water.
A moment where I am not useful.
A moment where I am simply mine.

And perhaps that is the real luxury.

Not being admired.

Not being needed.

Not being praised for how much we can carry.

But having one sacred place where we can put it all down and still feel worthy.

Signed:

A woman who finally understands that rest is not a reward.
It is a return.

#Ladiesofhive #Contest290 #Sunset

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | How do we overcome our doubts and anxieties
body.body: > https://youtu.be/3J4EEXHfIMo?si=0yAm3eJxK7uuNxp_ There are many times in my life that I have felt doubts and anxiety. Sometimes, I wonder about my future, my family, my work, my faith! Sometimes fear creeps into my heart and makes me weak or confused. But I have discovered that the process of conquering doubts and fears starts by simply choosing to trust God even if it's not obvious to me. I remind myself of God's understanding of my fears and His presence when I am alone. One thing that helps me overcome doubt is prayer. If my heart is burdened, I can speak directly to God. I'm not a man of flesh and blood. I give Him my troubles, my fears and my pain. The scripture below tells us in Philippians 4:6-7 to be not anxious about anything, but in all things by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, to present your requests to God. This verse reminded me of the fact that I should not bear my burden alone, but put it all into prayer. I feel a peace gradually coming into my heart when I pray. I also deal with doubts through clinging to God's promises in the bible. I sometimes think I'm afraid of what tomorrow may bring but I recall what God said in Isaiah 41:10 “Fear not, for I am with you.” When things are tough, this scripture brings me comfort because I know that God is always with me. I don't know what is going to happen next, but God does. One of my other things I try to do on a daily basis is to trust God gradually, day by day. I remind myself that I don't have to worry, but that I have to have faith—faith that will give me strength. 1 Peter 5:7: “Cast your cares on Him for He cares for you.” The love and safety I feel in her presence is my favorite aspect of her. I think that we have to deal with our doubts and anxieties when we can trust God, pray sincerely, and we have to remember that He does care about us.

body.body: /> the houses here in the center of town are built close together and most are quite close to the street. they are wooden and though old most of them have been modernized and insulated with new siding while keeping much of the exterior detail of the original design. it gives the place a distinct historical feel but since this is a shadow community i will not focus on the architecture other than how it pertains to the realm of shadows. the gray house with the three mailboxes is casting its shadow onto the side wall of the white house. included in that shadow are some windows in the side wall of the gray house. it is not obvious from the photo how the design of the house allows this, perhaps there is a glassed in veranda in the rear of the house. nonetheless it is certain that the sun is shining through those windows and that the wooden parts separating their panes of glass are casting their shadows onto the side of the white house since the sun is from the side and slightly behind there isn't any direct sunlight on the front wall and fence. not shown in the photo, there's another house across the street with the sun shining on it. the windows from the street front of that house are reflecting light onto the front wall and fence of the white house. the vertical wood separating the two sides of the window is called a mullion while the horizontal piece is called a transom. the moveable hinged wood surrounding the glass is collectively called a sash. though it may appear so, none of these curiously named wooden structures are casting their shadow onto the white house. quite unlike the shadow of the windows on the side wall, only the glass from across the street is reflecting light onto the otherwise completely shaded white front wall and fence.

话说昨天去参加原公司部门老总退休聚会，见到了许多久未相见的同事，甚是欣慰。

这些同事中有个女同事，胖乎乎的一个小丫头，为人特别和善，在公司时她的工位就在我的后边，经常听她在后边和另外一个女同事各种八卦聊天，我又特别爱听八股，所以我俩关系不错。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbcjpMaU2WijTz1mzYR4kR4uDjgcjgSVCBit4LBXh2UAh/image.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

后来从公司离职，我们也保持了一段QQ上的联系，再后来大家都用微信很少用QQ了，慢慢地就和她断了联系，非常遗憾。

没想到这次去那个农场，我刚停好车，前边又停过来一辆车，下车后她非常热情地喊我，我一看呦呵，这不是那个小胖丫嘛，简直是一点变化都没有呢。

到了吃饭时，她主动邀请我坐她旁边，说咱俩比较熟，有诸多话题可聊，我也乐不得地坐美女旁边。

聊天得知，在我离职两年后，她也从部门离职，去了另外一个汽车大厂，升职加薪，干得相当不错。

最让人羡慕的是，她家的小娃也相当争气，前两年以区排名第二的成绩考上了我们沈阳最好的高中之一（省实验），妥妥地人生赢家呀。

话说我们把在座的诸位同事挨个对了一遍，发现原来就我俩不在前公司了，剩下的都在前公司混成了一方大佬，各个级别都高的吓人。

若不是有她这个也是前公司离职的同事在，我还真的会有点尴尬呢——好吧，她虽然不在前公司了，但也是新公司的大佬。

话说大佬们三五成群地聊天，我和小胖丫就在那吃吃喝喝，不过怎么小胖丫看起来比我还能吃呢？各种酒水她也都尝了一遍，我则因为开车去的，没法喝酒，呜呜呜，亏大啦。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTKZaagW2pwsqviSyjvWFbnsT2hyLRX6DCetqGoJwdH11/image.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

大家聊得都很开心，我计划等着和大队伍一起撤离，准备吃完饭再在这个农场逛一圈，多拍些照片，然后再和同事们打几圈麻将，玩几把扑克。

结果小胖丫让我和她一起撤退，之所以要早早撤退，是因为她家娃娃五点放学，要在娃娃放学之前回家。而且到了下午四五点，路上会特别堵，所以要打些提前量。

而之所以喊我呢，是因为通过聊天发现，我们住得还挺进的，其它同事都在前公司附近，在大南边。我们在大北边。她想蹭我的车回家，哈哈。

那还能说啥，必须得送呀，可这时另外一个同事让我把他也送回家，他家在大西南边，哎，要绕个大圈，不过也不好拒绝呀，都送呗。

就这样，和领导与同事匆匆告别，开始送他（她）俩回家，绕了大圈先把大西南边的同事送回去，然后送这个女同事。这时路上已经特别堵啦，开车要小心翼翼的。

突然我的手机弹出来微信视频请求，一看是老父亲打来的。我晕，我才想起来老父亲在出门旅游，我本来要给他打电话呢，但是这边一聚会，给忘到脑后了。

赶紧接起视频，告诉老父亲我在开车呢，等回家在给他打回去。然后接着开车，在同事的娃娃放学前，成功地把同事送到小区门口。

回家后稍微休息了一下，就给老父亲打了视频，告诉他我今天也出去玩了，他打视频时我正开车回家呢。

但老父亲突然严厉地问我，怎么看你车后边还带个女的？

我晕，竟然有些谴责的意味。还好我没做啥亏心事，而且带送同事回家也和媳妇说啦。好多年前公司组织一起游玩时，媳妇和这个同事玩得还挺好呢。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSF8MeKeXXDL4jxVuemwGXuLZW8RF6mAxtrqTjurT5Ao6/image.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)

和老父亲说清楚后，他才开始聊他旅游的事情啦。晕呀，这要是我没报备，或者媳妇不认识这个同事，老父亲视频这一怒斥，我岂不是跳到黄河都洗不清啦，哈哈哈。

body.title: The Sonko–Diomaye Fallout (Senegal Politics)
body.body: >If you’ve been following this whole Senegal political drama since 2024, you’ll realize this is literally the kind of storyline Netflix would turn into a political thriller 😂😂😂. So here’s the story.

>Meet Ousmane Sonko, his picture is above a fiery anti-establishment, pan-Africanist politician who eventually became the undisputed favorite of Senegal’s youth. To many young people, he represented change, rebellion against the old political order, and a fresh future for the country. Everybody expected him to become President but then the establishment struck back. Due to a defamation conviction sometime back, the government effectively blocked him from contesting in the presidential election.

>Instead of fading into the background, Sonko made a bold move. He turned to his loyal ally, a relatively unknown official named Bassirou Diomaye Faye, and he basically said: “If I can’t run, then you will.” Their entire campaign revolved around the slogan “Diomaye is Sonko.” and somehow, it worked perfectly. Senegalese youths rallied behind the movement massively. In one of the wildest political turnarounds imaginable, Diomaye Faye went from being in prison to winning the presidency outright in the first round. The moment he became President, he immediately rewarded Sonko by appointing him Prime Minister. At the time, it looked like the perfect political partnership two close allies running the country side by side.

>But then gain if history has taught us anything it is that power sharing arrangements rarely ever stay peaceful for long. Fast forward to May 2026, and Senegal is battling a serious economic and debt crisis. Behind closed doors, tensions reportedly started growing between the President and his Prime Minister. The friendship that once looked unbreakable slowly turned cold. Sonko, being the larger than life political figure that he is, clearly did not want to remain in the background. He openly declared in parliament that he was “not a Prime Minister who blindly obeys.” He pushed aggressively for radical reforms, wanted oil contracts renegotiated, and strongly opposed plans related to debt restructuring.

>Meanwhile, President Diomaye Faye appeared to increasingly assert his authority, reminding everyone that ultimate executive power rests with the presidency. Recently, he even hinted publicly that if trust between them collapsed, the Prime Minister could be removed. Then came the political earthquake. On May 22, 2026, the President reportedly issued a sudden decree dissolving the entire government. Not just Sonko the whole cabinet was wiped clean in one move and Sonko’s reaction? Surprisingly calm. He even took to social media with a sarcastic post saying: “Praise be to God… tonight I will sleep with a light heart.” 😂

>Now, most people would assume this means Sonko’s political career is over. But honestly? This development may actually play right into his hands. Just weeks earlier, on May 9, Senegal’s parliament passed controversial electoral reforms that narrowed the kinds of criminal convictions capable of disqualifying someone from running for President. The reforms reportedly focused mainly on economic crimes. That is significant because Sonko’s old defamation conviction no longer prevents him from contesting future elections.

>Which means this entire fallout could become the perfect political reset for him. By leaving government now, Sonko can distance himself from the country’s worsening economic situation, criticize the administration from the outside, and essentially say that he tried to go in a different way to save the Senegalese economy but the executive power ultimtely rests with the President and he couldnt do anything and he can then rebuild his image once again as the anti establishment figure the youth originally fell in love with. It genuinely feels like the plot of a political drama series where former allies become rivals, power changes friendships, and everybody is secretly positioning for the next big election.

body.title: From JOY to WELL WASH: My Sunday Discovery on Saving More Without Sacrificing Quality
body.body:
![collage.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoneHy1zUeNLsSBuWMQkf6LtfQvrVgMFwFepePyVoum7drBMP9xHST2b3AZkiKvNzN9.jpg)

**Happy Sunday, Hive Family!** Most especially to my dear co-Filipino Hive Friends, I hope you’re all enjoying this beautiful day with smiles and gratitude. Sundays always feel like a fresh start, and today I want to share another small but meaningful step I’ve taken in my journey of cutting down expenses.

![2nd.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23yTSJdEhAL9mSvZkorG6hSM4TGMAKGkH1MKifDuUCJbPbgEr8R7YoobERBBp1bw3dRHw.jpeg)

As I’ve mentioned in my previous blogs, I’ve started making conscious changes in my household spending. One of the easiest ways to save is by shifting brands of everyday essentials. This week, I tried a new dishwashing liquid: **WELL WASH**.

![3rd.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23ywcVo94fEtRnYGrTJxL6HhiXNBcZHJqWW69AzDLnfexerftkgn7jkM7JwjaDtq9LNTc.jpeg)

At first, I was hesitant because my long-time companion in the kitchen has always been **JOY**. It’s popular, trusted, and familiar. But with the sudden change in my financial status, I knew I had to be practical.

To my surprise, **WELL WASH** never failed me! I gave it a try, and its performance is just as good as JOY. Plates, glasses, and pans came out squeaky clean, and the suds lasted long enough to finish a pile of dishes. The best part? It’s cheaper, which means more savings for me without compromising quality.

This small switch may seem simple, but it’s proof that we can find value in lesser-known brands. Sometimes, the best choices are the ones that help us balance both our needs and our budget.

**Thank you so much for reading, Hive Family.** Your support and encouragement inspire me to keep sharing these little life updates. May we all continue finding ways to thrive, even in challenging times. 💕

body.title: Rainy hibiscus autumn colour walk plus Thai fish cakes : May 23 2026
body.body:
Another grey rainy day. Best spent doing indoor stuff. Nope - not moving cupboards. That can wait till Monday. Was catching up on recovering from bad IT things the last two days. First was a new AI tool that did not work out the box. That set me back several hours on Friday getting it to work. Then the tool that I use to write peresell reports and reviews fell over. A big lesson in that story. If you are in the middle of a product launch do not update any of the software you use - wait until after the launch. And it kept raining ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3bc572bd-33c9-448f-bb14-6ea82923f6de.jpg) Did go for an umbrella walk - walked two stations down to visit a markets shop to get bread. So grey that the apartment block across the valley is not visible ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/55730fbc-77ea-444a-8ace-dcc121837edf.jpg) Maybe a hibiscus raindrops theme for the day - in pink and not snapped before ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3f2de503-f75e-4627-94c6-1a5d8dec7381.jpg) 3 apartments on one block sold since the last walk down here last week. Great location close to Killara Station but away from the Pacific Highway. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/22d634ca-c5a3-4f28-b05e-de1e561d3fa8.jpg) Interesting flower form - lily maybe ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/acf194be-a7c3-4aa1-a509-eb17db6ef06f.jpg) Back to the hibiscus raindrops theme ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/016783e0-a0bb-4e06-b8b1-bf162c885ead.jpg) And then comes along a wall of autumn colours ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6e419e82-2b74-41ad-adf1-1dd734bacd89.jpg) Tinges of autumn colours in the tips of this tree ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6a7ad126-1908-4dfd-99a4-ff07d3bf843c.jpg) Colours turning ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/efc8a89f-7648-41d3-9f38-e020d962e950.jpg) Raindrops on the strelitzia flower - my army regiment emblem - again - 6 SA Infantry ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1f32e9f3-e55b-414f-a39c-bfee5d4af6ff.jpg) Rainy day colours for Lindfield Station ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8f276771-3231-42fe-9225-c2506689749e.jpg) Advertising at the station for the local university - last photographed on campus Shopping done for dinner tomorrow. How about dinner tonight. Mynwife had the idea of making Thai fish cakes from the left over fish from yesterday ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b1f9b24a-c85f-4069-91a4-921d85bbe093.jpg) Stripped all the remaining flesh and mixed in coriander, Thai red curry paste, spring onion, chopped zucchini, fish sauce, one egg. Blitz in a food processor to make a paste. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c6656f3c-7487-4fcc-9dcc-63092cb4e647.jpg) It's a bit gooey. Fold in some rice four to get it to a workable consistency. Grab a small handful - pattie size - pop in some hot oil ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/321c6ba5-fe88-499f-bd2c-2561a1df89e5.jpg) Turn over after 4 or 5 minutes. They will flip over easily if they are browned enough underside ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cad98598-f1d4-46d9-a1bd-bcef42b82505.jpg) Browned like this. Served with sweet chilli sauce or a Thai dipping sauce. One of a few plates for our dinner - sushi made yesterday, sashimi, steamed prawn hargow and gyozas. Yum ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/11e9499c-a2ec-41de-a8e5-db32aa7058f3.jpg) Did get the IM stuff out. A browser extension that gives you access with your AI tools with a right click. body.title: Curious and striking fish sculptures on the shore of Tío Pedro beach (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
>

**<center>INGLÉS</center>**



Hello, fellow travelers around the world! It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a wonderful and blessed week. This time, I'm sharing my visit to a place near Tío Pedro Beach in Carúpano. Besides offering delicious food, it stands out for its eye-catching decorations featuring fish sculptures. As I was heading to the beach, the establishment on the shore caught my attention because of its curious sculptures. At first, I thought it was a hotel. The place is white with turquoise accents, and its excellent location offers a beautiful view of the sculptures to those passing by.

After taking a stroll around the back of the building and admiring the beautiful and charming beach, I headed towards this area to get a closer look at the sculptures. The entrance features a beautiful mural that reads \

The letters are decorated with tourist and cultural elements of this beautiful town: a boat, whales, and birds, including the scarlet ibis (Corocoras), which are abundant in this area and are one of the city's emblematic figures. The murals are colorful and typical of the region. On the letter \
part of the flag of Sucre state is visible, with its white stars on the blue stripe. The decoration also includes a lovely red heart made of flamingos, which can also be seen in the \

plaza. I liked this beautiful mural for its vibrant colors and the flamingo heart.\n\nWithout a doubt, this mural, with its vibrant colors and blue background, is a major attraction for visitors. I believe the artist considered every detail and the color palette used in the lettering to create an appealing and eye-catching design. In the background of the word \

the sun appears in red and yellow, indicating sunset. Flamingos are positioned in the corner, forming a beautiful heart with their necks. Part of the walkway leading to Tío Pedro beach is also visible.

>

**<center>ESPAÑOL</center>**


Hola,  hola amigos viajeros en todo el mundo,  es un placer saludarles deseo que tengan una excelente y bendecida semana,  en esta ocasión les comparto mi visita a un local ubicado cerca de la playa tío Pedro en Carúpano,  este además de ofrecer deliciosas comidas,  destaca por sus llamativas decoraciones con esculturas de peces,  cuando me dirigía a la playa  mencionada  me llamó la atención el establecimiento  que se encuentra en  la orilla de la playa por sus curiosas esculturas,  al principio pensé que era un hotel,  el local es de color blanco con turquesa y por su excelente ubicación ofrece una hermosa vista de las esculturas a quienes se desplazan por esta zona.

 Luego de hacer un recorrido por la parte trasera  del local,  observar la hermosa y encantadora playa,  me dirigí hacia este lugar para mirar de cerca las esculturas,  la entrada tiene un hermoso mural que dice \

,  las letras están decoradas con los elementos turísticos y culturales de esta hermosa población,  un bote,  peces ballenas,  aves, entre ellas las  Corocoras o Flamimgos, que abundan en esta zona, además constituyen una de las figuras emblemáticas de la ciudad y coloridos murales típicos de la región,  en la letra \

, se observa parte de la bandera del estado Sucre, con sus estrellas blancas en la franja de color azul, la decoración cuenta también con un lindo corazón de color rojo, formado por flamingos, estos también se pueden observar en la plaza Yo amo a Carúpano, me gustó este lindo mural por sus vibrantes colores y el corazón de flamingos. Sin duda, este mural con sus vibrantes colores y fondo de color azul, es un gran atractivo para los visitantes, creo que el artista pensó en cada detalle y la paleta de colores a emplear en la decoración de las letras para crear un atractivo y llamativo diseño; al fondo de la palabra Carúpano se observa el sol con los colores rojo y amarillo, indicando el atardecer, los flamingos se ubican en la esquina formando un hermoso corazón con el cuello, también se aprecia parte de la caminería que conduce a la playa tío Pedro ![escultura 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ywgSjfka6wwF9JF8uHH5LAkEyLecfCcfsGAorTttEYz7b79qWW6X24ZAb3gweYkWg9D.png) ![escultura 3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ynPwdVJBctuh2GVPFoTevQjJey8kkhqoh1Ai2jn7Pv8L7GzPeER4Fgdrr5fdmnFCaSp.png) ![escultura 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/488zfEAzDCxBRniigtkMr2gwDNxzi7EJbW2dj28GYB8gPtmSjrSbN88KT2SyUZNTT2.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EppKhvkdUrX8vuuUxbzVNRhrjNe3hQRZyNbHpP8R1ZLSpu7P2RzP1UCSGpWQ4xzDz6q.png) ![ESCULTURAS PECES (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xAdsr9hwwUdHnF6k3PZiQ2opSVSQfwAQ4azBjJL2a1cSLNzGVv5tgSBmc6d2j4RPNMR.jpeg) ![ESCULTURAS PECES (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Ep1UvkfbrmN32YF4CGNTew74mhg9khGUaTSDQxuFQQVkW9iLDRLCq9aeQ5iE3nxA2YF.jpeg) ![ESCULTURAS PECES (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpT3ChDLut7nXT17hitQdMHfernswdpiBzPsGYRhfYVBAh6hjbbF6mfMLPwVBJkqE1L.jpeg)

> The beautiful fish sculptures are located on posts next to the mural, forming a walkway that leads to the entrance of the establishment. They are made of concrete, and my first impression was that they were dolphins. However, the pointed mouth and fins suggest they belong to another marine family, although the tail is similar to that of a dolphin and cetaceans. Perhaps it's a mix of fish and dolphin. The important thing is that they are very striking sculptures and appear realistic due to their grayish color. They look like dolphins and yet they don't, haha, a fun little confusion. Upon closer inspection, you can see the tail, the upper and lower fins, and the zigzag-shaped dorsal fin. Here I go again with the riddle: to be honest, it's the first time I've seen this type of fin. I really don't know what animal they belong to. The eyes are very beautiful, and the sculpture blends in very well with the landscape, giving the impression that it's flying. On the other post, there is a striking fish, its scales, fins, and tail detailed. It is also made of concrete, and I liked the artist's attention to detail in tracing the lines on the fins and scales. Its mouth is open, the eye looks very nice, and it is hugging the column. Several concrete circles can also be seen, which I believe are the bubbles as it breathes.

> Las hermosas esculturas de los peces se ubican en unos postes al lado del mural, estos forman un pasillo que conduce hasta la entrada del establecimiento, están hechos de concreto y mi primera impresión fue creer que se trataba de unos delfines, pero por la forma de la boca puntiaguda y las aletas parece ser de otra familia marina, aunque la cola es similar a la de un delfín y los cetáceos, tal vez sea, una mezcla de pez con delfín, el punto importante es que son esculturas muy llamativas y parecen realistas por su color grisáceo, parecen delfines y a la vez no, jeje una pequeña y divertida confusión, observándolo de cerca se detallan la cola, las aletas superiores e inferiores y la aleta dorsal que tiene forma de zigzag, aquí voy nuevamentre con el acertijo, para ser honesta es la primera vez que veo este tipo de aletas, realmente desconozco a que animal pertenecen, los ojos se ven muy bonitos y la escultura combina muy bien con el paisaje, da la impresión que está volando. En el otro poste, se encuentra un llamativo pez y se detallan sus escamas, aletas y cola, está también hecho de concreto y me gustó la atención al detalle del artista al trazar las líneas en las aletas y escamas, tiene la boca abierta, el ojo se ve muy bonito y está abrazado a la columna, se observan también varios círculos de concreto, los cuales creo que son las burbujas mientras respira. ![ESCULTURAS PECES (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/244oWowT7yHMSbFcdyHMczbEhzsDRCbSYiBnanMuDLDpanymPQXM6iLbvqda4vYhvPvk8.jpeg) ![ESCULTURAS PECES (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23zRtPiEkEHJsbyRwtbQefNaxib5ibW5B6wjdsX3Pjs87wAhTKCZ5762yJptUwgV8Xm8B.jpeg) ![ESCULTURAS PECES (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Ep9zeDN2pEPMhNza5ArZpxCb7kc2CVursndYhJkyD2njVRJohfe5YS9A2G75m9wJqwm.jpeg) ![ESCULTURAS PECES (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Ep5kFGzUvW3PZNd24D7nYwHKPyNQu4kn9uEBK8achi4bQgXn5GuHNNP74uPiZGSXrdD.jpeg) ![ESCULTURAS PECES (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xATXrTfQSzWPCVqoDL9DaN7R4k15b5KTfzEuKjNFYwNNEF55ec6NeKhAS54M24nexDE.jpeg)

body.title: Forgive and forget, what does the bible say about it. Mcgi topic review
body.body:
Forgiveness of sins is a good thing in the life of followers of Jesus Christ. Jesus taught His followers to forgive others just as God forgives us. Forgiveness means letting go of bitterness, anger, and the desire for revenge. 

https://youtu.be/rI1_UqxSoB4?si=ixL47RCItrCk4-kr

*Ephesians 4:32, the Bible says, “Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.”*

In the bible word forgive and forget is not written there, but God told us to always forgive and forget and whenever we come to him He will always forgive us. Forgetting does not always mean losing memory of the hurt, but choosing not to continue using it against the person. The Bible encourages believers to forgive sincerely and move forward in love and wisdom. 

*Matthew 6:14, “For if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.”*

![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g050ab01f121a59867659df93d9f5b78fb72a66e54616a6265ba3513e6a730bb449f62c43d2fa8b6bdec7b7dae41b05ef4ad7564965e14a0a3d879c90cdb266e8_640.jpg)
Hoy mi caminata fue realmente emocionante. Comencé mi ruta en el parque central, donde el aire fresco llenaba mis pulmones y el sonido de las risas de niños jugando creaba un ambiente vibrante. Mientras caminaba, conocí a una mujer mayor que estaba alimentando a las palomas. Me contó que todos los días viene a este mismo lugar desde hace más de 20 años, y cada vez le gusta contarle a las aves las historias de su vida. Me pareció fascinante cómo las pequeñas cosas pueden ser tan significativas para algunas personas. Más adelante, vi a un grupo de artistas callejeros pintando un mural colorido en una pared adyacente. Había una artista joven que, con pincel en mano, estaba dando vida a un diseño que representaba la diversidad de la ciudad. Me detuve a admirar su trabajo y charlé un momento con ella. Me dijo que este mural es parte de un proyecto comunitario para embellecer el barrio y promover la inclusión. Cada día, la ciudad me sorprende con nuevas historias y conexiones, y hoy no fue la excepción. Sin duda, estas pequeñas interacciones son lo que hacen que mis caminatas sean aún más especiales. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: Recorrido matutino por la Avenida San Luis, Cumaná [Esp-Eng]
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Bendiciones abundantes y eternas para todos los miembros de esta comunidad de @worldmappin. Es un placer saludarlos y desearles un día feliz y lleno de bendiciones. Que las bendiciones de Dios inunden sus vidas. Hoy les comparto mi recorrido por la Avenida Universidad, ubicada en el sector San Luis. Comienza en el paso elevado Gran Mariscal de Ayacucho y se destaca por su proximidad a las playas de la zona. Importantes complejos turísticos, residencias y hoteles también se ubican a lo largo de esta avenida. Además, sirve como la principal vía que conecta Cumaná con el estado Anzoátegui y la hermosa localidad turística de Puerto la Cruz. Mi recorrido comenzó en la zona de los complejos turísticos y la cancha deportiva multiusos. Detrás de la cancha se encuentra la playa, y la fotografía muestra algunos de los edificios y complejos ubicados en esta avenida, así como complejos residenciales y el Gran Hotel Cumaná, un referente histórico de la ciudad.

> **
ENGLISH
** Abundant and eternal blessings to all members of this @worldmappin community. It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed day. May God's blessings flood your lives. Today I'm sharing my tour of Avenida Universidad, located in the San Luis sector. It begins at the Gran Mariscal de Ayacucho overpass and is notable for its proximity to the beaches of that area. Important tourist complexes, residences, and hotels are also located along this avenue. Furthermore, it serves as the main thoroughfare connecting Cumaná with Anzoátegui state and the beautiful tourist town of Puerto la Cruz. My tour began in the area of the tourist complexes and the multi-purpose sports court. Behind the court lies the beach, and the photograph shows some of the buildings and complexes located on this avenue, as well as residential complexes and the Gran Hotel Cumaná, a long-established landmark in the city. ![AU (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpXJaAt5Tah3qTkeJJprC4asBWHA2vN3MPyPx1j4g7uU6d6A3hDCKBDNp4u9jVjB5ij.jpeg) ![AU (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpGRBBdJ3hwUQDgTKSmPUK2rrgsBpVvCC1HdiYcYtv4mT9dqpNdtio3e6JaRKNC6WcR.jpeg) ![AU (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpA2ziCzCSe4rG5k3LEypb5jG9Aii3ZNFKwarJfBnNox74znf9sJXdoUfpuEpn5qpRx.jpeg) ![AU (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EowGdCiZNbLPBwY2HciqQKxuj44qLPXVkcecSVoPhgyETKXXDyEVJS3AAXVBj6esmeK.jpeg) ![av](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23xKraFohECgg1iahzgg3YXde7eECFqDh3FowpRXdss6vHXQrFUpzqW7wzHni4mbEJBWr.png) ![av](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23yd1vouCPYZj36yQffVe5vt7687necd8qC4eQB4rLgyGYRcJEWzgtRSpqkVif3FGaQtM.png) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> Siguiendo la ruta, observamos el conocido Cangrejo Azul, que se distingue por sus quioscos de madera que aluden a la vida marina. Este complejo cuenta con un parque infantil, restaurante, acceso a la playa, cabañas y toldos, así como una cancha de tenis para el disfrute y la recreación familiar. Visitar Cangrejo Azul siempre es una gran experiencia, ya que, además de disfrutar de las cálidas aguas de la playa, los niños tienen opciones para jugar y divertirse. La vista de esta zona es muy hermosa; se puede apreciar la playa con su precioso color azul y la variedad de plantas a lo largo del camino. Como he mencionado en publicaciones anteriores, el sector de San Luis es una larga franja costera dividida en secciones, cada una de las cuales da nombre a una playa. Muy cerca de este complejo se encuentra la oficina de Protección Civil, que brinda asistencia a los bañistas y protege las áreas acuáticas. De hecho, el punto de referencia más importante de la playa de San Luis antes de la apertura del complejo era la oficina de Protección Civil. La playa ubicada detrás de esta oficina es ideal para niños debido a sus olas suaves y poca profundidad. Siguiendo nuestro recorrido, tenemos otra vista del complejo turístico cangrejo azul, incluyendo los baños, las duchas y sus hermosos murales con cangrejos y olas del mar. También podemos ver las cabañas cerca de la playa, que ofrecen una hermosa vista del paisaje y un lugar para relajarse y observar el entorno. Más adelante, por la avenida, vemos varias palmeras, complejos hoteleros y una vista del casino militar.

> Continuing along the route, we observed the well-known Blue Crab, distinguished by its wooden kiosks alluding to marine life. This complex features a children's playground, restaurant service, beach access, cabanas and awnings, as well as a tennis court for family fun and recreation. Visiting Blue Crab is always a great experience because, in addition to enjoying the warm waters of the beaches, children have options to play and have fun. The view of this area is very beautiful; you can see the beach with its gorgeous blue color and various plants along the road. As I have mentioned in previous posts, the San Luis sector is a long coastal strip divided into sections, each giving the beach a name. Very close to the Blue Crab resort is the Civil Protection office, which provides assistance to beachgoers and protects the aquatic areas. In fact, the most important landmark for San Luis Beach before the Blue Crab resort opened was the Civil Protection office. The beach located behind this office is ideal for children due to its gentle waves and shallow depth. Continuing along, we have another view of the Blue Crab resort complex, including the restrooms, showers, and its beautiful murals featuring crabs and ocean waves. We can also see the huts located near the beach, which offer a beautiful view of the landscape and a place to relax and observe the surroundings. Continuing along the avenue, we see several palm trees, hotel complexes, and a view of the military casino. ![AU (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eos1E5jjp1FZHwhcipd2oWbTyF1n92Qfb9sf5E8G9duifpxz9Zs3phJcaAUTFcPLrGr.jpeg) ![AU (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpLfXUHrNpcoi3bifV2RBjAdEDw4Wt3NX7GJvWukAp3vVwNL3kCmSDCF3h5D6MLJ7Np.jpeg) ![AU (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eou9F5ujjqQKJh6DXLkFRArNkgc7Q79okJHGEnxWrrnXhEiD36Hc22v6p79cgW8eDPa.jpeg) ![AU (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoptrAc9bAGJjuiWTjmPaguE1PS1KcXVTU2AeyxFWF9vSpUwFvX8vGzDbdCQSGP8xvE.jpeg) ![AU (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpVBd6ZbPUtAbyj95Q7V2VNdKrP7PNUTdXAuzYHXq6PZh5wHr8eWeroKrCnLUHFdrVy.jpeg)

> Siguiendo por esta importante avenida de la ciudad, podemos apreciar el antiguo aeropuerto y su decoración isleña, compuesta por plantas, jarrones y palmeras, todo ello mantenido constantemente por la Fundación Cumaná Te Quiero. También podemos ver el logo de la Universidad de Oriente, ubicada en la intersección con la Avenida Las Industrias. En la entrada del antiguo aeropuerto, hay una escultura con el logo de la universidad y una base cilíndrica azul. Finalmente, podemos ver el paso elevado Gran Mariscal de Ayacucho, donde comenzó este recorrido. Aunque suelo transitar por esta zona, esta vez me detuve a observar con detalle los edificios, paisajes y establecimientos ubicados en esta avenida. No me había fijado antes en el logo de la universidad ni en varias de las estructuras. Desde este punto, la vista de la playa es hermosa e invita a disfrutar de sus cálidas y refrescantes aguas. Gracias por acompañarme en esta fascinante aventura.

> Continuing along this important thoroughfare of the city, we have a view of the old airport and its island decorations, which consist of grasses, vases, and palm trees, all of which receive constant maintenance from the Cumaná Te Quiero Foundation. We also have a view of the logo of the University of Oriente, located at the intersection with Avenida Las Industrias. At the entrance to the old airport, there is a sculpture with the university logo and a cylindrical blue base. Finally, we have a view of the Gran Mariscal de Ayacucho overpass, where this tour began. Although I regularly pass through this area, this time I took the time to observe in detail the buildings, landscapes, and establishments located on this avenue. I hadn't noticed the university logo and several of the structures before. From this vantage point, the view of the beach is beautiful and invites you to enjoy its warm and refreshing waters. Thank you for joining me on this fascinating adventure. ![AU (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqfFrXqk9cf2K9vyVY3HT9hQUSff7zuKCHmp9HJQbf1AY6r3D91dvZgJaM66bUJpb6s.jpeg) ![AU (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/244KLk314wa772chPTsSV8HiDi39GCRo8nGEfT6Axh1UgJL1eLguNrf7b5okQLKbv3gXC.jpeg) ![AU (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpA2a9WfkctHR2ojBLkrL43Xra1HhxsYr2qcUY4XtQuLxU48cqjPuiub19hP12wJ2ey.jpeg) ![av](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/242DGS42zh6YiJTTpmsSwAFDEadhLRszKT2kywmCzVBPBEMJG6greezHZ9YszqMTR6igH.png) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

body.title: My opinion about the movie \
// Mi opinión sobre la película \
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>






![1000253583.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/243MFksgR15xyapR2hmGzqVFufd3piE7R7FNbmUk4q3Y5AoF8XbFbmWXKy9awf1T6vw8k.jpg)






<Center>[Sources](https://www.imdb.com/es-ES/title/tt1403981/mediaviewer/rm4124347648/)</Center>



Hello, friends of #hive, and especially to the Movies&TvShows community. As always, I hope you and your family and friends are doing well. Today I’m stopping by to tell you about a movie I watched recently: “Remember Me,” or as the English title suggests, “ \

released in 2010. It’s a romantic drama directed by Allen Coulter, who seeks to transcend the genre through the weight of grief, family redemption, and a final twist that divides opinions. It stars Robert Pattinson in one of his first roles after \

![1000253588.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23uQtS29i7wa8Wxm9pptLMgJHEbVAuN5scRhQeW2eQv3uf5TGsBrb6JL4EU92Wpim2fUh.jpg)

<Center>[Sources](https://www.imdb.com/es-ES/title/tt1403981/mediaviewer/rm4124347648/)</Center>


Tyler Hawkins, the character played by Pattinson, is a rebellious, unmotivated young man scarred by a family tragedy: the suicide of his older brother, which has torn his parents—Pierce Brosnan and Lena Olin—apart and left him adrift. He works at a bookstore, lives with his best friend Aidan, played by Tate Ellington, and has a strained relationship with his father, a powerful businessman. His life changes when, following an altercation, he meets Ally Craig, played by Emilie de Ravin, a vibrant young woman who is also haunted by her mother’s murder years earlier. What begins as a relationship driven by a challenge turns into a deep romance that helps them both heal.



![1000253585.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/Eo1wpE5h687dekppatm1wSA3Ahv4yY65A5QVHJz964jQxbz7xmCL1wWyf1LS9cfgPAx.jpg)


<Center>[Sources](https://www.imdb.com/es-ES/title/tt1403981/mediaviewer/rm4124347648/)</Center>


The film’s greatest strength lies in the chemistry between Pattinson and de Ravin. Pattinson delivers a nuanced performance, showing himself to be vulnerable, intense, and restrained at times, moving somewhat away from the vampire charisma that catapulted him to fame. His scenes with young Caroline, played by Ruby Jerins, his younger sister, are especially tender and reveal a protective and affectionate side. De Ravin brings light and warmth as Ally, a woman who lives each day with intensity precisely because she has seen death up close. Their moments together—strolls through the city, late-night conversations, and moments of intimacy—convey authenticity and largely avoid the clichés of Hollywood romance.



![1000253587.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/48Pw9L9nttwH61zeLWFcV9HZBU2dbu7UegrbUGRwzX8sad5uFGs94TwWk2zuorkMs5.jpg)

<Center>[Sources](https://www.imdb.com/es-ES/title/tt1403981/mediaviewer/rm4124347648/)</Center>


However, the film is not without its problems. Will Fetters’ screenplay piles on traumas and emotional twists that sometimes border on the manipulative. The conflict with Tyler’s father, Brosnan—a solid but somewhat underutilized performance—and the family tensions are resolved in a predictable manner leading up to the controversial ending. That twist, which connects the story to a real historical event from 2001, divides audiences, as for some it is a powerful emotional punch that gives meaning to the title and the message of living in the present, but for others it feels forced, sensationalist, and disrespectful.



![1000253584.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/Eo1xLhfgp5iW7o1kQbekUgioifeL98CK9L5NUTbZb1EKS2mLVh2RTmmZCJ6uGvSh8RN.jpg)

<Center>[Sources](https://www.imdb.com/es-ES/title/tt1403981/mediaviewer/rm4124347648/)</Center>


Technically, the film looks great; the cinematography of New York captures both its charm and its loneliness, and the soundtrack complements the introspective tone. It’s not a masterpiece, but it is an honest drama about grief, forgiveness, and the fragility of life. Pattinson proves here that he has dramatic range and chooses ambitious—albeit imperfect—projects. In conclusion, friends, \

is a film that moves and unsettles in equal measure. It isn’t perfect, but its performances and its attempt to say something profound about loss make it worth watching. It will truly leave you thinking about how we remember those who leave us and the importance of saying “I love you” before it’s too late. Without further ado, I’ll sign off and see you next movie. Blessings galore.


![1000253586.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23tGa4LSeP2eAsKwEBdry9iFj5nFM2XhAZdHrfuDP2nU8Wstf3xm1sYrsX9kUQDCN8L56.jpg)


<Center>[Sources](https://www.imdb.com/es-ES/title/tt1403981/mediaviewer/rm4124347648/)</Center>



‎<div class=\

> The sources for the images used in this post have been provided. Texts translated into English by [DeepL Translate](https://www.deepl.com/mobile-apps/?utm_source=android&utm_medium=app&utm_campaign=share-with-friends). ‎
‎VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí!)

‎Hola amigos de #hive y en especial a la comunidad de Movies&TvShows, como siempre espero que se encuentren bien al igual que sus familiares y amigos, en el día de hoy paso por acá para hablarles de una película que ví en estos días, de trata de la cinta \
o como su título lo indica en inglés\

, estrenada en2010 y del género drama romántico, el cual está dirigido por Allen Coulter, el que busca trascender el género mediante el peso del duelo, la redención familiar y un giro final que divide opiniones. Protagonizada por Robert Pattinson en uno de sus primeros papeles después de \

.





Tyler Hawkins, papel que interpreta Pattinson, es un joven rebelde, desmotivado y marcado por una tragedia familiar, el suicidio de su hermano mayor, el cual ha fracturado a sus padres, Pierce Brosnan y Lena Olin, y lo han dejado a la deriva. El mismo trabaja en una librería, vive con su mejor amigo Aidan, papel que desempeña Tate Ellington, y mantiene una relación tensa con su padre, un poderoso hombre de negocios. Su vida cambia cuando, tras un altercado, conoce a Ally Craig, papel que interpreta Emilie de Ravin, una joven vibrante, pero también herida por el asesinato de su madre años atrás. Lo que comienza como una relación impulsada por un reto se convierte en un romance profundo que ayuda a ambos a sanar.





La gran fortaleza de la cinta radica en la química entre Pattinson y de Ravin. Pattinson ofrece una interpretación llena de matices, ya que lo podemos ver vulnerable, intenso y contenido en ocasiones, alejándose parcialmente del carisma vampírico que lo catapultó a la fama. Sus escenas con la pequeña Caroline, papel que nos regala Ruby Jerins, su hermana menor, son especialmente tiernas y muestran un lado protector y cariñoso. De Ravin aporta luz y calidez como Ally, una mujer que vive cada día con intensidad precisamente por haber visto la muerte de cerca. Sus momentos juntos, los paseos por la ciudad, conversaciones nocturnas e intimidad, transmiten autenticidad y evitan en gran medida los clichés del romance hollywoodense.





Sin embargo, la película no está exenta de problemas. El guion de Will Fetters acumula traumas y giros emocionales que a veces rozan lo manipulador. El conflicto con el padre de Tyler, Brosnan, correcto pero algo desaprovechado, y las tensiones familiares se resuelven de forma previsible hasta llegar al controvertido final. Ese giro, que conecta la historia con un acontecimiento histórico real de 2001, genera división, ya que para algunos es un golpe emocional poderoso que da sentido al título y al mensaje de vivir el presente, pero para otros resulta forzado, sensacionalista y poco respetuoso.




Técnicamente, la película luce bien, la fotografía de New York captura tanto su encanto como su soledad, y la banda sonora acompaña el tono introspectivo. No es una obra maestra, pero sí un drama honesto sobre el duelo, el perdón y la fragilidad de la vida. Pattinson demuestra aquí que tiene rango dramático y elige proyectos con ambición, aunque imperfectos. En conclusión amigos, \

es una película que emociona y molesta en igual medida. No es perfecta, pero sus actuaciones y su intento de decir algo profundo sobre la pérdida, la hacen digna de verse. Realmente, te dejará pensando en cómo recordamos a quienes se van y en la importancia de decir te quiero antes de que sea tarde. Sin más me despido y hasta la próxima peli. Bendiciones miles.

body.title: Is Alibaba Getting Ready to Take on Nvidia?
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTqjw9yTHwYGAAjYCjTDR7jgUfGYHKKKzd9vopXmXgsrs/1000009182.png 


There has been a lot of buzz in the tech world lately because of some big news coming out of China. Alibaba just dropped their new AI chip, the Zhenwu M890. It is not just a small update they are claiming it is three times faster than their previous model. It looks like Alibaba is really trying to stand on its own two feet, especially since it is getting harder for Chinese companies to get those high end AI chips from the U.S. Basically, they have decided to cook their own hardware so they can stay in the AI race.

**So, Is Alibaba Actually Doing Well Financially?**
If you take a look at the numbers, Alibaba is sitting on a pretty solid pile of cash about 316.82 billion dollars. That is a lot of money to keep things running. Their debt level is also totally manageable, with a debt to equity ratio of around 25%. They are bringing in about 76.21 billion dollars in operating cash flow, too. So, if you are wondering if they have the muscle to fund these new AI projects, the answer is yes. They definitely have the breathing room to keep building.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeQpxWVbodbqc373iJ7oSHxueqKTk3UMdr1GbKE4XtXc3/1000009163.jpg 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYi1wjxcjHfQVn8CM7Sa6W38hgzCs3GW5nUTdLdv9gJPF/1000009174.jpg 


**What Does the Stock Chart Say?**
For those of you who look at charts, BABA (Alibaba’s stock on the NYSE) is in an interesting spot right now. It is trading around 130 dollars. It has had some pressure to go down, but there is a strong floor or support area around 118 dollars that seems to be keeping the price from crashing further.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdzqpkdZ3XhzzaqyNdJMEq3y1oss3mWJNV23WmNJ46AvN/1000009175.jpg 


If you look at the weekly chart, you can clearly see a ceiling or supply area around 146 dollars. For traders, that range between 118 and 146 dollars is basically the battlefield right now. The price is kind of stuck in the middle, which is why it has been moving sideways lately.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPwVRbqaZoYQjzdRnxZANNTa1xqwvj6mmBYAbrYyqXbY8/1000009179.jpg 


Can Alibaba actually beat Nvidia? Honestly, that is not going to happen overnight. Nvidia has a massive lead and a huge ecosystem, while Alibaba is just starting to build its own domestic powerhouse. But, the fact that Alibaba is making its own chips is a big deal. It shows they are not just sitting around while the AI boom happens.

If you are watching BABA, keep an eye on what happens when the price tries to test that 146 dollar mark. If it breaks through, all this AI news might push the price higher. If it fails, it will probably drift back down to test that support area again. Just remember to manage your risk and don't go all in just because of the hype.

Source
  [Zhenwu M890 Alibaba vs Nvidia](https://ihal.it/alibaba-chip-ai-zhenwu-m890/)
