body.body: > Hola queridos amigos de @TheAnimeRealm, saludos y bendiciones, en esta ocasión vengo para hablarles de una historia en que la muerte y el revivir puede ser más complicado de lo que parece, ya que al morir y regresar de nuevo a la vida no deberías recordar nada de tu vida pasada, pero ¿Qué pasaría si puedes recordar esa vida pasada y que regresaras en la misma vida, es decir, siendo la misma persona con los mismos que conoces ya 4 veces? Es algo para buscar cambiar o que no has aprendido de esa vida y aunque sea dolorosos debes vivirla más de una vez, se trata de El anillo roto: Este matrimonio está destinado a fracasar. --- ![i-just-started-this-i-have-to-say-she-is-most-traumatized-v0-n6ega80ufxvc11.1.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/AKU5bjX47VYDihnG47mE7mpnBv5mfin9u12c5j7vhDee1C6odKwFgeYEeKz83hx.webp) [Fuente](https://webtoon.fandom.com/es/wiki/Este_matrimonio_está_destinado_a_fracasar) ---

> Se trata de la historia de Inés, una joven heredera de una noble familia, quien ha revivido en su misma vida como Inés 4 veces, en las cuales ha muerto prematuramente, sea por una enfermedad, por un loco obsesionado con ella que la llevo al suicidio o por haber tenido que tomar decisiones que llevo a la muerte de seres queridos, hasta que por fin llega a su cuarta vida, en la cual tras recordar todo lo que ha vivido en sus vidas pasadas y lo que sabe que puede pasar escogiendo el camino que ya ha vivido, decide teniendo apenas 6 años comprometerse con Cárcel Escalante el sobrino de la emperatriz, quien poseerá un gran futuro como heredero de esta noble familia y quien quizás la pueda salvar de su fatídico destino, sin recordar con exactitud su primera vida y sin saber que Cárcel puede ser alguien más allá que su salvador. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

> En el tiempo en que transcurre para que Inés y Cárcel se casen, ella vive su vida lo más tranquila posible evitando todos aquellos que en su vida pasada sabe que pueden hacerle daño o ella ocasionarle algún daño, como el príncipe heredero Oscar, el obsesionado con ella que la quiere para así aunque ella este comprometida con su primo, sin embargo, en esta vida ella lo ha podido sobrellevar, aunque su plan es casarse con Cárcel, tener un hijo y luego divorciarse para tener libertad, pero lo que no se espera es que el proceso terminará enamorándose de Cárcel, quien es un hombre físicamente hermoso, pero que por el destino que fue manejando Inés se convirtió el hombre más codiciado pero también mujeriego, hasta que al poco tiempo de casarse cae perdidamente enamorado de ella. --- ![469820113_548646714599105_962178984424585040_n2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/243We3TvPEjogbmBF6qzJ7gxwtfXNC61WbE2VfGzUhBwkoWiizxE3A8S8mP1w9Yf6YXGX.jpg) [Fuente](https://webtoon.fandom.com/es/wiki/Este_matrimonio_está_destinado_a_fracasar) ---

> Sin saber porque, Cárcel comienza a tener sentimiento por Inés, sus vidas comienzan a enlazarse, pero sus pasados siguen tan vivientes que por momentos se les será difícil comprender, pero juntos deberán aprender que hay cosas que pasan para aprender, que es mejor olvidar que recordar todo ese dolor que te carcome, pero que si hay oportunidad de regresar a la misma vida aprendiendo de los errores tras errores que se comenten tienen a la final una razón, y no hay que perder el horizonte en ello, si quieren llegar a ser felices deberán usar su pasado para armar un futuro en el que puedan estar juntos. Sigue activo publicándose, tiene hasta los momentos 120 capítulos, recomiendo para mayores de 18 años jeje. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png) **Autor Cheong-gwa (Ilustrador) y CHOKAM (adaptación), género romance, Año 2022.** ---
![493712841_711791424792101_3556300443425658288_n3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tvW8V3qKqeiETKvbSFwa3JkhSUBbtcV7G9B8YNNrh82uxnZwMiMM81qaGu4Qe8zvsAi.jpg)
[Fuente](https://webtoon.fandom.com/es/wiki/Este_matrimonio_está_destinado_a_fracasar) ---

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png) **ENGLISH**

> Hello dear friends of @TheAnimeRealm, greetings and blessings. On this occasion, I am here to talk to you about a story in which death and resurrection can be more complicated than it seems, since when you die and come back to life, you should not remember anything from your past life. But what if you can remember that past life and return to the same life, that is, being the same person with the same people you already know four times over? Is it something you should seek to change, or have you not learned from that life, and even though it is painful, you must live it more than once? This is The Broken Ring: This marriage is doomed to fail. --- ![i-just-started-this-i-have-to-say-she-is-most-traumatized-v0-n6ega80ufxvc11.1.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/AKU5bjX47VYDihnG47mE7mpnBv5mfin9u12c5j7vhDee1C6odKwFgeYEeKz83hx.webp) [Source](https://webtoon.fandom.com/es/wiki/Este_matrimonio_está_destinado_a_fracasar) ---

> This is the story of Inés, a young heiress from a noble family, who has relived her life as Inés four times, each time dying prematurely, either from illness, from a madman obsessed with her who drove her to suicide, or from having to make decisions that led to the death of loved ones, Until she finally reaches her fourth life, in which, after remembering everything she has experienced in her past lives and knowing what can happen if she chooses the path she has already lived, she decides, at just six years old, to commit herself to Cárcel Escalante, the emperor's nephew, who will have a great future as the heir to this noble family and who may be able to save her from her fateful destiny, without remembering her first life exactly and without knowing that Cárcel may be someone beyond her savior. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

> In the time that passes before Inés and Cárcel get married, she lives her life as peacefully as possible, avoiding all those who she knows from her past life could hurt her or cause her harm, such as Crown Prince Oscar, who is obsessed with her and wants her even though she is engaged to his cousin. However, in this life she has been able to cope, although her plan is to marry Cárcel, have a child, and then divorce him to gain her freedom. but what she does not expect is that she will end up falling in love with Cárcel, who is a physically handsome man, but who, due to the fate that Inés has been steering, has become the most coveted man but also a womanizer, until shortly after they marry, he falls madly in love with her. --- ![469820113_548646714599105_962178984424585040_n2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/243We3TvPEjogbmBF6qzJ7gxwtfXNC61WbE2VfGzUhBwkoWiizxE3A8S8mP1w9Yf6YXGX.jpg) [Source](https://webtoon.fandom.com/es/wiki/Este_matrimonio_está_destinado_a_fracasar) ---

> Without knowing why, Cárcel begins to have feelings for Inés, their lives begin to intertwine, but their pasts remain so vivid that at times it will be difficult for them to understand each other. Together, however, they must learn that some things happen so that we can learn from them, that it is better to forget than to remember all that pain that eats away at you, but that if there is an opportunity to return to the same life, learning from the mistakes made, they ultimately have a reason, and you must not lose sight of that. If they want to be happy, they must use their past to build a future in which they can be together. It is still being published, with 120 chapters so far. I recommend it for those over 18, haha. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png) **Author Cheong-gwa (Illustrator) and CHOKAM (adaptation), genre romance, Year 2022.** ---

[Source](https://webtoon.fandom.com/es/wiki/Este_matrimonio_está_destinado_a_fracasar) ---

body.title: Hive Philippines Travel and Nature Photography #1156 - by Allmonitors
body.body:
#1156 - Baler Aurora Shots for Sunday. 

A peaceful Sunday wonderful Hive family everywhere! I hope this day finds you wrapped in comfort and joy. Wishing everyone a joyful Sunday. Let us enjoy these last few hours of the weekend with gratitude. Stay safe, keep smiling and enjoy every bit of this day.
![1000006050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/243LovhYiDkAzQfoy6LnK1966qjMRcd8SLffP23nxFyYfnLuL8nxtqvXoGMGoHMgxZ1LT.jpg)

Now for today shots with my wife and I on the famous shores of Sabang Beach in Baler, Aurora. It was a gorgeous afternoon when we went out. The sun was high but starting its slow descent. 
![1000006059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/242Xtwq9G8JwWeZgwNXKNp5Hoxj4nnKbeivQKAje6Tzqa2ZxeG2QMHipsrqzBSAZ6hD79.jpg)

We walked and sat onto the beach and immediately noticed the unique sand which was dark black color which is typical for Baler. It gave the place a natural beauty. We took off our slippers and felt the sand between our toes. 
![1000006069.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23r1BCC4NjrmTnw4Ga2XCb8NyAXcUYbFJk5UtU7her4W5BgP7Q2q8qVnGQZHZqNaCrzzD.jpg)

The water felt cool, salty and refreshing. We just stuck to the shallow parts with the smaller waves wash over us. Being here with my wife just splashing around like kids was the best stress reliever. 
![1000006123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23ryvDUX41LqRU1Si2DviKYGSdUAiq2FepjvhfrYMvxTSXegGcDkMUQCCthzVXWSnMAhE.jpg)

We spent time just exploring the different areas of the beach. We watched the surfers in the distance. We found a spot to sit watching the afternoon go by. We took lots of photos too as remembrance. 
![1000006132.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EppKj17Hoenbuwo5QuZv7vqh7jhNL9HeR3ZjnDp6cwxBoKkmbegwP1KQ698iscbZ8Yq.jpg)

Follow me on my nature travels.
Shot taken in Baler Aurora, Philippines.

<center>Image/s were shot using Samsung Z5 flip phone. ~rex</center>

### ***Lifestyle monomad challange photography***



![1000100692.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23uQxjHx9bLq2gmPXDjnaqqdJdDvP3ZGqeGqktsarBoqYV3hrUmG5ci3rSbZzuRLWGyi8.jpg)

Greetings, blackandwhite photography lovers !

Today I am here to share some wonderful photography with you. After waking up in the morning, I freshened up and went to the market to have breakfast in the morning. Because I really wanted to go to the market this morning. So I went to the market and met a friend of mine. 

My friend is a tailor. He always makes people's clothes. He is a very good artist who is skilled in making different designs and different types of clothes. I went to my friend in the morning and I talked to him for a while. After talking, when we needed to have breakfast, we went to a tea shop.

So after going to the shop, we ordered two and ordered two biscuits with them. I liked them a lot more when the shopkeeper was serving them. I took a nice black and white photograph of the tea seller. 

Besides, there was a nice place to keep a tea cup in that shop. There were several glass tea cups. I took a black and white photograph of those tea cups. 

The tea pot had a strainer and I took a nice photograph. 

The last tea seller served us a beautiful cup of tea, hot and steaming in the morning. Then we drank that tea wonderfully.



![1000100688.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23wMU9P898vR3bvJGRqM8jAFw8HKRaJKaZMhPZgcUuHQDXtxpXFyRDpeYi11r5kR49U21.jpg)

body.title: Are we financially responsible to other people's need || Mcgi topic review
body.body:
According to the preaching of the bible, it told us to always care and love one another. God encourages believers to show love, kindness, and generosity to others, especially the poor and those going through difficult times. Helping others financially is one way Christians can reflect God’s love.  

>Galatians 6:2, “Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.” 

The Bible also teaches balance and responsibility. We are not expected to carry every person’s burden alone or support laziness and irresponsibility. In the bible, Paul warned that people should be willing to work if they are able. Christians are encouraged to help wisely, with compassion and understanding, while also encouraging others to be responsible and hardworking.

The Bible reminds us that giving should come from a willing and cheerful heart, not by force or pressure. God blesses those who give generously to help others in need. 

>Proverbs 19:17 says, “Whoever is kind to the poor lends to the Lord.”

body.title: (es.en)Aphrodite's Mirror ✦ El espejo de Afrodita (FICTION)
body.body:
#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  
 
 
# <center> ✦ ***Aphrodite's Mirror*** ✦</center> 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXd1voGv3MQfCiVZ5Z7xwY8X8piY6xfEr1bL2mxddspR8/the_new_york_public_library_7lobusxoxte_unsplash.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/figuras-griegas-antiguas-representadas-en-arte-de-incrustaciones-de-madera-7loBusXoxTE

In the depths of the Aegean Sea, sometimes calm, sometimes chaotic, where the foam sings at dawn and the doves, swans and seagulls go indistinctly from the rivers to the sea and from the sea to the river, Aphrodite, the most beautiful goddess, the embodiment of sensuality and love, prepared and stopped like every day to descend to Earth to visit lovers and lovers. She wasn't carrying her swan chariot this time, there was something different about her. It was a sunny spring morning, with dense air full of humidity and salt. That morning she wanted to walk among mortals, she wanted to know how much people talked about her, so she dressed as a maiden in simple, almost invisible clothing, hiding her royal bearing and blonde hair.

He dressed in a white linen tunic, without gold or myrrh, and felt for a moment that the fabric kissed his skin. Their clothes were long and modest, simple and unadorned, like waves when they are calm. Looking at himself in a pool of fresh water between cobblestones and stones, he smiled. This is what it feels like to be mortal, he thought. Not that of the goddess, but that of the woman who is the owner of her silence and the city. The one who walks with her thoughts on herself, not on what other gods will say, not on what mortals will desire.

He went down to a market on the island of Cythera among the aromas of reefs and withered grapes. There the market opened up immensely imposingly at the feet of a young girl of barely 22 years old. For a moment he felt chills and fear, and he wondered if he was doing the right thing, if it wasn't too dangerous, too unholy, to tread the same ground that mortals tread. The market was a coming and going of happy voices, some singing, others shouting, every now and then an argument, Aphrodite felt tiny. But he came back to the smell of the freshly cooked dishes, the fresh flowers and fruits, the soft touch of the fabrics, the rigid clay of the vessels that were displayed in the place. Everything was new, everything was magical for Aphrodite, everything was divine. Among stalls of figs and violet fabrics, an old woman was selling shell bracelets brought from beyond the sea, each shell a unique color, with a unique shine, beautifully woven around a violet fiber. Aphrodite crouched next to him, contemplating the beauty of that simple craftsmanship.

-What are you looking for, girl? -asked the old woman without recognizing her.
\
the goddess responded.\n-Everything you see here has a price- answered the old woman.\n-Price? \

the goddess responded and her cheeks lit up with the reddish tone of dawn.

The old woman laughed and offered him a broken bracelet. Aphrodite accepted it. In that a humble gesture, a humility that was not common in the gods of Olympus.
The old woman placed the bracelet on her wrist, and smiled, the goddess smiled back.

Aphrodite continued her mortal pilgrimage through the streets of the market, absorbed in the contemplation of her new treasure, something that despite having been made by mortal hands felt so divine. For a moment she thought that perhaps it wasn't a bracelet, it was a mirror that adorned her wrist, and there she was, reflected, broken and imperfect, but at the same time divine. She thought of her husband and she thought of her lover.

A young fisherman passed by, but he did not see the goddess of love, he saw a simple young woman of the same age. He saw a woman with wet eyes and distant thoughts. He offered him an olive.
\

said Aphrodite.
-Well, have a good trip, beautiful lady, I hope Aphrodite does not become jealous of your beauty.

They both laughed, she returned the clean olive pit.

At night someone walked among the Olympians, someone with mud on their feet, someone who would no longer be the captive of any network or any desire, only of herself and her broken reflection.

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

# <center> ✦ ***El espejo de Afrodita*** ✦</center> 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXd1voGv3MQfCiVZ5Z7xwY8X8piY6xfEr1bL2mxddspR8/the_new_york_public_library_7lobusxoxte_unsplash.jpg)


#### 📸https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/figuras-griegas-antiguas-representadas-en-arte-de-incrustaciones-de-madera-7loBusXoxTE

En las profundidades del mar Egeo, a veces tranquilo, a veces caótico, donde la espuma canta al amanecer y las palomas, cisnes y gaviotas van indistintamente de los ríos al mar y del mar al río, Afrodita, la diosa más bella, la encarnación de lo sensual y el amor se preparaba se paraba como cada día para bajar a la Tierra en visita a amantes y a enamorados. No llevaba su carro de cisnes esta vez había algo distinto en ella. Era una mañana soleada, de primavera, con un denso aire lleno de humedad y salitre. Esa mañana quería caminar entre los mortales quería saber qué tanto se hablaba de ella, por eso se vistió de doncella con un ropaje sencillo, casi invisible, ocultando su porte real y sus cabellos rubios.

Se vistió con una túnica de lino blanco, sin oro ni mirra y sintió por un momento que la tela le besaba la piel. Sus ropajes eran largos y recatados, sencillos y sin adornos, como las olas cuando están en calma. Al mirarse en un charco de agua dulce entre adoquines y piedras, sonrió. Así se siente ser mortal -pensó. No el de la diosa, sino el de la mujer que es dueña de su silencio y de la ciudad. La que camina con sus pensamientos en ella misma, no en el que dirán otros dioses, no en el que desearán los mortales.

Bajó a un mercado en la isla de Citera entre aromas de arrecifes y uvas marchitas. Ahí el mercado se abría inmenso imponente a los pies de una joven muchacha de apenas 22 años. Por un momento sintió escalofríos y temor, y pensó si estaba haciendo lo correcto, si no era demasiado peligroso, demasiado profano, pisar la misma tierra que pisan los mortales. El mercado era un ir y venir de alegres voces algunas cantaban otras gritaban, cada tanto una discusión, Afrodita se sintió minúscula. Pero volvió en sí al olor de los platillos recién cocinados, de las flores y frutas frescas, al tacto suave de las telas, del barro rígido de las vasijas que se exponían en el lugar. Todo era nuevo, todo era mágico para afrodita, todo era divino. Entre puestos de higos y telas violetas, una anciana vendía pulseras de concha traídas desde más allá del mar, cada concha con un color único, con un brillo único, bellamente tejidas alrededor de una fibra violeta. Afrodita se agachó a su lado, contemplando la belleza de esa simple artesanía

-¿Qué buscas, niña? -preguntó la vieja sin reconocerla.
-Busco no ser vista, busco no ser juzgada, busco no ser llamada vanidosa por simplemente ser bella —respondió la diosa.
-Todo lo que ves aquí tiene un precio- respondió la anciana
-¿Precio? Perdón no tengo dinero- respondió la diosa y sus mejillas se encendieron con el tono rojizo del amanecer

La anciana rió y le ofreció una pulsera rota. Afrodita la aceptó. En ese un gesto humilde, una humildad que no era común en los dioses de Olimpo.
La anciana colocó la pulsera en su muñeca, y sonrió, la diosa le devolvió la sonrisa.

Afrodita continuó su mortal peregrinaje entre las calles del mercado, absorta en la contemplación de su nuevo tesoro, algo que a pesar de haber sido hecho por manos mortales se sentía tan divino. Por un momento pensó que quizás no era una pulsera, era un espejo lo que adornaba su muñeca, y allí estaba ella, reflejada, rota e imperfecta, pero a la vez divina. Pensó en su marido y pensó en su amante.

Un pescador joven pasó cerca, pero no vio a la diosa del amor, vio a una joven sencilla de su misma edad. Vio a una mujer de mirada húmeda y pensamientos lejanos. Le ofreció una aceituna.
-Gracias-dijo ella.
-¿Vives cerca?- le preguntó el pescador
-No, estoy de paso- dijo Afrodita
-Pues buen viaje, bella dama, espero Afrodita no se ponga celosa de su belleza

Ambos rieron, ella le devolvió el hueso limpio de la aceituna.

A la noche alguien caminó entre los Olímpicos, alguien con barro en los pies, alguien que no volvería a ser cautiva de ninguna red ni de ningún deseo, solo de sí misma y de su roto reflejo.

body.title: Marrying after the death of a spouse, is it allowed by the bible
body.body:
The bible allows us to remarry after our wife or husband dies. The bond of marriage ends immediately either the wife or husband dies. In the New Testament, the Apostle Paul explained that a widow or widower is free to marry again after the death of their spouse, especially if the new marriage honors God and is built on faith, love, and commitment. Christians are encouraged to seek wisdom and God’s guidance before entering another marriage.
https://youtu.be/z-gs7LxXXuc?si=U2xgeo0eG7kf-owg
The Bible also shows compassion to those who lose their spouse. God understands loneliness, grief, and the need for companionship. Remarrying after the death of a spouse is not considered a sin in the Bible. Instead, it is seen as a personal decision that should be made prayerfully and with a sincere heart. 

**“A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, but he must belong to the Lord.” 1 Corinthians 7:39.**

Na závěr týdne zde máme opět nejlepší pozvánky do celého světa, a nejen to — tentokrát i do světa, který máme přímo pod nohama.

**Abia Tower**
Hlavní dominantou fotografie je stavba připomínající věž nebo rozhlednu. Je bílé barvy a v dolní části má hnědé základny. Celý objekt je obehnán plotem, tudíž soudím, že se nebude jednat o veřejně přístupnou stavbu. Jak jsem si na první pohled myslel, spíše půjde o určitý styl moderního umění. Na celém snímku převládají chladné barvy. Bledě modrá obloha s bílými oblaky, které jsou ve spodních částech šedé, barevně koresponduje s šedým asfaltem silnice. Negativně lze vytknout zachycené dráty elektrického vedení v horní části snímku.

**Capo Vaticano**
Na dalším snímku máme pohled na mořské pobřeží, které doslova zarůstá bujnou vegetací. Kompozice snímku je vyvážená. Levá strana, ze které vystupuje pevnina, nerovnoměrně ukusuje moře. Moře je blankytně modré a u pobřeží, kde stoupají útesy, lze vidět, že jsou hustě porostlé korály (alespoň v to doufám). Mezi vodním a suchozemským světem je úzký pruh písečné pláže, kde se jistě každý den odehrává boj o nadvládu flóry z levé strany a obyvatel moře. Velmi pěkný snímek.

**Chaukhandi Stupa**
Další snímek je pozvánkou do historie. Hlavním objektem snímku je stúpa, jejíž tmavě červená barva vytváří kontrast k zelené louce před divákem a zároveň tvoří tmavý kontrast oproti světlému nebi. Pozadí doplňují vzrostlé stromy. Pokud by autor udělal několik kroků doprava, uskupení vysokých trav, které vypadá jako ostrov v zeleném moři, by bylo také symetricky umístěno na snímku. Což je samozřejmě jen detail a pouze další možnost kompozice.

**Babadag Mtn.**
Na snímku máme další mořské pobřeží, tentokrát pohledem z hladiny. Spodní část snímku tvoří mírně zvlněná vodní hladina, jež zde hraje vedlejší roli. Hlavním objektem jsou hory vystupující nad hladinou a zejména hora na levé straně snímku, která díky zamženému oparu nechává vyniknout své monumentálnosti a vzdálenosti od místa, kde se fotograf nacházel. Při přiblížení snímku si může divák všimnout poměrně rušného provozu na hladině. Jen pro zajímavost — napočítal jsem deset lodí. A ještě pochvala pro autora: hladina vody je krásně vyrovnaná, což byla častá výtka u předchozích snímků.

**Ochozská Cave**
Poslední snímek nás zavede do chladného podzemí, kde vládne tma, vlhkost a nekonečný čas. Právě voda v součinnosti s časem je autorem tvarů, které jsou na fotografii zachyceny. Jen lidská představivost dokáže jednotlivé útvary pojmenovat. Barevnou kompozicí by se snímek mohl zařadit mezi noční fotografie, neboť zde převládají tmavé až černé odstíny, které kontrastují s jasně nasvícenými objekty ve velmi světlých tónech. Tentokrát zde máme kompozici od bílé až po černou s jasnou převahou hnědých až okrových barev. V přední části snímku jsou jasně osvětlené útvary připomínající kopečky soli či mouky. Naopak z horní části snímku postupně klesá strop do pozadí, kde se ztrácí v temnotě. Ve stejné tmavé části mizí i ony bílé kopečky. A tak vzniká dojem nekonečné propasti mezi těmito dvěma segmenty.

Závěrem opět patří poděkování všem řádně přihlášeným autorům pozvánek. Své dva hlasy pošlu do Itálie a do jeskyně.

body.title: A wet morning...
body.body:
...and I open the post with a Camellia flower wearing a rainwater crown. 
![005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/245HnoYUA3nXJFdhYdJn4oggSV59FMjBHq4F5x914BEY3wzaLFhHcFPtLKnUnRepR36qr.jpg)

Two parts in the post, as I also played a bit with the moon. The thing is that we expected no rain and yet for a few hours we had what we call fairy rain. Drops so small that one can barely feel them. Just a fine drizzle that wets everything very gently, and we were glad, especially after the damaging rainstorms and floods that we had to endure for the past days. I took some random shots during the day and thankfully the rain stopped. 

A dense mist had us drive very slowly with the car's lights on and we encountered no incidents on the roads. It seems the people have learnt how to drive in the wet, and one always has to be aware of some people's love to ignore the red traffic lights. Red means stop and wait for the green, but we have many chancers that simply drive through the red lights. Then another irritant is also those with the \

cars, the ones that try to sound like a rocket and the noise scares even the rain away.

Just to show you what the view looked like early morning. 
![001.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23ywoF66YwqzfFoKSQAJ5TwMrYKHsxYi3KXvgLZVssSPZscpvPdW7rNJBQLgu3wLgnt73.JPG)

Later on, the sun was, as usual, in a battle to break through the clouds. 
![012.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoeFsCSL3F6dW3a6ZCqjWwW1cZAV2mFZdUEzwwpmssYWAKyrbVcHgPk3iWpeSj9jt5H.JPG)

Ever so slowly the clouds started to brighten up.
![091.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EpGQJqcjx6LTXZdbUrTw6X1CRr5ENZPhFakSFQWCmKxkmAbhuzW3QYhEYoDfyno25at.JPG)

Hooray! The sky started to clear at last. 
![069.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/242YC5LEakD9dveZ1kQXwxdzLuZc7RvRStvjNTQF8ac3Z7wqBUQdtEgki8iUiCzDmdQiC.JPG)

In the second part of the post, I will show you some moon shots, as the sun seemed to light it up. The month of May has two full moons, and I missed the first one as the skies were covered in cloud, and so I will get a second chance to get the full moon on the 31st of May. I just hope that the clouds will read this post and give me a chance to get the full moon :)   

![100.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23u5tEBNe21WJAmA6McAaZY9uoDvemsHbBNSaBfJRzHPnqRGiboFU9ig3TGNwxo5wj3Ln.JPG)

This photo below is where I at first became aware of the moon as the cloud opened up. 
![072.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EopmaCtXM1VJ5iFAT7qG6DjAvwzYnPp242sZcMQg3NA9CnuEZMUfDfdXPY7gjhqPAGX.JPG)

But it wasn't going to be for long, and I only had a chance to get a few shots.
![103.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoJyyUsHDUBzeFK1D6JiwUmnc3rv7xwuKzgnkv3mJHNnZtWzvC9AzjhwZQbvRTgvepH.JPG)

![104.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EogLuygRRRitbNfrjqeFV1zQn98rtr52fUQiBKweDkFDqWnENMqSYYGkKbCymRfTpnd.JPG)

Finally, the cloud became jealous, and it closed the moon again, but by then I had enough shots.
![105.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Ep7sdceTqW9tysNK4YVdzKTh7sbiEsnYKWxugD3qLFvNJmZ8w3ZEBFsK1w7dDwh71mF.JPG)

I like to play in the sky as I am a being that belongs in the sky, at least it feels like that to me. Nary a day goes by that I do not have my eyes on the sky. Yes, I know that there are also abundant views for a photographer on the land, and I do try to combine the elements whenever I am out taking photos. Variety is the name of the game as it prevents one's offerings from becoming stale.

Nature, of course, has its own treasures for those of us that take a more concentrated look at things, and it holds a trove of surprises. One can learn nature's laws just via the medium of photography as everything in nature has a role in the eco-systems. Nothing goes to waste and the wetlands even filter the river water that flows into it. Just a pity that so many don't understand this as littering just continues to take place. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera.

Until next time, cheers!

body.title: Online Scams!!
body.body:
>Online scams are the worst, its almost always mind boggling when you here how people fall for them but at the same time you cant but pity them and know that almost anyone can fall for them, no one is too smart or intelligent to fall for them. Even billionaires and established entrepreneurs have fallen for scams, but today, scams have become so sophisticated and common that almost everybody either has a personal experience or knows someone who has fallen victim to one. At this point, protecting yourself online is no longer optional, you just have to be conscious and protect not only your financial assets but also your personal data.

Honestly, I think one of the reasons online scams have become more dangerous is because scammers now understand human emotions better than technology itself. Especially most of these romance scmas, they are the most used type of scams and most scams are no longer just random messages filled with terrible grammar asking for your bank details. They now look convincing, emotional, and sometimes even professional. For me, one of the first ways I protect myself from online scammers is by distrusting anything i did not initiate, whether it is clicking a link, transferring money, sharing an OTP, or “claiming” a prize immediately, especially when it comes to claiming prizes and also be very careful on phishing scams, especially when it comes to people that receive a lot of emails , you have to be very careful. These days we receive alot of mails and we just click on the links without thinking they have repercussions but they do, do not click on any links that you did not initiate, just clicking these days is enough for someone to have access to your wallets and passwords.

In the world today, I honestly believe digital scams tied to banking are among the most dangerous. Especially the ones where scammers impersonate banks agents or even government agencies. I remember wactching a true crime docu series of a woman that fell for a scam in which a person pretended to be a government agent and she fell for it twice. Sometimes they call with so much confidence that people genuinely believe they are speaking to legitimate officials.

Another dangerous category and i dare say the most common is romance and emotional manipulation scams, which sometimes can even lead to blackmail, especially when nudes are involved. A lot of people underestimate these because they think only “gullible” people fall for them, but loneliness and vulnerability can affect anybody. Personally, I avoid clicking random links, it doesnt no matter how harmless they look. I also try to verify information independently instead of trusting screenshots or forwarded messages. I go on google or reddit and try to verify and you will see genuine responses.

My advice to others would simply be this slow down online. Scammers often succeed because they manipulate greed. If it looks too good to be true the it is, verify before trusting and even after verifying if your gut feeling tells you not to trust it. Then Dont!!!!

body.title: Yogurt and Apple Pancakes 🥞 🍎
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hoy preparé para el desayuno de mi pequeño una receta algo diferente, bastante divertida, además de saludable y deliciosa, se trata de unos panqueques que hice con yogurt y manzana los cuales quedaron sumamente deliciosos, les muestro la preparación

> **
ENGLISH
** Today I made a slightly different recipe for my little one’s breakfast—it’s pretty fun, healthy, and delicious. I made pancakes with yogurt and apples, and they turned out absolutely delicious. Here’s how I made them ![1000904970.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23w2nywYkVzX3p4CnPNnoiELKbYzmuR3PxRz9vLEETUbHfigWhMu96fKReb2hsraodpUS.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** manzana, yogurt, azúcar, harina de trigo, canela

> **
INGREDIENTS
** apple, yogurt, sugar, wheat flour, cinnamon ![1000904919.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EoiVkpQaTNZhfDybHZxEuAWGCZr4E5XLSRnMEj2mL4nr2Uf3GFJqySYMANhVuZDGuu9.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Después de lavar muy bien la manzana retiré la cáscara, la corté en trozos, la llevé a la licuadora juntamente con el yogurt, el azúcar y la harina de trigo, licue muy bien hasta que obtuve una mezcla homogénea; luego agregué un poco de canela, tomé porciones de la masa y la lleve a una sartén engrasada con aceite y decoré con trozos de manzana, deje que se cocinara por ambos lados

> **
PROCEDURE
** After washing the apple thoroughly, I peeled it, cut it into pieces, and put it in the blender along with the yogurt, sugar, and wheat flour. body.title: Farmhouse Ale and a Blond
body.body:
![20260516_150744~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpNnpnPnXL4ebpw2LmUMRXoPw1ghPWHMJ2nWiwZqmKEB24hR8WNBZUKZuDPrqMNo4dY.jpg)

##### I have a new batch of beers for this weeks #Beersaturday. Today I'll be reviewing two of them, a farmhouse ale and a blond ale. Let's check them out.  

# <center>Legacy Canadian Farmhouse Ale</center>

<hr>

![20260516_161136~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23ydCJxdYaXQCCV5J4iYetJu9FKdN6GCd4AgF9F2dar2xnwrXeRG2ZwasACVLwrpwocFS.jpg)

Brewery: Legacy Brewing Co 
Origin: Northumberland County, ON Canada
Style: Farmhouse Ale
Abv: 4.8%
IBU: 20
SRM: Unknown 

![20260516_161108~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/242466UEzU2U9BhT8ThrFiL5yi7ZyEF959DUrTF4gPY5JppSuN4GhTBiTm87sZusWmtTr.jpg)

**Marketing:** The can is a deep navy blue with yellow brass etching. The image feels etched into the sleeve which gives is an interesting raised texture. Its slightly blurry on the eyes though, which erks me just a little. The image is very distinctly Art Deco inspired, which it very cool and part of the reason why I bought it (I'm clearly a sucker for marketing). However, the design doesn't fit the style of beer at all in my opinion. The beer is marketed as a farmhouse ale which brings to mind rural small towns and country landscapes, tractors and barns, but the image is of an opulent golden city metropolis. There is a disconnect there. The two ideas are polar opposites in theme, which almost makes me invision the Great Gatsby selling his mansion in the city and purchasing a small farm where he drinks this beer on his tractor while sowing his fields... it just doesn't make sense.

![20260516_160936~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23y92KsZHLWpd4V32fRBs1mLnoQ5ThTPTwkeBgNSCqAbQDsFV3xHiA6kHQU3xcRegspjy.jpg)

I really like the can design overall but the brewery would have been smarter to fill it with a golden ale or a blond ale, either of those would have been much more fitting.  

![20260516_161021~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23xAeVbVicLAS2LqAW9JAqijvSkgVDsyziCZToytWxZq1wpJLFUDHF3MWgcGP8ej7yPAa.jpg)

**Color:** The beer is a sort of burnt tumeric color with a good amount of haziness in it and a white head of foam on top that lasted quite a while. 

![20260516_161033~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23yJP8B7YinsU6abzNaBhV1asf7Qis8XKJAhkrXxBQ3XGEQkFRLxviXnrmXSoKvRHciHU.jpg)

**Nose:** The beer holds a malty aroma with notes of bread and biscuits. I got some grassy hops coming through as well and a slightly sweet smell of apple. 

![20260516_161330~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EpELCDPRr13nUiHa8jGLyLjH5J6iTD5tiDyph68HDeNAoUKtUBXjAxSZr95SHPejsY9.jpg)

**Taste:** Sweet with some sourness that became more pronouced the more I drank it, and a sharp bitter finish that came late but lingered on for a time. There was a fruitiness to it also, maybe apple or pear. It tasted like a spring or fall beer to me. 

![20260516_161042~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23xAZgz1GsCPxMNHgAMbjT2Z4qtLi9DXBEz4LQfVZXFyNZLhTr7tdPi5GbsPoTK3MSTya.jpg)

**Texture:** Lightly carbonated with soft bubbles and a weighty velvety texture. 

![20260516_162736~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23wqnjyEsBEHPghvw76RGmqESBn4YGytAXXksfXroQ7x33pV6DLc1gNjYZxwm8PZ8on29.jpg)

**Impression:** It was a fine beer. I enjoyed it but wasn't in love with it by any means. Near the end it was getting a little too sour for me and for that reason I likely won't buy it again. 

# <center>Food Truck Blond</center>

<hr>

![20260518_170815~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Ep3errVPdKRoYHe9fAzFyaHLgmBBwcEmY74usBXde5dTfYMxvVMWvbKm8SpN4B6fQKb.jpg)

Brewery: Henderson Brewing Co 
Origin: Lincoln ON Canada
Style: Blond Ale
Abv: 4.8%
IBU: Unknown 
SRM: Unknown 

![20260518_170735~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Eonm3VyDBk2iyYxrh2KwEJs9kF6W6LztMsdmxL2nQ7k7k9NTRwNg3wjdgzgcNxfVW7L.jpg)

**Marketing:** The can boasts a baby blue with contrasting pale yellow color scheme. The Henderson Brewing Co brand label is displayed prominantly and it has a 1950s style food truck image as well. No additional information is listed about the beer anywhere on the can but overall its a fun design with a vintage look about it. I like it. 

![20260518_170839~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoiXe2Pgom3HkJisgCJmtep4uAsJjdB7dLibhBBv9rkGgigpqwBVLvFz5czJdxqav9S.jpg)

**Color:** The beer poured a golden yellow with a flimsy head that dissipated almost immediately. The liquid had a slight haze to it but overall was very appealing looking.  

![20260518_170851~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoiXZnM4Sf5Hhuq2n88keZwCksw5yrgYXSTKKGCH4bChMZkHJsSaGRZEACPFsLWWrRg.jpg)

**Nose:** A very light bouquet but predominantly a malty aroma of fresh white bread.

![20260518_170908~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Eq9WmiPdLASRVUf4k9HEd4eiL7Q3sPciW64ZGGSebuT1aQ8CBzgD4UMCdAV5Qy3Vmfg.jpg)

**Taste:** Dry, tangy and bitter. Well balanced. A light fruity quality of apple or pear.  Some mild hoppiness came through later. 

**Texture:** Lightly carbonated with small soft bubbles. A mildly weighty mouthfeel. Medium bodied. Good texture.  

![20260518_170707~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23xAXuGwohjrUaeiWy492MLhGjxSXYbqR8xfJieu6hWT7XBmU8TxPfufxFn7vEJ8wrbKt.jpg)

**Impression:** This beer didn't have a lot of aroma or taste but I liked it quite a bit. I would say that you could drink several of these in one sitting but there was a somewhat heavy quality about it, so maybe not. It was like liquid bread, though not to the extent of a double bock. It was interesting and I enjoyed it. I would buy it again.  

### Well thats it for now. Until next time. Thanks for stopping by. Cheers everyone!

body.body:
![e7a02e3c-d27f-4f09-aac9-684bf21e6b17.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVtQguXANmKEGAwn36RD6e6Ts59toRHRdq67dqQmrNFcg/e7a02e3c-d27f-4f09-aac9-684bf21e6b17.jpeg)


Hello everyone!

My name is Prettynazzy, and I’m excited to officially join the amazing Hive community. It feels great to be part of a platform where creativity, learning, and meaningful connections are encouraged.

I am from Nigeria, a country blessed with rich culture, talent, and creativity. I’m someone who enjoys learning, creating, and sharing ideas that can inspire and help others grow.
I graduated from the Enugu State University Of Science And Technology, department of food science and technology.

Professionally, I wear different hats. I am a UI/UX designer, a hairdresser, and also a Food Scientist. These different career paths have helped me become both creative and analytical in the way I think and work.

As a UI/UX designer, I enjoy creating beautiful and user-friendly digital experiences. I love exploring design ideas, improving user interactions, and learning more about technology and digital innovation.

As a hairdresser, I enjoy beauty, styling, and helping people feel confident about themselves. Hair styling is not just work for me — it’s an art and a form of self-expression. I look forward to sharing hairstyle inspirations, beauty tips, and experiences from my journey in the beauty industry.

Being a Food Scientist has also given me a deep interest in food, nutrition, food safety, and healthy living. I enjoy learning about food processing, quality, and creativity in food preparation. I hope to share food-related content, recipes, and educational insights that people will find useful and interesting.

Beyond my professions, I also enjoy personal growth, creativity, and connecting with like-minded individuals. On Hive, I plan to share:

* UI/UX design ideas and experiences.
* Beauty and hairstyling content.
* Food science and cooking-related posts.
* Lifestyle and personal development content.
* Creative and educational experiences from my daily life.

My goal here is to connect with people, learn from experienced creators, and consistently create meaningful and original content that adds value to the community.

I truly appreciate platforms like Hive that support creativity and give individuals the opportunity to express themselves and grow. I’m also grateful to the welcoming communities that make newcomers feel at home.

Thank you for taking the time to read my introduction. I’m looking forward to meeting amazing people, learning new things, and sharing my journey with you all.

I would like to commend @chichebem that recommended this awesome platform to me and also thank all those that that brought this great project alive
.

Feel free to follow me and let me know the kind of content you would love to see from my future posts.

Warm regards,
Prettynazzy

body.title: Introducing Faridastan | My First Step Into the Hive Community
body.body: /> Faridastan Hey 👋 I'm Farida I was born in Karachi, the famous city of Pakistan, located in Sindh province. But my roots are from Dera Ismail Khan (KPK) from father's side, and chaman(Balochistan) from mother's side. All my life and education was done in Karachi. Later when I was 23, I got married to an army officer, who was my neighbor so we started liking each other, and things ended with a nikah knot.

/> Im the eldest daughter and totally different from the other siblings and cousins, you can say the problem child, because of exquisive behavior. I belong to a business owner + Pathan family, there was no focus on education, nor any guidelines for higher education, my father was much liberal among my other uncles. So then after my college, I did a few diplomas and short courses. \-Like textile designing \-Fine arts, pottery , food and beverages diploma I was the first girl in the family who learned driving, even the first girl who did a love marriage.
/> My married life didn't turn out well. After 20 years of domestic abuse and violence, he divorced me ( no regrets happily divorced) with 3 children, 2 boys and 1 girl.

/> It was a rough ride after divorce, but allhamdulilah survived, I used to do 3 jobs, in the morning teaching at a special children school. After that I used to go to a studio for voice over for dramas, commercials or documentaries, and a night shift at a restaurant as a restaurant manager.

/> My life got settled when I got a job at a UK based NGO as a clinic manager, a handsome salary with benefits. But meanwhile my ex claimed to take kids away from me, I did not agree but my daughter decided to move because she wanted him also to have the responsibility, because he was not supporting when kids were with me. So I got alone , that was the hardest period of my life, any mother can understand. So at this point I started looking for a partner or a boyfriend as a revenge to my ex.

/> But my daughter was not happy with her decision , going back to her father's house was a mistake. He started torturing the kids. She was a brilliant child , since childhood she always toped in every class. She wanted to become a doctor, but her father refused to pay her medical college fees, and made her work at home, preparing food, washing dishes, laundry, cleaning etc. In this all mess one day she got a cardiac arrest while sleeping on 18 Dec 2019, and she left this world at only 21 years of age.

/> I was shattered, resigned from my job , spending my days and nights crying, visiting her grave almost everyday, spending hours and hours there. Suddenly, one fine morning I woke up and thought life could not be spent like this. I needed to work ,earn to survive, so I decided to leave Karachi and move to some other city, so Islamabad was my first choice. I sold my furniture, packed only 2 bags of belongings and came to Islamabad.

/> I stayed for a month with a friend, searched for a job and a place to live and luckily got both. So now I'm spending my life with my rules and enjoying my hobbies mostly traveling around. I love cooking. Here are a few dishes am sharing with my readers.
/> My second passion is painting. Art makes me feel accomplished.
/> I also like DIY projects. Some of the pottery I made.
/> I love to share my travelling experiences. A couple of days before I came from Chitral. I will share more about it in one of my travel posts.

/>

So, this was my life short biography. Now I'm living and well settled in Islamabad, 1,444 km away, from my home town, and family.

I have made some new friends here, but mostly, I love staying at home and keep myself busy with my hobbies, growing vegetables, invite friends over lunch or dinner so cooking gives me stratification, making crochet items, knitting or painting.

People around always asking me, don't you get bored living alone, but honestly as a Pisces I love my loneliness 😉.

I am thankful to @hilal09 for introducing to Hive and blogging. A whole new world for me, I am excited and looking forward to share my stories. Our friendship thrives further my friend. I miss being with you in Karachi.

See you soon.

body.title: How do we overcome our doubts and anxieties
body.body:
Doubts and anxieties have becomes part of this life, but God told us not to worry about life because He is always with us. When fear and uncertainty come, we should turn to God in prayer and believe that He cares deeply for us. Faith grows stronger when we spend time reading God’s word and remembering His promises. The Bible reminds us that God is always near and ready to help those who seek Him.

The Bible also teaches that peace comes from depending on God instead of relying only on our own understanding. Anxiety can make the heart heavy, but trusting in God brings comfort and strength. Jesus encouraged His followers not to worry about tomorrow because God knows our needs and watches over our lives. Through prayer, patience, and faith, we learn to overcome fear little by little.

body.title: 러브 스토리의 주제는 다양
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gf4648ef2593143c424828732458f0ce61e9e1b4ddf8d1d43a6f4e35a40ef718478adf11e96df4636c18261f00b636f74a6d55d230d596356ba37e5e01632b1b6_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 다양한 주제를 가진 러브 스토리

## 1. 시간 여행자의 사랑
### 줄거리
미래에서 온 시간 여행자가 과거의 한 여성을 사랑하게 된다. 하지만 그들은 서로 다른 시대에 살고 있어, 사랑을 이어가기 위해 시간의 법칙과 싸워야 한다.

## 2. 이웃의 사랑
### 줄거리
도시의 아파트에서 이웃으로 살게 된 두 사람이 우연한 사건으로 서로에게 끌리게 된다. 그들의 일상 속에서 피어나는 작은 사랑의 순간들이 따뜻하게 그려진다.

## 3. 첫사랑의 재회
### 줄거리
고등학교 시절의 첫사랑이 성인이 되어 우연히 다시 만난다. 과거의 추억과 현재의 변화가 얽히며, 그들은 서로의 마음을 다시 확인하게 된다.

## 4. 문화의 차이를 넘어서
### 줄거리
서로 다른 문화와 배경을 가진 두 사람이 사랑에 빠진다. 그들은 서로의 문화를 이해하고 존중하며, 사랑을 키워나가는 과정을 그린다.

## 5. 반려동물의 중재
### 줄거리
한 남자와 한 여자가 각각의 반려견을 통해 만난다. 두 반려동물이 서로 친해지면서, 주인들 또한 서로에게 끌리게 되는 따뜻한 이야기.

## 6. 직장 내 연애
### 줄거리
같은 회사에서 일하는 두 사람이 업무를 통해 가까워지게 된다. 직장 내의 다양한 갈등과 경쟁 속에서 그들은 서로의 사랑을 지켜나가야 한다.

## 7. 온라인 연애
### 줄거리
소셜 미디어를 통해 만난 두 사람이 비대면으로 사랑에 빠진다. 그들은 서로의 진짜 모습을 알기 위해 노력하며, 현실에서 만나기 위한 여정을 시작한다.

## 8. 운명적인 만남
### 줄거리
우연히 같은 버스를 탄 남자와 여자가 서로의 눈길을 끌게 된다. 그들은 운명적인 만남을 통해 서로의 삶에 큰 변화를 가져오게 된다.

## 9. 장애를 극복한 사랑
### 줄거리
신체적 장애를 가진 남자와 그를 사랑하게 된 여자의 이야기를 다룬다. 그들은 서로의 사랑을 통해 장애를 극복하고, 진정한 행복을 찾아간다.

## 10. 잃어버린 기억
### 줄거리
교통사고로 기억을 잃은 남자가 자신의 과거를 찾기 위해 노력하는 과정에서, 그의 첫사랑을 다시 만나게 된다. 그들은 서로의 사랑을 회복하기 위해 애쓴다.

---

이처럼 다양한 주제를 가진 러브 스토리는 독자들에게 여러 감정을 불러일으키며, 각기 다른 사랑의 형태를 탐구할 수 있는 기회를 제공합니다.

body.title: Sublime and Beautiful Sunday
body.body:
# Sublime and Beautiful Sunday This post is for #SublimeSunday is inspired by @c0ff33a and #BeautifulSunday is initiated by @ace108. I must admit now that the weather has been nicer, the most sublime and beautiful sight for me is catching a nice sunrise, and over the last week I have bene lucky to catch a few nice sunrises, and today will share some from an early morning walk at the port. Now Mother nature can put on such amazing displays but she keeps us on our toes as we never know what sunrise colors we may be fortunate to see. As I have mentioned I check the weather apps and look at what coulds they say are around and use that to pick where i may got for my morning walk. This day according to the weather apps I was not that hopeful of a nice sunrise, and decided to head to the port for a walk, I often go there as even if the sky is dull its a cool spot for photos, if I am thinking there is a god chance of nice sunrise colors I will oftenhead to a beach or pond as I do love sunrises caught over the water. but as it happenned that morning the apps or my interpretation of the clouds was wrong and I was lucky enough to catch a nice sunrise, and when not expecting it, then its even more sublime This shot was taken just behind where I parked my car that moning, the Halina M and the seastreak ferry building in the background

body.title: Sore Muscles & Sweats: My Sunday Morning Run
body.body: /> It's Sunday, and it means a day off from work. I always wanted to have my run in the morning to start my day. I woke up around 5:30 and prepared myself for my run. I wore my workout clothes and had my cup of coffee. I only ate a biscuit to energize myself and have my light breakfast. I started my stretching workout, and it lasted for almost 10 minutes. After that, I already hit the road and started running. The sun is already rising when I get out, but the neighborhood is still silent. There are no other people in the streets yet.

/> I finished my first 3 kilometers with my sweat going through my face. I could also feel the soreness in my feet, but I wanted to continue anyway. I am looking forward to running about 5 kilometers this morning, and I am almost there. The sun is already heating my whole body. I can see the beauty in our community when running. The rice fields and the scenic view of the mountains make my runs perfect. And I am always grateful to have such a community like this.

/> It's already 5 kilometers, and I am feeling tired in my feet. The sweat is all over my face and body. The sun even made my face turn red and hot. I still continued running until I hit more than 5 kilometers. Now, I am thinking of running for a few more minutes.

/> I got home tired and started my cool-down exercise for like 5 minutes. Then, I checked my Strava application and smartwatch to see how many kilometers I ran this morning. I was shocked that I had run for about 7.13 kilometers already. I was only looking forward to 5 kilometers. Despite being tired and feeling my feet sore, it still felt good running for more than an hour. It felt like it energized my body more and made me feel productive.

body.title: Hive FPL GW38 Preview -  Final day thriller!
body.body:
Welcome back to the final week of Hive FPL 25/26! 

The Premier League title race may have failed to go the distance but that is certainly not true of the leagues here on Hive - there is a huge amount still to play for! 


![Screenshot 2026-05-24 at 12.48.00.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hivefpl/23wC5VxMM6BQrGb2x6YZ5CCYdvuhGFfaTD8DELNw3Xp1Mtkf8tLaTrzkNnQKvUSKZ5bED.png)


I think we all pretty much understand the permutations of the Premier League relegation battle and the contest for the last couple of European spots so lets dive straight into our Hive fixtures. 

# Classic League

GW37 was very much like GW36 in that top team Blue Mooners continued to edge away from their closet rivals while the likes of Sutter Kane and Suffragette City continued to move up through the pack. 

If there were a couple of gameweeks after this one you might fancy one of those sides to carry the moment forward and make charge for the title but to me it feels like they/I have themselves a bit much to do in just a single week. 

While stranger things have happened then overturning a 23 point deficit, it's the battle for position below that and a larger cut of the prize fund that is the most intriguing. 


![Screenshot 2026-05-20 at 06.45.56.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hivefpl/23t77AdYXeKbNqnufQKZ5iPttWz2mrP7BxWEvQSeVDvgNYjLFRGHQ7Jz1U8oMkvSJkLnk.png)

The real question is which players are likely to have the biggest impact on these league standings in the final week? 

I've done an analysis of the top 14 teams in Hive FPL to see which Premier League stars are in most of these sides and which are less popular picks.

It won't come as any major surprise that the likes of Haaland, Fernandes and Gabriel are all in 13 out of the top 14 sides. Accepting that the choice of captain can still be major factor, whatever these players score is generally irrelevant in regards moving up and down the league. 

Van Heck, Saka, Semenyo and O'Riley are also very popular, appearing in the majority of those teams. 

However, there are few dark horses floating around out there who could be the difference makers come the final reckoning on Sunday. They include... 

**Dango (Suffragette City)** - The Brentford man scored a brace in his last outing to take him to 15 goal involvements for the season. Liverpool's shaky defence may offer further opportunities to add to his 134 points. 

**Gibbs-White (Racibo)** - The Forest man is absolutely flying at the moment and yet he's in only 1 of the top 14 teams in Hive FPL. 8 goals and 2 assists in his last 9 appearances have given him a shot at the WC Squad and he'll be keen to finish off in front of his home fans this weekend. 

**Palmer (Fire Power)** - It's been another diasppointing FPL season for Palmer but we all know what he's capable of. Another player who'll be keen to prove form and fitness to secure a spot at the World Cup. No goal involvement in his last 8, it almost feels like he's due one of those monster returns! 

**Trossard (Racibo)** - Again on Racibo's team, Trossard's late season form has been a major factor in the Gunners getting over the line. The concern for him and other Arsenal assets is whether Arteta opts to rest them ahead of the Champions League final. 

**VVD (Tengo Rangers)** - How the mighty have fallen! Van Dijk was once one of the most picked players in the game but Liverpool's performances across the course of the season have eroded confidence in their squad amongst FPL players. In fact, the Liverpool captain is 1 of just 2 Liverpool players to be found in the top 14 sides in Hive FPL, the other being Szoboszlai (in 2 squads). However VVD is still scoring points, he got 14 of them last week and his 6 goals this season are his best ever return. Could he pop up with a points haul in GW38 to send Tengo Rangers into the top 10? 

**Pedro Porro (Emeka4)** - Another defender who was very popular at the start of the season appearing in over 2 million fantasy teams for GW1. That number halved during the course of the season and only Emeka4 has kept faith in the Spaniard. Porro has delivered just a single clean sheet bonus in his last 18 game weeks and more concerning, just 4 goal involvements all season. Spurs desperately need a clean sheet and a goal. Emeka4 in 12th place wouldn't mind that either! 

# Hive FPL Cup

It's the final! 

Suffragette City ended Blue Mooner's hopes of a treble by beating them in the semis while Murima's cup dreams roll on after they overcame higher ranked opposition once again. Their late season charge has moved them up to 21st in the Classic League and perhaps more importantly 5th in H2H Division 2, more on that later... 

### @talesfrmthecrypt v @youngvic 


![Screenshot 2026-05-21 at 06.21.50.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hivefpl/23vhwW9e6uV2LeVUM4dBab2fXZE7FDEeZfdehYCgLgsXhvxPXnsiUBewXrYTXhTC7Byn4.png)

Both these sides have been putting up consistently good scores in recent weeks (I guess they'd have to in order to reach the final!) but from quite different squads. 

Murima have gone for the tactic of investing in 2 high price keepers while Suffragette City are married o Raya in goal. Could he be rested for this game? 

In fact more generally, Suffragette City are incredibly reliant on Arsenal's back line with 3 defensive assets from the champions squad. That looked like a decent call when it appeared the title race would go to the wire, is it now a liability? 

In midfield, Murima are probably left asking the same question over Rice while Aston Villa may opt to give Morgan Rogers a breather after his European heroics. 

Ngumoha is a nice wildcard pick and exactly the type of player who will and indeed has gotten minutes late in the season. Harry Wilson and Fulham's season has fizzled out a bit, no goal involvement in his last 6 matches for the Welsh wizard. With his contract about to expire, this is likely to be his last apperance for the Cottagers, can he sign off in style? 

Suffragette City have 4 in form differentials in their midfield. Collectively they've provided 14 goal involvements over the last 4 weeks catupluting them into this final and up to 4th in the Classic League. 

Upfront Murima have players who have enjoyed a strong finish to the season. Beto has 6 goal involvements in his last 7 appearances and faces a nervy Spurs team on the final day. Watkins too is in excellent form but like Rogers may be afforded a rest. 

Thiago will be up against a shaky Liverpool defence at an Anfield where the atmosphere is set to be interesting to say the least. Atmosphere will also be a factor for West Ham captain Jarod Bowen, they need their talisman to deliver at home to Leeds in order to pull off the great escape!

# H2H Division 1

It's a fascinating finish to the top flight after the top 2 both lost in GW37! 


![Screenshot 2026-05-21 at 06.41.05.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hivefpl/23t77F3dmvaaAbXpzdWJHPik2pAH29ELvWXitxygq8JtbsEhyC7FLQ7D3weLYf7u21Nvt.png)


Likodra FC recorded just 39 points in their defeat with 13 of their 15 man squad blanking at a crucial moment. However, BlockchainFPL were unable to capitalise as they lost to Cunha Do Sum4 Mee. 

Those 2 defeats also mean that Steve Herbae are ready to pounce and snatch the title should those 2 slip up once again. 

Likodra FC play Suffragette City (see above for their squad) a side 6 places below them in the H2H league but who have scored 199 more points across the course of the season - go figure! 

Blockchain are up against Red Cards of Rohan another very solid outfit and perenial contenders across the board while Steve Herbae take on 23/24 H2H champions Shamzy FC. It suggests that there will be more twists and turns over the course of Sunday afternoon! 


![Screenshot 2026-05-21 at 06.52.07.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hivefpl/23t77EzMYxck9VWCu14TRoZ4TN7hpgi75TofhbZCo7fRsGc1B9rmCcNNQyoJcx1ep4ANb.png)

It the bottom, huge wins for FC McKane and Formidable Milano in GW37 boosted their chances of surival. FC McKane can mathmateically still go down but it seems unlikely. 

Nonzy FC are sinking faster than Hive's price, no win in their last 5. 

Hungry Lions and Skander played out a draw in GW37 which did neither side any great favours. However, it's Skander whose destiny is no. longer in their own hands. 

Spero FC also choose a bad time to have a crap game week, delivering just 45 points in GW37 and sliding back into the relegation zone. It's their final match against Hungry Lions that we'll focus on now... 

### @sperosamuel15 v @gvkanten 


![Screenshot 2026-05-21 at 07.22.21.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hivefpl/23vsLFFMY5vcuTacZkGJTaWdVFhzJV5Y7NjB7b4g41P1yBs271euRAnBMozKsTeV2F4NC.png)

The equation for these 2 is quite simple - win and you stay up! 

For Hungry Lions, there is a world in which they can lose and still avoid a bottom 5 finish but presumably they'll be keen to get the job done themselves. 

Spero FC were going into the final game week of the 24/25 season chasing the Classic League title - they won that. Can they hold their nerve once again at the last reckoning this season? 

Defensively there are more similarities than differences between the 2 squads. The Bournemouth assets on both sides could be crucial. The Cherries were within seconds of holding City midweek for what would have been their 3rd clean sheet in a row but neither of these sides have regularly picked either Senesi or Petrovic in their starting XI's. 

In midfield Spero FC have in form Jack Hinshelwood playing at home for a Brighton side that needs a result to guarantee European football next season. Hungry Lions have Danny Wellbeck looking to do the same and against his boyhood club. 

Again, if I were Hungry Lions, I would worry about the involvement of the likes of Saka and Eze in the Arsenal match at Palace. Rotation seems highly likely in the circumstances. 

In Dewsbury-Hall and Calvert-Lewin, Hungry Lions have players who will be involved in those highly emotional matches at the moment of the table.

# H2H Division 2

Congratulations to Sutter Kane, Hasalaand and baring a near miracle Racibo who have all been promoted to Division 1 next season alongside Blue Mooners. 

Division 1 is already tough enough but it's going to be elite next season with those 4 joining! 

The only question that remains to be answered is who will join them? 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hivefpl/23t8DBnQEwucZMyDMLatQx3avhJ5JyJ1Vp2AF3GAubVZcM6awqXz9DZrqfmawzwkqxahw.png)

Murima, who of course play in the Cup Final this weekend (see above) are in pole position. A win will be enough for them to be promoted and to be honest it's difficult to see that they won't achieve that. 

They play bottom of the league, 7 wins all season, Sportin. 

As you can imagine, this is a team that hasn't been updated in a very long time. However, they do still have 14 players who are very likely to score points this weekend so they are not quite the lame ducks that you sometimes find in this situation. 

Sportin opted for Salah over Haaland in their initial pick and he's had the captain's armband ever since. Can he deliver one last hurrah in front of his home crowd and torpedo Murima's hopes of promotion?

# GW38 Tips and Picks 


The joys of the final week. If you've got transfer or chips it's now of never!

##### <u>Hangovers and headaches </u>

This time last week, it was looking as though we'd be heading into a nervy afternoon at both ends of the table but with Arsenal clinching the title on Tuesday evening without kicking a ball in anger it means we're left with a few damp squibs in their place. 

For the Gunners in particular, they can now take their foot off the gas this weekend and focus entirely on their Champions League Final against PSG. 

Reports that the players were up into the early hours of Wednesday are understandable. How many of them are going to be in tip top shape to take on Palace? 

Of course Palace themselves have a cup final to focus on! 

For those that do play it could end up being one of the gentlest games of football you've ever seen as players simply go through the motions in order to avoid an injury. 

Man City then take on an Aston Villa side that didn't make it back home until Thursday and have already enjoyed an open top bus tour and player party since then. 

With Champions League football assured, I'm not sure how committed that group of players will be either and I'd expect significant squad rotation once again. 

##### <u>Where it matters most</u>

West Ham v Leeds and Spurs v Everton sees matches in which 2 teams are fighting for their respectively lives. 

The Hammers have to win and hope that Spurs lose in order to stay up. They were timid against Newcastle in the early stages of their last match and paid the price, they will have to come out swinging in this match so expect drama and hopefully for FPL players some goals! 

Spurs home form has been diabolical for the last 18 months. They are by no means assured of anything against even an Everton side who have failed to win in their last 6. 

There is a world in which Liverpool don't qualify for the Champions League. It'd take a big loss for them at home to Brentford and a big win for Bournemouth at Forest but still something to play for. 

The Liverpool and Villa results will then have a big impact on whether 6th is good enough for a Europa League spot or a Champions League spot. If Villa finish 5th, 6th place goes into the hat with Europe's elite - Barcelona vs Bournemouth?

There is then a massive crush beneath them for the remaining European spots. Sunderland take on Chelsea. The Blues know a win will get them some form of European football next season but a loss opens the door for Sunderland to grab one of those spots. 

##### <u>Best Differential Picks</u>

Being the last game week, it is a complete free hit with your transfers. No need to worry how they'll go next week, it's all on Sunday! 

**Zian Flemming** - 10 Premier League goals in a struggling side is very respectable return for the Burnley forward. Usually FPL managers would be targeting the bottom 2 for points but of course this weekend they play each other. Flemming is in just 0.5% of teams and a very affordable £5.3mil 

**Richarlison or Tel** - If you're looking for guaranteed starters then Spurs are a decent place to visit. You can't rotate the squad when you don't have one! If they are to secure just their 3rd home win of the season then you'd anticipate one or both of these 2 will be involved in a goal. The Brazilian has 15 goal involvements for the season including 3 in his last 4 while Tel has managed 2 in his last 3 and came close to adding to that at Chelsea on Tuesday. 

**Kroupi Jnr** - The secret has been out on this kid for a while and the real question remains as to whether Bournemouth can keep a teenager who has scored 13 Premier League goals in 25/26. Securing Champions League football next season might just convince the Frenchmen that has immediate development is best served by another season on the South coast. He's scored in 5 of his last 7 matches. 

**Brobbey**- When you consider that he didn't start a Premier League match for Sunderland until December then Brobbey's return of 8 goal involvements ( including 7 goals) is very respectable and if afforded opportunities from the start of next season, he's definitely one to keep an eye on. I think the Stadium of Light will be rocking for this one and his physicality might be too much for a shaky Chelsea backline to handle.

> Hello, my friends, wherever you are, as usual, I hope you are all healthy and happy, so you can go about your daily activities smoothly, and I hope you all have a wonderful day. In this meeting, I return to this beloved community to share some images. Today, one insect caught my attention again because of its striking color, a combination of colors that I personally find quite strange. I think this insect is a type of cricket, but because it is still young, its color still stands out very clearly. This caught my attention and I decided to take some pictures of it perched on wild leaves. Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad estuvo llena de momentos interesantes. Empecé mi recorrido por un parque que suele ser un punto de encuentro. Allí conocí a un anciano llamado Don Manuel, que tiene una increíble colección de postales antiguas. Nos detuvimos a charlar y me mostró algunas de sus favoritas; cada una de ellas tenía una historia fascinante detrás. Es impresionante cómo un simple objeto puede guardar tantos recuerdos. Más adelante, pasé por una pequeña plaza donde había un grupo de artistas pintando murales. Me llamó la atención un mural en proceso que representaba la diversidad de la ciudad, con colores vibrantes y figuras alegóricas. El artista, una joven llamada Sofía, me contó que este mural es parte de un proyecto comunitario para embellecer el barrio y dar voz a sus habitantes. La combinación de historias personales y el arte que encuentra en cada rincón hace que cada caminata sea una nueva aventura. Sin duda, hoy fue un día enriquecedor que reafirmó lo mucho que se puede aprender simplemente caminando y conectando con las personas a nuestro alrededor. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: A bridge of peace, nestled in the greenery.
body.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWQfDcEzFpB9zhdmmLx8P3Km1yqh2soKw1FdHzTiVN2UN/1779618324293.jpg) Wherever the green touches the horizon, the mind wants to get lost in the wild. Away from the hustle and bustle of mechanical life, every corner of our rural Bengal is like a living canvas. While walking along the rural roads recently, I was faced with such a peaceful and beautiful scene of nature that I couldn't help but frame it. Today I am sharing that beautiful moment with you. When I look at the picture, the first thing that catches my eye is the vast rice fields. The rice grains seem to whisper to each other in the gentle breeze. Crossing this green carpet of fields, a small bridge or culvert painted in red and white comes into view a little ahead. Our rural brothers and sisters know very well how important these small bridges are in rural communication. But not only because of necessity This red-and-white bridge creates a wonderful contrast with the surrounding greenery, which enhances the beauty of the entire scene. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbdGVpvExEHszkhxSpUrAStyfABMQneTZ12vdaLwcyLAY/1779618324613.jpg) The red and white pillars standing in a row on both sides of the bridge seem to define the boundaries of the walkway. The lonely electric pole standing in the distance and the light foggy or sunny atmosphere of the sky create a rural solitude. And the peaceful environment It has been more clearly portrayed. When fatigue sets in with the city's brick walls and honking car horns, this kind of free air and unfettered green eyes act as makeup and medicine for the mind. This simple form of nature reminds us that the true joys of life are hidden in the simplest things. The smell of rice and the touch of earth on this quiet afternoon are truly incomparable. For those of you who are immersed in the hustle and bustle of the city, please let us know in the comments section how you felt about this rural scene. I hope the picture brings some peace to your mind.

body.title: Bharwa Karela Recipe || Spiced Onion-Tomato Stuffed Bitter Gourd
body.body:
## <center> Hello all Bloggers </center>

Hi guys...! How are you all, I hope you all are well.
Today my in this blog I will share with you guys a new recipe. 
Last time I shared the recipe of Rustic Yogurt Chicken Masala, I am happy you all liked my recipe and gave me great feedback. 
Today I am going to share with you guys the recipe of Bharwa Karela.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWgTTk4NxRvTUsac2GFoVWBuuY2WYunHDCymK3j2oh7aZ/1779614873269.png)

***

## <center> Ingredients </center>

-  Bitter Gourds ( 500 grams )
-  Oil       ( 1 cup or for fry)
-  Onion  ( 300 grams )
-  Tomato  ( 200 grams )
-  Tamarind sauce ( 2 sp )
-  Salt & Turmeric ( according to taste )
-  Ground red chili & Chili flexes ( according to taste )
-  Hot spice ( 1 sp )
-  Green Chillies ( 3 )

***

## <center> Process </center>

Since I have Sundays off from college, I usually make some new recipe on Sundays and share it with you guys.
So, let me quickly tell you how to make this recipe step by step.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeMyFrtnG15tHV1JNjpmZUXcognrPPHTWTyNxYrcB1RvY/1779614916853.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmULfFGf73fVTrtSjsBYvHQM1u5pt6mpgdfGm9ddJ638Be/1779614916908.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPvuRkuVGpZwGC3QrYgf85Vs1rpXNtTGWb8iQ7MRmgLx9/1779614916959.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmexXoTmwYuvN4yqob8YuZ6NQGTrZDQWae7cGsicp9XLcg/1779614917012.jpg)|
|-|-|

I scraped the top layer of the bitter gourd and then salted them in separate pots.
Left them for about half an hour so that the salt could remove their bitterness.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbPsJt1muamS92ZC1YXPJpUKXrHxrvCvfRsa8RPV19YRq/1779614917059.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdUQ92tcozXkx3rY3pvLzu3t3C1YwFBBVu3BMabDasrGf/1779615026339.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVB31kCgcZjeq4SbK2qivfL3f2TYM18gsuogm26CXgeoY/1779615026437.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRfzHRYjMTtNudWaTXuX7XtrTQhveo8apKb4Rvc7DCaMF/1779615026490.jpg)|
|-|-|

Now I washed them well, dried the bitter gourds with the help of a cloth and squeezed the scraped bits well. 
I cut the bitter gourds in the middle and removed the seeds from inside them.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQWAeMJB4abTuMt488dWwsiFcGyQQyU2iaMUe9W26dRU2/1779615026547.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPReWkyf6LUtnTc8bB4LDNxXdhtQXqscKvzvtRQvJqGto/1779615026598.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ3tSjmBV5m3HCZbXE5c2SKfpNSREhyNQvKwxf2HY9t58/1779615060125.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaJycd69AwC7LW2YH986LNFAdfWyGDH2D9Y8MyHh4sars/1779615060185.jpg)|
|-|-|

Now it was time to make the masala for the filling.
So for that I poured cooking oil into a pot and then added scraped bits to it and fried them well. 
When they turned brown, I added onions to it.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVjnreS4yZjpUf8CFyTzhpicsTgN2U3Kj3PrLqJFxtAq8/1779615060251.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdv3WM4f5S6UXuShZCgMvbHr75UN4cFUXcYnBEaMe9S3L/1779615060300.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWNUFJWesjJMKhxR16vtzg2zhmbZCTDyRaRGPa5KWV1hM/1779615060351.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUaXNFCPtKaziR2BV8S83vQXKWtAVnLnboNJ69kYh7JDC/1779615099342.jpg)|
|-|-|

Then I added tomatoes and ground spices to it, which included salt, turmeric, chili flakes and crushed red chili. 
After that, I added finely chopped green chillies to it and cooked it.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRZ3UzyWLVMKPnxc8Ha7iTNgXZtmXT8tqihkkvJAjprvk/1779615099402.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTuGphgniLbr5TqEBtYRqLiAXDKbExvALbihE8TkGUgQ9/1779615099459.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX38g5Mid6UmjFdL3RqJ7hpdgaLMX6XFb9fgnyJuEZwN5/1779615099511.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRRrTdLQrHLcLkzs9DNh5F6mhbTVBBuxPQ4MBoHVMuNEY/1779615099565.jpg)|
|-|-|

Now I added tamarind sauce to it and after cooking for some time I sprinkled hot spices on it.
So this is my filling masala is completely ready now it's time to fill the bitter gourds.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaePuqaTh3Uzt5Agitbr4RrFiNoEVxBsQtAC69779uUu3/1779615130969.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmco55Nv9kPQt9TqNbFDfjeem5Rgo7FrKSC1PGHtj4C9Yo/1779615131026.jpg)|
|-|-|

For this, I filled the bitter gourds with this filling masala. 
And wrapped a thread over it so that the filling does not come out while frying. 

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTvuiCd2znjvbsgDjzPjfm6Jtf85aTroXNc16GWdkDu9o/1779615131081.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRMazY7BKq3n9QLueP22646X9MZsx35QKsncLRoeNZw58/1779615131134.jpg)|
|-|-|

Now I heated cooking oil in a pan. When the oil was hot, I put the filled bitter gourds in the hot oil to fry. 
I fried them on a normal flame and when they turned brown, I took them out of the oil with the help of a sieve.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbuLPEkc4c2bjui1CDxnyerKES39cJXGbnp7TyF6mKaE9/1779615131194.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd8qQ3Bx5KpyiJJRkb5MxGHyGWTNnffwkNg55oeJKfRed/1779615211653.jpg)|
|-|-|

So now I've removed the thread from them, so here are my stuffed bitter gourds ready.

The texture looks beautifully crisp while the masala inside appears juicy and full of flavor — a complete homemade desi masterpiece that looks both comforting and restaurant-worthy.

***

## *Final Look:*

These crispy stuffed karelas are the perfect example of how traditional cooking can turn simple ingredients into something truly special.
The golden fried exterior, flavorful onion-tomato filling, green chillies, and even the perfectly cooked scraped karela shavings blended inside the stuffing make every bite rich, smoky, and deeply satisfying. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPHWw1mUQpzC1tsD3G8VVRFXNHebnqkhWY3KVHJnYwKUS/1779615211709.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb36Rx76BQtqUA9JHdMszzqVYKhnurARPGsLXcjPAzuDs/1779615211768.jpg)

***
***

I hope you all like my recipe. I will wait for your comments. Now we will meet in the next post with a new recipe. Until then, Good Bye...🤗
