body.title: Following The Stream Up To The Ridge View In Sitio Alongon Paniangan Manticao, Misamis Oriental
body.body: >\nA quite and enjoyable adventure has been done again and for today's Nature travel blog of mine was at Sitio Alongon Paniangan Manticao, Misamis Oriental Mindanao Philippines. This place is one of the Barangay of the Municipality and it is located at the forestry and mountainous part of the Municipality of Manticao. Sitio Alongon is one of the place where border lines and points located. This Sitio is at the middle between the two Barangays of Manticao; Barangay Poblacion and Barangay Paniangan. The place contains lots of views like an old stream and a great overlooking views where neighboring mountains can be seen.\n</div class=\

>

![IMG_20260524_113801.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaSZWLruPasviASJBrX2VRQGzus28NqingCZtq4XxEjG8/IMG_20260524_113801.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260524_114145.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWvy2J1dm2Py2LYFCGG1XeNdhYZrX4dN8MyvhLeeWXvng/IMG_20260524_114145.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260524_113516.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbm3XTC3taHguU7LR8ZY4eSkRSN25QAR2zMVN2hF7uv6g/IMG_20260524_113516.jpg)
</center>
All of the views here are very Natural and as I reached the area I felt very amazed of the great relaxing views I've seen. The place at the old stream is very cold and relaxing and few water was still flowed down. I decided to touched the water and it was very cold. The small splash of water comes from the top of the stream brings a sound to the place aside of the sound of branches swaying because of the winds, and tweeting of birds hiding at the thick branches of the trees. The tall trees and wide big chunks of stones compost of silica rocks, are perfectly grows at the side of stream just like a man-made brick pile. Few big roots from the trees sticking at the big chunks of rocks and wavely rocks walls and floors where water always flows down heading at the tall cliff connects to the river. Aside of that, few rocks pools and moss also found in here bringing an attractiveness and great views of the stream.

![IMG_20260524_114041.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSv3GTKciiLDs8dC8XDWAEQh6kTdTZFsdVmRK5q4UuDxM/IMG_20260524_114041.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260524_113401.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPj545mCqBKr7dQLtWM9aMJetjnLXMKjLLxUdetVpF5aE/IMG_20260524_113401.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260524_113145.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNZxb7wX3gGTRb9gbTEbkjVKh5xUg31RdJAHm6KnGn9C4/IMG_20260524_113145.jpg)
</center>
As I continuously exploring the areas, I felt very tired that is why I decided to take a minute rest here in this Paradisiacal place in the part of the stream. It is very perfect to rest here because of the relaxing views and a quite and peaceful that we can feel. While resting, I noticed a whole at the rocks filled with water and fallen dry leaves. It might be very useful to all residents back in the days when the streams filled with lots of flowing water. Aside of that, a giant rocks covered with moss and a small amount of water flows. Resting in this area is truly very perfect and enjoyable, tall trees can be seen standing majestically and an old rocky road trail that leads to the far side of the mountain. It only compost small amount of soil that is why most the place here are solid Silica rocks. 

![IMG_20260524_113930.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNTH8Ykc2xdd8SBZnzWbC9U1P9Krs9S6sB8i6oCEiL8Vu/IMG_20260524_113930.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260524_112910.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbENd4fccososKGvnCRCcWsdrPhEuNUjFDscxRJtfHhzL/IMG_20260524_112910.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260524_112235.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYRp3GbhRUzGciJZBNwoRyUnnaom4eMTH6TfPo3DDYanp/IMG_20260524_112235.jpg)
</center>
It takes almost an hour before I reached the parts of the place I wanted to go. I felt very excited to visit because of the Natural wonderful views. The sceneries are very beautiful and contains an overlooking views of the far mountains. An agricultural plants like coconuts and a tall and majestic trees that helps the areas to become cool and more relaxing because of its shady spots. Even if it is located at the top of the mountain, there are also wide plains can found where agricultural grows. Camping and picnic activities are perfect here because of the open field spaces suitable for those who loves mountain climbing and Nature travel adventure. I felt that I am at the top of the World, touching the sky because of the high mountains I've climbed. This big trees helps wildlife animals like birds to have a place to live. I never thought that despite of the place compost of solid rocks, there are still few agricultural plants grows. Wild grass and dry moss almost covered silica rock surfaces and rocky road trails. 

![IMG_20260524_112742.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNUi3GTUKjXkCPC7MjrcQmamSUwnwSQBrguX7KdybEw2y/IMG_20260524_112742.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260524_112515.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPyjUyEpyzjMBoeyaDBytVtwJQX3ioyaf61KfNfefmFaA/IMG_20260524_112515.jpg)
</center>
During my Nature Travel Adventure, I really felt exciting and amazed of the place I've seen. More overlooking views and relaxing spots I saw and aside of that, More relaxing bonding with Nature. For those who loves nature travel, Sitio Alongon is the best and perfect destination and it is very worth it to travel and visit here specially during summer season. If you want to do moto-trail, it is also perfect here because of the road trail leads to the top of the mountain.

Until next post, have a nice and safe travel to everyone.

body.title: Curly Potato Balls Stuffed with Skipjack Tuna Flakes
body.body:
> ![20260517_120854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xAga5WUjNCyMeHbhbFr5ty6Fg6n8wchQdYDB5M1RBPZMyi9rVrxT8HdnCkcv8mnguhp.jpg)
Foodies, today I’m going to show you how to make a simple snack recipe: crispy potato balls stuffed with skipjack tuna floss, which I made in a [previous post](https://peakd.com/hive-120586/@nurfay/dried-skipjack-tuna). I used the leftover floss from when we cooked it yesterday. Afterward, my husband suggested I turn it into something else. That’s how I came up with this simple potato-based recipe. Crispy potato balls stuffed with skipjack tuna floss are an inspiration for those of you who want to enjoy potatoes in a different way. As you know, there are countless recipes for potatoes, including this crispy potato version. By using instant noodles, I made the potatoes extra crispy on the outside. Of course, they’re soft, savory, and slightly spicy with the tuna floss filling. ![20260517_120920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zGs7eYbjBi8nhiD9yq3osBt1tY8NQ9KTbeiKLrCSUtoNoKP1m3ZrsWCyM32NMDL9maU.jpg) Shaped into balls with a simple filling, they’re then dipped in egg and topped with noodles. The crispiness of the outside combined with the softness of the potato layer makes this snack very different from the usual. Of course, the process is very quick—you can make them anytime and anywhere.
Ingredients
![20260517_095108.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpT57ms8XFPBDb8Q1PdTYMTzNx2o8nNH6QqnC9T5LmG9bi22pSj8DzsjviAEH441aUJ.jpg)
2 potatoes 1 carrot 1 packet of instant noodles ¼ teaspoon salt ¼ teaspoon bouillon 1 clove of shallot 1 egg
Preparation Instructions
Boil the potatoes and carrots until tender and fully cooked, then mash them, adding salt and bouillon powder.

> ![20260517_092703.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vi42RCA1XJMxeLrkR5Dauwet365As7RvXiEmqQ8ow6mbamvBvcnpPuwYQQqfRzRTnSA.jpg)
Next, add the fried onions, then stir and mash; I like to keep the mixture slightly chunky.

> ![20260517_100121.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xVRJUa5nwvYiPFcGJfr8iT6KWAN4jTSf1BTHpgtiaQH6PfeeR6RavpxzmebtQdDk9vC.jpg) ![20260517_100652.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tmSAJxo1dxnWaiFhwJBPmPqPdo3TSB3X9NLYUEzYziMFiy7UzkAFgnVW2dnofMmWTnM.jpg)
Shape the mixture into balls and add the shredded beef filling inside, sealing all sides so the filling doesn’t leak out.

> ![20260517_100813.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23uQzxRupYX2yArFsotKR2V3Y8irFSyiswTBE4Qp4rubfHi2JhVNU9sH5uVMRKcL4cTFM.jpg)
Dip in egg, then coat in crushed instant noodles until fully covered.

> ![20260517_101809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tSYgrQvV6PdfAmYyRYaTBN5om8bmorJcHBp3G5iAq9TU9DrskzS2QNetgE9oDEKhNk6.jpg) ![20260517_101827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23x1DQ2a4ECVGG7wwkNtF6RwyFQPU9E1JhSYNHf1YXshjZmmNYG44LKfzbdyRhu5GSKBN.jpg)
Then fry in hot oil until golden brown or until the outside is crispy.

> ![20260517_102301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23u64tbupMyvVXS8qgr3osvsCbAPsiLUf3nzPzUiSeUGKxXZ5PyqKtJQDoFyE9A6h8F27.jpg)
Result
![20260517_120908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xVTgk7318aoicnQ7oPgr2dRcHsWKycsiZR3peDyDmSfKAoTd339FS2x8iCtxeTHYZvD.jpg) Serve with sauce or mayonnaise on top. Look at the result—it’s so beautiful; the combination is just right. The savory shredded meat pairs perfectly with the authentic flavor of the crispy fried instant noodle crumbs. Everything is perfect—the flavor combination is truly unique, in my opinion.
|![20260517_120926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23ynmZnkpE1vZD6Vc4zHjXaX5e42iwb1yfdEFQKjD9knhWnxkMZWh1ZMpYThnMdsbNQdg.jpg)|![20260517_120935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/241tr233xBfPR5PaGLayrRiMpAKsMYuRsaJ7QXTrp6Yw6bwwRRqMnTR89TdMFQRAwhtsd.jpg)|![20260517_121037.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xAkDGjwxkQDMhyZ7nvuFGYKJR3zXUTmfQZGLYCB23Z5Y67hihnqFspHZXqgKL5KRV1b.jpg)| |-|-|-|
If you love savory, spicy flavors with a crispy texture, you must try this recipe—it’s simple yet incredibly delicious. Best of all, you can also store it in the freezer since the process is so easy. Give this recipe a try—I guarantee you’ll love it.
![20230506_212938_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTv75jgyP5CSod1jCZoAPbPAnA7mSYtNJUa33KmuA4GgtmxGNNUyyxR9bq8gsiGS8qF.png)

body.title: Knowing the future//Mcgi topic review
body.body:
The bible made us to understand that only God knows the future. God created human being with a limited wisdom about the future. In the book of Isaiah, God says that He declares “the end from the beginning” because His wisdom is beyond human knowledge. This reminds believers to trust God instead of depending on fortune tellers, superstition, or fear about tomorrow.

Jesus also taught His followers not to worry too much about the future. He encouraged people to seek God first and live faithfully each day. While the future may seem uncertain to us, Christians believe that God guides the lives of those who trust in Him. Prayer, faith, and obedience help believers walk confidently even when they do not know what lies ahead.
https://youtu.be/Xto8QfUW0xE?si=N4snsxq6iL0Pu2zJ
The Bible also warns against trying to know the future through ungodly means such as divination, sorcery, or consulting mediums. Instead, believers are encouraged to depend on God’s Word and the guidance of the Holy Spirit. 

>“Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.” Proverbs 3:5.

body.title: Estridencia Sonora
body.body:
> **
Estridencia Sonora
** En un masivo Universo, un observador neutro, cuya identidad no tiene relevancia, escuchaba con atención el espacio profundo, fue en ese momento cuando recibió una estridencia sonora, un choque se estaba produciendo o ya se había producido en el pasado, en función de la distancia de procedencia podía darse en un tiempo u otro. Dos mundos trataban de unirse, de acoplarse, de entenderse, aunque en su origen no fuesen lo mismo, ni siquiera similares. Pero, no solo se percibía esa estridencia sonora, sino también partículas, ondas gravitacionales, producto del choque de fuentes de energía desconocidas en una lucha más mental que física. Nuestros implicados procedían de dos mundos diferenciados, tenían discrepancias en la forma de ver y entender los conceptos y el mundo en general, y colisionaban repetidas veces para tratar de entenderse, ya que había algo que los atraía, algo que no era necesario ser producto de la razón cósmica y al mismo tiempo algo que los distanciaba. 1. Musicalidad Este es un concepto importante en la historia que nos contempla, la musicalidad es la capacidad y sensibilidad humana para percibir, comprender y expresar la música. No es solo escuchar o poder seguir un ritmo, sino poder conectar emocionalmente con el sonido. Pero esa musicalidad no es igual para cualquier ser. La estridencia recibida por nuestro observador, era producto de la diferente forma de entender la música de ambos seres, los cuales trataban de conseguir una armonía sonora única, una que les llevase al entendimiento, la razón y la empatía, a pesar de las múltiples disonancias que entre ellos pudiera haber, y de hecho, las había. Cada uno interpretaba las cosas a su manera, cada uno creía en su concepto de musicalidad, cada uno luchaba con el otro y consigo mismo por tratar de que el otro pudiera entender su concepto sonoro, sus sentimientos, inquietudes, pensamientos, su propio yo. De esa lucha irradiaba una enorme cantidad de energía, que se perdía en el espacio profundo y que jamás volvería a ser recuperada. Tal vez la musicalidad mutua pudiera transformarse en amor algún día… 2. Arritmia En un lejano y maldito planeta, en un tiempo y lugar determinado, existió un filósofo que dijo: “El corazón tiene razones que la razón no entiende”. De esa frase se sacaron múltiples interpretaciones, y de ella se entiende el problema de nuestra estridencia sonora, la cual se traducía en una arritmia o incapacidad para sincronizar a dos seres muy diferentes, pero que un día quisieron unirse para tratar de compartir algo que va más allá de la razón. ¿Y por qué ese empeño? Solo ellos lo sabían, solo ellos tenían la capacidad de mirarse y saber que aunque eran diferentes, había algo que los había unido, algo que querían compartir, porque sabían que era beneficioso en sus vidas. Un sentimiento difícil de comprender hasta para ellos mismos, llamémoslo energía. La arritmia no dejó de producir fricciones, irregularidades en la forma de entender sus mentes, trataron siempre de empatizar, de saber lo que al otro le preocupaba, lo que le dolía, lo que le apasionaba, pero era complicado. En un mundo en el que lo principal era lo material y la imagen que se daba de uno mismo, no había mucho tiempo para la armonía, para la comprensión del otro hasta un nivel, digamos, cósmico. 3. Armonía Sus partículas colisionaban, su musicalidad era imperfecta, su disonancia evidente y sus sentimientos chocaban provocando un caos espacial sin precedentes y que era percibido en toda la galaxia. En el espacio todo parece tranquilo, todo se muestra relativamente estable, pero en realidad no es así y lo que impera es el más absoluto caos, pero ese caos crea y origina cosas maravillosas y solo el caos es capaz de mostrarnos cosas tan bellas en la naturaleza. Algunos lo llaman Dios y otros lo llaman Caos. El caos los unió y juntos crearon más caos aún, pero ese caos estuvo precedido por momentos de armonía, de dulzura, de pasión e incluso de amor. Hubo una alta comunicación y una confianza absoluta y ambos se hacían más bien que mal, ya que su dolor previo, procedente de otras experiencias vitales, era contrarrestado por todo lo bueno que se daban, de forma que, existió la musicalidad entre ellos y en el trato que se daban, hasta el punto de sentirse muy importantes el uno hacia el otro. Se puede decir que, aunque hablaban diferentes idiomas, en muchas cosas sí conseguían hablar el mismo, aunque eso quedara opacado por disonancias internas, propias y ajenas, que llegaron a enturbiar una maravillosa unión de dos seres diferenciados. Sus miradas lo decían todo, con ellas eran capaces de expresar más de lo que otros muchos no llegarían a poder comunicar jamás. Podían compartir emociones, intenciones e incluso mensajes completos sin la necesidad de emitir un solo sonido. De ahí se desprendía que podía existir una conexión profunda y pura. Además, en muchos sentidos, se llegaban a compenetrar de una forma casi perfecta, en muchas ocasiones llegando hasta un éxtasis cercano al nirvana, consiguiendo una armonía digna del mejor de los músicos. 4. Coda ¿Qué le podemos pedir al Caos? Solo que su desorganización nos lleve a la belleza, tú eres producto de ese caos, has nacido gracias a él, y es el responsable de que un ser tan bello haya nacido. Eres la máxima representación de esa belleza creada por la naturaleza de forma arbitraria, y que, por numerosas casualidades de la vida, te llevaron hasta mí. A veces las cosas no son más que una bonita casualidad y tú lo has sido para mí. Primero me embaucaron tus suaves y dulces movimientos, verte danzar era un regalo para mis ojos, seguías el ritmo de la música a la perfección, y yo, siempre detrás, tratando de no desentonar demasiado, intentando que mi cuerpo no produjera demasiadas disonancias en tus ojos. Luego fue tu mirada, siempre me ha encantado cómo me miras, cómo me mirabas, con un contraste entre incredulidad, debido a mis rarezas, y deseo de tenerme cerca, de tenerme dentro de ti, ¿dónde mejor se puede estar? Ya lo sabes tú. Más adelante tu voz, su sonoridad y lo que transmitían tus palabras, siempre un mensaje positivo, alegre y divertido. Y al final fue tu cuerpo, precioso, suave, esbelto y que llegaba a encajar a la perfección con el mío en cualquier contexto posible. Solo el Universo sabe lo que me has hecho sentir, lo que me has enseñado y lo que me has ayudado a evolucionar. El caos estuvo de nuestra parte, gracias al caos pude conocerte, pero al mismo tiempo es él el responsable de esta enorme y maldita estridencia sonora. Me gusta tu swing, me encanta nuestro swing, me enamora mi Chica Swing… [Mi blog](https://hive.blog/@simonmaz)

body.title: [ENG-SPN] Guardians of the Gorge / Guardianes del Desfiladero
body.body:
![DSCN1100.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Eoc8xHHoBwtNNdDttVeM4XVdotCLtkpaJz9EF63v9yC1mmgr3pXMf4FpTP3jghB7Ur1.JPG)

At the Hermitage of the Virgin of Las Eras, we find another of those curious Romanesque buildings. Located outside the walls of an old medieval town—in this case, Santa Gadea del Cid—it leaves the interested visitor wondering about its possible Templar origins, which, of course, as has happened so often along our routes, are not supported by any official documentation.

![DSCN1083.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EpCCNZM7V67hxhECBnynQum5pNVjRQGRQ7YykxCamKNj2T4r7GufWQeTuGTNs1bfGzc.JPG)

We are in the vicinity of Pancorbo, of its deadly gorge, which has claimed so many pilgrims' souls before they could complete the milestones of their sacred path—in few places is the arcane reference to the truly unpredictable ways of the Lord so evident as here—and also a stone's throw from the border of the Álava Plain, where, aside from the wine, the ancient sanctuaries, and the Byzantine architecture—a term I particularly prefer to Romanesque—one can also enjoy the sight of those enigmatic testimonies from the times of the Great Flood, which, like Sorginetxe or the Witch's House, are the dolmens.

![DSCN1105.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Eo8VDwt9BkMJNJ2m2FENgRigCWpeo3UXpPaVpuHffyBinXb8bQRmh5YBG4AVCxkoZMn.JPG)

Little can be said about this pseudo-Templar hermitage, which retains much of its original structure, except for the detail that, unlike many others of its kind and style, the exterior sculpture of its corbels and the small capitals of its windows feature well-defined, though entirely anonymous, faces. Their imperturbable hieratic stillness makes it difficult not to recall the words of Juan García Atienza, a researcher of \

when, referring to those other figures located in the strange cloister of the Monastery of San Juan de la Peña, he stated that they gave the impression of contemplating Eternity.

![DSCN1066.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoH2HVA9SEd8xWVSSDwue2WoqQwF9cvSD77UC9rcYGtAiMxrDdHizDmZMv6tp1gnE8N.JPG)

Tenemos, en la ermita de la Virgen de las Eras, otra de esas curiosas construcciones románicas, que, situadas extramuros de una antigua villa medieval, en este caso, Santa Gadea del Cid, hace sufrir al visitante interesado con la incertidumbre relativa a unos posibles orígenes templarios, que, por supuesto, como en tantas ocasiones nos ha sucedido a lo largo y ancho de nuestras rutas, no están avalados por sello de garantía de la documentación.

![DSCN1067.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Ep7xT5AJQFYYH1B1DZSmBDytJvDwrUtyQYSbrKinUAeUNUE4Vrh5wFHfcSfMUjzECPQ.JPG)

Estamos en las inmediaciones de Pancorbo, de su mortal desfiladero, que tantas almas de peregrinos se ha llevado antes de completar los hitos de su camino sagrado -en pocos lugares como aquí se pone de manifiesto la arcana referencia a lo imprevisibles que son, en realidad, los caminos del Señor- y también, a tiro de piedra con la frontera de una Llanada, la Alavesa, donde todavía, aparte del vino, de los santuarios ancestrales y de las arquitecturas bizantinas -término que particularmente me agrada más que románicas- también se puede disfrutar de la vista de esos enigmáticos testimonios de los tiempos del Diluvio Universal, que, como el de Sorginetxe o Casa de la Bruja, son los dólmenes.

![DSCN1090.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Ep3gnzLpkZj1KHLULmwGbah6cbhytSxqh1xScXiqmLDBBT3smfoid327dm36LUpUQSx.JPG)

Poco se puede decir de una ermita, pseudo-templaria, que conserva buena parte de su estructura original, salvo el detalle de que, a diferencia de otras muchas de su género y estilo, en la escultura exterior de sus canecillos y en los pequeños capiteles de sus ventanales, prevalecen unos rostros bien definidos, aunque totalmente anónimos, en cuyo imperturbable hieratismo, resulta difícil no recordar aquella frase del investigador de la España Mágica, Juan García Atienza, cuando, refiriéndose a aquellos otros situados en el extraño claustro del monasterio de San Juan de la Peña, afirmaba que daban la impresión de estar contemplando la Eternidad.

![DSCN1062.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EqJ1Qtc2aGbMPAMm8ZKomFAidfLXauYxaTsQUJuYou3gC43KLvQMrtBGDfj7sRFcay7.JPG)

body.title: 「生活」十日不见，从“花姑娘到老太太了”
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![ZheaZWKTmaymLIgX_mmexport1779614432870.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/tingjie/images/ZheaZWKTmaymLIgX_mmexport1779614432870/ZheaZWKTmaymLIgX_mmexport1779614432870.webp)
![KSm1kLpu85EyWV9R_mmexport1779614437402.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/tingjie/images/KSm1kLpu85EyWV9R_mmexport1779614437402/KSm1kLpu85EyWV9R_mmexport1779614437402.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

在上一次过来看我的三角梅时，还是嘴角上扬的状态！这棵绿茵三角梅是去年冬天买的，买回来把枝叶全部剪了，套上袋子，袋子扎上孔后 放在阳台晒太阳🌞后来没多久新叶就长出来了，就这样一直放在阳台上，长势很好！前不久发现新发的花瓣 开始由白渐转粉色了，好开心^_^这是养花有进步了吗？

然后在某天我就给它用了点肥（花多多一号）同一天也给家里的长寿花用了。隔了两天我发现家里的长寿花叶片打蔫了，豆包说肥太浓了，冲水补救了一下又缓过来了。赶紧过来看看三角梅，没发现它有什么变化，所以当天也就没给它冲水，当日还检查了土的干湿度。

今天过来直接傻眼了😨这是发生啥了？本来今天不是为它而来，是来看我的番茄长势的，这两天下雨🌧️看番茄有没有被淋到，它们待的地方不容易淋到雨，看要不要浇水的，没想到番茄挺好的，三角梅却给了我一棒。

三角梅是不喜水的，就算干了也不至于这样，叶片都还没打蔫呢！难道是肥伤根了？？豆包说是干的，我觉得不是！花盆拿在手里并没有轻飘飘的感觉！不知道能不能救活它了，给它过了一下水后拿到外面窗台了。



---

body.title: Tea Trick to Color Socks
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRFLyUCMwkQLEDHnZ92ZS3bxKpiYZHRy65jbBkXYX3LMb/1779613601394.jpg)

Hi guys, how are you all? I hope you are doing well and enjoying your lives.
I am also fine, but these days the weather in Pakistan is very dusty. Because of this dusty weather, I have developed a small allergy. My nose and eyes get irritated sometimes. Even then, I try to stay positive and do something useful in my free time. Today I have brought a very simple and useful tip for all of you. I hope you will like it.
This is something I learned from my nani (grandmother). She always teaches me simple and natural home tricks that save money and also help reuse old things. I really like her ideas, so I decided to share one of her tips with you today.

Today’s tip is about how you can give a new color to your old socks using only 2 simple ingredients. Sometimes we have old clothes or socks that look faded after washing many times. Instead of throwing them away, we can easily reuse them and make them look better again.
These socks in my example were actually new, but after washing them a few times in the washing machine, their color became dull and old-looking. That is why I decided to color them using this natural method.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQmepdQvWv3To2wQN8b4R6MmpMxZWYaXtwXLzniDH3A1S/1779613700136.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcgGTvVDvuPaKUnj5LEN2tVG4h7kERGaccfiXh8t8EESx/1779613700463.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcz7x82M1q9BHMtr58P8aqL3oxqsd4qqyREWuVxSq5Sop/1779613748603.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWg8ayQbnQiMjgJ9G17ULXLgzyRTsDVqjW1TicdM7StxA/1779613700763.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPUxY53FYcNuRARXrgSgmGBCZZC1Vwsj8cnFnxoky7Mix/1779613701022.jpg)


Ingredients:
Tea leaves
Water
Yes, it is that simple. Only these two things are needed.
Method:
First of all, take all the socks and wash them properly. Make sure there is no dust, dirt, or soap left on them. This step is very important because clean socks absorb color better and evenly.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSV7pUeTvVUMRYHtXnr9aWhxebVuaCnjr5aBL5aqj9udo/1779614527669.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRfEFBsM8DHJW5xpiCRaTbUJ9ECGccRbTvvH6KPJ7NVW7/1779613748672.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUaKk4MAjeHYb86B2EwfbaPLw5RfxZFPego1u68LSve1U/1779613749024.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXQbj7fwxt5ZxbVbhPZhhu2guRQygCfnh9VsbAfGzqqYB/1779613749366.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNhJKF9gFq7aqzFu5okQN447pskjc5CvykPK2aaF25YTe/1779613749695.jpg)

Now take a pot and add about 2 cups of water in it. Then add 1 teaspoon of tea leaves. Put it on the stove and let it boil properly. Slowly you will see that the water starts changing color and becomes brown like tea.
After boiling, strain the water carefully so that no tea leaves remain in it. This step is very important. If you do not strain it, the socks may get uneven color, with some parts dark and some parts light.
After straining, put the same water back into the pot and place it again on the stove. Now add all the socks into this tea-colored water.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRR8B7osXoArvpDKV5Grjuu55DCQD7qsjE9YCXWBs7Wkh/1779613792359.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb8VGt1neNUoZJ2DR2VQzn6STSLgBbJu5u3VBHoJAFs4N/1779613792681.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme7UYfsRjssPtXrrWNRMQ6JFK89UA1kod4Tewo6yAafvV/1779613793016.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcEhQy25L3kN97tgDVe8HmhGgx5dzNM5P3nndywf6NiPb/1779613793343.jpg)

Let them boil for about 5 minutes. You can gently stir them so that the color spreads evenly on all socks.
After 5 minutes, turn off the stove and take the socks out carefully. Now wash them once with cold water. Do not use hot water at this stage.
Then leave them to dry in the air. When they dry, you will see the result clearly.
When I first tried this method, I made a small mistake. I added too many tea leaves, around 6 teaspoons, and the socks became too dark. They still worked, but the color was much darker than I wanted. That is why I am sharing this tip with you so you do not repeat my mistake.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcbpRf5RNAxWhh7U9cUeHcN6Q93QiULzsMAM4q4XXr1Nh/1779613819912.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPp7uck4eLLmZvaxdeBSjf8HxRrFHhGVbtPKe2s59dSwV/1779613820212.jpg)

As you can see in my picture, the result still looked nice, but balance is very important.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaCBSJ2dEzsGRjnwFtUfxRafQWL9gy9fj8kZWTPju6kFR/1779613853698.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR2FFTvTdNhDYCjKDRdPtd9je14PZw3e6QCfuQAHgdHvf/1779613854107.jpg)

I was really happy when I saw the final result. It felt good to reuse something instead of wasting it.
I hope you liked this simple tip. If you try it, let me know how it worked for you. Thank you so much for reading and supporting me.

body.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《穿越后，满朝文武都是我学生》（朱一未x白昕怡）
body.body:
![IMG_5433](https://s1.img-e.com/20260422/69e8df3f21efb.jpeg)

昨天刚说最近这段时间看的短剧没啥新意，翻了翻待写清单会发现一部前阵子看了一直没同大家分享的剧。题材算是穿越+双向暗恋吧，我个人觉得蛮好看的。

从剧情的角度来说，男主为了救暗恋多年的女主结果两人双双被车撞到。睁开眼睛女主发现自己穿越成了丞相府的傻子嫡女，原主想必受尽了周围人的欺侮和冷眼，很惨。

女主原本抱着我不犯人人不犯我的原则，但当她意识到一味地忍让不能解决问题后，她开始对那些冒犯的人直接开怼。意料之外她用现代知识解决古代问题，实力在线啊。

一时间户部兵部等部门大佬都受到女主教导，他们皆尊称她一声老师。但她拎不清的父亲继母和继妹还在做白日梦，还在做着能成为太子妃做国丈的春秋大梦，哎。

男主也一同穿越过来成了太子，他俩还没重逢错过彼此的剧情让我看出了点《向左走向右走》的感觉。好在有缘分的人终不会错过彼此，第一季结束他俩也是妥妥HE啦。

从演员的角度来说，这部剧的主角颜值尊嘟很高。加上又是生面孔，我看的时候格外喜欢。服化道方面也很出色，看得出剧组在很用心的做这部剧，效果果然很不错。

总的来说，我觉得这是不很不错的剧，推荐推荐。


（本篇完）


————————


喜欢影视剧、美食和旅行的天秤座80后妹纸，喜欢一切新奇温暖的事物

body.title: 🌄 久違的淡江大學，跟淡水，都是年輕時千絲萬縷的牽掛 A trip down memory lane at Tamkang Uni
body.body:
![1000027363.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/242hUZxkt52uEAdhJ9JziwEFzGGcDfs3SBYw5GZreuEPtE8B454KRt9xk9zWkhPaVEraW.jpg) 上回到淡水來，吃完[當歸羊肉跟鴨🦆](https://peakd.com/hive-105017/@deanliu/tt-t4zlk6)，就往上爬了百來階梯，來到淡江大學，重新回憶一下年輕時的場景... 我這樣說，跟看這個標題，大概你們心裡都會想，原來劉美女是淡江大學畢業的啊！🤔 然而，並不是。我沒有在這裡念過書，我更不是淡水人。不過，我確實人生有一小段時期是住在淡水。 我這篇就是隨意說說，既不想說了什麼，又不想不說些什麼。 但是顯然，你接下來可以看出來，我一點沒有要把淡江大學校園當成景點介紹給你，拍的既不是重點，也不美麗。 我只是比較針對對我有意義的場景多拍一下而已。下面這張除外，這地方我沒見過　😂 ![1000027364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/2449zKEitGXfWsbczqFxbHRvXVdzcVcg1eeQXzX68i6bDjYYRqx3bH9FHhzqtDuEzFkFT.jpg) 這個校園外圍跟淡水熱鬧商業區橋接的階梯，當年應該是叫做好漢坡，現在不知道是否還這麼叫了．．．你看看，我口氣都很不確定的，如果是我的學校，怎麼可能不知道呢？ ![1000027360.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23wqcBpqTMXd7NMcRvR37TPAFLarBpGFrsQ2CzwUqHMDaQFuQyVW7mZtqg8kNKYLNjQa4.jpg) 這說難爬，其實也還好。 不過，當年我在這邊，多半以機車代步，不太走這裡的。 ![1000027361.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23zki7kePfoTACapkvaweF1XFtjYZS21bpHuvAAFSfCzRy9LcQdgJrU655yrRR8QUhDLg.jpg) 我跟淡水其實淵源比起淡大，可能要更多一些。 我在大學時期，就比較常來淡水了，對於這裡的街道，甚至某些區域的小路，都是有一定了解的。 當然，我是喜歡淡水這地方的風情的，台灣北部的重大港口，跟西方從殖民地到貿易出口的重地，洋樓，砲台，街屋，碼頭．．．．漢人的，洋人的，甚至原民的文化，在此融合結合，在戰爭與發展中，淡水醞釀了她獨一無二的魅力．．． That was what I loved about her. ![1000027362.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23vsEFGnAN8UXAJ8yUKFsWx9FW22X3zaBN9bXtSGawKWAKCJixwYcKHvnheBvxZknTiwb.jpg) 然後，當你喜歡了，多來了，這裡逐漸就變成你的了。不再以遊客自居，雖然也還沒到居民。 這心態上沒有距離，但實質上又保持一定距離，可能正是致命吸引力發生的原因。我想，如果當初我是直接在這裡變成淡水住民，可能生活裡的繁瑣事務，反而會讓我看不到淡水的那一份美吧！ 加以，念書之後，又有了另一機緣，讓我跟淡水再次結緣。 就是這一次，讓我從跟淡水有緣，擴大到了跟淡大也有了緣。 ![1000027367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23wqiH91xvk8tW7uwJfuDTwyQJRo923j1kKhL3yWxcLED8nxVUi6y4mDAiA9Se9Y7xGKj.jpg) 這是淡大校園旁一條常常車多機車多的山坡路。 ![1000027365.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23wgFm3dGTsUgLFdYZ3bW2FQkCisFk9aKqMc5Zb9KUFT12oAbBUhkCVgkGRpig66STE5h.jpg) 當年，也曾在這裡流連過～～～ ![1000027366.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23wWuAiJKei8jv9TrC4K9WTeG2Z4ryCWPRbsma5BhRpgcNbhiPWYHKtXUasMwyaawudzB.jpg) 以十年為單位的記憶不復，但依稀似乎沒有太大變化。 ![1000027368.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23uQpCi3n6z2ebR4YvSrv2ibMkCDYpCDkP4DJrPD92wd9iDc8PwwrELtMT5rcohy3A7bc.jpg) ![1000027369.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23wC9vT5RXEEDbktH25bXXJweQTq1SY7JGsqEGzymsaqexqh51wCrws4hkdenkyT4uSSg.jpg) ![1000027374.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23x16wuwVD7arGWy6KcDbFjsw6hkNBWSpRM4cnUzMZx5wE1dnB6eaZQXyLTr1QA1QXurR.jpg) 剛好校園內也在整修。 ![1000027371.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23zRxwrkeqyAdkHVfL9hymaRuqLwWfu1ZVZ3mfYaqv4tYepx42BX4stxxUPZ1kLqrEaYr.jpg) 說我不算淡大的學生是沒錯的，但我曾經來這裡坐在教室內旁聽過課，倒也沒錯。只是，堂數屈指可數。不是這裡的學生，但浪漫意義下可以是這裡的學生。 ![1000027373.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23yJEB2v1zq51xstbmp6G1emYnUd7mTx3SC7QXSpCSWZ6jdQtbnzvqdwG9Tp6pU5s4PWv.jpg) 這些路徑與店家，記憶一時湧上，但主角在這裡說了什麼話，已經不太記得了... ![1000027375.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23wC7UojbjdjChx1nuViqsW133zZkLA5Q7mFpZtQc7f37WPbLBftNwzjFzkr3xTeSYVtq.jpg) ![1000027376.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23w2ipRpruiSd3ZTavJtzFiXQ1e5yW7QbPWrrgfDQ3niyEHmtGRFhF7j2zZNd6nFsEM9T.jpg) 這個白色的捲捲，叫做蛋捲，是淡大的象徵。當年的淡江bbs站，就叫做蛋捲廣場。當然現在不在了，都AI年代了，還什麼逼逼野史...😑 ![1000027370.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/2458LVa4zCiUwP7qDytZFysGkq19NGXNGzGLVVSHqNgDAW9FfygPsMJuPgPSasNuEYGWb.jpg) 宮燈教室，是淡大的招牌特色。 ![1000027372.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/242rpetLGrzxEBeojoqTuEYLxmthbTySk9J3Etcgg6gQANniKbBxBbTTrqFAWKAsxCZYu.jpg) 中國宮廷式教室跟宮燈，具體就是這些細節。 ![1000027377.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23ywkj79GS99SvDszvLLKAZpNu4mnjSYH7fekbteT7uPXncijJoWiAT42kWjzGnTBkPc4.jpg) 也是挺有特色的。這邊我就更陌生了。畢竟我．．． 真不是淡大學生 😁 ![1000027380.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23xyNtqRd9geAVjT48HYbaenPMy7M3NiHxLpimrcGrSJYHfmM5XoHofgZY1dPuCtUgTL9.jpg) 剛好又有些坡度，顯得變化更多。 ![1000027379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23x159rtZuto4ZznsBGrrAs3vhSc24gqva9A5LWbUvLxkhFmnhMs8NvHyXCcn6dfG8wFk.jpg) ![1000027378.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23vsHqT2b2U1hxWnsDm4Y5ojSUX2s8kw2oXYF6sGZ66PrTMZTAiqBwK5NdhfpDaa6wPx3.jpg) 淡大的貓咪兒呀！當年我在這裡的時候，可能見過你的爺爺奶奶吧！😂😂😂 是不是你該叫我聲．．．．？ ![1000027381.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deanliu/23t7j8pSN6Ta5kW17cWvux144bG6tDSXy1nwp47oxJjHs7B6nnLQqBcMXjFz8bF3gRfuc.jpg) 經過這一趟，我還真的認真在想，是不是該考慮，搬到這裡來住呢？ 又或許，退休的時候在這裡比較安靜的地方，買個小房子，享受退休生活，既可在需要時，去沉浸在旅客紛擾的開心與學生年輕的能量之間，也可以快速上山，上陽明山，看河海，看夕陽，到沙崙海灘逐浪．．．然後在悠閒的平日，還能試著在古蹟之間感受這百年來的歷史，畫畫東西，寫寫Hive什麼的．．．😌 這不還有即將通車的淡江大橋，讓交通更便利，說不定到桃園機場出國也變方便了呢？😍 ***** *後記：這一篇是我在去年底寫的吧，當時放著沒發，也就忘了，今天發出來，見見陽光。但，現在淡江大橋剛剛通車，背景已然更新。* ******************

body.body:
I understand the limitations and costs. I read the introduction post and thought it was amazing. Good luck with the project, congratulations on your 10 years on Hive, and thanks for the link.

By the way, over the last few months I’ve been away from Hive. I had stepped away before and stopped posting for a while, but this time I was completely disconnected — I wasn’t even reading posts. Honestly, I feel like I missed a lot by being away. It seems like Hive is evolving into something new, and the internet itself is becoming something new as well. These new AI technologies have been changing a lot of things, and that’s actually one of the reasons I’ve been distant lately — I’ve been spending time studying and learning about them.

I saw something about Hive AI on Twitter, and it made me feel like I need to come back to Hive as soon as possible, even if it’s not necessarily to post, but at least to read and follow what’s being built. At first, I thought this whole vibe coding and AI-assisted coding trend could be a bad thing, but I was completely wrong.

I’m not saying your project is one of those, and I don’t want you to take this the wrong way (some people get offended by that). What I mean is that I feel like many new projects are starting to appear on Hive, and the trend seems to be growing. I want to try all of them, but I honestly don’t know where to find them.

I used to use HiveProjects.io, created by the developer em português of Engrave, to keep track of new projects, but I think it has been abandoned. Is there currently a place where all these projects are being cataloged?
  And sorry if anything sounded out of context — I used AI to help correct and translate my message since English isn’t my native language.

body.body: > This afternoon, I suddenly went to a roadside shop. Although the shop was not very big, the interior was quite neat and attractive. There were some really pure and natural things being sold there, such as various types of nuts, raisins, and raw honey. My eyes were watering at the sight of the things arranged in glass jars. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdAkR2gWqycXX7U6PbwVXTwn6JyGq8vDJhLEWjscnu286/image.png) I stood and talked to the shopkeeper for a while. The man was very friendly. He was explaining to me the qualities of different types of nuts. It is really a matter of luck to find such pure things in the crowd of adulterations these days. It was difficult to control my greed after seeing the shiny, fresh raisins along with the walnuts, cashews, and pistachios. And in a large container, pure honey from the Sundarbans was kept, the fragrance of which spread throughout the shop. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ4LdYBEJMoXv5fk8sczh49kcPKYYsheG1maSxYjGSjZs/image.png) I bought some cashews and a bottle of honey for myself. body.title: Reflection || Powerfull true Testimony of life
body.body:
I'm @techstyle how are you doing today, fasten your seat belt, I'm taking you along the memory lane a true life story of mine. 18 April 2026 is a day to remember. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmchqVgkxpwMNRphk4FUDR1pK75m4mzvTes932YoEwDG1k/img_20260506_071437.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSA7P4JXtLqcpPYZBNHLWyms1d4mtXaDoLnx95qC66S3A/img_20260423_wa0003.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeae8NkU16ySPab8hHGvEQZHzmWU5uq1SKacQwzwP6JWA/img_20260419_073815.jpg) Life does not always play out the way we expect. No matter how carefully we plan, it can be difficult to predict what lies ahead or what the next moment may bring. Sometimes, in just a few seconds, everything can change. It was on a faithful Saturday morning when I left home, just as I usually did, heading to my place of work. The day started like any other normal day. Work went smoothly, and by 2 p.m., I had completed my duties and prepared to return home. Feeling satisfied after a productive day, I made my way to the bus park and boarded a bus heading to my hometown. I paid for my seat and sat comfortably in the front of the vehicle. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaKb25VpdqqgC6q3UTebFrMNHoy1uH1mt12bfF2nqJdhB/img_20260423_wa0008.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbNZuLUubZsqURgXYdxzCnLR2Mfb1quSSxbhhYYJD5Zge/img_20260420_125649.jpg) A few minutes later, the bus was full. The driver started the engine, and we began our journey. It was supposed to be a simple 45-minute drive home. Everything seemed normal, and no one expected what would happen next. About five minutes before reaching the final bus stop, the driver stopped to drop off a passenger. Because it was raining heavily, he decided to cross over and park by the roadside to help unload the passenger’s luggage. He stepped out of the bus to assist. Within seconds, everything changed. A bus was approaching from the opposite direction. Instead of staying in its lane, it suddenly swerved off the major road and crashed directly into our bus. The impact was terrifying and unexpected. I found myself trapped inside the vehicle. My leg was stuck, and I could not pull it out. Panic filled the air as people screamed and struggled to escape. With the help of nearby people and passengers, I was eventually able to free my leg. When I finally got out, I realized I could barely walk. Blood covered parts of my body, and many passengers around me were also injured and bleeding. Despite the pain and confusion, I managed to gather strength and get myself to the hospital for treatment. It was one of the most painful and frightening experiences of my life. That day reminded me how fragile life can be. A journey that started like every other normal trip suddenly turned into a life-changing experience. Sometimes, we leave home not knowing what the day may bring, but moments like this teach us gratitude, resilience, and the importance of life itself. Looking back, I am deeply thankful to God for survival and for the gift of life. It was truly a journey I will never forget. . ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYhWsjebYj7DpV6YM5XSNqx1vHSVje5dvk52smm9LGNW4/ecency_divider4.gif)

body.title: Most popular data compression encrypt software for Windows, MacOS and Linux operating system.
body.body:
/>

I think you hear about RAR (Roshal Archive), it's developed by Eugene Roshal on 1993, RAR is used for reduces file sizes more effectively than standard ZIP (Zipped Information Package) files, it's saving space and making large downloads easier to manage, even we can encrypt any files protected with passwords to secure our sensitive or important data, it's very easily to share bunch of data with a single file with RAR.

<h6 style=\

>Application For RAR Different RAR applications are available for various operating systems, but the core functions such as creating or extracting unRAR archives can be managed using a wide range of software tools. For instance, if you create a password-protected RAR archive on the Windows operating system, you can access its data by extracting or unRARing it via the terminal in Linux. Similarly, on macOS, you can access the archive by extracting or unRARing it using applications such as the Unarchiver or Keka.

>Application for Windows - For the Windows operating system, you can find a wide range of applications, most of which are designed with a GUI (Graphical User Interface) for ease of use. Here are some of the most popular RAR and archive management applications available for Windows:- [WinRAR](https://www.win-rar.com), [7-Zip](https://www.7-zip.org) and [WinZip](https://www.winzip.com)

>Application For MacOS - Just like Windows, macOS also comes with various applications, and in most cases, it is used via a GUI (Graphical User Interface), much like Windows. Here are some of the most popular RAR and archive management applications available for MacOS:- [The Unarchiver](https://theunarchiver.com) and [Keka](https://www.keka.io)
>For Linux - However, applications for this are virtually non-existent on Linux; we are use it exclusively via the command line in the terminal.
>Install the RAR by the following command- > ``` > sudo apt install rar unrar > ```

>Here are the Command Line for use - **Create a Rar archive a folder-** > ``` > rar a archive_name.rar folder > ``` **Create a RAR archive multiple in a single RAR file-** > ``` > rar a archive_name.rar file1.exe file2.jpg file3.mp4 > ``` **Create a RAR archive with protected with password-** > ``` > rar a -p your_password archive.rar file_or_folder_to_archive > ``` **Extract RAR archive** - > ``` > unrar x archive.rar > ``` **Extract to specific folder-** > ``` > unrar x archive.rar /path/to/folder/ > ``` **Extract password protected RAR file-** > ``` > unrar e -pYOUR_PASSWORD archive.rar > ```
>I also have create a video how you can unrar file on Linux-\n\nhttps://youtu.be/rNQ-A2ivmYQ

body.body: />Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing great and welcome to another #Splinterlands post. Today was honestly one of the most insane battles I played in a while on #Splinterlands. At first I thought the match was completely over and there was no chance for me to win. My opponent had too many units left alive and my whole team was basically wiped out. But somehow one of my water units turned into an absolute monster and clutched a 1v4 situation because of the Resurgence ability.

> The battle only lasted 4 rounds but it felt super intense. Every round changed the battle completely. I was actually already preparing mentally for the loss lol. The ruleset for this battle was Global Warming, and honestly this ruleset helped my comeback alot. **Global Warming**: All units have the Burning status effect applied at the start of combat (At the beginning of round 2, burning has a 33% chance to spread to adjacent units. All Burning units lose 2 health).

> This made the battle really dangerous because everybody was slowly dying even if they survived attacks. Health management became super important. 𝐌𝐲 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐲 𝐆𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡 =========================================================== I decided to go with Water element because I wanted units with decent speed and survivability. Normally in Global Warming battles, fast units and units that can survive over time become really important. At first I thought my lineup was pretty decent. But after round 1, my opponent started destroying my team very quickly. Their damage output was actually crazy. My opponent had multiple strong units alive while my side was falling apart one by one.

> 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐆𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐁𝐚𝐝 𝐕𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐐𝐮𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐥𝐲 ========================================================================== By round 4 things were already looking horrible for me. Burning damage from Global Warming was stacking on everybody and my frontline disappeared pretty fast. What made things worse was that my opponent still had FOUR units alive while I only had one important unit left. At that moment I seriously thought: “Yep… its over.” But then the magic happened. The MVP unit activated **Resurgence**.

> This ability is honestly one of the coolest abilities in the game. **Resurgence**: Self-resurrects once per battle with 100% health and armor. All magic debuffs are removed, and all magic buffs are reapplied. Skips turn. Deals 1 physical damage to all units.

> The timing was literally perfect. Because of Global Warming, enemy units were already weak from burning damage. When my unit resurrected and damaged every unit on the field, suddenly the enemy team became extremely low health. Then burning damage kicked in again. That combo was sooo clutch.

> One by one the enemy units started dropping. Some died from attacks. Some died from Burning effect. Meanwhile my unit somehow survived all of it. I still dont know how this battle became a win lol. The final moments were crazy because the battlefield was almost empty and everybody was low HP. Then BOOM. Victory screen appeared.

></center>

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

Even after playing alot of battles in #Splinterlands, matches like this still surprise me. I was already accepting defeat but somehow the comeback happened in the most ridiculous way possible.

Honestly these are the battles that make Splinterlands really fun for me. Crazy moments, weird comebacks, and abilities interacting with rulesets in unexpected ways.

This was definitely one of my favorite battles from recent days.

Anyway thats it for today’s #splinterlands grind. More battles tomorrow and hopefully more crazy moments too. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

body.title: Antibes, one of the most beautiful places Cote'd Azur
body.body:
I don't know how many of you had the opportunity to visit Cote d'Azur, and has anyone stayed in Antibes, but in my opinion, this place between Cannes and Nice is one of the most beautiful I've seen.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNcjW3KTR119iUMCYbYEWdoe2Q2EJsx5MLSm6ittJMgZ7/1779611827353.jpg)

Maybe someone will say that I'm wrong and that I'm \
, but when I later found out during the research of this place that some other fantastic creative \

stayed there, I accept that they declare me the same.

In the middle of the 19th century, the most famous writer of futuristic novels, Jules Verne, lived in Antibes, as well as one of the most famous painters in the world, in the middle of the 20th century, Pablo Picasso.

Jules Verne lived in a rented villa on Cap d'Antibes, as well as on a moored yacht, while creating some of his most famous works, and Pablo Picasso was hosted in the old Garibaldi castle on the seafront in 1946.

I didn't get to the villa where Jules Verne lived, but I did get to the castle that was home to the famous painter for a year.
In that year, Picasso painted a lot of works, which he decided to donate as a gift to the owners of the Garibaldi castle, so that the castle would be turned into a museum... Which it still is today.

We arrived in Antibes by train, from Cannes.
From the train station, we headed towards the marina and the old town.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPejo4Gp16gTrhGncoGAWa289sbAPGosFN9dYwfDrGpRu/1779610039247.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZd8DE7ukBH1tF6KdN1jFtdsJUkB6uDiRxHMAiFryoKz7/1779610024256.jpg)

Marina Antibes is very luxurious, however, not like Marina Monte Carlo. There are a lot of interesting yachts there, and their owners drive interesting cars...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbU6esNpiD6XovfvZE63ZKQbDBoi57PsQ1rBT2rFdisLA/1779611901698.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSaP4Kxbev12MynGKZN96xanmnZZscqt7JUBaTraWuxx9/1779611901784.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ7FbUb4ecS8WRXqfhRw9zFDJnCi4xxdftrWVCSApWLbk/1779611901854.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVcvfXh7MLeub1ciR3oo18rUJ7H43KSErLzZBKQ82hV9E/1779611901921.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdzEGZtqJmBdsPcuY5YhrsCzTFjnxQG33k7dtkNjsi6P3/1779611901990.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZt9TsxN57LF9niqoU82oVEDrPD64FksE2YGnPh9pejtz/1779611918585.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdsJM8kpFwGp2oM81JFFrFnf5xhSXL1LBmiwP8ZWgEHFX/1779611873299.jpg)

The entrance to the fortified city is through high walls, through well-kept gates

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYiSQfYQrqDXqxNRGb9S9ZKLDUkEGf6wX39NsPNfp4pNQ/1779611936671.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbyGNSxbVL2ojj25iQ9Yoxig3e9CCNQaB9vpvRBUUTsAR/1779611936769.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWvxuqknYVjf9AtcvVKTae4KAGUoBmPSUhM24vopHZNm2/1779611936842.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNNhEa8gmTpuKoKw7eA47fcyYP8nMZRz9KSosd2bA9oTq/1779611936903.jpg)

The streets of the city are stony and narrow, the ocher color of the walls prevails, which, along with the bright blue sky, makes walking very pleasant.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWLhdJoQTZSh6518w886GUgqmEj3QEy1LE9M7JjZDerif/1779612015954.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVkVJiXjfHSa9fAwEBcCPe74gYFPTSJgWuK2WtmrvhdtN/1779612142815.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc2z1za3P44fgkX28e5rMHUb1eShgf1uEesE7ru28J5Pp/1779612142882.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdu7faNKunkLaZ3XzVMryPUt77bkKEfpzixAx8ZbVWZHS/1779612016278.jpg)

Visiting the old part of Antibes, we come across a spacious square where antiques are sold.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNaJgMSkTtwwJrzoWoAHEPn1fz3x71zkzNGuqJVo2wfPz/1779612045699.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS6ouXuzciKdKJqKwZtjdTyMqjzyNvTTouUV7fwL5Z1Bj/1779612045804.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQrWE93swz4akABPc1YHVNrJ2F6vs429Xwz4Eaej9jG6L/1779612045874.jpg)

Books, decorations, weapons... 
A lot of interesting items, for which we don't have time to look in detail now. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeDE1nC2g3Hjw2cvqA7Lrf69EZWdwsR4GioXTCLRu5JCC/1779612067966.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQGUXb36SLhviSjS97GLo48N33ffJvGUwgsQxEWfb3NrG/1779612068056.jpg)

We don't even have time to sit on the plateau and drink coffee or to have lunch in one of the restaurants we visit (if we wanted to, we would have chosen this one, in a small square with a tall pillar and a fountain).

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVT9pXucm1XqvLpSDTLzbJoDpXUZBjMWd13mgyJdrp7hZ/1779612358042.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXq7v5XdhNS2w7E7BQs7EAFYrH86nenvVEwAqnRbevcN9/1779612285935.jpg)

From the narrow stone streets, some invisible force pulls us towards the seashore.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSvwd5QCMCqP4kAr5p8UrpteksCbXAyrS7EfApDoW1HaU/1779612373004.jpg)

We pass through a narrow passage and stone steps into another smaller fortified area. We hear some roaring from the left side and we go to that side. We emerge at Garibaldi Castle, which today houses a museum with a display of Picasso's works.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW5rzsRPckdiiupdUHqeW1o6ZFfSZysPtQ9zfw1AbRm5j/1779612402083.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSQ2BkpkdyNR4ew7HGgdioC6bPwCS26bFGgWbCHV3cLfD/1779612402162.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaLMqtYErYv1yEHWbd6AYntH6wkba2Fb5VG8W3gmLDSQe/1779612402240.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeiXTpNvDzjrkRZSzWc1GdhBCrTjWj3edJvoZtSBAHQq2/1779612402310.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQdshkGeTJe3F1bHHi7qozcYYs1KppT5dMswBqNzHnMfu/1779612402383.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTSFH9LwZk5jEURgUfVVxw1Nx64BnGSzDPcY8q7wz4JXR/1779612435734.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ6xrcAas1KvxQ6yru4tJFkguJT4KYqBfu5LbzL5zGiPF/1779612435823.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaTfDwVSXXw1AWPSMJBLitFv1uPicUjqFoygwJBw4utUX/1779612435924.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbV9tWrqGh8xwRWJLgBbNQPhuDPzSaDGRDSC4KQeDGtw2/1779612436003.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSd52uqpGFPg9rF4vkzA5RSNEHD1WUVxzzGsXQRqZ3Exp/1779612436076.jpg)

Not wanting to linger in the museum, but wanting to listen and watch the waves on the seashore, we set off in the direction of the blue horizon.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNczuGctMasSsDGBnGjhqtLEnRGo5K7QerSwqvWnrb32Q/1779612507981.jpg)

My people, what a beauty. 
The steep ramparts of the fortified city rise over 10m above sea level, and the waves that hit the wall inexorably disperse into thousands of small droplets, which bring us refreshment and the smell of salt water.
I think I could spend days here, listening to the sound of the crashing waves and dozing on these ramparts.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVVevYMaLMFVHdtX42jDrSK6Z7Djxm3qdh6nd2VTrdoG8/1779612543515.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPwF7cQ8YyKTq7R7dQSGZtjNJacRqwtUp4SPe2gRGuQF7/1779612543599.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYpG8QiTrnQf7HZ31os6dUgdy65evwYuCxm94LXUWnL4p/1779612543706.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeGCTsFo36mTxQBSytwoVNmwRKdXxYv8z2jreKCMFrtWz/1779612543777.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcXgqvtwe64vv283rUfJjNngk74KUEk1aPwmmx9U7Un4b/1779612543858.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ691wvJCdFzP4PMvHrNVn4GnfosQRQ8FFUE2wpPd6BVR/1779612570587.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX9aaD4JKRpB4K2ndBdYALzPUjyrTsvnNzYbLKWuS2PZH/1779612581194.gif)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXqEB5Te1GE51rZcj2unhu5aicb8FbJCW2CYB2FGNpBv7/1779612603166.jpg)

However, after continuing along the coast, walking along the ramparts, where there are some interesting houses and apartments, we reach a small garden where some music is heard.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP7dSHdEVRovUj4JSf5RTDoHAXKVLKffATaBPZ55jEXpQ/1779612637943.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfUnRi2CrbDoMXhF9PYciDHuHU381tZm5GLFE75ZJFAj6/1779612638061.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXDWMjpSqQvR7Spd9zRdYkcBtQRfozc2B23NXPjcfcFNu/1779612638143.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmacrHzTdCgXEeU3bjuqxyTdcdoWFJkCTUG45BX9CwF4Af/1779612638211.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeUixbcn2gCUyZF6jR5x87gHVnEd7EBW5K6qydbgXMogk/1779612638282.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSfaNmtcsrwNWtb3todwdwxL9SJux9xF7MoPhGZH2dKeo/1779612654281.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRBAoaEdw2RDkxX4juV84U4mAPS1ZUh5Mw1oWJgKHPsJ7/1779612682189.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR7AUBegxcVLEu2mFCGKbb5m3uvSQ29W64DTCdq5VtqWe/1779612682276.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYRGSLEJaxZxXRdRvTNih7HfQmE114thfnfYKbNpBVBY4/1779612682362.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaq57J4AiBjN3xVScMi3rXBAhmXJnkQQvzbg5HrLYPLqZ/1779612682461.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPzDVMTjKgheLTCDxKkTWhNLHXXXuMNbfQX166MA77DFr/1779612682525.jpg)

Well, it was a part of Antibes and the scene that bought me, that I can claim that Antibes is the best.

A small garden, the Poet's Garden, in which there are palm trees, various decorative flowers, cacti, as well as boards with sayings of some of Antibes, one of them is Jules Verne.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRCUY6GLS9jm2Wc3iixPuCEbHQksRRQZySp76HSvB2qHy/1779612829631.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcvF5mS2aeBrUrouJQpGyuG7SLH13hy8NzEjvA2m6dc9d/1779612829730.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUVU3DFR6u2MsbeDfJtGmx9zmisEpwrZznyyXbXa9adv5/1779612829825.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaEhZvk98MxpEcRDMrnefGbEcTQbnYJynXPYrirjp88Vc/1779612829931.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWragjS1V5TFhUZ6LY4nn9LnmX7VswRkmS6qyYKe6fDXe/1779612830046.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdovZUJETwz4TC63fgQxWM6YozRhccrj9yAzvcHZgamWU/1779612862154.jpg)

On one of the plaques there is a quote written by him, which best describes Antibes.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdY2xvG5KNiYr5Mit9mmEsXA2rsx8NGSgn7SrGRuDMoZS/1779612746022.jpg)

\

Another writer, the famous Victor Hugo, lived in Antibes, to whom a monument was erected in that garden, which reads:
\

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNvLwUmXJDyadURAvu56Tdr5Vz19fgE7b4euLUZQ2hQqx/1779612772032.jpg)


And the writer Jacques Audiberti was born in Atibi.
He described his native Antibes in the following words:
\

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmegACokut3yDbEL5VdM3vBc5pkscsvQQhq2d3R1FgL5WE/1779612791893.jpg) And what would a poet's garden be without a little music. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPpeNmbWcWhtDZP9dnmGYmDGtVZkH6m5cRBTK5cnG4RaU/1779612896974.jpg) When I heard the chords of the guitar, I headed for the place where I had the best view and where I could hear the sounds the guitar was making. [

/>](https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=duskobgd/txban78t)

And for you (and for me too, to enjoy the beautiful sounds and color of the sky again), I made a video.
I would say - magical sounds with a beautiful view.

body.title: R503 FT Custom, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
body.body:
![26uUsAjKTsXCDw7zixZR182JbFKvgzJ9YwsFpTVcRaGCmsqhA1unTgpqWiBDQ5tBd5AmGnBFpy4Lmk3BXFR595EwFUhtXs5q4isCauVn1QdY4HMjutgHevLjqqv516CGfZ67NBPocpSHmffAz4kxArpJRFH3UoknS9WJML.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eoc64dtjcszy4m23wCRnvSm9YSMVpD6XCYrtXiy1ntyiW8sAw58ojy1RMPv1RNyfBQu.jpg)


Hey everyone! As you may have noticed these past few days, I've been sharing some drawings of rare and epic microphones. Today, I'm continuing with this theme of cards from the game, so for this drawing, I chose the R503 FT Custom card. The microphone depicted on this card is quite beautiful, with touches of silver and various shades of yellow. It has several subtle reflections on its surface, which I also tried to capture in the drawing. As always, you can tell me in the comments if I managed to capture the essence of the original card, lmao.

Let's get to the drawing, since that's probably what you're all eager to see. First, I opened the IbisPaint app to create the card's outline, just the inside. This outline is made up of two squares, which together form the frame. I always call it a frame because it's like framing a photo, and that's because the drawing in the middle is essentially a frame, hence the name. Take a look at how it turned out.

<div class=\

> ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8CxCbz5N6cCZTpNFnAaLFXzYmvCeRX9eVekYduqtje6TZCnvuVm9kvT8YY.jpg) In the center of the drawing, I drew a cylinder; this would be the main body of the microphone and its largest part. It's the central part. Next, I painted the area on top of the cylinder for the top of the microphone, which is where you would speak and where the voice is picked up. And at the bottom, I drew a stand to hold the microphone. In real life, that small area would be used to attach a cable or screw the microphone to a tripod. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8DHkUMDthZuCvi8xvLW7yYt8aFVGJKT7gozskwJf1cs6KFYWEzJE6QS2kU.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTNgDaQ6ex7ae7sepXbpj3dcgKPsSCQw6r67JBX76Ku1jf993rzJdXu6VS.jpg) In terms of details, what I mainly did was add several internal divisions, as usual. There were several, each one defining an area so that it could be observed more clearly. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTVXcodqnRaRAKWGmUBLWN3WuGzuYqKmyfhiMcX6mpR4J85BV3G9GJKX1z.jpg) With the sketch finished, I could finally start painting. As you'll see below, this is how I painted everything. Notice the shades of yellow I used on the microphone; some are for highlights, while others are for shadows. I took this as an example from the original card. I liked the effect. It's best if you see the other steps for yourselves in the screenshots. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoCoyNJi8ki5HgPZWF8GLQ9dGG5B5UMTPANuxM3ipwW4rN4kWRga8tLBB7aZvXBuUSn.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqL9HQDyJ9juv2QofoFy2Xc7rkjn89kws8C75r2ZHY2V68muV9DMEvo7Jv5i65qA5Ey.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqdAPNJEbf5PyXNnRgCWjymrf5qid8UQaHadwiX52tzEok9iJHaVuGtQ9fodSjo9DXS.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EnaZpZNqfSFJcevuUBBSUrgrtK3MTfhxaTmWgWzuNEtoYiN1Bp9fLCy8tKqj5qHeKuV.jpg) And now, folks, here's the drawing ready to show you. As you can see, it's finally finished. That's all for today. I'll see you in my next drawing. Blessings. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/243MHufoQHuKmjVs7ddkqVd5BD84FjKMH4f1uDxKh9QaJ6db5kaztp86HHYVUyFqAoHXP.jpg)

body.title: Spontaneous Surrealism – Óscar Domínguez
body.body:
> >Some art exhibitions surprise me, others amaze me; in others, I find myself questioning things or reflecting, but in most I simply enjoy each piece and what the artist conveys. --- ![Image_1779561497591.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wX5UvaAdeiJ3MhUwjuVz5Y2L1fyMkMmmMe9Hoz8i3K7FfQneVKhBuwQ4F4tbvCeUGsR.jpg) --- Some time ago, I was able to visit one of the wonderful temporary exhibitions held every so often at the city’s Picasso Museum. These exhibitions aren’t confined to a small room; instead, the space has a labyrinthine structure, where a large area is divided into smaller sections depending on the theme. The walls are always changing colour, depending on the artist and how they wish to highlight the works, and the truth is that the museum does an extraordinary job. Until that day, I was unaware of the great work of the surrealist artist Óscar Domínguez, who is on a par with Miró, Picasso, Dalí and many others of his era, a difficult time, when many had to live in France or travel there for their art to be recognised. --- ![20251005_182714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgaTfFWE7zCt1ccp6orwYgSyuBLL721SjFwmGrR9pGJKXw7qKoGFMYdNvRaB2FaWexd.jpg) --- ![20251005_183056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242466UsWTMk5YudniiYvv6cvqcy3Bxhx6h7ji9hKWy1VWJPMCyM2Sg2wfpioYsKTFmr8.jpg) “I Am Right, Surrealist Effect. Surrealist Composition II”, 1933, oil on canvas. --- ![20251005_183104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zbcnv6tWbb43JFhT4LfJNRHZTWy8GGbFsBhJwnWbGo2KiN68w5HyhnXEHS1q518kJHB.jpg) “The Piano”, 1933, oil on canvas. --- ![20251005_183111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48JeVJgkpbnNAyXrNmXH77dsTVBsuDk5W6mz6BB1sZUBU8sRpdfoYkSbAunaPK3nKB.jpg) “The Hunter”, 1933, oil on canvas. --- ![20251005_183127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48hJPpnAmcv3TtbWYLCQHtxRGWNNztp9NjuoZChbYVq4SaCkXJaLXEYE2ANiDrFZ6F.jpg) “Untitled”, 1933, oil on canvas. ---
![20251005_183137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48YdEo3h5Ukd6ep1nXpVB7b2wJQ1YFiQrVv1R8axbmk3FqHi7a7kpT35xofBCBtFQF.jpg)
“Le dimanche or Rut marin”, 1935, oil on canvas. --- That’s why, when I stepped into the large hall, I was utterly captivated, not only by the quality of the artist’s work, but also by the size of the paintings and the way he imbued them with his own style and the spirit of his native Canary Islands. I hadn’t always been drawn to this kind of art; it was only after I’d finished my studies in drawing and painting that I became interested. It was then that I began to see more of this kind of art, and the blend of illusion, imagination and magic, plus the fantasy, is something I love. You can capture practically anything, emotions, feelings, realities, ways of looking at life and even messages in various ways, some a little convoluted, but which the discerning eye will find meaning in. ---
![20251005_183212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48kC7dU3Jo23KhBih1cXAfL8pLsZfgUZYyeV3Tb1JpU2nsrVzdRsojeHkR5i7x4C9b.jpg)
“The Dragon Tree”, 1933, oil on canvas. ---
![20251005_183239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/AKzDoV9XrnkBttmaaKMviervjsHefrHYVrykRMwTAFkG6GZ9WopGctGaRR25bKd.jpg)
“Can Opener”, 1936, oil on canvas. --- ![20251005_183302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/24243ugnrMVSWzVo21tEndf5Mzd3oryy1LfccinAr5WqRPJYpxZAGmDNu2VuGVvyNuoca.jpg) “Spring”, 1939, oil on canvas. --- ![20251005_183319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ydByi55HcXpLcVdz4YLA5tahzhoqFV92DdURtJVSpwyPF2Xq91x3qtdUjUHe4jcQ1PX.jpg) “Surrealist Figures”, 1937, oil on canvas. --- ![20251005_183447.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAnjNM4ndzTs23xdMsKqjuxGfQGBAzaNudWQMiDMq45yz8iHDc1gf1rSyTD2E4gtKxq.jpg) “Apparition over the Sea”, 1939, oil on canvas. --- I often see surrealist art, even if it isn’t real, as a way of expressing oneself in a coded form, and that, on the other side, there will eventually be someone who sees something in a painting that resonates with them personally. I like to think that, because every artist has the canvas before them like a blank sheet of paper through which they can say many things, both personal and things they know, and perhaps it is the only way to express what they believe, see or feel. That is why I think art is wonderful and every artist has their own special way of doing things. This artist’s work is very good; I enjoyed standing there looking at each painting and observing both the colours he had used and his way of interpreting moments in life, sensations or experiences. --- ![20251005_183535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCJADMzSKBj2YvTAeWR7cMJ7erDGshHzB52BiZeXqaqmbCN9j1ApkF52Xghd23KNw8U.jpg) “Delfos”, 1957, oil on canvas. --- ![20251005_183547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242hcxtVbaCN6wkaMmFhekoACz4H99MCRyrCe9AA8tx1mzCkJHabUR4NaFNwU4dLTf1Zr.jpg) “Los sifones”, 1938, oil on canvas. --- ![20251005_183606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyhgBVfNsCSNiGKKrrJJJtSDmTxCHniT1KbhBBXhwYS1ycVHb41zgsgH68hsa5JWjU8.jpg) “The Road Roller and the Rose”, 1957, oil on canvas. --- ![20251005_183835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xpPNtqvx2z4qN3EQ7i3BJV8ejf9js5d5MBchntFcUCvsa3bT8Tz21aD2dncCcsZqmJg.jpg) “Lithochronic Figures”, 1939, oil on canvas. --- It is a form of surrealism brimming with magic, as if we were stepping through a door into a world that leads to unexpected places, where we can see strange shapes, figures and creatures. And there will always be one painting that we like more than another. In my case, I was drawn more to those with brighter, cheerful colours, rather than the dark or gloomy paintings, although of course they all have something worth seeing. On the other hand, as I looked at the paintings, another thing I particularly liked was that they all have a great sense of movement, as if what the artist wanted to express and everything he painted were moving to the beat of an invisible music, music with a special vibration that brought colour to some parts of the painting, light to others, and finally various shadows. Many of the works are among my favourites, such as ‘Apparition over the Sea’, ‘Surrealist Figures’, ‘The Piano’ and ‘I Am Right’. It’s hard to choose just one. If you have a favourite, I’d love to hear about it in the comments. --- ![20251005_183811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u6FdFjXYPt8mhUde34gjtKBwARTi2GYLs91vLbjWUYhRCJ9X1S9GqGXZdEJpT8jVmfD.jpg) “House”, Jacques Hérold, 1959, oil on canvas. --- ![20251005_183859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMkuh8sSgkbDpjDvwXjqAMpZqB44xhenRCngRWkjvkgsKzGpFKVuSpbt8utisnsSaGr.jpg) “Psychological Morphology”, Roberto Mata, 1938, oil on canvas. ---
![20251005_183934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/EqWnndQfJfR4WXkpwMpTqPE1LgRdbGk4DKdJaqTMRnWuQN6s5hjUFDAApESojaTm7Nm.jpg)
“Morgane”, Kurt Seligmann, 1951, oil on canvas. --- Three works by other artists accompanied this art exhibition; all three were equally spectacular. Of these three, the last one is my favourite. --- ![20251005_184152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsQfLozGTtSAUPBFrsPD8GNZL1S96vxEjbrC5odfFFhJMxMGBoLMUcUryCbB3oJZ8Ds.jpg) --- In one of the corners of a very dark room, I think I found confirmation of what I said earlier: a grand piano stood there to accompany a spectacular art exhibition. The atmosphere was perfect; the lighting and the harmony of the rooms allowed me to fully appreciate the work of this great artist. Thank you very much for joining me today; I wish you all a very happy Sunday. See you soon. Amonet. --- >All photographs are my own. ![Separador Amonet rosa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo45huwdpJdeDRRmb3tm3Sv7mxs8Uq3XUZDd5bjvGqBDKfDE5DLGQM1duXTEQQYhyjs.png) [//]:# (!worldmappin 36.721692 lat -4.418034 long Spontaneous Surrealism – Óscar Domínguez d3scr)

body.title: Step-by-Step Guide for Indian Nurses Moving to Germany
body.body:
[Nursing jobs in germany for indian nurses ](https://germanleap.com/nursing-jobs-in-germany/)have become a major career pathway for healthcare professionals seeking better salaries, international exposure, and long-term career growth. Germany is currently experiencing a significant shortage of qualified nursing staff due to its aging population and growing healthcare demands. This shortage has created thousands of employment opportunities for trained nurses from countries like India.

Indian nurses are increasingly choosing Germany because the country offers strong labor protections, modern healthcare infrastructure, and opportunities for permanent residency. Germany’s healthcare system is recognized globally for its advanced medical technology, high patient care standards, and organized hospital management systems. For many nurses, working in Germany provides both professional development and financial stability.

The first step in the process is understanding the eligibility requirements. Nurses planning to work in Germany generally need a recognized nursing qualification, clinical experience, and German language proficiency. Most employers and healthcare authorities require candidates to achieve at least B1 or B2 level German certification under the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).

Learning German is one of the most important parts of the migration process. Nurses must communicate effectively with patients, doctors, hospital staff, and caregivers. German hospitals prioritize patient safety and accurate communication, making language fluency essential for daily healthcare operations.

The German language system consists of multiple levels including A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, and C2. Beginners usually start from A1 and progress gradually toward professional-level fluency. Research in language learning suggests that consistent daily practice significantly improves fluency development. Nurses preparing for international relocation often dedicate several months to language preparation before beginning the employment process.

After language preparation, candidates usually begin the document verification process. Important documents may include nursing degree certificates, registration documents, passport copies, work experience records, educational transcripts, and professional licenses. German authorities review these documents to determine whether the candidate’s nursing qualification matches local healthcare standards.

In some cases, candidates may need to complete adaptation training or recognition programs. These programs are designed to bridge differences between healthcare education systems and ensure nurses meet German medical standards. The adaptation process often includes supervised clinical practice and healthcare communication training.

The growing demand for [nursing jobs in germany for indian nurses ](https://share.google/B3Fkc7ccToK5skQne)is strongly linked to demographic trends. Germany has one of the oldest populations in Europe, and healthcare institutions are under pressure to provide long-term care services for elderly citizens. According to healthcare workforce reports, Germany will continue requiring a large number of international nurses over the coming years.

Salary expectations are another major factor attracting Indian nurses. Entry-level nurses in Germany can earn approximately €2,500 to €3,500 per month depending on location, experience, and healthcare specialization. Additional benefits often include health insurance, pension contributions, paid leave, overtime compensation, and shift allowances.

German labor laws are considered among the strongest in Europe. Healthcare employees are protected through regulated working hours, employee rights policies, and workplace safety standards. These protections contribute to improved work-life balance and long-term job security.

Technology integration in German healthcare facilities also provides valuable international experience. Hospitals commonly use electronic health records, automated medication systems, advanced patient monitoring equipment, and digital healthcare management systems. Nurses working in such environments gain exposure to modern medical practices and internationally recognized clinical procedures.

Another important advantage is career progression. Nurses can specialize in fields such as critical care, geriatric nursing, pediatric nursing, emergency care, psychiatric care, and rehabilitation services. Specialization often leads to higher salaries and expanded responsibilities.

The visa process for healthcare workers has become more streamlined in recent years. Germany introduced policies to attract skilled international professionals and reduce healthcare workforce shortages. Nurses who receive job offers from recognized healthcare institutions can apply for employment visas and eventually explore pathways toward permanent residency.

Healthcare professionals interested in nursing jobs in germany for indian nurses should also understand cultural adaptation. Germany values punctuality, discipline, teamwork, and structured communication. Nurses who adapt to these workplace expectations often integrate more successfully into healthcare environments.

Practical training plays a significant role in German nursing careers. Hospitals emphasize hands-on patient care, accurate medical documentation, and adherence to treatment procedures. Nurses are expected to maintain professional communication standards and follow strict healthcare protocols.

Many Indian nurses preparing for Germany also improve soft skills such as empathy, patient interaction, stress management, and communication confidence. These qualities are highly valued in patient-centered healthcare systems where emotional support and professionalism are essential.

The demand for elderly care professionals remains especially strong. Germany’s aging population requires long-term support in nursing homes, rehabilitation centers, and assisted living facilities. Nurses with experience in geriatric care often receive strong employment opportunities.

The process of relocation may involve challenges including language adaptation, cultural adjustment, and professional transition. However, many nurses who complete the process successfully report significant improvements in income, career satisfaction, and quality of life.

Experts in global healthcare recruitment predict that international nursing opportunities in Germany will continue expanding throughout 2026 and beyond. As healthcare demands rise and workforce shortages increase, international recruitment is expected to remain a priority for German healthcare institutions.

Consistent preparation is the key to success. Nurses who focus on language skills, professional documentation, interview preparation, and healthcare communication often achieve smoother transitions into the German healthcare system.

The future outlook for Indian healthcare professionals in Germany remains highly positive. Strong demand, supportive immigration policies, and career growth opportunities continue attracting qualified nurses from India. Many professionals also use German healthcare experience as a foundation for broader international career opportunities.

In conclusion, nursing jobs in germany for indian nurses provide a strong pathway toward global career development, financial growth, and advanced professional experience. With proper planning, language training, and dedication, Indian nurses can successfully establish rewarding healthcare careers in Germany while contributing to one of Europe’s most advanced healthcare systems.

body.title: Застелили затіняючу сітку
body.body:
![IMG_20260522_170239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23wBy7mt9e9XfNSFVuQQexVHKBFRYAEwrXYgyscm7oCiFpDQL3B7LPsgHpScfqTgGRwA4.jpg)

Привіт, друзі! Зараз у нас несподівано намалювалися доволі спекотні кілька днів. Хоча, якщо подумати, то нічого аж такого дивного в цьому немає — кінець травня, майже літо. Просто перед тим прогнози показували зовсім іншу картину, тож після прохолодної весни така спека відчувається особливо сильно.

У нас прогнозують до 27° тепла, а це вже доволі спекотно навіть у тіні. А що вже казати про перебування на сонці чи тим паче у теплиці. Тому ми з чоловіком вирішили натягнути затіняючу сітку на теплицю. Вона в нас лежала складена ще з кінця минулого літа, коли ми її зняли, і от нарешті знову прийшов її час.

Минулого року ми кріпили сітку за допомогою пляшок із водою, але це була не надто вдала ідея. Коли одного разу під час бурі здійнявся сильний вітер , її частково здуло разом із тими пляшками. Тож цього року вирішили зробити все більш надійно: позабивали кілки й натягнули сітку шнурками приблизно так, як закріплюють туристичні палатки. Забиваєш кілки під кутом, натягуєш шнур — і конструкція тримається значно краще.

Ефект від того, що ми натягнули затіняючу сітку, відчувається миттєво. Як тільки ми натягнули сітку і я зайшла всередину теплиці, одразу стало помітно, що там набагато комфортніше. Температура, може, й не впала кардинально, але зникло це відчуття розпеченої духовки, коли повітря буквально пече.

Щоправда, вже в середу ця спека наче має закінчитися. І дуже хочеться, щоб причиною цього були дощі. Їх начебто передають, але якісь слабенькі, несерйозні. А ситуація вже реально сумна — стільки днів без нормального дощу.

Так, інколи трохи покропить, щоб трава остаточно не вигоріла, але цього катастрофічно мало для росту рослин. Багато що просто стоїть на місці. Ми поливаємо все, що можемо: помідори, огірки, грядки, куди дотягується шланг. Але ж усе поле не поллєш. Те, що висаджене чи посіяне далі, повністю залежить від погоди.

І це дуже тривожно.

Хоча я пригадала слова одного чоловіка, здається, десь в Instagram:
— Не просіть дощу, просіть урожаю.

І в цьому є сенс. Бо дощ може бути різний. Може прийти з градом, шквалом, сильним вітром і за кілька хвилин знищити те, що ростилося місяцями. Тож зараз я, мабуть, молюся не лише про вологу, а й про добрий урожай і спокійну погоду для всього, що ми так старанно вирощуємо.
