__main__\\.title: Curator Cat: Caturday and Memorial Day Weekend
__main__\\.body:
Greetings Fabulous Felines and Hoomans of Hivelandia and surrounding communities!

Once again the weekend is upon us, and that means it's time for a new round of cat photos for the Caturday update!

![CC0606-ShadowSunbeams.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23wqiZYXx6VJu8JzxVJJqpp3j9iYp4espromZhhSkZirVCzJ24s43QroCEhGNoZ7ZfFeg.jpg)
*Caught in the sunbeams!*

The Hoomans are enjoying a long holiday weekend, because this weekend includes Memorial Day on Monday — known as *Remembrance Day* in some parts of the world — so everything is closed and we all get to do our own thing.

We don't have anything in particular planned, although it seems a lot of Hoomans go and have picnics on this day. We're avoiding that because the Dad-Hooman says that the people who predict the weather say it's going to rain all day.

![CC0731-Shangri.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/242DLevTnWbaUMdf3d9QqUA4aho7jmiEK7eTatNQADJrA7mJ1ur24LMgHx9yCJSHHx5L1.jpg)
*Shangri enjoying a bit of catmint*

Not much fun for them, of course, but we have plenty of things we can do here that are indoors and that we cats can be part of.

Since the Hoomans will not be gardening if it's raining, they will probably be working on their arts and crafts projects inside and that means we will have something to supervise while they work! As everybody knows, most creative endeavors are best enjoyed with a cat... or several.

![CC0726-Nala.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23vsSgnncNrG68rzS6hLhRJEjY4oHEsLxqiRT28e2ztisn5m7PCzEjmgNr8VdoywNNoGn.jpg)
*Nala in the morning sun*

Of course we were all rather alarmed by the Hive-Engine hack and loss of some system crypto.

It's just sad home many dishonest Hoomans are out in the world... just traying to take advantage of others, rather than creating their own thing, with their own ideas. It does not sit well with *this* cat, to say the least!

![CC0558-PinkRoom.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/242Y5pKwAWyAb7f8ihQ225fBpn2PcydusyHJK7xPP9GZUcqu7s82ojPX5j8WZ7ZLuC5kG.jpg)
*My favorite sunny spot in the Mom-Hooman's office*

Although it was not a formal part of my Hive goals, we have now reached *800* posts of Caturdays and other posts with cat photos!

One some level, I feel pretty good about having stuck to the blog for over eight years and keeping up with our rotating crew of feline friends. Of course Shadow — the original *\

* — is still front and center!

![CC0685-SmudgeTreat.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/Eou8ny8Kz93Yzy4p7XZiBVQa9TtSgMSDjT4UheWartVkgEqVnnEn6fX938QJ6RSMKYw.jpg)
*Smudge getting a treat!*

Of course, we hope to keep going for many more years... providing, of course, that Hive continues to be *\
* which we very much hope it does.\n\nWe have really enjoyed the people *(and cats!)* we have gotten to know in this community, and it's much friendlier than the *\

to an art form!*

And that's about all we have for this weekend update.

We appreciate you visiting our little cat blog and hope to see you again soon! In the meantime, have a great Sunday and Memorial Day weekend!

__main__\\.title: Mensaje diario de 5 minutos-¡Tan productiva!/ Daily 5 minute message-So productive! 24 May 2026
__main__\\.body:
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXNjPmKX7DtF43RFmf9natLJbsoLekvpJN9SeREYCBz7X/imagen.png)
Me volví una trabajadora incansable de las letras a diario, escribí sin saber que era una terapia que sanaba. Aprendí a luchar con las ganas de no hacerlo, hasta entender que teclear es dejar un poco de nuestra alma en cada bocado. Compartir aprendizajes nos vuelve más productivas, ya no tenemos secretos y nos sentimos encantadas. Como ejercicio el sentirse productiva simplemente nos satisface. Volverse productiva es sentir que estamos haciendo algo bueno y cuando veo a otros siguiendo los mismos pasos, algunos a su ritmo voy comprendiendo que estoy dejando una huella para otros. No sabría indicar que tan productiva soy y aunque sigo trabajando, verdaderamente no me sostengo sola, tengo siempre gente a mi alrededor complementando mis necesidades, el mundo se vuelve complicado y más necesitado de nuestro servicios. Trabajamos y dejamos una costumbre, una forma de ser en cada espacio. Sin embargo logramos adaptarnos a los nuevos espacios, a nuevas costumbres.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTUdCViM2LJtEGUubntRe7SHfNdat3TchNWq66LjZpHeW/imagen.png)
A veces no puedo llevar el ritmo de ellos y a veces ellos no pueden llevar la rapidez mental de las letras y palabras que pasan por mi mente. Conversaciones que nunca ocurren, momentos que nunca suceden y que a la final me distraen de ser productiva. Como ser productiva estando dividida en dos mundos, en dos continentes, en ganas de seguir andando y conociendo sin extrañar las partes. Descubrir que la vida es así, un dejar ir a la olas, que recorran su mundo, que busquen su espacio, que decoren el mar. Este texto corresponde a mi participación en el reto diario de los amigos @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano y @mariannewest [post 24 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3113: so productive](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/24-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3113-so-productive)
ENGLISH VERSION
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmarDAsBJagfuwzMGNqiUUgi3KMgE1CaTvV5N8fnVt9MZB/imagen.png)
I became a tireless worker, writing in my journal without knowing it was a healing therapy. I learned to fight the urge to stop, until I understood that typing is leaving a little bit of our soul in every word. Sharing what we learn makes us more productive; we no longer have secrets and we feel delighted. As an exercise, feeling productive simply satisfies us. Becoming productive is feeling that we are doing something good, and when I see others following the same path, some at their own pace, I understand that I am leaving a mark on others. I couldn't say how productive I am, and although I continue working, I truly don't sustain myself alone. I always have people around me complementing my needs; the world becomes more complicated and more dependent on our services. We work and leave a habit, a way of being in every space. However, we manage to adapt to new spaces, to new customs.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTUdCViM2LJtEGUubntRe7SHfNdat3TchNWq66LjZpHeW/imagen.png)
Sometimes I can't keep up with them, and sometimes they can't keep up with the mental speed of the letters and words that race through my mind. Conversations that never happen, moments that never come to pass, and that ultimately distract me from being productive. How can I be productive when I'm divided between two worlds, two continents, wanting to keep moving forward and exploring without missing either side? Discovering that life is like this, letting go of the waves, letting them explore their world, find their space, and decorate the sea. This text corresponds to my participation in the daily challenge of friends @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano and @mariannewest. [post 24 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3113: so productive](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/24-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3113-so-productive)

__main__\\.title: Batman vs Scarecrow's Drone Army | GCPD Under Siege
__main__\\.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779605653624-117d150fc9e71c2e.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=yakubnoyon/35c583d2)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=yakubnoyon/35c583d2)


---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVRPJo7n5jhe44xkdojaJzLNcPjUuQhhXyJXEuyr8qfVr/gaming_photography_2_.gif)

After the server was connected to the GCPD computer, Batman returned there. Oracle was scanning every camera and she found that Gordon had been taken to the north side of the island

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU3ckNTtFoA3tUUSV8Z3EBbXfxeooGGsJb9sbdxQBBte3/snapshot_22.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTaF1rYDuVWMZ3R2KmrnL83NSVLTqsyEjWtw3asRB4iCD/snapshot_23.png)

while they were taking, the GCPD building suddenly shook and scarecrow appered onto the screen. He threatened all of the police officers that Batman can't save them. His army of drone tanks, cobra tanks, and flying drones was ready to attack the GCPD. This is the end.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP7kyS3Ef91Xc8UeY4xErv6EQ7cpjH1wUhpP5oSFoNfmh/snapshot_24.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYXRqmtN8Wva9viMXFRD7m8Q3shu4QFu5PuAsB9rJq7od/snapshot_25.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYs9NjcHoZWNHvFMphqfGh6yVYDFnZ66crgedf3EeNvya/snapshot_26.png)

Batman quickly came out of the GCPD. All the criminals inside were very happy. Scarecrow had attacked the building. They will be free and they started to mock Batman. Batman realized that 2 militia vans had already entered. He told Cash to fully lock the area.

They were outnumbered with guns in their hands, so Batman didn't go into a direct fight first. He hid somewhere safe and used the Batmobile to kill the enemies.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYD2Uy2pp3i3Ne7X5vYj3fVeNHEUayX2BriB2Sz6R51Dm/snapshot_27.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTv5ZLU1FazqFxzpv6ZuZUdZ44FMzAan1o2VyhPEzW9pE/snapshot_28.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXF9nANJW76Puz1iEFf9M79kMZEt11Zj7H15BMxZnXe2J/snapshot_29.png)

Some of the thugs managed to escape the bullets from the Batmobile and found Batman's location. They attacked Batman. But they were low in number and Batman was very skillful because of the recent combat upgrade. In a matter of seconds, all the thugs were grounded by him.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRyRfd4LhM2gxd7ZsKsCVm6GfJNJUipvUoWtjjLpcsjZP/snapshot_30.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXhqwScWjNu1jMF82XtqN8Z2hGAqsQueyy56Mx3a3Pa16/snapshot_31.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXcYuoDVo6sTRWj3LXYmkgLqAnxUkBqj7PTh5iVN56Yof/snapshot_32.png)

Those criminals were very clever, so they cut the GCPD's power supply. The building was in the dark. They had a backup generator but it was outside and no one could go outside in this situation but the Batman. He found a huge fan and he was sure this fan's tunnel would lead him to the outside or the other part of the building.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmST7BMVR83MsribTNDNKBKziWAEPiE1tFdhSb2EtkSVWC/snapshot_33.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmagzW6pAujhwC6L4Mm7atAuoHPCL5T3fxQhiHVk5sbV8V/snapshot_34.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeYZDcqVW4U4TgPZzeFeZHNQ8S9LaYm3HLBVxJn6oiQva/snapshot_35.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYsXJWgUBy6pkdMKT6es5yPjrFVNEVTRP3yuxCdJzj4Fe/snapshot_36.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYg3Cyk88GoTNa6ZsQGSJB4JXPY9Pwb2UqUMhvjkwPZfS/snapshot_37.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVfiZk6xck5trvZLkjjY9e8N2yF9tYUKBpFEEKLSvsbQi/snapshot_38.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY3nn9T5R9T1gAo3ckGabCjCwMzs5ZTHP1zxk4asmEz7N/snapshot_39.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf1dKamqAnSCMMppv41PT8UakcoSLZR8grnrbo969SfY3/snapshot_40.png)

After Batman came out of the building, He was shocked. Scarecrow sent a huge army of drone tanks. He sent every type of drone he had to GCPD so that it could destroy the building. They were shooting continuously at the building. It was sure that this building won't keep them out for much longer so Batman needed to react first.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcCMEvQt67rHwwsG9NEr7GakwiFR9yHeynYbfn4SyQGcX/snapshot_41.png)

But first things first, Batman had to turn on the generator. When he reached there, he found the generator had already been destroyed.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcMCSf64uSXCb9wisCQ4oVuvtBR4gR7okdX7gPP2wdZ4y/snapshot_42.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmctk3JK2DJar5dJxAYgAY81tNsMs7jJV4WFCE94TGVEhH/snapshot_43.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbwsDWoTdbM7bbaqDerEGZwkNK1UoPDMEUXoeq99W2yAU/snapshot_44.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcMyZCVczyR3CzdcAuFbEYuxHnLHjG5PzrTctFSEYPTi9/snapshot_45.png)

Oracel told him that there is a backup generator at the entrance of the GCPD. Batman wasted no time, went to the entrance. There he found the generator but it was guarded by the military. Batman fought very hard. All the soldiers were down one by one. After that, Batman went near the generator but it looked old and out of power. But no worries, Batman had the remote electrical charger. He used that device to power up the generator and it worked. The GCPD was back on power. Now it was time to deal with the drones.


---

* **Thank you for reading. See you all on my next blog.**

---

__main__\\.title: A FRIEND I MISS A LOT
__main__\\.body:
Good morning everyone you're welcome to my blog today.

The people we lose in life and the people we win with,I believe this topic relates to each and everyone of us on this platform in different ways because we have had people in our life that are not there anymore because of one incident or the other that might have happened along the line.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXAYfS4mqSksEPUUqbYY75hi8svxrAvN54aQScrh9ws3f/22549.png 




so back to my primary school days I used to have a girlfriend call the Becky ,Becky and I we are very good friends we practically did everything together ,we read together ,we ate together, she knew my parents and her mom also knows my mom they became best of friends.

Our friendship blossomed into a very beautiful thing that lasted down to our secondary school days and then we share dreams of attending the same university and creating so many memories together but you know how life can be, our plans got disrupted I got admission before her and entered school I spent 2 years already in school before she got admission into the same school.



So all this way that I've been in school , our communication actually dwindled and it was less frequent we didn't really get to know what was was happening in each other's life or talk over the phone like we used to do, so I had no idea that she had gotten admission into school .

While coming back from lectures I bumped into her and she acted like she didn't know who I was she wasn't happy to see me she didn't even wait to hug me and maybe ask for my number , so we can reconnect I tried reaching out a couple of times but it wasn't working so I knew that it was time to let go of that friendship and I did that I decided to let her and continue with my life and make new friends.

So it's okay to outgrow people ,yes it is most times for your own peace and sanity you need to let some people go. If I had decided to tie my happiness around what happened when I saw her after 2 years I would have been a very sad girl after then yes it hurt me deeply by , but i decided to leave past it and live my life in the best way possible.

And so many years after leaving school my graduated and I believe she had graduated too I also running to another similar situation where I had to either win a friend or lose a friend and what happened this time might sound funny but I'll still share it here.

I have always had to good friends and their names are Elizabeth and confidence we have been good friends for a very long time they're having been serious issue or rift between us recently likes happening and some things changed.

The friendship between Elizabeth and I and confidence has blossomed into something really beautiful over the years and when I had the s issue with lossing my girlfriend Becky , they were there to comfort me and help me move on from it.

Little did I know that I was going to be struggling with the same thing between my two friends it was indeed, Elizabeth was dating confidence brother and the relationship has lasted for up 5 years and still counting and all of a sudden he got tired of the relationship and decided to ghost her or break up with her .



And then confidence has been the one feeding her brother with a lot of negativities about Elizabeth that lead to the break and these are secrets that Elizabeth share with confidence as a friend she trusted so much.

So this caused a rift between the two of them and I was automatically dragged into against my better judgement I asked Lizzy and confidence to arrange a meeting a talk things out between themselves.

Confidence was not willing to talk things out and I had a lot of things going on with me at the moment to pay much attention to my girlfriend Elizabeth and confidence. And finally when I reached out to her she was so angry that I was there for her when she needed me .

And at that point we reconnected and confidence wasn't still willing to make peace it was a situation where we would either lose confidence or win her over and amend our friendship. But unfortunately confidence never came back. And most times in life we either win or lose and for me friendship means a lot to me . But you either lose or win sometimes in friendship not everyone is here to stay.
I really miss my friends so much especially confidence but life happens and we lose contact with some people.
Thank you for stopping by my blog.


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@betheloji12/a-friend-i-miss-a-lot-bby)

__main__\\.title: Sunday morning run
__main__\\.body:
![IMG_3114.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23zGWM2rFx3cE3pn5CnhZcM1SYxrLSMeLc97wyoNwcEuoWt7F5m8ey5BnVBn9WYDo1nVN.jpeg)

I got out of bed early as today was expected to be pretty warm here. I ended up later on the road than expected as I wanted to watch back Usyk vs Verhoeven before I went outside and Verhoeven clearly did better than expected. 

Even at 07:00 it was already pressing warm due to the high humidity. While I did bring 1 soft flask with me, I would had been a little smarter if I had also had taken some breakfast and had drank something else other than a coffee - but I will do that next time! 

I decided to go for a 15km run at mid to high zone 3 pace. Which brings my weekly activity to: 

Monday 8km 4:05/km (tempo run)
Tuesday 50km 5:25/km (ultra)
Thursday 8km 4:49/km (injury check run)
Sunday 15km 4:29/km (zone 3)
Total 81 km which felt great after a longer period of less activity. 


![IMG_3143.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23swkNnbaU1eG8Fg6vdS67Vgz3PibaM6b4i5z5WhTjk8LQkJCQjRBW174PwzjrN8RS6AZ.jpeg)

My run today was in a green polderlandscape that is part of Natura 2000 which is a program within the EU to have more nature preserved especially close to larger cities. Which is always a pleasure to run through. 


![IMG_3115.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23zRxag9dFQvKQx4ZizHNKXyo67ZVrDUL4EcaGQZtp5bkL5Qycbw4Aixrh8bbvtEFXRuV.jpeg)

![IMG_3116.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/242NfAiACs6qt3TuzMLUQm5ESUd6XeqwPe92RXmCqZE2oksLuGd97DgrFwAY4BASC3ViU.jpeg)

![IMG_3125.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/EoMDfKLT9JwZYLgKD9rKW8YyKcDafYsLKeQhynnVAvXrYFQQ3tiwELqkNrA7C8LFVSW.jpeg)

![IMG_3134.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/Ep3eGyvr9h61eyiRgtAXjn6qP5RP6Ufp2eFmMR28PHNNnX6mzGG1ihvdXrGVSjpNurK.jpeg)

We will receive the schedule from the oncologist this coming Wednesday; as we expect now, that will be chemo every other week until at least mid-September, followed by surgery in early November.

While my personal running ambitions are now of no importance - I do plan to stay as active as possible to remain fit , have distractions and also some time to clear my mind.

__main__\\.title: [EN/PT] So Productive
__main__\\.body: >\n\nThe ground started to get hotter as the sun shines. The light broke through every window, lighting up dark rooms. He felt the brightness on his eyes. He opened them slightly. The rest of the face was still sleepy. The first thought came to mind was: \

> He got up from bed, went to wash his face. As soon as he opened the door, he saw his reflection in the mirror. Messed up hair representing how much selfcare he had, tired eyes from staying up all the late nights and a slim body from poorly managed meals. He surely did reach those targets at work. But, the stare he had to mirror at that time, was something different. Something that he has not felt for a long time. He was thinking, was it worth it? Was that a sort of a trade? Can health be put on a scale to measure against anything in life? Was it worth a second thought? A hold for a moment maybe? Would a simple appreciation justify, for all of this? What if, all of this was only to get the chance to receive an appreciation? He realized that, there was no enough time to go through this thinking process in the morning. As he was gathering his stuff, he thought, I will have this on a piece of paper, when there is time later. The phrase which puts his thoughts among a long queue of postponed stuff to be done. # PT

>\n\nO chão começou a esquentar com o brilho do sol. A luz invadiu todas as janelas, iluminando os cômodos escuros. Ele sentiu o brilho nos olhos. Abriu-os ligeiramente. O resto do rosto ainda estava sonolento. O primeiro pensamento que lhe veio à mente foi: \

.\n\nLevantou-se da cama e foi lavar o rosto. Assim que abriu a porta, viu seu reflexo no espelho. Cabelo despenteado, representando o quanto se cuidara, olhos cansados ​​por ter passado as noites em claro e um corpo magro por causa das refeições mal planejadas. Certamente, ele havia atingido as metas no trabalho. Mas o olhar que se viu refletido naquele momento era diferente. Algo que não sentia há muito tempo. Ele se perguntou: valeu a pena? Foi uma espécie de troca? A saúde pode ser comparada a qualquer coisa na vida? Valeria a pena repensar? Talvez parar por um instante? Um simples agradecimento justificaria tudo isso? E se tudo isso fosse apenas para ter a chance de receber um agradecimento? Ele percebeu que não havia tempo suficiente para se dedicar a esse processo de reflexão pela manhã. Enquanto juntava suas coisas, pensou: \
. Essa frase colocou seus pensamentos em uma longa fila de tarefas adiadas.\n\nPosted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ronnie10/enpt-so-productive-efj)

links.body:
# Hello Hive 


![1000218275.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/2432LBy8ngxeJemR3Q9H6zPWWGaqEMJQ4YW2upjkmd9cr2C8KPfotcK6uEdUehmvn4yzp.jpg)

A beautiful Sunday morning to us all 
I hope that we are chilling on this weekend and having a good time. 

We had one of the most chaotic evenings yesterday among our poultry birds especially the turkey when they wouldn't allow us to have a peaceful evening yesterday. 


![1000218283.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/242DNogPuhtzmyjWBgXzCJgcYsprKWSum32P6HGruQyodoYiDbuG5vbyyhRxHZVdvNsma.jpg)

Both the children and the Turkey birds were happy playing around the compound. The children were unaware of the turkey chasing each other as it was mating time.
Mating is an innate behaviour among animals and as soon as they begin to reach 4 four months you start noticing this sign among them, At 6months max they are ready to mate and lay eggs. 


![1000218288.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EpNoRVoL2hT1BEweEr7KUR2cD8ddnEW4nyxBVh9V329WoXJtXDXJr9fqwuSJYxYFXAx.jpg)

![1000218297.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EpNpNLzu5mdV81jiYdHUhK9egqUQ7xeg2tcp81YgtECBHFsQxGjRwNrGc3YXngyqxSo.jpg)


Almost everybody in this compound now raises birds, as soon as they notice they benefits people derive from it, no one wants to be left behind. Everyone one has a small cage and keeps one or two birds and we are all hoping that they will continue to multiply. Now that almost everything is so expensive it is better for people to raise their birds by themselves which will be more cheaper than trying to purchase meat from the market. And since we have people among us who are familiar with this task, everyone gets to learn from each other and this knowledge is shared us here. 


Its a bit funny that regardless of how much these birds looked similar in appearance everyone knows the ones that are theirs.


![1000218291.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xySmViFnPLfSskTooCd6H2vpXf2Eh233vM69QgtZvS4Qrbf2Ri6b8TzVNGWWLmYAnJY.jpg)

Since our birds are a bit bigger in size now we decide to stop feeding them to the regular poultry feeds sold at the market. Raising poultry this way makes it cheaper compared feeding them with all through with the feeds sold at the market. 
Funny enough these birds can eat virtually anything been feed to them, all the crumbs from our table have now found some good use. 


The birds that are meant for laying eggs can be feed with quality foods all through so that they can lay these eggs at the appropriate time and lay quality eggs.

I have been sharing tips about how to raise turkey birds here with the community and hopefully someone will find these tips useful.

links.title: Nomisma Network Is Building DeFi Infrastructure For The AI Era
links.body:
[Nomisma Network](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) as an early-stage blockchain project building an AI-focused DeFi infrastructure layer. It aims to support decentralized applications by using a “subchain” model.

Early architectures work perfectly fine when the chain only needs to process simple transfers and basic swaps. TPS becomes a vanity metric and then latency starts bleeding into UX.

But once you start layering advanced DeFi strategies, real-time oracle streams, AI-assisted execution, or autonomous liquidity systems… the cracks begin to surface.

State bloat compounds and execution fragments across layers. [Nomisma](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) aims to make everything simple, DeFi that is smooth and doesn't crack when it has to scale! 

Suddenly the “decentralized” stack quietly leans on centralized APIs, off-chain compute, and Web2 crutches just to stay alive. That’s the hidden tradeoff most users never see.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYHnjisnPYd4RsCEuEPZbyB5RCds5MiM9EHe3XXe3LESL/image.png)


Crypto keeps preaching sovereignty while routing half its intelligence through middleware. But that’s exactly why [Nomisma Network](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) caught my attention.

New week but the same mission. Different signal and strategies because diamonds are no longer just a farming metric. They’re a reputation primitive… a behavioral layer sitting underneath the surface economy.

The real question stops being  “how do I farm more Diamonds?” and instead it shifted to “what variables is the system actually indexing?”. Efficiency depends on what's tracked! 

Activity? Consistency? Cross-dApp interaction? Timing? Retention? Wallet behavior? Hidden reputation scores? I have nothing to back any of that but I noticed things! 

Do quests unlock differently depending on user patterns? What about the PNL leaderboard? [Nomisma](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) shifted from a static campaign to adaptive infrastructure.

Honestly… that changes the meta entirely. Everyone can make noise on socials but experience backed by capital always hits better. The exploration starts with quests right?

But now this quests require USDT on the testnet, which you get from the mystery boxes. Yes anon... this time you have to spend something to make your way towards rewards! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPjP5uVkNhwS1LHUDJVjMgNAphr55BDxXt4bnmknZGEfh/image.png)


[Nomisma](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) Epoch 1 felt like exploration mode, with app testing experience that gave me 44.15 Diamonds. Not bad for the opening cycle! Epoch 2 turned up even better! 

I completed quests and pushed up on the PNL leaderboard, translated in 72 Diamonds. Since increasing activity inside the Nomisma ecosystem, my positioning shifted as well.

What’s clear though is that participation no longer feels equal across wallets. Some users are clearly experiencing different rails inside the same ecosystem.

The Mystery Box system reinforces that idea too. Each box is a multiplier engine, even if you don't unwrap a multiplier. The testnet USD in the box helps you earn points! 

Minted my ID, opened ten boxes, and hope that the $25 spent so far will at least break even! Play2Pay? Maybe! But the testnet money helps me get lots of points each epoch! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaXNseLrxTyBrREE6dSAHUCa5cEQ7LzN9everMzwi5svJ/image.png)


Why I like the [Nomisma](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) synergy even if you need to put skin in the game? Friction also filters out sybil spam and bot saturation, which could make the eventual reward distribution far more meaningful.

Beneath the quests and Diamonds, Nomisma Network seems to be testing a deeper thesis! Can DeFi infrastructure evolve into a scalable intelligence layer capable of supporting high-frequency data systems?

Will [Nomisma](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) be able to deliver AI-native applications and adaptive economic coordinatio without collapsing back into centralized architecture? That’s the real experiment! 

Epoch three came with ATH on earned diamonds, and maybe was the little 1.04x multiplier... but it wasn't. The secret is to tap into all the available ways that can earn points.

More points will convert into more diamonds, and consistency will pay off! My next goal is to make it on the PNL leaderboard and finally get some diamonds on that category! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPqLm5q9HZEuZL3NErBS4dZ1aT9FMnTpjA9fmisaomNjP/image.png)

Today I am here again with a photography. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTJjobjGN3VfQfApixjAMQRzwNFGpa2hnP39Eb9zB1FQE/1779603891502.jpg)| |-| The name of this bird is known as Jhutiala Shalik in our common village area but it has a beautiful name in English that is Typical Mynas These birds look very beautiful their structure and skin color is very beautiful. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYZf5KJNbkFfnJMa2oZ4iso4mNBcuKcH4az3KAvf6XDtX/1779603917549.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMRbSoSxP2Mu21s7NHL5wrgpFa8d3khvhbZ6Y1eEgiPz/1779603917630.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW7ocyE7CVMuKeYm1nLicBgt79WB5SKbejHLuy4EBu4uB/1779603917711.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY5bB9unUjtUCvDCUkisANphbshAjGQ6xEyA1mnLdE73B/1779603917808.jpg) Typical Mynas birds used to be seen a long time ago but are now much rarer. Today when I went for a walk this morning, this bird was feeding on the side of the road when it saw me trying to run away very quickly but I managed to take a few pictures intelligently. Typical Mynas birds are basically black in color, like ash soil, their legs and lips are the same color, the yellow beak looks very beautiful, especially they have a beautiful crest on their head, and that's why everyone calls them Ala Shalik. Also, these birds are very fickle in nature, they usually move far away from people, now many people learn these birds, for this day by day, these birds are going to extinction. It is not possible to take a lot of pictures of birds because they quickly change their place once they understand and once they move away, it is not possible to take a picture.

links.title: Pork goulash with mushrooms (champignons)
links.body:
## Gulasz wieprzowy z pieczarkami

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvwSfRBvFwZ8vCRBSKpawU9Wnm2uE78g47pKunAY9FqQ/a10.jpg)



Ingredients: Pork, wheat flour, onion, carrot, fresh mushrooms, dried sweet pepper, dried or fresh hot pepper, pepper, salt, allspice, bay leaf, dried juniper, Chinese cabbage.
>Składniki: Mięso wieprzowe, mąka pszenna, cebula. marchewka. świeże pieczarki, słodka suszona papryka, ostra papryka suszona lub świeża, pieprz, sól, ziele angielskie liść laurowy, suszony jałowiec, kapusta pekińska.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcDA7CWrbe2YixeZ8DWXmZ9HRwKLj2Zu8UrsFgqeyTMpU/b14.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfZq4JqHJkjojLofARzx9xSDDwUXnrb6xFFQGc6NpNqTb/b15.jpg)
|-|-|


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTbV5WPxt99ZTyNqUxrZE7L23YaHhQPPB59JacnUca2ew/b04.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPzkZLiDkbMf2rZHrdpkgRJkCcnEKAvKLoKFFywF2sjEb/b09.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYUtpF2BV9nDUK2LQovp16VoAxNw4tprMKU26A35qDPj1/b10.jpg)






Preparing the goulash: Coat the pork cut into thick cubes in flour and fry in hot fat in a pan.
>Przygotowanie gulaszu: Pokrojone w grubą kostkę mięso wieprzowe obtaczamy w mące i podsmażamy na patelni na rozgrzanym tłuszczu. 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY9GfHDXasz6Xsk8feXAiZxdttjusKPASWv9wujkL5ZRr/b12.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQowXYwLFY6qa1GUM12i37wTxWBNFSdPPgqx78Ehok1NR/b13.jpg)

Next, transfer the browned meat to a pot, add diced onion, carrot, and spices: pepper, salt, allspice, bay leaf, a generous amount of sweet paprika, and chili pepper to taste. Add water and simmer until the meat is tender.
>Następnie przekładamy podsmażone mięso do garnka, dodajemy pokrojoną w kostkę cebulę, marchewkę oraz przyprawy czyli pieprz, sól, ziele angielskie, liść laurowy, duża ilość słodkiej sproszkowanej papryki, oraz papryki ostrej według uznania. Całość podlewamy wodą i dusimy d miękkości mięsa.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY25i5o51GQgRRWU8pbq4Whojqbx76XfNSpGG6Wv59cTa/b08.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPFdMRG6eoDCJQgY7jYriesmfe8yXvoWzAjkFsjfkfBmg/b07.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb3VaHpxCBChkzxxb6oDrdZssLMiLhVTHoqAVyha8iRNN/b06.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3ULMPwAVPXvqwVRMqtHDM9bhLaENY6VNbpit2bdvrsL/b03.jpg)

Once the meat is relatively tender, add the peeled and sliced ​​mushrooms and simmer for another 30 minutes. The goulash is ready.
>Gdy mięso jest już w miarę miękkie, dodajemy obrane ze skórki i pokrojone w plasterki pieczarki i dusimy wszystko jeszcze przez około 30 minut. Gulasz gotowy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcAXi1Mv7B6B2iFnKP5AT8Vn5xBpaDEHaJQ1KMdkuZBw9/b05.jpg)

Serve with boiled potatoes and a salad, in my case with Chinese cabbage with garlic and mayonnaise.
>Podajemy z ziemniakami ugotowanymi na sypko oraz z surówką, w moim wypadku z kapustą pekińską z czosnkiem i majonezem.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRk9B2DVhukiVnjodnNQ7i7m3FuHfTryX9Bfqkrebugus/b02.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYEX9YFyiuyaUtiKEa7JjSpUcXP86wRDESQ3AyfppbQsx/b01.jpg)







![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhpNzKaZ6qU2mDdZHWzuJDyU8nd2auuYNEHwQudjArvu/ornament_kuchnia1.png)


## Enjoy your meal 😉

links.title: For Recognizing Us
links.body:
Absolutely. Yeah, I've told Rick numerous times in an open space how much I care about the time that we spend together, and I wish there was more time. I just wish there was more time.

But speaking of time, I just wanted to say, I didn't say what I'm grateful for today, and Bridget and Fred entered the room, and they had me thinking of how grateful I am about their kindness and just being a voice of reason in spaces. I usually, in the middle of the night, I'll listen to a space, and there was, I guess, a disruption in Melody's space last night, and I just wanted to say, and I spoke to Fred about this, how wonderful it was and how hard they tried just to make peace with the person who was disrupting that space, that beautiful space that Melody had. I like to listen to her sing, not so much any of the rest of you.

No, I'm just kidding. But no, I just wanted to say. On that note, I'm going to sing right now, so while Dante is still here.

I wanted to say I'm grateful. Yeah, I'm grateful really for Bridget's and Fred's really voice of reason and kindness and working through kind of someone who's in a dark place right now who comes with the same kind of act in every space. So I'm grateful for that, for you both, truly.

I am. That was really a nice listen, and yeah. Oh, Dante, thank you for that.

Sometimes spaces go sideways, and Fred's amazing. When he came up, I was like, oh, thank God. I was so exhausted last night because I had just done like four hours of channeled messages in my public community, like consistent four hours straight, right? So I just did not, and we've never had that experience in all those spaces before.

So it was a lot to handle, and I just feel like sometimes people, like you said, are in a dark place, whatever that looks like for them, and then that can kind of get everyone else riled up, right? So it was just that perfect mixture of like a number of people were kind of getting riled up by that energy, and that's in some ways it's distortion, right? So it's like the way to handle it, of course, you can be an ex, or you can do it in a more loving way, right? And sometimes you need to be an ex, and sometimes you don't, and maybe we didn't take care of it as quickly as I would have on the other app for sure. But, you know, ex is a different ballgame here, and there's a lot more sensitivities to certain things. So I think we did the best that we could in that moment, and you just learn from it and move on.

And I'm grateful that people stayed through it and after to see how it shifted on me, right? But, yeah, I mean, it happens. What are you going to do? There's just a lot of people going through a lot of different things on this app. There's going to be some of that sometimes, right? And thank you for recognizing us.

links.body:
这家小店很不错，关键是这附近的大学生都认这家店，所以她们家生意很不错。中午的时候又买了她家的冷面夹和手抓饼。冷面夹知道是什么吗我刚开始也不知道，姑娘说就是冷面夹臭豆腐。噢，叫她们这样叫起来感觉还挺高端的美食啦。
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU4AoepEYqJvCKtGzoeZN7cyw78deZj21RPGnFcLHMb8t/1779602542715.jpg)
这个浴霸开关坏了。姑娘说沐浴的时候开灯按了一下给她吓一跳，下边几个按不动，碰一下哗啦都碎碎的掉地上啦！这是怎么回事？时间长开关内的材质糟糕了吗？担心会触电，我赶快找来透明胶先凑合着给粘上。跟房东说了一下，不过这种情况怎说呢，房东也不定管吧？但的确我们没有搞破坏呀？碰一下它就碎了。房东说还是买个换上吧，别在晚上摸到触电了就糟了。我问了一下五金店的人，这样的开关要18块钱左右。看看吧等周一问问物业管理的人能不能给安装一下。
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfWhrcS7M7og2KwsYuUTDEpx9kjbbizqUTHzKja1jkKTy/1779603005642.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRi4r2APtL3uyqMZ9b79NjWbwwzqcM2cVzPJkEXvNXSDn/1779603005688.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYYfTe5ZM1D2xEY1mzfmNNaAWeBFhUuxFXRmm1qKo8CXA/1779603030315.jpg)
今天还有件重要的事情解决了。最近养老保险扣费晚了好几天了，不知道什么原因。领导特意去帮我问了一下，说是22-24号之前看看吧。今天打开支付宝，果真扣费了。之前的担心都是多余的了。因为自己已经交够年限了，想再多交几年，毕竟退休了就能多开些养老保险嘛!一切顺利就不用特意回家再办手续了。真是顺利呢。最近可以安心在大连呆着了，姑娘也不张罗休息回家了，她说要省点费用，突然家懂事儿了哈呢!
领导今天请假休息陪他三哥看病去了。来信息说结果还行，没有想的那么可怕。大夫给开了一个月的药，说一个月后再去检查。要说他三哥这病也是喝酒喝出来的，我这么觉得的呵，本来不胖的人硬喝出来酒精肝，这能怪谁呢，现在年龄渐大什么病痛都找上门来。所以一个人的身体还是要从年轻的就要注意保养，不要透支身体。

links.title: Simplicity without nuances.
links.body:
Simplicity without nuances. Simple things, or simple tasks, at first glance seem devoid of any complex nuances, like the simple communication of two birds that understand each other with a half-glance, with a single, seemingly inarticulate sound. ![1rewtDSC06127.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQme7RqQC5wrYmBHTvZtnJe6ts8CC7ocD7Kzp6tUeiouQny/1rewtDSC06127.png) In theory, any task is little different from wanting to have a picnic somewhere in a crowded place. You're hungry, so just sit down on a bench and eat, without looking around, without paying attention to the people around you, who, in essence, are certain nuances that, to some extent, can influence the outcome of a seemingly simple task. LOL. ![1artsDSC00820.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmTWn7dP9x8uj1gdAQKYEQSPM4jr6Tvi8bqPaVPTEGzBTv/1artsDSC00820.png) Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. links.title: Follow your heart!!
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcH2eDXKHi3896PpXB1A2wbhoCNP6zyameV6dq6iy3e1L/file_0000000037b072088d60aa445453ffd6.png 

It's rightly said that we should be good listeners, but what about listening to your hearts!!

I think it's extremely important to pay attention to what your heart is trying to tell you!!

We listen to our bodies, but when it comes to the heart, we don't give it the attention it deserves!! 

Our heart is made up of our feelings, our passions, and our dreams. 

All these elements play a vital role in determining our career, our future, and ultimately our destiny!! 

The people who suppress their inner voice don't feel the sense of fulfilment in their lives!!

Following our dreams is the ultimate choice we all ought to make as we navigate the journey of life!!

Find your passion and pursue your hobbies, but for that, we have to be financially independent in order to be able to  get to the position where we experience financial freedom, i.e.,. we are able to spend our time according to our wishes!!

Dream big!! But I think these dreams and passions need a lot of self-belief in order to pursue them and achieve them. 

Believing in ourselves results in believing in our dreams!! Thus, our self-esteem and our self-confidence are the underlying causes that motivate us to promote and express ourselves fully through actualizing our dreams and pursue our passions!!

Our hearts tell us to go beyond our comfort zones to achieve our full potential.

Thus, following our hearts will ultimately transform our lives into a happier and healthier life as we will get closer to the realisation of our true potential.

In short, life is too short to waste it in suppressing our true desires .Instead, determine what you truly want, and don't be reluctant in putting all your heart into experiencing the joy of fulfilling your wishes and genuine aspirations!!

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@hilal09/follow-your-heart-5sz)

links.title: Nyasha Mbalika || The Fire Archer That Changes Battles || Deadly Speed and Stun Power
links.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 24, 2026, 11_00_58 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uFYBqP86KGaRuxj1Rj1QtcU2CxVvR7booDdGTi6hyoDtCByo3dCjJtqydDmA35xV8PX.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


In #splinterlands there are some cards that really prove to be game changers.If they are used with the right strategy and correct position then I think sometimes even a single card can play up to 50% role in winning the battle. 

Among such powerful cards one name is Nyasha Mbalika which is easily available in the market at different prices. This card is of Legendary rarity and belongs to the Fire element. 

Its mana cost is 8 which is a bit high but in return it gives very strong performance. Its attack type is ranged meaning it attacks from a distance which is its biggest specialty. Because of this it is not used in the front line but keeps dealing damage from safe positions.

If we talk about its stats at higher level then it becomes even more powerful. 
Its attack is 3
Speed 5 
Health 7 
Armor 1. 

![Screenshot 2026-03-19 114435.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tGwKrxPkBGj9WWHesDJKfjabFx2Y8mPPSuFbRBV4W26K1PRyfFDGeGhfdzDaRTPeHTh.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

This combination makes it both fast and strong. Because of high speed it often attacks first and sometimes also dodges enemy attacks.

Now lets talk about positioning which is the most important factor in #splinterlands. According to my experience if your monsters are in the right position then your chances of winning increase a lot. 

And if the position is wrong then even with strong monsters you can still lose the battle.

Nyasha Mbalika best position is middle or backline because it is a ranged attacker. In my opinion middle position is better where it stays safe after the tank and keeps giving continuous damage. In this way it survives longer which is its real strength.

Its abilities also make it more special. The longer it stays alive in battle the more it keeps disturbing the enemy. It has the Stun ability which temporarily stops the enemy meaning they miss their turn. This is a very powerful effect.

![Screenshot 2026-03-19 114449.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wBfyqnx6M8odWYAVveXrFVzN7nb2Umjcpgy4vW9TfAGT9Cj8XVp11d61X51B4yLHz8g.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

Besides this it has three more great abilities that is...

**It always targets the enemy with the lowest health so it quickly eliminates weak monsters on the backline**.

**It gives +1 attack to all melee monsters in its team which increases team damage a lot**.

**It reflects 50% damage back to ranged attackers which is very useful for defense**

If I talk about its price it is available at different rates. Currently it can be found around $2.799, some versions are near $4 while high level or rare copies can go up to $39. This all depends on its level and type (gold or regular).

In my view this monster is worth to buy and is at reasonable price. If you use it with the right position and the right team it can really play a very big role in your victory.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.


![1400.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EppNdx4pfHvBAhyDRLuzxTB7hUfR2bCnbRNf7EiU9SYxCmECi7HXeQW7RLfPCAXn2Hd.gif)

- слово, яке щовечора кажуть одне одному мільйони людей. Цей ліричний трек продовжує  емоційну та максимально життєву лінію пісень YAKTAK про прості, але глибокі моменти повсякденності. Цього разу його новий трек виглядає спробою перетворити звичне слово на музичний жест турботи.\nНастрій композиції продовжує лінію попередніх робіт артиста, особливо пісні \

присутня ще вища концентрація мінімалізму та відчуття домашнього затишку. HiveSuite improves feed UI consistency, media strip layouts, and PeakD-style on-chain notification handling.

# HiveSuite 

## Right-Side Media Strip Across All Feeds

### Unified Feed Media Experience

- feat(ui): apply right-side media strip across feeds.
- Auto-applied the new right-side media strip layout across all feeds using `BlogPostList`.  


- Applied across:
  - Blogs  
  - Communities  
  - MyFriends  
  - Profile tabs  


- Improved media rendering consistency across the application.  

- Unified feed presentation and visual spacing throughout all feed views.  


- Outcome:
  - Cleaner and more modern feed experience  
  - Better multi-media presentation consistency  
  - Improved visual hierarchy across HiveSuite feeds  


Right-Side Media Strip

![Right-Side Media Strip - Desktop](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23tkhS9p6BuYuwRNSKTLyVNmv6aR7A1ZN5DoNS6nPt9aiG6tjAGnzEDSKCwJ1hHixeCSg.png)

![Unified Feed Layout - My Communities](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/48GgFbiZcm4FwCDWWsNNZRdgLyUyF6UiUZrgqXrLjwrjRbZXAVt1q3XX9ZUkS2WMkk.png)



---

## Feed Card UI & Community UX Improvements

### Feed & Community Experience Updates

- feat(feed): adopt new card UI + community UX.
- Applied the new media strip card UI across:
  - All feeds  
  - Profile pages  


- Improved mobile card sizing for better responsive rendering.  

- Updated skeleton loaders for layout consistency across devices.  


### Community Page UX Improvements

- Updated `CommunityDetail` page behavior:
  - Sticky tabs support  
  - Scroll reset improvements  


- Feed updates automatically propagated through HiveReactKit shared components.  


- Outcome:
  - Improved responsive experience on mobile devices  
  - Better community browsing workflow  
  - Consistent feed behavior across the platform  


Mobile Feed Cards
![Mobile Feed Cards](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23tGdwUZG9c6wcua9NHEzCYtjL5FNcsghcVeWAQYhUGBTq9utamc4kzKB3J2zrJR7ziCQ.png)



Community UX Improvements

---

## Notifications System Improvements

### PeakD-Style On-Chain Read State

- feat(notifications): peakd-style mark-as-read + chain unread state.
- Notifications now use on-chain unread state handling aligned with PeakD behavior.  

- Replaced localStorage-based notification cursor with:
  - `lastReadDate` from API  


- Implemented mark-as-read using:
  - `aioha.customJSON`  
  - Clean typed transaction handling  


- Uses current timestamp instead of latest notification timestamp for safer synchronization.  

- Added optimistic UI updates with automatic resync on success or failure.  

- Mark-as-read button remains always enabled:
  - Supports idempotent interaction behavior  


- Outcome:
  - Improved notification synchronization reliability  
  - Better alignment with Hive ecosystem notification standards  
  - More consistent unread state management across devices  


On-Chain Notification Read State & Notification UX Improvements

![On-Chain Notification Read State & Notification UX Improvements](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23xKnFjHW3wZqmKJjFfa65KsNmWvA54QWsHbYPeFifNzXEGo3P36MTyY2rXb7Xn98bG5q.png)

- Building reusable feed infrastructure and standardized UI systems for the Hive community  
- Contributing towards a more reliable and feature-rich Hive ecosystem experience

links.title: Challenge #04893-M144: Something's in the Water
links.body:
![annette-batista-day-op5zrC8iaDQ-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23vhHCQpCqia5U7uNNiEQnBy6oxpKLSffL8j13CkJomB2kwNhDsUsffk2iHQraYHn7NAz.jpg)

> The laundresses of three neighboring noble estates have long come the same bend in the river to clean the fabrics of their masters and chat about the day’s trivialities. All seemed right and normal for years, until one day the laundry emerged from the waters covered in strange, flowing symbols too neat to be stains, too precise to be meaningless. -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

Three Baronets held neighbouring lands, and it was a lucky thing that they were friends. The shared hunting grounds were a forest where a majority of the three realms' politics happened whilst riding out and locating their shared quarry. Most of the rest happened over ales at the feast for the victor.

It was therefore no shock that the servants were also fast allies. The neighbouring holiday castles shared the same stream where the laundresses clustered to chatter and scrub. Most of the news that didn't reach the town criers exchanged itself at that junction.

\
cheered the laundress for Ronchenac, Nellie. \
said the laundress for Sweetcomb, Olga. \
said the laundress for Dawburn, Wynna. \

The other two cooed their interest, hands never stopping on their work.

\
said Nellie. She lifted up the latest piece she'd been scrubbing. A bed sheet for one of the staff, but now it was all over with symbols. She turned the sheet about. \
She scrubbed at a patch with her soap. Worried it against the washboard. \
said Olga, checking her work on a kerchief. It, too, was covered in scrawl that she couldn't read. \

They at least made sure all the laundry was as clean as they could get it, because they took pride in their work.

They said hurried farewells and scurried off to their lords to bring the matter to their relative court Wizards. Not seconds later, three heads popped up from the flowing water. One undine lifted up by the other two to check in three directions.

\
She returned fully to the water, and each of the three checked the shorelines where washing had been moments before.\n\n\
\n\nThe scout of the trio searched her shore, slapping it with irritation when she was done. \
She sighed as she sank up to her iridescent, scaled shoulders. \

>Unsplash] If you like my stories, please [Check out my blog and Follow me](https://peakd.com/@internutter). Or share them with your friends! _Or_ visit my [hub site](https://www.internutter.org) to see what else I'm up to. # <center> Welcome to the #DailyPrompt by the @daily.prompt, your daily writing prompt from the @Freewritehouse, and the Freewriters Community!</center>

<center><sub><sub>The @Freewritehouse, and members of the Freewriters Community, will be forever grateful to @mariannewest for creating the daily freewriting prompt and for posting it for 2023 days!!! Thank you Marianne!</sub></sub></center>




Freewriting is a great way to start or maintain a writing habit. And we've been making it easy for you with a daily prompt for over 3000 days!

And, as an added bonus, we are continuing to award **three freewriters a Hive SBI share every single day**!
<center>![giveaway.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/AJoLtsVsugdVrTuJ5x7bFSQywMHn9X8XiTcDB748kRJdDaiJHvbSAZ6bAHMVj3j.gif)</center>
All you have to do, for a chance of winning one is 
- write a freewrite based on the @Daily.Prompt
- post it in the Freewriters Community, 
- and drop a link in the comments section of this post! 

Every day **three** of the best daily freewrites will be awarded **one** HiveSBI share. 
<sub>Not sure what Hive SBI is? [Find out more here](https://docs.hivesbi.com/)</sub>

What are you waiting for?



# <center>Today's #DailyPrompt is</center>

# <center>so productive</center>

...

How to freewrite...

- Set your timer for 5 minutes
- Start writing
- Use the hashtag #freewrite #dailyprompt
- Publish your piece (include a link to this post if you wish)
- Copy and paste your URL into the comment section of **this post**.
<sup>Or, if you don't want to publish your freewrite, just copy and paste as a comment under the prompt post.</sup>
- What if you want to write for longer than five minutes? No problem! There are no rules... 

except...
# 
### <center>**NO plagiarism, NO AI-generated stories**</center> 
<center><sup>(write your own story; that is kinda the whole point!)</sup></center>

<center>![ezgif.com-crop (1).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/23tGTgenLx7nZuH24w8svkxMgichtFRkx4TPk4Ycqw4gV2EF1XNXCmJHkuoes3Lki5fPH.gif)</center>

# Check the @freewritehouse for fun contests

Other contests are available at the FreewriteHouse. Thank you to everyone who contributes!

<sub>If you have an idea for a contest (and the time and motivation to run it) please contact @felt.buzz</sub>


...
# Contests by Friends of the Freewriters

@improv runs a weekly Punday contest. Check it out!

<sub>If you are running a contest you want to be listed here, let @felt.buzz know.</sub>

# Writing help

- A free app: Grammarly. A lot of us are not native English speakers and I am finding it a helpful app. It will underline spelling and grammar mistakes. Remember that it is not always right -especially if you use complex sentence structures. [Here is the link](https://app.grammarly.com/)
- Remember [The Most Dangerous Writing App](https://www.squibler.io/dangerous-writing-prompt-app). You set the time - 5 min - and start typing. Don’t stop!!! It will destroy what you wrote if you stop for more than 3 seconds - and backspace does not count as writing on the app. If you are prone to stop and think - this app forces you to keep going. You can make corrections after the 5 minutes are over.
- A timer. Egg timer is a free tool you can use on your desktop to set a time. This is useful for our freewrites or if you want to work in blocks of time and then take a break. [Here is the link](https://e.ggtimer.com/)

Хотів затишного місця,? То купляв би собі ділянку десь в селі, та не мав би проблем. А тут, посеред нового району з активним будівництвом демонстративно показувати який ти придурок і цар гори, це вже занадто. Сподіваюсь, на таке самоуправство буде адекватна реакція.

links.title: You’re doing too much | LOH #289 contest week
links.body: > Greetings ladies, once again as always arriving late but at least I arrived, here is one of the questions that caught my attention the most.

> Saludos ladies, una vez mas como siempre llegando tarde pero al menos llegué, por aquí una de las preguntas que más me llamó la atención.
![IMG_2042.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTC8DUd1XPmTxMwvxvkTzvAXDhX6M6mxT1shgJRsEj8BP/IMG_2042.jpeg)

>\n\n> Feeling like you don't have enough time is often a sign that you're trying to ignore your own physical and mental limits. Are there any particular situations that make you feel like you're doing \

lately? Honestly, I feel like I'm doing too much, and I wonder if it's because of a quarter-life crisis, lol. But at the same time, it's also because I want to experience things I didn't have the chance to in my teens, and since I'm an adult now, I can make my own decisions and I'm responsible for my actions. I'll explain all the activities I do in my life right now. I go to the gym, I make an effort to eat healthy, I'm in a running club, I box, I practice archery, I have a day job six days a week in person, and I have another job at night on weekends, also in person. I read for at least an hour every day, I try to paint, I write down my thoughts and for my blog. Then, in addition, when I get home, I have to do all my housework, and I also have a cat, so that's another thing to take care of… I myself think I do too much, and sometimes I get stressed because when I manage to stop, I see that there are things I haven't organized, laundry to do, food to prepare, and so on…

>\n\n> Sentir que no te alcanza el tiempo suele ser una señal de que estás intentando ignorar tus propios límites físicos y mentales.¿Hay alguna situación en particular que te haga sentir que estás haciendo \

últimamente? Honestamente siento que sí estoy haciendo demasiadas cosas y me pongo a pensar si es por la crisis de los 30 años, lol. Pero al mismo tiempo también porque quiero experimentar cosas que no tuve ña oportunidad de hacerlo en mi adolescencia y como ahora soy adulta puedo tomar mis propias decisiones y soy responsable de mis propios actos. Les explicaré todas las actividades que hago en mi vida en la actualidad. Voy al gimnasio, pongo mi esfuerzo es comer saludable, estoy en un club de running, hago boxeo, practico tiro con arco, tengo un trabajo durante el día 6 veces por semana presencial y tengo otro trabajo en la noche los fines de semanas presencial también, estoy leyendo al menos 1 hora diaria, trato de pintar algo, escribo mis pensamientos y para mi blog. Luego adicionalmente al llegar a casa tengo que hacer todos mis deberes del hogar y también tengo un gato por lo que es otro cuidado… Yo misma creo que hago demasiadas cosas y a veces me estreso porque cuando logro detenerme, veo que hay cosas que no he organizado, ropa por lavar, comida por preparar y así…

Friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well, and I am too. Alhamdulillah, today I am back with a new recipe. I hope you will like the recipe because it is very healthy and very tasty. Here I have made a recipe with chicken, potatoes, and tomatoes, which is very healthy and very tasty. Let's go over all the details of how I made it.

Chicken, potatoes, small cardamom, large cardamom, cinnamon, pepper, salt, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, dried chili powder, oil, ginger, garlic paste

To prepare today's recipe, I first washed the chicken thoroughly and cut it into small pieces. Of course, you should wash the chicken thoroughly, if possible, wash it in salt water. Then I boiled the potatoes, peeled them, and cut them into small pieces. Then I peeled the potatoes and cut them into small pieces.

![a20ef39a-9681-419c-a88c-50870fe5413c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewhyydgQvkLEhFE1F9i3QdMpkdqkMwuDusM6o34pbZs8/a20ef39a-9681-419c-a88c-50870fe5413c.jpg)

After all my preparations are done, I will cook now. Then I put a pan on the stove, add chopped onion, bay leaves, and fry it well in oil. Of course, I will fry it until it turns almond-like. Then I will add all the powdered spices, add garam masala, and fry it again for about 5 minutes. When the oil is on top,

![86188437-0597-458a-91b3-e2ed7704efb0.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQAKMvKBQdgwtw6kD5dKe5Lf7DZcBGs3vcM1ZQQyE7wqx/86188437-0597-458a-91b3-e2ed7704efb0.jpg)

Then I will put my two chickens here, mix everything well, and cover it with a lid for about 15 minutes, so that my chickens will be cooked, and after that I will turn on the light and the potatoes here, and then mix everything well and cover it with a lid again for about 15 minutes because the potatoes need to be cooked well.

Of course, I have to observe whether everything is cooked well. Then I read it carefully. When it is cooked, I will add water here. Of course, I will add salt. I have to check it well and then add the fried jira  powder here. Cover it with a lid again for about ten minutes. But my cooking will be done. You can see how much oil has come out, and my cooking is complete. Then I must prepare it for serving at the dish , and it will be delicious.

![0fdc18db-f80e-4a93-b018-7c55b1834d0c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTfAQuffpa7b2nB9hsi32CVEPwcthaV2BjUpSYJA2oVt4/0fdc18db-f80e-4a93-b018-7c55b1834d0c.jpg)

Amigos, ¿cómo están? Espero que estén todos bien, yo también. Alhamdulillah, hoy les traigo una nueva receta. Espero que les guste porque es muy saludable y deliciosa. Aquí les presento una receta con pollo, papas y tomates, que es muy saludable y sabrosa. Veamos todos los detalles de cómo la preparé.

Pollo, papas, cardamomo pequeño, cardamomo grande, canela, pimienta, sal, cúrcuma en polvo, comino en polvo, cilantro en polvo, chile seco en polvo, aceite, jengibre, pasta de ajo

Para preparar la receta de hoy, primero lavé bien el pollo y lo corté en trozos pequeños. Por supuesto, debes lavar bien el pollo; si es posible, lávalo con agua salada. Luego herví las papas, las pelé y las corté en trozos pequeños.

![a20ef39a-9681-419c-a88c-50870fe5413c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewhyydgQvkLEhFE1F9i3QdMpkdqkMwuDusM6o34pbZs8/a20ef39a-9681-419c-a88c-50870fe5413c.jpg)

! [b5a0f797-bcfc-481c-b78f-93bf54f41fea.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWxNCyF72zTjxaDV7J134mPDSpCdhwWVhnaJJn9iK6Gzc/b5a0f797-bcfc-481c-b78f-93bf54f41fea.jpg)

![ 1425d720-c61b-42af-9f97-6b2adb50cb00.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZHKeX2Erx5Ppo8YVyVpEP64ByuwamYyHTRnsq3XQfcmA/1425d720-c61b-42af-9f97-6b2adb50cb00.jpg)

![d [4f99682-b39c-470b-bb29-a675c9f5579c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeXseQx2hKhbspqhRVyPj5ppkzo4pBqkN2Pnvb8YedG4D/d4f99682-b39c-470b-bb29-a675c9f5579c.jpg)

Una vez terminados todos los preparativos, voy a cocinar. Pongo una sartén en la estufa, añado cebolla picada y hojas de laurel, y la sofrío bien en aceite. La sofrío hasta que se dore. Luego añado todas las especias en polvo, el garam masala y la sofrío durante unos 5 minutos. Cuando el aceite esté caliente... arriba,

links.title: Do Not Be Trapped By Waiting For Life To Become Too Easy
links.body: >\n\nThere was a time I wanted to improve my fitness and maybe even build some muscles. But everytime I came back from work, I felt so tired and then I would postpone it to another day. I kept hoping for a \
to start the exercises. But to my surprise, weeks passed, months passed, and for almost 1 year, I was postponing it. It was then that it dawned on me that there may not be a \

to start the exercise. So I decided to begin it even if it was just for a few minutes everyday after work. Over time, I became more fit, I built the muscles I desired, and even my overall health improved. This goes to prove that you do not have to wait until life becomes too easy or perfect before you take a step.

<center>![pexels-mikhail-nilov-8937581.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb3YqzwvDPZLHfMX8FMbJrfRDKWVFNsC5xxhCfMPmcQYr/pexels-mikhail-nilov-8937581.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-man-in-gray-suit-jacket-looking-at-his-wristwatch-8937581)</sub></center>

A lot of people delay growth, delay actions, or even responsibilities, simply because they are waiting for life to become easy for them. They will keep telling themselves that they will become more serious when things become comfortable, or that they will start when things calm down, or that they will chase their goals when life will become less stressful. However, they will see themselves trapped in an endless delay. This is because the perfect condition they expect may not come, and the challenges of life may not fizzle away as they expect. In fact, expecting that life will be without challenges may make you to keep waiting in vain. Waiting for perfect condition or perfect time or perfection may become a trap to delay your progress and prevent growth.

By constantly waiting for life to be too easy, it can create endless postponement. The thing that you may not understand is that challenges will always come, there may be distractions, inconveniences, etc. So if you keep waiting for an ideal condition before you take your first step, the step may never come. It may even make you to waste valuable time and opportunities that may come your way. You have to understand that growth does not always happen in perfect conditions, but in imperfect conditions, and taking steps irrespective of the situations.

A lot of the successful people that you know did not wait until life became comfortable or easy for them before they took a step. They conditioned their mind and learned to work in discomfort, through uncertainties and even obstacles. Take the example of Mark Zuckerberg, he did not wait until everything was easy or for the perfect condition before he took a step towards his goal. Right inside his dormitory, he was able to start up something. What he started in the corner of his room is now what we know as Facebook (Meta) and has gone global. If he was waiting for when life will be easy, he may never have started at all.

Difficult season is not a sign for you to give up, rather it should help you to build capacity, strengthen you, and make you to keep going. In fact, it is even part of what should make you stronger. If you get too dependent on comfort, you may struggle to take actions during difficult moments. You will only work when motivated, or when things are going smoothly, or when you feel emotionally ready and energised. But what happens if things do not go as you have thought or expected? This is why your actions should be without recourse to what is happening. The real growth will require consistency even when the situations are not comfortable.

<center>![pexels-anntarazevich-6230972.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQMRN4P4F23X9NQTocrFicyqs3m9Pg4JmVe5DsYo7mvQT/pexels-anntarazevich-6230972.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/close-up-shot-of-scrabble-tiles-on-a-white-surface-6230972)</sub></center>

It is worthy to note that life teaches a lot of vital and valuable lessons through challenges. Difficult situations can help you to build patience, confidence, problem-solving skills, emotional strength and even maturity. Trust me, if life were to be as easy as the \

there are some qualities that you may never know that you have, and there are things about you that you will not even develop. A lot of the strongest and wisest people, both in this contemporary time and in history, became that way because they learned how to handle challenges and hard times instead of running away from them. In life, more often than not, progress will not require perfect conditions. In fact, you do not have to figured out every single detail and everything in full before you take your first step. What matters is that you have started. Then with the small consistent steps you take, you will be surprised how you will achieve your goal. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

links.title: Ставок. Вихідні. Дали воду
links.body: Якщо чесно, - я навіть не здивована. Знаючи підлу сутність людисьок, яким поки що дано орендувати наш ставок, нічого іншого не приходиться й очікувати. Бо вони знають масу способів, як впливати на стан риби у ставку. І робити доступну тільки на вихідні і свята риболовлю тут безперспективною.\n\

, скажуть старі риболови-любителі. Місцеві кажуть, що бувало і таке, діставалося орендарям та їх посіпакам за неприкрите знущання над улюбленим хобі багатьох. Але ж це не є виходом в наш час. Така первісна дикість, правда, й досі існує на водосховищах, наприклад. Там, де орудують нечесні на руку промисловики. Ти запросто можеш потрапити в їх немилість, і хтось із вас на цьому безкрайньому безлюдному штучному морі може просто бути притопленим. І довго його шукатимуть водолази... І скажуть потім: \

...
Ну це вже я відволіклась на своє, пережите. 
До ставка.
Ось таким ми із собачкою побачили його сьогодні: переповненим водою, яка при свіжескошених берегах була брудною. Підійшла до заставок, а вони пересунуті під самий берег. Дійсно, ними підіймали рівень води, свідомо. На вихідні. Саме коли людям можна було б піти перепочити з вудочкою над ставком. Але - ми не підемо. Бо такі різкі зміни рівня води змінюють її тиск, що впливає на стан риби. Вона наче завмирає в ступорі, нічого не їсть і ні на що не реагує. І це може бути кілька днів.
Тож \

links.title: El miedo no tiene fin./Fear has no end.[Spa-Eng ]
links.body:
, mayor es su terror. El miedo impide vivir bien. Es algo que debilita a las personas desde dentro y crea obstáculos en diversas actividades. Este miedo puede ser de varios tipos: miedo a los fantasmas, a cualquier animal o insecto, miedo a hacer algo nuevo, e incluso a veces tememos ir a un lugar desconocido. Todos tenemos miedo a los fantasmas en mayor o menor medida, pero debido a este miedo ocurren muchos accidentes en nuestras vidas, nos asustamos mucho y, a menudo, sufrimos ataques de pánico. El miedo a cualquier animal o insecto también está presente en nuestra vida cotidiana. Cuando vemos un animal violento, naturalmente nos asustamos. Aunque los animales también nos temen, muchas veces, cuando un animal violento aparece repentinamente frente a nosotros, nos asustamos mucho. De igual manera, cuando caminamos por una calle vacía, el miedo nos invade. Así como los chicos le temen a las calles vacías, las chicas les temen aún más, porque pueden ocurrir diversos accidentes en ellas, y también existe el miedo a los fantasmas.

Siempre albergamos temores sobre diversas cosas. Al pensar en ellas, también tememos si nuestros pensamientos se llevarán a cabo según lo planeado. De hecho, debido a este miedo, en más de la mitad de las ocasiones nos quedamos atrás en muchas cosas, lo que nos impide mejorar en diversas áreas de la vida o llevar a cabo nuestros planes. El miedo puede paralizar nuestra vida y retrasar nuestro éxito en muchos aspectos. Por lo tanto, debemos intentar superarlo y tomar la iniciativa con valentía. Puede que el miedo que sentimos sea solo una ilusión y que, gracias a nuestra valentía, logremos el éxito. Muchas veces, aunque lo intentemos, no podemos superarlo y se instala en nuestra mente de tal manera que no podemos liberarnos de él.

Si queremos superar el miedo y avanzar en la vida, debemos pensar siempre positivamente, sin dejarnos llevar por aquello que nos asusta. Por ejemplo, si pensamos que no podemos realizar una tarea, el miedo a no ser capaces de hacerla permanecerá en nuestra mente. Pero si creemos que podemos hacerla o que la haremos de maravilla, sin duda podremos. Hemos visto en muchos casos que, en nuestra vida cotidiana, no sentimos mucho miedo, pero cuando vemos un vídeo de terror o una película de fantasmas, sentimos que puede haber un espíritu o un fantasma a nuestro alrededor. En realidad, este miedo depende completamente de nuestra mente: si pensamos que hay un fantasma, tendremos miedo y sentiremos su presencia; pero si pensamos que no existen los fantasmas, tendremos mucha valentía y podremos superar el miedo.

De hecho, el miedo intenta controlar nuestra mente y nuestros pensamientos, así que si logramos controlarlos y eliminar por completo el miedo, nunca más temeremos a nada. Hoy en día, en la era de las redes sociales, vemos muchos videos de personas que no temen a los fantasmas, sino que los buscan. Hay quienes se adentran en bosques, fotografían animales y aves y los encuentran. Otros deambulan por la noche, explorando el mundo. También vemos personas a nuestro alrededor que no le temen a nada, ni siquiera a los trabajos más duros, ni a ir a lugares nuevos o aprender cosas nuevas. Sin duda, debemos aprender de ellas. El miedo debe desaparecer para siempre. Solo así lo venceremos y encontraremos la paz interior.




https://images.pexels.com/photos/4349900/pexels-photo-4349900.jpeg


 [sourch](  https://www.pexels.com/photo/unrecognizable-person-representing-horrible-monster-behind-opaque-glass-4349900/)




The smaller the word \

, the bigger its terror. Fear is something that does not allow people to live well. Fear is something that weakens people from within and creates obstacles in various activities. This fear can be of various types such as fear of ghosts, fear of any animal or insect, fear of doing something new, and even sometimes we are afraid of going to an unknown place. We all have the fear of ghosts more or less, but due to this fear, many accidents happen in our lives, we become very scared, and many times panic attacks occur. Fear of any animal or insect is also present in our normal life. When we see a violent animal, we naturally get afraid of them. Although animals also fear us, many times when a violent animal suddenly comes in front of us, we become very scared. Similarly, when we walk on an empty road, fear keeps roaming in our mind. Just as boys are afraid of empty roads, girls are more afraid of them, because various accidents can happen on empty roads, and there is also the fear of ghosts. We always have fears about different things in our minds. When we think about different things, we also have the fear of whether those thoughts will be implemented as planned. In fact, because of this fear that has formed in our minds, more than half of the time we fall behind in doing many things, due to which we cannot improve in many areas of life or implement our plans. Fear is something that can completely stop our lives and can delay us from succeeding in various ways. Therefore, we should always try to suppress this fear and take initiatives in various works with courage in our minds. It may also be that the fear for which we are afraid is only in our minds and because of doing the work with courage, we were able to achieve success in that work beautifully. Many times, even if we try, we cannot suppress the fear and fear makes a home in our minds in such a way that we cannot get out of fear. If we want to get out of fear in life and move forward in life by overcoming fear, then we must always think positively in every case without thinking about the things we fear. For example, if we ever think that this task cannot be done by us, then the fear of not being able to do that task will remain in our mind. But if we think that we can do the task or the task will be done beautifully by us, then we will definitely be able to do the task. We have seen in many cases that when we live a normal life, we are not very afraid, but whenever we watch a scary video or a ghost movie, we feel that there may be a spirit around us or a ghost is roaming around us. Actually, this fear depends entirely on our mind, if we think that there is a ghost, then we will be afraid and feel the ghost, but if we think that there is no such thing as a ghost, then we will have a lot of courage in our mind and will be able to overcome fear. In fact, fear tries to control our mind and thoughts a lot, so if we can control our mind and thoughts and completely remove fear from our minds, then we will never be afraid of anything. Nowadays, in the age of social media, many videos are seen that some people are not afraid of ghosts but rather search for ghosts, there are many people who go to different forests and take photographs of different animals and birds and find them. There are many people who roam around at night and love to explore the world. We will also see some people around us who are never afraid of anything. Not afraid of doing even the hardest work. Not afraid of going to a new place or learning anything new. We definitely need to learn from those people. Fear needs to be erased from our minds forever. Only then will we conquer fear and find peace in life. > Translated by Google Translate. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/moral-degradation-on-social-media-3wf)
