links.title: Binfire of the Vanities – The ongoing implosion of the Restore Britain Party.
links.body:
![Biinfire .jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/48QRKJbPMDSMsT2wj1L8eQV8s3H9VgzA9HhzDRyt71L1pwqpfkPXHbAPVB4bGseVUD.jpg)
Picture Shows: A representation of just where the Restore Britain party is at present. 




The Makerfield by-election as well as being Andy Burnham’s hoped for stepping stone to the Commons and therefore the Labour leadership is also showing the world what an absolute binfire the Restore Britain Party has turned out to be.  This vanity project of a party set up by the former Reform MP Rupert Lowe when he turned his Restore Britain pressure group into a registered political party is imploding at a rapid rate.

So far this motley collection of fools, extremists and podcast bros (some of whom I used to have a lot of time for but less so now) has:

Passed off pictures of activists and canvassers from Great Yarmouth at the recent local elections as pictures taken during the the Makerfield campaign.

Attracted some genuine neo-Nazis in the form of the Patriotic Alternative group as campaigners.

Selected a candidate, Rebecca Shepherd, who doesn’t seem to be all that visible or voluble and who at one point appeared shocked and embarrassed at one of Rupert Lowe’s rants onstage.

Who have supporters and activists who have engaged in online rows about policy and personalities which have included some restore activists accusing others in Restore of being ‘Jews’ and ‘Zionists’.

Have attracted a whole load of people who appear to be unreconstructed supporters of the neo-Nazi British National Party (BNP).

Made claims that they are garnering massive support from Makerfield residents that seem to be falling apart when real polling figures from the first opinion poll carried out in the seat by the Sunday Times show them on 7%.

Made unrealistic claims about being able to win this seat when it’s clear that they cannot.

Have rarely shown ordinary people interacting with Restore canvassers.  Nearly all the pictures I’ve seen of Restore in Makerfield show gatherings of Restore activists, mostly from outside the constituency it appears, in pubs or halls and even then it’s clear that this is not a well supported outfit.

Have primarily concentrated on attacking Reform even though it’s Reform that have the best chance of denying Burnham his chance of a Commons seat and throwing the increasingly hated Labour Party into a damaging leadership fight.  Restore clearly have no strategic or tactical abilities or any skill in reading the wider situation.

Are not dispelling the criticisms of Restore being a party that is little more than a personality cult based around the worship of Rupert Lowe. Lowe is not doing much in the way of challenging media in connection with this contest, which is needed to get a party to a wider audience and for a party to properly set out its stall and instead is being given softball interviews by fawning podcast bros.

There’s a whole lot more criticisms out there of Restore and these criticisms are going to get more intense and more weighty as time goes on.  The party’s cynical exploitation of the data gathered in Restore’s independent grooming gang inquiry, data that survivors gave to Restore in good faith when Restore was a pressure group and not a political party, is also likely to come out and bite them hard as more public and media attention is turned on Restore.

Restore seem to be all that many of us predicted it would be which is a home for nutbags, misfits and those engaged in the right wing version of the political purity spirals that have so far been mostly a feature of parties of the Left.  They are, to use an analogy based on Monty Python’s ‘Life of Brian’ the ‘Popular Front of Judea’ of British politics, poorly supported, poorly managed and with few supporters who are not complete nutbags.

Restore are still dangerous.  In a tight contest which Makerfield is likely to be, the few hundred or maybe even a thousand or so votes might make the difference between Reform winning or Andy Burnham winning and going on to damage Britain even more than Labour has already damaged the country.

Restore are an incoherent mess, riddled with extremists, fantasists, political fraggles and cynics and are lacking in even basic knowledge of political tactics.  I was wary of Restore and it appears that so far my wariness has been justified.

links.title: THE ENDORSEMENT THAT LASTED 72 HOURS — A GAME OF DECEPTION, POWER, AND POLITICAL BETRAYAL
links.body:
![images (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23xybjaBtx7oLLrSHbwkD2ofSyhFfnAfq6S1gAyhZf4LbCTvAZ7DAVZv2gsom8gtm5q1d.jpeg)
[Source](https://www.google.com/search/about-this-image?img=H4sIAAAAAAAA_wEYAOf_ChYI0qT2rNC64f6tARD_6-qDuNif6qoBNCVFOxgAAAA%3D&q=https://www.facebook.com/6orno2online/photos/confusion-hit-the-kwara-apc-governorship-primary-friday-after-governor-abdulrahm/1301026408673471/&cs=1&ctx=iv&hl=en-NG&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiclIWWldGUAxU8g_0HHSDpAL0Qg4ILegQIBBAO)
Politics in Nigeria has always been filled with surprises, hidden agendas, overnight alliances, and unexpected betrayals. But what recently happened in Kwara State, particularly in Ilorin, has once again reminded the people that in politics, loyalty can expire within hours and power remains the ultimate priority.
As Nigeria gradually prepares for the 2027 general elections, political parties across the country have already begun their internal strategies and primary processes in order to position strong candidates ahead of the battle for power. In Kwara State, attention was heavily focused on the APC, the ruling party both at the federal level and within the state.
With Governor AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq nearing the end of his administration, the biggest question on everyone’s mind became: “Who will the governor support as his successor?”
For weeks, political discussions, street conversations, and stakeholder meetings all pointed in one direction — Yahya Seriki.

![images (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23z7X8wgmot4X4GpmD8wB6eUBSdFcKTCJgDxXX3zbBx1H8o1C7nHy3dvzakR2h6TGXth6.jpeg)
[Source]( https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1aa3jdyr4P/)
The belief across Ilorin was that Yahya Seriki had become the chosen candidate of the governor. The news spread rapidly across communities, and immediately the atmosphere changed. Supporters celebrated openly, youth groups became energized, and many political followers believed the future had already been decided.
And honestly, the excitement was understandable.
Yahya Seriki is widely seen by many people as a grassroots politician, a man connected to the youths, and someone who understands the struggles of ordinary citizens. His popularity among young people made the endorsement look like a victory for the masses.
The city was alive with celebration.
But politics has a way of changing direction overnight.
The first sign that something was not right came when the primary election process was unexpectedly suspended on May 21st, 2026, and moved to the following day, May 22nd. That sudden postponement immediately created suspicion in the minds of many observers.
Political analysts began asking questions.
What changed overnight?
Who held the secret meetings?
What political interests suddenly entered the picture?
Was there pressure from powerful stakeholders behind the scenes?
Those questions remained unanswered.
Then came the biggest shock.
Within less than 72 hours, the political atmosphere completely changed. The same Yahya Seriki who was being celebrated as the governor’s preferred candidate suddenly appeared abandoned politically, while support reportedly shifted towards another aspirant — Danladi.
According to the primary election results:
Danladi — 94,990 votes
Yahya Seriki — 47,700 votes
Bashir Omolaja Abolarinwa — 22,118 votes
Now, the real issue is not necessarily who won the primary election because politics itself is a contest of interests, influence, and numbers. Every election must eventually produce a winner.
But what truly shocked the people was the speed of the political turnaround.
How does a candidate move from being publicly celebrated and politically projected to suddenly losing support within just 72 hours?
That is the question many people across Kwara State are still asking.
For many supporters, it felt like a carefully planned political drama. Some described it as betrayal. Others called it political survival. While some simply said, “This is Nigerian politics.”
Across Ilorin, conversations changed immediately. Markets, viewing centers, campuses, and political gatherings became filled with debates. Many residents openly admitted they never saw such a twist coming.
This situation also reveals an important reality about Nigerian politics — sometimes the people may have emotional attachments to candidates, but political decisions are often controlled by deeper forces invisible to the public eye.
Power negotiation. Political loyalty. Influence. Interests. Survival.
Those are the real engines behind many political decisions.
At the moment, disappointment can clearly be seen among many Yahya Seriki supporters. But politics moves quickly, and today’s setback can become tomorrow’s comeback.
The people will now wait patiently for the main elections next year to see whether this political calculation will eventually favor the APC or create new divisions within the party.
One thing is certain — the political story in Kwara State is far from over.
Politics in Nigeria remains one of the most unpredictable games ever played.
And sometimes, 72 hours is enough to completely change the destiny of an entire political movement.
Thanks for visiting my blog.

Standing in the midst of the sky, lighted and free flowing as the clouds but not quite, as I am nowhere around them. They are a barrier that needs uncovering. At some point we should let go as though brushed veils. A man can be optimistic about that, a fresh breath of air and the thing that holds within, that snatches. Its presence is dominated on this roof, where pipes lay around, the grit and the gravel, laid to cool the building. Perhaps a misery to walk on without shoes, but who would do that? Come up above without the shoes or initiate walking dismissing the slippers. Although some may say about this whole endeavor of mine as well. The misty cold air mixed with the geyser's ecstatic smell. The night makes it so that the only watching eye is me and the moon. The hustle is down there where living lives. Here the more up I am the more astute the hug by the force that allows the clouds to be up there and me on the ground. The drop is the only presence, which is constant, but here literally there is a downside to dropping down. It is not going down the hierarchical order. Somehow in the morning I feel relieved staying here, clinging to it, although it wants me back. The gravity.

*The roof holds me where clouds cannot reach,
gravity whispers what the heart already knows:
to let go is not to fall but to stop holding
the thing that holds us, that snatches breath,
until morning comes and we are finally light.*

*To die here is not an ending but a settling,
a weight finally admitted, finally named.
The sky does not ask us to rise.*

links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101779574158.997987) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101779574167.4395409) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101779574173.419022) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101779574179.784552) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101779574185.800428) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101779574191.307683) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101779575307.389824) “One More Trip Around The Sun….Almost!”😇 “Silvertop we need to be ready to go at 3:30!”🥰 Today isn’t “THE” day Lol, but with our oldest son’s busy schedule at the oil refinery, he finally had a day off work to get together!😍 Michael and his Wife are taking Silvertop and Liz out to dinner!🥰 “ NO paparazzi photos, dad!”🙄 “OK ……Michael Lol!”😍 “Dad, we normally do what is called a “Turnaround” switching from winter gasoline mixture, to Summer, but with the shutdown of oil going through the Straight of Hormuz, we are running at 110% production trying to keep gasoline flowing!”😅 If you really enjoy your work, a “Turnaround” isn’t drudgery, but Silvertop is WAY past wanting to work 12 to 14 hours a day for 10 to 12 weeks straight…..SEVEN days a week!🙄 Michael is starting to “Get it”. He’s had a few trips around the Sun as well as his dad Lol!😇 When my son first started working at the refinery, he was “Hungry”………..😮 Eventually, everyone understands……..😇 Money, my friends is always needed, but sooner or later, you start looking around and see you friends, and family enjoying life, while you slave away working long hours! “Dad, I try to turn down overtime, and let the young guys have it”!😮 Life goes by so quickly my friends! That’s one of the reasons Silvertop hikes, to stay healthy, to be around for a long time…… enjoying time with family!🥰 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike😊

links.title: Happy Caturday everybody!  😽😻…… My Actifit Report Card: May 23 2026
links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779572609.88409) Yep- it’s Caturday! Celebrate your little furry feline child and show them how much they’re loved! 😻 Ah Caturdays! My day to sleep in just a little and try to recharge from the workweek. I woke up a bit groggy this morning. Weird dreams about adding on to one of our neighbor’s house and somewhat cliff side heights. Very odd indeed! Anyway, today is one of those days you just kind of sit in waiting. We are meeting our oldest son and his wife at a steakhouse in Lynden for an early (like 3 weeks early) birthday dinner for someone whose birthday is in June. Not me-I’m a November baby, so you might be able to guess who it is. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779572645.5969691) I find I don’t like getting into any projects because I’m always watching the clock. Maybe that sounds odd but I’ve always been that way. So no major stuff today-just little things. 😏 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779572690.507072) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779572712.706202) It’s sunny today and it’s morning as I am writing this to make sure I’m ready to post when we get home. I’m enjoying birdsong as I sit on the garden swing and also soaking up a bit of vitamin D. There’s a light breeze and ironically the smell of woodsmoke in the air. Our neighbor must be cold again! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779572761.4539409) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779572774.4895391) I have found a sanctuary in my little garden nook. It’s quiet and peaceful. Now if I could find a solution for the tinnitus I have that never leaves me in silence, I’d be one happy lady for sure! I’ll write tomorrow about the dinner and whatnot. In the meantime enjoy some pictures of Cot and Cyle as they enjoy their Caturday! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779572822.745343) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779572835.4744592) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779572850.771724) Here they are doing what they enjoy most! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779572934.9645538) That’s gonna be it for now. Take care and enjoy the rest of your day wherever you are! 🙏🌏🙏 👣☕️🐑🌞😎👍😁🌲🌿🌙🥱😴 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779572992.718524) BSB Psalm 95:1-11 Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation! In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him. The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land. O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker. For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care. Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, in the day at Massah in the wilderness, where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work. For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways.” So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.” 🌹🙏

title.title: A strange feeling of buying new clothes and bags
title.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRpWdDTsxpjBtdjR1ewv9TYymAmkmHwsqhU6Tgwtv6fwZ/1779599128829.jpg) A parent can sacrifice all the happiness in the world to see a smile on their child's face. And if that smile comes from getting something they love, then there is no limit to that joy. When I went to the store and was choosing my daughter's favorite frock from the variety of dresses, a different feeling was running through my mind. How my mother Moni would look like a fairy if she wore the dress. This thought filled my mind with a strange peace. And when I chose a backpack with his favorite cartoon character, it felt like I had won a battle. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaPqCVNf3vEZ6MeqrKVVCeMkrUPoqai9Ji9ngdEwMAjaA/1779599129050.jpg) When I returned home and handed the two packets to my daughter, the sudden surprise in her eyes and the wide smile on her face were worth seeing. The way she happily danced around the house like a fairy with her wings cut off upon receiving the new dress. That will be one of the best scenes of my life. The joy of standing in front of the mirror with that cute pose and walking around the house with the new bag on my back. After seeing all this, the amount of self-satisfaction that was working in my heart cannot be expressed in words. In fact, the heavenly happiness that lies in being able to fulfill the small wishes of a child cannot be found in anything else. All the fatigue, busyness and mental stress of the whole day seemed to fly away like camphor in exchange for that one moment of laughter. It felt like all the hard work and struggle of life were worthwhile today. New clothes and bags may be just some material things But the emotion, love and innocent joy of a daughter that went with it will forever remain etched in my memory. There is no gift in this world more precious and beautiful than a child's smile. 📸 Photography| Details 📸 |-|-| |Camera used|Smartphone| |Model|Realme-C53| |Location| Bangladesh| |Photographer|@queen88|

title.title: El hogar de la estrella de mar / The starfish's home
title.body:
<center>

Por una cañería de la gran ciudad,
va saliendo algo irreal,
es una estrella de mar
y no sé cómo llegó a este lugar. 

La estrella se trepa en la cañería 
y ahí se queda tranquila,
nadie la busca, se siente no querida
y en este lugar empezará una nueva vida. 

>Through a pipe in the big city,
something unreal is emerging,
it’s a starfish,
and I don’t know how it got here.

>The starfish climbs up the pipe
and stays there quietly,
no one is looking for it, it feels unwanted,
and here it will begin a new life. 


![55318.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23yJM5ABXtkigVXmnh7cv49pyYLy4i7Hdz3CGhrQfwLrbxwvsuEzhw37vbtPr2BC8sW5V.gif)

Pasa por el lugar un caracol,
con una coraza de marrón color,
la estrella se llena de admiración
y analiza la situación.

Se esconde y cuando el animal pasa,
con sus ventosas toma la coraza,
el caracol no entiende lo que pasa
y da la vuelta para recuperar su valva.

>A snail crawls by,
with a brown shell,
the star is filled with wonder
and assesses the situation.

>It hides, and when the snail passes by,
it grabs the shell with its suction cups,
the snail doesn’t understand what’s happening
and turns around to retrieve its shell.

![55319.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23yTmAozxMz3sWdDygZ9UZCwdwAoDr7kKqPoYwYs11hKDXNbr9UnVYhCHkYckMPdkMbjU.gif)

La estrella de mar toma la coraza
y la pone sobre sí, con gracia,
ahora lleva una casa
y esto la hace sentir afortunada.

El caracol se queda nostálgico,
pero la felicidad de la estrella le da agrado 
y cuando se está marchando
la estrella lo llama afanado. 

>The starfish picks up the shell
and places it on itself, gracefully,
now it has a home,
and this makes it feel lucky.

>The snail feels a bit wistful,
but the starfish’s happiness pleases it,
and as it’s leaving,
the starfish calls out to it eagerly. 

![55320.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23ywwQu5oGBuXAEFh3nmyLg3CjRcbHQrvjZ5bUHRKzXgSiKgtfRrvSTYcCQYgZyWTkWfE.gif)

Le regresa su coraza con amor,
ella no se quedará en esta nación
la estrella irá con determinación,
al océano, dónde nació.

Ya conoció el lugar
y aunque creyó que sería ideal,
con el tiempo empezó a extrañar,
el agua salada y los arrecifes que en casa están. 

> She returns her armor with love,
she will not stay in this land,
the star will journey with determination
to the ocean, where she was born.

>She has already seen the place,
and though she thought it would be perfect,
over time she began to miss
the salt water and the reefs back home. 


</center>

title.title: Potato omelette with onion, bell peppers and tomato (Eng-Esp)
title.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23u69QjBLUuLixujzFRWDRjSL5bN2QSxNfL6o8kpk2uYx2tL4AVscxe5u7zyBVxTVZKhF.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening, Hivefood friends! I hope you had a wonderful Saturday! This time, I'll show you how to prepare a \

. Whenever I make this recipe, I usually serve it with baked cassava bread or toasted sesame seed slices. Let's put on our aprons and begin this wonderful process!

>* Buenas noches amigos de hivefood, espero hayan pasado un magnífico sábado! En esta ocasión, les explico como preparar una “exquisita tortilla con patatas, cebolla, pimientos y tomates”. Siempre que realizo esta receta suelo acompañar con: casabe al horno o rebanas de pan tostado con ajonjolí... Pongámonos el delantal para empezar nuestro maravilloso proceso!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/48me6qqafPRCLHBHB1jykV7oXsZjbwSqv3SiNTmSvSY8KQbmz7MQPGK2C48homTKMP.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: eggs, potatoes, bell peppers, sweet peppers, ripe tomatoes, black pepper, touch of oregano powder, mild olive oil and salt to taste.

>* INGREDIENTES: huevos, patatas, pimientos, ajíes dulces, tomates maduros, pimienta negra, toquesito de orégano en polvo, aceite de oliva suave y sal al gusto.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EoeGKBiz6SzjXBFmUsjLMicHQZBNKnTuH7EbPCHtmZC7HLbgrYGTU2mjvtHG1cBuVs1.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/Eoc9vqnRhvRXScbzMtGhPKDfqR2s9extWRLH5Eis6cTbFxREirHAgAUjyuyezMgJJCg.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23vsWheTsyCvJ8E1A4FiWNPxCvSRp3mVkEW8ofSFXGMyQJ6FFRaCQEmUJNdVo9HsGMpoF.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uR3DWnkDcQz7nPCXuYWABua5JaMXSW5GP3qMYubgkrVB3aw4jMdqKDAv7gZqQzUTcUD.png)</center>

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil to the pan... Sauté the onion, along with the finely chopped sweet peppers. Cook until translucent (season with salt and pepper).
Add the bell pepper... Sauté over medium heat for 15 minutes or until the ingredients are cooked through.

>* Incorporamos 2 cucharadas de aceite de oliva al sartén... Sofreímos la cebolla, junto con los ajies dulces (finamente cortados). Cocinamos hasta que tomen una textura cristalina (salpimentamos).
Agregamos el pimiento... Salteamos a fuego \

durante 15 minutos o hasta comprobar que los ingredientes están listos.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tvpmDPJn79G6B197g9VqFpsb4BPSPJGDYTzmFT7DLBbsU7XBrnD4xNa8v9ebbzpCpuz.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uFaDxMBEwZNAEpNGUZ6ihxKtnvpbez5rUXCa8ZKP2MHjyo7ZipPwYweCfNUZ68BMAoc.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wX3mZ8PZSvUuvRMmjzJ4JEdxGuxqvAa13vZaLSZ8KifjSDR4vDRJcwqSUyHMhoCeyqy.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23vi2A53bvHFZ8pkEr3hiTyM5439AHnArq2L89zbN6ukN2K2wZh2FZyHnkpJoD5h9FAGD.png)</center>

* Beat the eggs until frothy. Add the reserved sautéed vegetables and the cooked potatoes. Season with black pepper, dried oregano, and salt to taste. Mix gently with a folding motion.

>* Batimos los huevos hasta conseguir una textura espumosa... Incorporamos el sofrito que teníamos reservado, junto con las patatas (cocidas). 
En este paso aliñamos con: pimienta negra, orégano en polvo y sal al gusto. Mezclamos con movimientos suaves y envolventes.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EouAhhmSxBsEdhV78ktXVHgh5M7C7BjynSBSmKxouvsXD6bwYbySyTAniYVcLRRFnJM.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wCLJyK1tu6r9qwgSUkEK4GtVsJTptnNtRk1DanPvrtA6rYsWCqy6DtjiK7C1TUEJvDn.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tvu33P4Bk1cUgGBmTae6yFhXLwgb1VrLe43occigDp1qXoiGJJ6aKEPLSE1miL3jyaB.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tvwdQobcaiJXJRydrAvC1bkpXahDK2PgGYzVfjcsFYPiUWRz8LVQ8KwsmTJJSRSp7js.png)</center>

* We lightly grease the bottom of a non-stick frying pan with olive oil. We add our delicious mixture and cook over medium heat until it's cooked through. I personally love it when it's lightly browned, but that's up to you.
When it releases easily, you'll know it's time to flip it using a round board or a flat plate.

>* Untamos el fondo de un sartén antiadeherente con un toque de aceite de oliva. Colocamos nuestra suculenta mezcla, cocinamos a fuego \

hasta comprobar que está lista. 
Particularmente me encanta que su consistencia quede ligeramente dorada, pero este paso se los dejo a su elección.
Cuando se despegue con facilidad sabrán que es el momento de voltear con ayuda de una tabla redonda o un plato llano.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wCNNcxDvZAGiQHbNdFgBYXGSzqAtLKYNxb2CHADri63b6YkhJ4s11y8q1aDUsFbR4dr.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EoEsrtesXfnrB2LSZYcYEvKmgmVcscnQ3RQE6nPDX4g74patZczNJwGohBtpqoZDZME.png)</center>

* Friends, here's our healthy and nutritious dish, a great option to share with the family. When plating, I thought it would be a nice touch to garnish it with: tomato slices... I loved the result!
I hope you enjoyed the process; I'm sure it will become one of your favorite recipes... Thank you so much for visiting my blog, and I wish you a wonderful Sunday!

>* Amigos, a continuación les presento nuestro saludable y nutritivo platillo, una excelente opción para compartir en familia. Al momento de emplatar me pareció genial decorar con: ruedas de tomate... El resultado me encantó!
Espero hayan disfrutado el proceso, estoy segura que se convertirá en una de sus recetas favoritas... Muchas gracias por visitar mi blog, les deseo un domingo maravilloso!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/48me6qqafPRCLHBHB1jykV7oXsZjbwSqv3SiNTmSvSY8KQbmz7MQPGK2C48homTKMP.png)</center>

* All photos are my own work

title.title: Liang Bua: Unveiling the Mystery of the Flores \
in the Heart of Manggarai
title.body:
Flores is an island of endless wonders, but none have captured the world’s imagination quite like Liang Bua. Located in Rampasasa Hamlet, Manggarai Regency, this massive limestone cave is not just a natural landmark; it is one of the most important archaeological sites on the planet.
​ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUKrMjSrSmhXffhLbFjmJunxgWXKR2cBxkU1pWEGKz83n/1000705658.jpg 

The vast interior of Liang Bua where history was rewritten.
​The \

of History
In the local Manggarai language, Liang means cave and Bua means cool. It is a perfect name, as the air inside this 50-meter-long and 25-meter-high cavern remains refreshingly cold even on a hot day. Walking into this natural cathedral, you are surrounded by towering stalactites and stalagmites that have witnessed thousands of years of evolution.
​The World-Shaking Discovery: Homo Floresiensis
In 2003, Liang Bua became the center of global scientific attention when archaeologists discovered the remains of a previously unknown human species: Homo floresiensis.
​ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdn9Pu4GprUn9J1fL3dPcEzwKhEfWWZDskEoX1rB96My5/1000705660.png 

​Nicknamed \

because of its small stature (standing only about 1 meter tall), this discovery challenged everything we knew about human history. These ancient people lived in this very cave, hunting pygmy elephants and surviving alongside giant monitor lizards. Seeing the excavation pits today is a humbling experience—you are standing in the exact spot where our understanding of humanity changed forever.
​A Complete Visitor Experience
Visiting Liang Bua is a journey through time that is both accessible and educational:
​The On-Site Museum: Before entering the cave, make sure to visit the museum. It houses replicas of the \

skulls, ancient stone tools, and detailed explanations of the excavation process.
​A Sanctuary of Peace: Despite its fame, the cave maintains a serene, mystical atmosphere. You might see local children from Rampasasa playing near the entrance, adding a touch of modern life to this ancient site.
​https://3speak.tv/shorts?v=yordan96/fekdmxpj
​Traveler’s Guide to Liang Bua
​Location: Approximately 15 km from Ruteng city center.
​Access: Easily reachable by renting a motorcycle (ojek) or car. The drive offers beautiful views of the Manggarai highlands.
​Entrance Fee: Very affordable! Approximately IDR 5,000 for domestic tourists and IDR 20,000 for international visitors.
​Facilities: Parking areas and local guides are available to tell the deep stories of the cave's past.
​If you are exploring the highlands of Flores, Liang Bua is an essential stop. It is a rare place where you can touch the prehistoric past while embracing the \

tranquility of nature.
​Thank you for joining me on this journey into human history!

title.body: Liang Bua is a prehistoric cave and a world-renowned archaeological site located in Rampasasa Hamlet, Manggarai Regency, East Nusa Tenggara (Flores). The name \
meaning cool/cold—referring to the refreshing atmosphere inside.\n\nThis site gained global fame for the 2003 discovery of Homo floresiensis, an extinct hominin species famously dubbed the \

due to its small stature. Measuring 50 meters in length, 40 meters in width, and 25 meters in height, this massive cavern is not just a geological wonder but a gateway to the prehistoric past. Visitors can explore the cave's stunning stalactites and stalagmites, visit the on-site museum for historical insights, and stand in the exact spot where human evolution history was rewritten.

Located just 15 km from Ruteng, this site is easily accessible via motorcycle or car. It offers a unique sanctuary where nature and science blend seamlessly. A must-visit for any history enthusiast exploring the highlands of Flores!

title.title: Prince Pigfrog\\Prinz Schweinefrosch
title.body:
Hello,my friends!
New story of Svinni the pig right now!



![svinushka.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbXMoP8yAThnwh3kyQ1j8nfAaC5Cy5hWL6qkQ76S3aCnj/svinushka.jpg)


In a faraway kingdom, there lived Pigfrog. It's easy for female frogs. Just sit in the swamp, chomp on mosquitoes, and wait for a foolish prince—it depends on your luck, but he'd definitely have to ride off on a white horse and take you down the aisle—that's the end of sitting in the swamp. Princes these days are so unscrupulous, they'll even agree to kiss frogs—it's all the rage! The green movement and all that! Not the French, eh, not the French! They'd gobble you up under a glass of Château de Chryto. Well, of course, there are nuances in the lives of waiting frogs, like being shot by an arrow out of sheer stupidity, or being gobbled up by a stork, depriving the enchanted frogs of the joy of marriage. C'est la vie et cherchez la femme!

But few people know that there are also male enchanted frogs. Unexpected, huh?! And their fate is not so great! They can't offer a rich dowry, although they are supposedly the younger sons of princes without a stake or court. Princes are of little interest to them, except perhaps the particularly courtly princes in rhinestones and feathers. But not everyone needs such interest! And proper princesses don't wander through swamps looking for toads as husbands! The husbands themselves come to the father-king for a casting.

So! Once upon a time, in a swamp, there lived a certain Pigfrog. He was actually a pig, but by the whim of the fairy tale author, he suddenly became an enchanted frog. The author vilely enchanted him, and now he gleefully rubs his paws and enjoys the torment of a pig and frog. To somehow soften the bitter pill of swamp suffering, Pigfrog was promoted to prince. Prince Pigfrog! The author hasn't yet figured out how to disenchant Pigfrog back into a pig, so Pigfrog will have to sit in that swamp for a long time. Well, maybe a princess is needed, we'll see. Arrows and bows are definitely out; that's bad form!

Pigfrog absolutely refused to eat mosquitoes. At least he had cookies and coffee! And recently, a large heron came by and became very interested in Pigfrog... culinarily. The naive bird wanted to devour the frog, well, she thought it was a frog. How could a dark bird from the swamp know about enchanted frogs? The heron quickly received a slap in the face from powerful paws and, along with a few of her feathers, lost interest in the strange frog. At least someone! Disenchant Pigfrog!!

P.S. The author subtly hinted that only a portion of dried squid can disenchant the prince in frog form!

...there will be a sequel someday...or not...



![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

In einem fernen Königreich lebte einst ein Schweinefrosch. Für Froschweibchen ist es einfach. Man sitzt einfach im Sumpf, knabbert Mücken und wartet auf einen törichten Prinzen – es kommt aufs Glück an, aber er müsste schon auf einem weißen Pferd davonreiten und einen zum Altar führen – dann wäre das Sumpf-Sitzen endlich vorbei. Prinzen sind heutzutage so skrupellos, dass sie sogar Frösche küssen würden – total angesagt! Die Umweltbewegung und so! Nicht die Franzosen, nein, nicht die Franzosen! Die würden einen unter einem Glas Château de Chruto verspeisen. Nun ja, natürlich gibt es auch im Leben wartender Frösche Nuancen, wie zum Beispiel aus purer Dummheit von einem Pfeil getroffen zu werden oder von einem Storch verspeist zu werden, wodurch die verzauberten Frösche um die Freude der Ehe gebracht werden. C'est la vie et cherchez la femme!


Aber nur wenige wissen, dass es auch männliche Zauberfrösche gibt. Unerwartet, nicht wahr?! Und ihr Schicksal ist alles andere als rosig! Sie können keine reiche Mitgift bieten, obwohl sie angeblich die jüngeren Söhne von Prinzen ohne Hofstaat sind. Prinzen interessieren sie kaum, außer vielleicht die besonders höfischen Prinzen in Strass und Federn. Aber nicht jeder braucht solches Interesse! Und anständige Prinzessinnen streifen nicht durch Sümpfe auf der Suche nach Kröten als Ehemänner! Die Ehemänner selbst kommen zum Vaterkönig, um sich einen aussuchen zu lassen.

So! Es war einmal in einem Sumpf ein gewisser Schweinefrosch. Er war eigentlich ein Schwein, aber durch die Laune des Märchenautors wurde er plötzlich zu einem Zauberfrosch. Der Autor hatte ihn auf gemeine Weise verzaubert, und nun reibt er sich vergnügt die Pfoten und genießt die Qualen eines Schweins und Frosches. Um das Leid des Sumpfes etwas zu lindern, wurde Schweinefrosch zum Prinzen ernannt. Prinz Schweinefrosch! Die Autorin hat noch nicht herausgefunden, wie man den Frosch wieder in ein Schwein verwandelt, also muss Schweinefrosch noch lange im Sumpf ausharren. Vielleicht braucht es ja eine Prinzessin, mal sehen. Pfeil und Bogen gibt es definitiv nicht; das ist unhöflich!

Schweinefrosch weigerte sich beharrlich, Mücken zu essen. Wenigstens gab es Kekse und Kaffee! Und vor Kurzem kam ein großer Reiher vorbei und interessierte sich sehr für Schweinefrosch … kulinarisch. Der naive Vogel wollte den Frosch verschlingen, nun ja, er hielt ihn für einen Frosch. Wie sollte ein dunkler Vogel aus dem Sumpf etwas von verzauberten Fröschen wissen? Der Reiher bekam schnell eine Ohrfeige von kräftigen Pfoten und verlor, zusammen mit ein paar Federn, das Interesse an dem seltsamen Frosch. Endlich jemand! Entzaubert Schweinefrosch!!

</liketuimages>


Who says you need to break the bank or book a flight just to get a breath of fresh air? 

In times like these when everything is getting more expensive, traveling and finding recreation for the family means getting a little creative.
Happily, wifey and I discovered that you don’t have to look far! The **Ninoy Aquino Parks and Wildlife Center** and the **Quezon City Circle** are absolute gems right in the heart of the metro that you can visit over and over again without hurting your wallet.

We have been here several times and we keep coming back because:

 * **A Feast for the Senses:** The scenic views of the lagoon, the towering green trees, and the beautiful ornamental plants give the perfect reprieve to a tired body and mind. 🍃✨

 * **Pure Energy Boost:** Feeling that strong gust of crisp, fresh air blowing against your face completely enlivens the senses and gives your lungs and heart a much-needed energy kick! 💨❤️

 * **Guilt-Free Pinoy Comfort Food:** Forget the fast food and processed snacks. The parks are packed with vendors selling incredible local Filipino delicacies! We treated ourselves to classic *suman kamoteng kahoy* (cassava suman), fresh *buko juice* straight from the shell, and sweet, warm *banana cue*. Not only is it way healthier than junk food, but you also get to directly support our local vendors and the community economy! 🥥🍌

> 💚 **The Verdict:** Sometimes, the best way to recharge is to just slow down, touch grass (literally, like I did! 😂), and enjoy the simple things with the people you love.
> 
Looking forward to another great, relaxing, and budget-friendly weekend date with wifey! 💑

Where’s your go-to budget spot in the city? Let me know in the comments! 👇

**# Spanish Translation** 
## 🌳 Una Escapada de Fin de Semana Económica en Metro Manila 🌳
¿Quién dice que se necesita gastar una fortuna o reservar un vuelo para respirar un poco de aire fresco? En estos tiempos en que todo está cada vez más caro, viajar y encontrar recreación para la familia significa ser un poco creativos.
Afortunadamente, mi esposa y yo descubrimos que no hay que buscar muy lejos. El Centro de Vida Silvestre y Parque Ninoy Aquino y el Círculo de Quezon City son verdaderas joyas en pleno corazón de la metrópoli que se pueden visitar una y otra vez sin afectar el bolsillo.
### Por Qué Seguimos Regresando:
 * **Un Banquete para los Sentidos:** Las vistas panorámicas de la laguna, los imponentes árboles verdes y las hermosas plantas ornamentales ofrecen el alivio perfecto para un cuerpo y una mente cansados.
 * **Un Impulso de Pura Energía:** ¡Sentir esa fuerte brisa de aire fresco en la cara aviva por completo los sentidos y le da a los pulmones y al corazón un impulso de energía muy necesario!
 * **Comida Tradicional Filipina sin Culpa:** Olvídense de la comida rápida y los bocadillos procesados. ¡Los parques están llenos de vendedores con deliciosos manjares locales filipinos! Nos deleitamos con el clásico suman kamoteng kahoy (suman de yuca), jugo de buko (coco) fresco directamente de la fruta y un dulce banana que bien calientito. No solo es mucho más saludable que la comida chatarra, ¡sino que también apoyas directamente a los vendedores locales y a la economía de la comunidad!
> **El Veredicto:** A veces, la mejor manera de recargar energías es simplemente ir más despacio, acostarse en el pasto (¡literalmente, como lo hice yo! ) y disfrutar de las cosas sencillas con las personas que amas.
> 
¡Ya tengo muchas ganas de que llegue otro fin de semana excelente, relajante y económico con mi esposa!

COVID-19 cases in Singapore have surged again. Between May 10–16, 2026, 12,700 cases were recorded, a significant increase compared to 8,000 cases the previous week. This surge has also impacted hospitalizations, with the daily average increasing from 56 to 73 cases per day, as well as an average of one case in intensive care units per day. 

However, Singapore's Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA) confirmed that public hospitals are still capable of handling the surge. The CDA also emphasized that there is no indication that the currently circulating variant is more contagious or causes more severe disease than previous variants. The CDA stated that periodic waves of COVID-19 are expected to continue throughout the year as part of the endemic respiratory disease pattern. The agency is currently monitoring the development of infections and the situation on the ground. For Indonesian citizens planning to travel to Singapore, this development is a cause for concern.

title.title: Project Controls In Construction | Compass Consult | From Planning To Handover
title.body: >Getting a construction project from concept to completion is never as simple as it looks on paper. Between budgets, deadlines, and shifting priorities, there’s a lot that can go off track if there isn’t a clear plan in place. That’s where project controls step in, offering a way to bring structure and visibility to the entire process.

>Project controls help keep everything moving forward with purpose. They cover how costs are managed, how schedules are maintained, and how performance is measured along the way. From the early planning stages right through to handover, project controls in construction provide a framework that makes it easier to stay on target and adapt when needed.

>They’re not just about ticking boxes. Project controls are about making smarter decisions, catching problems early, and keeping everyone on the same page. Whether it’s a small upgrade or a major build, the right controls can make a big difference to how smoothly the work unfolds.

>How do project controls support the planning phase?
Project controls help shape the planning phase by setting clear goals, budgets, and timelines. They offer tools to estimate costs, allocate resources, and flag potential risks early. With a solid plan in place, teams can move forward with more confidence, knowing they have a framework to measure progress and adjust when needed. It all starts with building a strong foundation.

>What role do project controls play during construction execution?
Once construction begins, project controls provide structure and visibility. They help track progress, compare results to plans, and manage changes. Whether it’s a delay, a cost issue, or a shift in scope, project controls in construction help keep everything on track. By staying informed and proactive, teams can avoid setbacks and make sure each step moves the project forward.

>How can project controls improve decision-making during delivery?
Good decisions rely on good information. Project controls give teams access to real-time data, showing how the project is performing against key metrics. This helps identify issues early and supports quick, informed action. With everyone working from the same set of facts, decisions become clearer, communication improves, and the project stays better aligned from start to finish.

>Why are project controls just as critical at project handover?
At handover, project controls help tie up all loose ends and make sure everything is fully ready for the next stage. They support final reporting, confirm compliance, and ensure the right documents are delivered. It’s about finishing strong, with a clear record of what’s been done and what comes next. A smooth handover sets the tone for lasting results and client satisfaction.

title.title: I used a template to draw Ryomen Sukuna[Eng-Spn]
title.body:
Hey Hive friends! I found some templates on YouTube to learn how to draw my favorite characters from Jujutsu Kaisen.

Today I'm going to draw Ryomen Sukuna, a really bad character known as the King of Curses.

These templates make it easier for me to draw him because I do it step by step, and they're very easy to make. I do them carefully and step by step so that the drawing turns out similar.

I'm going to make all the character templates, starting with Ryomen Sukuna, a demon-human from 1000 years ago who was defeated by sorcerers, but his body was left in the form of 20 cursed fingers. These fingers became powerful cursed objects that, if gathered together, can return Sukuna to his full form. That's why the characters search for these fingers throughout the story. After defeating Gojo Satoru, Sukuna becomes the most powerful.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/EoCkWefE733KgXBgkAFnqf5SguuSwC4ELpvYPkcvc7XkVBD9bexP69MnCA7NxnGmcFU.png)

Ryomen Sukuna's appearance resembles a four-armed, two-faced demon. Currently, he looks like his vessel (Yuji Itadori), but with pink, spiked hair and markings on his forehead, nose, cheeks, and body. He also has a second pair of eyes beneath his normal ones. He is a very powerful and terrifying character.

This is my final result; I think it turned out great.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tvpu2V4FYyFKBF3zgH7pNeTG9122sgHH2bnSaDGZpizc9ngHJ62zgUyNMYNB4i3wZgY.png)

title.title: La pérdida del yo colectivo: cuando una sociedad se disuelve
title.body:
Publicado en Español, Inglés y Portugués.
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQw2JwU2YZKUQAE61ASGeTACHqkLJgYrVDkmJ5AfYGKx8/1779598340909.png) *Editado en PhotoCollage* 
[Fuente](https://www.cronista.com/resizer/v2/imagen-narrativas-spin-co-M44KUWBPPJAFVKXHBVABYJ5CKA.png?auth=039640d997678a3a583ba5e3a5f263321acc18bef17de21907ed649c4a785d14&smart=true&width=990&height=557&quality=70) *de la imagen utilizada*

---

Hay una analogía que duele por su precisión, así como un individuo puede perder su sentido de identidad o sea sentirse desconectado de sus propios pensamientos, de su cuerpo, de su historia, también una sociedad entera puede experimentar la fractura de su yo colectivo.

Esto no es metáfora poética. Es un diagnóstico clínico aplicado al cuerpo de la sociedad actual.

Después de  una guerra civil o una crisis económica devastadora, las certezas compartidas se desmoronan. \

, todo eso se vuelve solo murmullo infértil. Aparece entonces la despersonalización social vemos como la gente observa cómo su propia sociedad actúa sin autenticidad, de manera automática y sin rumbo. Así como lo hace un autómata que camina pero ya no elige el destino.\n\nTambién ocurre de forma más gradual, la globalización, el consumismo desbocado, la digitalización de la vida, todo eso diluye los rituales, las tradiciones, los relatos que cohesionaban al grupo. Y en su lugar emerge un vacío. Las instituciones se sienten como un decorado. Las normas, como una ficción que ya nadie sostiene. La fragmentación se vuelve polarización tóxica, cada grupo construye su propia realidad, y el \

común se encoge hasta casi desaparecer.

Pero aquí viene lo inquietante, esa pérdida del yo social no es necesariamente un final. También puede ser una apertura.

La historia muestra que las grandes crisis como la posguerra, la Gran Depresión, las pandemias, pueden forzar cambios estructurales que en tiempos de estabilidad serían impensables. Nuevos pactos verdes, repensar el trabajo, movimientos por cuidados y salud mental colectiva, ciudadanías más activas y horizontales. Si el viejo yo social se disuelve, quizá pueda nacer otro más flexible, más empático con la interdependencia real que siempre existió, pero que el individualismo salvaje ocultó.

Lo incierto, y aquí el diagnóstico se vuelve crudo, es si ese parto será con dolor controlado o con catástrofe. Porque una sociedad que ha perdido su yo tiene dos caminos uno es aferrarse a identidades endurecidas tales como nacionalismos agresivos, autoritarismos de manual utilizándolos como muletas desesperadas, o aceptar la disolución como una oportunidad para recomponerse de forma más lúcida.

Hoy, mirando el mundo, nadie puede decir con certeza hacia qué lado se inclina la balanza. Hay fuerzas para lo peor, la erosión democrática, las guerras por recursos, la normalización del odio. También hay semillas para lo mejor, cooperación Sur-Sur, autonomía energética y alimentaria, redes de cuidados que no aparecen en los titulares.

La diferencia final no la decidirán los grandes líderes ni los tratados internacionales. La decidirán los pueblos. Y su sabiduría o su cansancio para elegir quién los representa, en qué dirección empujan y qué tipo de humanidad están dispuestos a sostener.

Porque al final, el yo social no es una abstracción. Es la suma de actos pequeños, cotidianos, anónimos. Eso no cambia el mundo entero. Pero cambia el mundo de una persona. Y quizá, en cadena, eso sea todo lo que puede salvar al yo colectivo de desaparecer del todo.

---
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)

---
---

# *ENGLISH*

---
---

There is an analogy that hurts because of its precision: just as an individual can lose their sense of identity —feeling disconnected from their own thoughts, body, and history— an entire society can also experience the fracture of its collective self.

This is not poetic metaphor. It is a clinical diagnosis applied to the body of contemporary society.

After a civil war or a devastating economic crisis, shared certainties crumble. \

— all of this becomes barren murmur. Then social depersonalization appears: we see people watching their own society act without authenticity, mechanically and aimlessly, like an automaton that walks but no longer chooses its destination.\n\nIt also happens more gradually. Globalization, runaway consumerism, the digitalization of life — all of this dilutes the rituals, traditions, and narratives that once held the group together. In their place, a void emerges. Institutions feel like stage sets. Norms feel like a fiction that no one upholds anymore. Fragmentation turns into toxic polarization; each group builds its own reality, and the common \

shrinks until it almost disappears.

But here comes the unsettling part: this loss of the social self is not necessarily an end. It can also be an opening.

History shows that great crises — like the post-war period, the Great Depression, pandemics — can force structural changes that would be unthinkable in times of stability. New green deals, rethinking work, movements for collective care and mental health, more active and horizontal forms of citizenship. If the old social self dissolves, perhaps a new one can be born — more flexible, more empathetic to the real interdependence that has always existed but that savage individualism concealed.

What is uncertain — and here the diagnosis becomes raw — is whether this birth will happen with controlled pain or with catastrophe. Because a society that has lost its self has two paths: one is to cling to hardened identities — aggressive nationalisms, textbook authoritarianisms — using them as desperate crutches; the other is to accept dissolution as an opportunity to recompose itself more lucidly.

Today, looking at the world, no one can say with certainty which way the scales tip. There are forces for the worse: democratic erosion, resource wars, the normalization of hatred. There are also seeds for the better: South-South cooperation, energy and food autonomy, care networks that don't make headlines.

The final difference will not be decided by great leaders or international treaties. It will be decided by the people. And by their wisdom — or their exhaustion — in choosing who represents them, in which direction they push, and what kind of humanity they are willing to sustain.

Because in the end, the social self is not an abstraction. It is the sum of small, everyday, anonymous acts. That doesn't change the whole world. But it changes one person's world. And perhaps, in a chain, that is all it takes to keep the collective self from disappearing entirely.

---
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)

---
---

# *PORTUGUÉS*

---
---



Há uma analogia que dói pela sua precisão: assim como um indivíduo pode perder seu senso de identidade — sentindo-se desconectado de seus próprios pensamentos, do seu corpo, da sua história —, também uma sociedade inteira pode experimentar a fratura do seu eu coletivo.

Isso não é metáfora poética. É um diagnóstico clínico aplicado ao corpo da sociedade atual.

Depois de uma guerra civil ou de uma crise econômica devastadora, as certezas compartilhadas desmoronam. \

— tudo isso se torna apenas um murmúrio infértil. Aparece então a despersonalização social: vemos as pessoas observando sua própria sociedade agir sem autenticidade, de maneira automática e sem rumo. Como um autômato que anda, mas já não escolhe o destino.\n\nTambém acontece de forma mais gradual. A globalização, o consumismo desenfreado, a digitalização da vida — tudo isso dilui os rituais, as tradições, as narrativas que uniam o grupo. E em seu lugar surge um vazio. As instituições parecem cenário. As normas, uma ficção que ninguém mais sustenta. A fragmentação se transforma em polarização tóxica; cada grupo constrói sua própria realidade, e o \

comum encolhe até quase desaparecer.

Mas aqui vem o inquietante: essa perda do eu social não é necessariamente um fim. Também pode ser uma abertura.

A história mostra que grandes crises — como o pós-guerra, a Grande Depressão, as pandemias — podem forçar mudanças estruturais que seriam impensáveis em tempos de estabilidade. Novos pactos verdes, repensar o trabalho, movimentos por cuidados e saúde mental coletiva, cidadanias mais ativas e horizontais. Se o velho eu social se dissolve, talvez possa nascer outro, mais flexível, mais empático com a interdependência real que sempre existiu, mas que o individualismo selvagem escondeu.

O incerto — e aqui o diagnóstico se torna cru — é se esse parto será com dor controlada ou com catástrofe. Porque uma sociedade que perdeu seu eu tem dois caminhos: um é agarrar-se a identidades endurecidas — nacionalismos agressivos, autoritarismos de manual — usando-as como muletas desesperadas; o outro é aceitar a dissolução como uma oportunidade para se recompor de forma mais lúcida.

Hoje, olhando para o mundo, ninguém pode dizer com certeza para que lado a balança pende. Há forças para o pior: erosão democrática, guerras por recursos, normalização do ódio. Também há sementes para o melhor: cooperação Sul-Sul, autonomia energética e alimentar, redes de cuidado que não aparecem nas manchetes.

A diferença final não será decidida pelos grandes líderes nem pelos tratados internacionais. Será decidida pelos povos. E pela sua sabedoria — ou seu cansaço — para escolher quem os representa, em que direção empurram e que tipo de humanidade estão dispostos a sustentar.

Porque, no fim, o eu social não é uma abstração. É a soma de atos pequenos, cotidianos, anônimos. Isso não muda o mundo inteiro. Mas muda o mundo de uma pessoa. E talvez, em cadeia, isso seja tudo o que pode salvar o eu coletivo de desaparecer por completo.

---
---

title.title: [ENG/ESP] A peaceful Saturday filled with beautiful scenery and delicious food.
title.body: > **Happy Sunday to everyone! I sincerely hope you’re enjoying this weekend and that you can treat yourselves to a little downtime—the kind that your body and soul will thank you for. As for me, I’ve had a wonderful time with my family, spoiling them a bit and making the most of every moment to recharge my batteries. Today I want to tell you about how our Saturday went—a simple day but full of those little details that make it special, the kind you love without even realizing it. Usually, on weekends my husband and I are home alone, because our son often goes to his friend’s house. So the morning started off calmly, without any rush or hustle. We woke up at our own pace, made breakfast, and then went to feed our birds. Lately, they’ve been laying very few eggs—barely four, when we usually collect fifteen. The heat is too intense, and even though they have a roof and a fan, you can still tell they’re suffering from the weather. That’s why today we decided to add vitamins to their fresh water to help them cope with these sweltering temperatures. After tending to them and making sure they were comfortable, we left the house because we’d received a message on Zoom letting us know we could pick up a package for a friend who lives in Paraguachí. So we got organized and set off. The sky was beautiful, with a few clouds that made it look even more stunning, as if the day wanted to treat us to a special view. As we drove along, we enjoyed the contrast between the natural and the urban—that blend so characteristic of our island that never fails to surprise us.**

> *Feliz domingo para todos, de corazón deseo que estén disfrutando este fin de semana y que puedan regalarse un ratito de descanso, de esos que el cuerpo y el alma agradecen. Yo, por mi parte, la he pasado muy bien junto a mi familia, consintiéndolos un poco y aprovechando cada momento para recargar energías. Hoy quiero contarles cómo transcurrió nuestro sábado, un día sencillo pero lleno de esos detalles que lo hacen especial, de esos que uno ama sin darse cuenta. Por lo general, los fines de semana mi esposo y yo estamos solos en casa, porque nuestro hijo suele ir a casa de su amiga. Así que la mañana comenzó con calma, sin apuros ni carreras. Nos levantamos tranquilos, preparamos el desayuno y luego fuimos a darle alimento a nuestras aves. En estos días han estado poniendo muy poco, apenas cuatro huevos cuando normalmente recogíamos quince. El calor está demasiado fuerte y, aunque tienen techo y extractor, igual se nota que sufren por el clima. Por eso hoy decidimos agregarles vitaminas al agua fresca para ayudarlas a sobrellevar estas temperaturas tan sofocantes. Después de atenderlas y asegurarnos de que estuvieran cómodas, salimos de casa porque nos había llegado un mensaje de Zoom avisando que ya podíamos retirar una encomienda para una amiga que vive en Paraguachí. Así que nos organizamos y emprendimos camino. El cielo estaba precioso, con algunas nubes que lo hacían ver aún más hermoso, como si el día quisiera regalarnos un paisaje especial. Mientras avanzábamos, íbamos disfrutando del contraste entre lo natural y lo urbano, esa mezcla tan característica de nuestra isla que siempre logra sorprendernos.*
![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-44.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xejy26jsxbLKqtQtK1zMhRXuyS5755ni2BjQSFG3yNPsMwtaUktsaFD6tTWBPvxuSjj.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-43.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpT4BGv7SPbXDDQ9vGdzBQJXRFXjwYcoWtAzLmvf2Kqr3FpTRaXe2ULSGrix2ZLHbqT.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-42.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpNoooq5rtKsMj5bsDS3x6tTYggWb8GLgUZg79g3UfkwdjYFR63wDKN8dzsJsPeCacD.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-41.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7uYggbCTUfTfFSiTf9JnmyUWWpWbpyrBG3b4X19dMGRAtKmvPUqD7k4toF9zDcjGG.jpg)

> **We arrived at the Zoom office in Sambil, which is our favorite because of its efficiency and the friendly service we always receive there. We picked up the package without any issues and headed to Paraguachi to visit our friend who lives near the beautiful church.**

> *Llegamos a la oficina de Zoom del Sambil, que es la que más nos gusta por su rapidez y el buen trato que siempre nos brindan. Retiramos la encomienda sin contratiempos y nos dirigimos a Paraguachi a casa de nuestra amiga que vive cerca de la hermosa iglesia.*
![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-40.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqHzwpmVf2re5NeRdqQr99tcFsrpQXzC2szGLwyyvEGfZajXqp2PPJjKQsCXLabX7Ae.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-39.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqFsUpQKNKQDc54HHahaA7ba5GVMpMuyhNs92W6oVG9H1oJg1HKJy4mR2N5Dn2tuzP8.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep3fM97ydB3Ui4ou3DpYJmaE44E6CDJ2DU7VFEFj3B2NwdSDFi5SY1pFKoX7idwUzXE.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-34.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eos1inDTaFBEh6JrS7uvwxezpckMqXmMry5kxWhmRYaC7xUWrVcCcHZFscA9mPMCssb.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23w2uVmRKGNsb5GLXaXYAfvDLZ73eJuGrcxM5yznt6UsgkAqrZuXxH2U4uVtNDafYHxY5.jpg)

> **We went back home because I had been planning to make a dish that my husband and son love. I’d been thinking about it since early in the morning, so as soon as I walked into the kitchen, I got right to work. I decided to make some cannelloni. Although pasta isn’t exactly my favorite food, they do love it, and today I wanted to spoil them a little more. I gathered all the ingredients, chopped, mixed, seasoned, and assembled the cannelloni with patience and love.**

> *Regresamos a casa, porque yo tenía en mente preparar un plato que a mi esposo y a mi hijo les encanta. Ya venía con la idea desde temprano, así que apenas entré a la cocina puse manos a la obra. Decidí preparar unos canelones. Aunque las pastas no son precisamente mi comida favorita, a ellos sí les encantan, y hoy quería consentirlos un poco más. Reuní todos los ingredientes, piqué, mezclé, sazoné y armé los canelones con paciencia y cariño.*
![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-57.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpGRE3muoYBbQhojuXfGWfHtg6xPRwofXFDj3BRsvzWQzzbPFJt5EZF5x7dg18omjMh.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpGQgA6FzZgj6G2XDWw2ZLTFC4yNMWVn33v7QcWiMTpHyLhNgakuv21cHkCfNsbWKeg.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoyP3GgDEBMp26R9UuUWBXpEh6qPPdhUmyDSCSg6zGvEaw5oDMMZaBNnqjUSCE4TT9U.jpg)

> **Then I put them in the oven, and within minutes, the house began to fill with that delicious smell that signals something good is about to come out. That aroma blended with the joy that was already in the air, with that wonderful feeling of family love that is beyond compare.**

> *Luego los llevé al horno y, en cuestión de minutos, la casa comenzó a llenarse de ese olor delicioso que anuncia que algo bueno está por salir. Ese aroma se mezcló con la alegría que ya se sentía en el ambiente, con esa deliciosa sensación de amor familiar que no tiene comparación.*
![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EokdbV8gEPU73JEKmrhRiFEYmuLh13r4EExb19MvXBdFBX4CMgNjN2GtJkpW4AHmg67.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-51.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xAXuQngTwtajmGaKPSRQtYLjLLCeK3adu39ekAjmeFUYJ2UTHCVEoG1AXc8RiwrzJJ2.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-50.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpGQf52Lddrf7GyRVPsVSwLDRHtPdni3hREhPwwZSDqXNSUb4oecaQRrfB8YjfxGy8w.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-49.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoCj3mcUHk41R4D4GVcEcugZLazgk9JqLz59Bo3DTG982V2nQBBCizW1YLnKFNNWGjV.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-47.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23tmQ5iPggcm3VoiAJTt6xstqV6NfK76ynVKcrUMhKjgGLtkDRP6w1AckQu2PbG1Jy6Ep.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-24_00-59-45.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpVCYvikrkusghDUbw6wZ74CENfG6bJYD7LHijRkDJmb3bKwaLmqik4UWwDfotxCLd6.jpg)

> **Once the cannelloni was ready, we sat down at the table and enjoyed it together. It was the perfect way to end a quiet, family-filled Saturday full of those little moments that make life more beautiful. And so, dear friends, that’s how we wrapped up our Saturday: with good company, good food, and grateful hearts. I’ll be back here very soon to share another little slice of my daily life with you, because there’s always something lovely to tell. See you soon. Bye.**

> *Cuando los canelones estuvieron listos, nos sentamos a la mesa y disfrutamos juntos. Fue un cierre perfecto para un sábado tranquilo, familiar y lleno de pequeños momentos que hacen la vida más bonita. Así, queridos amigos, cerramos nuestro sábado; con buena compañía, buena comida y un corazón agradecido. Muy pronto volveré por aquí para compartirles otro pedacito de mi día a día, porque siempre hay algo lindo que contar. Hasta pronto.   Chao.*

title.title: Splinterlands: Got 2 EPIC Gladiator cards this time!🔥
title.body:
>This represents yet another type of reward that serves as an indicator of my improved in-game performance. Here, I am not referring to the cards received as rewards—since those are distributed randomly to everyone—but rather to the Gladius Packs that I am now able to open at any given time. It has been a few months now, but prior to this period, I would typically earn enough Merits to purchase only one—or at most, two—Gladius Packs throughout an entire season. However, nowadays, in almost every season, I earn enough Merits to purchase four or five Gladius Packs in a single transaction. Purchasing a single Gladius Pack requires 2,000 Merits; today, I once again purchased three Gladius Packs at once, for which I had to pay a total of 6,000 Merits. Each Gladius Pack contains a total of five random Gladius Gladiator cards, one of which is guaranteed to be of Rare rarity or higher. In Brawl Battles, you are free to use any one of these cards of your choice without any restrictions; furthermore, under the Are You Not Entertained Rule Set, you are permitted to use an additional card from this set. In other words, if you are not participating in a Brawl Battle—meaning you are playing in Modern Mode—you would typically be unable to use any cards from this specific set; however, whenever the Are You Not Entertained Rule Set is active, you are free to use any one card from this set without restriction.

\n\n

>I received a total of 15 cards across three sets—five cards per set—from the Kuhl pack. While the minimum expectation was to receive at least three Rare or better cards in total, I actually received not only the three Rare cards but also two Epic cards; this meant the count of higher-rarity cards increased from the expected three to five. To be honest, among the cards shown in the screenshot above, the ones I use most frequently are precisely those Rare and Epic cards. However, in rare situations—such as low-Mana battles or matches governed by specific rule sets like \

—cards like Whistling Damon, Ajax Lightfoot, and Isgald Vorst prove to be extremely effective; indeed, on the battlefield, you will find that these cards provide you with a distinct competitive edge. Yet, if sufficient Mana is available, the roles that Gorth can fulfill as a sturdy tank—or that the magic-wielding Captain Katie can play from the middle of the lineup—are best executed by the Rare cards within your set. This is because, for a slightly higher Mana cost, the boost these cards receive in terms of Health and Attack Power is truly formidable.

\n\n

>Initially, to survive on the battleground, all you really need is good health; however, to apply pressure on the enemy, you require not only strong attack power but also high speed. The significance of \

lies in the fact that they offer you a superior balance of all stats within a single card. Consider, for instance, the cards shown in the screenshot above: on one side, you have Chimney Wallstop—a Common card that is truly remarkable for its sheer attack power. Yet, despite possessing excellent attack power and even decent health, this card's speed is strictly basic. Now, you could either pair this card with a \

unit that boosts its speed and perhaps provides it with some cover; otherwise, if you deploy it without any support, its sluggish speed will prevent its massive attack power from ever finding the opportunity to truly shine. Speed ​​matters immensely on the battleground; after all, if the enemy strikes before you do, there is a very real possibility that you could be knocked out before your turn even arrives. In contrast—and for the sake of comparison—consider Quora Towershead, a card with an identical Mana cost. This is an Epic card, and its attack power is equally impressive. Rather than focusing on the slight difference in attack power here, observe instead that it possesses two distinct types of attack abilities, which contributes to a superior power balance. Furthermore, its health is quite robust, and—as another crucial stat—its speed is three times faster than that of Chimney Wallstop. This is precisely what constitutes an excellent balance across all stats. And beyond all this, this card also features a \

ability, allowing it to restore one-third of its maximum health at the end of every round. Moreover—as is the case with all the aforementioned cards—it naturally possesses the inherent Bloodlust ability. Now, it is your turn: take these cards into battle and witness firsthand the impact their presence in your team has upon the enemy.

* * *

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n
>If you also want to enjoy this amazing game and you have not yet signed up, <a target=\

Please don't think that anything I have written in this blog has been copied from somewhere or is AI-generated.` 2. `Paragraph Dividers and all the photos are from #Splinterlands.` 3. `All the other content images and words are mine unless otherwise stated.`

家人在異地工作，每次回台離台都會去大吃一頓，這次自然也不例外，為了和家人們有一個可以暢聊的空間，悠閒的吃飯喝東西，找一個適合談心的地方自然是重中之重，而我們最喜歡的餐廳就是這間位在中和的布納咖啡餐館。

基本就是幾個月來一次大吃大喝的概念，這次我們點了不一樣的餐點，像是烤雞啦，本來以為是一隻雞結果才半隻，皮的部分挺好吃挺香的，但以肉質來說感覺有點柴，而我點的XO醬辣炒海鮮就很夠味，我個人非常喜歡，吃的可過癮呢。

昨天也是排了一天的看屋行程，因為餐廳在中和，所以看屋行程也排到中和去，只是花了一兩個小時之後再開車到工地現場去看，發現是條無尾道路而且馬路不太大車子卻很多，等於是若以後住這裡開車出門可能常常要回堵很久才出得去，光想就讓人打退堂鼓了XD

看了一星期的房子還是覺得自己現在住的房子最舒服又自在，寬敞視野好又面公園，其他家人就問我們的房子是怎麼了嗎?不然幹嘛要換房子?問得好啊，哈哈哈，多帶家人去看房他們才會知道現在住的已經很美好了?

這一晚聊得很多，雖然每次來這裡講話都要很大聲才聽得見，但還是挺好聊的，是個很棒的聚餐地點。

---

昨天出席了同事的婚礼，这还是我第一次出席新加坡婚礼(呵呵避无可避的请柬，因为太早收到)。

在新加坡，大家都会在出席婚宴前，参考婚礼红包行情网页，了解一下红包分量如何不失礼：
[SingaporeBrides](https://singaporebrides.com/wedding-ang-bao-rates/) 
是得分辨市区郊区、或周末平日或午餐晚餐的分别，我看一般市区的周末婚宴都是新币200+打底，事前我也打听了好些同事，大家都觉得这些年的婚席红包行情真的涨一倍了，加上溢价，这笔红包钱如果拿去普通餐馆吃，都可以请整桌人吃海鲜大餐了，我昏。

婚礼前一天，我才发现有些非华族的同事不太知道华人婚宴的“行情”，还以为180-200很多了，当我告诉他，该家酒店周末午餐的最低行情，他都大吃一惊，怎么这么高（ 最低行情再加人情费 ）。

酒席的菜肴都是个人分量分配好的，不是我们马来西亚婚宴常见的，端上桌子让客人自己分，所以那些没满桌的，都不知道餐馆会不会上其他未出席客人的份额（我桌子满10人，没人缺席）

婚礼，一对新人是有准备些小游戏与盲盒给嘉宾，不知是不是多数新加坡婚宴的常见，不过借用这个点子。小游戏就是类似彩票一样的Bingo， 荧幕上开出的号码，连成满2排就可以领红包；盲盒也一样-领到里面含有元宝的宾客，可以领红包。

不知是不是婚宴是午餐的关系，这一次婚宴吃完了每道菜，不会觉得特别的饱，也或许因为是个人分量，所以是刚刚好，不会过饱，算是好事。

不知其他地方的婚宴红包行情，也是走这样的行情吗-就是打听餐馆的婚席，再除以10得到最低入门级红包数额，呵呵

body.title: Not as planned. My Actifit Diary: May 23 2026
body.body:
What a weirdly great day! Morning was awesome as always when Ellie stays over night. Everything slow and easy, coffee, breakfast (salad as she loves it), electronic music - Essence by Paul Kalkbrenner, highlighted in my main account today. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/81aab3b7-f7f6-4cd4-9b2d-29c8bad5dc41.jpg)

I worked a little, I admit. Inventory. But I also hunted for the steam_api64r.dll for quite a while. I really want to keep playing CoD Infinite Warfare, but u couldn't find the right dll. And no, I did not buy the game, so I need that specific dll for the crack, and that's a minefield of viruses. Didn't find a trustable one. Maybe I'll just download the game again. Not that important, anyway.

I did make some good progress in SPL. Went up another league, and calculated a little more for my land strategy. Prices are falling in both cards and plots, and I really want to take advantage. A friend also gave me a posting key to play a big tournament with all cards available, and I did score two wins so far. Tomorrow I'll know how many more... I neglected tournaments for a while. Should get back into it... 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/58005c05-70e8-4c8b-bf27-af1b1892eb4f.jpg)

I had lunch with my in-laws, that was fun. The three terrible sisters (that includes my fiancee) enjoyed their gossip, and my step daughter and I kind of stared at them most of the time. \
Kami said at the end. And I whispered a \

her way. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/88375110-85a6-45d1-bac6-aa278dccc3a2.jpg) I wanted to go home and just play and chill. But I met a friend on the street and we went for a Cuba Libre. Then I wanted to go back and watch a stupid movie. But a group of other good friends wanted me to go spend time with them in my favorite bar. So I went. And Ellie came by. They went to watch the MJ movie, which I did not want to watch in Spanish. Now she's sleeping here on my couch. I guess it's time to go to bed. Thank you for reading and have a good night!

body.title: WHY NOT USE THE MAIN ENTRANCE INSTEAD?
body.body:
Hi pals... so about Yesterday during the weekend, I volunteered for an event in a local government area and because I was very unfamiliar with the terrain, the first rider I took drove me past the school I was meant to stop at.
When we got to a certain point, I inquired about my destination and he apologized because he had drove past it.


![IMG-20260412-WA0085_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23z7Hr9YxCZwp4JM3mNvxLSNRn8p4SdB4rPZCuvyQmNudjGKPw9FxovBXAxDhdfGBdCD2.jpg)


In essence, I had to find my way back.I entered another keke, and this second driver asked me, “Do you want me to enter inside the school?”

I said yes.

He took another route and stopped at what looked like the back entrance of the school. 
Immediately I saw the place, my spirit became uncomfortable. 

That entrance was a lonely path surrounded by refuse dumps, dirt, and filth.

As a spiritual person that I am, I  tend to see life from a deeper perspective so I asked him, “Is there no other way to enter this school than this back entrance?”

The man kept trying to convince me to just enter from there because according to him, all way na way.

Some students nearby also tried to encourage me.“You can pass here, sir”. one of them quipped.
This is also a road. Another said and the first student tried to play the gentleman by extending his hand to help me carry my bag.

But I wasn't having it.

I said, “No, thank you\

His name will not be Zacharias, but John.
God is still looking for people who will say
 “Not so.”

This pattern stops with me.
I will do things differently.
I will follow the right path.
Do not allow societal pressure push you into pathways your spirit is rejecting.


![IMG_20260523_213455_708.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AK9NHqLWdHPEVhDiwiLLZHkrXnDQMsVqYHypgdyxspeCFMPaj6S6342bxX4snxT.jpg)

There is always another way. 
There is always a cleaner path. 
There is still a front gate.
So today, I want to encourage you.

Choose the right way even when it is longer. Choose integrity even when compromise looks easier. Choose purity over pollution. Choose obedience over pressure.
Look for the ancient paths and walk in them.

And may the Spirit of God give you the boldness to reject every wrong pattern that has appeared more convenient around you in Jesus name, Amen.
 You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra!

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@johnpetra/why-not-use-the-main-entrance-instead-af3)
