body.body:
> Feliz fin de semana tengan todos un gusto saludarles nuevamente y desearle desde la distancia que cada uno de ustedes se encuentren bien en sus hogares disfrutando de los mejores platillos hechos con amor, este fin de semana decidí hacer una torta de piña ya que en mi nevera había una piña desde hace días y no encontraba que preparar, por lo tanto tuve la idea de hacer una torta la cual consiste en crear un caramelo y luego agregar trozos de piña para hacer una torta volteada como la conocen en muchas partes, sin embargo no me dio el resultado que yo esperaba, el caramelo se pegó a la bandeja y los trozos de piñas quedaron blancos y sin color, de igual manera la torta quedó espectacular esponjosa con buen sabor, pero son cosas que pasan dentro de la cocina de igual manera quise compartirlas con ustedes y me dejen saber si tienen alguna técnica para que el caramelo no se quede pegado en la parte de abajo de mi tortera y pueda quedar conjuntamente con la piña sobre la torta. > Happy weekend everyone! It's a pleasure to greet you all again and wish you all well at home, enjoying the best dishes made with love. This weekend I decided to make a pineapple upside-down cake since I had a pineapple in my fridge for days and couldn't think of what to do with it. So I had the idea to make a cake by creating a caramel and then adding pineapple chunks to make an upside-down cake, as it's known in many places. However, it didn't turn out as I expected. The caramel stuck to the pan and the pineapple chunks remained white and colorless. Even so, the cake itself was spectacular—fluffy and delicious. But these things happen in the kitchen, and I wanted to share it with you. I'd love to hear if you have any techniques to prevent the caramel from sticking to the bottom of the cake pan so that it adheres perfectly to the pineapple on top of the cake.
![GridArt_20260523_233135327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJhZvtiemxfdKVuBqvL7pdjVnhwGJKRGkyDod8rZ71YwApZdMiNwCqsDTsNJW3c.jpg)
Ingredientes: 300 gramos de harina de trigo leudante, polvo de hornear, 3 huevos, aceite, jugo de piña, piña en trozos, 200 gramos azúcar. > Ingredients: 300 grams of self-raising wheat flour, baking powder, 3 eggs, oil, pineapple juice, chopped pineapple, 200 grams of sugar.
![GridArt_20260523_232807887.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23wMexXPU98suk7azdPdxfQZ8czm1mwYK6JPJSFX1giu1mdQRWnt5jnixL2EX9DBThrFA.jpg)
Comenzamos pelando la piña cortandolas en trozos y llevando una parte a la licuadora con un vaso de agua para obtener el jugo de piña, el resto de la piña podemos reservarla para la decoración. > We start by peeling the pineapple, cutting it into pieces, and putting some of it in the blender with a glass of water to get the pineapple juice. We can reserve the rest of the pineapple for decoration. Por otra parte separé las yemas de las claras, procedí a batir las claras de huevo hasta que comenzara a duplicar su tamaño poco a poco añadí el azúcar, seguidamente unir la mezcla de merengue con las yemas añadiendo un chorrito de aceite y el jugo de piña. > On the other hand, I separated the yolks from the whites, proceeded to beat the egg whites until they began to double in size, gradually adding the sugar, then combining the meringue mixture with the yolks, adding a splash of oil and the pineapple juice.

Continué con los ingredientes secos agregando polvo de hornear una pizca de sal y la harina de trigo mezclando hasta integrar todo en una mezcla homogénea. > I continued with the dry ingredients, adding baking powder, a pinch of salt, and wheat flour, mixing until everything was incorporated into a homogeneous mixture. body.title: Getting back in the pool for some relaxed exercise
body.body:
The pool sessions are some of my favorite kinds of exercise and I got to cash in my free voucher at the swim club that was terribly busy the last time I went.  I only cashed it in because the ticket was going to expire.  I had a time in the afternoon on a weekday where I didn't have to work and just as I suspected, this is the best time to go to these sorts of places as it was almost completely unoccupied.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23u5ZX8iVVxBwd6DNdC4tyEzGYvipYP9Qb6c6aL9zXYbygtmmUwbcj6LekVSHXCVrvEyN.png)
</center>
As I tend to do I was curious about how many calories a 25 minute session would burn especially if I wasn't really trying to push it.  Remember, I don't do hardcore exercise that really hurts me because my idea is to get exercise into my life that I do not hate and therefore don't mind doing it the next time. 

This was a 25 minutes session because your timer starts as soon as you scan the QR code and then a number pops up on the wall letting you know how much time you have left that everyone can see from the pool.  It is a pretty interesting system actually.  It will turn red once you time is up and while they aren't huge on the enforcement in the middle of the day, I feel as though 25 minutes is enough.  I'm kind of bored of it at this point anyway.  

<center>  
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/Eo6Bfgeifgz6SwVrew39chzCRHHvpWQxrRFtMqEtm9fYQ4JfEuM8hkNLitXjJNWpZBR.png)
</center>

I guess I have a pretty consistent pace when I am doing the breaststroke and there was only one drop off during my entire session.  That was when my goggle strap came loose for some reason and it took me about a minute to get it sorted out.  During that time I accidentally discovered that this pool must be salt water cleaned because the usual burning out of the eyes with all the chemicals didn't happen during this exposure to the water.   This is incredible.  I remember the chemical baths I had a child and this is a much better system.   It doesn't burn at all!

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23tRojiypmMkgUQAogAE8BqwikcxQ84Kr1wQ8aGKLJajmLjtSDshyWUgfmP4kqRdrLKzw.png) </center>

If you are not familiar with \

just know that it simply measures your efficiency as far as distance and number of strokes is concerned and it appears as though I am pretty consistent with the one exception being when my goggles fly off my head for some reason.   In SWOLF a lower score is a better score just like in GOLF.   I don't really know what to make of this and believe it is just some new sort of made up statistic so that the watches can claim to have other information that they are giving you.  

I really wish I could get more swimming into my weekly workouts but because real-estate is so expensive in downtown Chicago, these places are kept really expensive.  Almost none of the gyms here have swimming pools included in the membership fees simply because of the enormous amount of space that a pool occupies. This swimming club is really expensive with a half hour session normally costing around 10 dollars.  That's just crazy talk to me but just like anything else in the world they have figured out how much people will pay for something and that is how much they charge.  

I kind of miss the days of public pools when I was a kid living in more rural areas and I think I was able to get into the place for the entire day for less than a dollar.  Such is the way of living in one of the most populated cities in the world I guess.  I seriously need to look at moving away from here so I can experience those things again.  

It will likely be quite some time before I go swimming again but maybe one of these days I should head down to the great lake that is right next to my neighborhood and see what that is all about.   I have been in this city for years and haven't so much as dipped my toes into Lake Michigan.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![dtPFSRqGRsyIQOR3_e695cb13f1b7033819be69d0b27260_livephoto.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/dtPFSRqGRsyIQOR3_e695cb13f1b7033819be69d0b27260_livephoto/dtPFSRqGRsyIQOR3_e695cb13f1b7033819be69d0b27260_livephoto.webp)

![8JYZHOUbwzP3WwcC_8d3e1a63a4d1ca870c4c58940ef7bb_livephoto.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/8JYZHOUbwzP3WwcC_8d3e1a63a4d1ca870c4c58940ef7bb_livephoto/8JYZHOUbwzP3WwcC_8d3e1a63a4d1ca870c4c58940ef7bb_livephoto.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

往常每周六晚上我都有四节课，这周情况比较特殊。由于下周学生将进入自主复习阶段，以答疑辅导为主，学校决定下周正常上课不放假，于是我们把两周的单休合并到一起，这周便有了两天完整的休息时间。

原本满心想着趁假期放松，现实却没能如愿。这两天几乎都在陪着Sheya完成作业，直到今天上午，才把作业全部写完。

说实话，昨天下午我身心俱疲。一年级的作业量并不轻松，光是书面任务就有一张语文试卷、两张数学试卷。除外，数学还要认识、练习人民币的使用，而语文既要默写两首古诗和语文园地的习语，不少生字课堂上并未学习，老师要求孩子们先自主默写，不会的再翻书核对补写字。除此之外，还得复习六、七、八三个单元，课本里每一篇课文都要求全文背诵。

Sheya专注力不算出众，加上年纪偏小，很难长时间安稳学习，写作业时小动作总是接连不断。昨天最让我急躁的一幕，是让她独自默写古诗。遇上不会写的字，她就愣在原地走神，一会儿摆弄剪刀，一会儿对着镜子玩耍，看得我心里焦急。短短两首诗足足耗了一小时，倘若没有我的督促，这份作业恐怕翻倍时间都完成不了。

语文作业好不容易结束，紧接着就要开始数学练习。她做题十分粗心，常常没读完题目就匆忙下笔，看见括号就直接当成填空题作答。和她讲解时，她还透着不耐烦，我忍不住开口劝导，我们两人动辄僵持半个多小时，既拖延进度，又让人身心疲惫。

很多基础概念她也没能理解透彻，做图形分类题时常出错。同样是三角形，仅仅大小有区别，她就误以为不属于同一类别。读题马虎，理解又跟不上，考试成绩自然达不到预期。

我也只能默默开导自己，她还未满7岁，理解抽象概念本就存在难度，只能循序渐进耐心引导。可每次辅导时，只要看到她消极懈怠的态度，我就难以平复心情，忍不住心生火气，这也是我一直难以调整的地方。

就拿练字这件事来说，她只勉强在练字的一小时里稍微收敛心神，压根不清楚练字的真正意义。平日里写作业也是如此，明明可以工整书写，下笔却总是随性潦草。我反复提醒她握笔姿势、书写习惯，可种种问题始终难以改正，难道我对她的要求太高了吗？


---

body.title: El intérprete y el verdugo [Esp-Eng]
body.body: _Saludos, comunidad @holos.lotus_\n\n_Tengo una amiga que suele utilizar una frase, poco más o menos radical, pero que pensándolo bien tiene buena cuota de sentido, ella plantea: \

, y es algo que se nos puede presentar a diario, que hasta cierto punto puede ser cansón. Tú mandas un mensaje, dices algo en una reunión, o haces un comentario en el grupo de amigos o incluso de la familia, y de repente te encuentras respondiendo por algo que jamás se te pasó por la cabeza. Algo así como que uno dice A, el otro entiende B, y terminas discutiendo sobre Z; y al final te pueden hacer responsable de lo que la otra parte interpretó, no de lo que realmente dijiste._

>Greetings, community @holos.lotus

>I have a friend who often uses a phrase that is more or less radical, but when you think about it, it makes a good deal of sense. She says: \

And this is something we can face every day, to the point that it can become tiresome. You send a message, say something at a meeting, or make a comment in a group of friends or even family, and suddenly you find yourself answering for something that never even crossed your mind. It's like you say A, the other person understands B, and you end up arguing about Z. And in the end, you can be held responsible for what the other party interpreted, not for what you actually said.
*********
<center>https://images.pexels.com/photos/8015694/pexels-photo-8015694.jpeg</center>
*********
<center>[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/cielo-hombre-manos-nubes-8015694/)</center>

_En tal sentido creo que aquí hay una confusión de base bastante seria, y me atrevo a decir que esto no es un accidente raro, sino que suena más a regla que a excepción. Uno tiene que hacerse cargo de sus palabras, eso es innegable: si se dice una tontería, asumirla; si se hiere sin querer, disculparse; pero de ahí a que alguien tome una frase, la retuerza con sus propios miedos, sospechas o sus ganas de pelear, y luego eche culpas por lo que salió de su cabeza... no, ya eso es otra música, ahí el problema no es lo que se dijo, sino esa especie de filtro con el que escucharon._

_Porque escuchar bien es un arte que últimamente se ha ido perdiendo: muchas personas no escuchan para entender, sino para confirmar lo que ya creen, y si encima llegan con sospechas debajo del brazo, pues ya la tenemos: todo lo que digas va a sonar a algo que no es, esa actitud de \

, es una forma de secuestrar la conversación; donde el otro termina hablando solo, porque en realidad ya se decidió lo que iba a decir antes de que abriera la boca._

>In that sense, I think there is a very serious underlying confusion here, and I dare say this isn't a rare accident; it sounds more like the rule than the exception. You have to take responsibility for your words, that's undeniable: if you say something foolish, own up to it; if you unintentionally hurt someone, apologize. But from there to someone taking a phrase, twisting it with their own fears, suspicions, or desire to argue, and then blaming you for what came out of their head… no, that's a different tune entirely. The problem there isn't what was said, but rather that kind of filter through which they listened.

>Because listening well is an art that has been getting lost lately: many people don't listen to understand, but to confirm what they already believe. And if they also show up with suspicions under their arm, well then we've got it: everything you say will sound like something it isn't. That attitude of \

is a way of hijacking the conversation, where the other person ends up talking to themselves, because it was already decided what they were going to say before they even opened their mouth.
*********
<center>https://images.pexels.com/photos/2068154/pexels-photo-2068154.jpeg</center>
*********
<center>[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/dos-hombres-de-pie-en-el-suelo-durante-el-anochecer-2068154/)</center>

_Recuerda dinámicas donde la proyección es la de poner en el otro lo que uno mismo trae, cuestión que no es ingenua cuando la interpretación maliciosa tiende a repetirse: empieza el rumor, después el señalamiento, luego el aislamiento, y todo partiendo de nada sólido. Hoy se suele socializar bajo una suerte de aceleración, comunicando por fragmentos, con el dedo listo para malinterpretar antes de leer la segunda línea, donde los tonos se pierden, los contextos se esfuman, y esto también pasa cara a cara, en la mesa, en el trabajo, desnudando esa incapacidad para interpelar \

, como si verificar diera pereza, se prefiere suponer._\n\n_No se trata de que todo el mundo tenga la obligación de adivinar lo que se quiere decir (hay que esforzarse por hablar lo más claro posible), pero la claridad no es un blindaje contra la mala fe: se puede ser muy cristalino, y aún así el otro elegirá empañarte si le conviene, hay una lección sencilla que en tales circunstancias se olvida: \

; si esa interpretación se alza como verdad absoluta y se juzga con ella, la cuestión ya no es la palabra, sino la decisión de no contrastar. La comunicación sana necesita de los dos lados, o sea, que uno hable bien y el otro escuche sin poner trampas._\n\n_Así que la próxima vez que alguien te diga \

._\n\n>Think about dynamics where projection means placing onto others what you carry within yourself. This is not innocent when malicious interpretation tends to repeat itself: the rumor starts, then the accusation, then the isolation, and all of it based on nothing solid. Nowadays, people tend to socialize under a kind of acceleration, communicating in fragments, with a finger ready to misinterpret before reading the second line. Tones get lost, contexts vanish, and this also happens face to face, at the dinner table, at work, exposing that inability to ask, \

As if verifying were too much trouble, they prefer to assume.\n\n>It's not that everyone is obligated to guess what you mean (you must strive to speak as clearly as possible), but clarity is not a shield against bad faith. You can be very transparent, and yet the other person will still choose to cloud you if it suits them. There is a simple lesson that, in such circumstances, is forgotten: \

If that interpretation rises up as absolute truth and they judge based on it, the issue is no longer the words spoken, but the decision not to cross-check. Healthy communication requires both sides — that is, one person speaks well and the other listens without setting traps.\n\n>So next time someone tells you, \
take a breath and ask them: \

body.title: Michael Jakcson 2026: Noche de Cine [ES | EN]
body.body:
>


Llevo dos días tratando de escribir esta bonita experiencia del Cinex, antes que me hicieran molestar estuve con ánimos e inspiración y actualmente tengo un bloqueo que me cuesta recuperarme pero junto ganas para describir de igual forma como fue la Película de Michael Jackson 2026 porque no puedo dejar que las injusticias me hagan enfurecer. Creánme que aprovechar las salidas con amigos es una escape de la realidad.

Siempre he seguido la Historia de Michael Jackson, de hecho, desde pequeña mi mamá me ha contado su historia. De niña, en el 2009 recibí la noticia que falleció Michael Jackson por televisión y desde entonces he seguido su historia y he escuchado sus canciones. La canción \

era muy tendencia en Mtv en aquel entonces y era una de las que más me asustaban. Otro detalle es que nunca creí las acusaciones contra él, porque sabía que era inocente y que nunca tuvo infancia. Jaffar jackson fue el protagonista y representó a Michael buenísimo,sabemos que Jaffar Jackson es sobrino de Michael, hijo de algunos de sus hermanos. > I’ve been trying to write about this wonderful experience at Cinex for two days now. Before things started getting on my nerves, I was feeling upbeat and inspired, but now I’m stuck in a rut and having a hard time getting back on track. Still, I’m mustering the energy to describe what Michael Jackson’s 2026 movie was like, because I can’t let injustices make me angry. Believe me, spending time with friends is a great escape from reality. > I’ve always followed Michael Jackson’s story; in fact, my mom has been telling me about him since I was little. As a child, in 2009, I heard the news of Michael Jackson’s death on TV, and ever since then I’ve followed his story and listened to his songs. The song “Thriller” was very popular on MTV back then, and it was one of the songs that scared me the most. Another thing is that I never believed the accusations against him, because I knew he was innocent and that he never had a childhood. > Jaffar Jackson stole the show and did a fantastic job portraying Michael. We know that Jaffar Jackson is Michael's nephew, the son of one of his brothers. ****

>


Con unos amigos que tengo decidí salir para ver la Película de Michael Jackson que está todavía en Estreno en Cinex de Marina Plaza ubicado en la Ciudad de Cumaná, todos nos reunimos en el Cine temprano para poder comprar las entradas, que de hecho, suena chistoso porque un amigo compró 15 entradas porque también venía la familia peluche, unos de sus familiares. El turno para ver era de 7:30 Pm y allí si es bueno tener carro que te lleven y en este caso tuve suerte porque tenía día libre al día siguiente y podía quedarme en casa de unos amigos y desconectarme de la realidad por un día.

La quería ver, porque hablaban mucho de lo buena que era y quería darle la oportunidad. Admiro muchísimo a Michael, de verdad que mis gustos musicales siempre fueron así, sus pasos de bailes, su voz y su manera tan magnifica de ser gran ser humano, a pesar de la crueldad de su padre. 

----

![20260518_193542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrearojas55/23tRrDJ3Kowhiwo3JexDJ5oMVX6mJj142Yf5479HDdDV8aDqCpUNh97NSr8d8uby6Q15M.jpg)

<div class=\

>


La película relata la historia de un niño de Gary, un pueblo pequeño ubicado en Indiana, Estados Unidos. Su familia es pobre, 5 hermanos destinados a tener un padre tan dañino al punto de golpear con su correa a cualquiera de los 5 hermanos si se equivocaban, uno de ellos era el más pequeño de los Jackson Five, Michael Jackson. Su infancia fue arrebatada, nunca fue un niño normal, su maltrato y verbal por parte de su padre lo llevó a detreriorarse psicologicamente una vez iba creciendo. Le encantaba tener colecciones de Disney y Peter Pan era su aliado por las noches, ellos eran sus amigos. Imagina practicar tantas horas sin descanso, recibir maltratos y convertirte luego de adolescente en el Rey del Pop. Pero Michael tenía algo particular, al cumplir los 18 tenía que deshacerse de su padre que de igual forma seguía molestandolo.

Michael Jackson subió a la forma al decidir convertirse en solista, fue una de las mejores decisiones de su vida porque de esta manera podía seguir su vida artística que su padre lo convirttió pero con sus propios ideales, convirtiendo una de sus canciones en albumnes vendidas. Su carrera fue un éxito, pocas escenas de la pleícula fueron omitidas como su historia con el vitiligo que para los años de 1980 eran silenciado en forma de tabú y hasta ahora ha sido de unos artistas que esigue siendo recordado. Todas sus ideas musicales las \

una de ellas era Beait y Thriller. Beat it la usó como un mensaje al mundo para dar consiencia sobre los pandilleros en esos años que estaban ocurriendo muerte y thriller fue un intento de aprovechar el sistema audiovisual a su favor, que la descatalagoraron y nadie creía que iba a estar en tendencia porque MTV era el boom y estaba surgiendo. Un canal de música por así decirlo. > The film tells the story of a boy from Gary, a small town in Indiana, United States. His family was poor; he had five siblings, all of whom had to endure a father so abusive that he would beat any of them with his belt if they made a mistake. One of them was the youngest of the Jackson Five, Michael Jackson. His childhood was stolen from him; he was never a normal child. The physical and verbal abuse he suffered at the hands of his father led to his psychological deterioration as he grew older. He loved collecting Disney items, and Peter Pan was his companion at night—they were his friends. Imagine practicing for so many hours without rest, enduring abuse, and then becoming the King of Pop as a teenager. But Michael had something special: when he turned 18, he had to cut ties with his father, who continued to torment him just the same. > Michael Jackson hit his stride when he decided to go solo; it was one of the best decisions of his life because it allowed him to continue the artistic path his father had set him on, but on his own terms, turning his songs into best-selling albums. His career was a success; few scenes from the film were omitted, such as his story with vitiligo, which in the 1980s was silenced as a taboo, and to this day he remains one of the artists who is still remembered. All his musical ideas were hits; two of them were “Beat It” and “Thriller.” He used “Beat It” as a message to the world to raise awareness about gang violence during those years when deaths were occurring, and “Thriller” was an attempt to use the audiovisual system to his advantage—it was initially shelved, and no one believed it would become a hit because MTV was just taking off and emerging as a music channel, so to speak. ----

> Es cierto que hubieron escenas que fuerln omitidas, realmente Michael Jackson fue un ícono en los 80 como en la actualidad. Pudo tener fama y ser billonario pero su vida personal, esa que fue arrebatada cuando niño es lo que duele. Tuvo hasta un Chimpances que fue su amigo y no tenía con quien jugar Twister. De verdad que crecer duele, como también tener toda la fama del mundo y no tener amistades. > It’s true that some scenes were left out, but Michael Jackson was truly an icon in the ’80s just as he is today. He may have achieved fame and become a billionaire, but his personal life—the one that was taken from him as a child—is what really hurts. He even had a chimpanzee as a friend and no one to play Twister with. Growing up really does hurt, just as having all the fame in the world and no friends does. ---- ![20260518_201239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrearojas55/23wzze553hXJreUA4QokuaXEg1KLyApAZPDSL9gfy1H2phhQQV1daH7ohK4je337ae2qV.jpg) ![20260518_201235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrearojas55/23wWnW7dRsNkF3WAqqzWR4jKtpuwAgvMMjrwxjc1WHdoxFHL3FtHXaxjaqurqAHbjRiQX.jpg) ---

> La verdad, no sé que más decir, a mi me gustó la película aunque su hija Paris Jackskn ma haya criticado, es en definitiva muy buena aunque odié más a su papá porque seres como él tan porqueria todavia los hay en este mundo. Michael siempre fue un niño, donaba millones de dólares a los hospitales y a niños que necesitaban. Eso es lo que vale más. > Honestly, I don't know what else to say. I liked the movie, even though his daughter Paris Jackskn criticized it. It's definitely very good, although I hated her dad even more because there are still scumbags like him in this world. Michael was always a kid at heart; he donated millions of dollars to hospitals and children in need. That's what matters most. --- ![20260518_213124.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrearojas55/23vsG6Kuw3J9Ttk38wp8MEFhuEJpRK1VjP9aCexMkdMJyafohmut3Dt2yCjHYh3oc17kq.jpg) ![20260518_213130.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrearojas55/23tvB1uZvYG1MxWDNbkULenR3m11r2pxfj6cGEzcjqXEgB9sYKdAMPNBDDaozMJgBP278.jpg) ----

> Sus pasos de bailes siempre serán admirados y hasta ahora, no ha salido nadie que lo iguale. Grande Michael Jackson. La recomiendo mucho, si eres gran fan de Michael Jackson en estos tiempos todavía. > His dance moves will always be admired, and so far, no one has come along who can match him. Michael Jackson was truly great. I highly recommend it if you're still a big Michael Jackson fan today. --- ![20260518_190355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrearojas55/23ycuUKKWevfB6kMHi8yFM8isAnqR6XuMAgqZcEduwvoTrjzApusxSzAt6qsvrrXXEvLC.jpg) ---- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ElN_4vUvTPs&list=RDElN_4vUvTPs&start_radio=1 ---- ######

body.body:
---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![Delicioso almuerzo (14).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wqroEvXAv4WdC6tvVWtCSLMuARHyq4WLEUCMNtePJTCmkufEhqfsVjJkGqtHQFRbPDQ.jpg)

>


Hola, amigos, hoy con otra receta sencilla de preparar; se trata de una pasta corta guisada. De verdad que esta pasta queda deliciosa y muy jugosa, ideal para un almuerzo. La podemos acompañar con pollo frito, una carne asada o frita. Lo mejor de este plato es recordar a mi abuela, ya que ella fue la que me enseñó a prepararlo. Espero que les guste, así que aquí les dejo el paso a paso.  

>Hi, everyone! Today I have another easy-to-make recipe for you: a pasta bake. This dish is truly delicious and very juicy—perfect for lunch. We can serve it with fried chicken, roasted meat, or fried meat. The best part about this dish is that it reminds me of my grandmother, since she was the one who taught me how to make it. I hope you like it, so here are the step-by-step instructions.  


---
![El texto del párrafo (32).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EouEzXFRam7Qu5Er4T5yaxbebYHDJJvGYKKJedtHFWxqE5sXNxmydEWFdjp6DLSkUTF.jpg)

<div class = \

> - 600 gr de pasta corta - 600 g de pasta corta - 1 salsa para pizza - 1 pimentón rojo - 1 cebolla - 4 dientes de ajo - 1 tallo de ajo porro - 1 cucharadita de cúrcuma - 1 cucharadita de paprika - Aceite de oliva - Sal

> - 600 g short pasta - 1 jar of pizza sauce - 1 red bell pepper - 1 onion - 4 cloves of garlic - 1 leek - 1 teaspoon turmeric - 1 teaspoon paprika - Olive oil - Salt

![1000474632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yThZgMdzLVESzWFfjdNPin4HQyn6Vjzpg4FhdSAKmR3hwypAnAcBpxmy35NptMrfwbf.jpg)

- Lo primero que hacemos es colocar una olla con agua en la cocina y dejamos cocinar y, cuando hierve, le añadimos la pasta y sal, dejamos cocinar hasta que esté blanda. Una vez listo, escurrimos con un colador, añadimos agua fría y reservamos. > - First, place a pot of water on the stove and bring it to a boil. Once it’s boiling, add the pasta and salt, and cook until tender. When done, drain the pasta in a colander, rinse with cold water, and set aside.
|![pasta112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tSYPyyAcNS9fHtUt6BZRfXSSNBryfVEw73EFQjT6x9gjSqmsUB14QyVaMCGD7dfZTKT.jpg)|![1000474731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yd3zLFEkULe1vCoyfj3gFkgbzfjA9PpCnDvS7jwkWVh81VZNxiRGCRp5q2YGxWxh39A.jpg)|![1000474732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vi1wyojwxVLWF9jkU3V1mN8tVZvFdro5ZQyvy5LYXgP3hA4JGadZq2vVhdDhyGaYwVn.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![1000474754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tvnby4XxT3cDY1T5BQquR54GQXjaNzpB86T3d56oToRbYMyptJzSsfZricq9NdGK3Bi.jpg)|![1000474759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23x195k479wY8u8uMVtNuqpoWKZY5bzbXN9MVdFBEWjfXP1HedUfasgjd62EyEZQQBFM2.jpg)| |-|-|
- Ahora colocamos una sartén, le untamos aceite y, cuando esté caliente, añadimos la cebolla, el pimentón y el ajoporro, previamente lavados, y dejamos sofreír. > - Now place a skillet on the stove, coat it with oil, and once it’s hot, add the onion, bell pepper, and leek—all of which have been washed beforehand—and sauté them.
|![1000474709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vhyWJH2L33CKE3vpfbRbHXmMBPqFAeF2spi1zYRGsYz3oD2J9caUXtEHF4RKnKFgprA.jpg)|![1000474711.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsNmGbTUbxUSfh5yc7QFFSCVCWWLTpWXzUHgivJxQ2k6JSGWuEyEnRa9HfGuqwYdmNb.jpg)| |-|-| |![salsa11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xp4QYCFGSXuV3S1fCjbLLMp9ezFcQVZoU4HEmKwzGVcmAsW1XojGwxPKvTsWfmVBNwy.jpg)|![1000474717.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2mLQ23FwdDMp5dJB8oXnYkYVPnesdxnN8NLqb6XhY3GWsDHktDr2ScGnyvYf8qjjaL.jpg)|
- Una vez sofritas las verduras, las añadimos en un vaso de la licuadora, agregamos sal, los dientes de ajo y el pimentón y licuamos, hasta formar una mezcla. > - Once the vegetables have been sautéed, place them in a blender, add salt, the garlic cloves, and the paprika, and blend until smooth.
|![1000474742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2qZG86YGM8Nv7jUZ9fRAoo1F8L82QkkdkgrimshjdU7Ygvzf6DsfVJdrfUfbi8SJs5.jpg)|![1000474743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23zS59redCnCwHUBHPb83FpW7jNHSb5mo11C7SfVhrqSgKnS4vTonQeCMeh3dH7JNu4iV.jpg)| |-|-|
- Ahora tomamos otra sartén y la colocamos en la cocina; allí agregamos la mezcla, sal y la salsa para pizza. > - Now take another skillet and place it on the stove; add the mixture, salt, and pizza sauce.
|![pasta114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wqbyjosBWXxeM22D7FR9sJAopaXpQBexJmoCC1Cb8wVM8TeC6Fz9BbrTsKQChZ5Tija.jpg)|![1000474745.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xKtBo1m3rdWN1FS2mnhodz6NetXkvZAfBCm97qZreHgYKtGmRgbDRVQLEhP5615q2Ju.jpg)| |-|-|
- Ahora añadimos la salsa a la olla, incorporamos la pasta y mezclamos. > - Now add the sauce to the pot, add the pasta, and stir.
|![1000474755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xKsyHYkGExi69Kcivi88LfmzmwHWkU1Asx7rHH3TN78aN2RxcY1B6V2d9SDHxhYeLhn.jpg)|![1000474756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wCDiKrRfs9bhKhMG3uPPz9wewwWjqbbeFMYSwfYFuk5ZZijftLZT22cWVA485TMwETD.jpg)|![1000474758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2qMC7NtUE63cNens5ammPwtbtnRJzFNdScQ1TWiKTbLgGhp3WirKcu45i5YbMVpozz.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Ya lista esta deliciosa pasta corta guisada. > - This delicious pasta dish is now ready.
![1000474773.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23y8v2tovA3pNAtvpaV3wHNrDhyqUWBJPHMgLD8hrgjSo1ofMUZounYFK8C11F6AoZYdb.jpg) ![1000474776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23ynb3ekwop5M1vfBc5G8ZjeJqCT4RKvbp97suFaB8N8UxWmGZwiZ63DhcZYaPGxDMchv.jpg) ![1000474779.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMf8G1EqbDf42rSR5i5Qir5Yb6KwEDEtGURx9mKUxfDE5jpqGLKSMHB1wLsch316Xx3.jpg) ![1000474783.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wgSTPmVMu3Sa9uDbKUWc7QVvTe8B5nS6ih2SVrs9KTQPygbPjdGhGj5hZd349JViQuT.jpg) ![1000474781.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsUqfFBoCESfRwvJ6Kk47qbYJFyTRgd3DrDxpapc1Zq699JJcwzV6c4FGPEGn2dwXz3.jpg)

<center>



![Picsart_25-03-29_15-59-45-353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/23z7BhqbrpBESXqSvZhDSCDJCPbWLvuv9D8HZNc6o7nSWBGjNKE2h6idFZnAnk6Ya4Br7.jpg)

Hola amigos de Hive y de esta linda comunidad! Es primera vez que hago un a publicación aquí, simplemente quería compartirles estás fotos, ya qué este maquillaje me lo realicé yo solito, sin tener mucha experiencia sobre el maquillaje glam, he de decir que siento que no me quedó tan mal, no busco ser experto, pero aún así me gustaría aprender más, ya que soy bailarín y a veces me tocan situaciones donde tengo que maquillarme yo solo.
Jamás me atrevería a hacer un tutorial, pero estás fotos me las tomé en un día de presentación que tenía en la noche, lastimosamente el baile no se pudo hacer, porque se fué la luz, así que este lindo maquillaje no lo pudo apreciar la audiencia pero sí aprovecho de mostrarlo por acá, es un ahumado sin mucho que agregar, con un poco de highlight en el lagrimal del ojo, me gustó mucho compartir estás fotos y espero que a ustedes les haya gustado, si tienen tips, sería de mucha ayuda un saludo a todos.
<center>


![photo_4936476771566594757_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/243MHgc6wWxWkEeujvJf9xn7aiYoi1FFwzCJjpXTr6ZCwFcKK4JVw3zTUaXDBTZPjPh5C.jpg)


</center>

># <center><div class=\

> Hive/ MakeUpPower - Make-up for a night out by D-rock [Esp]-[Eng] - INSPIRATION >Hello, friends of Hive and this lovely community! This is my first time posting here; I just wanted to share these photos with you, as I did this make-up all by myself. Without having much experience with glam make-up, I have to say I don’t think it turned out too badly. I’m not aiming to be an expert, but I’d still like to learn more, as I’m a dancer and sometimes find myself in situations where I have to do my own make-up. >I’d never dare to do a tutorial, but I took these photos on the day of a performance I had in the evening. Unfortunately, the dance couldn’t go ahead because the power went out, so the audience couldn’t appreciate this lovely make-up, but I’m taking the opportunity to show it here. It’s a smoky eye with not much else to it, with a bit of highlighter in the inner corner of the eye. I really enjoyed sharing these photos and I hope you liked them too. If you have any tips, they’d be a great help. Best wishes to everyone.
*** ![PicsArt_05-10-01.07.40.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/23w38iCLMGT8m9Rzcq4Ed1HG7HFvvGWS9stepeZxnqhpCY1NJceoLKY7BNKGLxMGKHwFb.jpg)

body.title: finally decided open them today
body.body:
Today was  really happy day for me. I had been saving up guild packs for a while and finally decided open them today. There is a special kind excitement in opening guild packs, because you never know when a card will come out. The moment you open each pack, it feels like a new surprise is waiting. And be honest, I am quite happy wit cards I received today. Some of the cards are already in my collection, but getting them again will increase their power, and some cards have brought a completely new experience.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQThRCkfZ7YzQMWay7zNpJewK53PbDJnfrZ6DRvGJAu7P/1779593706683.png)

In the first picture, I received several strong and balanced cards. The “Hugo Strongsword” card caught my eye the most. This card has both good attack and defense. Especially when used in the mid lineup, it can put pressure on the opponent. In addition, the “Witch of Warwick” card also looked great. As mysterious as it looks, its power is also quite effective. I usually like cards that are not only strong, but also give a different fantasy feel to them. This card is exactly that.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPd16c6guPhMxfobngsLxiF9otZWP4sDpLmLBuy2bxC9Q/1779593581588.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcuCsSAXv9Qp8jwbcoy7Le7337RiVb7kHph1B6r53WSAs/1779593581453.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVSNSn8fmy9acoLD8Gnnqj4rH5qh3ETxxgQRQLq5APL7n/1779593581516.jpg)

 In addition, I was also very happy to get the “Krash Wanderford” card. Because its speed and attack combination are very good. This type of card is very effective for quickly attacking and putting pressure on the opponent. On the other hand, the card named “Alva The Crusher” seems to be as powerful as its name. Just looking at this character standing with a huge hammer, it is clear that it will work great on the frontline. It seems that it will not be easily defeated due to its high health. And the “Liza Fox” card was one of the most interesting cards for me. The feeling of getting a Rare card is different. The design and style of this card impressed me a lot.

In the second picture, I again got some extraordinary cards. Although the “Helmet Kharafax” card looks very simple, its skills can be very useful. Being a low-manner card, it can provide a good advantage in small-manner matches. I personally like cards that offer good performance at a low cost. In addition, the “Chimney Wallstop” card is huge, so at first glance it seemed like a strong tank card.  Its high health and defense can be a big obstacle for the opponent.

The most special card in this picture was “Kotriphus Bayne”. I was really happy after getting it because it is a Rare card. Since its health is very high it can last on field for  long time. This type card can change the pace of the match. On the other hand, the “Ajax Lightfoot” card looks like a very fast character. Its attack and speed combined make it very effective. I think I will use this card in a speed-based team in the future.

There are also some good cards in the third picture. I was quite happy to get “Witch of Warwick” and “Alva The Crusher” again. Getting  same card multiple times is not a bad thing, because it creates an opportunity  upgrade the card. Card upgrades are very important  be strong in game. So getting the same card again is rather positive for me.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdpjAoBYhi74e8yG4SMY8Qmjzta3Gb7MwFJy9tJYkLYSN/1779593535790.jpg)

The most interesting card in this picture was “Cutter Brize”. This card with a green background looks completely.The “Bertrol Gobson” card is also quite interesting. Even though it is a small manor, it can be used as a support unit. And the design of the “Isgald Vorst” card impressed me the most. With a sword in hand, this character looks like a royal warrior. This type of card increases interest in games.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd7873ownsoTEejT7qTHActbv2jdTirmzadmXVNyqbZjJ/1779593535901.jpg)

The entire pack opening experience today was very enjoyable for me. While opening each pack, I felt like I might get something better this time. The moments of getting Rare cards were the most exciting. Because Rare cards always make the collection more valuable. I always try to gradually strengthen my deck, and today's cards will help a lot in that journey.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4xU7ADawRzwFRHmKiL9QYmDRyvDwqCKmx6Ztconvm8s/1779593536082.jpg)

Another fun aspect of opening a guild pack is that it is not only for the game, but also gives mental pleasure. The feeling of getting a new card is like receiving a gift. Especially when there are cards that I wanted in advance, the joy increases even more. In today's pack opening, I not only got strong cards, but also got many beautifully designed cards.  The artwork on each card is so beautiful that its nice  look at them individually.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeGvcU1d7VyjqejPaRRHnYEvvYYPYV9FfxTLJqyC853tg/1779593535991.jpg)

I think the real fun game is not just in winning, but in these kinds experiences. Collecting new cards, planning them, thinking about which cards use on which team—the whole thing is very exciting. These cards today will definitely play an important role in my future battles.

 I got a lot beautiful and useful cards, which have enriched my collection. Now my goal will be to gradually upgrade these cards and build a stronger team. Hopefully, I will have a better pack opening experience in the future and be able to collect more awesome Rare and powerful cards.

body.title: Memories of my youth:  Trying a lot of drugs but not really being a \
of any of them
body.body:
I think that drugs have a real chance to ruin some people and then there are other people that will have a go at them, find them ok, have a good time on them, but then also realize that this is something that can be very damaging to their ability to operate and then just opt out of using them in the future.  

I know a few people whose lives were turned upside down by addiction and therefore I want to let everyone know that I am in no way advocating for drug use.  I can see the danger.  I just think that there is a certain type of person out there that has an addictive personality and if it wasn't for the illegal drugs getting them all out of whacks it would be something else.  The people I know that destroyed lives with drugs were really unreliable and kind of failures even before drugs stepped into the picture so it wasn't actually all that surprising when they took it to an extreme.  Rather than focus on them I would prefer to focus on myself because I have a much clearer image of that.

<center> https://media1.tenor.com/m/pN1WOqW2ZG4AAAAC/drugs-are-bad-drugs.gif
[src](https://media1.tenor.com/m/pN1WOqW2ZG4AAAAC/drugs-are-bad-drugs.gif)</center> 

When I was in high school I wasn't really very much into partying.  I was kind of a nerd and enjoyed sports.  I also had a pretty strict family life so the idea of rolling around in a field all night while my parents thought I was at a sleepover wasn't something I would have been able to get away with.  I didn't really even enjoy drinking and would be one of those straight-edge kids at a party that on the rare occasion that the police would raid the place, I would be the person calmly walking towards them, because I knew I hadn't done anything wrong.  Other kids were jumping out of windows and over fences and I just walked up and said \

I knew people that smoked a bunch of weed in high school and especially in college but I never really took to it because I am one of those people that became paranoid about my own behavior when I was stoned because I would get the giggles and also lose my train of thought really easily.  I guess I don't really like the way that it makes me feel slow.  I'm not a super active guy anymore and I have some friends that will bring a joint over that we have a few puffs on the porch with, but getting stoned off of weed was never really my thing.   I don't think I have ever actually purchased any of it.   

Acid and Mushrooms I did both of them one time.  This stuff seriously took me out of the game, so to speak, and debilitated me to the point where I felt really silly about how I was behaving afterwards although at the time I couldn't really help it.  I guess I don't like being like that because of the sense of shame that I felt afterwards because most people are a completely different person on hallucinogenics... I was anyway so those were both a once only sort of thing.

Ecstasy was really a big deal when I was in college and I had mixed experiences with this.  On one hand it could be a lot of fun and really opened up the senses.  It was pretty handy if there were a bunch of girls that were also doing them with you and no, I don't mean this in a rapey way.   I'll let you fill in the blanks there on your own but the reason why I never really did this all that much and found it easy to say no to was because if you got ones that were good, it was a really long commitment.   I would say you are going to be in that \

for 4-8 hours on a good pill and I don't like to be committed to anything that you cannot possibly get out of for that long an amount of time.\n\nI had a run in with meth one time and that was enough to convince me that this drug is truly dangerous.  It's just a dirty high and it feels nervous, if that makes sense.  Plus the total inability to sleep for long stretches of time afterwards an the fact that the next day or perhaps 2 days are completely destroyed because of it is all the reason that I ever needed to stay away from that shit.   The two people I know that seriously screwed up their lives with drugs were both meth-heads.  If you listen to only one piece of \

advice listen to the part about staying away from meth.  Not only does it have more cons than pros but it also is from dubious origin.  There isn't exactly a lot of quality control in the meth world and you never really know what you are getting.  Now that we have whatever that super dangerous chemical that is killing people left and right in the mix these days as well, it's just to dangerous and has more of a \

feel to it than any of the other ones.

I never tried heroin nor knew anyone that has in a needles sense.  That's a level of crazy that I never wanted anything to do with and if anyone had so much as suggested it to me I would have seriously reevaluated our friendship.  

<center> https://www.bam.org/globalassets/programs/cinema/2026fy/0725/nyc-2000s/requiem-for-a-dream.jpg
[src](https://www.bam.org/globalassets/programs/cinema/2026fy/0725/nyc-2000s/requiem-for-a-dream.jpg)</center>

Watch the film \

to have a powerful look at heroin addiction.   

The only drug that I ever did that kind of appealed to me and I actually sought out a few times in my adult life was cocaine.  While I do not advocate for the use of any drugs (or even alcohol for that matter) I can see why it is that people enjoy cocaine.  It puts you on a different plane intellectually and just makes everyone more suave.  you have no fear and you are logical as well as smooth and witty.  At least that was the case with me.  It also makes everything you do more fun.  

I think my favorite part about cocaine was that once you did some of it, you got really high for around an hour and then you either did more of it or you came back down.  This is just the right amount of commitment for me.  You can go and have an absolute blast for a couple of hours and then call it a day.  It is also extremely expensive so anyone other than the most irresponsible person is going to only dabble in it every now and then.   

One of the downsides about acquiring this drug in USA anyway, is that there are a lot of scammers out there that load it up with things that are meant to grow the weight and therefore the profits but the ingredients don't actually do anything except make you need to use the bathroom.   

<hr>

in all of these things I never let any of this screw up my work or school life.  I didn't get a multi-day hangover from any of these other than the one time I did meth and that was enough to convince me to never do it again.  I suspect this is why the people who do meth do it *all the time* because the only way that they can feel not terrible is to do more meth.  That's not a good thing at all now, is it?   

I am happy that I tried all of them and had the willpower to not get hooked.  Now when someone talks about these drugs I don't have the Mr. Mackey approach of \

I have more of an informed way of thinking about it.  \n\nLike most people I have a few friends that are very functional on weed and they seem to be stoned basically all the time.  I have not seen a negative impact on my friends that are like this but I do think there is a danger there.  Those catch-phrases about it being a gateway drug is absolutely true because it's always the one that people do first before moving on to the \

I don't regret my drug use and I think it says something at least somewhat good about me that even though I was at maximum stoopid between the ages of 17 and 24 or so, I still had the presence of mind to know that all of these things should be used sparingly.   I never really even think about using these days and will even pass on grass most of the time when it is offered to me, which isn't often.   People don't get involved with drugs nearly as frequently once they are past the age of say, 35 or so.   

What about you?  got any experiences or stories to share?

那天在摊贩那里买到了发苦的榴莲，然后商家不予受理，我就打了12315，通过语音提示在南宁12345小程序或者公众号进行投诉受理，然后提交表单之后过了一两天我就收到了市民热线的电话，说让我告诉他事发地点是具体在哪里。

不同的地点管辖部门不一样。然后刚好是桥上，我自认为是桥上。他问我在桥的哪一边，一边归属于江南区，一边归属于青秀区。我当时也是瞎逛逛到那边去的，我怎么会知道是哪一面。

后面我打开地图看了半天告诉他桥的那么旁边是什么公园。然后他觉得我说的不够具体，继续追问我行驶路线，后面还吵起来了。

我说这个是路边摊贩，他随时会走动，问在哪里也没有什么用呢。为何不直接联系那个人，因为我也提供了联系方式。

他们就说他们不会随便联系那个商家，要先确认清楚事发地点啥的。。。。 。。
